abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那辆旧车丢弃在路边。

abate.example: The storm began to abate after midnight, and the streets became safe again.
abate.exampleZh: 午夜过后风暴开始减弱，街道又变得安全了。

abbreviation.example: The abbreviation for this word is easy to remember.
abbreviation.exampleZh: 这个单词的缩写很容易记住。

abdicate.example: The old king decided to abdicate the throne and let his son rule.
abdicate.exampleZh: 老国王决定退位，让他的儿子统治。

abdomen.example: The doctor gently pressed my abdomen to see if it hurt.
abdomen.exampleZh: 医生轻轻按压我的腹部，看看是否疼痛。

abduct.example: The police arrested the man who tried to abduct a young child.
abduct.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了那个试图绑架一名幼童的男子。

abide.example: I cannot abide the loud noise from the street every night.
abide.exampleZh: 我无法忍受每晚街上传来的吵闹声。

ability.example: She has the ability to solve difficult problems quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有快速解决难题的能力。

abject.example: The poor family lived in abject poverty for many years.
abject.exampleZh: 这户贫穷的家庭多年来生活在赤贫之中。

abnormal.example: His abnormal behavior worried all of us at the party last night.
abnormal.exampleZh: 昨晚在聚会上，他反常的行为让我们大家都很担心。

aboard.example: All the passengers were safely aboard the ship before it left the port.
aboard.exampleZh: 所有乘客在船离开港口前都安全上船了。

abode.example: They found a small abode near the river and lived there happily.
abode.exampleZh: 他们在河边找到一个小住所，并在那里快乐地生活。

abolish.example: Many people want to abolish the old law because it is unfair.
abolish.exampleZh: 许多人想要废除那条不公平的旧法律。

abominable.example: The cold weather here is abominable and makes everyone unhappy.
abominable.exampleZh: 这里的寒冷天气很可恶，让每个人都不开心。

aborigine.example: The aborigine told us a story about the old river.
aborigine.exampleZh: 那位土著居民给我们讲了一个关于这条古老河流的故事。

abort.example: They decided to abort the plan because the weather was too bad.
abort.exampleZh: 他们决定中止这个计划，因为天气太糟糕了。

abortion.example: The law about abortion is still a serious issue in many countries.
abortion.exampleZh: 关于堕胎的法律在许多国家仍然是一个严重的问题。

abound.example: Fish abound in this clear river near our small town.
abound.exampleZh: 我们小镇附近这条清澈的河里鱼很多。

about.example: I am not sure about the answer to your question.
about.exampleZh: 我不确定你问题的答案。

above.example: The bird is flying above the tall tree in our garden.
above.exampleZh: 那只鸟正在我们花园里的高树上方飞翔。

abroad.example: She wants to study abroad after she finishes high school next year.
abroad.exampleZh: 她想明年高中毕业后去国外留学。

abrogate.example: The new government decided to abrogate the old law last year.
abrogate.exampleZh: 新政府去年决定废除那条旧法律。

abrupt.example: The car came to an abrupt stop at the red light.
abrupt.exampleZh: 汽车在红灯处突然停下。

abscond.example: The thief tried to abscond with the money before the police arrived.
abscond.exampleZh: 小偷在警察到达前试图带着钱潜逃。

absence.example: His absence from the meeting made everyone wonder where he was.
absence.exampleZh: 他缺席会议让大家都想知道他去了哪里。

absent.example: He was absent from school yesterday because he felt very sick.
absent.exampleZh: 他昨天没去上学，因为他觉得很不舒服。

absentee.example: The teacher marked the absentee in her notebook after the morning bell rang.
absentee.exampleZh: 早铃响后，老师在笔记本上记下了那名缺席者。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the small country.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对这个小国的所有人拥有绝对权力。

absolve.example: The judge decided to absolve the young man of all charges.
absolve.exampleZh: 法官决定免除这个年轻人的所有指控。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water and nutrients from the soil through their roots.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收水分和养分。

abstain.example: Doctors say you should abstain from sugar if you want to stay healthy.
abstain.exampleZh: 医生说如果你想保持健康，就应该戒糖。

abstemious.example: He is abstemious with food and money, so he saves a lot.
abstemious.exampleZh: 他在饮食和花钱上很有节制，因此存了不少钱。

abstract.example: The idea is too abstract for most young students to understand clearly.
abstract.exampleZh: 这个想法对大多数年轻学生来说太抽象，难以清楚理解。

abstruse.example: The professor's abstruse explanation confused most students in the class today.
abstruse.exampleZh: 教授深奥的解释让今天班上大多数学生感到困惑。

absurd.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for our own poor planning.
absurd.exampleZh: 把我们自己糟糕的规划归咎于天气是荒谬的。

abundance.example: There is an abundance of fresh fruit in the market this summer.
abundance.exampleZh: 今年夏天市场上新鲜水果供应充足。

abundant.example: Fresh water is abundant in this area during the rainy season.
abundant.exampleZh: 雨季时这个地区有丰富的淡水。

abuse.example: Parents should never abuse their children at home.
abuse.exampleZh: 父母绝不应该在家里虐待自己的孩子。

abyss.example: The small boat fell into a deep abyss in the dark sea.
abyss.exampleZh: 小船掉进了黑暗大海里的一个深渊。

academic.example: She has a strong academic background and teaches at a local university.
academic.exampleZh: 她有很强的学术背景，并在当地一所大学任教。

academy.example: My sister studies music at a famous academy in our city.
academy.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们城市一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accelerate.example: We must accelerate our work to finish the project on time.
accelerate.exampleZh: 我们必须加快工作，以便按时完成项目。

accent.example: She speaks English with a slight accent but everyone understands her clearly.
accent.exampleZh: 她说英语带一点口音，但每个人都能清楚地听懂她。

accept.example: I am happy to accept your kind invitation to dinner tonight.
accept.exampleZh: 我很高兴接受你今晚共进晚餐的盛情邀请。

access.example: Students can access the online library from home with a password.
access.exampleZh: 学生可以用密码在家访问在线图书馆。

accident.example: I had a small accident on my way to work today.
accident.exampleZh: 我今天上班路上出了个小事故。

acclaim.example: The young singer won great acclaim for her beautiful songs last night.
acclaim.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手昨晚因她美妙的歌曲赢得了极大的赞誉。

acclimate.example: It took him a few weeks to acclimate to the new job.
acclimate.exampleZh: 他花了几个星期才适应新工作。

accommodate.example: This hotel can accommodate up to two hundred guests.
accommodate.exampleZh: 这家酒店最多可容纳两百位客人。

accommodation.example: We found cheap accommodation near the train station for our trip.
accommodation.exampleZh: 我们为旅行在火车站附近找到了便宜的住处。

accompany.example: I will accompany my mother to the hospital tomorrow morning.
accompany.exampleZh: 明天早上我会陪母亲去医院。

accomplish.example: With hard work, we can accomplish our goals and help other people.
accomplish.exampleZh: 通过努力，我们能够实现目标并帮助他人。

accord.example: The two countries signed a peace accord after long talks.
accord.exampleZh: 两国在长期会谈后签署了一项和平协议。

account.example: I opened a new bank account and saved some money for my sister.
account.exampleZh: 我开了一个新的银行账户，为妹妹存了一些钱。

accrue.example: Interest will accrue on the loan if you do not pay it on time.
accrue.exampleZh: 如果你不按时还款，贷款就会产生利息。

accumulate.example: Dust can accumulate quickly on old books if you leave them alone.
accumulate.exampleZh: 如果你把旧书放在一边不管，灰尘会很快在上面积聚。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of this test is very important for our work.
accuracy.exampleZh: 这项测试的准确性对我们的工作非常重要。

accurate.example: This map is accurate and helps us find the right road.
accurate.exampleZh: 这张地图很准确，能帮助我们找到正确的路。

accuse.example: They accuse him of taking the money without any proof.
accuse.exampleZh: 他们没有任何证据就指责他拿了钱。

accustom.example: It takes time to accustom yourself to a new school.
accustom.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校需要时间。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to waking up early every morning.

ache.example: I have a dull ache in my back after sitting all day.
ache.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，我的背有一阵隐隐的疼痛。

achieve.example: She worked hard every day to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
achieve.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

acid.example: The acid in the lemon makes the fruit taste very sour.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬中的酸使这种水果尝起来很酸。

acknowledge.example: We should acknowledge her help and say thank you to her.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 我们应该承认她的帮助，并向她道谢。

acorn.example: A small squirrel found an acorn under the big tree.
acorn.exampleZh: 一只小松鼠在大树下找到了一颗橡子。

acoustic.example: The acoustic guitar sounds very warm and clear in this small room.
acoustic.exampleZh: 这把原声吉他在这个小房间里听起来非常温暖清晰。

acquaint.example: I will acquaint you with the new rules before you start.
acquaint.exampleZh: 我会在你开始前让你熟悉新规则。

acquire.example: You can acquire new skills by practicing a little every day.
acquire.exampleZh: 你可以通过每天练习一点来习得新技能。

acre.example: The farmer owns ten acres of land near the river.
acre.exampleZh: 这位农民在河边拥有十英亩土地。

acrobat.example: The acrobat climbed high and jumped through a small ring.
acrobat.exampleZh: 那名杂技演员爬得很高，并跳过了一个小圆环。

across.example: She walked across the street to buy some fresh bread at the shop.
across.exampleZh: 她穿过街道去商店买一些新鲜面包。

act.example: We must act now to protect our environment for future generations.
act.exampleZh: 我们现在必须采取行动，为子孙后代保护环境。

action.example: His quick action saved the child from danger.
action.exampleZh: 他的迅速行动救了那个孩子。

activate.example: You need to activate your account before you can use it.
activate.exampleZh: 你需要在使用前激活你的账户。

active.example: She stays active by walking to work and playing tennis every weekend.
active.exampleZh: 她通过步行上班和每周末打网球来保持活跃。

activist.example: The young activist spoke calmly to the crowd about clean water.
activist.exampleZh: 这位年轻的积极分子平静地向人群谈论清洁用水。

activity.example: The school has many fun activities for students after class.
activity.exampleZh: 学校课后为学生安排了许多有趣的活动。

actor.example: The actor gave a short speech after the play ended.
actor.exampleZh: 演出结束后，那位演员做了简短的发言。

actual.example: The actual cost was higher than the price we had expected.
actual.exampleZh: 实际费用比我们预期的价格更高。

acute.example: He felt an acute pain in his chest after running.
acute.exampleZh: 他跑步后感到胸口一阵剧痛。

adage.example: My grandmother often says an old adage about saving money for rainy days.
adage.exampleZh: 我奶奶常说一句关于存钱以备不时之需的老格言。

adapt.example: Students must adapt to new rules when they start a new school.
adapt.exampleZh: 学生在新学校开始时必须适应新规则。

add.example: Please add some milk to my coffee before you serve it.
add.exampleZh: 请在端上来之前给我的咖啡加一些牛奶。

addict.example: He became an addict after taking the drug for a long time.
addict.exampleZh: 他长期服用这种药物后成了成瘾者。

addition.example: In addition to math, she studies English and history at school every day.
addition.exampleZh: 除了数学，她每天在学校还学习英语和历史。

address.example: Please write your address on this form before you leave the office.
address.exampleZh: 请在离开办公室前把你的地址写在这张表格上。

adept.example: She is adept at solving simple problems quickly and calmly every day.
adept.exampleZh: 她擅长每天快速而冷静地解决简单问题。

adequate.example: The room was adequate for our small family and very comfortable.
adequate.exampleZh: 这个房间对我们的小家庭来说足够用，而且非常舒适。

adhere.example: We must adhere to the rules when we work together.
adhere.exampleZh: 我们一起工作时必须遵守规则。

adhesive.example: This adhesive tape is strong and can fix the broken box.
adhesive.exampleZh: 这种黏性胶带很结实，可以修好破了的盒子。

adjacent.example: The hotel is adjacent to the train station and a small park.
adjacent.exampleZh: 这家酒店毗邻火车站和一个小公园。

adjective.example: The teacher explained that an adjective describes a noun in a simple sentence.
adjective.exampleZh: 老师解释说，形容词在简单句中用来描述名词。

adjoin.example: The small garden adjoins our house, and it is very quiet.
adjoin.exampleZh: 这个小花园与我们的房子相邻，而且非常安静。

adjourn.example: The judge decided to adjourn the meeting until next Monday morning.
adjourn.exampleZh: 法官决定将会议延期至下周一上午。

adjunct.example: The small room is an adjunct to the main office.
adjunct.exampleZh: 这个小房间是主办公室的附属物。

adjust.example: You can adjust the chair to make it more comfortable.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以调节椅子，让它更舒服。

administer.example: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient this morning.
administer.exampleZh: 护士今天上午会给病人用药。

administration.example: The new administration promised to improve public services for every family in our city.
administration.exampleZh: 新政府承诺改善我们城市每个家庭的公共服务。

admiration.example: I have great admiration for my teacher because she works very hard.
admiration.exampleZh: 我非常钦佩我的老师，因为她工作非常努力。

admire.example: I admire her courage because she always helps other people in need.
admire.exampleZh: 我钦佩她的勇气，因为她总是帮助有需要的人。

admit.example: I admit that I made a mistake and I am sorry.
admit.exampleZh: 我承认我犯了一个错误，我很抱歉。

adobe.example: The old house was built with adobe bricks and a wooden roof.
adobe.exampleZh: 那座老房子是用土坯砖和木屋顶建造的。

adolescence.example: Many changes happen during adolescence as children grow into young adults.
adolescence.exampleZh: 当孩子成长为年轻人时，青春期会发生许多变化。

adolescent.example: Many adolescent students find it hard to talk to their parents.
adolescent.exampleZh: 许多青少年学生发现很难与父母交谈。

adopt.example: The company decided to adopt a new plan for the project.
adopt.exampleZh: 公司决定为这个项目采用一项新计划。

adore.example: Many young fans adore the singer and travel far to see her shows.
adore.exampleZh: 许多年轻粉丝崇拜这位歌手，并不远千里去看她的演出。

adorn.example: She will adorn the room with flowers for the party.
adorn.exampleZh: 她将用鲜花装饰房间，为聚会做准备。

adrenaline.example: His body released adrenaline when he heard the loud noise.
adrenaline.exampleZh: 听到巨响时，他的身体释放了肾上腺素。

advance.example: The army will advance at dawn to take the small town.
advance.exampleZh: 军队将在黎明时前进，以占领那个小镇。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living here is that everything is close.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在这里的一大优势是一切都很近。

advent.example: The advent of spring brings warm weather and bright flowers.
advent.exampleZh: 春天的到来带来了温暖的天气和鲜艳的花朵。

adventure.example: We went on a great adventure in the forest last summer.
adventure.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在森林里进行了一次很棒的冒险。

adversary.example: The brave knight finally defeated his old adversary in a fair fight.
adversary.exampleZh: 勇敢的骑士终于在公平的决斗中击败了他的老对手。

adverse.example: The bad weather had an adverse effect on our small garden.
adverse.exampleZh: 恶劣天气对我们的小花园产生了不利影响。

adversity.example: She stayed calm and strong when adversity came into her life.
adversity.exampleZh: 当逆境降临时，她保持冷静和坚强。

advertise.example: Many small shops advertise their new products on social media every day.
advertise.exampleZh: 许多小商店每天在社交媒体上宣传他们的新产品。

advice.example: My teacher gave me some good advice about how to study.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一些关于如何学习的好建议。

advisable.example: It is advisable to drink enough water every day.
advisable.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水是明智的。

advise.example: I advise you to see a doctor before your cold gets worse.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你在感冒加重前去看医生。

advocate.example: Many people advocate clean water for every child in the world.
advocate.exampleZh: 许多人提倡为世界上每个孩子提供清洁的水。

aerial.example: The aerial on the roof helps us get a clear television signal.
aerial.exampleZh: 屋顶上的天线帮助我们获得清晰的电视信号。

aesthetic.example: The new library has a simple aesthetic that makes people feel calm.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 新图书馆有一种简洁的美感，让人感到平静。

affable.example: Our new neighbor is an affable man who always greets everyone warmly.
affable.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居是一位和蔼可亲的人，他总是热情地和每个人打招呼。

affair.example: The whole affair was a small mistake, but it taught us a useful lesson.
affair.exampleZh: 整件事只是一个小错误，但它给我们上了有用的一课。

affect.example: The bad weather can affect our plans for the school trip.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣天气可能会影响我们学校旅行的计划。

affection.example: She showed great affection for the little dog in the park.
affection.exampleZh: 她对公园里的小狗表现出极大的喜爱。

affiliate.example: Our small team will affiliate with a larger company next year.
affiliate.exampleZh: 我们的小团队明年将加入一家更大的公司。

affirm.example: The teacher will affirm that our plan is good and safe.
affirm.exampleZh: 老师会确认我们的计划是好的且安全的。

affix.example: Please affix the label to the box before you send it.
affix.exampleZh: 请在寄出前把标签贴到箱子上。

afflict.example: The old man is afflicted by a bad cough every winter.
afflict.exampleZh: 这位老人每年冬天都受严重咳嗽的折磨。

affluence.example: Their affluence lets the family buy good food and a bigger house.
affluence.exampleZh: 他们的富裕使这家人能买好食物和更大的房子。

affluent.example: The affluent family lives in a big house near the park.
affluent.exampleZh: 这个富裕的家庭住在公园附近的一栋大房子里。

afford.example: Many families cannot afford a new house in this city.
afford.exampleZh: 许多家庭在这座城市买不起新房子。

afraid.example: I am afraid of big dogs, so I stay away from them.
afraid.exampleZh: 我怕大狗，所以远离它们。

after.example: We went home after the movie ended and ate dinner together.
after.exampleZh: 电影结束后我们回家一起吃了晚饭。

aftermath.example: The town slowly rebuilt its homes in the aftermath of the storm.
aftermath.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，小镇慢慢重建了家园。

afternoon.example: I will go to the park with my friends this afternoon.
afternoon.exampleZh: 今天下午我会和朋友们去公园。

afterward.example: We ate dinner and afterward we watched a movie at home.
afterward.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，之后在家看了一部电影。

again.example: I read the letter again because I wanted to understand it better.
again.exampleZh: 我又读了一遍这封信，因为我想更好地理解它。

against.example: Many people voted against the new plan at the meeting yesterday.
against.exampleZh: 昨天会议上许多人投票反对这项新计划。

age.example: People often learn new skills and gain wisdom as they age.
age.exampleZh: 人们随着年龄增长，常常会学习新技能并获得智慧。

agency.example: The travel agency helped us book a cheap flight to Paris.
agency.exampleZh: 这家旅行社帮我们预订了飞往巴黎的便宜航班。

agenda.example: The meeting agenda is on the table for everyone to read.
agenda.exampleZh: 会议议程在桌上供大家阅读。

agent.example: The travel agent helped us book a simple trip to the beach.
agent.exampleZh: 旅行社代理人帮我们预订了一趟简单的海滩之旅。

aggravate.example: Lack of sleep can aggravate your health problems and make you feel worse.
aggravate.exampleZh: 缺乏睡眠会加重你的健康问题，让你感觉更糟。

aggregate.example: The aggregate cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
aggregate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要高。

aggressive.example: The aggressive dog barked at the mailman and scared the little children.
aggressive.exampleZh: 那只好斗的狗对着邮递员叫，吓坏了小孩子们。

agile.example: Our small team is agile enough to change plans quickly when needed.
agile.exampleZh: 我们的小团队足够敏捷，能在需要时迅速改变计划。

agitate.example: The loud noise began to agitate the baby in the next room.
agitate.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音开始让隔壁房间的婴儿变得烦躁。

ago.example: I moved to this city two years ago with my family.
ago.exampleZh: 两年前我和家人搬到了这座城市。

agony.example: She cried out in agony when she broke her leg.
agony.exampleZh: 她摔断腿时痛苦地大叫。

agree.example: I agree with you, and we can start the work today.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你的看法，我们今天可以开始这项工作。

agreeable.example: The weather was agreeable, so we took a long walk in the park.
agreeable.exampleZh: 天气宜人，所以我们在公园里散了很久的步。

agreement.example: The two sides finally reached an agreement after a long and friendly talk.
agreement.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好交谈，双方终于达成了协议。

agriculture.example: My grandfather works in agriculture and grows rice and vegetables on his farm.
agriculture.exampleZh: 我的祖父从事农业，在他的农场里种植水稻和蔬菜。

ahead.example: We finished the work ahead of time and went home early.
ahead.exampleZh: 我们提前完成了工作，然后早早回家了。

aid.example: The nurse gave first aid to the injured boy before the doctor arrived.
aid.exampleZh: 护士在医生到来之前给受伤的男孩进行了急救。

aim.example: We aim to finish the project before the end of this week.
aim.exampleZh: 我们旨在本周结束前完成这个项目。

air.example: The fresh air in the mountains made us feel calm and happy.
air.exampleZh: 山里的新鲜空气让我们感到平静而快乐。

aircraft.example: The aircraft landed safely on the runway after a long flight.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架飞机在长途飞行后安全降落在跑道上。

airline.example: The airline lost my bag, but it found it the next day.
airline.exampleZh: 航空公司弄丢了我的包，但第二天又找到了。

airport.example: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight left.
airport.exampleZh: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达了机场。

aisle.example: She walked down the aisle to find her seat on the plane.
aisle.exampleZh: 她沿着过道走过去，找到了自己在飞机上的座位。

alarm.example: The fire alarm woke everyone up early this morning.
alarm.exampleZh: 今天早上火灾警报把大家都吵醒了。

album.example: I put our holiday photos in a new album yesterday.
album.exampleZh: 我昨天把我们的假期照片放进了一本新相册。

alchemy.example: The old book about alchemy made him dream of magic and gold.
alchemy.exampleZh: 那本关于炼金术的旧书让他梦想着魔法和黄金。

alcohol.example: You should not drink too much alcohol before you drive a car.
alcohol.exampleZh: 你应该在开车前不要喝太多酒。

alert.example: The guard stayed alert all night and watched the gate carefully.
alert.exampleZh: 警卫整夜保持警觉，并仔细看守大门。

algebra.example: I find algebra easier when I practice solving simple equations every day.
algebra.exampleZh: 我发现每天练习解简单方程时，代数会更容易。

alien.example: The strange light in the sky came from an alien spaceship.
alien.exampleZh: 天空中奇怪的光来自一艘外星飞船。

align.example: We need to align our plans before the meeting starts tomorrow.
align.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前使我们的计划保持一致。

alike.example: The two brothers look very much alike and share the same smile.
alike.exampleZh: 这两兄弟长得很像，而且有着同样的笑容。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive after the long cold winter.
alive.exampleZh: 那棵老树在漫长的寒冬之后仍然活着。

all.example: All the students in my class work hard and help each other every day.
all.exampleZh: 我班所有学生每天都很努力并互相帮助。

allegation.example: The police are investigating a serious allegation against the local manager.
allegation.exampleZh: 警方正在调查针对当地经理的一项严重指控。

allege.example: The police allege that he stole money from the small shop last night.
allege.exampleZh: 警方声称他昨晚从那家小商店偷了钱。

allegiance.example: The soldiers swore allegiance to their country and promised to defend it.
allegiance.exampleZh: 士兵们宣誓效忠国家，并承诺保卫它。

allergy.example: She has a serious allergy to peanuts and must avoid all nuts.
allergy.exampleZh: 她对花生有严重的过敏症，必须避免所有坚果。

alleviate.example: The doctor gave him medicine to alleviate the pain in his back.
alleviate.exampleZh: 医生给他药以减轻他背部的疼痛。

alley.example: The old man walked slowly down the narrow alley to his small home.
alley.exampleZh: 那位老人沿着狭窄的小巷慢慢走回他小小的家。

alliance.example: The two countries formed an alliance to protect each other from danger.
alliance.exampleZh: 两国结成联盟以保护彼此免受危险。

allocate.example: The school will allocate more money to buy books for the new students.
allocate.exampleZh: 学校将拨出更多钱为新学生买书。

allot.example: We will allot ten minutes to each student for the test.
allot.exampleZh: 我们将给每个学生分配十分钟用于测试。

allow.example: My parents allow me to play games after I finish my homework.
allow.exampleZh: 我父母允许我完成作业后玩游戏。

allowance.example: My monthly allowance helps me pay for books and bus tickets.
allowance.exampleZh: 每月的津贴帮我支付书本和公交车票的费用。

alloy.example: This alloy is strong and light enough for making bicycle frames.
alloy.exampleZh: 这种合金足够坚固且轻，适合制作自行车车架。

ally.example: A true ally supports you when times are hard and stays by your side.
ally.exampleZh: 真正的盟友会在困难时期支持你，并陪伴在你身边。

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning because I woke up late.
almost.exampleZh: 今天早上我差点错过公交车，因为我起晚了。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the river.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在河边的一所小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked about our plans for next week.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边散步，聊了聊下周的计划。

alongside.example: She walked alongside her friend and talked about their weekend plans.
alongside.exampleZh: 她和朋友并肩走着，聊着周末的计划。

aloof.example: The new student seemed aloof at first but soon made friends.
aloof.exampleZh: 新同学起初显得冷漠，但很快就交到了朋友。

aloud.example: Please read the story aloud so everyone in the room can hear you.
aloud.exampleZh: 请把故事大声读出来，让房间里的每个人都能听见。

alphabet.example: The English alphabet has twenty-six letters that children learn in school.
alphabet.exampleZh: 英语字母表有二十六个字母，孩子们在学校学习它们。

already.example: She has already finished her homework and now she is playing outside.
already.exampleZh: 她已经完成了作业，现在正在外面玩。

also.example: She likes tea, and she also likes coffee after lunch.
also.exampleZh: 她喜欢茶，午饭后也喜欢咖啡。

altar.example: The priest stood quietly in front of the old stone altar.
altar.exampleZh: 牧师静静地站在古老的石祭坛前。

alter.example: We had to alter our plans because the weather suddenly got much worse.
alter.exampleZh: 由于天气突然变得差很多，我们不得不改变计划。

alternate.example: We alternate between work and rest every two hours.
alternate.exampleZh: 我们每两个小时交替工作和休息。

alternative.example: We need an alternative plan because the first one is too expensive.
alternative.exampleZh: 我们需要一个替代方案，因为第一个方案太贵了。

although.example: Although it was raining, we still went for a short walk outside.
although.exampleZh: 虽然当时在下雨，我们还是去外面短距离散步了。

altitude.example: The plane is flying at a high altitude above the clouds.
altitude.exampleZh: 飞机正在云层上方的高海拔处飞行。

altogether.example: The whole trip cost altogether about two hundred dollars and we enjoyed it.
altogether.exampleZh: 这次整个旅行总共花了大约两百美元，我们玩得很开心。

altruistic.example: She is an altruistic person who always helps others without expecting anything in return.
altruistic.exampleZh: 她是一个总是帮助别人而不求回报的无私的人。

aluminum.example: The aluminum can is light and easy to carry.
aluminum.exampleZh: 这个铝罐很轻，便于携带。

always.example: She always helps her friends when they need her.
always.exampleZh: 当她的朋友需要帮助时，她总是帮助他们。

amateur.example: He is an amateur photographer who takes pictures for fun on weekends.
amateur.exampleZh: 他是一名业余摄影师，周末拍照只是为了好玩。

amaze.example: The magic show will amaze all the children at the party.
amaze.exampleZh: 这场魔术表演会让派对上的所有孩子感到惊奇。

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the students and gave a short talk about peace.
ambassador.exampleZh: 大使会见了学生们，并做了一个关于和平的简短讲话。

ambient.example: The ambient noise in the library made it hard to focus.
ambient.exampleZh: 图书馆里的环境噪音让我很难集中注意力。

ambiguous.example: His answer was ambiguous, so we did not know what he meant.
ambiguous.exampleZh: 他的回答模棱两可，所以我们不知道他是什么意思。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in need.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助有需要的人。

ambitious.example: She is an ambitious young woman who wants to start her own company.
ambitious.exampleZh: 她是一位有抱负的年轻女性，想创办自己的公司。

amend.example: We need to amend the plan before the meeting starts tomorrow.
amend.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前修改这个计划。

amid.example: The children played happily amid the flowers in the garden.
amid.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园的花丛中快乐地玩耍。

ammunition.example: The soldiers carried enough ammunition for the long battle in the mountains.
ammunition.exampleZh: 士兵们为山中的漫长战斗携带了足够的弹药。

among.example: She found her keys among the books on the old wooden table.
among.exampleZh: 她在旧木桌上的书堆里找到了她的钥匙。

amount.example: The total amount of water in the bottle is two liters.
amount.exampleZh: 瓶子里水的总量是两升。

ample.example: The garden has ample space for children to play and run.
ample.exampleZh: 这个花园有足够的空间供孩子们玩耍和奔跑。

amplify.example: The new speaker can amplify the music so everyone can hear it.
amplify.exampleZh: 新扬声器可以放大音乐，让每个人都能听到。

amuse.example: The funny cartoon amused the children for the whole afternoon.
amuse.exampleZh: 这部有趣的动画片把孩子们逗乐了一整个下午。

analogy.example: A good analogy can make a hard idea easy for students to understand.
analogy.exampleZh: 一个好的类比能让困难的概念变得容易让学生理解。

analysis.example: Her careful analysis of the problem helped the team find a simple solution.
analysis.exampleZh: 她对问题的仔细分析帮助团队找到了一个简单的解决办法。

analyze.example: We need to analyze the data before we make a final decision.
analyze.exampleZh: 我们需要在做出最终决定之前分析这些数据。

anatomy.example: Studying anatomy helps students understand how the human body works.
anatomy.exampleZh: 学习解剖学帮助学生理解人体是如何运作的。

ancestor.example: My ancestor came from a small village many years ago.
ancestor.exampleZh: 我的祖先很多年前来自一个小村庄。

anchor.example: The ship dropped its anchor near the small island and waited for help.
anchor.exampleZh: 船在小岛附近抛锚，等待救援。

ancient.example: We saw many ancient buildings on our trip to Rome.
ancient.exampleZh: 我们在罗马之行中看到了许多古老的建筑。

anecdote.example: My grandfather often tells a funny anecdote about his first day at work.
anecdote.exampleZh: 我祖父经常讲一个关于他第一天上班的搞笑趣闻。

angle.example: We looked at the problem from a different angle and found a simple answer.
angle.exampleZh: 我们从不同的角度看待这个问题，并找到了一个简单的答案。

angry.example: He felt angry when his little brother broke his favorite toy.
angry.exampleZh: 当他弟弟弄坏他最喜欢的玩具时，他感到很生气。

animal.example: The animal is very big and it lives in the forest.
animal.exampleZh: 这只动物很大，它生活在森林里。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing basketball with my friends yesterday.
ankle.exampleZh: 我昨天和朋友们打篮球时伤了脚踝。

annex.example: The country tried to annex the small island despite strong international opposition.
annex.exampleZh: 该国不顾强烈的国际反对，试图吞并这个小岛。

anniversary.example: We plan to celebrate our tenth wedding anniversary with a small family dinner.
anniversary.exampleZh: 我们打算用一顿小型家庭晚餐来庆祝结婚十周年纪念日。

announce.example: The school will announce the new class schedule tomorrow morning.
announce.exampleZh: 学校将在明天上午宣布新的课程安排。

annoy.example: Loud music late at night can annoy your neighbors and cause problems.
annoy.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐可能会惹恼邻居并引发麻烦。

annual.example: The company holds an annual meeting for all its workers in May.
annual.exampleZh: 公司在五月为所有员工举行年度会议。

anonymous.example: The anonymous writer sent a letter to the local newspaper last week.
anonymous.exampleZh: 那位匿名作者上周给当地报纸寄了一封信。

another.example: I finished one book and now I want to read another.
another.exampleZh: 我读完了一本书，现在想再读一本。

answer.example: Please answer my question before the meeting starts this afternoon.
answer.exampleZh: 请在今天下午会议开始前回答我的问题。

antenna.example: The small bug uses its antenna to find food at night.
antenna.exampleZh: 这只小虫子用它的触角在夜间寻找食物。

anthem.example: The national anthem played loudly before the big game began.
anthem.exampleZh: 大型比赛开始前，国歌响亮地奏响。

anticipate.example: We anticipate a small rise in prices next month.
anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预期下个月价格会小幅上涨。

antique.example: She bought an antique chair at a small shop near her home.
antique.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一家小店里买了一把古董椅子。

anxiety.example: Many students feel great anxiety before they take a big exam.
anxiety.exampleZh: 许多学生在参加大考前会感到非常焦虑。

anxious.example: She feels anxious before every exam, but she still studies hard.
anxious.exampleZh: 她每次考试前都感到焦虑，但她仍然努力学习。

any.example: Do you have any questions about the lesson today?
any.exampleZh: 你对今天的课有任何问题吗？

anybody.example: Anybody can learn to cook simple meals with a little practice.
anybody.exampleZh: 任何人只要稍加练习都能学会做简单的饭菜。

anyhow.example: Anyhow, we should leave now before the rain gets heavier.
anyhow.exampleZh: 无论如何，我们应该在雨变大之前离开。

anyone.example: Anyone can join the club if they pay the small fee.
anyone.exampleZh: 任何人只要支付少量费用就可以加入这个俱乐部。

anything.example: You can ask me anything if you need help with your homework.
anything.exampleZh: 如果你做作业需要帮助，你可以问我任何事。

anyway.example: I was tired, but I went to the party anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 我很累，但还是去参加聚会了。

anywhere.example: You can sit anywhere you like in this big room.
anywhere.exampleZh: 你可以在这个大房间里随便坐在任何地方。

apart.example: They live apart now, but they still talk every day.
apart.exampleZh: 他们现在分开住了，但仍然每天交谈。

apartment.example: They live in a small apartment near the train station.
apartment.exampleZh: 他们住在火车站附近的一间小公寓里。

apologize.example: I want to apologize to you for my mistake yesterday.
apologize.exampleZh: 我想为我昨天的错误向你道歉。

apology.example: She gave him a sincere apology for arriving late to the meeting.
apology.exampleZh: 她为开会迟到向他真诚道歉。

apparatus.example: The laboratory has new apparatus for measuring the temperature of water.
apparatus.exampleZh: 实验室有测量水温的新设备。

apparel.example: She bought new apparel for the winter season.

apparent.example: It was apparent that she was very tired after the long trip.
apparent.exampleZh: 很明显，长途旅行后她非常疲惫。

appeal.example: The new park will appeal to families with young children.
appeal.exampleZh: 这个新公园会吸引有小孩的家庭。

appear.example: A strange light appeared in the sky just before the storm began.
appear.exampleZh: 暴风雨开始前，天空中突然出现了一道奇怪的光。

appearance.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised all of us.
appearance.exampleZh: 她突然出现在聚会上，让我们所有人都很惊讶。

appetite.example: I have no appetite for dinner because I ate a big lunch today.
appetite.exampleZh: 我晚饭没有胃口，因为今天午饭吃得很饱。

applaud.example: The audience stood up to applaud the young singer after her song.
applaud.exampleZh: 那位年轻歌手唱完后，观众站起来为她鼓掌。

applause.example: The audience gave loud applause after the singer finished her song.
applause.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，观众给予了热烈的掌声。

appliance.example: The kitchen has a new appliance that makes cooking much easier for us.
appliance.exampleZh: 厨房里有一件新电器，让我们的烹饪轻松多了。

applicable.example: These rules are applicable to all students in our school.
applicable.exampleZh: 这些规则适用于我们学校的所有学生。

applicant.example: The applicant filled out the form and waited for a reply.
applicant.exampleZh: 申请人填好了表格，然后等待回复。

application.example: I sent my job application to the company last week.
application.exampleZh: 我上周把求职申请寄给了那家公司。

apply.example: You can apply for this job online before Friday.
apply.exampleZh: 你可以在周五之前在线申请这份工作。

appoint.example: The company will appoint a new manager next week.
appoint.exampleZh: 公司下周将任命一位新经理。

appointment.example: I have a dentist appointment at three o'clock this afternoon.
appointment.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点有一个牙医预约。

appraise.example: The teacher will appraise our work before the final exam.
appraise.exampleZh: 老师会在期末考试前评价我们的作业。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate your help with my homework today.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我非常感激你今天帮我做作业。

approach.example: We need a better approach to solve this problem together.
approach.exampleZh: 我们需要一个更好的方法来解决这个问题。

appropriate.example: It is not appropriate to wear shorts to a formal meeting.
appropriate.exampleZh: 穿短裤参加正式会议是不合适的。

approval.example: The manager gave his approval before we started the new project.
approval.exampleZh: 经理在我们开始新项目之前给予了批准。

approve.example: The manager will approve the new plan after he reads it.
approve.exampleZh: 经理读完后会批准这个新计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的大约费用是两百美元。

apron.example: The cook tied a clean apron around her waist before making dinner.
apron.exampleZh: 厨师在做晚饭前在腰间系了一条干净的围裙。

apt.example: She is apt to forget names when she meets many new people.
apt.exampleZh: 当她见到许多新朋友时，她容易忘记名字。

aptitude.example: She has a natural aptitude for learning new languages quickly.
aptitude.exampleZh: 她有快速学习新语言的天赋。

aquatic.example: Many aquatic plants grow in the shallow water near the shore.
aquatic.exampleZh: 许多水生植物生长在靠近岸边的浅水中。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary rule that no one in class understood.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师定了一条任意的规定，班上没有人明白。

arch.example: The old stone arch stands at the entrance of the park.
arch.exampleZh: 那座古老的石拱门立在公园入口处。

archaeology.example: She studies archaeology at a small university near her home.
archaeology.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小型大学学习考古学。

archer.example: The archer shot an arrow at the target and smiled.
archer.exampleZh: 弓箭手向靶子射了一箭，然后笑了。

architect.example: The architect drew a simple house for the young family.
architect.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为这个年轻家庭画了一栋简单的房子。

architecture.example: The old building shows a beautiful style of local architecture.
architecture.exampleZh: 这座老建筑展现了当地建筑风格的美。

archive.example: I found the old letter in the school archive yesterday afternoon.
archive.exampleZh: 我昨天下午在学校档案馆找到了那封旧信。

arctic.example: The arctic is very cold and covered with ice all year.
arctic.exampleZh: 北极地区非常寒冷，全年都被冰覆盖。

ardent.example: She is an ardent supporter of the local football team.
ardent.exampleZh: 她是当地足球队的热情支持者。

arduous.example: The long climb up the mountain was arduous for the young students.
arduous.exampleZh: 对年轻学生来说，爬上这座山是一段艰苦的旅程。

area.example: This area of the city is very quiet at night.
area.exampleZh: 城市的这个地区晚上很安静。

argue.example: They often argue about small things at the dinner table.
argue.exampleZh: 他们经常在餐桌上为小事争论。

argument.example: We had a long argument about where to go for dinner.
argument.exampleZh: 我们为去哪里吃晚饭争论了很久。

arid.example: The arid land had very little water and almost no trees.
arid.exampleZh: 这片干旱的土地几乎没有水，也几乎没有树。

arise.example: New problems often arise when people try to change old habits quickly.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们试图快速改变旧习惯时，新问题常常会出现。

arithmetic.example: Learning basic arithmetic helps children solve everyday problems with confidence and speed.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 学习基础算术能帮助孩子们自信而迅速地解决日常问题。

arm.example: The soldiers will arm themselves with new guns before the long journey.
arm.exampleZh: 士兵们将在长途旅程前用新枪武装自己。

armor.example: The knight wore heavy armor before riding into battle on his horse.
armor.exampleZh: 骑士骑马上战场前穿上了厚重的盔甲。

army.example: The army marched through the city early in the morning.
army.exampleZh: 军队一大早就穿过城市行进。

around.example: There are many trees around the small lake near our house.
around.exampleZh: 我们家附近的小湖周围有很多树。

arouse.example: The good news aroused her interest in the project.
arouse.exampleZh: 这个好消息唤起了她对这个项目的兴趣。

arrange.example: I will arrange the chairs and tables for the meeting tomorrow.
arrange.exampleZh: 我会为明天的会议安排桌椅。

array.example: The store sells a wide array of fresh fruit and vegetables every day.
array.exampleZh: 这家商店每天出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

arrest.example: The police will arrest the man who stole the car yesterday.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察将逮捕昨天偷车的那个男人。

arrive.example: We will arrive at the train station before noon tomorrow.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们明天中午前会到达火车站。

arrogant.example: He was too arrogant to listen to anyone else's advice.
arrogant.exampleZh: 他太傲慢了，听不进别人的建议。

arrow.example: The arrow hit the target in the middle of the board.
arrow.exampleZh: 箭射中了木板正中央的靶子。

art.example: She loves art and often visits the museum with her friends.
art.exampleZh: 她热爱艺术，经常和朋友们一起去博物馆。

artery.example: The main artery carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.
artery.exampleZh: 这条主要动脉将血液从心脏输送到身体其他部位。

article.example: I read an interesting article about animals in the school library yesterday.
article.exampleZh: 我昨天在学校图书馆读了一篇关于动物的有趣文章。

artificial.example: The flowers on the table are artificial and look very real.
artificial.exampleZh: 桌上的花是人造的，看起来却非常逼真。

artistic.example: She has an artistic way of painting flowers and trees.
artistic.exampleZh: 她画花草树木很有艺术感。

as.example: I saw her as she was walking home from school.
as.exampleZh: 我看见她时，她正从学校走回家。

ascend.example: The climbers slowly ascend the steep mountain before the sun goes down.
ascend.exampleZh: 登山者在太阳下山前缓慢攀登陡峭的山。

ascertain.example: We must ascertain the truth before we make any decision.
ascertain.exampleZh: 我们必须在做出任何决定之前查明真相。

ash.example: The fire left a pile of ash in the old fireplace.
ash.exampleZh: 火在旧壁炉里留下了一堆灰烬。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed after she told a lie to her best friend.
ashamed.exampleZh: 她向最好的朋友撒谎后感到羞愧。

ashore.example: After the long trip, the sailors were glad to go ashore.
ashore.exampleZh: 经过漫长的旅程，水手们很高兴上岸。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man walk past.
aside.exampleZh: 她走到旁边，让那位老人走过去。

ask.example: You can ask your teacher for help after class today.
ask.exampleZh: 你今天课后可以向老师求助。

asleep.example: The little boy fell asleep on the soft sofa after lunch.
asleep.exampleZh: 小男孩午饭后在柔软的沙发上睡着了。

aspect.example: The most important aspect of this job is working well with other people.
aspect.exampleZh: 这份工作最重要的方面是能与其他人很好地合作。

aspiration.example: Her main aspiration is to become a doctor and help people.
aspiration.exampleZh: 她最大的渴望是成为一名医生并帮助人们。

assemble.example: The workers will assemble the new machine in the factory tomorrow morning.
assemble.exampleZh: 工人们明天早上会在工厂里组装这台新机器。

assert.example: She asserted that the plan was safe and fair.
assert.exampleZh: 她断言这个计划既安全又公平。

assess.example: Teachers assess students' work to see how much they have learned.
assess.exampleZh: 老师评估学生的作业，以了解他们学到了多少。

asset.example: Good communication skills are a valuable asset in every job.
asset.exampleZh: 良好的沟通能力在每份工作中都是一项宝贵的财富。

assign.example: The teacher will assign homework to every student in the class.
assign.exampleZh: 老师会给班上的每个学生布置作业。

assist.example: The nurse will assist the doctor during the simple operation tomorrow morning.
assist.exampleZh: 护士明天早上会在简单的手术中协助医生。

associate.example: I associate this song with my happy childhood summer days.
associate.exampleZh: 我把这首歌和我快乐的童年夏日联系在一起。

assorted.example: The store sells assorted fruits, snacks, and drinks for busy workers.
assorted.exampleZh: 这家商店为忙碌的工人出售各种水果、零食和饮料。

assume.example: We should not assume that everyone agrees with our plan.
assume.exampleZh: 我们不应假定每个人都同意我们的计划。

assure.example: I assure you that the work will be finished on time.
assure.exampleZh: 我向你保证这项工作会按时完成。

asthma.example: My sister has asthma and she keeps her inhaler close.
asthma.exampleZh: 我妹妹有哮喘，她总是把吸入器放在身边。

astonish.example: The magician's final trick will astonish everyone in the room.
astonish.exampleZh: 魔术师最后的戏法会让房间里的每个人感到惊讶。

astronaut.example: The astronaut floated slowly inside the space station and looked out the window.
astronaut.exampleZh: 宇航员在空间站里慢慢漂浮，并望向窗外。

astronomy.example: I want to study astronomy because I love stars and planets.
astronomy.exampleZh: 我想学习天文学，因为我喜欢星星和行星。

asylum.example: The family asked for asylum after they left their country.
asylum.exampleZh: 这家人离开自己的国家后申请了庇护。

at.example: I will meet you at the park near my house tomorrow.
at.exampleZh: 我明天会在我家附近的公园见你。

athlete.example: The young athlete trains hard every day to win a medal.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员每天刻苦训练，以赢得一枚奖牌。

atlas.example: I found an old atlas on the top shelf of the library.
atlas.exampleZh: 我在图书馆最上层的架子上找到了一本旧地图册。

atmosphere.example: The small restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere at night.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家小餐厅晚上有一种温暖而友好的气氛。

atom.example: An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element.
atom.exampleZh: 原子是化学元素的最小单位。

atop.example: A small cat sat atop the old wooden roof.
atop.exampleZh: 一只小猫坐在旧木屋顶上。

attach.example: Please attach the label to your bag before you leave the room.
attach.exampleZh: 请在离开房间前把标签系在你的包上。

attack.example: The dog may attack strangers if it feels afraid or unsafe.
attack.exampleZh: 如果狗感到害怕或不安全，它可能会攻击陌生人。

attain.example: She worked hard every day to attain her goal of becoming a doctor.
attain.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的目标。

attempt.example: She will attempt to fix the old bike this afternoon.
attempt.exampleZh: 她今天下午将尝试修理那辆旧自行车。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting with my team tomorrow morning.
attend.exampleZh: 明天上午我会和团队一起参加那个会议。

attention.example: Please pay attention to the teacher when she is speaking to the class.
attention.exampleZh: 当老师对全班讲话时，请注意听讲。

attitude.example: Her attitude toward the new job is very positive and open.
attitude.exampleZh: 她对这份新工作的态度非常积极和开放。

attorney.example: The attorney asked the judge for more time to prepare.
attorney.exampleZh: 律师请求法官给更多时间准备。

attract.example: The new museum is trying to attract more young people every year.
attract.exampleZh: 这家新博物馆正努力每年吸引更多年轻人。

attribute.example: People often attribute their success to hard work and good luck.
attribute.exampleZh: 人们常把他们的成功归因于努力工作和好运气。

auction.example: They will auction the old house next week.
auction.exampleZh: 他们下周将拍卖那栋老房子。

audience.example: The speaker asked the audience to turn off their phones during the talk.
audience.exampleZh: 演讲者请观众在讲话期间关掉手机。

audio.example: The audio quality of this old recording is not very good.
audio.exampleZh: 这段旧录音的音频质量不太好。

audit.example: The company will audit its accounts before the end of this year.
audit.exampleZh: 公司将在今年年底前审计其账目。

augment.example: They plan to augment the small team with two new workers next month.
augment.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月用两名新员工来扩充这个小团队。

august.example: We will visit our grandparents in August and stay for a week.
august.exampleZh: 我们将在八月去看望祖父母，并住一个星期。

aunt.example: My aunt makes delicious cookies for us every weekend.
aunt.exampleZh: 我阿姨每个周末都给我们做美味的饼干。

aural.example: The aural test helps students improve their listening skills.
aural.exampleZh: 听力测试帮助学生提高他们的听力技巧。

authentic.example: This is an authentic recipe from my grandmother.
authentic.exampleZh: 这是我祖母传下来的正宗食谱。

author.example: The author wrote a short book about life in the city.
author.exampleZh: 这位作者写了一本关于城市生活的短书。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping the streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 当地当局负责保持街道清洁和安全。

autobiography.example: I read her autobiography last week and learned about her early life.
autobiography.exampleZh: 我上周读了她的自传，了解了她早年的生活。

automatic.example: The door has an automatic lock that closes behind you every time.
automatic.exampleZh: 这扇门有一个自动锁，每次都会在你身后关上。

automobile.example: My father bought a new automobile last week and he likes it very much.
automobile.exampleZh: 我父亲上周买了一辆新汽车，他非常喜欢它。

autonomous.example: This small group is autonomous and makes its own rules every year.
autonomous.exampleZh: 这个小团体是自治的，并且每年制定自己的规则。

autonomy.example: The region was given full autonomy to make its own local laws.
autonomy.exampleZh: 该地区获得了制定本地法律的完全自治权。

autumn.example: The leaves turn brown and fall to the ground in autumn.
autumn.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶变成褐色并落到地上。

available.example: The new book is available at the school library today.
available.exampleZh: 这本新书今天在学校图书馆可以借到。

avalanche.example: A sudden avalanche covered the mountain road with deep snow and rocks.
avalanche.exampleZh: 一场突如其来的雪崩用厚厚的雪和岩石覆盖了山路。

avenue.example: The wide avenue leads to the city center and the main park.
avenue.exampleZh: 这条宽阔的大道通向市中心和主公园。

average.example: The average temperature in our city is about twenty degrees in spring.
average.exampleZh: 我们城市春天的平均气温大约是二十度。

averse.example: Most people are averse to working late on Friday afternoons.
averse.exampleZh: 大多数人都不喜欢在周五下午加班。

avert.example: The quick action of the driver helped avert a serious accident on the road.
avert.exampleZh: 司机迅速的行动帮助避免了一场严重的道路事故。

aviation.example: My uncle works in aviation and often flies to different countries.
aviation.exampleZh: 我叔叔从事航空工作，经常飞往不同国家。

avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar if you want to stay healthy.
avoid.exampleZh: 如果你想保持健康，你应该避免吃太多糖。

await.example: We await the results of the test with great patience.
await.exampleZh: 我们非常耐心地等待测试结果。

awake.example: I was still awake when the morning light came into my room.
awake.exampleZh: 晨光照进房间时，我仍然醒着。

award.example: She won an award for her work at the school.
award.exampleZh: 她因在学校的工作获得了一个奖项。

aware.example: I am aware that the weather will be cold tomorrow.
aware.exampleZh: 我知道明天天气会很冷。

away.example: She walked away from the noisy crowd and found a quiet place.
away.exampleZh: 她离开喧闹的人群，找到了一个安静的地方。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed home and watched a movie.
awful.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们待在家里看电影。

awkward.example: He felt awkward at the party because he did not know anyone.
awkward.exampleZh: 他在聚会上感到尴尬，因为他不认识任何人。

axis.example: The x axis runs from left to right on the graph.
axis.exampleZh: 在图表上，x 轴从左向右延伸。

babble.example: The baby began to babble happily while the water ran softly nearby.
babble.exampleZh: 宝宝开始咿呀学语，旁边的水轻轻流淌。

baby.example: The baby is sleeping quietly in the small bed.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正在小床上安静地睡觉。

bachelor.example: My uncle is a bachelor and lives alone in a small house.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个单身汉，独自住在一所小房子里。

back.example: I put my bag on the back seat of the car.
back.exampleZh: 我把包放在汽车的后座上。

backbone.example: She showed real backbone when she refused to give up her dream.
backbone.exampleZh: 当她拒绝放弃自己的梦想时，她展现出了真正的毅力。

backfire.example: His plan might backfire and make the whole situation much worse for everyone.
backfire.exampleZh: 他的计划可能事与愿违，让整个情况对每个人来说都糟糕得多。

background.example: She has a strong background in math and science.
background.exampleZh: 她在数学和科学方面有很强的背景。

backstage.example: The singer waited backstage before the show and felt a little nervous.
backstage.exampleZh: 歌手演出前在后台等候，感到有点紧张。

backup.example: I saved a backup of my photos on another drive.
backup.exampleZh: 我把照片的备份保存在另一个硬盘上。

backward.example: He took a backward step and fell into the old chair.
backward.exampleZh: 他向后退了一步，跌进了那把旧椅子。

bacteria.example: Some bacteria can make people sick if food is not kept cold.
bacteria.exampleZh: 如果食物没有冷藏，有些细菌会让人生病。

bacterium.example: A bacterium is a very small living thing that can make people sick.
bacterium.exampleZh: 细菌是一种非常微小的生物，能使人患病。

bad.example: The bad weather made us stay at home all day.
bad.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气让我们整天待在家里。

badge.example: She wears a small badge on her jacket to show her name.
badge.exampleZh: 她在夹克上戴着一枚小徽章来显示她的名字。

badger.example: The children kept badgering their mother for ice cream after dinner.
badger.exampleZh: 孩子们晚饭后一直缠着妈妈要冰淇淋。

badly.example: He badly hurt his leg when he fell off the bike yesterday.
badly.exampleZh: 他昨天从自行车上摔下来时，腿伤得很严重。

badminton.example: I play badminton with my friends at the park every Sunday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上和朋友们在公园打羽毛球。

baffle.example: The strange question seemed to baffle even the best students in class.
baffle.exampleZh: 这个奇怪的问题似乎连班上最好的学生都难住了。

bag.example: She put the apples in a big bag and carried it home.
bag.exampleZh: 她把苹果放进一个大袋子里，然后把它带回家。

baggage.example: She carried too much baggage and felt tired after the long trip.
baggage.exampleZh: 她带了太多行李，长途旅行后觉得很累。

bait.example: He used a small fish as bait to catch a bigger one.
bait.exampleZh: 他用一条小鱼作诱饵去钓一条更大的鱼。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake bread every Sunday morning.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢每个星期天早上烤面包。

baker.example: The baker makes fresh bread every morning before the sun comes up.
baker.exampleZh: 面包师每天早上在太阳升起前制作新鲜面包。

bakery.example: The bakery near my house sells fresh bread every morning.
bakery.exampleZh: 我家附近的面包店每天早上都卖新鲜面包。

balance.example: Please check the balance in your bank account today.
balance.exampleZh: 请今天查一下你银行账户里的余额。

balcony.example: We stood on the balcony and watched the sunset over the quiet town.
balcony.exampleZh: 我们站在阳台上，看着夕阳落在安静的小镇上。

bald.example: The man is bald, so he always wears a hat in the sun.
bald.exampleZh: 那个男人是秃头，所以他在太阳下总是戴帽子。

bale.example: The farmer tied the hay into a large bale before the storm came.
bale.exampleZh: 农民在暴风雨来临前把干草捆成了一大捆。

balk.example: The horse balked at the narrow bridge and would not move forward.
balk.exampleZh: 那匹马在窄桥前犹豫不前，不肯往前走。

ball.example: The children played with a red ball in the park after school.
ball.exampleZh: 放学后，孩子们在公园里玩一个红色的球。

ballad.example: My grandfather often sings an old ballad about the sea and lost love.
ballad.exampleZh: 我祖父经常唱一首关于大海和逝去爱情的古老民谣。

ballet.example: She loves ballet and practices every day after school.
ballet.exampleZh: 她喜欢芭蕾舞，每天放学后都练习。

balloon.example: The red balloon floated high above the trees in the park.
balloon.exampleZh: 那只红色的气球在公园里的树上方高高飘着。

ballot.example: Every voter must cast a ballot before the polls close tonight.
ballot.exampleZh: 每位选民必须在今晚投票站关闭前投下选票。

bamboo.example: The giant panda likes to eat fresh bamboo in the forest every day.
bamboo.exampleZh: 大熊猫喜欢每天在森林里吃新鲜的竹子。

ban.example: The school bans phones during class, so students must keep them in their bags.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机，所以学生必须把它们放在书包里。

banana.example: I eat a banana every morning before I go to school.
banana.exampleZh: 我每天早上去学校前都会吃一根香蕉。

band.example: The band played music at the school party last night.
band.exampleZh: 乐队昨晚在学校派对上演奏了音乐。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on his arm after the small accident.
bandage.exampleZh: 那次小事故之后，护士在他手臂上包扎了一条干净的绷带。

bandit.example: The bandit stole a bag of gold and ran into the forest.
bandit.exampleZh: 那个强盗偷了一袋金子，然后跑进了森林。

bang.example: The door closed with a loud bang and made everyone jump.
bang.exampleZh: 门砰的一声关上了，把大家都吓了一跳。

banish.example: The king decided to banish the bad man from the small town.
banish.exampleZh: 国王决定把那个坏人从小镇放逐出去。

bank.example: I went to the bank to open a new account.
bank.exampleZh: 我去银行开了一个新账户。

bankrupt.example: The company went bankrupt after a long year of bad sales.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 这家公司在经历了一年糟糕的销售后破产了。

banner.example: They hung a bright banner across the street for the school festival.
banner.exampleZh: 他们为学校庆典在街道上挂了一条鲜艳的横幅。

banquet.example: They held a big banquet after the wedding to thank all their friends.
banquet.exampleZh: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会来感谢所有朋友。

bar.example: He went to the bar after work and ordered a cold drink.
bar.exampleZh: 他下班后去了酒吧，点了一杯冷饮。

barb.example: His sharp barb hurt her feelings and made her cry.
barb.exampleZh: 他尖刻的话伤了她的感情，让她哭了。

barber.example: The barber cut my hair quickly and then smiled at me.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师很快地给我剪了头发，然后对我笑了笑。

bare.example: He walked on the hot sand with bare feet all afternoon.
bare.exampleZh: 他整个下午光着脚走在滚烫的沙子上。

barely.example: She barely had time to eat before the bus arrived.
barely.exampleZh: 公交车到之前她几乎没时间吃饭。

bargain.example: I got a real bargain when I bought this jacket yesterday.
bargain.exampleZh: 我昨天买这件夹克时捡了个大便宜。

barge.example: The barge carried a heavy load of coal slowly down the river.
barge.exampleZh: 那艘驳船载着沉重的煤炭，缓缓顺流而下。

bark.example: The dog next door likes to bark at every passing car.
bark.exampleZh: 隔壁的狗喜欢对每一辆经过的车吠叫。

barn.example: The farmer kept the cows and hay inside the big red barn.
barn.exampleZh: 农民把奶牛和干草存放在那座红色的大谷仓里。

barometer.example: The barometer fell quickly before the storm, so we stayed home.
barometer.exampleZh: 暴风雨前气压计迅速下降，所以我们待在家里。

baron.example: The old baron owned much of the land around the small town.
baron.exampleZh: 这位老男爵拥有小镇周围的大片土地。

barrel.example: The worker filled a large barrel with clean water for the village.
barrel.exampleZh: 工人为村庄把一个大桶装满了干净的水。

barren.example: The barren land could not grow any food for the poor farmers.
barren.exampleZh: 这片贫瘠的土地无法为贫穷的农民种出任何食物。

barrier.example: The language barrier made it hard for them to understand each other.
barrier.exampleZh: 语言障碍使他们很难理解彼此。

base.example: The base of the lamp is made of strong metal.
base.exampleZh: 灯的底座是用坚固的金属制成的。

baseball.example: My brother plays baseball with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
baseball.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午和他的朋友们打棒球。

baseline.example: We use last year's sales as the baseline for this year's plan.
baseline.exampleZh: 我们用去年的销售额作为今年计划的基准。

basement.example: We keep our old boxes and winter clothes in the basement.
basement.exampleZh: 我们把旧箱子和冬衣放在地下室里。

basic.example: This basic lesson is easy for all new students to understand.
basic.exampleZh: 这节基础课对所有新学生来说都很容易理解。

basin.example: The farmer filled a large basin with water for the thirsty animals.
basin.exampleZh: 农夫把一个大盆装满水给口渴的动物喝。

basis.example: Trust is the basis of every good friendship between two people.
basis.exampleZh: 信任是两个人之间每一段良好友谊的基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a large basket on the kitchen table.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜苹果放进厨房桌子上的一个大篮子里。

bass.example: He plays the bass in a small band on weekends.
bass.exampleZh: 他周末在一个小乐队里弹贝斯。

bat.example: I saw a bat fly into the old tree near our house.
bat.exampleZh: 我看见一只蝙蝠飞进了我们家附近的那棵老树里。

batch.example: The bakery made a fresh batch of bread early this morning.
batch.exampleZh: 面包店今天一早做了一批新鲜面包。

bath.example: She filled the bath with warm water and washed her little dog.
bath.exampleZh: 她给浴缸放满温水，洗了她的小狗。

bathe.example: The children bathe in the warm water after playing in the garden.
bathe.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里玩耍后，在温水中洗澡。

bathroom.example: I need to use the bathroom before we leave the house.
bathroom.exampleZh: 我需要在我们离开家之前用一下洗手间。

bathtub.example: She filled the old bathtub with warm water and bubbles after work.
bathtub.exampleZh: 她下班后用温水和泡泡把旧浴缸装满了。

batter.example: She mixed the batter and poured it into the hot pan.
batter.exampleZh: 她把面糊搅好，倒进热锅里。

battery.example: I need to charge my phone battery before we leave for the trip.
battery.exampleZh: 我们出发旅行前，我需要给手机电池充电。

battle.example: The soldiers fought a long battle to protect their homes and families.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们打了一场漫长的战役来保护他们的家园和家人。

bay.example: They parked the boat in a quiet bay and ate lunch.
bay.exampleZh: 他们把船停在一个安静的海湾里，然后吃了午饭。

bayonet.example: The soldier fixed a bayonet to his rifle before the long march.
bayonet.exampleZh: 士兵在长途行军前把刺刀装到了步枪上。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and collected shells in the warm sun.
beach.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，在温暖的阳光下捡贝壳。

beam.example: The old wooden beam above the door began to crack.
beam.exampleZh: 门上方的旧木梁开始裂了。

bean.example: I put a bean in the soil and it grew fast.
bean.exampleZh: 我把一颗豆子放进土里，它很快长出来了。

bear.example: I cannot bear the loud noise from the street every night.
bear.exampleZh: 我无法忍受每天晚上街上吵闹的噪音。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and he tells funny stories.
beard.exampleZh: 我的祖父留着长长的白胡子，他会讲有趣的故事。

bearing.example: His calm bearing gave the team confidence during the difficult meeting.
bearing.exampleZh: 他冷静的举止在艰难的会议上给了团队信心。

beast.example: The wild beast ran quickly through the dark forest and hid behind a tree.
beast.exampleZh: 那只野兽快速跑过黑暗的森林，躲在一棵树后。

beat.example: Our team beat the strong home side in the final game yesterday.
beat.exampleZh: 我们队昨天在决赛中打败了强大的主队。

beautiful.example: The garden looks beautiful when the flowers bloom in spring.
beautiful.exampleZh: 春天花开时，这个花园看起来很美。

because.example: I stayed at home because it was raining all day.
because.exampleZh: 我待在家里，因为下了一整天雨。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor and help people in her town.
become.exampleZh: 她想成为一名医生，帮助她所在城镇的人们。

bed.example: She put a soft blanket on the bed before going to sleep.
bed.exampleZh: 她在睡觉前把一条柔软的毯子铺在床上。

bedrock.example: The old house was built on solid bedrock under the soil.
bedrock.exampleZh: 这座老房子建在土壤下坚固的基岩上。

bee.example: A small bee is flying from one flower to another in the garden.
bee.exampleZh: 一只小蜜蜂正在花园里从一朵花飞向另一朵花。

beef.example: My mother cooks beef with potatoes and carrots for dinner every Sunday.
beef.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐做牛肉配土豆和胡萝卜。

beer.example: I bought a bottle of beer for my father after work.
beer.exampleZh: 下班后我给父亲买了一瓶啤酒。

before.example: You should finish your homework before you go out to play.
before.exampleZh: 你应该在出去玩之前完成作业。

beg.example: The poor man had to beg for food on the cold street.
beg.exampleZh: 那个可怜的男人不得不在寒冷的街上乞讨食物。

begin.example: We begin our English class at nine every morning.
begin.exampleZh: 我们每天早上九点开始上英语课。

behalf.example: I am speaking on behalf of my whole family today.
behalf.exampleZh: 今天我代表我们全家发言。

behave.example: Children should behave well when they visit a quiet library with their parents.
behave.exampleZh: 孩子们和父母去安静的图书馆时应该守规矩。

behavior.example: His behavior in class was very good today, and the teacher praised him.
behavior.exampleZh: 他今天在课堂上的表现很好，老师表扬了他。

behind.example: The small boy hid behind the tall tree during the game.
behind.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在游戏时躲在高树后面。

belief.example: Her belief in kindness helps her stay calm during hard times.
belief.exampleZh: 她对善良的信念帮助她在艰难时期保持平静。

believe.example: I believe your story because you have always been honest with me.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信你的说法，因为你一直对我很诚实。

bell.example: The teacher rang the bell and the students went back to class.
bell.exampleZh: 老师敲响了铃，学生们回到了教室。

belly.example: He felt a sharp pain in his belly after eating too much.
belly.exampleZh: 他吃太多后感到肚子一阵剧痛。

belong.example: These books belong to my sister and she keeps them on her desk.
belong.exampleZh: 这些书属于我妹妹，她把它们放在她的书桌上。

below.example: The temperature is below zero today, so please wear a warm coat.
below.exampleZh: 今天气温低于零度，所以请穿一件暖和的外套。

belt.example: He wears a black belt with his blue jeans every day.
belt.exampleZh: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤时都系一条黑色腰带。

bench.example: We sat on a wooden bench in the park and ate lunch.
bench.exampleZh: 我们坐在公园里的木制长凳上吃午饭。

bend.example: The road bends sharply to the left after the old bridge.
bend.exampleZh: 这条路在旧桥之后向左急转弯。

beneath.example: The cat is sleeping beneath the old wooden table.
beneath.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在旧木桌下面。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for your health and can make you feel happy.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对健康有益，并能让你感到快乐。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can benefit your health in many simple ways.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能以许多简单的方式有益于你的健康。

bent.example: The old bent tree near the river gives shade on hot days.
bent.exampleZh: 河边那棵弯曲的老树在炎热的日子里提供阴凉。

beside.example: She sat beside me on the bench and we watched the sunset.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在我旁边的长椅上，我们一起看日落。

best.example: She is my best friend and we play together every day.
best.exampleZh: 她是我最好的朋友，我们每天都一起玩。

bet.example: I bet he will win the race tomorrow morning.
bet.exampleZh: 我打赌他明天早上会赢得比赛。

betray.example: I will never betray my best friend for money or fame.
betray.exampleZh: 我永远不会为了金钱或名声背叛我最好的朋友。

better.example: You can do better if you try a little harder.
better.exampleZh: 如果你再努力一点，你可以做得更好。

between.example: The small park is between the school and the library.
between.exampleZh: 这个小公园在学校和图书馆之间。

bewilder.example: The many strange signs on the road bewilder the new driver.
bewilder.exampleZh: 路上许多奇怪的标志使这位新司机感到迷惑。

beyond.example: The village lies beyond the river and is hard to reach.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个村庄在河的那边，很难到达。

bias.example: People should not let bias stop them from judging others fairly.
bias.exampleZh: 人们不应该让偏见阻止自己公平地评判他人。

bible.example: The old book on the shelf is a bible for our family.
bible.exampleZh: 书架上那本旧书是我们家的经典。

bibliography.example: The teacher asked us to add a bibliography at the end of the report.
bibliography.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在报告末尾加上参考文献目录。

bicycle.example: I ride my bicycle to school every day because it is close.
bicycle.exampleZh: 我每天骑自行车上学，因为学校很近。

bid.example: She made a low bid for the old house at the auction.
bid.exampleZh: 她在拍卖会上为那栋老房子出了一个低价。

big.example: This is a big problem for our small team.
big.exampleZh: 这对我们这个小组来说是个大问题。

bike.example: I ride my bike to school every morning because it is fast.
bike.exampleZh: 我每天早上骑自行车上学，因为这样很快。

bill.example: I paid the bill at the restaurant and then left a small tip.
bill.exampleZh: 我在餐厅付了账单，然后留了一点小费。

billion.example: The company spent one billion dollars on a new project last year.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司去年在一个新项目上花费了十亿美元。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottle in the bin near the door.
bin.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进靠近门的垃圾箱里。

bind.example: Please bind these old papers together before you put them on the shelf.
bind.exampleZh: 请把这些旧文件装订在一起，再把它们放到书架上。

biography.example: I read a short biography of a famous scientist last week.
biography.exampleZh: 上周我读了一篇关于一位著名科学家的简短传记。

biology.example: She studies biology at school and hopes to become a doctor.
biology.exampleZh: 她在学校学习生物学，并希望成为一名医生。

bird.example: A small bird is singing in the tree outside my window.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我窗外的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last night.
birth.exampleZh: 她昨晚生了一个健康的男婴。

biscuit.example: My little sister ate a sweet biscuit with her warm milk.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妹妹就着温牛奶吃了一块甜甜的饼干。

bishop.example: The bishop spoke kindly to the people after the Sunday service.
bishop.exampleZh: 主教在周日礼拜后亲切地对人们讲话。

bit.example: I only need a bit of help with this simple task.
bit.exampleZh: 这个简单的任务我只需要一点帮助。

bite.example: A small dog may bite your shoe if it feels scared.
bite.exampleZh: 如果感到害怕，小狗可能会咬你的鞋子。

bitter.example: The medicine tastes bitter, but it helps you feel better soon.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药很苦，但能让你很快好起来。

bizarre.example: The strange old house had a bizarre shape that scared the children.
bizarre.exampleZh: 那座奇怪的老房子有一个古怪的形状，把孩子们吓坏了。

black.example: She wore a black dress to the party last night.
black.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条黑色连衣裙去参加聚会。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard for all the students.
blackboard.exampleZh: 老师把新单词写在黑板上，让所有学生都能看到。

blade.example: The blade of the knife is very sharp and cuts well.
blade.exampleZh: 这把刀的刀刃非常锋利，切起来很顺手。

blame.example: You should not blame others for your own mistakes and bad decisions.
blame.exampleZh: 你不应该为自己的错误和糟糕决定责怪别人。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top of the page.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶部的空白处。

blanket.example: She put a warm blanket over the child before he went to sleep.
blanket.exampleZh: 她在孩子睡觉前给他盖上了一条温暖的毛毯。

blast.example: The blast broke the old windows and shook the whole house.
blast.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了旧窗户，震动了整栋房子。

blaze.example: The firemen worked all night to put out the blaze.
blaze.exampleZh: 消防员整夜工作以扑灭大火。

bleed.example: The cut on his hand began to bleed during the long walk home.
bleed.exampleZh: 他手上的伤口在漫长的回家路上开始流血。

blend.example: You can blend the fruit with milk to make a healthy drink.
blend.exampleZh: 你可以把水果和牛奶混合，做成一杯健康的饮品。

bless.example: May God bless you and your family with health and happiness.
bless.exampleZh: 愿上帝保佑你和你的家人健康幸福。

blind.example: The old man is blind, but he can still walk home alone.
blind.exampleZh: 那位老人双目失明，但他仍能独自走回家。

block.example: There is a big block of ice on the road.

blood.example: The doctor said his blood was healthy after the test.
blood.exampleZh: 医生说他检查后血液是健康的。

bloom.example: The flowers bloom in the warm spring sun every year.
bloom.exampleZh: 每年温暖的春日阳光下，花儿都会盛开。

blossom.example: The small tree will blossom in spring and bring beauty to our garden.
blossom.exampleZh: 这棵小树会在春天开花，为我们的花园带来美丽。

blouse.example: She wore a white blouse to the office today.
blouse.exampleZh: 她今天穿了一件白色女衬衫去办公室。

blow.example: The strong wind began to blow all the leaves off the trees.
blow.exampleZh: 大风开始把树上的叶子都吹落了。

blue.example: She wore a blue dress and felt happy all day long.
blue.exampleZh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙，整天都很开心。

blueprint.example: The team made a clear blueprint for the new project last week.
blueprint.exampleZh: 团队上周为这个新项目制定了一份清晰的蓝图。

blur.example: The rain made the window blur, so I could not see the road.
blur.exampleZh: 雨水使窗户变得模糊，所以我看不清路。

blush.example: She began to blush when everyone looked at her new dress.
blush.exampleZh: 当所有人都看着她那条新裙子时，她开始脸红了。

board.example: The board met today and made a new plan for the school.
board.exampleZh: 董事会今天开会，为学校制定了一项新计划。

boast.example: She likes to boast about her new car to all her friends.
boast.exampleZh: 她喜欢向所有朋友吹嘘她的新车。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the lake on a sunny morning.
boat.exampleZh: 在一个晴朗的早晨，我们坐小船穿过了湖面。

body.example: The human body needs water and rest every single day.
body.exampleZh: 人体每天都需要水和休息。

boil.example: Please boil the water for five minutes before you make the tea.
boil.exampleZh: 请先把水煮沸五分钟，然后再泡茶。

boiler.example: The old boiler in the basement makes a loud noise every morning.
boiler.exampleZh: 地下室里那台旧锅炉每天早上都会发出很大的噪音。

bold.example: Her bold idea helped the small team solve a very hard problem.
bold.exampleZh: 她大胆的想法帮助这个小团队解决了一个非常困难的问题。

bolt.example: The worker used a strong bolt to fix the broken chair.
bolt.exampleZh: 工人用一根结实的螺栓修好了那把坏椅子。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the field and the police closed the road.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在田里被发现，警察封锁了道路。

bond.example: A strong bond between parents and children helps the whole family stay happy.
bond.exampleZh: 父母与孩子之间牢固的纽带有助于整个家庭保持幸福。

bone.example: The dog found a big bone in the garden and ate it.
bone.exampleZh: 狗在花园里找到一根大骨头并把它吃了。

bonus.example: The company gave every worker a small bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.exampleZh: 公司在年底给每位员工发了一小笔奖金。

book.example: I booked a room online before my trip to the city.
book.exampleZh: 我在去那座城市旅行前在网上预订了一个房间。

bookcase.example: I put my new books on the bookcase next to the window.
bookcase.exampleZh: 我把我的新书放在窗边的书架上。

bookmark.example: I put a bookmark in my book before I went to bed.
bookmark.exampleZh: 我在睡觉前把书签夹进了书里。

bookstore.example: I often go to the bookstore near my school to buy books and magazines.
bookstore.exampleZh: 我经常去学校附近的书店买书和杂志。

boom.example: The city's population began to boom after the new train station opened.
boom.exampleZh: 新火车站开通后，这座城市的人口开始激增。

boost.example: The new policy will boost local business and help create more jobs.
boost.exampleZh: 新政策将促进本地商业并帮助创造更多就业机会。

boot.example: She put her new boots by the door before leaving for work.
boot.exampleZh: 她把新靴子放在门边，然后去上班。

border.example: The river forms a natural border between the two small towns.
border.exampleZh: 这条河形成了两个小镇之间的天然边界。

bore.example: The long movie began to bore the children after the first hour.
bore.exampleZh: 那部冗长的电影在第一个小时后开始让孩子们感到厌烦。

boring.example: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep in the middle.
boring.exampleZh: 这部电影太无聊了，我中间睡着了。

born.example: He was born in a small town near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 他出生在海边的一个小镇。

borrow.example: You can borrow my book and give it back tomorrow.
borrow.exampleZh: 你可以借我的书，明天还给我。

boss.example: My boss gave me a new task to finish before Friday.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板给了我一个新任务，要在周五前完成。

both.example: Both of my parents like to walk in the park after dinner.
both.exampleZh: 我父母都喜欢晚饭后去公园散步。

bother.example: Please do not bother me while I am trying to study.
bother.exampleZh: 请在我努力学习的时候不要打扰我。

bottle.example: She put a cold bottle of water into her bag.
bottle.exampleZh: 她把一瓶冷水放进了她的包里。

bottom.example: The bottom of the old box is broken and dirty.
bottom.exampleZh: 那个旧盒子的底部破了而且很脏。

bounce.example: The ball will bounce high when you throw it at the wall.
bounce.exampleZh: 当你把球扔向墙时，它会弹得很高。

bound.example: The train is bound for the city and will leave in ten minutes.
bound.exampleZh: 这列火车开往那座城市，将在十分钟后出发。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two small villages.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两个小村庄之间的天然分界线。

bow.example: He gave a polite bow and then left the room quietly.
bow.exampleZh: 他礼貌地鞠了一躬，然后安静地离开了房间。

bowl.example: She put the fresh fruit in a large bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把新鲜水果放在桌上的一个大碗里。

box.example: She kept the old letters in a small box under her bed.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧信件放在床下的一个小盒子里。

boycott.example: Many people decided to boycott the company after they learned about its bad actions.
boycott.exampleZh: 许多人在得知这家公司的恶劣行为后决定抵制它。

brace.example: She used a wooden brace to support the old shelf.
brace.exampleZh: 她用木支架支撑那个旧架子。

brain.example: You need to use your brain to solve this easy puzzle.
brain.exampleZh: 你需要动动脑筋来解开这个简单的谜题。

brake.example: He pressed the brake hard and the car stopped at once.
brake.exampleZh: 他用力踩下刹车，车子立刻停了下来。

branch.example: The bird sat on a branch and sang a sweet song.
branch.exampleZh: 那只鸟坐在树枝上，唱着一首甜美的歌。

brand.example: This popular brand makes simple shoes for people who walk a lot.
brand.exampleZh: 这个受欢迎的品牌为经常走路的人制作简单的鞋子。

brass.example: The band's brass section played loudly during the parade.
brass.exampleZh: 游行时乐队的铜管乐器组演奏得很响亮。

brave.example: The brave firefighter saved the little child from the burning house today.
brave.exampleZh: 今天，那位勇敢的消防员从着火的房子里救出了那个小孩。

breach.example: The company was fined for a serious breach of safety rules.
breach.exampleZh: 公司因严重违反安全规定而被罚款。

bread.example: She bought fresh bread from the small shop near her house.
bread.exampleZh: 她在她家附近的小店买了新鲜面包。

breadth.example: The breadth of the river surprised everyone who crossed it.
breadth.exampleZh: 这条河的宽度让每个过河的人都感到惊讶。

break.example: Let us take a short break before we start the next lesson.
break.exampleZh: 让我们在开始下一节课之前短暂休息一下。

breakdown.example: The sudden breakdown of the old machine stopped work for two hours.
breakdown.exampleZh: 那台旧机器突然故障，使工作中断了两个小时。

breakfast.example: I eat breakfast at seven every morning before school.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点上学前吃早餐。

breakthrough.example: The scientists made a major breakthrough in cancer research last year.
breakthrough.exampleZh: 科学家去年在癌症研究方面取得了重大突破。

breath.example: Take a deep breath and relax before you start your speech.
breath.exampleZh: 在你开始演讲之前，深吸一口气并放松。

breathe.example: When I feel nervous, I breathe slowly and think about something calm.
breathe.exampleZh: 当我感到紧张时，我会慢慢呼吸，并想一些平静的事情。

breed.example: Farmers often breed sheep and cows on this small family farm.
breed.exampleZh: 农民常常在这个小型家庭农场里饲养羊和牛。

breeze.example: A cool breeze came through the open window and made us feel relaxed.
breeze.exampleZh: 一阵凉爽的微风吹过敞开的窗户，让我们感到放松。

bribe.example: The man tried to bribe the police officer with money.
bribe.exampleZh: 那个男人试图用钱贿赂警察。

brick.example: The old wall was made of red brick and strong stone.
brick.exampleZh: 那堵旧墙是用红砖和坚硬的石头砌成的。

bride.example: The bride wore a white dress and smiled at her guests.
bride.exampleZh: 新娘穿着白色连衣裙，对着宾客微笑。

bridge.example: We need a bridge to connect the two small villages.
bridge.exampleZh: 我们需要一座桥来连接这两个小村庄。

brief.example: The manager gave a brief talk about the new plan.
brief.exampleZh: 经理就新计划作了简短发言。

briefcase.example: He put the important papers into his black briefcase and left the office.
briefcase.exampleZh: 他把重要文件放进黑色公文包，然后离开了办公室。

bright.example: The bright sun made the room warm and the children happy.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的阳光让房间变得温暖，让孩子们很开心。

brilliant.example: She had a brilliant idea to help the whole team finish early.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她有一个绝妙的主意，帮助整个团队提前完成。

bring.example: Please bring your book to class tomorrow so we can study together.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天把你的书带到课上，这样我们可以一起学习。

brisk.example: We went for a brisk walk in the park before breakfast.
brisk.exampleZh: 我们在早餐前去公园轻快地散步。

broad.example: The teacher gave us a broad overview of the topic today.
broad.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们讲了这个主题的概括性介绍。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the football game live tonight.
broadcast.exampleZh: 广播电台今晚将现场直播这场足球比赛。

broaden.example: Reading more books can broaden your mind and help you see new ideas.
broaden.exampleZh: 多读书可以开阔你的眼界，帮助你看到新的想法。

broken.example: My old phone is broken, so I cannot call you today.
broken.exampleZh: 我的旧手机坏了，所以今天不能给你打电话。

broom.example: She used a broom to clean the floor after the party.
broom.exampleZh: 派对结束后，她用扫帚打扫了地板。

brother.example: My brother is a kind man who helps his friends.
brother.exampleZh: 我的兄弟是个善良的人，他帮助他的朋友。

brown.example: She wore a brown coat and carried a small bag.
brown.exampleZh: 她穿了一件棕色外套，还提着一个小包。

browse.example: I like to browse the internet for funny videos on weekends.
browse.exampleZh: 我喜欢周末上网浏览搞笑视频。

brush.example: I use a small brush to clean the dust from my old shoes.
brush.exampleZh: 我用一把小刷子清理旧鞋上的灰尘。

bubble.example: The little boy laughed when the soap bubble popped in his hand.
bubble.exampleZh: 那个小男孩笑了，因为肥皂泡在他手里破了。

bucket.example: She filled the bucket with water and carried it to the garden.
bucket.exampleZh: 她把水桶装满水，然后把它搬到花园里。

bud.example: In early spring, tiny green buds begin to appear on the trees.
bud.exampleZh: 早春时节，树上开始冒出小小的绿色嫩芽。

budget.example: We need to make a budget for our trip next month.
budget.exampleZh: 我们需要为下个月的旅行做预算。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: The tall building near the park has many offices and shops.
building.exampleZh: 公园附近的那栋高楼里有许多办公室和商店。

bulb.example: I changed the broken light bulb in the kitchen this morning.
bulb.exampleZh: 今天早上我换了厨房里坏掉的灯泡。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is already done and we can finish today.
bulk.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成，我们今天可以收尾。

bullet.example: The soldier found a bullet on the ground near the old wall.
bullet.exampleZh: 士兵在旧墙附近的地上发现了一颗子弹。

bulletin.example: The school posted a bulletin about the summer holiday dates.
bulletin.exampleZh: 学校张贴了一份关于暑假日期的公告。

bump.example: I did not see the rock and got a bump on my head.
bump.exampleZh: 我没看见那块石头，头上撞出了一个肿块。

bunch.example: She gave me a bunch of fresh flowers from her garden.
bunch.exampleZh: 她给了我一把从她花园里摘的新鲜花。

bundle.example: She put the old clothes in a bundle and carried them home.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把旧衣服捆成一包，然后带回了家。

burden.example: She felt the burden of caring for her sick mother alone.
burden.exampleZh: 她独自照顾生病的母亲，感到负担沉重。

bureau.example: The travel bureau helped us plan a simple trip to the coast.
bureau.exampleZh: 旅行社帮我们规划了一次简单的海滨之旅。

bureaucracy.example: Too much bureaucracy makes it hard for small businesses to grow quickly.
bureaucracy.exampleZh: 过多的官僚程序使小企业难以快速成长。

burn.example: Be careful not to burn the soup on the stove today.
burn.exampleZh: 今天小心别把炉子上的汤烧煳了。

burst.example: The old pipe burst and water quickly filled the small kitchen.
burst.exampleZh: 旧水管爆裂了，水很快淹满了小厨房。

bury.example: The dog likes to bury its bone in the soft garden soil.
bury.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢把骨头埋在松软的花园土壤里。

bus.example: I take the bus to work every morning at seven o'clock.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点乘公共汽车去上班。

bush.example: There is a small bush near the front door of our house.
bush.exampleZh: 我们家前门附近有一小丛灌木。

business.example: My father runs a small business in our town.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们镇上经营一家小公司。

busy.example: My mother is very busy today, so I will help her with dinner.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天很忙，所以我会帮她做晚饭。

but.example: I wanted to go out, but it started to rain heavily.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但开始下大雨了。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成小块给我们。

butter.example: I put some butter on my bread before I eat breakfast.
butter.exampleZh: 我在吃早餐前在面包上放了一些黄油。

butterfly.example: The bright butterfly lands on a red flower in the garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 那只鲜艳的蝴蝶落在花园里的一朵红花上。

button.example: Please press the red button to start the machine in the morning.
button.exampleZh: 请在早上按下红色按钮来启动这台机器。

buy.example: I want to buy some fresh fruit for my family today.
buy.exampleZh: 我今天想给家人买一些新鲜水果。

buzz.example: The small bee will buzz around the bright flowers in our garden.
buzz.exampleZh: 那只小蜜蜂会在我们花园里的鲜艳花朵周围嗡嗡叫。

cab.example: We took a cab to the airport early this morning.
cab.exampleZh: 我们今天一大早坐出租车去了机场。

cabal.example: A small cabal met in secret to plan the town election.
cabal.exampleZh: 一个小阴谋集团秘密会面，策划镇上的选举。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with some onions and potatoes for dinner.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚餐用一些洋葱和土豆煮卷心菜。

cabin.example: We stayed in a small wooden cabin near the lake last summer.
cabin.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在湖边一间小木屋里。

cabinet.example: The new cabinet keeps all the plates and cups safe and clean.
cabinet.exampleZh: 这个新橱柜让所有盘子和杯子安全又干净。

cable.example: The workers used a long cable to pull the heavy boat to shore.
cable.exampleZh: 工人们用一根长缆绳把沉重的船拉向岸边。

cacao.example: The farmer grows cacao trees and sells the beans at the local market.
cacao.exampleZh: 农民种植可可树，并把可可豆卖到当地市场。

cache.example: The computer keeps a cache of recent files to load them faster.
cache.exampleZh: 计算机会保存近期文件的缓存，以便更快地加载它们。

cactus.example: A cactus can live for a long time without any water.
cactus.exampleZh: 仙人掌没有水也能活很长时间。

cadence.example: The soft cadence of her voice helped the baby fall asleep.
cadence.exampleZh: 她轻柔的语调帮助婴儿入睡了。

cadenza.example: The young pianist played a beautiful cadenza before the orchestra returned.
cadenza.exampleZh: 年轻钢琴家在管弦乐队重新加入前演奏了一段优美的华彩乐段。

cadet.example: The young cadet studies hard every day and hopes to become a good officer.
cadet.exampleZh: 这位年轻的军校学员每天努力学习，希望成为一名优秀的军官。

caffeine.example: Drinking too much caffeine late at night can make it hard to sleep.
caffeine.exampleZh: 深夜摄入过多咖啡因会让人难以入睡。

cage.example: The zookeeper put the sick bird in a small cage to rest.
cage.exampleZh: 动物园管理员把生病的鸟放进一个小笼子里休息。

cairn.example: We built a small cairn to mark the path across the hill.
cairn.exampleZh: 我们在山上堆了一个小石冢来标记小路。

cajole.example: She tried to cajole her little brother into cleaning the room with candy.
cajole.exampleZh: 她试着用糖果哄弟弟打扫房间。

cake.example: She made a chocolate cake for her brother's birthday party last night.
cake.exampleZh: 她昨晚为弟弟的生日派对做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

calamity.example: The storm was a terrible calamity for the small village.
calamity.exampleZh: 这场风暴对这个小村庄来说是一场可怕的灾难。

calcium.example: Milk and cheese are good sources of calcium for growing children.
calcium.exampleZh: 牛奶和奶酪是成长中儿童的良好钙来源。

calculate.example: Please calculate the total cost before you buy the tickets.
calculate.exampleZh: 请在买票前计算总费用。

calculus.example: I learned basic calculus in my first year of college.
calculus.exampleZh: 我在大学第一年学习了基础微积分。

calendar.example: I wrote the meeting on my calendar so I would not forget it.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把会议写在了日历上，这样就不会忘记。

calf.example: The farmer fed the young calf some milk before it went to sleep.
calf.exampleZh: 农夫在小牛睡觉前给它喂了一些牛奶。

caliber.example: The new manager is a person of high caliber and great ability.
caliber.exampleZh: 这位新经理是一位才干出众、能力很强的人。

calibrate.example: The engineer will calibrate the machine before we start the test.
calibrate.exampleZh: 工程师会在我们开始测试前校准这台机器。

call.example: Please call me when you get home tonight.
call.exampleZh: 你今晚到家后请给我打电话。

calligraphy.example: Chinese calligraphy is a traditional art that uses brushes and ink.
calligraphy.exampleZh: 中国书法是一种使用毛笔和墨水的传统艺术。

calm.example: She tried to stay calm when the small boat moved in the waves.
calm.exampleZh: 当小船在浪中摇晃时，她努力保持镇静。

calorie.example: This small snack has only fifty calories and is very easy to carry.
calorie.exampleZh: 这个小零食只有五十卡路里，而且非常容易携带。

calve.example: The glacier began to calve large blocks of ice into the sea.
calve.exampleZh: 冰川开始崩解出大块冰落入海中。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot desert with a heavy load.
