camel.exampleZh: 骆驼驮着重物缓慢地走过炎热的沙漠。

cameo.example: She had a small cameo in the new film last year.
cameo.exampleZh: 她去年在那部新电影里有一个小客串。

camera.example: I bought a new camera to take pictures on my trip.
camera.exampleZh: 我买了一台新相机，用来在旅行中拍照。

camouflage.example: The soldiers used branches and leaves as camouflage in the forest.
camouflage.exampleZh: 士兵们在森林里用树枝和树叶作为伪装。

camp.example: We set up our camp near the river and cooked dinner together.
camp.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭起营地，一起做了晚饭。

campaign.example: The school started a campaign to help poor children in the city.
campaign.exampleZh: 学校发起了一项运动，帮助城里的贫困儿童。

campus.example: The new library is in the middle of our campus.
campus.exampleZh: 新图书馆在我们校园的中央。

can.example: I can swim very well, and my sister can too.
can.exampleZh: 我游泳游得很好，我妹妹也会。

canal.example: The old canal runs through the city and brings water to many farms.
canal.exampleZh: 这条古老的运河穿过城市，为许多农场带来水。

canary.example: The little yellow canary sang a sweet song in its cage.
canary.exampleZh: 那只黄色的小金丝雀在笼子里唱了一首甜美的歌。

cancel.example: They had to cancel the game because of the heavy rain.
cancel.exampleZh: 他们不得不因为大雨取消比赛。

cancer.example: Smoking can increase the risk of lung cancer in many people.
cancer.exampleZh: 吸烟会增加许多人患肺癌的风险。

candid.example: She gave a candid answer to my question about her plans.
candid.exampleZh: 她坦率地回答了我关于她计划的问题。

candidate.example: The candidate answered every question clearly during the job interview this morning.
candidate.exampleZh: 这位候选人在今天上午的求职面试中清楚地回答了每个问题。

candle.example: She lit a candle and put it on the table.
candle.exampleZh: 她点燃了一支蜡烛，把它放在桌子上。

candy.example: The little girl got a piece of candy from her grandmother.
candy.exampleZh: 小女孩从她奶奶那里得到了一块糖果。

cane.example: The old man walked slowly down the road with a wooden cane in his hand.
cane.exampleZh: 老人手里拿着一根木手杖，沿着路慢慢走。

canine.example: The dog showed its canine teeth when a stranger came near the gate.
canine.exampleZh: 当陌生人走近大门时，那只狗露出了犬齿。

canister.example: She put the sugar in a small metal canister on the shelf.
canister.exampleZh: 她把糖放进架子上一个小金属罐里。

cannon.example: The old ship carried a large cannon on its front deck.
cannon.exampleZh: 那艘旧船的前甲板上装着一门大炮。

canoe.example: We took a small canoe across the quiet lake before the sun rose.
canoe.exampleZh: 我们在太阳升起前乘一艘小独木舟横渡了平静的湖面。

canopy.example: A thick green canopy shaded the small path through the forest.
canopy.exampleZh: 茂密的绿色树冠为穿过森林的小路遮阴。

cantaloupe.example: I bought a sweet cantaloupe and shared it with my family.
cantaloupe.exampleZh: 我买了一个甜哈密瓜，和家人一起分享。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day at noon.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天中午在学校食堂吃午饭。

canvas.example: She painted a bright red flower on a large white canvas.
canvas.exampleZh: 她在一块白色的大画布上画了一朵鲜红的花。

canyon.example: The river runs through a deep canyon with tall rocky walls.
canyon.exampleZh: 这条河流经一个有着高耸岩壁的深峡谷。

cap.example: She put a red cap on her head before going outside.
cap.exampleZh: 她出门前把一顶红帽子戴在头上。

capability.example: This new software has the capability to solve many common problems quickly.
capability.exampleZh: 这款新软件能够快速解决许多常见问题。

capable.example: She is capable of doing this difficult work all by herself.
capable.exampleZh: 她有能力独自完成这项困难的工作。

capacity.example: The room has enough capacity for twenty people at one time.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个房间一次能容纳二十人。

cape.example: The old sailor wore a heavy cape on the cold ship.
cape.exampleZh: 那位老水手在寒冷的船上穿着一件厚重的斗篷。

capillary.example: Tiny capillaries carry blood from small arteries to the body's cells.
capillary.exampleZh: 微小的毛细血管把血液从小动脉输送到身体的细胞。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and a very important city.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，也是一座非常重要的城市。

capsule.example: The doctor gave me a small capsule to take after dinner.
capsule.exampleZh: 医生给了我一颗小胶囊，让我晚饭后服用。

captain.example: The captain told the team to stay calm and play together.
captain.exampleZh: 队长告诉队员们保持冷静并团结协作。

caption.example: The caption under the photo explains where the family went last summer.
caption.exampleZh: 照片下方的说明文字解释了这家人去年夏天去了哪里。

captive.example: The captive escaped from the old prison during the dark night.
captive.exampleZh: 那名俘虏在漆黑的夜晚从旧监狱逃走了。

capture.example: The police tried to capture the thief near the old market.
capture.exampleZh: 警察试图在旧市场附近抓住那个小偷。

carbohydrate.example: Rice and bread are common foods that contain a lot of carbohydrate.
carbohydrate.exampleZh: 米饭和面包是含有大量碳水化合物的常见食物。

carbon.example: Carbon is an important element found in all living things.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是存在于所有生物体内的重要元素。

carbuncle.example: The old king wore a bright carbuncle on his crown.
carbuncle.exampleZh: 老国王的王冠上镶着一颗明亮的红宝石。

carcass.example: The farmer found a dead carcass near the river and called the police.
carcass.exampleZh: 农民在河边发现了一具动物尸体，然后报了警。

card.example: I sent my friend a birthday card with a funny picture.
card.exampleZh: 我给朋友寄了一张带有搞笑图片的生日贺卡。

cardiac.example: The doctor said his cardiac test was normal and he could go home.
cardiac.exampleZh: 医生说他的心脏检查正常，他可以回家了。

cardinal.example: Honesty is a cardinal rule in our small family business.
cardinal.exampleZh: 诚实是我们小型家族企业的一条基本准则。

care.example: She takes good care of her little brother every day.
care.exampleZh: 她每天细心照顾她的小弟弟。

career.example: She wants to build a strong career in teaching and help many young students.
career.exampleZh: 她想在教学中建立一份稳固的事业，并帮助许多年轻学生。

careful.example: Please be careful when you cross the busy street with your children.
careful.exampleZh: 带孩子过繁忙街道时请小心。

caress.example: She gently caressed the baby's soft cheek and smiled with love.
caress.exampleZh: 她轻轻抚摸婴儿柔软的脸颊，满怀爱意地笑了。

cargo.example: The ship carried a heavy cargo of grain across the sea.
cargo.exampleZh: 这艘船载着一批沉重的谷物货物横渡大海。

caribou.example: We saw a caribou walking slowly across the cold snowy field.
caribou.exampleZh: 我们看到一只驯鹿在寒冷的雪地里慢慢走过。

caricature.example: The newspaper printed a funny caricature of the mayor at the town fair.
caricature.exampleZh: 报纸在镇上集市上刊登了一幅有趣的市长讽刺画。

carnation.example: She bought a pink carnation for her mother on Mother's Day.
carnation.exampleZh: 她在母亲节给妈妈买了一朵粉色的康乃馨。

carnival.example: The town holds a big carnival every summer, and everyone loves it.
carnival.exampleZh: 这个小镇每年夏天都会举办一场盛大的狂欢节，大家都很喜欢。

carnivore.example: A lion is a large carnivore that hunts other animals for food.
carnivore.exampleZh: 狮子是一种大型食肉动物，捕猎其他动物为食。

carol.example: The children sang a happy carol at the Christmas party last night.
carol.exampleZh: 孩子们昨晚在圣诞聚会上唱了一首欢快的颂歌。

carp.example: We caught a large carp in the quiet lake near our house.
carp.exampleZh: 我们在家附近安静的湖里钓到了一条大鲤鱼。

carpenter.example: The carpenter built a small wooden table for our new kitchen.
carpenter.exampleZh: 木匠为我们的新厨房做了一张小木桌。

carpet.example: The old carpet in our living room feels soft and warm.
carpet.exampleZh: 我们客厅里的旧地毯摸起来柔软又温暖。

carriage.example: The old carriage moved slowly down the quiet road in the morning.
carriage.exampleZh: 那辆旧马车在清晨沿着安静的道路缓慢前行。

carrier.example: The carrier will bring your package to the city tomorrow morning.
carrier.exampleZh: 这家运输公司明天早上会把你的包裹送到城里。

carrot.example: My mother put a carrot in the soup.
carrot.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了一根胡萝卜。

carry.example: She will carry the heavy box to the car for her friend.
carry.exampleZh: 她将帮朋友把那个重箱子搬到车上。

cart.example: She put the groceries in the cart and walked to the checkout.
cart.exampleZh: 她把食品杂货放进购物车，然后走向收银台。

cartilage.example: The doctor said the cartilage in his knee is damaged and needs rest.
cartilage.exampleZh: 医生说他的膝盖软骨受损，需要休息。

carton.example: She put the books in a large carton and carried it upstairs.
carton.exampleZh: 她把书放进一个大纸板箱里，然后把它搬到了楼上。

cartoon.example: My little sister watches her favorite cartoon every morning before she goes to school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上上学前都会看她最喜欢的卡通。

carve.example: He carved a small bird out of wood with a simple knife.
carve.exampleZh: 他用一把简单的刀把木头雕刻成了一只小鸟。

cascade.example: The water fell down the rocks in a small cascade.
cascade.exampleZh: 水从岩石上落下，形成一个小瀑布。

case.example: This is a difficult case, and the doctor needs more time.
case.exampleZh: 这是一个棘手的病例，医生需要更多时间。

cash.example: I need some cash to buy food at the store today.
cash.exampleZh: 我今天需要一些现金去商店买食物。

casket.example: The old man kept his letters in a small wooden casket.
casket.exampleZh: 那位老人把他的信件放在一个小木盒里。

cassette.example: I found an old cassette in the drawer and played it.
cassette.exampleZh: 我在抽屉里找到一盒旧磁带，并把它播放了。

cast.example: The director chose a strong cast for the new play.
cast.exampleZh: 导演为这部新剧挑选了一组强大的演员阵容。

caste.example: The old caste system still shapes how people live in some rural areas.
caste.exampleZh: 旧的种姓制度仍然影响着一些农村地区人们的生活方式。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a high hill near the river.
castle.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在河边的高山上。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party and felt relaxed all evening.
casual.exampleZh: 他穿着休闲服装去参加聚会，整晚都感到轻松。

casualty.example: The storm caused one casualty and left many homes without power.
casualty.exampleZh: 这场风暴造成一人伤亡，并让许多家庭断电。

cat.example: The cat sleeps on the warm sofa every afternoon after lunch.
cat.exampleZh: 这只猫每天午饭后都在温暖的沙发上睡觉。

catalog.example: The teacher asked us to catalog all the old books in the room.
catalog.exampleZh: 老师让我们给房间里所有旧书编目录。

catalyst.example: The new teacher was a catalyst for change in our small school.
catalyst.exampleZh: 新老师是我们这所小学校里推动变革的催化剂。

cataract.example: The old man had a cataract removed from his left eye last week.
cataract.exampleZh: 这位老人上周从左眼摘除了白内障。

catastrophe.example: The storm was a catastrophe for the small town and its people.
catastrophe.exampleZh: 这场风暴对小镇和居民来说是一场大灾难。

catch.example: I need to catch the early bus to school tomorrow.
catch.exampleZh: 我明天需要赶上早班公交车去学校。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category from the others on the shelf.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与书架上其他书不同的类别。

cater.example: The hotel can cater to families with young children and large groups.
cater.exampleZh: 这家酒店可以满足带小孩的家庭和大型团体的需求。

cathedral.example: The old cathedral stands in the center of the city.
cathedral.exampleZh: 那座古老的大教堂坐落在市中心。

catholic.example: She goes to a Catholic church every Sunday with her family.
catholic.exampleZh: 她每周日都和家人一起去天主教堂。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps many cattle on his small farm near the river.
cattle.exampleZh: 农夫在河边的小农场里养了许多牛。

cauliflower.example: My mother cooked cauliflower with potatoes and carrots for dinner last night.
cauliflower.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈用土豆和胡萝卜煮了花椰菜。

cause.example: The heavy rain can cause serious problems for farmers in this area.
cause.exampleZh: 大雨会给这个地区的农民带来严重问题。

caustic.example: His caustic words hurt her feelings at the meeting yesterday.
caustic.exampleZh: 他刻薄的话昨天在会议上伤害了她的感情。

caution.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy street.
caution.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cavalry.example: The cavalry rode quickly across the open field to help the soldiers.
cavalry.exampleZh: 骑兵迅速穿过开阔的田野去帮助士兵。

cave.example: The bear found a dark cave and slept there all winter long.
cave.exampleZh: 那只熊找到一个黑暗的山洞，并在那里睡了整个冬天。

cavern.example: The explorers found a dark cavern under the old hill.
cavern.exampleZh: 探险者们在古老的山丘下发现了一个黑暗的大洞穴。

cease.example: The rain will cease soon, so we can go outside and play.
cease.exampleZh: 雨很快就会停，所以我们可以出去玩。

ceasefire.example: The two sides finally agreed to a ceasefire after long talks.
ceasefire.exampleZh: 经过长时间谈判，双方最终同意停火。

cedar.example: The tall cedar in our garden gives us cool shade in summer.
cedar.exampleZh: 我们花园里那棵高大的雪松在夏天为我们提供凉爽的树荫。

ceiling.example: The ceiling of the old room is very high and bright.
ceiling.exampleZh: 这个旧房间的天花板很高也很明亮。

celebrate.example: We celebrate my mother's birthday with a small cake every year.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们每年都用一个小蛋糕庆祝我妈妈的生日。

celebration.example: The whole town came together for a big celebration after the team won.
celebration.exampleZh: 球队获胜后，全镇人聚在一起举行了一场盛大的庆祝活动。

celebrity.example: Many people want to become a celebrity because they enjoy public attention.
celebrity.exampleZh: 许多人想成为名人，因为他们喜欢公众关注。

celery.example: I put some fresh celery and tomatoes in the salad for lunch today.
celery.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了一些新鲜的芹菜和西红柿。

celestial.example: The celestial bodies in the night sky look bright and beautiful.
celestial.exampleZh: 夜空中的天体看起来明亮又美丽。

cell.example: Each cell in the table has a small number.
cell.exampleZh: 表格中的每个单元格都有一个小数字。

cellar.example: The old farmer kept potatoes and wine in the cool cellar.
cellar.exampleZh: 那位老农把土豆和葡萄酒存放在凉爽的地窖里。

cellist.example: The cellist played a slow song for the children at school.
cellist.exampleZh: 大提琴手在学校为孩子们演奏了一首慢歌。

cello.example: She plays the cello in our school music group every Friday.
cello.exampleZh: 她每周五在学校音乐小组里拉大提琴。

cellulose.example: Cotton is mostly cellulose, and plants use it to build strong cell walls.
cellulose.exampleZh: 棉花的主要成分是纤维素，植物用它来构建坚固的细胞壁。

celsius.example: The weather is cold because the temperature is five degrees celsius today.
celsius.exampleZh: 今天天气很冷，因为气温只有五摄氏度。

cement.example: We used cement to fix the broken wall in the garden.
cement.exampleZh: 我们用水泥修补了花园里破损的墙。

cemetery.example: The old cemetery near our house is very quiet at night.
cemetery.exampleZh: 我们家附近的旧墓地夜晚非常安静。

censor.example: The censor read the book carefully before allowing it to be published.
censor.exampleZh: 审查员在允许这本书出版之前仔细阅读了它。

census.example: The government will conduct a census next year to count every person.
census.exampleZh: 政府明年将进行人口普查，统计每一个人。

cent.example: I only have one cent left in my pocket today.
cent.exampleZh: 今天我口袋里只剩下一分钱。

centennial.example: The small town will hold a big party for its centennial next year.
centennial.exampleZh: 这个小镇明年将为它的百年纪念举办一场盛大的聚会。

centigrade.example: The water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade at sea level.
centigrade.exampleZh: 水在海平面处达到一百摄氏度时沸腾。

centimeter.example: The pencil is about fifteen centimeters long, so it fits in my small bag.
centimeter.exampleZh: 这支铅笔大约十五厘米长，所以能放进我的小包里。

central.example: The central station is close to the main shopping area.
central.exampleZh: 中央车站离主要购物区很近。

centre.example: The new shopping centre is in the centre of our town.
centre.exampleZh: 新的购物中心位于我们镇的中心。

century.example: The old church was built in the nineteenth century and still stands today.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪，至今仍然矗立。

cereal.example: I eat cereal with milk every morning before I go to school.
cereal.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前都吃麦片配牛奶。

cerebellum.example: The cerebellum helps control balance and movement in the human body.
cerebellum.exampleZh: 小脑帮助控制人体的平衡和运动。

cerebral.example: Reading good books can improve your cerebral skills and help you think clearly.
cerebral.exampleZh: 读好书能提升你的智力能力，帮助你清晰思考。

ceremonial.example: The king wore a ceremonial robe during the important event.
ceremonial.exampleZh: 国王在重要活动中穿着礼仪长袍。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony was simple and all our friends came to celebrate.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式很简单，我们所有的朋友都来庆祝了。

certain.example: I am certain that this is the right answer for you.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定这对你来说是正确答案。

certainty.example: There is no certainty that he will come tomorrow.
certainty.exampleZh: 他明天是否会来还不确定。

certificate.example: She received a certificate after she finished the training course last week.
certificate.exampleZh: 她上周完成培训课程后收到了一张证书。

certification.example: She received a certification after she finished the training course last week.
certification.exampleZh: 她上周完成培训课程后获得了一份认证。

certify.example: The doctor must certify that the patient is healthy enough to travel.
certify.exampleZh: 医生必须证明病人健康状况足以旅行。

chafe.example: My new shoes chafe my heels when I walk for a long time.
chafe.exampleZh: 我走路时间长了，新鞋就会磨痛我的脚后跟。

chagrin.example: To his chagrin, he forgot his keys and could not enter the house.
chagrin.exampleZh: 令他懊恼的是，他忘了钥匙，进不了家门。

chain.example: The bicycle chain fell off, so I could not ride to school.
chain.exampleZh: 自行车链条掉了，所以我无法骑车去学校。

chair.example: The teacher put an old wooden chair beside the desk for the visitor.
chair.exampleZh: 老师把一把旧木椅放在桌子旁边给访客坐。

chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting and asked everyone to sit down.
chairman.exampleZh: 主席宣布会议开始，并请大家坐下。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard with a piece of chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上写下了新单词。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge for many busy people.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言对许多忙碌的人来说是一个很大的挑战。

chamber.example: The doctor checked the small chamber and found nothing unusual in it.
chamber.exampleZh: 医生检查了那个小腔室，没有发现任何异常。

champ.example: The young champ raised the cup and smiled at the crowd.
champ.exampleZh: 那位年轻的冠军举起奖杯，向人群微笑。

champagne.example: We drank champagne at the party and everyone smiled all night.
champagne.exampleZh: 我们在派对上喝了香槟，大家整晚都笑容满面。

champion.example: She became the world champion after years of hard training and many competitions.
champion.exampleZh: 经过多年刻苦训练和许多比赛，她成为了世界冠军。

chance.example: I had a chance to meet my old friend at the park today.
chance.exampleZh: 今天我在公园有机会见到我的老朋友。

chancellor.example: The new chancellor promised to help students and teachers at the university.
chancellor.exampleZh: 新任大学校长承诺帮助这所大学的师生。

chandelier.example: The large chandelier in the dining room shines brightly above the table.
chandelier.exampleZh: 餐厅里那盏大枝形吊灯在桌子上方明亮地照着。

change.example: You can change your clothes before we leave for the party.
change.exampleZh: 我们出发去参加聚会之前，你可以换一下衣服。

channel.example: This TV channel shows many funny cartoons for children every morning.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每天早上播放许多有趣的儿童动画片。

chant.example: The students chant the song together in the classroom every morning.
chant.exampleZh: 学生们每天早上在教室里一起吟唱这首歌。

chaos.example: The power cut left the whole office in complete chaos.
chaos.exampleZh: 停电让整个办公室陷入了彻底的混乱。

chap.example: The young chap helped the old man carry his heavy bags home.
chap.exampleZh: 那个小伙子帮老人把沉重的袋子搬回家。

chapel.example: The old chapel stands quietly beside the school and the small garden.
chapel.exampleZh: 那座古老的小教堂安静地立在学校和小花园旁边。

chapter.example: I read the first chapter of this book last night.
chapter.exampleZh: 我昨晚读了这本书的第一章。

char.example: The fire will char the meat if you leave it too long.
char.exampleZh: 如果你把肉放得太久，火会把它烧焦。

character.example: Her character is kind and calm, and everyone likes her.
character.exampleZh: 她的性格善良又冷静，大家都喜欢她。

charcoal.example: She drew a dark tree with a piece of charcoal.
charcoal.exampleZh: 她用一块木炭画了一棵深色的树。

charge.example: The hotel will charge us extra for breakfast and parking.
charge.exampleZh: 酒店会额外向我们收取早餐和停车费。

charity.example: She gives old clothes to a local charity every spring.
charity.exampleZh: 她每年春天都把旧衣服捐给当地的一家慈善机构。

charlatan.example: The doctor was a charlatan who sold fake medicine to poor people.
charlatan.exampleZh: 那个医生是个江湖骗子，向穷人出售假药。

charm.example: Her warm smile and kind words give the old shop a special charm.
charm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑和亲切的话语给这家老店增添了特别的魅力。

chart.example: The teacher drew a simple chart to show how the numbers changed.
chart.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的图表来说明这些数字是如何变化的。

charter.example: The king signed a charter that gave the town new rights.
charter.exampleZh: 国王签署了一份宪章，赋予该镇新的权利。

chase.example: The dog likes to chase the ball around the park.
chase.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢在公园里追着球跑。

chasm.example: There is a deep chasm between the two sides of the road.
chasm.exampleZh: 道路两边之间有一道很深的裂隙。

chassis.example: The mechanic checked the chassis before installing the new engine.
chassis.exampleZh: 机械师在安装新发动机之前检查了底盘。

chaste.example: She lived a chaste life and never spoke badly of anyone.
chaste.exampleZh: 她过着贞洁的生活，从不说任何人的坏话。

chat.example: We often chat with our neighbors in the garden after dinner.
chat.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们常在花园里和邻居聊天。

chatter.example: The little birds chatter in the trees every morning before the sun rises.
chatter.exampleZh: 小鸟每天早晨在太阳升起前在树上啁啾。

chauffeur.example: The chauffeur opened the car door for the old man.
chauffeur.exampleZh: 司机为那位老人打开了车门。

chauvinist.example: My uncle is a chauvinist who thinks his country is always right.
chauvinist.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个沙文主义者，他认为自己的国家永远是对的。

cheap.example: This cheap bag broke after only one week of use.
cheap.exampleZh: 这个便宜的包只用了一周就坏了。

cheat.example: He tried to cheat on the test but the teacher saw him.
cheat.exampleZh: 他考试时想作弊，但老师看到了他。

check.example: Please check your answers carefully before you hand in the test paper.
check.exampleZh: 请在交试卷前仔细检查你的答案。

cheek.example: The cold wind made my cheek feel red and numb.
cheek.exampleZh: 冷风让我的脸颊感到又红又麻。

cheer.example: The happy fans cheer for their team after the game.
cheer.exampleZh: 比赛结束后，开心的球迷们为他们的球队欢呼。

cheese.example: I like to put some cheese on my bread for lunch.
cheese.exampleZh: 我喜欢午饭时在面包上放一些奶酪。

chef.example: The chef in the small restaurant makes very good food for everyone.
chef.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆的厨师为大家做非常好吃的东西。

chemical.example: We must store every chemical in a safe place at school.
chemical.exampleZh: 我们必须把每一种化学品都存放在学校里的安全地方。

chemist.example: The chemist in our town sells medicine and gives helpful advice.
chemist.exampleZh: 我们镇上的药剂师卖药并给出有用的建议。

chemotherapy.example: My aunt felt tired after chemotherapy, but she stayed strong and hopeful.
chemotherapy.exampleZh: 我姑姑化疗后感到疲倦，但她依然坚强并充满希望。

cherish.example: I cherish the happy memories we made together last summer.
cherish.exampleZh: 我珍视我们去年夏天一起创造的美好回忆。

cherry.example: She put a red cherry on top of her birthday cake.
cherry.exampleZh: 她把一颗红樱桃放在她的生日蛋糕上。

chess.example: My brother and I play chess every Sunday afternoon at home.
chess.exampleZh: 我和哥哥每个星期天下午都在家下国际象棋。

chest.example: He kept his old tools in a wooden chest near the door.
chest.exampleZh: 他把旧工具放在门边的一个木箱里。

chestnut.example: The old man roasted a chestnut over the fire in his small yard.
chestnut.exampleZh: 那位老人在他的小院子里在火上烤了一颗栗子。

chew.example: Dogs like to chew on bones after they finish eating.
chew.exampleZh: 狗吃完东西后喜欢啃骨头。

chick.example: The little chick followed its mother around the farm all morning.
chick.exampleZh: 小鸡整个上午都跟着妈妈在农场里转。

chicken.example: My mother cooked a whole chicken for our family dinner last night.
chicken.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈为我们家的晚餐煮了一整只鸡。

chide.example: My mother chided me gently for forgetting to call her last night.
chide.exampleZh: 妈妈轻声责备我昨晚忘了给她打电话。

chief.example: The chief reason we moved here is the quiet neighborhood.
chief.exampleZh: 我们搬到这里的主要原因是安静的社区。

child.example: Every child in the class received a small book from the teacher.
child.exampleZh: 班上的每个孩子都从老师那里得到了一本小书。

childhood.example: I spent my childhood in a small village near the sea.
childhood.exampleZh: 我的童年是在海边的一个小村庄里度过的。

chill.example: There is a chill in the air this morning.
chill.exampleZh: 今天早上空气里有一丝寒意。

chimney.example: Smoke from the old chimney rose slowly into the cold morning sky.
chimney.exampleZh: 烟从旧烟囱里慢慢升入寒冷的晨空。

chimpanzee.example: The chimpanzee at the zoo used a stick to get some food.
chimpanzee.exampleZh: 动物园里的黑猩猩用一根树枝获取了一些食物。

chin.example: He rested his chin on his hand and looked out the window.
chin.exampleZh: 他把下巴搁在手上，望着窗外。

china.example: She keeps her tea in a beautiful blue china pot.
china.exampleZh: 她把茶叶放在一个漂亮的蓝色瓷罐里。

chip.example: The computer has a small chip that makes it run very fast.
chip.exampleZh: 这台电脑有一个小芯片，使它运行得非常快。

chipmunk.example: A small chipmunk ran across the path and disappeared into the bushes.
chipmunk.exampleZh: 一只小花栗鼠跑过小路，消失在灌木丛里。

chirp.example: Birds chirp in the garden every morning.
chirp.exampleZh: 鸟儿每天早晨在花园里啁啾。

chisel.example: He used a sharp chisel to cut the wood into small pieces.
chisel.exampleZh: 他用一把锋利的凿子把木头切成小块。

chivalry.example: He showed true chivalry when he helped the lost child find her parents.
chivalry.exampleZh: 他帮助迷路的孩子找到父母时展现了真正的骑士精神。

chocolate.example: I bought a small box of chocolate for my sister yesterday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 我昨天给我妹妹买了一小盒巧克力。

choice.example: You have a choice between the red one and the blue one.
choice.exampleZh: 你可以在红色的那个和蓝色的那个之间做选择。

choir.example: The church choir sings beautiful songs every Sunday morning.
choir.exampleZh: 教堂唱诗班每个星期天早上都唱优美的歌曲。

choke.example: The smoke made him choke, so he opened the window quickly.
choke.exampleZh: 烟雾使他窒息，所以他很快打开了窗户。

cholesterol.example: Eating too much fried food can raise the cholesterol level in your blood.
cholesterol.exampleZh: 吃太多油炸食品会升高血液中的胆固醇水平。

choose.example: You can choose any book you like from this small shelf.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以从这个小书架上选择任何你喜欢的书。

chop.example: He used a sharp knife to chop the onions for dinner.
chop.exampleZh: 他用一把锋利的刀为晚餐切洋葱。

chopstick.example: Please put one chopstick on each plate before we start eating dinner.
chopstick.exampleZh: 请在我们开始吃晚饭前，在每个盘子上放一根筷子。

chord.example: She played a soft chord on the guitar and smiled at me.
chord.exampleZh: 她在吉他上弹了一个柔和的和弦，并对我微笑。

chore.example: Washing the dishes is a boring chore that I do every evening.
chore.exampleZh: 洗碗是我每天晚上都要做的一件无聊的家务。

chorus.example: The whole class sang the chorus together at the end of the song.
chorus.exampleZh: 全班同学在歌曲结尾一起唱了副歌。

christen.example: They will christen the baby in the old church this Sunday.
christen.exampleZh: 他们这个星期天将在那座老教堂为婴儿施洗礼。

christian.example: My Christian friend goes to church every Sunday with his family.
christian.exampleZh: 我的基督徒朋友每个星期天都和家人一起去教堂。

chrome.example: The old car has shiny chrome on its front bumper and doors.
chrome.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的前保险杠和车门上有闪亮的镀铬。

chronic.example: My uncle has chronic back pain and cannot sit for long.
chronic.exampleZh: 我叔叔有慢性背痛，不能久坐。

chronicle.example: The old book is a chronicle of life in our town.
chronicle.exampleZh: 这本旧书是我们镇上生活的编年史。

chronology.example: The teacher explained the chronology of the war in simple words.
chronology.exampleZh: 老师用简单的语言讲解了这场战争的时间顺序。

chrysanthemum.example: I saw a yellow chrysanthemum in the garden this morning.
chrysanthemum.exampleZh: 今天早上我在花园里看到了一朵黄色的菊花。

chuckle.example: She began to chuckle softly while reading the funny letter from her old friend.
chuckle.exampleZh: 她读着老朋友寄来的有趣信件时，开始轻声笑了起来。

chunk.example: She cut the meat into a large chunk for the soup.
chunk.exampleZh: 她把肉切成一大块用来做汤。

church.example: Many people go to the church on Sunday morning with their families.
church.exampleZh: 许多人周日早上和家人一起去教堂。

churn.example: The old machine will churn the milk into fresh butter today.
churn.exampleZh: 那台旧机器今天会把牛奶搅成新鲜黄油。

cider.example: My father likes to drink cold cider on hot summer days.
cider.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢在炎热的夏天喝冰苹果酒。

cigar.example: My grandfather sat on the porch and smoked a cigar after dinner.
cigar.exampleZh: 我爷爷晚饭后坐在门廊上抽了一支雪茄。

cigarette.example: He put a cigarette in his mouth and walked outside to smoke.
cigarette.exampleZh: 他把一根香烟放进嘴里，走到外面去抽烟。

cinder.example: The old fire left only a few cinders in the cold stove.
cinder.exampleZh: 旧火在冰冷的炉子里只留下几块煤渣。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night to watch a new film.
cinema.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去电影院看了一部新电影。

cipher.example: The spy wrote the message in cipher so no one could read it.
cipher.exampleZh: 间谍用密码写这条信息，所以没人能读懂。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The electric circuit broke and the small lamp stopped working last night.
circuit.exampleZh: 电路断了，小灯昨晚不亮了。

circular.example: The table in the kitchen has a circular top and four wooden legs.
circular.exampleZh: 厨房里的桌子有一个圆形桌面和四条木腿。

circulate.example: Rumors can circulate quickly through a small town.
circulate.exampleZh: 谣言会在小镇里迅速传播。

circulation.example: Regular exercise improves blood circulation and helps keep your body healthy.
circulation.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能改善血液循环，并有助于保持身体健康。

circumference.example: We measured the circumference of the tree with a long piece of string.
circumference.exampleZh: 我们用一根长绳子量了那棵树的周长。

circumstance.example: We must act quickly because this circumstance is new and difficult for everyone.
circumstance.exampleZh: 我们必须迅速行动，因为这种情况对每个人来说都是新的且困难。

circus.example: The children laughed at the funny clowns in the circus last night.
circus.exampleZh: 孩子们昨晚在马戏团里被有趣的小丑逗笑了。

cite.example: The teacher asked us to cite two books in our short essay.
cite.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在短文中引用两本书。

citizen.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in a free country.
citizen.exampleZh: 在一个自由的国家里，每个公民都有投票权。

citizenship.example: Citizenship gives people the right to vote and to live safely in their country.
citizenship.exampleZh: 公民身份赋予人们投票权以及在所在国安全生活的权利。

city.example: I moved to a new city last year to find a better job.
city.exampleZh: 去年我搬到一个新城市，想找一份更好的工作。

civic.example: The city built a new civic center for all its residents.
civic.exampleZh: 市政府为所有居民建了一座新的市民中心。

civil.example: The new law protects the civil rights of every person in our country.
civil.exampleZh: 新法律保护我们国家每个人的公民权利。

civilian.example: The soldiers helped the civilians leave the dangerous area after the attack.
civilian.exampleZh: 士兵们在袭击后帮助平民离开危险地区。

civilization.example: Ancient Egypt had a rich civilization along the Nile River.
civilization.exampleZh: 古埃及在尼罗河沿岸拥有丰富的文明。

civilize.example: Teachers help civilize young children by teaching them good manners and respect.
civilize.exampleZh: 老师通过教导孩子礼貌和尊重来帮助教化幼儿。

claim.example: He will claim the lost bag at the front desk tomorrow morning.
claim.exampleZh: 他明天早上会到前台认领丢失的包。

clamor.example: The loud clamor from the crowd made it hard to hear.
clamor.exampleZh: 人群的喧闹声太大，很难听清。

clamp.example: Please use a clamp to hold these two pieces of wood together.
clamp.exampleZh: 请用夹具把这两块木头固定在一起。

clan.example: The whole clan came together to celebrate the wedding in the village.
clan.exampleZh: 整个宗族聚在一起，在村里庆祝这场婚礼。

clap.example: Everyone began to clap loudly when the singer finished her song.
clap.exampleZh: 歌手唱完歌后，大家都开始大声鼓掌。

clarify.example: Please clarify your question so I can give you a better answer.
clarify.exampleZh: 请澄清你的问题，这样我才能给你更好的回答。

clarinet.example: My sister plays the clarinet in our school band every Friday afternoon.
clarinet.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周五下午在学校乐队里吹单簧管。

clarity.example: The teacher explained the problem with great clarity so everyone understood it.
clarity.exampleZh: 老师非常清晰地解释了这个问题，所以每个人都懂了。

clash.example: Their ideas often clash during meetings, but they still work well together.
clash.exampleZh: 他们的想法在会议上经常冲突，但他们仍然合作得很好。

clasp.example: She clasped the necklace around her neck and smiled at the mirror.
clasp.exampleZh: 她把项链扣在脖子上，对着镜子笑了。

class.example: Our class has twenty students and a very kind teacher.
class.exampleZh: 我们班有二十名学生和一位非常和蔼的老师。

classic.example: This book is a classic story that many children love to read.
classic.exampleZh: 这本书是一个许多孩子喜欢读的经典故事。

classify.example: We classify the books by subject before we put them on the shelves.
classify.exampleZh: 我们把书按主题分类，然后把它们放到书架上。

classroom.example: Our classroom is clean and bright, and we study here every day.
classroom.exampleZh: 我们的教室干净明亮，我们每天在这里学习。

clatter.example: The old truck made a loud clatter as it drove over the rocky road.
clatter.exampleZh: 那辆旧卡车驶过石子路时发出响亮的咔嗒声。

clause.example: This clause in the contract explains when you must pay.
clause.exampleZh: 合同中的这一条款说明了你必须何时付款。

clay.example: The children made a small pot from wet clay in the garden.
clay.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里用湿黏土做了一个小陶罐。

clean.example: Please clean your room before you go out to play with your friends.
clean.exampleZh: 请在你出去和朋友玩之前打扫你的房间。

clear.example: The sky is clear today, so we can see the mountains far away.
clear.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗，所以我们可以看见远处的群山。

clench.example: She clenched her fists and took a deep breath before the race.
clench.exampleZh: 比赛前，她握紧拳头，深吸了一口气。

clergy.example: The clergy led the morning prayer at the small village church.
clergy.exampleZh: 神职人员在小村庄的教堂里带领了晨祷。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my lost bag.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台职员帮我找到了丢失的包。

clever.example: The clever girl found an easy way to solve the problem.
clever.exampleZh: 那个聪明的女孩找到了一个解决这个问题的简单方法。

click.example: Please click the blue button to start the game now.
click.exampleZh: 请现在点击蓝色按钮来开始游戏。

client.example: The client asked us to finish the work before Friday.
client.exampleZh: 客户要求我们在周五之前完成这项工作。

cliff.example: We stood near the cliff and watched the sea below.
cliff.exampleZh: 我们站在悬崖附近，望着下方的大海。

climate.example: The climate in this city is warm and wet all year.
climate.exampleZh: 这座城市的气候全年温暖湿润。

climax.example: The movie reaches its climax when the hero finally meets his old friend.
climax.exampleZh: 当英雄终于见到他的老朋友时，电影达到了高潮。

climb.example: They climb the hill every morning before breakfast.
climb.exampleZh: 他们每天早上在早餐前爬那座小山。

cling.example: The child still clings to his mother when he feels afraid.
cling.exampleZh: 孩子害怕时仍然紧紧依恋着母亲。

clinic.example: The new clinic is near my house and opens early every morning.
clinic.exampleZh: 新诊所就在我家附近，每天早上很早就开门。

clip.example: She used a clip to hold the papers together on the desk.
clip.exampleZh: 她用夹子把桌上的纸夹在一起。

cloak.example: He wore a dark cloak to hide his face from the crowd.
cloak.exampleZh: 他穿着一件深色斗篷，在人群中遮住自己的脸。

clock.example: The clock on the wall shows the time for everyone in the room.
clock.exampleZh: 墙上的时钟为房间里的每个人显示时间。

clockwise.example: Please turn the handle in a clockwise direction to open the door.
clockwise.exampleZh: 请按顺时针方向转动把手来开门。

clone.example: The scientist made a clone of the sheep in a simple lab.
clone.exampleZh: 科学家在一个简单的实验室里克隆了这只羊。

close.example: Please close the door when you leave the room today.
close.exampleZh: 今天离开房间时请把门关上。

closet.example: She put her old clothes in the closet and closed the door.
closet.exampleZh: 她把旧衣服放进壁橱，然后关上了门。

cloth.example: She bought some soft cloth to make a new dress for her daughter.
cloth.exampleZh: 她买了一些柔软的布料，为她女儿做一条新裙子。

clothes.example: She washes her clothes every Saturday morning before she goes to work.
clothes.exampleZh: 她每周六早上上班前洗衣服。

clothing.example: She bought warm clothing for the cold winter trip to the mountains.
clothing.exampleZh: 她为去山区的寒冷冬季旅行买了保暖衣物。

cloud.example: A dark cloud moved across the sky before the rain began.
cloud.exampleZh: 下雨前，一朵乌云掠过天空。

club.example: She joined a new club at school and made many good friends.
club.exampleZh: 她在学校加入了一个新社团，并交了许多好朋友。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the old house last night.
clue.exampleZh: 警方昨晚在那栋老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

clumsy.example: He is too clumsy to carry the glass without dropping it.
clumsy.exampleZh: 他太笨拙了，拿玻璃杯时总会把它摔掉。

cluster.example: A small cluster of stars shines brightly in the night sky.
cluster.exampleZh: 一小簇星星在夜空中明亮地闪烁。

clutch.example: She had to clutch the rope tightly to avoid falling.
clutch.exampleZh: 她不得不紧紧抓住绳子以免摔倒。

coach.example: Our basketball coach helps every player improve after school on weekdays.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的篮球教练在工作日放学后帮助每位球员提高。

coagulate.example: Blood will coagulate when it is exposed to air for a long time.
coagulate.exampleZh: 血液暴露在空气中很长时间后会凝结。

coal.example: The old train burned coal to make steam for its long journey.
coal.exampleZh: 那列旧火车燃烧煤炭产生蒸汽，以完成它的长途旅程。

coalition.example: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
coalition.exampleZh: 两个政党结成联盟以赢得选举。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the big waves come in.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着大浪涌来。

coastal.example: The small coastal town is quiet and beautiful in the summer.
coastal.exampleZh: 这个沿海小镇在夏天安静又美丽。

coastline.example: The coastline is long and beautiful, and many birds live there.
coastline.exampleZh: 这条海岸线又长又美，许多鸟生活在那里。

coat.example: She wore a warm coat because the weather was very cold today.
coat.exampleZh: 她穿了一件暖和的外套，因为今天天气很冷。

coating.example: A thin coating of paint protects the old wooden table from water.
coating.exampleZh: 一层薄薄的油漆涂层保护着这张旧木桌不受水侵蚀。

coax.example: She tried to coax the scared cat out from under the bed.
coax.exampleZh: 她试着哄那只害怕的猫从床底下出来。

cobble.example: The old man used a smooth cobble to fix the broken wall.
cobble.exampleZh: 老人用一块光滑的鹅卵石修补破损的墙。

cocaine.example: The police found cocaine in his car and arrested him at once.
cocaine.exampleZh: 警察在他的车里发现了可卡因，并立即逮捕了他。

cock.example: The cock crowed loudly at dawn and woke everyone on the farm.
cock.exampleZh: 公鸡在黎明时大声打鸣，叫醒了农场里的所有人。

cockpit.example: The pilot sat in the cockpit and checked every button before the flight.
cockpit.exampleZh: 飞行员坐在驾驶舱里，在飞行前检查了每个按钮。

cocktail.example: She ordered a fruity cocktail and drank it slowly by the pool.
cocktail.exampleZh: 她点了一杯果味鸡尾酒，在泳池边慢慢喝着。

cocoa.example: I like to drink hot cocoa on cold winter mornings with my family.
cocoa.exampleZh: 我喜欢在寒冷的冬天早晨和家人一起喝热可可。

coconut.example: I bought a coconut at the market and drank its sweet water.
coconut.exampleZh: 我在市场买了一个椰子，喝了它甜甜的椰水。

cod.example: We caught a large cod near the old boat this morning.
cod.exampleZh: 今天早上我们在旧船附近钓到了一条大鳕鱼。

code.example: Please enter the code on the screen to open the door.
code.exampleZh: 请输入屏幕上的密码来开门。

coexist.example: People from different cultures can coexist peacefully when they respect each other.
coexist.exampleZh: 当人们互相尊重时，来自不同文化的人可以和平共处。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before I go to work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会喝一杯咖啡。

coffin.example: They put the old wooden coffin into the ground on a cold morning.
coffin.exampleZh: 在一个寒冷的早晨，他们把旧木棺材放进了土里。

cognition.example: Good sleep can improve your cognition and help you learn new things.
cognition.exampleZh: 良好睡眠能改善你的认知，并帮助你学习新事物。

cognitive.example: Good sleep can improve cognitive skills and help you learn new things.
cognitive.exampleZh: 良好睡眠能提高认知能力，并帮助你学习新事物。

cohabit.example: Many young couples cohabit before marriage these days.
cohabit.exampleZh: 现在很多年轻情侣在结婚前同居。

coherent.example: Her story was coherent and easy for everyone to follow.
coherent.exampleZh: 她的故事连贯一致，大家都容易听懂。

cohesion.example: Team members trust each other, and this trust gives the group real cohesion.
cohesion.exampleZh: 团队成员彼此信任，这种信任赋予团队真正的凝聚力。

cohesive.example: A good team is cohesive and works well together every day.
cohesive.exampleZh: 一个好的团队有凝聚力，并且每天都能很好地合作。

cohort.example: The new cohort of students started classes together this morning.
cohort.exampleZh: 这批新生今天早上一起开始上课。

coil.example: She used a long rope to coil around the old tree.
coil.exampleZh: 她用一根长绳盘绕在那棵老树上。

coin.example: I found a shiny coin on the sidewalk near my house.
coin.exampleZh: 我在我家附近的人行道上发现了一枚闪亮的硬币。

coincide.example: Our ideas often coincide, so we rarely argue about the plan.
coincide.exampleZh: 我们的想法常常一致，所以我们很少为计划争吵。

coincidence.example: It was a coincidence that we met again at the same small cafe.
coincidence.exampleZh: 我们又在同一家小咖啡馆见面，真是巧合。

coincidental.example: It was purely coincidental that we met at the same small cafe.
coincidental.exampleZh: 我们在同一家小咖啡馆碰面纯属巧合。

coke.example: He drank a cold coke after work and felt much better.
coke.exampleZh: 他下班后喝了一瓶冷可乐，感觉好多了。

collaborate.example: We often collaborate with other teams to finish the work on time.
collaborate.exampleZh: 我们经常与其他团队合作，按时完成工作。

collaboration.example: Our team worked in close collaboration with the local school on this project.
collaboration.exampleZh: 我们团队在这个项目上与当地学校密切合作。

collapse.example: The old building may collapse after the heavy rain stops.
collapse.exampleZh: 那座旧楼可能在大雨停后倒塌。

collar.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck in the park.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗在公园里脖子上戴着一个红色项圈。

colleague.example: My colleague helped me finish the report before the meeting started.
colleague.exampleZh: 我的同事在会议开始前帮我完成了报告。

collect.example: She likes to collect old stamps from different countries around the world.
collect.exampleZh: 她喜欢收集来自世界不同国家的旧邮票。

collection.example: She keeps a small collection of old coins in her desk.
collection.exampleZh: 她在书桌里收藏着一小套旧硬币。

collective.example: The team made a collective decision to finish the work early.
collective.exampleZh: 团队做出了集体决定，要提前完成工作。

college.example: My sister studies at a small college near our home.
college.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们家附近的一所小型学院学习。

collide.example: The two cars collided at the corner because the driver did not stop.
collide.exampleZh: 两辆车在拐角处相撞，因为司机没有停车。

collision.example: The two cars had a bad collision on the busy road this morning.
collision.exampleZh: 今天早上两辆汽车在繁忙的道路上发生了严重碰撞。

collude.example: The two men tried to collude and cheat the company out of money.
collude.exampleZh: 这两个男人试图串通起来骗取公司的钱。

colonial.example: Many colonial buildings still stand in the old part of the city.
colonial.exampleZh: 许多殖民时期的建筑仍然矗立在城市的旧城区。

colonialism.example: Many countries in Africa suffered under colonialism for a long time.
colonialism.exampleZh: 非洲许多国家长期遭受殖民主义之苦。

colony.example: The small colony of ants built a new home under the old tree.
colony.exampleZh: 这一小群蚂蚁在老树下面建了一个新家。

color.example: Her favorite color is blue, and she paints her room with it.
color.exampleZh: 她最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，她用这种颜色粉刷房间。

colossal.example: The new stadium is a colossal building near the river.
colossal.exampleZh: 这座新体育场是河边一座巨大的建筑。

colour.example: What is your favourite colour for the walls in this room?
colour.exampleZh: 这个房间里你最喜欢墙壁用什么颜色？

column.example: The teacher wrote the new words in a single column on the board.
column.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上把新单词写在一列里。

columnist.example: The columnist writes a short article about city life every week.
columnist.exampleZh: 这位专栏作家每周写一篇关于城市生活的短文。

comb.example: She uses a small comb to fix her hair before school every morning.
comb.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前用一把小梳子整理头发。

combat.example: The soldiers showed great courage in combat and never gave up.
combat.exampleZh: 士兵们在战斗中表现出极大的勇气，从未放弃。

combination.example: The combination of good food and music made the party fun.
combination.exampleZh: 美食和音乐的结合让聚会很有趣。

combine.example: We combine our ideas to make the project better and finish it faster.
combine.exampleZh: 我们结合各自的想法，让项目更好并更快完成。

combust.example: Dry wood combusts quickly when it gets very hot in a fire.
combust.exampleZh: 干木头在火中变得很热时会迅速燃烧。

comedy.example: The comedy on television last night made my whole family laugh.
comedy.exampleZh: 昨晚电视上的那部喜剧让我们全家都笑了。

comet.example: Last night I saw a bright comet in the sky through my telescope.
comet.exampleZh: 昨晚我用望远镜在天空中看到了一颗明亮的彗星。

comfort.example: She found great comfort in her friends after the long and difficult day.
comfort.exampleZh: 在漫长而艰难的一天之后，她从朋友们那里得到了很大的安慰。

command.example: The general can command his soldiers to move quickly and stay together.
command.exampleZh: 将军能命令他的士兵快速移动并保持在一起。

commander.example: The commander told his soldiers to stay calm and wait for new orders.
commander.exampleZh: 指挥官告诉他的士兵保持冷静，等待新的命令。

commemorate.example: People build a small garden to commemorate the soldiers who died in the war.
commemorate.exampleZh: 人们建了一座小花园来纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵。

commence.example: The meeting will commence at nine in the morning.
commence.exampleZh: 会议将在上午九点开始。

comment.example: She left a kind comment under my photo yesterday.
comment.exampleZh: 她昨天在我的照片下留了一条友善的评论。

commentary.example: I listened to the live commentary during the football game last night.
commentary.exampleZh: 昨晚足球比赛期间，我听了现场解说。

commerce.example: Online commerce makes it easy for small shops to reach new customers.
commerce.exampleZh: 在线商务让小商店更容易接触到新顾客。

commercial.example: The commercial area of the city is busy every day.
commercial.exampleZh: 城市的商业区每天都很繁忙。

commission.example: The city formed a commission to study the problem and report its findings.
commission.exampleZh: 该市成立了一个委员会来研究这个问题并报告其调查结果。

commissioner.example: The commissioner met the local people and listened to their problems.
commissioner.exampleZh: 专员会见了当地人并听取了他们的问题。

commit.example: He promised to commit more time to his family this year.
commit.exampleZh: 他承诺今年把更多时间投入到家庭中。

commitment.example: She made a strong commitment to help her team finish the project on time.
commitment.exampleZh: 她郑重承诺帮助团队按时完成项目。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Friday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 委员会将于周五开会讨论新计划。

commodity.example: This commodity is very useful in our daily life.
commodity.exampleZh: 这种商品在我们的日常生活中非常有用。

common.example: This is a common problem for many students in our school.
common.exampleZh: 这是我们学校许多学生常见的问题。

commonplace.example: Such complaints are commonplace in this small office.
commonplace.exampleZh: 这类抱怨在这个小办公室里很常见。

commonwealth.example: The former colony joined the commonwealth after gaining full independence.
commonwealth.exampleZh: 这个前殖民地在获得完全独立后加入了该联邦。

communicate.example: We use email to communicate with our teachers every day.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每天用电子邮件和老师沟通。

communication.example: Good communication helps people solve problems and work together more easily.
communication.exampleZh: 良好的沟通有助于人们解决问题并更轻松地合作。

community.example: Our community works together to keep the park clean and safe.
community.exampleZh: 我们的社区齐心协力保持公园干净和安全。

commute.example: I commute to work by bus every morning.
commute.exampleZh: 我每天早上乘公交车通勤上班。

commuter.example: Every morning the commuter takes the train to work in the city.
commuter.exampleZh: 每天早上，这位通勤者乘火车去城里上班。

compact.example: This compact car is easy to park in small spaces.
compact.exampleZh: 这辆小型汽车很容易停在狭小的空间里。

companion.example: A good companion makes a long journey feel short and happy.
companion.exampleZh: 一位好同伴会让漫长的旅程感觉短暂又快乐。

companionship.example: Good companionship makes long journeys feel shorter and much more enjoyable.
companionship.exampleZh: 好的陪伴让漫长的旅途感觉更短，也更愉快。

company.example: My father works for a small company in the city center.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在市中心一家小公司工作。

comparable.example: These two phones are comparable in price and size.
comparable.exampleZh: 这两部手机在价格和大小上差不多。

comparative.example: This comparative study shows that the new method is clearly better.
comparative.exampleZh: 这项比较研究表明，新方法明显更好。

compare.example: We often compare prices before we buy things at the store.
compare.exampleZh: 我们经常在商店买东西前比较价格。

comparison.example: The comparison between the two plans helped us make a wise choice.
comparison.exampleZh: 这两个计划之间的比较帮助我们做出了明智的选择。

compartment.example: She put her bag in the small compartment above her seat.
compartment.exampleZh: 她把包放在座位上方的那个小隔层里。

compass.example: A compass can help you find your way when you are lost.
compass.exampleZh: 指南针能在你迷路时帮你找到方向。

compassion.example: She showed great compassion for the sick children in her neighborhood.
compassion.exampleZh: 她对附近生病的孩子们表现出极大的同情。

compel.example: The bad weather compelled us to cancel the trip.
compel.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们取消了这次旅行。

compensate.example: The company will compensate customers for the damage caused by the delay.
compensate.exampleZh: 公司会赔偿顾客因延误造成的损失。

compensation.example: The company paid him compensation for the injury he suffered at work.
compensation.exampleZh: 公司就他在工作中受到的伤害向他支付了赔偿金。

compete.example: Our team will compete in the city basketball game next Saturday.
compete.exampleZh: 我们队下周六将参加城市篮球比赛。

competent.example: She is a competent teacher and her students all like her.
competent.exampleZh: 她是一位有能力的老师，她的学生都喜欢她。

competing.example: The two competing plans made it hard for us to choose.
competing.exampleZh: 这两个相互竞争的计划让我们难以选择。

competitive.example: She is very competitive and always tries to win every game.
competitive.exampleZh: 她非常好胜，总是想在每场比赛中获胜。

competitor.example: Every competitor must follow the rules during the race tomorrow.
competitor.exampleZh: 每位参赛者明天在比赛中都必须遵守规则。

compile.example: They will compile a list of all the books in the library.
compile.exampleZh: 他们将汇编图书馆里所有书籍的清单。

complain.example: Many customers complain about the slow service at this small restaurant every day.
complain.exampleZh: 许多顾客每天都抱怨这家小餐馆服务慢。

complaint.example: She made a complaint about the loud music from the party next door.
complaint.exampleZh: 她投诉隔壁派对音乐太吵。

complement.example: A good sauce is a perfect complement to the simple dish.
complement.exampleZh: 好的酱汁是这道简单菜肴的完美补充。

complete.example: The team will complete the project before the end of this week.
complete.exampleZh: 团队将在本周末之前完成这个项目。

complex.example: This math problem is too complex for most students to solve quickly.
complex.exampleZh: 这道数学题对大多数学生来说太复杂，难以快速解出。

complexion.example: Her complexion looked healthy after a week of rest.
complexion.exampleZh: 休息一周后，她的面色看起来很健康。

complexity.example: The complexity of the new rules made the work hard for everyone.
complexity.exampleZh: 新规则的复杂性让每个人的工作都变得困难。

compliant.example: The new machine is compliant with all safety rules in our factory.
compliant.exampleZh: 这台新机器符合我们工厂的所有安全规定。

complicate.example: Too many rules can complicate even a simple task for new workers.
complicate.exampleZh: 太多规则会让新员工连简单任务都变得复杂。

complication.example: The doctor said the infection was a serious complication after the surgery.
complication.exampleZh: 医生说感染是手术后的严重并发症。

component.example: The engine has many small components that work together.
component.exampleZh: 这台发动机有许多协同工作的小部件。

comport.example: He always comports himself with great calm when things go wrong.
comport.exampleZh: 事情出错时，他总是表现得非常镇定。

compose.example: The teacher asked us to compose a short song for the school show.
compose.exampleZh: 老师让我们为学校演出创作一首短歌。

composer.example: The composer wrote a beautiful song for the film last year.
composer.exampleZh: 这位作曲家去年为这部电影写了一首优美的歌曲。

composition.example: The teacher asked us to write a short composition about our family.
composition.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一篇关于家庭的短作文。

compost.example: We put fruit peels and dead leaves in the compost bin.
compost.exampleZh: 我们把果皮和枯叶放进堆肥箱里。

compound.example: Water is a simple compound made from hydrogen and oxygen.
compound.exampleZh: 水是由氢和氧组成的简单化合物。

comprehend.example: It is hard for young children to comprehend this difficult idea.
comprehend.exampleZh: 幼儿很难理解这个困难的想法。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of difficult texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对难文章的理解。

comprehensive.example: The report gives a comprehensive view of the city's air quality problems.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 这份报告全面介绍了该市的空气质量问题。

compress.example: You can compress the files into one small folder before you send them.
compress.exampleZh: 你可以在发送之前把这些文件压缩成一个小文件夹。

comprise.example: The team comprises five members from three different countries.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由来自三个不同国家的五名成员组成。

compromise.example: They reached a compromise after a long and difficult discussion.
compromise.exampleZh: 经过漫长而艰难的讨论，他们达成了妥协。

compulsory.example: Physical education is compulsory for all students in our school.
compulsory.exampleZh: 在我们学校，体育对所有学生都是必修的。

compute.example: We use a computer to compute the total cost of the trip.
compute.exampleZh: 我们用计算机计算这次旅行的总费用。

computer.example: I use my computer every day to check email and do homework.
computer.exampleZh: 我每天用电脑查看电子邮件和做作业。

comrade.example: My father said his old comrade helped him when times were hard.
comrade.exampleZh: 我父亲说他的老战友在艰难时期帮助过他。

conceal.example: She tried to conceal her sadness from her friends at the party.
conceal.exampleZh: 她试图在聚会上向朋友们隐瞒自己的悲伤。

concede.example: He refused to concede the game even after making many mistakes.
concede.exampleZh: 他即使犯了很多错误也拒绝认输。

conceited.example: He is so conceited that he never listens to anyone else.
conceited.exampleZh: 他太自负了，从不听别人的话。

conceive.example: It is hard to conceive how people lived without electricity in the past.
conceive.exampleZh: 很难想象过去没有电人们是如何生活的。

concentrate.example: I cannot concentrate on my work when the room is too noisy.
concentrate.exampleZh: 房间太吵时，我无法专心工作。

concentration.example: Good concentration helps students finish their homework quickly and correctly.
concentration.exampleZh: 良好的专注力能帮助学生又快又准确地完成作业。

concept.example: The idea of freedom is a difficult concept for young children to understand.
concept.exampleZh: 自由这一观念对幼儿来说是一个难以理解的概念。

conception.example: Her conception of friendship is simple and kind.
conception.exampleZh: 她对友谊的观念简单而友善。

concern.example: This problem may concern everyone who lives in our small town.
concern.exampleZh: 这个问题可能关系到我们小镇上的每个人。

concerning.example: I have a question concerning the new rules for our class.
concerning.exampleZh: 我有一个关于我们班新规则的问题。

concert.example: We went to a concert last night and heard beautiful music.
concert.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去听了一场音乐会，听到了美妙的音乐。

concession.example: The manager made a small concession to end the long argument.
concession.exampleZh: 经理做出了一个小让步来结束这场长时间的争论。

concise.example: Her report was concise and clear, so everyone understood it quickly.
concise.exampleZh: 她的报告简明清晰，所以每个人都很快理解了。

conclude.example: We can conclude from these facts that the plan will work.
conclude.exampleZh: 我们可以从这些事实得出结论：这个计划会成功。

conclusion.example: After a long discussion, we finally reached a clear conclusion about the plan.
conclusion.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，我们终于就这个计划得出了一个明确的结论。

concrete.example: We need concrete evidence before we make a big decision today.
concrete.exampleZh: 我们需要具体证据才能在今天做出重大决定。

condemn.example: Many people condemn the new law because they think it is unfair.
condemn.exampleZh: 许多人谴责这项新法律，因为他们认为它不公平。

condense.example: When water vapor cools, it can condense into small drops on cold glass.
condense.exampleZh: 当水蒸气冷却时，它会在冰冷的玻璃上凝结成小水滴。

condition.example: The doctor said his condition is getting better every day.
condition.exampleZh: 医生说他的病情每天都在好转。

conduct.example: The teacher will conduct a simple test in class tomorrow.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师明天将在课堂上进行一次简单的测试。

conductor.example: The conductor raised his hand and the train began to move.
conductor.exampleZh: 列车长举起手，火车开始移动。

cone.example: She bought an ice cream cone and ate it in the park.
cone.exampleZh: 她买了一个冰淇淋蛋筒，在公园里吃掉了。

confederacy.example: The small states formed a confederacy to protect their shared trade routes.
confederacy.exampleZh: 这些小州组成了一个同盟来保护它们共同的贸易路线。

confederate.example: The confederate leaders met to discuss their shared plans.
confederate.exampleZh: 邦联领导人会面讨论他们的共同计划。

confer.example: The doctors will confer with the family before they make a final decision.
confer.exampleZh: 医生们会在做出最终决定前与家属商议。

conference.example: I will go to a conference in Beijing next week with my team.
conference.exampleZh: 下周我将和我的团队去北京参加一个会议。

confess.example: He decided to confess the truth to his parents after dinner.
confess.exampleZh: 他决定晚饭后向父母坦白真相。

confide.example: I confide in my best friend when I feel worried.
confide.exampleZh: 当我感到担心时，我会向最好的朋友吐露心声。

confidence.example: She spoke with great confidence during her first job interview yesterday.
confidence.exampleZh: 她在昨天的第一次求职面试中充满自信地发言。

confident.example: She feels confident when she speaks in front of her class.
confident.exampleZh: 她在全班同学面前讲话时感到自信。

confidential.example: Please keep this report confidential because it contains private information about our company.
confidential.exampleZh: 请对这份报告保密，因为它包含我们公司的私人信息。

configuration.example: The new configuration of the room makes it easier to move around.
configuration.exampleZh: 房间的新布局让人走动起来更容易。

confine.example: The doctors confine the sick man to his room for a week.
confine.exampleZh: 医生把病人限制在房间里一个星期。

confirm.example: Please confirm your booking by email before you come to the hotel.
confirm.exampleZh: 请你在来酒店之前通过电子邮件确认你的预订。

confirmation.example: I received a confirmation email after I booked the hotel room online.
confirmation.exampleZh: 我在网上预订酒店房间后收到了一封确认邮件。

conflict.example: There was a serious conflict between the two groups over the new rules.
conflict.exampleZh: 两个团体因新规定发生了严重冲突。

conform.example: Good students conform to the school rules and listen to their teachers.
conform.exampleZh: 好学生遵守校规并听从老师的话。

confront.example: We must confront the difficult problem before it gets worse.
confront.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前面对它。

confuse.example: The teacher's long explanation confused many students in the class today.
confuse.exampleZh: 老师冗长的讲解今天让班上许多学生感到困惑。

confusion.example: The sudden change in the rules caused a lot of confusion among us.
confusion.exampleZh: 规则的突然改变在我们中间引起了很多困惑。

congeal.example: The cold air made the soup congeal into a thick, solid block.
congeal.exampleZh: 冷空气使汤凝结成一块厚实的固体。

congenial.example: She is congenial and easy to talk to at work.
congenial.exampleZh: 她在工作中很随和，也很好交谈。

congenital.example: The doctor said the baby had a congenital heart problem.
congenital.exampleZh: 医生说这个婴儿有先天性心脏问题。

congest.example: Too many cars congest the narrow streets every morning.
congest.exampleZh: 每天早上太多汽车使狭窄的街道拥堵。

congratulate.example: I want to congratulate you on passing your driving test today.
congratulate.exampleZh: 我想祝贺你今天通过了驾驶考试。

congregate.example: Every morning, many birds congregate near the lake to drink and rest.
congregate.exampleZh: 每天早晨，许多鸟聚集在湖边喝水休息。

congress.example: The congress passed a new law after a long and serious debate.
congress.exampleZh: 国会经过长时间认真辩论后通过了一项新法律。

conifer.example: The tall conifer in our garden stays green all winter.
conifer.exampleZh: 我们花园里那棵高大的针叶树整个冬天都保持绿色。

conjecture.example: His idea was only a conjecture and no one could prove it.
conjecture.exampleZh: 他的想法只是一个推测，没有人能证明它。

conjunction.example: The conjunction of hard work and luck helped him succeed.
conjunction.exampleZh: 努力和运气的结合帮助他成功了。

conjure.example: The old woman can conjure a bright bird from her hat.
conjure.exampleZh: 那位老妇人能从帽子里变出一只亮丽的鸟。

connect.example: Please connect your phone to the Wi-Fi before you start the online meeting.
connect.exampleZh: 开始线上会议前，请把你的手机连接到 Wi-Fi。

connection.example: A good internet connection is important for online classes and video calls.
connection.exampleZh: 良好的网络连接对在线课程和视频通话很重要。

connive.example: The manager connived at the workers' unsafe behavior for many months.
connive.exampleZh: 经理许多个月来一直纵容工人的不安全行为。

connoisseur.example: My uncle is a connoisseur of old books and fine tea.
connoisseur.exampleZh: 我叔叔是一位旧书和好茶的鉴赏家。

connotation.example: The word home has a warm connotation for most people.
connotation.exampleZh: home 这个词对大多数人来说有温暖的内涵。

conquer.example: She worked hard to conquer her fear of speaking in public.
conquer.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己当众演讲的恐惧。

conqueror.example: The old king was a great conqueror who won many battles.
conqueror.exampleZh: 那位年老的国王是一位赢得许多战役的伟大征服者。

conquest.example: The king celebrated his conquest of the city with a great feast.
conquest.exampleZh: 国王用一场盛大的宴会庆祝他攻下这座城市。

conscience.example: A good conscience helps you sleep well after making a difficult choice.
conscience.exampleZh: 良好的良知能让你在做出艰难选择后安然入睡。

conscientious.example: She is a conscientious worker and always finishes her tasks on time.
conscientious.exampleZh: 她是一名认真的员工，总是按时完成任务。

conscious.example: She was conscious of the danger and walked home quickly.
conscious.exampleZh: 她意识到危险，于是快步走回家。

consciousness.example: Meditation can help you become more aware of your own consciousness.
consciousness.exampleZh: 冥想可以帮助你更加觉察自己的意识。

consecutive.example: She won three consecutive games and became the champion of our school.
consecutive.exampleZh: 她连续赢了三场比赛，成为我们学校的冠军。

consensus.example: The group finally reached a consensus after a long and friendly discussion.
consensus.exampleZh: 小组经过长时间友好讨论后终于达成了共识。

consent.example: Her parents did not consent to the school trip this year.
consent.exampleZh: 她父母今年没有同意这次学校旅行。

consequence.example: Every choice has a consequence, so think carefully before you act.
consequence.exampleZh: 每个选择都有后果，所以行动前要仔细考虑。

consequently.example: It rained all day, and consequently the game was canceled.
consequently.exampleZh: 下了一整天雨，因此比赛取消了。

conservation.example: Water conservation helps us save enough clean water for the dry season.
conservation.exampleZh: 节约用水能帮助我们为旱季储存足够的清洁水。

conservatism.example: His conservatism makes him resist every new idea at work.
conservatism.exampleZh: 他的保守主义使他在工作中抵制每一个新想法。

conservative.example: My grandfather is a conservative man and he dislikes rapid changes in society.
conservative.exampleZh: 我的祖父是个保守的人，他不喜欢社会上的快速变化。

conserve.example: We should conserve water and electricity at home every day.
conserve.exampleZh: 我们每天都应该在家里节约用水和用电。

consider.example: We should consider his advice before we make the final decision.
consider.exampleZh: 在做最终决定之前，我们应该考虑他的建议。

considerable.example: This project will require a considerable amount of time and money.
considerable.exampleZh: 这个项目将需要相当多的时间和金钱。

considerate.example: It is considerate of you to help your busy neighbor.
considerate.exampleZh: 你帮助忙碌的邻居，真是体贴。

consideration.example: After careful consideration, she decided to accept the new job offer.
consideration.exampleZh: 经过仔细考虑，她决定接受这份新工作。

consist.example: The team consists of five players and two coaches.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名队员和两名教练组成。

consistency.example: The team showed great consistency in its work throughout the whole year.
consistency.exampleZh: 这支团队全年在工作中表现出很高的一致性。

consistent.example: Her work is consistent and always meets the same high standard.
consistent.exampleZh: 她的工作始终如一，总是达到同样高的标准。

console.example: She tried to console her friend after the bad news.
console.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，她试着安慰她的朋友。

consolidate.example: We need to consolidate our small teams into one strong group.
consolidate.exampleZh: 我们需要把我们的小团队合并成一个强大的团队。

consonant.example: The letter B is a consonant, while the letter A is a vowel.
consonant.exampleZh: 字母B是辅音，而字母A是元音。

consortium.example: The consortium of local banks agreed to fund the new hospital.
consortium.exampleZh: 当地银行的财团同意资助这家新医院。

conspicuous.example: The bright red car was very conspicuous in the parking lot.
conspicuous.exampleZh: 那辆鲜红色的汽车在停车场里非常显眼。

conspiracy.example: The police found a conspiracy to steal money from the small bank.
conspiracy.exampleZh: 警方发现了一个从这家小银行偷钱的阴谋。

constant.example: The baby's constant crying kept the whole family awake all night.
constant.exampleZh: 婴儿不停的哭声让全家人整夜没睡。

constellation.example: The constellation Orion is easy to see on a clear winter night.
constellation.exampleZh: 猎户座这个星座在晴朗的冬夜很容易看到。

constituent.example: The senator met with every constituent at the town hall meeting.
constituent.exampleZh: 参议员在市政厅会议上会见了每一位选民。

constitute.example: These small parts constitute the whole machine and make it work.
constitute.exampleZh: 这些小零件构成了整台机器，并使其运转。

constitution.example: The new constitution gives every citizen the right to vote freely.
constitution.exampleZh: 新宪法赋予每位公民自由投票的权利。

constitutional.example: The court said the new law was not constitutional.
constitutional.exampleZh: 法院表示这项新法律不符合宪法。

constrain.example: Time and money often constrain what we can do on weekends.
constrain.exampleZh: 时间和金钱常常限制我们在周末能做的事。

constraint.example: Time is a constraint that stops us from doing everything we want.
constraint.exampleZh: 时间是一种约束，使我们无法做所有想做的事。

construct.example: They plan to construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The construction of the new school will take about two years.
construction.exampleZh: 新学校的建设将需要大约两年时间。

constructive.example: She gave me some constructive advice that helped me solve the problem.
constructive.exampleZh: 她给了我一些建设性的建议，帮助我解决了这个问题。

consult.example: I will consult my teacher before I choose my next class.
consult.exampleZh: 我会在选择下一门课之前咨询我的老师。

consultant.example: The company hired a consultant to help improve its customer service.
consultant.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来帮助改善客户服务。

consultation.example: The doctor had a short consultation with the patient before the test.
consultation.exampleZh: 医生在检查前与病人进行了简短的会诊。

consume.example: People consume too much energy every day in big cities.
consume.exampleZh: 在大城市里，人们每天消耗太多能源。

consumer.example: The consumer often chooses the cheaper product when prices are high.
consumer.exampleZh: 消费者在价格高时通常会选择更便宜的产品。

consumption.example: The country's energy consumption has risen sharply over the past few years.
consumption.exampleZh: 这个国家的能源消耗在过去几年里急剧上升。

contact.example: I lost contact with my old friend after he moved away.
contact.exampleZh: 他搬走以后，我就和这位老朋友失去了联系。

contain.example: This box can contain all of your old books and toys.
contain.exampleZh: 这个盒子能装下你所有的旧书和玩具。

container.example: The small container on the table holds all my favorite snacks.
container.exampleZh: 桌子上的小容器装着我所有最喜欢的零食。

contaminant.example: The factory released a harmful contaminant into the river near our town.
contaminant.exampleZh: 工厂将一种有害污染物排放到我们镇附近的河里。

contaminate.example: The dirty water can contaminate the river and harm the fish.
contaminate.exampleZh: 脏水会污染河流并伤害鱼类。

contemporary.example: Contemporary music often uses sounds that older listeners may find strange.
contemporary.exampleZh: 当代音乐常使用年长听众可能觉得奇怪的声音。

contend.example: The two teams will contend for the prize again this year.
contend.exampleZh: 这两支队伍今年将再次争夺这个奖项。

content.example: The content of this book is easy for young readers to understand.
content.exampleZh: 这本书的内容对年轻读者来说很容易理解。

contest.example: She won the singing contest at our school last week.
contest.exampleZh: 她上周在我们学校的歌唱比赛中获胜。

context.example: The teacher explained the word in the context of the story.
context.exampleZh: 老师在故事的语境中解释了这个单词。

continent.example: Africa is a large continent with many countries and diverse cultures.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是一个拥有许多国家和多元文化的大陆。

continental.example: The continental climate here has hot summers and very cold winters.
continental.exampleZh: 这里的大陆性气候夏季炎热，冬季非常寒冷。

contingency.example: We saved money for any contingency that might arise during the trip.
contingency.exampleZh: 我们存了钱，以备旅途中可能出现的任何意外事件。

contingent.example: The trip is contingent on the weather and our work schedule.
contingent.exampleZh: 这次旅行取决于天气和我们的工作安排。

continual.example: Her continual questions made it hard for the teacher to finish the lesson.
continual.exampleZh: 她不断提问，让老师很难把课讲完。

continue.example: We will continue to work hard and learn new things every day.
continue.exampleZh: 我们将继续努力工作，每天学习新东西。

continuous.example: The continuous rain kept us inside the house all day.
continuous.exampleZh: 持续的降雨让我们一整天都待在家里。

contort.example: The pain made him contort his face in a strange way.
contort.exampleZh: 疼痛使他的脸奇怪地扭曲起来。

contour.example: The mountain's contour is easy to see on this map.
contour.exampleZh: 这座山的等高线在这张地图上很容易看出来。

contraception.example: Many young people learn about contraception before they become sexually active.
contraception.exampleZh: 许多年轻人在开始性生活之前了解避孕。

contraceptive.example: The doctor gave her a contraceptive and explained how to use it safely.
contraceptive.exampleZh: 医生给了她一种避孕药，并解释了如何安全使用。

contract.example: She signed a two-year contract with the company and started work on Monday.
contract.exampleZh: 她与公司签订了一份为期两年的合同，并在周一开始工作。

contractor.example: The contractor will build a new house for our family next year.
contractor.exampleZh: 承包商明年将为我们家建一栋新房子。

contradict.example: His kind words contradict his angry actions every single day.
contradict.exampleZh: 他友善的话语与愤怒的行为每天都相矛盾。

contradiction.example: There is a clear contradiction between what he says and what he does.
contradiction.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在明显的矛盾。

contrast.example: There is a clear contrast between the two pictures.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两幅图之间有明显的对比。

contribute.example: Many people contribute money and time to help local schools and families in need.
contribute.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱捐时间，帮助当地学校和有需要的家庭。

contribution.example: Her small contribution to the project helped the whole team succeed.
contribution.exampleZh: 她对项目的小小贡献帮助整个团队取得了成功。

contrite.example: She felt contrite after she forgot her friend's birthday.
contrite.exampleZh: 她忘记朋友的生日后感到很懊悔。

contrive.example: They contrived a simple plan to finish the work before noon.
contrive.exampleZh: 他们设计了一个简单的计划，要在中午前完成工作。

control.example: She tries to control her anger when things go wrong at work.
control.exampleZh: 当工作中出现问题时，她尽量控制自己的怒气。

controversial.example: This controversial rule has caused many arguments among students and teachers.
controversial.exampleZh: 这条有争议的规定在学生和老师中引发了许多争论。

controversy.example: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents.
controversy.exampleZh: 新校规在家长中引起了很多争议。

convene.example: The manager will convene a short meeting after lunch today.
convene.exampleZh: 经理将在今天午餐后召开一个简短的会议。

convenience.example: I keep snacks in my bag for convenience when I travel.
convenience.exampleZh: 为了方便，我在旅行时把零食放在包里。

convenient.example: This house is in a convenient place near the bus stop.
convenient.exampleZh: 这房子位置很方便，就在公交站附近。

convention.example: The annual convention gave members a chance to discuss new ideas.
convention.exampleZh: 年度大会给了会员们讨论新想法的机会。

conventional.example: Most people still prefer conventional methods when they learn a new language.
conventional.exampleZh: 大多数人在学习一门新语言时仍然偏爱传统方法。

conversation.example: I had a nice conversation with my new neighbor yesterday.
conversation.exampleZh: 我昨天和我的新邻居进行了一次愉快的交谈。

conversion.example: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took two years.
conversion.exampleZh: 把旧工厂改造成公寓花了两年时间。

convert.example: They will convert the old factory into a small shopping center next year.
convert.exampleZh: 他们明年将把这座旧工厂改造成一个小购物中心。

convey.example: Her smile can convey a warm feeling to everyone.
convey.exampleZh: 她的微笑能向每个人传达一种温暖的感觉。

convict.example: The jury decided to convict the man after hearing all the facts.
convict.exampleZh: 陪审团在听取所有事实后决定判定这名男子有罪。

conviction.example: Her strong conviction helped her finish the difficult task.
conviction.exampleZh: 她坚定的信念帮助她完成了这项艰巨的任务。

convince.example: I tried to convince my friend to join the school team.
convince.exampleZh: 我试着说服我的朋友加入校队。

cook.example: My mother will cook a big dinner for our family tonight.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈今晚会为我们家做一顿丰盛的晚餐。

cool.example: The evening air is cool, so we can walk to the park.
cool.exampleZh: 傍晚的空气很凉爽，所以我们可以步行去公园。

cooperate.example: Good teams cooperate with each other to finish the work on time.
cooperate.exampleZh: 好的团队会互相合作，按时完成工作。

cooperation.example: Good cooperation between the two teams made the project much easier and faster.
cooperation.exampleZh: 两个团队之间的良好合作使这个项目变得容易和快速得多。

coordinate.example: We need to coordinate our plans before the meeting starts tomorrow.
coordinate.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前协调我们的计划。

cop.example: A cop helped the lost child find his way home.
cop.exampleZh: 一名警察帮助迷路的孩子找到了回家的路。

cope.example: Many people find it hard to cope with stress at work.
cope.exampleZh: 许多人发现很难应对工作中的压力。

copper.example: The wire is made of copper and carries electricity to our home.
copper.exampleZh: 这根电线由铜制成，把电输送到我们家。

copy.example: Please copy this page and give one copy to your teacher.
copy.exampleZh: 请复印这一页，并给你的老师一份。

coral.example: The bright coral in the sea is home to many small fish.
coral.exampleZh: 海里鲜艳的珊瑚是许多小鱼的家。

cord.example: She tied the box with a strong cord before carrying it to the car.
cord.exampleZh: 她把箱子用一根结实的绳子绑好，然后把它搬到车上。

cordial.example: She gave us a cordial welcome and made everyone feel at home.
cordial.exampleZh: 她热情地欢迎我们，让每个人都感到宾至如归。

core.example: The core of the problem is easy to understand and solve.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心很容易理解和解决。

cork.example: He pulled the cork out of the bottle and poured the wine.
cork.exampleZh: 他把软木塞从瓶子里拔出来，然后倒了酒。

corn.example: My grandfather grows corn in the field behind his small house every summer.
corn.exampleZh: 我爷爷每年夏天都在他小房子后面的田里种玉米。

corner.example: The little cat is sleeping quietly in the warm corner of the room.
corner.exampleZh: 那只小猫正安静地睡在房间温暖的角落里。

corporate.example: The corporate office is in the city and has many workers.
corporate.exampleZh: 公司办公室位于城里，有许多员工。

corporation.example: He works for a large corporation that makes computers and phones.
corporation.exampleZh: 他在一家生产电脑和手机的大型公司工作。

correct.example: Please check if your answers are correct before you hand in the test.
correct.exampleZh: 请在交卷前检查你的答案是否正确。

correlate.example: These two events often correlate with each other in daily life.
correlate.exampleZh: 这两个事件在日常生活中常常相互关联。

correlation.example: There is a strong correlation between daily exercise and good health.
correlation.exampleZh: 每天锻炼与身体健康之间存在很强的相关性。

correspond.example: The results do not correspond with what we saw in the first test.
correspond.exampleZh: 这些结果与我们第一次测试中看到的情况不一致。

correspondence.example: Our long correspondence finally led to a friendly meeting last week.
correspondence.exampleZh: 我们长期的通信最终促成了上周的一次友好会面。

corridor.example: She walked quietly down the long corridor to reach her office.
corridor.exampleZh: 她沿着长长的走廊安静地走到办公室。

corrode.example: Salt water can corrode the metal parts of a boat very quickly.
corrode.exampleZh: 盐水会很快腐蚀船的金属部件。

corrupt.example: The corrupt official took money from the poor people.
corrupt.exampleZh: 那个腐败的官员从穷人那里拿钱。

corruption.example: The new law aims to fight corruption in local government.
corruption.exampleZh: 新法律旨在打击地方政府的腐败。

cosmic.example: The cosmic rays from space can harm astronauts on long trips.
cosmic.exampleZh: 来自太空的宇宙射线可能伤害长途旅行中的宇航员。

cost.example: The cost of this small apartment is too high for us.
cost.exampleZh: 这套小公寓的成本对我们来说太高了。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume to the school party last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一套漂亮的化装服去参加学校聚会。

cottage.example: They stayed in a small cottage near the lake for a week.
cottage.exampleZh: 他们在湖边的一间小屋里住了一个星期。

cotton.example: My mother bought a soft cotton shirt for me at the store.
cotton.exampleZh: 我妈妈在商店给我买了一件柔软的棉布衬衫。

couch.example: I sat on the couch and watched a movie with my sister.
couch.exampleZh: 我和妹妹坐在长沙发上看了一部电影。

cough.example: He began to cough loudly after breathing in some cold night air.
cough.exampleZh: 吸入一些寒冷的夜间空气后，他开始大声咳嗽。

could.example: She said she could help us with the work tomorrow.
could.exampleZh: 她说她明天能帮我们做这项工作。

council.example: The city council will meet tomorrow to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市议会明天将开会讨论新公园。

counsel.example: I asked my lawyer for counsel before I signed the contract.
counsel.exampleZh: 我在签署合同前向律师寻求了法律忠告。

count.example: Please count the books on the table before you leave the room.
count.exampleZh: 请在你离开房间前数一下桌子上的书。

counter.example: She put the small bag on the counter and paid the cashier.
counter.exampleZh: 她把小包放在柜台上，然后付钱给收银员。

counterpart.example: Each manager met their counterpart from the other company to discuss the new plan.
counterpart.exampleZh: 每位经理会见了另一家公司的对应负责人，讨论新计划。

country.example: I love my country and the people who live there.
country.exampleZh: 我爱我的国家，也爱生活在那里的人们。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and grow fresh vegetables in their garden.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，在他们的园子里种新鲜蔬菜。

county.example: Our county has a new library and a large public park.
county.exampleZh: 我们县有一座新图书馆和一个大型公园。

coup.example: The army planned a coup to take control of the government.
coup.exampleZh: 军队策划了一场政变以控制政府。

couple.example: A young couple moved into the house next to ours last week.
couple.exampleZh: 一对年轻夫妇上周搬进了我们隔壁的房子。

courage.example: She found the courage to speak in front of the whole class.
courage.exampleZh: 她找到了在全班同学面前发言的勇气。

course.example: This course teaches us how to write simple English sentences.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程教我们如何写简单的英语句子。

court.example: The young man went to court to explain what happened that day.
court.exampleZh: 那个年轻人去法院解释那天发生了什么。

courtesy.example: She thanked him for his courtesy and kindness during the visit.
courtesy.exampleZh: 她感谢他在访问期间的礼貌和好意。

courtyard.example: The children played in the courtyard while their parents watched from the window.
courtyard.exampleZh: 孩子们在院子里玩耍，而他们的父母从窗户看着。

cover.example: Please cover the food before you put it in the fridge.
cover.exampleZh: 请在你把食物放进冰箱之前把它盖好。

coverage.example: The new insurance policy provides good coverage for most common medical costs.
coverage.exampleZh: 新的保险政策为大多数常见医疗费用提供了良好的保障。

cow.example: The farmer milks one cow every morning before the sun rises.
cow.exampleZh: 农民每天早上在太阳升起前给一头奶牛挤奶。

coward.example: The coward ran away when he saw the big dog.
coward.exampleZh: 那个懦夫看到那只大狗时跑掉了。

crab.example: My little brother found a crab under a rock at the beach.
crab.exampleZh: 我弟弟在海滩的石头下发现了一只螃蟹。

crack.example: The old wall began to crack after the heavy rain.
crack.exampleZh: 那堵旧墙在大雨后开始裂开。

cradle.example: The old cradle beside the bed was made of wood.
cradle.exampleZh: 床边那个旧摇篮是木头做的。

craft.example: She learned the craft from her grandmother over many years.
craft.exampleZh: 她多年来向祖母学习这门手艺。

craftsman.example: The old craftsman made a beautiful wooden chair for his young grandson.
craftsman.exampleZh: 这位老工匠为他年幼的孙子做了一把漂亮的木椅。

crane.example: The tall crane lifted the heavy box onto the truck.
crane.exampleZh: 高高的起重机把沉重的箱子吊到了卡车上。

crash.example: The car crashed into a tree and the driver was not hurt.
crash.exampleZh: 汽车撞到树上，司机没有受伤。

crater.example: The old crater is now a small lake with clear water.
crater.exampleZh: 那个古老的火山口现在是一个清澈的小湖。

crawl.example: The baby can crawl across the floor to reach his toys.
crawl.exampleZh: 婴儿能爬过地板去够他的玩具。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every game on TV.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球很着迷，电视上每场比赛都看。

cream.example: She put some cream on her face before going to bed.
cream.exampleZh: 她睡觉前往脸上涂了一些面霜。

create.example: We can create a small garden behind the house this spring.
create.exampleZh: 今年春天我们可以在房子后面建一个小花园。

creative.example: She has a creative mind and often finds new ways to solve problems.
creative.exampleZh: 她有一个有创造力的头脑，常常能找到解决问题的新方法。

creativity.example: Teachers can help students develop creativity through simple art and music activities.
creativity.exampleZh: 老师可以通过简单的美术和音乐活动帮助学生培养创造力。

creator.example: The creator of this game is a young woman from Japan.
creator.exampleZh: 这款游戏的创作者是一位来自日本的年轻女性。

creature.example: The small creature lives under the old bridge near our house.
creature.exampleZh: 那只小生物住在我们家附近的老桥下。

credential.example: You need a valid credential to apply for this job.
credential.exampleZh: 你需要有效资格证书才能申请这份工作。

credibility.example: The newspaper lost its credibility after it printed a story that was not true.
credibility.exampleZh: 这家报纸在刊登了一则不实报道后失去了可信性。

credible.example: Her story sounds credible because she gives clear and simple reasons.
credible.exampleZh: 她的说法听起来可信，因为她给出了清楚而简单的理由。

credit.example: You can get credit for this course if you pass the exam.
credit.exampleZh: 如果你通过考试，你就能获得这门课程的学分。

creditor.example: The creditor asked him to pay back the money by Friday.
creditor.exampleZh: 债权人要求他在周五前还钱。

creek.example: A small creek runs behind our house and flows into the river.
creek.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们家后面流过，然后注入河中。

creep.example: The cat likes to creep slowly through the tall grass in our garden.
creep.exampleZh: 那只猫喜欢悄悄穿过我们花园里的高草。

cremation.example: The family chose cremation after the funeral service ended.
cremation.exampleZh: 葬礼仪式结束后，这家人选择了火葬。

crescent.example: A thin crescent moon hung above the quiet town last night.
crescent.exampleZh: 昨晚一弯细细的新月挂在安静的小镇上空。

crest.example: We reached the crest of the hill just before the sun set.
crest.exampleZh: 我们就在太阳落山前到达了山顶。

crew.example: The entire crew worked together to keep the ship safe during the storm.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员齐心协力，在暴风雨中保证船只安全。

cricket.example: The children heard a cricket singing in the garden last night.
cricket.exampleZh: 孩子们昨晚听到一只蟋蟀在花园里唱歌。

crime.example: The police are working hard to reduce crime in our city.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正在努力减少我们城市的犯罪。

criminal.example: The police finally caught the criminal who robbed the small bank.
criminal.exampleZh: 警方终于抓住了那个抢劫小银行的罪犯。

crimson.example: She wore a crimson dress and smiled at everyone in the room.
crimson.exampleZh: 她穿着一条深红色的连衣裙，对房间里的每个人微笑。

crisis.example: The country faced a serious economic crisis last year.
crisis.exampleZh: 这个国家去年面临严重的经济危机。

crisp.example: The fresh apple is crisp and sweet, so I eat it every day.
crisp.exampleZh: 这个新鲜苹果又脆又甜，所以我每天都吃。

criterion.example: The main criterion for choosing the winner is fairness and honesty.
criterion.exampleZh: 选择获胜者的主要标准是公平和诚实。

critic.example: The critic wrote a short review of the new film.
critic.exampleZh: 这位评论家为这部新电影写了一篇简短的影评。

critical.example: The doctor said her condition is critical and she needs help now.
critical.exampleZh: 医生说她的情况很危急，她现在需要帮助。

criticism.example: His criticism of the plan was fair and helped us improve it.
criticism.exampleZh: 他对这个计划的批评是公正的，帮助我们改进了它。

criticize.example: My teacher will criticize my essay if I make too many mistakes.
criticize.exampleZh: 如果我犯太多错误，老师会批评我的文章。

crocodile.example: The crocodile lives in the river and has very strong teeth.
crocodile.exampleZh: 鳄鱼住在河里，并且有非常坚固的牙齿。

crop.example: Farmers work hard to grow a good crop every year.
