crop.exampleZh: 农民每年辛勤劳作，以种出好庄稼。

cropland.example: The farmers grow rice and corn on the rich cropland near the river.
cropland.exampleZh: 农民们在河边肥沃的农田里种植水稻和玉米。

cross.example: Please cross the street carefully when the light turns green.
cross.exampleZh: 绿灯亮时请小心过马路。

crossroads.example: Our small town has a busy crossroads where two main roads meet.
crossroads.exampleZh: 我们的小镇有一个繁忙的十字路口，两条主路在此交汇。

crow.example: A black crow sat on the fence and called loudly at dawn.
crow.exampleZh: 一只黑乌鸦停在栅栏上，在黎明时大声啼叫。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the free concert.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看免费音乐会。

crown.example: The queen wore a golden crown at the ceremony in the old castle.
crown.exampleZh: 女王在古老城堡的仪式上戴着一顶金王冠。

crucial.example: Getting enough sleep is crucial for your health and your daily work.
crucial.exampleZh: 获得充足睡眠对你的健康和日常工作至关重要。

crude.example: His crude joke made everyone at the dinner table feel uncomfortable.
crude.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的玩笑让餐桌上的每个人都感到不舒服。

cruel.example: It is cruel to laugh at people when they are in trouble.
cruel.exampleZh: 当人们遇到困难时嘲笑他们是残忍的。

cruise.example: We will cruise along the coast and enjoy the warm sun.
cruise.exampleZh: 我们将沿着海岸巡航，享受温暖的阳光。

crumb.example: She fed a small crumb to the bird on the garden wall.
crumb.exampleZh: 她把一小块面包屑喂给了花园墙上的那只鸟。

crush.example: The heavy box may crush the small flowers in the garden.
crush.exampleZh: 那个沉重的箱子可能会压坏花园里的小花。

crust.example: The bread has a hard crust, but the inside is very soft.
crust.exampleZh: 这块面包有一层硬皮，但里面很软。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she lost her toy.
cry.exampleZh: 宝宝丢了玩具后开始哭。

crypt.example: The old church has a dark crypt under the main floor.
crypt.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂主楼层下面有一个黑暗的地下室。

crystal.example: She put a small crystal on the table and looked at it.
crystal.exampleZh: 她把一块小水晶放在桌上，看着它。

cub.example: The little cub stayed close to its mother in the cold forest.
cub.exampleZh: 这只小幼兽在寒冷的森林里紧挨着它的妈妈。

cuban.example: My neighbor plays Cuban music every weekend and everyone enjoys it.
cuban.exampleZh: 我的邻居每个周末都放古巴音乐，大家都很喜欢。

cube.example: The child built a small cube with six square faces.
cube.exampleZh: 那个孩子用六个正方形面搭了一个小立方体。

cubic.example: The box has a cubic shape and takes up little space.
cubic.exampleZh: 这个盒子呈立方体形状，占用的空间很小。

cuckoo.example: We heard a cuckoo singing in the tall tree behind our house.
cuckoo.exampleZh: 我们听到一只杜鹃在我们屋后的高树上唱歌。

cucumber.example: I put fresh cucumber slices in my salad for lunch today.
cucumber.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了新鲜的黄瓜片。

cuff.example: He rolled up his shirt cuff before washing his hands.
cuff.exampleZh: 他洗手前卷起了衬衫袖口。

cuisine.example: French cuisine is famous around the world for its rich flavors and elegant dishes.
cuisine.exampleZh: 法国菜肴以其丰富的风味和优雅的菜品闻名世界。

culminate.example: The long project will culminate in a big party for everyone.
culminate.exampleZh: 这个长期项目将以一场为大家举办的大型聚会告终。

culmination.example: The festival was the culmination of months of hard work by the whole town.
culmination.exampleZh: 这场庆典是全镇数月辛勤工作的成果。

culprit.example: The police finally found the culprit who stole the old car.
culprit.exampleZh: 警方最终找到了偷走那辆旧车的罪犯。

cult.example: Some people believe that small group is a dangerous cult.
cult.exampleZh: 有些人认为那个小团体是一个危险的邪教。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate the land and grow food for their families.
cultivate.exampleZh: 农民耕种土地，为家人种植食物。

cultural.example: The city has many cultural events for families every summer.
cultural.exampleZh: 这座城市每年夏天为家庭举办许多文化活动。

culture.example: Learning about other cultures helps us understand people from different countries.
culture.exampleZh: 了解其他文化有助于我们理解来自不同国家的人。

cunning.example: The cunning fox found a way into the chicken house.
cunning.exampleZh: 那只狡猾的狐狸找到了进入鸡舍的办法。

cup.example: She poured hot tea into a cup and smiled.
cup.exampleZh: 她把热茶倒进一个杯子里，然后笑了。

cupboard.example: The cups are in the cupboard next to the kitchen door.
cupboard.exampleZh: 杯子在厨房门旁边的碗柜里。

curb.example: The city hopes to curb traffic and make the streets safer for children.
curb.exampleZh: 市政府希望控制交通，让街道对孩子们更安全。

cure.example: The new medicine may cure his cough in a few days.
cure.exampleZh: 这种新药也许能在几天内治好他的咳嗽。

curiosity.example: Her curiosity led her to ask many simple questions about the world.
curiosity.exampleZh: 她的好奇心促使她问了许多关于世界的简单问题。

curious.example: The curious child asked many questions about how the stars move at night.
curious.exampleZh: 那个好奇的孩子问了许多关于星星在夜间如何移动的问题。

curl.example: She likes to curl up on the sofa with a good book.
curl.exampleZh: 她喜欢蜷缩在沙发上看一本好书。

currency.example: The country uses a new currency for all daily purchases and business deals.
currency.exampleZh: 这个国家在所有日常购物和商业交易中使用一种新货币。

current.example: The current weather is warm and sunny, so we can go outside today.
current.exampleZh: 当前的天气温暖晴朗，所以我们今天可以出去。

curriculum.example: The school has a new curriculum for all students this year.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校今年为所有学生开设了新课程。

curse.example: The old man cursed the bad weather and went back home.
curse.exampleZh: 老人咒骂了糟糕的天气，然后回家了。

curtain.example: She opened the curtain to let the morning sunlight into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进房间。

curve.example: The road makes a sharp curve near the old bridge.
curve.exampleZh: 这条路在老桥附近有一个急弯。

cushion.example: I put a soft cushion behind my back while I read.
cushion.exampleZh: 我读书时在背后放了一个柔软的坐垫。

custody.example: The mother was given custody of her two young children after the divorce.
custody.exampleZh: 离婚后，母亲获得了两个年幼孩子的监护权。

custom.example: It is a local custom to give guests tea when they arrive.
custom.exampleZh: 客人到来时给他们茶是当地的风俗。

customer.example: The customer asked the shop worker for a better price on the old chair.
customer.exampleZh: 那位顾客向店员询问那把旧椅子能否给个更好的价格。

customize.example: You can customize this simple chair to match your room.
customize.exampleZh: 你可以定制这把简单的椅子来搭配你的房间。

cut.example: Please cut the cake into small pieces for the children.
cut.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕切成小块给孩子们。

cute.example: The little girl has a cute smile and everyone likes her.
cute.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容，大家都很喜欢她。

cyberspace.example: Many students learn how to stay safe in cyberspace every day.
cyberspace.exampleZh: 许多学生每天学习如何在网络空间中保持安全。

cycle.example: The water cycle moves water from the sea to the sky.
cycle.exampleZh: 水循环把水从海洋带到天空。

cyclist.example: A cyclist must always wear a helmet when riding on a busy road.
cyclist.exampleZh: 骑自行车的人在繁忙道路上骑行时一定要戴头盔。

cyclone.example: The cyclone destroyed many houses near the coast last night.
cyclone.exampleZh: 昨晚这场气旋摧毁了海岸附近的许多房屋。

cylinder.example: The car has four cylinders and a small engine under the hood.
cylinder.exampleZh: 这辆车有四个气缸，引擎盖下装着一台小发动机。

cymbal.example: The drummer hit the cymbal loudly at the end of the song.
cymbal.exampleZh: 鼓手在歌曲结尾处用力敲响了钹。

cynic.example: The old cynic trusted no one and laughed at every kind offer.
cynic.exampleZh: 那个老愤世嫉俗者不信任任何人，对每一次善意的帮助都一笑置之。

cynical.example: He became cynical about politics after years of broken promises.
cynical.exampleZh: 在多年空头承诺之后，他对政治变得愤世嫉俗。

cynicism.example: His constant cynicism made it hard for people to trust him.
cynicism.exampleZh: 他持续的愤世嫉俗让人们很难信任他。

dab.example: She used a dab of glue to fix the small broken cup.
dab.exampleZh: 她用了一点胶水来粘好那个小破杯子。

dabble.example: She likes to dabble in painting on lazy Sunday afternoons at home.
dabble.exampleZh: 她喜欢在悠闲的周日下午在家涉猎绘画。

daffodil.example: A yellow daffodil grows in the garden near my house.
daffodil.exampleZh: 一朵黄色的水仙花长在我家附近的花园里。

daft.example: It was a daft idea to go outside in this heavy rain.
daft.exampleZh: 在这种大雨中出门是个愚蠢的主意。

dagger.example: The thief hid a small dagger under his old coat.
dagger.exampleZh: 小偷把一把小匕首藏在他的旧外套下面。

dahlia.example: My grandmother grows a bright red dahlia in her small garden every year.
dahlia.exampleZh: 我奶奶每年在她的小花园里种一株鲜红的大丽花。

daily.example: I read the daily news before I start my work every morning.
daily.exampleZh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会看每日新闻。

dainty.example: She served dainty cakes on a small plate at tea time.
dainty.exampleZh: 她在下午茶时把小巧精致的蛋糕盛在一个小盘子里。

dairy.example: Some people cannot eat dairy because it makes them feel sick.
dairy.exampleZh: 有些人不能吃乳制品，因为这会让他们感到不适。

dale.example: We walked through the green dale and saw many sheep.
dale.exampleZh: 我们穿过绿色的山谷，看见了许多羊。

dalliance.example: Their summer dalliance by the lake felt like a happy dream.
dalliance.exampleZh: 他们在湖边的夏日嬉戏像一场快乐的梦。

dally.example: Do not dally in the morning, or you will miss the bus.
dally.exampleZh: 早上不要磨蹭，否则你会错过公交车。

dam.example: The old dam holds the river water for the nearby farm.
dam.exampleZh: 这座旧水坝为附近的农场拦住了河水。

damage.example: The storm caused serious damage to many homes in the village.
damage.exampleZh: 这场风暴给村里的许多房屋造成了严重损坏。

damask.example: The old chair was covered with a beautiful blue damask.
damask.exampleZh: 那把旧椅子上铺着漂亮的蓝色锦缎。

dame.example: The kind dame helped the lost child find his way home.
dame.exampleZh: 那位善良的女士帮助迷路的孩子找到了回家的路。

damp.example: The walls are damp because the air in this room is too wet.
damp.exampleZh: 墙壁很潮湿，因为这个房间里的空气太湿了。

dampen.example: Rain will dampen the ground and make the air feel cool.
dampen.exampleZh: 雨水会弄湿地面，让空气感觉凉爽。

damsel.example: The brave knight rescued the young damsel from the tall dark tower.
damsel.exampleZh: 勇敢的骑士从高高的黑塔中救出了年轻的少女。

dandelion.example: A small dandelion grew beside the road, and my sister picked it.
dandelion.exampleZh: 一朵小蒲公英长在路边，我妹妹把它摘了下来。

dander.example: His rude words raised my dander, so I left the room quickly.
dander.exampleZh: 他的粗鲁话语惹怒了我，所以我很快离开了房间。

dandruff.example: He washes his hair often because dandruff makes him feel uncomfortable.
dandruff.exampleZh: 他经常洗头，因为头皮屑让他感到不舒服。

dank.example: The cellar was dank and cold, so we stayed upstairs.
dank.exampleZh: 地窖又阴湿又冷，所以我们都待在楼上。

dapper.example: He looks very dapper in his new suit today.
dapper.exampleZh: 他今天穿着新西装看起来非常整洁漂亮。

dapple.example: The sunlight made dapple shadows on the warm grass.
dapple.exampleZh: 阳光在温暖的草地上投下斑驳的影子。

dare.example: I dare you to jump into the cold river with us.
dare.exampleZh: 我敢你跟我们跳进冰冷的河里。

daring.example: Her daring plan helped the small team win the important game.
daring.exampleZh: 她大胆的计划帮助小团队赢得了这场重要比赛。

dark.example: The room was very dark, so we turned on a small light.
dark.exampleZh: 房间很暗，所以我们打开了一盏小灯。

darn.example: My grandmother will darn the hole in my sock before I wear it again.
darn.exampleZh: 我奶奶会在我再次穿之前把我袜子上的洞织补好。

dart.example: He threw the dart and then darted across the room.
dart.exampleZh: 他扔出飞镖，然后飞奔穿过房间。

dash.example: He made a dash for the bus, but it had already left.
dash.exampleZh: 他朝公交车猛冲过去，但车已经开走了。

data.example: The data show that most students prefer to study in the morning.
data.exampleZh: 这些数据显示，大多数学生更喜欢在上午学习。

database.example: The school keeps all student records in a large database.
database.exampleZh: 学校把所有学生记录保存在一个大型数据库中。

date.example: We set a date for our next meeting.
date.exampleZh: 我们为下次会议定了一个日期。

daub.example: He daubed the wall with wet paint and left a dark stain.
daub.exampleZh: 他把湿油漆涂在墙上，留下了一块深色污迹。

daughter.example: Their youngest daughter helps her mother cook dinner every Sunday evening.
daughter.exampleZh: 他们最小的女儿每周日晚上都帮妈妈做晚饭。

daunt.example: The long climb did not daunt the young hikers.
daunt.exampleZh: 那段漫长的攀登并没有让年轻的徒步者气馁。

dauntless.example: The dauntless young soldier ran into the burning house to save the child.
dauntless.exampleZh: 那位无畏的年轻士兵冲进燃烧的房子去救那个孩子。

dawdle.example: Don't dawdle in the hallway; we need to leave for school now.
dawdle.exampleZh: 别在走廊上磨蹭了，我们现在得出发去学校。

dawn.example: The sky grew bright at dawn, and we began our long walk home.
dawn.exampleZh: 黎明时天空变亮，我们开始了漫长的回家之路。

daybreak.example: We left the house at daybreak to catch the early train.
daybreak.exampleZh: 我们在黎明时分离开家去赶早班火车。

daydream.example: She likes to daydream in class instead of listening to the teacher.
daydream.exampleZh: 她喜欢在课上做白日梦，而不听老师讲课。

daytime.example: The stars are not visible in the daytime.

daze.example: The sudden news left him in a daze for a long while.
daze.exampleZh: 这个突如其来的消息让他恍惚了好一阵子。

dazzle.example: The bright lights of the city dazzle her every time she visits.
dazzle.exampleZh: 她每次进城，城市里明亮的灯光都让她目眩。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden is dead now.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树现在死了。

deaden.example: Loud music can deaden the pain of a long, boring drive.
deaden.exampleZh: 大声的音乐能减弱漫长无聊车程中的痛苦。

deadline.example: The deadline for the school project is next Friday afternoon.
deadline.exampleZh: 学校项目的截止日期是下周五下午。

deadlock.example: The two sides reached a deadlock in the talks and could not agree.
deadlock.exampleZh: 双方在会谈中陷入僵局，无法达成一致。

deadly.example: The snake's bite can be deadly to small children.
deadly.exampleZh: 这种蛇的咬伤对小孩可能是致命的。

deaf.example: The old man is deaf, so we must speak loudly to him.
deaf.exampleZh: 那位老人聋了，所以我们必须大声跟他说话。

deafening.example: The music at the party was deafening, so we went outside to talk.
deafening.exampleZh: 派对上的音乐震耳欲聋，所以我们走到外面去聊天。

deal.example: I need to deal with this problem before the meeting starts today.
deal.exampleZh: 今天会议开始前，我需要处理这个问题。

dealer.example: The car dealer sold my father a new car last week.
dealer.exampleZh: 那位汽车经销商上周卖给我父亲一辆新车。

dear.example: My dear mother always writes me a long letter every week.
dear.exampleZh: 我亲爱的母亲每周都会给我写一封长信。

dearth.example: There is a dearth of clean water in this small village.
dearth.exampleZh: 这个小村庄缺乏干净的水。

death.example: His death made everyone in the small town very sad.
death.exampleZh: 他的死让小镇上的每个人都十分悲伤。

debacle.example: The company's new product was a complete debacle and lost millions of dollars.
debacle.exampleZh: 公司的新产品彻底失败了，损失了数百万美元。

debatable.example: Whether this rule is fair is still debatable among the students.
debatable.exampleZh: 这条规则是否公平在学生中仍然有争议。

debate.example: The students had a long debate about school rules after class.
debate.exampleZh: 学生们课后就校规展开了长时间的辩论。

debilitate.example: The long illness debilitated him so much that he could not walk.
debilitate.exampleZh: 这场久病使他虚弱得无法行走。

debris.example: After the storm, workers cleared the debris from the road.
debris.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，工人们清理了道路上的残骸。

debt.example: He worked two jobs to pay off his debt.
debt.exampleZh: 他打两份工来还清他的债务。

debug.example: I need to debug this simple program before we run it again.
debug.exampleZh: 在我们再次运行这个程序之前，我需要调试这个简单的程序。

debut.example: Her debut at the school concert made everyone cheer loudly.
debut.exampleZh: 她在学校音乐会上的首次登台让所有人都大声欢呼。

debutante.example: The debutante wore a white dress to her first big party.
debutante.exampleZh: 这位初次参加社交的少女穿着白色连衣裙去参加她的第一场大型舞会。

decade.example: My father worked in that small town for a decade.
decade.exampleZh: 我父亲在那个小镇工作了十年。

decadence.example: The old king's court was famous for its decadence and endless parties.
decadence.exampleZh: 这位老国王的宫廷以堕落和无休止的宴会而闻名。

decamp.example: The soldiers decided to decamp before the enemy could find them.
decamp.exampleZh: 士兵们决定在敌人找到他们之前撤营。

decant.example: Please decant the wine slowly into the glass before dinner.
decant.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前把葡萄酒慢慢倒进玻璃杯里。

decay.example: Old fruits decay quickly in warm weather and attract insects.
decay.exampleZh: 旧水果在温暖天气里很快腐烂，还会招来昆虫。

deceased.example: The deceased man's family came to the funeral.
deceased.exampleZh: 这位已故男子的家人前来参加葬礼。

deceit.example: His deceit hurt the people who trusted him most.
deceit.exampleZh: 他的欺骗伤害了最信任他的人。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive his friends, but they found out the truth.
deceive.exampleZh: 他试图欺骗他的朋友们，但他们发现了真相。

decelerate.example: The car began to decelerate as it approached the busy crossing.
decelerate.exampleZh: 汽车在接近繁忙的十字路口时开始减速。

decency.example: He always treats other people with decency and respect.
decency.exampleZh: 他总是以体面和尊重对待他人。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
decent.exampleZh: 他是个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

decentralize.example: The company decided to decentralize its decision-making so local teams could act faster.
decentralize.exampleZh: 公司决定下放决策权，以便本地团队能更快行动。

deception.example: His kind words were just a deception to get our money.
deception.exampleZh: 他那些好话只是为了骗走我们的钱而设的骗局。

decibel.example: The noise from the street was over eighty decibels last night.
decibel.exampleZh: 昨晚街上的噪音超过了八十分贝。

decide.example: We have to decide where to go for lunch today.
decide.exampleZh: 我们得决定今天中午去哪里吃饭。

deciduous.example: Maple trees are deciduous, so their leaves turn red and fall in autumn.
deciduous.exampleZh: 枫树是落叶树，所以它们的叶子在秋天变红并掉落。

decimal.example: The number 3.14 is a decimal, not a whole number.
decimal.exampleZh: 数字 3.14 是一个小数，而不是整数。

decipher.example: It took the experts many hours to decipher the old letter.
decipher.exampleZh: 专家们花了好几个小时才破译这封旧信。

decipherable.example: The old letter was finally decipherable after we found the key.
decipherable.exampleZh: 找到钥匙后，那封旧信终于可以破译了。

decision.example: The judge will make a final decision about the case tomorrow morning.
decision.exampleZh: 法官将于明天上午对此案作出最终判决。

decisive.example: Her decisive action saved the whole team from a serious mistake.
decisive.exampleZh: 她果断的行动使整个团队免于犯下严重错误。

deck.example: We stood on the deck and watched the sun go down.
deck.exampleZh: 我们站在甲板上看着太阳落下。

declaim.example: He likes to declaim against the government at every meeting.
declaim.exampleZh: 他喜欢在每次会议上慷慨抨击政府。

declaration.example: The two countries signed a joint declaration to protect the river.
declaration.exampleZh: 两国签署了一份共同宣言来保护这条河流。

declarative.example: Her speech was clear and declarative, so everyone understood her main point.
declarative.exampleZh: 她的讲话清晰而具陈述性，所以每个人都明白了她的要点。

declare.example: The teacher will declare the winner of the game tomorrow morning.
declare.exampleZh: 老师明天上午将宣布比赛的获胜者。

declination.example: The declination of the old bridge worried the local engineers.
declination.exampleZh: 这座老桥的衰退让当地工程师感到担忧。

decline.example: Sales began to decline after the summer holiday ended.
decline.exampleZh: 暑假结束后，销售额开始下降。

decode.example: We need a program to decode this secret message.
decode.exampleZh: 我们需要一个程序来解码这条秘密信息。

decompose.example: Bacteria help decompose dead leaves into rich soil.
decompose.exampleZh: 细菌帮助将枯叶分解成肥沃的土壤。

decor.example: She used fresh flowers as decor for the dinner table.
decor.exampleZh: 她用鲜花作为餐桌的装饰。

decorate.example: We will decorate the classroom with colorful paper flowers for the party.
decorate.exampleZh: 我们会用彩纸花装饰教室，为聚会做准备。

decorative.example: The decorative pillows on the sofa make the room look warm and bright.
decorative.exampleZh: 沙发上的装饰性靠垫让房间看起来温暖又明亮。

decorum.example: Good decorum means being quiet and polite during the school ceremony.
decorum.exampleZh: 良好的礼仪意味着在学校典礼上保持安静和礼貌。

decoy.example: The hunter used a wooden duck as a decoy to catch more birds.
decoy.exampleZh: 猎人用一只木鸭作诱饵来捕捉更多的鸟。

decrease.example: The number of students in our class began to decrease last year.
decrease.exampleZh: 我们班的学生人数去年开始减少。

decree.example: The king made a decree that all citizens must pay the new tax.
decree.exampleZh: 国王颁布法令，所有公民都必须缴纳新税。

decrepit.example: The old man walked slowly with a decrepit wooden cane.
decrepit.exampleZh: 那位老人拄着一根破旧的木拐杖慢慢走着。

dedicate.example: He decided to dedicate his free time to helping older people in his town.
dedicate.exampleZh: 他决定把业余时间奉献给帮助镇上的老年人。

deduce.example: From these clues, we can deduce who took the book.
deduce.exampleZh: 从这些线索中，我们可以推断出是谁拿走了那本书。

deduct.example: The company will deduct the tax from your monthly pay.
deduct.exampleZh: 公司会从你的月薪中扣除税款。

deductive.example: The detective used deductive reasoning to find the truth.
deductive.exampleZh: 侦探运用演绎推理来查明真相。

deed.example: His good deed helped the old man get home safely.
deed.exampleZh: 他的善举帮助那位老人安全回到了家。

deem.example: Many people deem this book very useful for beginners.
deem.exampleZh: 许多人认为这本书对初学者很有用。

deep-seated.example: His fear of dogs is deep-seated, but he is slowly getting better.
deep-seated.exampleZh: 他对狗的恐惧根深蒂固，不过他正在慢慢好转。

deepen.example: Daily practice will deepen your understanding of the new language.
deepen.exampleZh: 每天练习会加深你对这门新语言的理解。

deface.example: Someone used a knife to deface the new wooden bench.
deface.exampleZh: 有人用刀损毁了那张新木椅的外观。

defame.example: He tried to defame his neighbor with false stories online.
defame.exampleZh: 他试图在网上用虚假的故事诽谤他的邻居。

default.example: If you do not pay on time, you will default on the loan.
default.exampleZh: 如果你不按时付款，你就会违约。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and finally defeated the strong rival in the last game.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，终于在最后一场比赛中击败了强劲的对手。

defect.example: The defect in this old phone makes it hard to use.
defect.exampleZh: 这部旧手机的缺陷让它很难使用。

defend.example: The soldiers fought bravely to defend their city from the enemies.
defend.exampleZh: 士兵们英勇作战，保卫他们的城市不受敌人侵犯。

defendant.example: The defendant told the judge that he did not steal the money.
defendant.exampleZh: 被告告诉法官他没有偷那笔钱。

defensible.example: Her decision was hard to attack because it was based on defensible facts.
defensible.exampleZh: 她的决定很难被攻击，因为它建立在可辩护的事实之上。

defer.example: We can defer the meeting until next week.
defer.exampleZh: 我们可以把会议推迟到下周。

deference.example: He showed great deference to his teacher's advice.
deference.exampleZh: 他对老师的建议表现出极大的尊重。

deferential.example: He was always deferential to his older colleagues at work.
deferential.exampleZh: 他对工作中年长的同事总是很恭敬。

defiance.example: His quiet defiance surprised the teacher and the whole class.
defiance.exampleZh: 他无声的蔑视让老师和全班同学都感到意外。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin C can cause serious health problems.
deficiency.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素C会导致严重的健康问题。

deficit.example: The company had a large deficit last year and had to cut costs.
deficit.exampleZh: 公司去年有很大赤字，不得不削减成本。

defile.example: They were angry that someone had defiled the ancient temple.
defile.exampleZh: 有人玷污了这座古老的寺庙，他们对此非常愤怒。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the new word in our own words.
define.exampleZh: 老师让我们用自己的话给这个新单词下定义。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before we make the final plan.
definite.exampleZh: 在制定最终计划之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday night.
definitely.exampleZh: 我星期六晚上一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the word so we could understand it.
definition.exampleZh: 老师给这个词下了一个清晰的定义，这样我们就能理解它了。

definitive.example: The judge's definitive ruling ended the long dispute between the two companies.
definitive.exampleZh: 法官的最终裁决结束了这两家公司之间长期的纠纷。

deflate.example: The team did not want to deflate her hopes before the final match.
deflate.exampleZh: 在决赛之前，队友们不想让她泄气。

deflect.example: He raised his arm to deflect the ball away from his face.
deflect.exampleZh: 他抬起手臂把球挡开，使它偏离自己的脸。

defoliate.example: The strong wind can defoliate the trees in just one night.
defoliate.exampleZh: 大风能在一夜之间使树木落叶。

deforestation.example: Deforestation is a serious problem because it destroys the homes of many animals.
deforestation.exampleZh: 砍伐森林是一个严重的问题，因为它破坏了许多动物的家园。

deform.example: Too much heat can deform the plastic bottle easily.
deform.exampleZh: 过多的热量很容易使塑料瓶变形。

defraud.example: The man tried to defraud the old couple of their savings.
defraud.exampleZh: 那个男人试图骗取这对老夫妇的积蓄。

defray.example: My parents helped defray the cost of my new books.
defray.exampleZh: 我父母帮我支付了新书的费用。

deft.example: She is deft with her hands and can make beautiful paper flowers.
deft.exampleZh: 她的双手很灵巧，能做出漂亮的纸花。

defuse.example: The police worked quickly to defuse the bomb and keep everyone safe.
defuse.exampleZh: 警察迅速行动拆除炸弹引信，确保所有人安全。

defy.example: The small boy dared to defy his parents and stayed out late.
defy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩胆敢违抗父母，在外面待到很晚。

degenerate.example: Without regular use, his skills began to degenerate into simple habits.
degenerate.exampleZh: 由于缺乏经常性的练习，他的技能开始退化为简单的习惯。

degrade.example: Plastic bags degrade slowly in the ocean and harm many sea animals.
degrade.exampleZh: 塑料袋在海洋中降解缓慢，会伤害许多海洋动物。

degree.example: The water temperature is ten degrees today, so the pool feels cool.
degree.exampleZh: 今天水温是十度，所以泳池水感觉有点凉。

dehumanize.example: War and cruelty can dehumanize people and make them lose their kindness.
dehumanize.exampleZh: 战争和残酷会使人失去人性，让人变得冷漠。

dehydrate.example: Hot sun and strong wind can dehydrate your body very quickly.
dehydrate.exampleZh: 烈日和强风会使你的身体很快脱水。

deify.example: Some fans deify their favorite singers and treat them like gods.
deify.exampleZh: 一些粉丝把喜爱的歌手神化，待他们如同神明。

deity.example: In the old story, a powerful deity created the mountains and the sea.
deity.exampleZh: 在那个古老的故事里，一位强大的神创造了群山和海洋。

dejected.example: He looked dejected after losing the game.
dejected.exampleZh: 输掉比赛后，他看上去很沮丧。

delay.example: Heavy rain may delay our flight by several hours.
delay.exampleZh: 大雨可能会让我们的航班延误几个小时。

delectable.example: The cake she made was delectable and everyone asked for more.
delectable.exampleZh: 她做的蛋糕非常美味，每个人都想再要一些。

delegate.example: The manager will delegate the task to a team member.
delegate.exampleZh: 经理会把这项任务委派给团队成员。

delete.example: Please delete the old files before you save the new ones.
delete.exampleZh: 请你在保存新文件之前先删除旧文件。

deleterious.example: Too much sugar is deleterious to your teeth and your health.
deleterious.exampleZh: 吃太多糖对你的牙齿和健康有害。

deliberate.example: She made a deliberate choice to study abroad for one year.
deliberate.exampleZh: 她经过深思熟虑，选择出国学习一年。

delicacy.example: This soup is a local delicacy that many visitors enjoy during winter.
delicacy.exampleZh: 这道汤是当地的美味，许多游客在冬天都喜欢喝。

delicate.example: The delicate glass flower breaks easily if you drop it.
delicate.exampleZh: 这朵精致的玻璃花一掉到地上就很容易碎。

delicious.example: The soup my mother makes is delicious and we eat it every Sunday.
delicious.exampleZh: 我妈妈做的汤很美味，我们每个星期天都喝。

delight.example: The children shouted with delight when they saw the snow.
delight.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴地欢呼起来。

delimit.example: A low fence delimits the garden from the busy road.
delimit.exampleZh: 一道低矮的篱笆把花园与繁忙的马路分隔开来。

delineate.example: The teacher asked us to delineate the main idea in a few words.
delineate.exampleZh: 老师让我们用几句话勾勒出主要意思。

delinquency.example: The school reports a rise in delinquency among older students this year.
delinquency.exampleZh: 学校报告今年高年级学生的行为不良现象有所增加。

delinquent.example: The court tried to help the young delinquent instead of sending him to prison.
delinquent.exampleZh: 法院试图帮助这个年轻的少年犯，而不是把他送进监狱。

delirious.example: The sick man was delirious and did not know where he was.
delirious.exampleZh: 那个病人精神错乱，不知道自己身在何处。

deliver.example: She will deliver the letters to her neighbors this afternoon.
deliver.exampleZh: 她今天下午会把信递给邻居们。

delivery.example: The delivery of the package was late because of the heavy rain.
delivery.exampleZh: 由于大雨，包裹的递送迟到了。

delude.example: Do not let his kind words delude you into trusting him.
delude.exampleZh: 不要让他那些好听的话哄骗你去信任他。

deluge.example: The heavy rain caused a deluge that covered the whole village.
deluge.exampleZh: 大雨引发了一场洪水，淹没了整个村庄。

delusion.example: He was under the delusion that everyone at work admired him.
delusion.exampleZh: 他有一种错觉，以为公司里每个人都很钦佩他。

demagogue.example: The demagogue told the crowd what they wanted to hear, not the truth.
demagogue.exampleZh: 那个蛊惑民心的政客对人群说的都是他们想听的话，而不是真相。

demand.example: Many customers demand better service from the hotel.
demand.exampleZh: 许多顾客要求酒店提供更好的服务。

demarcate.example: A low fence demarcates the two gardens.
demarcate.exampleZh: 一道矮栅栏把两个花园分隔开来。

demean.example: He never lets anyone demean him in front of his friends.
demean.exampleZh: 他从不允许任何人在朋友面前贬低他。

demeanor.example: Her calm demeanor made everyone feel comfortable during the difficult meeting.
demeanor.exampleZh: 她沉稳的举止让每个人在那场艰难的会议中都感到自在。

demented.example: The old man became demented and could no longer recognize his own family.
demented.exampleZh: 那位老人变得精神错乱，再也认不出自己的家人了。

dementia.example: The doctor said his memory loss was caused by dementia.
dementia.exampleZh: 医生说他的记忆丧失是由痴呆引起的。

demise.example: The old king's sudden demise left the whole country in deep sorrow.
demise.exampleZh: 老国王的突然去世让整个国家陷入深深的悲痛之中。

democracy.example: Many people believe that democracy gives every citizen a voice in the government.
democracy.exampleZh: 许多人认为，民主让每位公民在政府中都有发言权。

democratic.example: Our school has a democratic system for choosing class leaders each year.
democratic.exampleZh: 我们学校每年都用民主的方式选举班干部。

demographic.example: The demographic changes in our city have made schools need more teachers.
demographic.exampleZh: 我们城市的人口结构变化使学校需要更多教师。

demography.example: She studies demography to understand how populations change over time.
demography.exampleZh: 她学习人口学，以了解人口如何随时间变化。

demolish.example: The city plans to demolish the old building next spring.
demolish.exampleZh: 市政府计划明年春天拆除这栋旧楼。

demonize.example: Some newspapers demonize young people instead of listening to their problems.
demonize.exampleZh: 一些报纸妖魔化年轻人，而不是倾听他们的问题。

demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment to the class tomorrow.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师明天将向全班演示这个实验。

demonstration.example: The teacher gave a short demonstration to show how the machine works.
demonstration.exampleZh: 老师做了一个简短的演示，来说明这台机器是如何运作的。

demoralize.example: The long delay began to demoralize the whole team.
demoralize.exampleZh: 漫长的延误开始使整个团队士气低落。

demote.example: The manager had to demote him after he made the same mistake twice.
demote.exampleZh: 在他两次犯下同样的错误后，经理不得不将他降职。

denial.example: His denial of the mistake surprised everyone in the room.
denial.exampleZh: 他对那个错误的否认让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

denigrate.example: Some people denigrate his work, but I think it is quite good.
denigrate.exampleZh: 有些人贬低他的工作，但我觉得相当不错。

denim.example: He likes to wear denim jackets when the weather gets cool.
denim.exampleZh: 天气转凉时，他喜欢穿牛仔布夹克。

denizen.example: The old man is a longtime denizen of this quiet mountain village.
denizen.exampleZh: 这位老人是这个宁静山村的长期居民。

denomination.example: The old man gave the child a coin of small denomination.
denomination.exampleZh: 那位老人给了孩子一枚小面额的硬币。

denominator.example: The denominator of this fraction is ten, so the answer is easy.
denominator.exampleZh: 这个分数的分母是十，所以答案很简单。

denote.example: Dark clouds often denote rain, so take an umbrella with you.
denote.exampleZh: 乌云常常表示要下雨，所以带把伞吧。

denounce.example: The workers denounced the new safety rules as unfair and dangerous.
denounce.exampleZh: 工人们谴责新的安全规定不公平且危险。

dense.example: The dense forest is full of tall trees and small animals.
dense.exampleZh: 这片茂密的森林里长满了高大的树木，还有许多小动物。

density.example: The density of this liquid is higher than that of water.
density.exampleZh: 这种液体的密度比水高。

dental.example: I have a dental appointment tomorrow morning at the clinic near my office.
dental.exampleZh: 我明天上午在办公室附近的诊所有一个牙科预约。

dentist.example: I have a toothache, so I will see the dentist tomorrow morning.
dentist.exampleZh: 我牙疼，所以明天早上我要去看牙医。

deny.example: She denied taking the money from the desk drawer.
deny.exampleZh: 她否认从书桌抽屉里拿了钱。

depart.example: We must depart early tomorrow morning before the roads get busy.
depart.exampleZh: 我们明天一早必须出发，赶在道路变得拥挤之前。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a large company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的销售部门工作。

departure.example: His sudden departure from the team surprised everyone in the office.
departure.exampleZh: 他突然离开团队让办公室里的每个人都很惊讶。

depend.example: The final result will depend on how hard you work.
depend.exampleZh: 最终结果将取决于你有多努力。

dependable.example: She is a dependable friend who always helps me when I need it.
dependable.exampleZh: 她是个可靠的朋友，我需要帮助时她总是会帮我。

dependent.example: Children are still dependent on their parents for food and money.
dependent.exampleZh: 孩子们在食物和金钱上仍然依赖父母。

depersonalize.example: The new rules may depersonalize the way teachers treat their students.
depersonalize.exampleZh: 新规定可能会使老师对待学生的方式失去个性。

depict.example: The book depicts life in a small village many years ago.
depict.exampleZh: 这本书描绘了多年前一个小村庄的生活。

deplete.example: Too much farming can deplete the soil and harm the crops.
deplete.exampleZh: 过度耕种会耗尽土壤养分并损害作物。

deplorable.example: The dirty rooms and bad food made our short holiday truly deplorable.
deplorable.exampleZh: 脏乱的房间和糟糕的食物让我们的短假真是可悲。

deplore.example: Many people deplore the way the city wastes water every summer.
deplore.exampleZh: 许多人强烈反对这座城市每年夏天浪费水的做法。

deploy.example: The manager will deploy more workers to the busy team tomorrow.
deploy.exampleZh: 经理明天会调派更多工人到那个忙碌的团队。

deport.example: The government decided to deport him after he broke the law.
deport.exampleZh: 他违法后，政府决定将他驱逐出境。

depose.example: The angry people wanted to depose the old king and choose a new leader.
depose.exampleZh: 愤怒的民众想要废黜年迈的国王，并选出一位新的领袖。

deposit.example: I deposit some money in the bank every month.
deposit.exampleZh: 我每个月都在银行存一些钱。

deposition.example: The lawyer read the deposition aloud in court before the judge.
deposition.exampleZh: 律师在法官面前大声宣读了这份证词。

depraved.example: The depraved man stole money from his own family.
depraved.exampleZh: 那个堕落的男人偷了自己家人的钱。

deprecate.example: Many older workers deprecate the sudden changes in the company.
deprecate.exampleZh: 许多老员工反对公司突然的变动。

depreciate.example: Some people depreciate old things, but their value often grows with time.
depreciate.exampleZh: 有些人轻视旧东西，但它们的价值往往随时间增长。

depress.example: The bad news began to depress everyone in the small office.
depress.exampleZh: 这个坏消息开始让小办公室里的每个人都感到沮丧。

depression.example: The doctor said his depression got worse during the long, cold winter.
depression.exampleZh: 医生说他的抑郁症在漫长寒冷的冬天变得更严重了。

deprive.example: The new law may deprive many poor families of their homes.
deprive.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能会剥夺许多贫困家庭的家园。

depth.example: The depth of the lake is about ten meters here.
depth.exampleZh: 这里湖的深度大约是十米。

deputy.example: The deputy spoke for the manager at the meeting.
deputy.exampleZh: 副手在会上代表经理发言。

derelict.example: The derelict building on our street was torn down last year.
derelict.exampleZh: 我们街上那座废弃的建筑去年被拆除了。

deride.example: The older students deride him for wearing old clothes to school.
deride.exampleZh: 高年级学生嘲笑他穿旧衣服去学校。

derision.example: His silly mistake made him an object of derision among his friends.
derision.exampleZh: 他愚蠢的错误使他成了朋友们嘲笑的对象。

derivation.example: The derivation of this word is explained in the dictionary.
derivation.exampleZh: 这个单词的词源在词典中有解释。

derive.example: Children can derive great joy from reading simple books at home.
derive.exampleZh: 孩子们能在家里阅读简单的书时获得很大的快乐。

dermatology.example: She studies dermatology because she wants to help people with skin problems.
dermatology.exampleZh: 她学习皮肤学，因为她想帮助有皮肤问题的人。

derogatory.example: He made a derogatory remark about her new haircut.
derogatory.exampleZh: 他对她的新发型说了一句贬损的话。

descend.example: The plane began to descend slowly toward the runway.
descend.exampleZh: 飞机开始缓慢下降，朝跑道飞去。

descendant.example: She has many descendants who still live in the old village.
descendant.exampleZh: 她有许多后代仍然住在那个古老的村庄里。

descent.example: The plane began its slow descent through the thick clouds.
descent.exampleZh: 飞机开始穿过厚厚的云层缓慢下降。

describe.example: Can you describe your new teacher in a few words?
describe.exampleZh: 你能用几句话描述一下你的新老师吗？

description.example: This book gives a clear description of life in a small town.
description.exampleZh: 这本书清楚地描述了一个小镇上的生活。

desegregate.example: The new law helped desegregate schools across the country in the 1960s.
desegregate.exampleZh: 这项新法律在20世纪60年代帮助全国各地的学校废除了种族隔离。

desert.example: Camels can walk for days across the hot desert without any water.
desert.exampleZh: 骆驼能在炎热的沙漠中行走数天而不喝水。

deserve.example: Hard workers deserve good pay and a fair chance to grow.
deserve.exampleZh: 努力的人应得良好的报酬和公平的成长机会。

desiccate.example: The hot sun will desiccate the small plants in the garden.
desiccate.exampleZh: 烈日会使花园里的小植物干枯。

design.example: She wants to design a simple garden for her new house.
design.exampleZh: 她想为她的新房子设计一个简单的花园。

designate.example: The teacher will designate one student to lead the group today.
designate.exampleZh: 老师今天会指定一名学生来带领这个小组。

desirable.example: A quiet room is desirable when you need to study for an exam.
desirable.exampleZh: 当你需要为考试复习时，安静的房间是理想的。

desire.example: Her greatest desire is to travel around the world with her family.
desire.exampleZh: 她最大的愿望是和家人一起环游世界。

desirous.example: She is desirous of learning new skills and works hard every day.
desirous.exampleZh: 她渴望学习新技能，并且每天都努力学习。

desk.example: I put my books and a small lamp on the desk.
desk.exampleZh: 我把书和一盏小台灯放在书桌上。

desolate.example: The old house stood alone on a desolate hill far from town.
desolate.exampleZh: 那座老房子孤零零地立在远离城镇的荒凉山丘上。

despair.example: He was in deep despair after losing his job and his home.
despair.exampleZh: 在失去工作和家之后，他陷入了深深的绝望。

desperate.example: He was desperate for a job after losing his old one.
desperate.exampleZh: 失去旧工作后，他极渴望找到一份新工作。

despicable.example: It is despicable to lie to a friend who trusts you.
despicable.exampleZh: 对信任你的朋友撒谎是可鄙的。

despise.example: Many people despise him because he is rude to everyone.
despise.exampleZh: 很多人鄙视他，因为他对每个人都很粗鲁。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, we still went to the park.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是去了公园。

despondent.example: She felt despondent after failing the test three times.
despondent.exampleZh: 三次考试不及格后，她感到十分沮丧。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: We reached our destination after a long bus ride.
destination.exampleZh: 经过长途巴士旅程，我们到达了目的地。

destined.example: She was destined to become a great singer one day.
destined.exampleZh: 她注定有一天会成为一位伟大的歌手。

destiny.example: She believes that love can change a person's destiny.
destiny.exampleZh: 她相信爱能改变一个人的命运。

destitute.example: After the flood, many families were left destitute and needed help from the community.
destitute.exampleZh: 洪水过后，许多家庭变得一贫如洗，需要社区的帮助。

destroy.example: The big fire destroyed many old trees in the forest last night.
destroy.exampleZh: 昨晚这场大火烧毁了森林里的许多老树。

destruction.example: The storm caused great destruction to houses and trees in the small town.
destruction.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨给小镇的房屋和树木造成了巨大的破坏。

destructive.example: War is a destructive force that hurts many innocent people.
destructive.exampleZh: 战争是一种破坏性的力量，会伤害许多无辜的人。

desultory.example: His desultory reading habits meant he rarely finished any book.
desultory.exampleZh: 他散漫的阅读习惯意味着他很少读完任何一本书。

detach.example: Please detach the old label from the box before you ship it.
detach.exampleZh: 请在发货前把旧标签从箱子上撕下来。

detail.example: Please give me more detail about your plan before we start.
detail.exampleZh: 在我们开始之前，请多告诉我一些关于你计划的细节。

detect.example: I can detect a strange smell in the kitchen.
detect.exampleZh: 我能察觉到厨房里有一股奇怪的气味。

detective.example: The detective looked carefully at every small clue in the old room.
detective.exampleZh: 侦探仔细查看了那个旧房间里的每一条小线索。

detente.example: The two countries hoped for detente after many years of tense relations.
detente.exampleZh: 两国希望在多年紧张关系之后实现缓和。

detention.example: The teacher gave him detention for talking too much in class.
detention.exampleZh: 老师因为他上课说话太多罚他课后留校。

deter.example: High fences and bright lights can deter thieves from entering the yard at night.
deter.exampleZh: 高高的围栏和明亮的灯光能阻止小偷在夜间进入院子。

deteriorate.example: His health began to deteriorate quickly after he stopped taking the medicine.
deteriorate.exampleZh: 他停止服药后，健康状况开始迅速恶化。

determination.example: Her determination helped her finish the difficult race.
determination.exampleZh: 她的决心帮助她跑完了那场艰难的比赛。

determine.example: We need to determine the cause of the problem before we fix it.
determine.exampleZh: 我们需要先查明问题的原因，然后再去解决它。

deterrent.example: The high fence is a strong deterrent against thieves at night.
deterrent.exampleZh: 这道高围栏是夜间防贼的有力威慑。

detest.example: Most people detest waiting in long lines at the airport.
detest.exampleZh: 大多数人都讨厌在机场排长队等候。

detonation.example: The loud detonation shook the windows of every house on our street.
detonation.exampleZh: 巨大的爆炸声震动了我们街上每户人家的窗户。

detract.example: Small mistakes can detract from an otherwise good speech.
detract.exampleZh: 一些小错误会减损一场本来不错的演讲。

detractor.example: Even his detractors admitted that the new plan worked well.
detractor.exampleZh: 就连他的贬低者也承认这个新计划效果很好。

detrimental.example: Staying up late every night is detrimental to your health.
detrimental.exampleZh: 每晚熬夜对你的健康有害。

devaluation.example: The country's devaluation made imported goods more expensive for ordinary families.
devaluation.exampleZh: 该国的货币贬值使进口商品对普通家庭来说更贵了。

devastate.example: The storm devastated the small town and shocked all the people there.
devastate.exampleZh: 这场风暴摧毁了小镇，让那里所有人都感到震惊。

devastation.example: The war brought devastation to the small town and its people.
devastation.exampleZh: 战争给这个小镇和它的人民带来了毁灭。

develop.example: The small town has developed into a busy city over the years.
develop.exampleZh: 多年来，这个小镇已经发展成一座繁忙的城市。

development.example: The development of new technology has changed our daily lives a lot.
development.exampleZh: 新技术的发展在很大程度上改变了我们的日常生活。

deviate.example: Do not deviate from the plan we agreed on yesterday.
deviate.exampleZh: 不要偏离我们昨天商定的计划。

device.example: This small device helps us measure the temperature of the water.
device.exampleZh: 这个小装置帮助我们测量水的温度。

devil.example: The old story says a devil lives in that dark cave.
devil.exampleZh: 那个古老的故事说，有个魔鬼住在那座黑暗的洞穴里。

devious.example: The devious path through the forest took us two hours longer.
devious.exampleZh: 穿过森林的迂回小路让我们多花了两个小时。

devise.example: Our teacher asked us to devise a simple plan for the school trip.
devise.exampleZh: 老师让我们为学校旅行想出一个简单的方案。

devoid.example: The old house was devoid of furniture and felt very cold.
devoid.exampleZh: 那栋老房子没有家具，感觉非常冷清。

devote.example: She will devote more time to her family this year.
devote.exampleZh: 她今年会投入更多时间陪伴家人。

devour.example: The hungry dog devoured all the food in its bowl.
devour.exampleZh: 那只饥饿的狗狼吞虎咽地吃光了碗里所有的食物。

devout.example: She is a devout believer who goes to church every Sunday morning.
devout.exampleZh: 她是一位虔诚的信徒，每个星期天早上都去教堂。

dew.example: In the early morning, the grass is wet with dew.

diabetes.example: My grandfather has diabetes, so he avoids sugar and walks every day.
diabetes.exampleZh: 我爷爷患有糖尿病，所以他避免吃糖，并且每天散步。

diabolical.example: The villain in the story is truly diabolical and cruel.
diabolical.exampleZh: 故事里的反派确实极其邪恶又残忍。

diagnose.example: Doctors must diagnose the problem early so the patient can get help.
diagnose.exampleZh: 医生必须尽早诊断出问题，这样病人才能得到帮助。

diagnosis.example: The doctor made a quick diagnosis and gave her some medicine.
diagnosis.exampleZh: 医生很快做出了诊断，并给她开了一些药。

diagnostic.example: The doctor ran a diagnostic test to find the cause of her cough.
diagnostic.exampleZh: 医生做了一项诊断性检查，以找出她咳嗽的原因。

diagonal.example: Draw a diagonal line from the top left corner to the bottom right corner.
diagonal.exampleZh: 从左上角到右下角画一条对角线。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the board to explain the water cycle.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一张简单的示意图来解释水循环。

dial.example: Please dial the number on the phone and wait for an answer.
dial.exampleZh: 请在电话上拨这个号码，然后等待对方接听。

dialect.example: People in that small village still speak an old dialect at home.
dialect.exampleZh: 那个小村庄的人们在家里仍然说一种古老的方言。

diameter.example: The circle has a diameter of ten centimeters.
diameter.exampleZh: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。

diamond.example: She wore a diamond ring on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在聚会上手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。

diarrhea.example: The child had diarrhea for two days and could not go to school.
diarrhea.exampleZh: 这个孩子腹泻了两天，不能去上学。

diary.example: I write in my diary every night before I go to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 我每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

dichotomy.example: There is a clear dichotomy between what he says and what he does.
dichotomy.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在明显的对立。

dictate.example: The manager will dictate a short letter to his assistant today.
dictate.exampleZh: 经理今天要向他的助手口述一封短信。

dictator.example: The dictator ruled the country for many years and no one could oppose him.
dictator.exampleZh: 那个独裁者统治这个国家很多年，没有人能反对他。

diction.example: Clear diction helps the audience understand every word you say.
diction.exampleZh: 清晰的措辞有助于听众听懂你说的每一个字。

dictionary.example: I use a dictionary to look up new words when I read.
dictionary.exampleZh: 我阅读时用词典查新单词。

dictum.example: My grandfather often repeated an old dictum about saving money for hard times.
dictum.exampleZh: 我祖父经常重复一句关于存钱以备不时之需的古老格言。

didactic.example: His didactic style made the simple story feel like a long lecture.
didactic.exampleZh: 他说教的风格让这个简单的故事听起来像一场漫长的讲座。

die.example: His old dog died quietly in the garden last night.
die.exampleZh: 他的老狗昨晚在花园里安静地死了。

dielectric.example: The engineers placed a thin dielectric between the two metal plates.
dielectric.exampleZh: 工程师在两块金属板之间放置了一层薄电介质。

diesel.example: The truck runs on diesel and is very noisy in the morning.
diesel.exampleZh: 这辆卡车用柴油，早上噪音很大。

diet.example: My doctor says a healthy diet and daily exercise will help me feel better.
diet.exampleZh: 我的医生说健康的饮食和每天锻炼会让我感觉更好。

differ.example: My answer will differ from yours because we read the question differently.
differ.exampleZh: 我的答案会和你的不同，因为我们对问题的理解不一样。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two plans.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个计划之间有很大的差异。

different.example: My brother and I have different hobbies but we still play together every day.
different.exampleZh: 我弟弟和我有不同的爱好，但我们每天还是一起玩。

differentiate.example: Young children often cannot differentiate between real life and video games.
differentiate.exampleZh: 小孩子常常无法区分现实生活和电子游戏。

difficult.example: This math problem is too difficult for me to solve.
difficult.exampleZh: 这道数学题对我来说太难了，解不出来。

difficulty.example: I had some difficulty understanding the teacher's question at first.
difficulty.exampleZh: 起初我在理解老师的问题上有些困难。

diffidence.example: Her diffidence kept her from raising a hand in class.
diffidence.exampleZh: 她的羞怯让她不敢在课堂上举手。

diffident.example: She was too diffident to speak up in front of the whole class.
diffident.exampleZh: 她太羞怯了，不敢在全班同学面前发言。

diffraction.example: The bright colors on the soap bubble come from diffraction of light.
diffraction.exampleZh: 肥皂泡上明亮的颜色来自光的衍射。

diffuse.example: The smell of fresh bread began to diffuse through the whole house.
diffuse.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味开始扩散到整栋房子里。

dig.example: The dog likes to dig in the garden every morning.
dig.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢每天早上在花园里挖土。

digest.example: It takes time to digest this long article about food and health.
digest.exampleZh: 理解这篇关于食物与健康的长文章需要时间。

digit.example: My little sister can write each digit from zero to nine.
digit.exampleZh: 我妹妹会写从零到九的每个数字。

digital.example: My digital watch shows the time and the date.
digital.exampleZh: 我的电子手表显示时间和日期。

dignify.example: They tried to dignify the small ceremony with flowers and soft music.
dignify.exampleZh: 他们用鲜花和轻柔的音乐让这个小仪式显得有尊严。

dignity.example: She treated every patient with dignity and respect, even when they were very poor.
dignity.exampleZh: 即使病人非常贫穷，她也以尊严和尊重对待每一位病人。

digress.example: Sorry, I digress; let me go back to my main point.
digress.exampleZh: 抱歉，我离题了；让我回到主要观点上。

dilapidated.example: They live in a dilapidated old house near the river.
dilapidated.exampleZh: 他们住在河边一栋破旧的老房子里。

dilate.example: The doctor used special drops to dilate my eyes before the test.
dilate.exampleZh: 医生在检查前用特殊的眼药水扩大了我的瞳孔。

dilemma.example: She faced a difficult dilemma about whether to leave her job.
dilemma.exampleZh: 她面临一个困境，不知是否该辞掉工作。

diligent.example: She is a diligent student and always finishes her homework on time.
diligent.exampleZh: 她是个用功的学生，总是按时完成作业。

dilute.example: Please dilute the juice with water before you give it to the child.
dilute.exampleZh: 请先用水把果汁稀释，再给孩子喝。

dim.example: The room was dim because the only lamp was old and weak.
dim.exampleZh: 房间很昏暗，因为唯一的台灯又旧又暗。

dimension.example: Please measure the dimension of this box before you buy it.
dimension.exampleZh: 买之前请量一下这个箱子的尺寸。

diminish.example: The noise from the street began to diminish after midnight.
diminish.exampleZh: 午夜过后，街上的噪音开始减弱。

diminutive.example: The diminutive dog slept quietly in a small basket by the door.
diminutive.exampleZh: 那只小巧的狗安静地睡在门边的小篮子里。

din.example: The din from the party next door kept me awake all night.
din.exampleZh: 隔壁聚会的喧闹声让我整夜没睡着。

dine.example: We often dine at a small restaurant near our home on Fridays.
dine.exampleZh: 我们常在周五去家附近的一家小餐馆进餐。

dinner.example: We usually eat dinner together at seven every evening.
dinner.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上七点一起吃晚餐。

dinosaur.example: The dinosaur was very big and lived on Earth a long time ago.
dinosaur.exampleZh: 恐龙体型很大，很久以前生活在地球上。

diode.example: A diode lets current flow in only one direction.
diode.exampleZh: 二极管只允许电流朝一个方向流动。

dip.example: She dipped her bread into the warm soup and smiled.
dip.exampleZh: 她把面包蘸进热汤里，笑了。

diphthong.example: The word "diphthong" is difficult for many students to spell correctly.
diphthong.exampleZh: “diphthong”这个词对许多学生来说很难正确拼写。

diploma.example: She put her diploma on the wall after finishing college.
diploma.exampleZh: 大学毕业后，她把毕业文凭挂在了墙上。

diplomatic.example: She was very diplomatic when she told him about the mistake.
diplomatic.exampleZh: 她告诉他这个错误时表现得非常圆滑。

dire.example: The village was in dire need of food and clean water.
dire.exampleZh: 这个村庄急需食物和干净的水。

direct.example: The teacher gave us direct instructions before the test started.
direct.exampleZh: 老师在考试开始前给了我们直接的指示。

direction.example: Please read the directions on the box before you use this medicine.
direction.exampleZh: 使用这种药之前，请先阅读盒子上的用法说明。

directly.example: She went directly home after work and did not stop anywhere.
directly.exampleZh: 她下班后直接回家，没有在任何地方停留。

director.example: The director asked the actors to stay for one more short practice.
director.exampleZh: 导演让演员们留下来再多排练一小会儿。

directory.example: I looked up his number in the phone directory.
directory.exampleZh: 我在电话簿里查了他的号码。

dirge.example: The old woman sang a sad dirge at the soldier's funeral.
dirge.exampleZh: 那位老妇人在士兵的葬礼上唱了一首悲伤的挽歌。

dirt.example: The children came home with dirt all over their hands and faces.
dirt.exampleZh: 孩子们回到家时，手上和脸上全是污垢。

dirty.example: His dirty hands made the clean white towel look very dark.
dirty.exampleZh: 他脏兮兮的手把干净的白毛巾弄得看起来很黑。

disability.example: People with a disability often need extra help at work and in daily life.
disability.exampleZh: 残疾人士在工作和日常生活中常常需要额外的帮助。

disable.example: The accident may disable him and change his whole life.
disable.exampleZh: 这场事故可能使他丧失能力，改变他的一生。

disadvantage.example: A big disadvantage of this plan is that it costs too much money.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这个计划的一大缺点是要花太多钱。

disagree.example: I disagree with my brother about which movie we should watch tonight.
disagree.exampleZh: 我不同意我哥哥关于我们今晚该看哪部电影的看法。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned gray.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变得灰暗。

disappoint.example: I hope the movie will not disappoint you tonight.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望今晚这部电影不会让你失望。

disarm.example: The police tried to disarm the man before he could hurt anyone.
disarm.exampleZh: 警察试图在他伤害任何人之前解除他的武装。

disarray.example: The room was in complete disarray after the party last night.
disarray.exampleZh: 昨晚聚会之后，房间里一片混乱。

disaster.example: The storm was a disaster for the small village.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场风暴对这个小村庄来说是一场灾难。

disastrous.example: The heavy rain had a disastrous effect on the small town last night.
disastrous.exampleZh: 昨晚的大雨对那个小镇造成了灾难性的影响。

disburse.example: The company will disburse the funds to each worker next week.
disburse.exampleZh: 公司将在下周向每位工人支付这笔资金。

discard.example: Please discard the old papers before you move to the new office.
discard.exampleZh: 在你搬到新办公室之前，请把旧文件丢弃。

discern.example: I can discern a clear difference between the two plans.
discern.exampleZh: 我能察觉出这两个方案之间的明显差别。

discharge.example: The factory was fined for discharging dirty water into the river.
discharge.exampleZh: 这家工厂因向河里排放污水而被罚款。

discipline.example: Learning discipline helps students do better in every subject at school.
discipline.exampleZh: 学习纪律能帮助学生在学校的每一门学科中表现更好。

disclaim.example: He disclaimed any knowledge of the missing money.
disclaim.exampleZh: 他否认知道那笔丢失的钱。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the details of the new plan.
disclose.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露新计划的细节。

disco.example: We went to a disco near the station and danced all night.
disco.exampleZh: 我们去了车站附近的一家迪斯科舞厅，跳了一整晚的舞。

discomfort.example: I felt some discomfort in my back after sitting all day.
discomfort.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，我感到背部有些不适。

disconcert.example: The sudden question seemed to disconcert the young speaker.
disconcert.exampleZh: 这个突然的问题似乎让那位年轻的演讲者感到不安。

discontent.example: Many workers feel discontent because their pay is low and their hours are long.
discontent.exampleZh: 许多工人感到不满，因为工资低而且工作时间长。

discount.example: The store offers a small discount on all winter coats this week.
discount.exampleZh: 这家店本周对所有冬季外套提供小幅折扣。

discourse.example: His new discourse on climate change was long but very clear.
discourse.exampleZh: 他那篇关于气候变化的新论述很长，但非常清晰。

discover.example: I was happy to discover a small quiet park near my new home.
discover.exampleZh: 我很高兴发现新家附近有一个安静的小公园。

discovery.example: The discovery of the small star changed how we look at space.
discovery.exampleZh: 这颗小恒星的发现改变了我们看待太空的方式。

discreet.example: Please be discreet about this news and do not tell anyone.
discreet.exampleZh: 请对这个消息谨慎一些，不要告诉任何人。

discrepancy.example: There is a clear discrepancy between the two reports.
discrepancy.exampleZh: 这两份报告之间存在明显的差异。

discrete.example: The teacher put the students into discrete groups for the science project.
discrete.exampleZh: 老师把学生们分成一个个独立的小组来做科学项目。

discriminate.example: It is wrong to discriminate against people because of their skin color.
discriminate.exampleZh: 因为肤色而歧视他人是错误的。

discrimination.example: We should treat everyone equally and fight against discrimination in daily life.
discrimination.exampleZh: 我们应该平等对待每个人，并在日常生活中反对歧视。

discuss.example: We often discuss our plans for the weekend at the dinner table.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们常常在餐桌上讨论周末的计划。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about the new plan after lunch.
discussion.exampleZh: 午饭后我们花了很长时间讨论这个新计划。

disdain.example: She looked at the cheap gift with disdain and refused to take it.
disdain.exampleZh: 她鄙视地看了看那份廉价的礼物，拒绝接受。

disease.example: This disease can make people feel very tired and weak.
disease.exampleZh: 这种疾病会让人感到非常疲倦和虚弱。

disenfranchise.example: The new law may disenfranchise many poor voters in the city.
disenfranchise.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能会剥夺该市许多贫穷选民的投票权。

disfigure.example: The fire badly disfigured his face and hands.
disfigure.exampleZh: 那场火灾严重毁坏了他的脸和双手。

disgrace.example: His rude behavior brought disgrace to the whole family.
disgrace.exampleZh: 他的粗鲁行为给整个家庭带来了耻辱。

disguise.example: He tried to disguise his voice on the phone.
disguise.exampleZh: 他在电话里试图掩饰自己的声音。

disgust.example: The smell of old food filled her with disgust.
disgust.exampleZh: 旧食物的气味让她满心厌恶。

dish.example: She put the hot dish on the table and smiled.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热菜放在桌上，笑了笑。

dishonest.example: It is dishonest to take money that does not belong to you.
dishonest.exampleZh: 拿不属于你的钱是不诚实的。

disillusion.example: The bad news may disillusion him, but he needs to know the truth.
disillusion.exampleZh: 这个坏消息可能会让他醒悟，但他需要知道真相。

disjointed.example: His story was so disjointed that nobody could follow what happened next.
disjointed.exampleZh: 他的故事太不连贯了，没人能听懂接下来发生了什么。

disk.example: Please save the file to the disk before you turn off the computer.
disk.exampleZh: 关掉电脑之前，请把文件保存到磁盘上。

dislike.example: I really dislike getting up early on cold winter mornings.
dislike.exampleZh: 我很不喜欢在寒冷的冬日早晨早起。

dislocate.example: He fell off the bike and dislocated his shoulder.
dislocate.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，肩膀脱臼了。

dismal.example: The weather was dismal and the whole town felt sad and quiet.
dismal.exampleZh: 天气阴沉，整个小镇都显得悲伤而安静。

dismantle.example: The workers will dismantle the old bridge next week.
dismantle.exampleZh: 工人们下周将拆除这座旧桥。

dismay.example: The bad news filled her with dismay, and she sat down quietly.
dismay.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她满心沮丧，她安静地坐了下来。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers because they were often late.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名工人，因为他们经常迟到。

disorder.example: The room was in complete disorder after the party last night.
disorder.exampleZh: 昨晚派对过后，房间里一片混乱。

disorient.example: The dark streets began to disorient him after the party.
disorient.exampleZh: 聚会结束后，昏暗的街道开始让他迷失方向。

disparage.example: Please do not disparage his work in front of the whole team.
disparage.exampleZh: 请不要在全队面前贬低他的工作。

disparate.example: Their ideas are disparate, so the team needs more time to agree.
disparate.exampleZh: 他们的想法迥然不同，所以团队需要更多时间才能达成一致。

dispassionate.example: A good judge stays dispassionate when hearing both sides of the story.
dispassionate.exampleZh: 好的法官在听取双方陈述时会保持冷静，不带偏见。

dispatch.example: The company will dispatch a small team to the site tomorrow morning.
dispatch.exampleZh: 公司明天早上会派一个小团队去现场。

dispel.example: The teacher's kind words helped dispel the students' fears about the exam.
dispel.exampleZh: 老师温和的话语帮助驱散了学生们对考试的恐惧。

dispensable.example: In a small kitchen, a third pot is dispensable because one large pot is enough.
dispensable.exampleZh: 在小厨房里，第三口锅是可有可无的，因为一口大锅就足够了。

disperse.example: The wind began to disperse the thick smoke over the field.
disperse.exampleZh: 风开始把田野上空的浓烟吹散。

displace.example: Cars have largely displaced horses in cities today.
displace.exampleZh: 如今汽车已在城市里基本上取代了马。

display.example: The store will display its new phones in the front window.
display.exampleZh: 这家商店会把新手机陈列在前窗里。

displease.example: Loud music late at night may displease your neighbors.
displease.exampleZh: 深夜放很大声的音乐可能会让你的邻居不快。

disposable.example: We bought disposable plates and cups for the picnic, then threw them away.
disposable.exampleZh: 我们为野餐买了一次性盘子和杯子，用完后就把它们扔掉了。

dispose.example: We must dispose of the old books before the new ones arrive.
dispose.exampleZh: 我们必须在新的书到来之前把旧书处理掉。

disposition.example: Her cheerful disposition makes her popular with everyone at work.
disposition.exampleZh: 她开朗的性情使她在工作中很受大家欢迎。

dispossess.example: The new law may dispossess many families of their homes.
dispossess.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能会剥夺许多家庭的住房。

dispute.example: The two sides are still trying to settle the dispute over the land.
dispute.exampleZh: 双方仍在努力解决这场土地争端。

disquiet.example: The strange silence in the house filled her with disquiet.
disquiet.exampleZh: 房子里奇怪的寂静让她感到不安。

disregard.example: He chose to disregard the warning and drove on in the rain.
disregard.exampleZh: 他选择不理会警告，继续在雨中开车。

disrepute.example: The old hotel fell into disrepute after several guests complained about its dirty rooms.
disrepute.exampleZh: 在几位客人抱怨房间脏乱之后，这家老酒店便名声扫地了。

disrupt.example: Heavy snow can disrupt train service across the whole country.
disrupt.exampleZh: 大雪可能会扰乱全国的火车运营。

dissect.example: In science class we dissect a frog to learn about its body parts.
dissect.exampleZh: 科学课上我们解剖一只青蛙，了解它的身体结构。

disseminate.example: The internet helps people disseminate news and ideas very quickly.
disseminate.exampleZh: 互联网帮助人们非常迅速地传播新闻和观点。

dissent.example: Several members expressed dissent during the meeting but agreed to follow the final decision.
dissent.exampleZh: 几位成员在会议上表达了异议，但同意服从最终决定。

dissident.example: The dissident spoke openly against the government and was later arrested.
dissident.exampleZh: 这位持不同政见者公开反对政府，后来被逮捕了。

dissociate.example: She tried to dissociate herself from the failed project.
dissociate.exampleZh: 她试图与那个失败的项目脱离关系。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar in warm water until it dissolves completely.
dissolve.exampleZh: 把糖搅入温水中，直到它完全溶解。

distance.example: The distance between the two cities is about one hundred miles.
distance.exampleZh: 这两座城市之间的距离大约是一百英里。

distant.example: She lives in a distant city and we rarely see her now.
distant.exampleZh: 她住在一座遥远的城市，我们现在很少见到她。

distend.example: The balloon will distend as we blow more air into it.
distend.exampleZh: 当我们往气球里吹更多空气时，它会膨胀起来。

distill.example: We distill water to make it clean and safe to drink.
distill.exampleZh: 我们蒸馏水，使其干净且可以安全饮用。

distinct.example: There is a distinct difference between these two kinds of music.
distinct.exampleZh: 这两种音乐之间有明显的区别。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two words in daily use.
distinction.exampleZh: 在日常使用中，这两个词之间有明显的区别。

distinctive.example: The little cafe has a distinctive smell of fresh coffee and warm bread.
distinctive.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆有一种独特的气味，混合着新鲜咖啡和温热面包的香味。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look exactly the same.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们长得一模一样。

distort.example: The article distorts the facts to make the story more exciting.
distort.exampleZh: 这篇文章歪曲事实，让故事更刺激。

distract.example: The loud music outside the window distracted me from my homework.
distract.exampleZh: 窗外的吵闹音乐让我分心，没法专心做作业。

distraught.example: She was distraught when she lost her keys on the bus.
distraught.exampleZh: 她把钥匙丢在公交车上，心里非常烦乱。

distress.example: The lost child was in great distress until a kind woman helped him.
distress.exampleZh: 那个走失的孩子非常痛苦，直到一位好心的女士帮助了他。

distribute.example: Volunteers will distribute food and water to the families after the storm.
distribute.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，志愿者将向这些家庭分发食物和水。

distribution.example: The distribution of food to the villagers was fair and quick.
distribution.exampleZh: 向村民分发食物的过程既公平又迅速。

district.example: She lives in a quiet district near the river.
district.exampleZh: 她住在河边一个安静的区。

distrust.example: She began to distrust his sweet words after hearing the truth.
distrust.exampleZh: 听到真相后，她开始怀疑他的甜言蜜语。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am studying in my room.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在房间学习时请不要打扰我。

disturbance.example: The loud music caused a disturbance late at night.
disturbance.exampleZh: 响亮的音乐在深夜造成了打扰。

ditch.example: The farmer dug a ditch to bring water to his crops.
ditch.exampleZh: 农民挖了一条沟渠把水引到庄稼地里。

diurnal.example: Most birds are diurnal and sleep at night.
diurnal.exampleZh: 大多数鸟类是白天活动的，夜间睡觉。

dive.example: The bird made a quick dive into the water to catch a fish.
dive.exampleZh: 那只鸟迅速俯冲入水，去抓一条鱼。

diverge.example: Our opinions diverge when we talk about how to spend the money.
diverge.exampleZh: 当我们讨论如何花这笔钱时，我们的意见出现了分歧。

diverse.example: Our city has diverse food from many countries around the world.
diverse.exampleZh: 我们的城市有来自世界许多国家的多种多样的食物。

diversify.example: Our company plans to diversify its products to reach more customers.
diversify.exampleZh: 我们公司计划使产品多样化，以吸引更多客户。

diversity.example: Our school has students from many countries, which brings great diversity to campus life.
diversity.exampleZh: 我们学校有来自许多国家的学生，这给校园生活带来了极大的多样性。

divert.example: Heavy rain forced the pilot to divert the plane to another airport.
divert.exampleZh: 大雨迫使飞行员把飞机转移到另一个机场。

divest.example: The company decided to divest its smaller factories and focus on its main business.
divest.exampleZh: 公司决定处置掉较小的工厂，专注于主要业务。

divide.example: A small river divides the two villages, but the people share the same market.
divide.exampleZh: 一条小河流经两个村庄之间，但人们共用同一个集市。

dividend.example: The company pays a dividend to its shareholders every year.
dividend.exampleZh: 公司每年向股东派发股息。

divine.example: They believe the king has divine power to heal the sick.
divine.exampleZh: 他们相信国王拥有治愈病人的神圣力量。

division.example: The manager divided the work into two divisions to save time.
division.exampleZh: 经理把工作分成两个部门以节省时间。

divorce.example: The divorce was hard for their two young children.
divorce.exampleZh: 离婚对他们两个年幼的孩子来说很难熬。

divulge.example: She did not want to divulge the secret to anyone.
divulge.exampleZh: 她不想向任何人泄露这个秘密。

dizzy.example: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast after sitting for a long time.
dizzy.exampleZh: 坐久了之后，如果我起身太快，就会感到头晕。

docile.example: The docile dog sat quietly beside its owner all afternoon.
docile.exampleZh: 那只温顺的狗整个下午都安静地坐在主人身边。

dock.example: The small boat waited at the dock while the workers loaded boxes.
dock.exampleZh: 小船在码头等着，工人们往船上装箱子。

doctor.example: My mother told me to see a doctor because my cough got worse.
doctor.exampleZh: 我妈妈让我去看医生，因为我的咳嗽加重了。

doctrine.example: The church teaches this doctrine to all new members.
doctrine.exampleZh: 教会向所有新成员传授这一教义。

document.example: Please keep this document in a safe place for your records.
document.exampleZh: 请把这份文件保存在安全的地方以备查阅。

documentary.example: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa last night.
documentary.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于非洲野生动物的纪录片。

dodge.example: He quickly dodged the ball and ran to the other side.
dodge.exampleZh: 他迅速躲开球，跑到了另一边。

dogged.example: Her dogged efforts finally helped the small team win the game.
dogged.exampleZh: 她顽强的努力最终帮助这支小球队赢得了比赛。

dogma.example: He refused to accept the dogma of his old school.
dogma.exampleZh: 他拒绝接受他母校的教条。

dolphin.example: We saw a dolphin jump out of the water near our boat.
dolphin.exampleZh: 我们看到一只海豚在船附近跃出水面。

domain.example: She is an expert in the domain of computer science.
domain.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的专家。

dome.example: The old church has a large white dome on top.
dome.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂顶部有一个白色的大圆顶。

dominant.example: This team is dominant in the league and wins almost every game.
dominant.exampleZh: 这支球队在联赛中占优势，几乎每场比赛都赢。

dominate.example: The tall tower dominates the small town and can be seen from far away.
dominate.exampleZh: 这座高塔耸立在小镇之上，从很远的地方就能看到。

dominion.example: The king ruled his dominion with a strong army.
dominion.exampleZh: 国王用强大的军队统治着他的领地。

doom.example: Bad decisions can doom a small business to failure.
doom.exampleZh: 错误的决定可能注定让一家小企业失败。

dormant.example: The bear stays dormant in its cave through the cold winter months.
dormant.exampleZh: 这只熊在寒冷的冬季几个月里一直蛰伏在洞穴中。

dorsal.example: The shark has a large dorsal fin on its back.
dorsal.exampleZh: 这条鲨鱼的背上有一个很大的背鳍。

dose.example: The doctor gave the child a small dose of medicine.
dose.exampleZh: 医生给孩子服了一小剂药。

dot.example: There is a small red dot on the map.

double.example: The price of this coat is double what it was last year.
double.exampleZh: 这件外套的价格是去年的两倍。

doubt.example: I doubt he will come to the party tonight.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚不会来参加聚会。

dough.example: My mother made the dough for the bread this morning.
dough.exampleZh: 今天早上我妈妈做了面包用的面团。

draft.example: She wrote a first draft of the report and asked me to check it.
draft.exampleZh: 她写了报告的第一稿，并让我检查一下。

drag.example: Please drag the heavy box into the room before it gets dark.
drag.exampleZh: 请在天黑之前把这个重箱子拖进房间里。

dragon.example: In the story, a brave boy meets a green dragon in the mountains.
dragon.exampleZh: 在故事里，一个勇敢的男孩在山中遇到了一条绿色的龙。

drain.example: The old pipes drain the rainwater away from the roof very slowly.
drain.exampleZh: 那些旧管道把雨水从屋顶排走，速度非常慢。

drama.example: The drama at school today was very exciting for all the students.
drama.exampleZh: 今天学校里的戏剧性事件让所有学生都很兴奋。

dramatic.example: The movie had a dramatic ending that surprised everyone in the theater.
dramatic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个戏剧性的结局，让影院里的每个人都感到惊讶。

drastic.example: The company made drastic changes to its plan last year.
drastic.exampleZh: 公司去年对它的计划做了大幅调整。

draw.example: Please draw a picture of your family for me.
draw.exampleZh: 请给我画一幅你家人的画。

drawback.example: The only drawback of this plan is that it costs too much time.
drawback.exampleZh: 这个计划唯一的缺点是要花费太多时间。

dread.example: Many students dread the exam because they are afraid of failing again.
dread.exampleZh: 许多学生很怕这场考试，因为他们担心自己又考不及格。

dream.example: I often dream about flying, and my dream is to become a pilot.
dream.exampleZh: 我常梦见飞翔，我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

dreary.example: The rainy Monday morning felt dreary and long.
dreary.exampleZh: 那个下雨的周一早晨让人觉得沉闷又漫长。

dress.example: She will dress quickly and then go to the party with her friends.
dress.exampleZh: 她会很快穿好衣服，然后和朋友们一起去参加聚会。

drift.example: The empty boat began to drift slowly down the quiet river at dawn.
drift.exampleZh: 黎明时分，那条空船开始沿着安静的河面缓缓漂流。

drill.example: The teacher will drill the students on the new words before the test.
drill.exampleZh: 老师会在考试前让学生操练这些新单词。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before breakfast.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上早饭前喝一杯水。

drip.example: Water began to drip from the old pipe onto the floor.
drip.exampleZh: 水开始从旧管道滴到地板上。

drive.example: He has the drive to finish the work, so he drives on.
drive.exampleZh: 他有完成这项工作的干劲，因此他继续开车前进。

drop.example: A drop of rain fell from the leaf onto the ground.
drop.exampleZh: 一滴雨水从叶子上落到了地上。

drought.example: The drought lasted for months and many farmers lost their crops.
drought.exampleZh: 这场干旱持续了数月，许多农民失去了庄稼。

drown.example: The heavy rain drowned the small garden in water last night.
drown.exampleZh: 昨晚的大雨淹没了小花园。

drowse.example: The warm afternoon sun made the students drowse during the long lecture.
drowse.exampleZh: 温暖的午后阳光让学生们在漫长的讲座中打起了瞌睡。

drudgery.example: Cleaning the same floors every day is hard drudgery for the hotel staff.
drudgery.exampleZh: 每天擦同样的地板，对酒店员工来说是很乏味的苦活。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help with the pain.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药来帮助缓解疼痛。

drum.example: He played the drum with his hands at the school concert.
drum.exampleZh: 他在学校音乐会上用手打鼓。

dry.example: My shirt is still wet, so I will dry it in the sun.
dry.exampleZh: 我的衬衫还是湿的，所以我要把它放在太阳下晒干。

dual.example: This phone has a dual camera on the back.
dual.exampleZh: 这款手机的背面有一个双摄像头。

dub.example: They will dub the film into Chinese for the local audience.
dub.exampleZh: 他们会把这部电影配成中文给当地观众看。

dubious.example: I am dubious about his promise to finish the work today.
dubious.exampleZh: 我对他今天完成工作的承诺表示怀疑。

duck.example: The little duck swims in the pond behind our house.
duck.exampleZh: 那只小鸭在我们房子后面的池塘里游来游去。

duct.example: The workers cleaned the air duct above the kitchen ceiling yesterday.
duct.exampleZh: 工人们昨天清理了厨房天花板上方的通风管道。

due.example: The report is due on Friday, so please finish it soon.
due.exampleZh: 报告预定在周五交，所以请尽快完成。

dunce.example: The class laughed at the dunce who always failed the simple test.
dunce.exampleZh: 班上同学都嘲笑那个总是连简单测验都不及格的笨学生。

duplicate.example: Please duplicate this file and put the copy on my desk.
duplicate.exampleZh: 请复制这个文件，并把副本放在我的桌子上。

durable.example: This durable bag has lasted for many years of daily use.
durable.exampleZh: 这个耐用的包经受住了多年日常使用。

duration.example: The duration of the meeting was about two hours.
duration.exampleZh: 这次会议的持续时间大约是两小时。

duress.example: The police said the suspect signed the confession under duress.
duress.exampleZh: 警方说嫌疑人在胁迫下签署了供词。

during.example: I read two books during the summer holiday.
during.exampleZh: 暑假期间我读了两本书。

dusk.example: We walked home together at dusk after the long game.
dusk.exampleZh: 漫长的比赛结束后，我们在黄昏时一起走回家。

dust.example: There is a lot of dust on the old wooden table.
dust.exampleZh: 那张旧木桌上有很多灰尘。

dutiful.example: She is a dutiful daughter who always helps her parents at home.
dutiful.exampleZh: 她是个孝顺的女儿，总是在家里帮助父母。

duty.example: It is my duty to help my parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是我的责任。

dwarf.example: The huge tree dwarfs the small house next to it.
dwarf.exampleZh: 那棵大树使旁边的小房子显得很矮小。

dwell.example: Many birds dwell in these tall trees near the river.
dwell.exampleZh: 许多鸟栖息在河边的这些高树上。

dwelling.example: Their old dwelling was small but warm and always full of laughter.
dwelling.exampleZh: 他们的旧住所虽小，却很温暖，总是充满笑声。

dwindle.example: The number of fish in the river continues to dwindle every year.
dwindle.exampleZh: 河里鱼的数量每年都在持续减少。

dye.example: She used a natural dye to make the old dress blue.
dye.exampleZh: 她用一种天然染料把旧裙子染成了蓝色。

dynamic.example: The music is dynamic and full of energy.
dynamic.exampleZh: 这段音乐很有动感，充满活力。

dynamite.example: The workers used dynamite to break the large rocks into small pieces.
dynamite.exampleZh: 工人们用炸药把大块岩石炸成小块。

dynamo.example: The old dynamo in the basement still makes enough power for the whole house.
dynamo.exampleZh: 地下室那台旧发电机仍能为整栋房子提供足够的电力。

dynasty.example: The Ming dynasty built many great walls and palaces in China.
dynasty.exampleZh: 明朝在中国修建了许多宏伟的城墙和宫殿。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们热切地想在圣诞节早上打开礼物。

eagle.example: The eagle flew high above the mountains and looked for food.
eagle.exampleZh: 那只鹰飞到群山上方，寻找食物。

ear.example: My little sister has a small red mark on her left ear.
ear.exampleZh: 我妹妹的左耳上有一个小红点。

early.example: She gets up early every morning to walk her dog.
early.exampleZh: 她每天早上很早起床去遛狗。

earmark.example: The city earmarked extra money for new parks this year.
earmark.exampleZh: 市政府今年为新建公园专门拨出了额外资金。

earn.example: He works hard every day to earn money for his family.
earn.exampleZh: 他每天努力工作，为家人挣钱。

earnest.example: She gave an earnest answer to every question I asked.
earnest.exampleZh: 她对我提出的每个问题都作了认真的回答。

earth.example: The earth moves around the sun once every year in space.
earth.exampleZh: 地球每年在太空中绕太阳运行一圈。

earthly.example: She gave up her earthly possessions to help the poor.
earthly.exampleZh: 她放弃了尘世的财产去帮助穷人。

earthquake.example: The earthquake broke many houses and roads in the small town.
earthquake.exampleZh: 这场地震毁坏了小镇上的许多房屋和道路。

ease.example: This new phone is easy to use and brings me great ease.
ease.exampleZh: 这部新手机很容易使用，给我带来了极大的便利。

easily.example: You can easily find the answer in this book.
easily.exampleZh: 你可以很容易地在这本书里找到答案。

east.example: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
east.exampleZh: 太阳从东方升起，在西方落下。

eastern.example: The sun rises in the eastern sky every morning.
eastern.exampleZh: 太阳每天早晨从东方的天空升起。

easy.example: This easy test only takes ten minutes to finish.
easy.exampleZh: 这个简单的测试只需要十分钟就能完成。

eat.example: We usually eat rice and vegetables for lunch at home.
eat.exampleZh: 我们通常在家吃米饭和蔬菜当午饭。

eavesdrop.example: She stood by the door to eavesdrop on their conversation.
eavesdrop.exampleZh: 她站在门边偷听他们的谈话。

ebbing.example: The old fisherman knew the ebbing tide would soon leave his boat on the sand.
ebbing.exampleZh: 老渔夫知道退潮很快就会把他的船搁在沙滩上。

ebony.example: The old piano was made of shiny black ebony.
ebony.exampleZh: 那架旧钢琴是用乌黑发亮的乌木制成的。

ebullient.example: The ebullient crowd cheered loudly when the team won the final game.
ebullient.exampleZh: 球队赢得决赛时，热情奔放的人群大声欢呼。

eccentric.example: My eccentric neighbor wears a coat in summer and talks to his plants.
eccentric.exampleZh: 我那位古怪的邻居夏天穿大衣，还跟他的植物说话。

eccentricity.example: My old neighbor's eccentricity makes him interesting, but he is still a kind man.
eccentricity.exampleZh: 我那位老邻居的古怪让他很有趣，但他仍然是个善良的人。

echo.example: The echo of our voices came back from the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 我们的声音从空荡的大厅里传回回声。

eclectic.example: Her music style is eclectic and mixes jazz with pop.
eclectic.exampleZh: 她的音乐风格兼收并蓄，把爵士和流行融合在一起。

eclipse.example: During the eclipse, the sky grew dark and the stars came out.
eclipse.exampleZh: 日食期间，天空变暗，星星出现了。

ecologist.example: The ecologist studies how animals and plants live together in the forest.
ecologist.exampleZh: 这位生态学家研究森林中动物和植物如何共同生活。

ecology.example: Ecology helps us understand how living things depend on each other.
ecology.exampleZh: 生态学帮助我们了解生物之间如何相互依存。

economic.example: The country has seen strong economic growth over the past ten years.
economic.exampleZh: 这个国家在过去十年里经历了强劲的经济增长。

economical.example: This small car is very economical and cheap to run.
economical.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车非常经济实惠，开起来很便宜。

economics.example: She studies economics at university and wants to work in a bank.
economics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习经济学，想在一家银行工作。

economy.example: The country's economy is growing slowly but steadily this year.
economy.exampleZh: 今年这个国家的经济正在缓慢但稳定地增长。

eddy.example: The little boat was caught in a strong eddy near the rocks.
eddy.exampleZh: 小船在岩石附近被一个强劲的漩涡困住了。

edge.example: The cup is near the edge of the table.

edible.example: Are these small red berries in the garden edible?
edible.exampleZh: 花园里的这些红色小浆果可以吃吗？

edict.example: The king issued an edict that everyone must pay the new tax.
edict.exampleZh: 国王颁布了一项法令，规定每人都必须缴纳新税。

edifice.example: The old edifice at the corner of the street is a famous library.
edifice.exampleZh: 街角的那座古老大厦是一座著名的图书馆。

edify.example: Good books can edify young readers and help them think more clearly.
edify.exampleZh: 好书能启迪年轻读者，帮助他们更清晰地思考。

edit.example: I edit the school video with my friends every Friday afternoon.
edit.exampleZh: 我每周五下午和朋友们一起剪辑学校的视频。

edition.example: This is the second edition of my favorite book.
edition.exampleZh: 这是我最喜欢的那本书的第二版。

editor.example: The editor read my story and asked for two small changes.
editor.exampleZh: 编辑读了我的故事，并要求做两处小改动。

editorial.example: The newspaper published an editorial about the new school policy.
editorial.exampleZh: 报纸发表了一篇关于新学校政策的社论。

educate.example: Parents and teachers should educate children to be kind and honest.
educate.exampleZh: 家长和老师应当教育孩子善良诚实。

education.example: My parents believe that education can change a person's life.
education.exampleZh: 我的父母相信教育能改变一个人的一生。

educator.example: Our teacher is a kind educator who helps every student learn with joy.
educator.exampleZh: 我们的老师是一位善良的教育家，他帮助每个学生快乐地学习。

eerie.example: The empty house looked eerie in the dark.
eerie.exampleZh: 那栋空房子在黑暗中显得很怪异。

efface.example: Time can efface even the saddest memories from our minds.
efface.exampleZh: 时间甚至能抹去我们心中最悲伤的记忆。

effect.example: The new rule had a big effect on how we work.
effect.exampleZh: 新规定对我们的工作方式产生了很大影响。

effective.example: The new medicine is very effective for a bad cough.
effective.exampleZh: 这种新药对严重的咳嗽非常有效。

effectual.example: Her simple plan was effectual and solved the problem quickly.
effectual.exampleZh: 她那个简单的计划很奏效，很快就解决了问题。

effeminate.example: His voice sounded effeminate, so some people made fun of him.
effeminate.exampleZh: 他的声音听起来有些女人气，所以有些人取笑他。

efficacy.example: The doctor wants to test the efficacy of the new drug.
efficacy.exampleZh: 医生想测试这种新药的功效。

efficiency.example: Good planning can improve our work efficiency and save time.
efficiency.exampleZh: 好的计划能提高我们的工作效率并节省时间。

efficient.example: This new machine is very efficient and saves us a lot of time.
efficient.exampleZh: 这台新机器非常高效，为我们节省了大量时间。

effigy.example: The angry crowd burned an effigy of the unpopular leader in the square.
effigy.exampleZh: 愤怒的人群在广场上烧毁了那位不受欢迎领导人的模拟像。

effort.example: She put a lot of effort into her English homework.
effort.exampleZh: 她在英语作业上付出了很多努力。

effrontery.example: He had the effrontery to ask for more money after doing so little.
effrontery.exampleZh: 他干了那么少的活，却厚颜无耻地要求加钱。

egalitarian.example: They want a more egalitarian society where everyone has a fair chance.
egalitarian.exampleZh: 他们想要一个更平等的社会，让每个人都有公平的机会。

eggshell.example: She put the broken eggshell in the bin after making breakfast this morning.
eggshell.exampleZh: 今天早上做完早餐后，她把碎蛋壳放进了垃圾桶。

ego.example: His ego was hurt when no one praised his work.
ego.exampleZh: 没有人称赞他的工作，他的自尊心受到了伤害。

egocentric.example: Young children are often egocentric and think only about their own needs.
egocentric.exampleZh: 幼儿往往以自我为中心，只想着自己的需求。

egotism.example: His egotism made it hard to work with him.
egotism.exampleZh: 他的自我中心让人很难和他共事。

egotist.example: The egotist talked about himself all night and never asked a single question.
egotist.exampleZh: 那个自大者整晚都在谈自己，一个问题也没问。

eight.example: My little sister is eight years old and she loves to read.
eight.exampleZh: 我妹妹八岁，她喜欢读书。

either.example: You can take either of the two books home today.
either.exampleZh: 你今天可以把这两本书中的任意一本带回家。

eject.example: The machine will eject the empty cup after you press the green button.
eject.exampleZh: 按下绿色按钮后，机器会弹出空杯子。

ejection.example: The sudden ejection of hot gas from the pipe scared everyone nearby.
ejection.exampleZh: 管道中突然喷出的热气吓到了附近的每个人。

elaborate.example: She gave an elaborate answer to our simple question about the trip.
elaborate.exampleZh: 她对我们关于这次旅行的简单问题作了详尽的回答。

elastic.example: The waistband of these pants is elastic, so they fit many people.
elastic.exampleZh: 这条裤子的腰带有弹性，所以适合很多人穿。

elated.example: She felt elated when she heard the good news about her exam.
elated.exampleZh: 听到考试的好消息时，她感到兴高采烈。

elbow.example: She hurt her elbow when she fell off the bike.
elbow.exampleZh: 她从自行车上摔下来时伤到了肘部。

elder.example: My elder sister looks after me when our parents are away.
elder.exampleZh: 父母不在时，我姐姐会照顾我。
