elect.example: The class will elect a new leader on Monday.
elect.exampleZh: 全班将在周一选举一位新班长。

election.example: She won the election and became the new mayor of our town.
election.exampleZh: 她赢得了选举，成为我们镇的新市长。

electorate.example: The electorate voted in large numbers for a new government.
electorate.exampleZh: 选民大批投票支持新政府。

electric.example: This electric car is quiet and easy to drive in the city.
electric.exampleZh: 这辆电动车很安静，在城市里开起来也很轻松。

electrical.example: The electrical wiring in this old house needs to be replaced soon.
electrical.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的电线需要尽快更换。

electrician.example: The electrician came to our house to fix the broken lights.
electrician.exampleZh: 电工来我们家修理坏掉的灯。

electricity.example: The storm cut off our electricity for two days last week.
electricity.exampleZh: 上周那场暴风雨让我们停电了两天。

electrify.example: The news of the accident electrified the whole town.
electrify.exampleZh: 事故的消息震惊了整个小镇。

electron.example: An electron is a very small part of every atom in the world.
electron.exampleZh: 电子是世界上每个原子中非常小的一部分。

electronic.example: I use an electronic dictionary to learn new English words every day.
electronic.exampleZh: 我每天用电子词典学习新的英语单词。

elegant.example: She wore an elegant dress to the party last night.
elegant.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条优雅的连衣裙去参加聚会。

element.example: Water is made of two elements, hydrogen and oxygen.
element.exampleZh: 水由两种元素组成，即氢和氧。

elementary.example: This book teaches elementary math to young children.
elementary.exampleZh: 这本书向年幼的孩子教授基础数学。

elephant.example: The elephant is very big and it drinks a lot of water.
elephant.exampleZh: 这头象非常大，它喝很多水。

elephantine.example: The old elephantine machine moved slowly across the factory floor.
elephantine.exampleZh: 那台老旧而笨重的机器缓慢地穿过工厂地板。

elevate.example: The teacher asked us to elevate the box above our heads.
elevate.exampleZh: 老师让我们把箱子举过头顶。

elevation.example: The village sits at an elevation of two thousand meters above the sea.
elevation.exampleZh: 这个村庄位于海拔两千米的高处。

elevator.example: She took the elevator to the tenth floor this morning.
elevator.exampleZh: 今天早上她乘电梯去了十楼。

elicit.example: The teacher asked several questions to elicit answers from the quiet students.
elicit.exampleZh: 老师问了几个问题，想从安静的学生那里引出答案。

eligible.example: Only students with good grades are eligible for this scholarship.
eligible.exampleZh: 只有成绩优秀的学生才有资格获得这项奖学金。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate the bad habits that waste our time every day.
eliminate.exampleZh: 我们必须消除那些每天浪费我们时间的坏习惯。

elite.example: The elite of the city gathered to discuss the new school plan.
elite.exampleZh: 这座城市的精英聚集在一起讨论新的学校计划。

elixir.example: The old story says this magic elixir can cure any illness.
elixir.exampleZh: 古老的传说中说这种神奇的灵丹妙药能治愈任何疾病。

elk.example: We saw a large elk near the lake during our trip.
elk.exampleZh: 我们在旅行途中看到一只大麋鹿在湖边。

ellipse.example: The teacher drew a perfect ellipse on the board with a piece of chalk.
ellipse.exampleZh: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上画了一个完美的椭圆。

ellipsis.example: The writer used an ellipsis to show that part of the sentence was left out.
ellipsis.exampleZh: 作者用了省略号来表示句子的一部分被省略了。

elm.example: An old elm stands beside the river and gives shade in summer.
elm.exampleZh: 一棵老榆树矗立在河边，夏天为人们提供阴凉。

elocution.example: Good elocution helps a speaker hold the attention of a large audience.
elocution.exampleZh: 良好的演说技巧有助于演讲者吸引大批听众的注意力。

elongate.example: The teacher asked us to elongate the rope so everyone could hold it.
elongate.exampleZh: 老师让我们把绳子拉长，这样每个人都能抓住它。

elope.example: The young couple decided to elope because their parents did not agree.
elope.exampleZh: 这对年轻情侣因为父母不同意而决定私奔。

eloquent.example: Her eloquent speech made everyone in the room believe her idea.
eloquent.exampleZh: 她雄辩的演讲让房间里的每个人都相信了她的想法。

else.example: Do you want anything else from the store today?
else.exampleZh: 你今天还想从商店买点别的什么吗？

elucidate.example: The teacher tried to elucidate the difficult rule with a simple example.
elucidate.exampleZh: 老师试着用一个简单的例子来阐明这条难懂的规则。

elude.example: The true meaning of the poem eludes most readers.
elude.exampleZh: 这首诗的真正含义让大多数读者无法理解。

elusive.example: The exact meaning of this old poem is still elusive to most readers.
elusive.exampleZh: 这首古诗的确切含义对大多数读者来说仍然难以捉摸。

elysium.example: In the old story, good people go to a peaceful elysium after death.
elysium.exampleZh: 在古老的故事里，好人死后会去一个安宁的极乐世界。

emaciated.example: The lost dog looked thin and emaciated after many days without food.
emaciated.exampleZh: 那只走失的狗在好几天没有食物后看起来又瘦又憔悴。

emanate.example: A warm light emanates from the small lamp on the desk.
emanate.exampleZh: 桌上那盏小灯散发出温暖的光。

emancipate.example: The new law will emancipate many workers from unfair old rules.
emancipate.exampleZh: 这项新法律将把许多工人从陈旧而不公平的规定中解放出来。

embankment.example: The river ran fast beside the high embankment.
embankment.exampleZh: 河水在高高的堤岸旁快速流过。

embargo.example: The government placed an embargo on oil exports last year.
embargo.exampleZh: 政府去年对石油出口实施了禁运。

embark.example: We will embark on a new project next Monday.
embark.exampleZh: 我们下周一将着手一个新项目。

embarrass.example: I did not want to embarrass him in front of his friends.
embarrass.exampleZh: 我不想在他的朋友面前让他难堪。

embassy.example: My uncle works at the embassy in Beijing.
embassy.exampleZh: 我叔叔在北京的大使馆工作。

embattled.example: The embattled team kept fighting even after losing its best player.
embattled.exampleZh: 这支身陷困境的球队即使失去了最好的球员，仍继续奋战。

embed.example: The teacher used songs to embed new words in the students' minds.
embed.exampleZh: 老师用歌曲把新单词深深印在学生们的脑海里。

embellish.example: She likes to embellish her stories with funny details.
embellish.exampleZh: 她喜欢用有趣的细节来润色她的故事。

embezzle.example: The manager tried to embezzle money from the company last year.
embezzle.exampleZh: 经理去年试图挪用公司的钱。

emblem.example: The white dove is a well-known emblem of peace.
emblem.exampleZh: 白鸽是众所周知的和平象征。

embody.example: Her daily actions embody the values that the whole team believes in.
embody.exampleZh: 她的日常行动体现了整个团队所信奉的价值观。

embrace.example: She smiled and gave her old friend a warm embrace.
embrace.exampleZh: 她微笑着，给了老朋友一个温暖的拥抱。

embryo.example: The embryo develops slowly inside the egg.

embryonic.example: The plan is still in an embryonic stage and needs much more work.
embryonic.exampleZh: 这个计划仍处于萌芽阶段，还需要做更多的工作。

emend.example: Scholars often emend old texts when they find clear errors.
emend.exampleZh: 学者们在发现明显错误时常常会校勘古老的文本。

emerald.example: The ring has a small emerald in the center.
emerald.exampleZh: 这枚戒指的中央镶着一颗小祖母绿。

emerge.example: After the rain, small flowers began to emerge from the wet soil.
emerge.exampleZh: 雨后，小花开始从湿润的土壤中出现。

emergence.example: The emergence of new ideas often changes the way we live.
emergence.exampleZh: 新想法的出现常常改变我们的生活方式。

emergency.example: Please call this number if there is an emergency at home.
emergency.exampleZh: 如果家里出现紧急情况，请拨打这个号码。

emigrant.example: My grandfather was an emigrant who left his small village for America.
emigrant.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位移居外国者，他离开小村庄去了美国。

emigrate.example: My uncle decided to emigrate to Canada with his family.
emigrate.exampleZh: 我叔叔决定和家人一起移居加拿大。

emigre.example: The emigre left his country and found a new home abroad.
emigre.exampleZh: 这位流亡者离开祖国，在国外找到了新的家。

eminent.example: She is an eminent scientist who has helped many young students.
eminent.exampleZh: 她是一位杰出的科学家，帮助过许多年轻学生。

emissary.example: The king sent an emissary to talk with the enemy.
emissary.exampleZh: 国王派了一位使者去与敌人谈判。

emit.example: The old factory emits thick black smoke into the air every morning.
emit.exampleZh: 那家旧工厂每天早上向空中排放浓黑烟。

emolument.example: The manager received a small emolument for his extra work.
emolument.exampleZh: 经理因额外工作得到了一笔小额报酬。

emotion.example: She could not hide her emotion when she heard the good news.
emotion.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她无法掩饰自己的情绪。

emotional.example: She felt very emotional when she said goodbye to her old friends.
emotional.exampleZh: 当她向老朋友们告别时，她感到非常情绪激动。

empathy.example: She showed great empathy for her friend's sadness.
empathy.exampleZh: 她对朋友的悲伤表现出极大的共情。

emperor.example: The emperor lived in a large palace with his family.
emperor.exampleZh: 皇帝和他的家人住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

emphasis.example: The teacher put great emphasis on reading every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 老师非常强调每天阅读。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the importance of reading every day at school.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师常常强调每天在学校阅读的重要性。

emphatic.example: She gave an emphatic no to the offer.
emphatic.exampleZh: 她断然拒绝了这个提议。

empire.example: The Roman empire was very large and lasted for many years.
empire.exampleZh: 罗马帝国非常庞大，延续了很多年。

empirical.example: The study gives empirical evidence that regular exercise improves sleep.
empirical.exampleZh: 这项研究提供了实证证据，表明经常锻炼能改善睡眠。

empiricism.example: Modern science depends on empiricism rather than on pure guesswork.
empiricism.exampleZh: 现代科学依靠经验主义，而非纯粹的猜测。

employ.example: The small shop employs three people and uses old machines.
employ.exampleZh: 这家小店雇了三个人，并且使用旧机器。

employee.example: The company gave every employee a new computer last week.
employee.exampleZh: 公司上周给每位员工发了一台新电脑。

employer.example: My employer gives us a short break every morning.
employer.exampleZh: 我的雇主每天早上给我们一段短暂的休息时间。

employment.example: She found employment at a small shop near her home.
employment.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一家小店找到了工作。

empower.example: This new tool will empower teachers to help every student learn better.
empower.exampleZh: 这个新工具将赋予教师权力，帮助他们让每个学生学得更好。

empty.example: He emptied the box and found it was completely empty.
empty.exampleZh: 他把箱子倒空后，发现里面完全是空的。

emulate.example: Many young players try to emulate their favorite stars on the court.
emulate.exampleZh: 许多年轻球员试图在球场上模仿他们最喜欢的球星。

enable.example: This new tool enables students to study at home easily.
enable.exampleZh: 这个新工具使学生能够在家轻松学习。

enact.example: The city will enact a new law to keep the streets clean.
enact.exampleZh: 这座城市将制定一项新法律来保持街道清洁。

enamel.example: The dentist said the enamel on my teeth is still strong and healthy.
enamel.exampleZh: 牙医说我的牙釉质仍然坚固健康。

enamor.example: Her gentle voice and kind smile enamored him at first sight.
enamor.exampleZh: 她温柔的声音和善良的微笑让他一见倾心。

enchant.example: The old story will enchant every child in the room.
enchant.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事会让房间里的每个孩子都陶醉。

encipher.example: They encipher the message before sending it to the other team.
encipher.exampleZh: 他们在把消息发送给另一个小组之前先将其译成密码。

enclave.example: This small village is an enclave inside the larger neighboring country.
enclave.exampleZh: 这个小村庄是位于较大邻国境内的一块飞地。

enclose.example: Please enclose your photo with the form.
enclose.exampleZh: 请随表格附上你的照片。

enclosure.example: The sheep were kept safe inside a small stone enclosure.
enclosure.exampleZh: 羊群被安全地关在一个小石围场里。

encode.example: You need to encode the message before you send it to your friend.
encode.exampleZh: 你需要先把这条信息编码，然后再发送给你的朋友。

encompass.example: Our new course encompasses both theory and hands-on practice.
encompass.exampleZh: 我们的新课程既包含理论，也包含实践操作。

encore.example: The happy crowd shouted for an encore after the final song.
encore.exampleZh: 最后一首歌结束后，开心的人群大声喊着要求加演。

encounter.example: We had a scary encounter with a bear in the forest.
encounter.exampleZh: 我们在森林里遭遇了一只熊，很吓人。

encourage.example: My parents always encourage me to try new things after school.
encourage.exampleZh: 我的父母总是鼓励我在放学后尝试新事物。

encroach.example: New buildings are beginning to encroach on the old farmland.
encroach.exampleZh: 新建筑开始侵占这片旧农田。

encumber.example: Heavy debts encumber many young families today.
encumber.exampleZh: 沉重的债务拖累着如今的许多年轻家庭。

encyclopedia.example: My grandfather keeps a big encyclopedia on the shelf in his study.
encyclopedia.exampleZh: 我爷爷在他的书房书架上放着一本大百科全书。

end.example: The meeting will end at five this afternoon.
end.exampleZh: 会议将在今天下午五点结束。

endanger.example: Pollution and hunting endanger many wild animals around the world.
endanger.exampleZh: 污染和捕猎危及世界上许多野生动物。

endear.example: His kind words and warm smile endear him to everyone.
endear.exampleZh: 他和善的话语和温暖的笑容让每个人都喜爱他。

endeavor.example: Her endeavor to learn English helped her find a better job.
endeavor.exampleZh: 她学习英语的努力帮助她找到了一份更好的工作。

endemic.example: This bird is endemic to the small island and lives nowhere else.
endemic.exampleZh: 这种鸟是该小岛特有的，在其他地方都见不到。

endless.example: The long road seemed endless as we walked through the desert.
endless.exampleZh: 当我们穿过沙漠时，那条长长的路似乎没有尽头。

endorse.example: Many famous players endorse sports shoes and clothes from big companies.
endorse.exampleZh: 许多著名运动员为大公司的运动鞋和服装代言。

endow.example: Her rich uncle decided to endow the small school with a new library.
endow.exampleZh: 她富有的叔叔决定捐赠给这所小学校一座新图书馆。

endurance.example: Long-distance running requires both physical endurance and a strong mind.
endurance.exampleZh: 长跑既需要身体耐力，也需要坚强的意志。

endure.example: She had to endure a lot of pain after the accident last year.
endure.exampleZh: 去年事故后她不得不忍受很多痛苦。

enemy.example: The soldiers fought bravely against a strong enemy in the mountains.
enemy.exampleZh: 士兵们在山里勇敢地对抗一支强大的敌军。

energy.example: I drink water after running because it gives me more energy.
energy.exampleZh: 我跑步后喝水，因为它给我更多能量。

enervate.example: The long illness seemed to enervate him and he rarely left his bed.
enervate.exampleZh: 这场漫长的疾病似乎使他衰弱，他很少离开床。

enforce.example: The school must enforce the new rules for all students.
enforce.exampleZh: 学校必须对所有学生强制执行这些新规定。

enfranchise.example: The new law will enfranchise millions of young people.
enfranchise.exampleZh: 新法律将赋予数百万年轻人选举权。

engage.example: She likes to engage in sports after school.
engage.exampleZh: 她喜欢放学后从事体育运动。

engagement.example: Their engagement was announced at a small family dinner last night.
engagement.exampleZh: 他们的订婚是在昨晚一次小型家庭晚餐上宣布的。

engender.example: Small acts of kindness often engender trust between people.
engender.exampleZh: 小小的善举常常会在人与人之间产生信任。

engine.example: The engine of my old car makes a strange noise every morning.
engine.exampleZh: 我那辆旧车的发动机每天早上都会发出奇怪的噪音。

engineer.example: My father is an engineer, and he designs bridges and roads.
engineer.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名工程师，他设计桥梁和道路。

engineering.example: My brother studies engineering at a large university in the north.
engineering.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方的一所大型大学学习工程学。

engrave.example: They will engrave her name on the wooden box.
engrave.exampleZh: 他们将在木盒上刻下她的名字。

engross.example: The interesting story engrossed the children and made them forget the time.
engross.exampleZh: 这个有趣的故事使孩子们全神贯注，忘记了时间。

engulf.example: Dark clouds engulfed the small town before the storm arrived.
engulf.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云吞没了这个小镇。

enhance.example: Good teachers use simple games to enhance student interest in learning English.
enhance.exampleZh: 好老师用简单的游戏来提高学生学习英语的兴趣。

enigma.example: The old man's silence was an enigma to everyone in the village.
enigma.exampleZh: 那位老人的沉默对村里的每个人来说都是个谜。

enjoin.example: The judge enjoined the company from dumping waste into the river.
enjoin.exampleZh: 法官命令该公司禁止向河中倾倒废物。

enjoy.example: I enjoy reading books with my sister every evening after dinner.
enjoy.exampleZh: 每天晚饭后我都喜欢和妹妹一起看书。

enlarge.example: We need to enlarge the photo before we put it on the wall.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们需要在把照片挂到墙上之前先把它放大。

enlighten.example: My teacher used a simple story to enlighten us about the value of honesty.
enlighten.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的故事启发我们认识诚实的价值。

enlist.example: The army tried to enlist young men from nearby villages.
enlist.exampleZh: 军队试图从附近村庄征募年轻男子。

enliven.example: Her funny stories always enliven the long meetings at work.
enliven.exampleZh: 她有趣的故事总能让冗长的工作会议变得生动活泼。

enmity.example: Years of unfair treatment created deep enmity between the two families.
enmity.exampleZh: 多年的不公平对待在两个家庭之间造成了深深的敌意。

ennui.example: After weeks of rain, a deep ennui settled over the small town.
ennui.exampleZh: 下了几周的雨后，一种深深的厌倦笼罩了这座小镇。

enormity.example: People were shocked by the enormity of the crime against the village.
enormity.exampleZh: 人们对针对这个村庄的罪行的穷凶极恶感到震惊。

enormous.example: The elephant is an enormous animal with very big ears.
enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种耳朵非常大的庞大动物。

enough.example: We have enough time to finish the work today.
enough.exampleZh: 我们今天有足够的时间完成这项工作。

enquire.example: I will enquire about the train times at the front desk.
enquire.exampleZh: 我会到前台询问火车时刻。

enrage.example: His rude words enraged the old man and made him walk away.
enrage.exampleZh: 他无礼的话激怒了那位老人，使他转身离开了。

enrich.example: Reading good books can enrich your life in many simple ways.
enrich.exampleZh: 读好书能在许多简单的方面丰富你的人生。

enroll.example: I want to enroll in the evening English class this fall.
enroll.exampleZh: 我想在今年秋天注册晚上的英语课。

ensconce.example: She ensconced herself in a soft chair by the window.
ensconce.exampleZh: 她安坐在窗边一张柔软的椅子上。

ensue.example: After the long drought, a serious food shortage ensued across the region.
ensue.exampleZh: 长期干旱之后，该地区随之出现了严重的粮食短缺。

ensure.example: Please ensure the door is locked before you leave.
ensure.exampleZh: 离开前请确保门已锁好。

entail.example: This new job will entail a lot of travel and long hours.
entail.exampleZh: 这份新工作需要大量出差和长时间工作。

entangle.example: The dolphin got entangled in the fishing net and could not swim away.
entangle.exampleZh: 那只海豚被渔网缠住，游不走了。

enter.example: Please knock before you enter the quiet room.
enter.exampleZh: 进入这个安静的房间前请先敲门。

enterprise.example: Starting a small enterprise takes hard work, patience and a clear plan.
enterprise.exampleZh: 创办一家小企业需要努力工作、耐心和清晰的计划。

entertain.example: They entertained their guests with music and good food all evening.
entertain.exampleZh: 他们整晚用音乐和美食招待客人。

entertainment.example: Watching movies is my favorite form of entertainment on weekends.
entertainment.exampleZh: 看电影是我周末最喜欢的娱乐方式。

enthrall.example: The little girl was enthralled by the magic show at the party.
enthrall.exampleZh: 那个小女孩被派对上的魔术表演迷住了。

enthuse.example: She enthused about the new project and talked to everyone at the office.
enthuse.exampleZh: 她热情地谈论这个新项目，并和办公室里的每个人都说了一遍。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for music made everyone in the class want to learn to play.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让班上每个人都想学着演奏乐器。

enthusiastic.example: She is very enthusiastic about her new job at the small library.
enthusiastic.exampleZh: 她对在小图书馆的这份新工作非常热情。

entice.example: They tried to entice the children with free candy.
entice.exampleZh: 他们试图用免费糖果引诱孩子们。

entire.example: She spent the entire day cleaning her small house.
entire.exampleZh: 她花了一整天打扫她的小房子。

entitle.example: This ticket entitles you to one free drink at the bar.
entitle.exampleZh: 这张票让你有权在酒吧免费享用一杯饮品。

entity.example: Each entity in the system has its own name and record.
entity.exampleZh: 系统中的每个实体都有自己的名称和记录。

entomology.example: She studies entomology because she has always loved insects.
entomology.exampleZh: 她学习昆虫学，因为她一直喜爱昆虫。

entourage.example: The famous singer traveled with a large entourage of guards and assistants.
entourage.exampleZh: 这位著名歌手带着大批保镖和助理随行。

entrails.example: The old story says the hunter buried the animal's entrails deep in the ground.
entrails.exampleZh: 古老的故事说，猎人把动物的内脏深埋在地里。

entrance.example: We waited for our friends at the main entrance of the school.
entrance.exampleZh: 我们在学校正门入口处等我们的朋友。

entrap.example: The police tried to entrap him with a fake offer.
entrap.exampleZh: 警方试图用一个虚假的提议诱捕他。

entreat.example: She had to entreat her boss for one more day off.
entreat.exampleZh: 她不得不恳求老板再给她一天假。

entrepreneur.example: The young entrepreneur started a small company in his home city.
entrepreneur.exampleZh: 这位年轻的企业家在他的家乡城市创办了一家小公司。

entropy.example: The messy room showed how quickly entropy grows when no one cleans.
entropy.exampleZh: 这个凌乱的房间表明，没人打扫时混乱会增长得多快。

entry.example: The guard checked every entry in the visitor log before noon.
entry.exampleZh: 保安在中午前检查了访客登记簿上的每一条记录。

enumerate.example: She began to enumerate the reasons why the plan would not work.
enumerate.exampleZh: 她开始列举这个计划行不通的原因。

enunciate.example: Please enunciate your words clearly so everyone in the room can understand you.
enunciate.exampleZh: 请把话说清楚，让房间里的每个人都能听懂。

envelop.example: Dark clouds slowly envelop the small town before the storm arrives.
envelop.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云慢慢笼罩了这座小镇。

envelope.example: She put the letter in a white envelope and mailed it.
envelope.exampleZh: 她把信放进一个白色的信封里，然后寄了出去。

enviable.example: She has an enviable job that lets her travel around the world.
enviable.exampleZh: 她有一份令人羡慕的工作，可以让她环游世界。

envious.example: She felt envious when her friend got a new bike.
envious.exampleZh: 朋友得到一辆新自行车时，她感到羡慕。

environment.example: We must protect the environment for our children and grandchildren.
environment.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。

environmental.example: We should all help protect the environmental health of our city.
environmental.exampleZh: 我们都应该帮助保护我们城市的环境健康。

envisage.example: We envisage a bright future for the small town.
envisage.exampleZh: 我们设想这个小镇有一个光明的未来。

envision.example: We envision a future where everyone has clean water.
envision.exampleZh: 我们展望一个人人都能用上清洁水源的未来。

envoy.example: The king sent an envoy to the neighboring country to discuss peace.
envoy.exampleZh: 国王派了一位使节前往邻国商讨和平。

envy.example: She felt envy when she saw her friend's new car.
envy.exampleZh: 她看到朋友的新车时感到羡慕。

enzyme.example: Enzymes in our stomach help break down food into smaller pieces.
enzyme.exampleZh: 我们胃里的酶帮助把食物分解成更小的部分。

eon.example: It felt like an eon before the bus finally arrived.
eon.exampleZh: 感觉过了极漫长的一段时间，公交车才终于到站。

ephemeral.example: The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral, lasting only a few days each spring.
ephemeral.exampleZh: 樱花之美是短暂的，每个春天只持续几天。

epic.example: The old movie is an epic about a long journey home.
epic.exampleZh: 这部老电影是一部关于漫长归乡之旅的史诗。

epicenter.example: The earthquake's epicenter was deep under the sea near the small island.
epicenter.exampleZh: 这次地震的震中位于那座小岛附近的海底深处。

epidemic.example: The flu epidemic spread quickly through the small town last winter.
epidemic.exampleZh: 去年冬天，流感疫情在那个小镇上迅速蔓延。

epidermis.example: The epidermis is the thin outer layer of your skin.
epidermis.exampleZh: 表皮是皮肤薄薄的外层。

epigram.example: My grandfather likes to end every speech with a short, funny epigram.
epigram.exampleZh: 我祖父喜欢在每次演讲结尾说一句简短有趣的警句。

epilogue.example: The epilogue of the novel tells us what happened to the hero years later.
epilogue.exampleZh: 小说的尾声告诉我们主人公多年以后的遭遇。

episode.example: That funny episode happened during our first year at college.
episode.exampleZh: 那段有趣的插曲发生在我们大学一年级的时候。

epitaph.example: The old stone epitaph on his grave is hard to read now.
epitaph.exampleZh: 他墓碑上那块古老的墓志铭现在已经很难辨认了。

epithet.example: The king earned the epithet the Bold after winning many battles.
epithet.exampleZh: 这位国王在赢得许多战役后获得了“勇者”的称号。

epitome.example: The small town is the epitome of a quiet, friendly community.
epitome.exampleZh: 这个小镇是安静友善社区的缩影。

equable.example: Her equable temper makes her easy to work with.
equable.exampleZh: 她温和的性情使她很容易相处。

equal.example: Her score is equal to mine, so we share the first prize.
equal.exampleZh: 她的分数和我相等，所以我们共享一等奖。

equality.example: The new law aims to give all people equality at work and in school.
equality.exampleZh: 这项新法律旨在为所有人提供在工作和学校中的平等。

equanimity.example: She faced the bad news with equanimity and kept working calmly.
equanimity.exampleZh: 她平静地面对这个坏消息，继续镇定地工作。

equation.example: This equation is hard, so I need help with it.
equation.exampleZh: 这个方程式很难，所以我需要人帮忙。

equator.example: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
equator.exampleZh: 赤道是环绕地球中部的一条假想线。

equilibrium.example: The market slowly found its equilibrium after the big price change.
equilibrium.exampleZh: 价格大幅变动后，市场慢慢找到了平衡。

equip.example: We equip every new student with a laptop and a study guide.
equip.exampleZh: 我们为每位新生配备一台笔记本电脑和一本学习指南。

equipment.example: Our new office has modern equipment for every worker.
equipment.exampleZh: 我们的新办公室为每位员工配备了现代化的设备。

equitable.example: The teacher tried to make the rules fair and equitable for every student.
equitable.exampleZh: 老师努力让规则对每个学生都公平公正。

equity.example: The company treats all its workers with equity and respect.
equity.exampleZh: 公司以公平和尊重对待所有员工。

equivalent.example: Ten dollars is equivalent to about seventy yuan in today's market.
equivalent.exampleZh: 按今天的市场行情，十美元约等于七十元人民币。

equivocal.example: His answer was equivocal, so nobody knew what he really planned to do.
equivocal.exampleZh: 他的回答模棱两可，所以没人知道他到底打算做什么。

equivocate.example: He always equivocates when I ask him about his real plans.
equivocate.exampleZh: 每当我问他真正的计划时，他总是含糊其辞。

era.example: The Internet began a new era in how people share information.
era.exampleZh: 互联网开启了人们分享信息的新时代。

erase.example: Please erase the wrong answer and write the correct one again.
erase.exampleZh: 请擦掉错误的答案，然后重新写正确的。

erect.example: They will erect a new school building on the empty land.
erect.exampleZh: 他们将在那片空地上建造一座新教学楼。

erode.example: Heavy rain can erode the soil on the hill over time.
erode.exampleZh: 大雨会随着时间侵蚀山上的土壤。

erosion.example: Wind and rain caused serious erosion of the soil on the hill.
erosion.exampleZh: 风雨造成了山上土壤的严重侵蚀。

err.example: Everyone can err, so please check your answers before you hand them in.
err.exampleZh: 每个人都会犯错，所以请在交卷前检查你的答案。

errand.example: My mother asked me to run an errand for her this morning.
errand.exampleZh: 今天早上我妈妈让我帮她跑一趟腿。

errant.example: The errant dog wandered far from home and could not find its way back.
errant.exampleZh: 那只迷途的狗走得很远，找不到回家的路。

erroneous.example: His erroneous answer made the whole class laugh.
erroneous.exampleZh: 他错误的答案让全班都笑了。

error.example: This small error made the whole team work late again.
error.exampleZh: 这个小小的错误让整个团队又加班到很晚。

erudite.example: The erudite professor explained the ancient story in a simple way.
erudite.exampleZh: 这位博学的教授用简单的方式解释了那个古老的故事。

erupt.example: The volcano could erupt at any time, so the villagers left their homes.
erupt.exampleZh: 火山随时可能喷发，因此村民们离开了家。

escalate.example: The small argument escalated into a serious fight between the two teams.
escalate.exampleZh: 这场小争论升级成了两个团队之间的严重冲突。

escape.example: The little cat escaped from the room through an open window last night.
escape.exampleZh: 昨晚那只小猫从敞开的窗户逃出了房间。

eschew.example: Many young people eschew fast food and cook at home.
eschew.exampleZh: 许多年轻人避开快餐，选择在家做饭。

escort.example: Two police officers agreed to escort her safely to the station.
escort.exampleZh: 两名警察同意护送她安全到达车站。

esoteric.example: The old book was too esoteric for most readers to understand.
esoteric.exampleZh: 这本旧书太深奥了，大多数读者都看不懂。

especially.example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in summer.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橘子。

espionage.example: The police caught two men and charged them with espionage.
espionage.exampleZh: 警方抓获了两名男子，并指控他们从事间谍活动。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her summer holiday for the class.
essay.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一篇关于暑假的短文。

essence.example: The essence of her idea is simple and easy to understand.
essence.exampleZh: 她这个想法的本质很简单，容易理解。

essential.example: Clean water is essential for good health and daily life.
essential.exampleZh: 干净的水对健康和日常生活是必不可少的。

establish.example: The two companies agreed to establish a new rules committee last week.
establish.exampleZh: 这两家公司上周同意成立一个新的规则委员会。

establishment.example: The establishment of the new school took two years.
establishment.exampleZh: 这所新学校的建立花了两年时间。

estate.example: His family owns a large estate in the north.
estate.exampleZh: 他家在北方拥有一座大庄园。

esteem.example: Good teachers are held in high esteem by their students and parents.
esteem.exampleZh: 优秀的老师受到学生和家长的高度敬重。

estimate.example: I estimate that the trip will take about three hours by train.
estimate.exampleZh: 我估计这趟旅行坐火车大约需要三个小时。

estrange.example: His long silence did not estrange him from his old friends.
estrange.exampleZh: 长久的沉默并没有使他与老朋友疏远。

eternal.example: Their eternal love for each other never changed over the years.
eternal.exampleZh: 多年来，他们彼此之间永恒的爱从未改变。

ether.example: Doctors once used ether to help patients sleep during an operation.
ether.exampleZh: 医生过去用乙醚帮助病人在手术中入睡。

ethic.example: A strong work ethic helps people succeed in almost any job.
ethic.exampleZh: 强烈的职业道德能帮助人们在几乎任何工作中取得成功。

ethical.example: It is not ethical to share a friend's private messages without asking.
ethical.exampleZh: 未经询问就分享朋友的私人消息是不道德的。

ethics.example: She studies ethics at university and wants to become a teacher.
ethics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习伦理学，并且想成为一名教师。

ethnic.example: People from many ethnic groups live together in this city.
ethnic.exampleZh: 许多不同民族的人共同生活在这座城市里。

etiquette.example: Good etiquette means saying please and thank you to other people.
etiquette.exampleZh: 良好的礼仪意味着对他人说请和谢谢。

evacuate.example: The teachers helped the children evacuate the school quickly.
evacuate.exampleZh: 老师们帮助孩子们迅速撤离了学校。

evade.example: You cannot evade the truth forever, so tell us what happened.
evade.exampleZh: 你不能永远逃避真相，所以告诉我们发生了什么。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate students' work at the end of each term.
evaluate.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评估学生的作业。

evanescent.example: The beauty of the sunset was evanescent and soon faded away.
evanescent.exampleZh: 日落的美是短暂易逝的，很快就消失了。

evaporate.example: The water in the pot will evaporate quickly under the hot sun.
evaporate.exampleZh: 锅里的水在烈日下会很快蒸发。

evasive.example: His evasive answer made everyone in the room feel even more confused.
evasive.exampleZh: 他躲闪的回答让屋里的每个人都更加困惑了。

even.example: The table is even, so the cup stays still.
even.exampleZh: 桌子是平的，所以杯子放得很稳。

event.example: The school sports event was great fun for all the students.
event.exampleZh: 这次学校体育比赛对所有学生来说都很有意思。

eventually.example: The rain stopped and the sun eventually came out in the afternoon.
eventually.exampleZh: 雨停了，下午太阳终于出来了。

ever.example: This is the best cake I have ever eaten.
ever.exampleZh: 这是我吃过的最好吃的蛋糕。

evict.example: The landlord tried to evict the family from the small apartment.
evict.exampleZh: 房东试图把这家人从这间小公寓里赶出去。

evidence.example: The police found no evidence that he was at the scene.
evidence.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他在现场的证据。

evident.example: It is evident that she works very hard every day.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，她每天都工作得很努力。

evince.example: Her smile evinced a quiet confidence that made everyone feel at ease.
evince.exampleZh: 她的微笑表现出一种安静的自信，让每个人都感到自在。

evocative.example: The old song is evocative of my happy childhood summers.
evocative.exampleZh: 这首老歌让我回想起童年那些快乐的夏天。

evoke.example: The old song can evoke happy memories of my childhood.
evoke.exampleZh: 那首老歌能唤起我对童年的快乐回忆。

evolution.example: The evolution of language takes many years and many small changes.
evolution.exampleZh: 语言的演变需要很多年以及许多微小的变化。

evolve.example: Small changes in our habits can evolve into big results over time.
evolve.exampleZh: 我们习惯中的小改变会随着时间逐步发展成大成果。

ewe.example: The farmer kept one old ewe and two young lambs in the field.
ewe.exampleZh: 农夫把一只老母羊和两只小羊羔养在田里。

exact.example: Please tell me the exact time of your train tomorrow.
exact.exampleZh: 请告诉我你明天火车的确切时间。

exaggerate.example: Don't exaggerate the danger; the trip is actually quite safe.
exaggerate.exampleZh: 别夸大危险，这次旅行其实相当安全。

exalt.example: The teacher wanted to exalt hard work, not just talent.
exalt.exampleZh: 老师想赞扬努力，而不仅仅是天赋。

examine.example: The doctor will examine your eyes and ask you a few questions.
examine.exampleZh: 医生会检查你的眼睛，并问你几个问题。

example.example: Her good grades are a fine example for the younger students.
example.exampleZh: 她的好成绩是低年级学生的好榜样。

exasperate.example: His endless questions began to exasperate the tired teacher.
exasperate.exampleZh: 他无休止的问题开始激怒这位疲惫的老师。

excavate.example: Workers began to excavate the old site early this morning.
excavate.exampleZh: 工人们今天一早开始挖掘这处旧遗址。

exceed.example: His score exceeded everyone's expectations and he won the first prize.
exceed.exampleZh: 他的分数超出了所有人的预期，他赢得了一等奖。

exceedingly.example: The exam was exceedingly hard, so most students could not finish it.
exceedingly.exampleZh: 这场考试极其难，所以大多数学生没能做完。

excel.example: She works hard and excels at math in school.
excel.exampleZh: 她学习努力，在学校里擅长数学。

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher who always helps her students.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位优秀的老师，总是帮助她的学生。

except.example: Everyone was tired except Tom, who wanted to keep playing.
except.exampleZh: 除了汤姆，大家都累了，而他还想继续玩。

exception.example: There is one exception to this rule for very young children.
exception.exampleZh: 对非常年幼的孩子来说，这条规则有一个例外。

exceptional.example: Her work on the project was exceptional, and everyone praised her effort.
exceptional.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上的表现非常杰出，大家都称赞她的努力。

excerpt.example: The teacher read a short excerpt from the novel to the class.
excerpt.exampleZh: 老师给全班朗读了这部小说的一个简短节选。

excess.example: Too much sugar in food can cause an excess of energy in children.
excess.exampleZh: 食物中糖分过多会导致儿童能量过剩。

excessive.example: The teacher said that excessive noise in the classroom makes it hard to learn.
excessive.exampleZh: 老师说教室里过度的噪音会让人难以学习。

exchange.example: I exchange my old books with my friend at school.
exchange.exampleZh: 我在学校和我的朋友交换旧书。

excise.example: The doctor had to excise the small lump from his arm.
excise.exampleZh: 医生不得不从他手臂上切除那个小肿块。

excite.example: The good news excited all the children in the small room.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息让小屋里的所有孩子都很兴奋。

exclaim.example: She looked at the gift and exclaimed with joy at how beautiful it was.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看着礼物，惊喜地呼喊它多么漂亮。

exclude.example: Please do not exclude her from the game today.
exclude.exampleZh: 请不要把她排除在今天的游戏之外。

exclusive.example: This club is exclusive and only a few rich people can join it.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这家俱乐部很排外，只有少数有钱人才能加入。

excrete.example: Plants excrete water through their leaves on hot days.
excrete.exampleZh: 植物在炎热的天气里通过叶子排出水分。

excruciating.example: Waiting for the test results was an excruciating experience for the whole family.
excruciating.exampleZh: 等待检查结果对全家人来说是一段极其痛苦的经历。

excursion.example: Our class went on a short excursion to the nearby museum last Friday.
excursion.exampleZh: 上周五我们班去附近的博物馆进行了一次短途旅行。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late today.

execute.example: The team will execute the plan next week.
execute.exampleZh: 团队将在下周执行这个计划。

executive.example: The executive made a short speech at the meeting today.
executive.exampleZh: 这位执行官今天在会上做了简短的发言。

exempt.example: The school exempts poor students from paying the fee.
exempt.exampleZh: 学校免除贫困学生的费用。

exercise.example: Daily exercise helps you stay healthy and think more clearly.
exercise.exampleZh: 每天锻炼有助于你保持健康、思路更清晰。

exert.example: Teachers exert a strong influence on how students think and behave.
exert.exampleZh: 老师对学生的思考方式和行为举止有很大的影响。

exhale.example: Take a slow breath in, then exhale gently through your mouth.
exhale.exampleZh: 慢慢吸气，然后通过嘴巴轻轻呼气。

exhaust.example: The long run exhausted him, and he needed a rest.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长跑使他筋疲力尽，他需要休息一下。

exhibit.example: Many students exhibit their art in the school hall every spring.
exhibit.exampleZh: 许多学生每年春天都在学校大厅展出他们的艺术作品。

exhibition.example: The art exhibition in the city museum is free for students.
exhibition.exampleZh: 市博物馆里的艺术展览对学生免费。

exhilarate.example: The good news exhilarated the whole team and made everyone smile.
exhilarate.exampleZh: 这个好消息让整个团队都很兴奋，每个人都笑了。

exhort.example: My father often exhorts me to study harder and never give up.
exhort.exampleZh: 父亲常常劝诫我要更努力学习，绝不放弃。

exile.example: After many years of exile, he finally returned to his home country.
exile.exampleZh: 流亡多年后，他终于回到了自己的祖国。

exist.example: Many people believe that life may exist on other planets in space.
exist.exampleZh: 许多人相信太空中其他星球上可能存在生命。

existence.example: Many people still doubt the existence of life on other planets.
existence.exampleZh: 许多人仍然怀疑其他星球上是否存在生命。

exit.example: Please use the back exit when you leave the building tonight.
exit.exampleZh: 今晚离开大楼时，请走后门出口。

exodus.example: The war caused a mass exodus of families from the small town.
exodus.exampleZh: 战争导致大批家庭从小镇离去。

exonerate.example: The new video evidence helped exonerate the young man after ten long years.
exonerate.exampleZh: 新的视频证据帮助这个年轻人在漫长的十年后洗清罪名。

exorbitant.example: The hotel charges exorbitant prices for a simple cup of coffee.
exorbitant.exampleZh: 这家酒店一杯简单的咖啡就要价过高。

exotic.example: She took many photos of exotic flowers in the garden.
exotic.exampleZh: 她在花园里拍了很多异国花卉的照片。

expand.example: We plan to expand our small business and hire more local workers.
expand.exampleZh: 我们计划扩大我们的小生意，并雇用更多本地工人。

expanse.example: The children ran across the wide expanse of green grass.
expanse.exampleZh: 孩子们跑过那片广阔的绿草地。

expansion.example: The fast expansion of the city brought new roads and many jobs.
expansion.exampleZh: 城市的快速扩张带来了新的道路和许多就业机会。

expatriate.example: Many expatriates in this city meet every Friday to share stories about home.
expatriate.exampleZh: 这座城市里的许多移居国外者每周五聚会，分享关于家乡的故事。

expect.example: I expect my sister to call me after she finishes work today.
expect.exampleZh: 我期待我妹妹今天下班后给我打电话。

expectation.example: My parents have high expectations for me, but I just want to be happy.
expectation.exampleZh: 父母对我期望很高，但我只想快乐地生活。

expedient.example: The old bridge was only an expedient fix until the new one opened.
expedient.exampleZh: 那座旧桥只是在新桥开通前的权宜之计。

expedite.example: The new online system will expedite the approval process for all students.
expedite.exampleZh: 新的在线系统将加快所有学生的审批流程。

expedition.example: The expedition reached the top of the mountain after ten long days.
expedition.exampleZh: 这支探险队在漫长的十天后到达了山顶。

expel.example: The school may expel students who break the rules again.
expel.exampleZh: 学校可能会开除再次违反规定的学生。

expend.example: We expend a lot of time and energy on this project every day.
expend.exampleZh: 我们每天在这个项目上花费大量的时间和精力。

expense.example: The trip was expensive, but the expense was worth it.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行花费不小，但这笔开支是值得的。

expensive.example: This watch is too expensive for me to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这块手表太贵了，我买不起。

experience.example: She has a lot of experience in teaching young children English.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教幼儿英语方面有丰富的经验。

experiment.example: The students did a simple experiment to see how plants grow.
experiment.exampleZh: 学生们做了一个简单的实验，观察植物如何生长。

experimental.example: This experimental drug may help patients who have no other good choices.
experimental.exampleZh: 这种实验性药物可能会帮助那些没有其他好选择的病人。

expert.example: She is an expert in computer science and teaches at the university.
expert.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的专家，在大学任教。

expertise.example: She has strong expertise in computer science.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在计算机科学方面有很强的专长。

expire.example: My passport will expire at the end of this year.
expire.exampleZh: 我的护照将在今年年底到期。

explain.example: Can you explain this word to me in simple English?
explain.exampleZh: 你能用简单的英语给我解释一下这个词吗？

explanation.example: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the rule to the class.
explanation.exampleZh: 老师向全班清楚地解释了这条规则。

explicit.example: She gave explicit instructions before she left the office.
explicit.exampleZh: 她离开办公室前给出了明确的指示。

explode.example: The old car exploded with a loud noise near our school.
explode.exampleZh: 那辆旧汽车在我们学校附近随着一声巨响爆炸了。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit poor workers to make more money.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司剥削贫穷的工人来赚更多的钱。

exploration.example: Space exploration helps us learn more about the planets and stars.
exploration.exampleZh: 太空探索帮助我们更多地了解行星和恒星。

explore.example: We plan to explore the old forest behind our school this summer.
explore.exampleZh: 我们打算今年夏天去探索学校后面的那片古老森林。

explosion.example: The explosion broke every window in the old school building.
explosion.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了那栋旧校舍的所有窗户。

explosive.example: The workers found old explosive devices near the road and called the police.
explosive.exampleZh: 工人们在路边发现了旧的爆炸装置，然后报了警。

exponent.example: She is a strong exponent of clean energy in her town.
exponent.exampleZh: 她是她所在小镇清洁能源的有力倡导者。

export.example: Our country exports a lot of rice to other countries every year.
export.exampleZh: 我们国家每年向其他国家出口大量大米。

expose.example: He did not want to expose his fear to the other students.
expose.exampleZh: 他不想在其他学生面前暴露自己的恐惧。

exposition.example: The art exposition in our city showed paintings by many young artists.
exposition.exampleZh: 我们城市的艺术博览会展示了许多年轻艺术家的画作。

exposure.example: Too much exposure to the sun can harm your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 过多暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

expound.example: The teacher expounded the main idea clearly and simply to the class.
expound.exampleZh: 老师清晰而简单地向全班阐述了主要观点。

express.example: She expressed her thanks to the kind driver on the express train.
express.exampleZh: 她在快车上向那位好心的司机表达了感谢。

expression.example: Her sad expression told me that something was very wrong.
expression.exampleZh: 她悲伤的表情告诉我，出事了。

expulsion.example: The school announced his expulsion after he broke the rules three times.
expulsion.exampleZh: 他三次违反规定后，学校宣布将他开除。

expunge.example: The school agreed to expunge the bad record from his file.
expunge.exampleZh: 学校同意从他的档案中删除那条不良记录。

exquisite.example: She wore an exquisite dress to the party last night.
exquisite.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条精美的裙子去参加聚会。

extant.example: Only a few extant copies of this old book remain today.
extant.exampleZh: 这本古书如今只剩几本现存的副本。

extend.example: They plan to extend the meeting by one hour tomorrow afternoon.
extend.exampleZh: 他们计划明天下午把会议延长一个小时。

extension.example: She asked for an extension of the deadline because she needed more time.
extension.exampleZh: 她申请延长截止日期，因为她需要更多时间。

extensive.example: She has extensive knowledge of local plants and animals.
extensive.exampleZh: 她对当地的动植物有广泛的了解。

extent.example: I was surprised by the extent of the damage to the old house.
extent.exampleZh: 那座老房子受损的程度让我感到吃惊。

exterior.example: The exterior of the old house looks very clean and bright.
exterior.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外部看起来非常干净明亮。

external.example: The external walls of the old house need a fresh coat of paint.
external.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外墙需要重新刷一层漆。

extinct.example: Many kinds of animals became extinct because people cut down their forests.
extinct.exampleZh: 许多种动物因为人类砍伐森林而灭绝了。

extinction.example: Many animals face extinction because people are cutting down their forests.
extinction.exampleZh: 许多动物面临灭绝，因为人们正在砍伐它们的森林。

extinguish.example: The firefighters worked hard to extinguish the fire before midnight.
extinguish.exampleZh: 消防员们努力在午夜前把火扑灭。

extol.example: The teacher often extols the value of hard work and kindness.
extol.exampleZh: 老师常常颂扬努力和善良的价值。

extort.example: The man tried to extort money from his old boss.
extort.exampleZh: 那个男人试图向他的老上司勒索钱财。

extra.example: She paid extra for a bigger room with a nice view.
extra.exampleZh: 她额外付钱换了一间景观更好的大房间。

extract.example: She used a small tool to extract the juice from the lemon.
extract.exampleZh: 她用一个小工具从柠檬中提取果汁。

extracurricular.example: My extracurricular activities include the school band and the chess club.
extracurricular.exampleZh: 我的课外活动包括校乐队和国际象棋社。

extradite.example: The police want to extradite the thief from another country.
extradite.exampleZh: 警方想把那名窃贼从另一个国家引渡回来。

extraneous.example: The editor removed all extraneous words from the short report.
extraneous.exampleZh: 编辑删掉了这份简短报告里所有无关的词语。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary voice and sings in front of thousands of people.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她有一副非凡的嗓音，能在成千上万人面前演唱。

extrapolate.example: Scientists extrapolate future climate trends from many years of weather data.
extrapolate.exampleZh: 科学家根据多年的天气数据推断未来的气候趋势。

extraterrestrial.example: Scientists are still searching for signals from extraterrestrial life in space.
extraterrestrial.exampleZh: 科学家们仍在太空中寻找外星生命的信号。

extravagant.example: She thinks his expensive car is a bit too extravagant.
extravagant.exampleZh: 她觉得他那辆昂贵的汽车有点太奢侈了。

extreme.example: This winter has brought extreme cold and heavy snow to our city.
extreme.exampleZh: 今年冬天给我们城市带来了极度的寒冷和大雪。

extremely.example: The math test was extremely hard, so I finished it very slowly.
extremely.exampleZh: 这次数学考试极其难，所以我做得很慢。

extricate.example: He tried to extricate himself from the difficult situation at work.
extricate.exampleZh: 他试图让自己从工作中的困境中解脱出来。

extrinsic.example: Money is an extrinsic reward that does not always bring real happiness.
extrinsic.exampleZh: 金钱是一种外在的奖励，并不总能带来真正的幸福。

extrovert.example: My sister is an extrovert who loves talking to new people at parties.
extrovert.exampleZh: 我妹妹是个外向的人，喜欢在聚会上和新认识的人聊天。

exuberant.example: The children were exuberant when they saw the snow outside.
exuberant.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面的雪时兴高采烈。

exude.example: Her face exuded confidence as she walked slowly onto the stage.
exude.exampleZh: 当她慢慢走上舞台时，脸上流露出自信。

exult.example: The children exulted when they saw the first snow of winter.
exult.exampleZh: 孩子们看到冬天的第一场雪时欢欣鼓舞。

eye.example: Please look me in the eye and tell me the truth.
eye.exampleZh: 请看着我的眼睛，对我说实话。

eyewitness.example: The police asked the eyewitness to describe the man she saw.
eyewitness.exampleZh: 警方请这位目击者描述她所看到的那名男子。

fable.example: My grandmother told me an old fable about a clever fox.
fable.exampleZh: 我的祖母给我讲了一个关于聪明狐狸的古老寓言。

fabric.example: The soft fabric of this shirt feels very comfortable on my skin.
fabric.exampleZh: 这件衬衫的柔软布料贴在我的皮肤上感觉很舒服。

fabricate.example: He tried to fabricate a story about the missing money.
fabricate.exampleZh: 他试图编造一个关于那笔失踪的钱的故事。

fabulous.example: We had a fabulous time at the beach with our friends.
fabulous.exampleZh: 我们和朋友们在海滩度过了一段极好的时光。

facade.example: Behind his friendly facade, he was actually a very shy man.
facade.exampleZh: 在友善的外表背后，他其实是个非常害羞的人。

face.example: She washed her face and went to work.
face.exampleZh: 她洗了脸，然后去上班了。

facet.example: This problem has another facet that we have not yet discussed.
facet.exampleZh: 这个问题还有另一个方面，我们尚未讨论。

facetious.example: His facetious answer made everyone laugh during the serious meeting.
facetious.exampleZh: 在严肃的会议上，他那个不严肃的回答让大家都笑了。

facial.example: She has a gentle facial treatment at the spa every month.
facial.exampleZh: 她每个月都在水疗中心做一次温和的面部护理。

facile.example: His facile answer to the hard question showed that he had not thought about it.
facile.exampleZh: 他对这个难题的轻率回答表明他并没有认真思考过。

facilitate.example: Good roads facilitate trade between small towns and big cities.
facilitate.exampleZh: 良好的道路促进了小城镇与大 cidades 之间的贸易。

facility.example: The new sports facility is open to all students after school.
facility.exampleZh: 这个新的体育设施在放学后向所有学生开放。

fact.example: The fact is that we need more time to finish this work.
fact.exampleZh: 事实是我们需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

faction.example: The small faction inside the party wants a new leader.
faction.exampleZh: 党内这个小派系想要一位新领袖。

factor.example: Money is an important factor when choosing a new job.
factor.exampleZh: 在选择新工作时，金钱是一个重要的因素。

factory.example: My father works in a large car factory near our home.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近一家大型汽车工厂工作。

factual.example: Please give me a factual report about what happened yesterday.
factual.exampleZh: 请给我一份关于昨天所发生事情的、基于事实的报告。

faculty.example: The faculty voted to change the exam rules for all first-year students.
faculty.exampleZh: 全体教员投票决定修改所有一年级学生的考试规则。

fad.example: Many people think this new diet is just a fad.
fad.exampleZh: 许多人认为这种新饮食方式只是一时的风尚。

fade.example: The bright curtain will fade in the strong summer sun.
fade.exampleZh: 那块色彩鲜艳的窗帘在强烈的夏日阳光下会褪色。

fail.example: Many students fail the test because they never study at home.
fail.exampleZh: 许多学生考试不及格，因为他们从不在家学习。

failure.example: His first attempt ended in failure, but he never gave up trying.
failure.exampleZh: 他的第一次尝试以失败告终，但他从未放弃尝试。

faint.example: She felt faint after standing in the hot sun for an hour.
faint.exampleZh: 她在烈日下站了一个小时后感到头晕眼花。

fair.example: It is not fair to blame the whole team for one small mistake.
fair.exampleZh: 因为一个小错误就责怪整个团队是不公平的。

fairly.example: She speaks English fairly well for someone who started last year.
fairly.exampleZh: 对于去年才开始学的人来说，她的英语说得相当好。

fairy.example: The little girl believes a fairy lives in her garden.
fairy.exampleZh: 这个小女孩相信花园里住着一位仙女。

faith.example: I have faith in my team and in our plan.
faith.exampleZh: 我对我的团队和我们的计划有信心。

faithful.example: My dog is a faithful friend who waits for me every day.
faithful.exampleZh: 我的狗是一位忠实的朋友，每天都等着我。

fake.example: He tried to fake a smile when he heard the bad news.
fake.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息时，他试图假装笑一下。

falcon.example: The falcon flew high above the trees and then dived down quickly.
falcon.exampleZh: 那只猎鹰飞到树梢上方高处，然后迅速俯冲下来。

fall.example: In autumn, leaves fall from the trees and cover the ground.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶从树上落下，铺满地面。

fallacy.example: It is a fallacy to think that money always brings happiness.
fallacy.exampleZh: 认为金钱总能带来幸福是一种谬误。

fallout.example: The fallout from the accident made many people afraid to leave their homes.
fallout.exampleZh: 事故的余波让许多人不敢离开家。

fallow.example: The farmer let the field stay fallow for a year.
fallow.exampleZh: 农夫让这块地休耕了一年。

false.example: This answer is false, so please try again.
false.exampleZh: 这个答案是错误的，所以请再试一次。

falsify.example: He tried to falsify the records to hide his mistake.
falsify.exampleZh: 他试图篡改记录以掩盖自己的错误。

falter.example: His voice began to falter when he spoke about his mother.
falter.exampleZh: 当他谈到母亲时，他的声音开始颤抖。

fame.example: The young singer found fame after her first song became popular.
fame.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手在她的第一首歌走红后出了名。

familiar.example: The small streets of my old hometown are very familiar to me.
familiar.exampleZh: 我老家那些小街道对我来说非常熟悉。

family.example: My family likes to eat dinner together every evening.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人喜欢每天晚上一起吃饭。

famine.example: The war destroyed the crops and brought famine to the whole country.
famine.exampleZh: 战争毁了庄稼，给整个国家带来了饥荒。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful old bridges and gardens.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市因其美丽的古老桥梁和花园而闻名。

fan.example: The fan waved a small fan to cool herself and cheer for her favorite team.
fan.exampleZh: 这位粉丝挥着一把小扇子给自己降温，同时为她最喜欢的球队加油。

fanatic.example: My brother is a football fanatic and never misses a match.
fanatic.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个足球迷，从不错过任何一场比赛。

fancy.example: She wears a fancy dress to the party and everyone likes it.
fancy.exampleZh: 她穿了一条精致的连衣裙去参加聚会，大家都很喜欢。

fantastic.example: The view from the top of the hill was fantastic.

fantasy.example: She likes to read fantasy novels before going to sleep.
fantasy.exampleZh: 她喜欢在睡前读奇幻小说。

far.example: My school is not far from my home, so I walk there every day.
far.exampleZh: 我的学校离家不远，所以我每天走路去那里。

far-reaching.example: The new law will have a far-reaching effect on small businesses.
far-reaching.exampleZh: 这项新法律将对小企业产生深远的影响。

faraway.example: She lives in a faraway village and rarely comes to the city.
faraway.exampleZh: 她住在一个遥远的村庄，很少到城里来。

farce.example: The whole meeting was a farce that wasted everyone's time.
farce.exampleZh: 整个会议就是一场浪费大家时间的闹剧。

fare.example: The bus fare to the city is only two dollars.
fare.exampleZh: 到市区的公交车费只要两美元。

farewell.example: We said farewell to our friends at the station.
farewell.exampleZh: 我们在车站向朋友们告别。

farm.example: My uncle works on a small farm and grows rice and corn.
farm.exampleZh: 我的叔叔在一个小农场务农，种水稻和玉米。

farmer.example: The farmer gets up early every morning to feed his cows.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位农民每天早上很早起床去喂他的奶牛。

farmhouse.example: The old farmhouse sits quietly at the end of a long dirt road.
farmhouse.exampleZh: 那座老农舍静静地坐落在一条长长的土路尽头。

farming.example: My uncle has worked in farming since he was a young boy.
farming.exampleZh: 我叔叔从小就从事农业工作。

fascinate.example: The magic show fascinated all the children in the room.
fascinate.exampleZh: 这场魔术表演让房间里的所有孩子都着迷了。

fascinating.example: The science museum is a fascinating place for children to visit.
fascinating.exampleZh: 科学博物馆是孩子们参观的一个迷人的地方。

fascism.example: The history book explains how fascism grew in Europe before the war.
fascism.exampleZh: 这本历史书解释了法西斯主义在战前如何在欧洲发展壮大。

fashion.example: She always follows the latest fashion in clothes and music.
fashion.exampleZh: 她总是追随最新的服装和音乐时尚。

fashionable.example: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服。

fast.example: He can run very fast, but he is fasting today for health reasons.
fast.exampleZh: 他能跑得很快，但他今天为了健康正在禁食。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
fasten.exampleZh: 请系紧安全带，飞机即将起飞。

fat.example: Eating too much fat is not good for your health.
fat.exampleZh: 吃太多脂肪对你的健康不好。

fatal.example: A small mistake in the lab can be fatal for everyone.
fatal.exampleZh: 实验室里的一个小错误可能对每个人都是致命的。

fatalism.example: His fatalism stopped him from trying to change anything in his life.
fatalism.exampleZh: 他的宿命论使他不再尝试改变生活中的任何事情。

fate.example: She believed that fate brought them together after so many years.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信是命运让他们在这么多年后走到了一起。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike when I was young.
father.exampleZh: 我小的时候，父亲教我骑自行车。

fathom.example: It is hard to fathom why she left so suddenly.
fathom.exampleZh: 很难理解她为什么突然离开。

fatigue.example: After a long day of work, he felt great fatigue and went to bed early.
fatigue.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，他感到非常疲劳，于是早早上床睡觉了。

fault.example: The fault in the old machine caused a lot of trouble.
fault.exampleZh: 这台旧机器的故障引起了很多麻烦。

faulty.example: The faulty machine stopped working after only two days.
faulty.exampleZh: 那台有毛病的机器只用了两天就停止工作了。

fauna.example: The island's fauna includes many birds and small animals found nowhere else.
fauna.exampleZh: 这座岛屿的动物区系包括许多其他地方没有的鸟类和小型动物。

favor.example: She did me a big favor and I will always support her work.
favor.exampleZh: 她帮了我一个大忙，我会一直支持她的工作。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable for our trip to the beach.
favorable.exampleZh: 天气对我们的海滩之行很有利。

favorite.example: This is my favorite song, and I play it every day.
favorite.exampleZh: 这是我最喜欢的歌，我每天都放它。

fear.example: Many people fear failure, but fear can also keep us safe.
fear.exampleZh: 很多人害怕失败，但恐惧也能保护我们安全。

fearful.example: The fearful storm kept all the children inside the house last night.
fearful.exampleZh: 那场可怕的暴风雨昨晚让孩子们都待在屋里。

fearless.example: The fearless girl jumped into the cold water and saved the small dog.
fearless.exampleZh: 那个无畏的女孩跳进冰冷的水里，救起了那只小狗。

feasible.example: It is not feasible to finish this work in one day.
feasible.exampleZh: 在一天内完成这项工作是不可行的。

feast.example: We had a big feast with our family last night.
feast.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和家人一起吃了一顿丰盛的盛宴。

feat.example: Climbing that mountain alone was a great feat for the young boy.
feat.exampleZh: 独自爬上那座山对这个小男孩来说是一项了不起的壮举。

feather.example: The bird lost a small feather while it was flying over the garden.
feather.exampleZh: 那只鸟飞过花园时掉落了一根小羽毛。

feature.example: The best feature of this small café is its quiet garden.
feature.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆最大的特色是它安静的花园。

federal.example: The federal government built a new road through our town last year.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府去年在我们镇上修建了一条新路。

federation.example: The sports federation meets every year to make rules for all its member clubs.
federation.exampleZh: 该体育联合会每年开会，为所有成员俱乐部制定规则。

fee.example: The school fee is not very high for local families.
fee.exampleZh: 这所学校的学费对当地家庭来说不算很高。

feeble.example: The old man was too feeble to walk up the stairs.
feeble.exampleZh: 那位老人太虚弱了，无法走上楼梯。

feed.example: Please feed the cat some fish before you go to work.
feed.exampleZh: 去上班之前，请给猫喂一些鱼。

feedback.example: The teacher gave us helpful feedback on our English homework.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我们的英语作业给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel happy when I play with my friends after school.
feel.exampleZh: 放学后和朋友一起玩时，我感到很开心。

feeling.example: I had a strange feeling that someone was watching me.
feeling.exampleZh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，好像有人在看着我。

feet.example: My feet hurt after walking ten miles in these old shoes.
feet.exampleZh: 穿着这双旧鞋走了十英里后，我的脚很疼。

feign.example: She tried to feign illness so she could stay home from school.
feign.exampleZh: 她试图装病，好能待在家里不去上学。

feint.example: The boxer made a quick feint to the left before throwing his right punch.
feint.exampleZh: 拳击手先向左做了一个快速佯攻，然后打出右拳。

feline.example: Her feline eyes and quiet steps make her look like a cat.
feline.exampleZh: 她那双猫一样的眼睛和安静的步伐让她看起来像一只猫。

fell.example: He fell the old tree with a sharp axe yesterday morning.
fell.exampleZh: 他昨天早上用一把锋利的斧头砍倒了那棵老树。

fellow.example: He is a friendly fellow who works with me every day.
fellow.exampleZh: 他是一个每天和我一起工作的友好家伙。

fellowship.example: She received a fellowship to study music in another country.
fellowship.exampleZh: 她获得了一笔奖学金，去另一个国家学习音乐。

felony.example: He was sent to prison for committing a felony last year.
felony.exampleZh: 他去年因犯重罪而被送进监狱。

felt.example: She cut a small heart from red felt and sewed it onto the bag.
felt.exampleZh: 她从红色毛毡上剪下一颗小心形，把它缝在了包上。

female.example: The female doctor helped the sick child feel better.
female.exampleZh: 那位女医生帮助生病的孩子感觉好多了。

feminine.example: She has a soft and feminine voice that many people like.
feminine.exampleZh: 她有一副柔和而富有女人味的嗓音，很多人喜欢。

fence.example: My father built a new wooden fence around our small garden last summer.
fence.exampleZh: 去年夏天，我父亲在我们的小花园周围建了一道新的木栅栏。

fend.example: She must fend for her two young children all day.
fend.exampleZh: 她必须整天照料两个年幼的孩子。

feral.example: The feral cat hid under the old house and would not come out.
feral.exampleZh: 那只野猫躲在老房子下面，怎么也不肯出来。

ferment.example: The juice must ferment for several days before it is ready to drink.
ferment.exampleZh: 这种果汁必须先发酵几天才能饮用。

ferocious.example: The ferocious dog scared the little children away from the gate.
ferocious.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗把小孩子吓得不敢靠近大门。

ferret.example: The detective will ferret out the truth behind the missing money.
ferret.exampleZh: 侦探将搜查失踪钱款背后的真相。

ferry.example: We took the ferry across the river to visit the small island.
ferry.exampleZh: 我们乘渡船过河去参观那个小岛。

fertile.example: The fertile land near the river is good for growing rice.
fertile.exampleZh: 河边肥沃的土地适合种植水稻。

fertilizer.example: The farmer put fertilizer on his corn to help it grow.
fertilizer.exampleZh: 农民给玉米施肥，帮助它生长。

fervent.example: She gave a fervent speech about protecting the environment.
fervent.exampleZh: 她就保护环境发表了一番热烈的演讲。

fervor.example: She spoke about her hometown with great fervor and a warm smile.
fervor.exampleZh: 她带着极大的热情和温暖的微笑谈起她的家乡。

fester.example: The small wound began to fester after nobody cleaned it for several days.
fester.exampleZh: 好几天没人清理，那个小伤口开始溃烂。

festival.example: Every spring our town holds a music festival in the park.
festival.exampleZh: 每年春天我们镇都会在公园里举办音乐节。

fetch.example: Please fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen.
fetch.exampleZh: 请去厨房给我拿一杯水来。

fete.example: The whole village came to the fete and enjoyed music, food and games.
fete.exampleZh: 全村人都来参加游园会，享受音乐、美食和游戏。

feud.example: The two families have had a bitter feud for over fifty years.
feud.exampleZh: 这两个家族之间的世仇已经持续了五十多年。

fever.example: The little boy has a high fever and must stay in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 这个小男孩发高烧，今天必须卧床休息。

feverish.example: The boy felt feverish and tired, so his mother let him stay home from school.
feverish.exampleZh: 那个男孩觉得发烧又疲倦，所以妈妈让他留在家里没去上学。

few.example: Few people know how to fix this old machine.
few.exampleZh: 很少有人知道怎么修这台旧机器。

fiber.example: Eating food with a lot of fiber is good for your stomach.
fiber.exampleZh: 吃富含纤维的食物对你的肠胃有好处。

fickle.example: The weather here is fickle and can change from sunny to rainy in minutes.
fickle.exampleZh: 这里的天气反复无常，几分钟内就能从晴天变成雨天。

fiction.example: She likes to read fiction before going to sleep.
fiction.exampleZh: 她喜欢在睡觉前读小说。

fidelity.example: He showed great fidelity to his old friends and never forgot them.
fidelity.exampleZh: 他对老朋友非常忠诚，从未忘记他们。

field.example: The children are playing football in the green field behind our school.
field.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们学校后面的绿色田野上踢足球。

fiend.example: That old story says a cruel fiend lives in the dark forest.
fiend.exampleZh: 那个古老的故事说，黑暗的森林里住着一个残忍的恶魔。

fierce.example: The fierce dog ran after the ball across the park.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗穿过公园追着球跑。

fiery.example: The fiery sun made everyone stay inside and drink cold water.
fiery.exampleZh: 火热的太阳让大家都待在室内喝冷水。

fifteen.example: My sister is fifteen years old and she loves to play basketball.
fifteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十五岁，她喜欢打篮球。

fifth.example: She lives on the fifth floor of that old building.
fifth.exampleZh: 她住在那栋旧楼的五楼。

fifty.example: My grandmother lives in a small house with fifty red roses in her garden.
fifty.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在一栋小房子里，她的花园里有五十朵红玫瑰。

fig.example: She gave me a fig from her garden and a warm smile.
fig.exampleZh: 她从花园里摘了一个无花果给我，还给了我一个温暖的微笑。

fight.example: The two boys began to fight over the last piece of cake.
fight.exampleZh: 两个男孩为了最后一块蛋糕开始打起来。

figure.example: The numbers in the report don't figure correctly, so check them again.
figure.exampleZh: 报告里的数字算得不对，请再核对一遍。

filament.example: The thin filament inside the light bulb broke after many years of use.
filament.exampleZh: 灯泡里的细灯丝在用了很多年后断了。

file.example: Please file these papers in the cabinet and put the file back.
file.exampleZh: 请把这些文件归档到柜子里，然后把文件夹放回去。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water before you put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请先把杯子装满水，再把它放到桌子上。

film.example: We watched a funny film about a small dog last night.
film.exampleZh: 昨晚我们看了一部关于一只小狗的有趣电影。

filter.example: You can filter the water before drinking it, and clean the filter often.
filter.exampleZh: 你可以先过滤水再喝，并经常清洗过滤器。

filth.example: The dirty floor was covered with filth and old food.
filth.exampleZh: 脏兮兮的地板上满是污物和旧食物。

fin.example: The shark's fin cut through the water as it swam near the boat.
fin.exampleZh: 鲨鱼游到船附近时，它的鳍划破了水面。

final.example: This is the final test before the students go home.
final.exampleZh: 这是学生们回家前的最后一场考试。

finally.example: After three long hours, the bus finally arrived at the small station.
finally.exampleZh: 经过漫长的三个小时后，公交车终于到达了那个小车站。

finance.example: The company needs more finance to build the new factory this year.
finance.exampleZh: 公司今年需要更多资金来建新工厂。

financial.example: She works in a financial company in the city center.
financial.exampleZh: 她在市中心的一家金融公司工作。

find.example: I cannot find my keys anywhere in this messy room.
find.exampleZh: 在这个乱糟糟的房间里，我到处都找不到我的钥匙。

finding.example: The new finding may help doctors treat this common disease.
finding.exampleZh: 这一新发现可能有助于医生治疗这种常见疾病。

fine.example: The fine weather made everyone happy, so we walked to the park.
fine.exampleZh: 好天气让每个人都很开心，所以我们步行去了公园。

finger.example: The baby likes to point at the dog with one small finger.
finger.exampleZh: 宝宝喜欢用一根小手指指着那只狗。

finish.example: I will finish my homework before dinner and then watch TV.
finish.exampleZh: 我会在晚饭前完成作业，然后看电视。

finite.example: Our planet has finite resources, so we should use them carefully.
finite.exampleZh: 我们的星球资源有限，所以我们应该谨慎使用它们。

fire.example: The workers used fire to keep warm and cook their food.
fire.exampleZh: 工人们用火取暖并烹煮食物。

firm.example: She works for a small firm, and her belief in the plan is very firm.
firm.exampleZh: 她在一家小公司工作，她对这项计划的信念非常坚定。

first.example: This is my first day at the new school.
first.exampleZh: 这是我在新学校的第一天。

fiscal.example: The government announced a new fiscal plan to help small businesses.
fiscal.exampleZh: 政府宣布了一项新的财政计划来帮助小企业。

fish.example: We caught a big fish in the river near our house.
fish.exampleZh: 我们在离家不远的河里抓到了一条大鱼。

fishery.example: This fishery is famous for its fresh fish.
fishery.exampleZh: 这个渔场以新鲜的鱼而闻名。

fission.example: The scientist studied fission in the tiny cell.
fission.exampleZh: 科学家研究了这个微小细胞中的分裂。

fit.example: This coat is a good fit and it keeps me warm.
fit.exampleZh: 这件外套很合身，而且让我保持温暖。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的体能和健康都很重要。

five.example: My sister has five red apples in her small bag.
five.exampleZh: 我妹妹的小包里有五个红苹果。

fix.example: Can you fix my bike before we leave for school?
fix.exampleZh: 你能在我们去上学前修好我的自行车吗？

fixture.example: The broken light fixture in the hallway needs to be replaced soon.
fixture.exampleZh: 走廊里那个坏了的灯具需要尽快更换。

fizzle.example: Our plan to save money fizzled out when the car broke down.
fizzle.exampleZh: 我们省钱的计划因汽车抛锚而最终失败了。

flag.example: The flag on the tall building is red and white.
flag.exampleZh: 那栋高楼上的旗帜是红白相间的。

flagrant.example: The company was fined for a flagrant violation of safety rules.
flagrant.exampleZh: 该公司因公然违反安全规定而被罚款。

flail.example: The lost child began to flail his arms in the dark.
flail.exampleZh: 那个走失的孩子在黑暗中开始挥舞双臂。

flair.example: She has a real flair for making people feel welcome.
flair.exampleZh: 她在让人感到受欢迎方面很有天赋。

flake.example: A flake of snow landed on my hand and quickly melted.
flake.exampleZh: 一片雪花落在我手上，很快就融化了。

flamboyant.example: His flamboyant red jacket made him easy to spot in the crowd.
flamboyant.exampleZh: 他那件艳丽惹眼的红色夹克让他在人群里很容易就能被认出来。

flame.example: The old man sat by the flame and told us stories.
flame.exampleZh: 老人坐在火苗旁，给我们讲故事。

flank.example: The garden is on the flank of the hill, facing the river.
flank.exampleZh: 花园位于山坡的侧面，面向河流。

flannel.example: He wore a warm flannel shirt on the cold winter morning.
flannel.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬日早晨，他穿着一件温暖的法兰绒衬衫。

flap.example: The bird flapped its wings and flew away from the tree.
flap.exampleZh: 那只鸟拍动翅膀，从树上飞走了。

flare.example: The old camera flared in the bright sun, and his anger flared too.
flare.exampleZh: 旧相机在强光下闪了光，他的怒火也突然爆发了。

flash.example: A bright flash of lightning lit up the whole sky last night.
flash.exampleZh: 昨晚一道明亮的闪电照亮了整个天空。

flashy.example: He bought a flashy car to impress his friends.
flashy.exampleZh: 他买了一辆浮华的汽车来给朋友们留下深刻印象。

flat.example: We live in a small flat on the third floor.
flat.exampleZh: 我们住在三楼的一套小公寓里。

flatter.example: She tried to flatter her boss to get a better job.
flatter.exampleZh: 她试图奉承老板以获得更好的工作。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor that my whole family loves.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，我全家都喜欢。

flaw.example: One small flaw in the plan could cause trouble later.
flaw.exampleZh: 计划中的一个小缺点可能会在以后带来麻烦。

flea.example: The dog kept scratching because it had a flea in its fur.
flea.exampleZh: 那只狗不停地挠，因为它的毛里有一只跳蚤。

fledgling.example: The fledgling writer sent her first story to a small magazine.
fledgling.exampleZh: 这位初出茅庐的作家把她的第一篇小说投给了一家小杂志。

flee.example: The family had to flee their home when the flood water rose quickly.
flee.exampleZh: 洪水迅速上涨时，这家人不得不逃离家园。

fleece.example: That shop tried to fleece us for a simple cup of coffee.
fleece.exampleZh: 那家店想靠一杯普通的咖啡敲诈我们。

fleet.example: The country sent a large fleet of ships to protect the coast.
fleet.exampleZh: 该国派出了一支庞大的舰队来保护海岸。

flesh.example: The flesh of this fruit is soft and sweet.
flesh.exampleZh: 这种水果的果肉柔软又香甜。

flexible.example: Her work hours are flexible, so she can pick up her son.
flexible.exampleZh: 她的工作时间很灵活，所以能去接儿子。

flick.example: She used a flick of her wrist to open the small box.
flick.exampleZh: 她用手腕轻轻一弹，打开了那个小盒子。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed for two hours because of heavy snow.
flight.exampleZh: 由于大雪，我们飞往北京的航班延误了两个小时。

flimsy.example: The box was made of flimsy cardboard and broke when I picked it up.
flimsy.exampleZh: 这个箱子是用薄而不结实的纸板做的，我一拿起来就破了。

flinch.example: He did not flinch when the doctor cleaned the deep cut.
flinch.exampleZh: 医生清洗那道很深的伤口时，他没有退缩。

fling.example: She had to fling the rope to the boat before the waves pulled it away.
fling.exampleZh: 她不得不在海浪把船冲走之前把绳子猛地扔向那条船。

flint.example: He struck the flint to make a small fire.
flint.exampleZh: 他敲击燧石来生起一小堆火。

flip.example: She likes to flip through magazines before bed every night.
flip.exampleZh: 她喜欢每晚睡前快速翻看杂志。

flirt.example: She likes to flirt with the new boy in her class.
flirt.exampleZh: 她喜欢和班上新来的男孩调情。

float.example: The empty boat floats slowly on the quiet river.
float.exampleZh: 空船在安静的河面上缓缓漂浮。

flock.example: A large flock of birds flew over the old house this morning.
flock.exampleZh: 今天早上，一大群鸟从这座老房子上空飞过。

floe.example: A large floe of ice floated slowly past our boat.
floe.exampleZh: 一大块浮冰慢慢地漂过我们的船。

flood.example: Heavy rain can flood the roads and many homes near the river.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨可能会淹没道路和河边的许多房屋。

floor.example: The children sat on the floor and played with their toys.
floor.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地板上玩玩具。

floppy.example: Her floppy hat fell over her eyes as she ran.
floppy.exampleZh: 她跑的时候，松软的帽子盖住了眼睛。

flora.example: The flora of this island includes many rare and beautiful plants.
flora.exampleZh: 这个岛上的植物区系包括许多珍稀而美丽的植物。

floral.example: The garden has a lovely floral smell in spring.
floral.exampleZh: 春天里，花园有一股怡人的花香。

florid.example: His florid face suggested he had just come in from the cold.
florid.exampleZh: 他红润的脸说明他刚从寒冷的外面进来。

flounder.example: The team floundered without a clear plan and made several costly mistakes.
flounder.exampleZh: 团队没有明确的计划，手足无措，犯了好几个代价高昂的错误。

flour.example: She bought a bag of flour to make bread for her family.
flour.exampleZh: 她买了一袋面粉，为家人做面包。

flourish.example: Small shops flourish when the local economy is strong.
flourish.exampleZh: 当地经济强劲时，小商店就会兴旺起来。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the quiet green valley.
flow.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓流过安静翠绿的山谷。

flower.example: The flowers in our garden open in spring and smell very sweet.
flower.exampleZh: 我们花园里的花在春天开放，闻起来很香。

flu.example: I stayed home from school because I had the flu last week.
flu.exampleZh: 上周我得了流感，所以待在家里没去上学。

fluctuate.example: Prices often fluctuate during the year, so we check them every week.
fluctuate.exampleZh: 价格在一年中经常波动，所以我们每周都会查看。

fluent.example: She is fluent in English and speaks it every day.
fluent.exampleZh: 她英语很流利，而且每天都讲英语。

fluff.example: The little bird was covered in soft yellow fluff after it hatched.
fluff.exampleZh: 那只小鸟孵出来后，身上长满了柔软的黄色绒毛。

fluid.example: Water is a fluid that flows freely and takes the shape of its container.
fluid.exampleZh: 水是一种流体，能自由流动并呈现容器的形状。

fluke.example: It was pure fluke that we met at the station that day.
fluke.exampleZh: 那天我们在车站相遇纯属侥幸。

fluorescent.example: The bright fluorescent light in the office makes everyone feel tired.
fluorescent.exampleZh: 办公室里明亮的荧光灯让每个人都感到疲倦。

flush.example: Her face began to flush when the teacher praised her in class.
flush.exampleZh: 老师在课堂上表扬她时，她的脸开始泛起红晕。

fluster.example: The sudden question from the teacher flustered him and he forgot his answer.
fluster.exampleZh: 老师突然提问让他慌了神，他忘了答案。

flutter.example: The flag began to flutter in the wind as the children watched.
flutter.exampleZh: 孩子们看着旗帜在风中开始飘动。

flux.example: Her life is in a state of constant flux after the move.
flux.exampleZh: 搬家之后，她的生活一直处于不断变动的状态。

fly.example: The bird can fly high, but the fly in the kitchen cannot.
fly.exampleZh: 鸟儿能飞得很高，但厨房里的那只苍蝇却不能。

foam.example: The waves left white foam on the sand near our feet.
foam.exampleZh: 海浪在我们脚边的沙滩上留下了白色的泡沫。

focus.example: Please focus on your homework and finish it before dinner.
focus.exampleZh: 请集中精力做作业，在晚饭前完成。

foe.example: He treats everyone who disagrees with him as a foe.
foe.exampleZh: 他把每个与他意见不同的人都当作敌人。

fog.example: The heavy fog made it hard to see the road ahead.
fog.exampleZh: 大雾让人很难看清前方的路。

foil.example: The police foil the thief's plan to steal the old painting.
foil.exampleZh: 警察挫败了小偷盗窃那幅古画的计划。

fold.example: She helped her mother fold the clean clothes and put them away.
fold.exampleZh: 她帮妈妈把干净的衣服叠好并收了起来。

foliage.example: The autumn foliage in the park turns red and gold every year.
foliage.exampleZh: 公园里的秋叶每年都会变成红色和金色。

folk.example: My folk in the village still sing these old songs.
folk.exampleZh: 我在村里的亲人仍在唱这些老歌。

follicle.example: Each hair grows out of a small follicle in the skin.
follicle.exampleZh: 每根头发都从皮肤里的一个小毛囊中长出来。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我会给你指路。

following.example: Please read the following words and write them in your notebook.
following.exampleZh: 请读下面的单词，并把它们写在笔记本上。

food.example: We need to buy some food for the party on Friday night.
food.exampleZh: 我们需要为周五晚上的聚会买些食物。

fool.example: He felt like a fool after he believed that silly story.
fool.exampleZh: 他相信了那个愚蠢的故事后觉得自己像个傻瓜。

foolish.example: It was foolish of me to go out without an umbrella.
foolish.exampleZh: 我没带伞就出门，真是太傻了。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk in the park.
foot.exampleZh: 在公园走了很久之后，我的左脚很疼。

footstep.example: I heard his footsteps on the stairs and knew he was home.
footstep.exampleZh: 我听到他在楼梯上的脚步声，就知道他回家了。

for.example: I bought this book for my sister because she loves reading.
for.exampleZh: 我给妹妹买了这本书，因为她喜欢阅读。

forage.example: The birds forage for food in the snow during cold winter days.
forage.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬日里，鸟儿在雪中寻找食物。

foray.example: Their first foray into the export market was small but successful.
foray.exampleZh: 他们首次尝试出口市场，规模虽小却很成功。

forbid.example: My parents forbid me to play games late at night.
forbid.exampleZh: 我父母不许我深夜玩游戏。

force.example: The force of the wind broke the old tree in our garden.
force.exampleZh: 风的力量吹断了我们花园里的那棵老树。

ford.example: The old car could not cross the shallow ford after the heavy rain.
ford.exampleZh: 大雨过后，那辆旧车无法驶过那片浅滩。

forebode.example: The dark clouds forebode a heavy storm later this afternoon.
forebode.exampleZh: 乌云预示着今天下午晚些时候会有一场大暴风雨。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天下午会下雨。

foreclose.example: The bank may foreclose on the house if payments stop.
foreclose.exampleZh: 如果停止还款，银行可能会取消这栋房子的抵押品赎回权。

forefather.example: My forefathers came to this small town many years ago.
forefather.exampleZh: 我的祖先很多年前来到这个小镇。

foreground.example: The little dog in the foreground makes the whole photo look lively.
foreground.exampleZh: 前景里的那只小狗让整张照片看起来很有生气。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check for a fever.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的额头上，检查他是否发烧。

foreign.example: She likes to learn foreign languages and make friends from other countries.
foreign.exampleZh: 她喜欢学习外语，也喜欢结交来自其他国家的朋友。

foreman.example: The foreman told the workers to finish the job before noon.
foreman.exampleZh: 工头让工人们在中午前完成这项工作。

foremost.example: She is one of the foremost experts on climate change in the world.
foremost.exampleZh: 她是世界上最重要的气候变化专家之一。

forensic.example: The forensic team found useful evidence at the scene of the crime.
forensic.exampleZh: 法医小组在犯罪现场找到了有用的证据。

foresee.example: Nobody can foresee what will happen in the next few years.
foresee.exampleZh: 没有人能预见未来几年会发生什么。

forest.example: We walked through the forest and saw many tall trees.
forest.exampleZh: 我们穿过森林，看到了许多高大的树。

forester.example: The forester showed us how to plant young trees on the hill.
forester.exampleZh: 那位林务员教我们如何在山坡上种植小树。

foretell.example: No one can foretell what will happen next year.
foretell.exampleZh: 没有人能预言明年会发生什么。

forever.example: I will always remember the happy days we spent together forever.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远记得我们一起度过的快乐时光。

forge.example: He tried to forge his father's signature on the school letter.
forge.exampleZh: 他试图在学校信上伪造他父亲的签名。

forget.example: I always forget where I put my keys.
forget.exampleZh: 我总是忘记把钥匙放在哪里。

forgive.example: I hope you can forgive me for the mistake I made yesterday.
forgive.exampleZh: 我希望你能原谅我昨天犯的错。

fork.example: Please put a clean fork next to my plate.
fork.exampleZh: 请在我盘子旁边放一把干净的叉子。

form.example: Water can take the form of ice, steam or liquid.
form.exampleZh: 水可以以冰、蒸汽或液体的形式存在。

formal.example: He wore a formal suit to the important meeting yesterday.
formal.exampleZh: 他昨天穿了一套正式的西装去参加那个重要会议。

format.example: Please use the same format for all the reports this week.
format.exampleZh: 本周所有报告请使用相同的格式。

formation.example: The formation of good habits takes time and daily practice.
formation.exampleZh: 良好习惯的形成需要时间和每天的练习。

former.example: The former teacher now works in a small library.
former.exampleZh: 这位以前的老师现在在一家小图书馆工作。

formidable.example: The old castle had a formidable wall that kept enemies away.
formidable.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡有一道令人生畏的城墙，把敌人挡在外面。

formula.example: The team found a simple formula for solving this problem quickly.
formula.exampleZh: 团队找到了一个快速解决这个问题的简单方案。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a simple plan for the new project.
formulate.exampleZh: 团队将为这个新项目制定一个简单的计划。

forsake.example: He would never forsake his old friends for money or fame.
forsake.exampleZh: 他绝不会为了金钱或名声而抛弃老朋友。

fort.example: The old fort stands on the hill and guards the small town below.
fort.exampleZh: 那座古老的堡垒矗立在山丘上，守卫着下面的小镇。

forth.example: She stepped forth from the crowd and asked a simple question.
forth.exampleZh: 她从人群中向前走出，问了一个简单的问题。

forthcoming.example: The forthcoming holiday gives us plenty of time to visit our family.
forthcoming.exampleZh: 即将到来的假期给了我们充足的时间去看望家人。

forthright.example: She gave a forthright answer to every question the reporter asked.
forthright.exampleZh: 她对记者提出的每个问题都给出了直率的回答。

fortify.example: We built a wall to fortify the city against attack.
fortify.exampleZh: 我们建了一堵墙来加强城市的防御，抵御进攻。

fortitude.example: She faced her long illness with quiet fortitude and never complained.
fortitude.exampleZh: 她以平静的坚韧面对漫长的病痛，从不抱怨。

fortress.example: The old fortress stands on the hill above our town.
fortress.exampleZh: 那座古老的堡垒矗立在我们小镇上方的山丘上。

fortunate.example: She felt fortunate to have such kind and helpful friends.
fortunate.exampleZh: 她觉得自己很幸运，能有这样善良又乐于助人的朋友。

fortune.example: She made a fortune by selling her small business to a larger company.
fortune.exampleZh: 她把小公司卖给一家大公司，赚了一大笔钱。

forty.example: My grandmother has lived in this small town for forty years.
forty.exampleZh: 我的祖母在这个小镇上住了四十年。

forum.example: The school forum gives students a place to share their ideas.
forum.exampleZh: 学校的论坛给学生提供了一个分享想法的场所。

forward.example: Please move your chair forward so we can all see the screen.
forward.exampleZh: 请把你的椅子往前移，这样我们都能看到屏幕。

fossil.example: The scientists found a small fish fossil in the rock.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家们在岩石中发现了一块小鱼化石。

foster.example: Her new job helped foster a strong sense of teamwork.
foster.exampleZh: 她的新工作有助于培养强烈的团队合作意识。

foul.example: The foul smell from the trash made everyone leave the room quickly.
foul.exampleZh: 垃圾散发的难闻气味让大家很快离开了房间。

found.example: They found a small school in the village last year.
found.exampleZh: 他们去年在村里创办了一所小学校。

foundation.example: A strong education is the foundation of a good life.
foundation.exampleZh: 良好的教育是美好生活的基础。

founder.example: The founder of our school started the first library here.
founder.exampleZh: 我们学校的创始人在这里创办了第一个图书馆。

fountain.example: The children played happily near the fountain in the city park.
fountain.exampleZh: 孩子们在城市公园的喷泉旁快乐地玩耍。

four.example: There are four chairs around the small table in the kitchen.
four.exampleZh: 厨房里的小桌子周围有四把椅子。

fourth.example: Our team finished fourth in the school race last Friday.
fourth.exampleZh: 我们队上周五在学校比赛中获得了第四名。

fowl.example: The farmer keeps chickens and other fowl in the yard behind his house.
fowl.exampleZh: 这位农民在房子后面的院子里养鸡和其他家禽。

fox.example: The clever fox ran across the field before the dogs could catch it.
fox.exampleZh: 那只狡猾的狐狸跑过田野，狗还没来得及抓住它。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to the meeting today.
fraction.exampleZh: 今天只有一小部分学生来参加了会议。

fracture.example: The doctor said the small fracture in his arm would heal in six weeks.
fracture.exampleZh: 医生说他的手臂上的小骨折六周内就会愈合。

fragile.example: The old glass is very fragile, so please hold it with care.
fragile.exampleZh: 这个旧玻璃杯非常易碎，请小心拿稳。

fragment.example: I found a fragment of broken glass on the kitchen floor.
fragment.exampleZh: 我在厨房地板上发现了一片碎玻璃。

fragrance.example: The sweet fragrance of the flowers filled the whole room.
fragrance.exampleZh: 花的芳香充满了整个房间。

frail.example: The frail old man needs help to walk up the stairs.
frail.exampleZh: 这位虚弱的老人需要人扶着才能上楼梯。

frame.example: The workers built a strong steel frame for the new building.
frame.exampleZh: 工人们为新楼搭建了坚固的钢框架。

framework.example: This framework helps us understand how the whole system works.
framework.exampleZh: 这个框架帮助我们理解整个系统是如何运作的。

franchise.example: She bought a fast food franchise and opened her own restaurant last year.
franchise.exampleZh: 她购买了一个快餐特许经营权，去年开了自己的餐厅。

frank.example: To be frank, I do not like this plan at all.
frank.exampleZh: 说实话，我一点也不喜欢这个计划。

frantic.example: She made a frantic search for her lost keys before the meeting.
frantic.exampleZh: 会议前，她焦急地四处寻找丢失的钥匙。

fraternal.example: The two clubs have a fraternal relationship and often help each other.
fraternal.exampleZh: 这两个俱乐部有着兄弟般的关系，经常互相帮助。

fraud.example: The police arrested the man for fraud after he took people's money.
fraud.exampleZh: 那名男子拿走了人们的钱后，警方以诈骗罪逮捕了他。
