fraudulent.example: The company was fined for using fraudulent methods to sell its products.
fraudulent.exampleZh: 该公司因使用欺诈手段销售产品而被罚款。

fray.example: The old rope began to fray after many years of heavy use.
fray.exampleZh: 那根旧绳子在多年高强度使用后开始磨损。

freak.example: The old man is a kind freak who collects strange things.
freak.exampleZh: 这位老人是个收集奇怪物件的怪人，但心地善良。

freckle.example: The little girl has a small freckle on her nose.
freckle.exampleZh: 这个小女孩的鼻子上有一个小雀斑。

free.example: The museum is free on Sundays, so we can go with our friends.
free.exampleZh: 博物馆周日免费，所以我们可以和朋友们一起去。

freedom.example: Students here have the freedom to choose what they want to study.
freedom.exampleZh: 这里的学生有选择自己想学什么的自由。

freeze.example: The water in the small lake will freeze when winter comes.
freeze.exampleZh: 冬天来临时，小湖里的水会结冰。

freight.example: The freight arrived at the port early this morning.
freight.exampleZh: 这批货物今天一早抵达港口。

frequency.example: The frequency of buses on this route is very low at night.
frequency.exampleZh: 这条线路的公交车在夜间班次频率很低。

frequent.example: He is a frequent visitor to our small town library.
frequent.exampleZh: 他是我们小镇图书馆的常客。

fresh.example: We bought fresh fruit and vegetables at the small market this morning.
fresh.exampleZh: 今天早上我们在那个小市场买了新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

fret.example: Don't fret about the test; you have studied hard all week.
fret.exampleZh: 别为考试发愁，你已经努力学习了一整周。

friction.example: There is some friction between the two teams about the new plan.
friction.exampleZh: 两个团队之间对新计划存在一些摩擦。

friday.example: We will meet again this Friday to talk about the new plan.
friday.exampleZh: 我们这个星期五会再次见面，讨论新的计划。

fridge.example: Please put the milk in the fridge before it gets warm.
fridge.exampleZh: 请把牛奶放进冰箱，以免变温。

friend.example: My best friend lives next door and we walk to school together every day.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友住在隔壁，我们每天一起走路去上学。

friendly.example: Our new neighbors are very friendly and often help us.
friendly.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，常常帮助我们。

friendship.example: True friendship grows when friends help each other through hard times.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊在朋友互相帮助度过困难时成长。

fright.example: The loud noise gave the little boy a terrible fright.
fright.exampleZh: 那声巨响把小男孩吓了一大跳。

frighten.example: The loud noise at night frightens the small children.
frighten.exampleZh: 夜里的巨响使小孩子们感到害怕。

fringe.example: The old tablecloth had a colorful fringe along its edge.
fringe.exampleZh: 那块旧桌布的边缘有一圈彩色的流苏。

front.example: The car stopped in front of the small shop.
front.exampleZh: 那辆车停在那个小店的前面。

frontier.example: Space is the next frontier for human exploration and science.
frontier.exampleZh: 太空是人类探索与科学的下一片前沿领域。

frost.example: The thin frost on the grass made the field look white this morning.
frost.exampleZh: 今天早上草地上薄薄的霜让田野看起来白茫茫的。

frown.example: My mother gave a frown when I said I would go out tonight.
frown.exampleZh: 我说今晚要出门时，妈妈皱起了眉头。

fruit.example: Eating fresh fruit every day is good for your health.
fruit.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果对你的健康有好处。

frustrate.example: Long delays often frustrate people who are waiting for a bus.
frustrate.exampleZh: 漫长的延误常常让等公交车的人感到沮丧。

fry.example: My mother likes to fry two eggs for breakfast every morning.
fry.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢每天早上煎两个鸡蛋当早餐。

fuel.example: This dry wood is good fuel for the fire.
fuel.exampleZh: 这些干木头是生火的好燃料。

fulfill.example: She works hard every day to fulfill her dream of becoming a teacher.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为教师的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of fresh water from the well.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了从井里打来的新鲜水。

fumble.example: He fumbled for the keys in his dark coat pocket.
fumble.exampleZh: 他在深色外套口袋里笨拙地摸索钥匙。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the park and the kids found the magic show very fun.
fun.exampleZh: 我们在公园里玩得很开心，孩子们觉得那个魔术表演很有趣。

function.example: The function of this small button is to turn the machine on.
function.exampleZh: 这个小按钮的功能是开动机器。

fund.example: The school used the fund to buy new books for the library.
fund.exampleZh: 学校用这笔资金为图书馆购买了新书。

fundamental.example: Reading and writing are fundamental skills that every student needs at school.
fundamental.exampleZh: 阅读和写作是每个学生在学校都需要的基本技能。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old teacher.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老教师告别。

funnel.example: He poured the oil through a funnel into the bottle.
funnel.exampleZh: 他把油通过漏斗倒进瓶子里。

funny.example: The movie was very funny, so everyone laughed loudly together.
funny.exampleZh: 这部电影非常滑稽，所以大家一齐大声笑了起来。

fur.example: The cat has soft white fur and big green eyes.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的白毛和绿色的大眼睛。

furious.example: My father was furious when he saw the broken window.
furious.exampleZh: 我父亲看到破窗户时非常愤怒。

furnace.example: The old house stays warm in winter because its furnace works very well.
furnace.exampleZh: 这栋老房子冬天很暖和，因为它的暖气锅炉运转得很好。

furnish.example: We will furnish the new apartment with a sofa and a bed.
furnish.exampleZh: 我们将用一张沙发和一张床来布置新公寓。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 我们上周为客厅买了新家具。

further.example: We need to study this problem further before we make any decisions.
further.exampleZh: 在做出任何决定之前，我们需要进一步研究这个问题。

furthermore.example: The room is small and clean; furthermore, it is very cheap.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这个房间又小又干净，而且还很便宜。

furthest.example: That small village is the furthest place I have ever visited.
furthest.exampleZh: 那个小村庄是我去过的最远的地方。

fury.example: His face turned red with fury when he saw the broken window.
fury.exampleZh: 看到被打破的窗户时，他气得脸都红了。

fuse.example: The two small companies decided to fuse into one larger team.
fuse.exampleZh: 这两家小公司决定合并成一个更大的团队。

fusion.example: The fusion of two small companies created a much larger and stronger business.
fusion.exampleZh: 两家小公司的合并创造了一个规模更大、实力更强的企业。

fuss.example: She made a big fuss about the small mistake in the report.
fuss.exampleZh: 她对报告中的那个小错误大做文章。

futile.example: Trying to change his mind again would be a futile effort.
futile.exampleZh: 再试图改变他的想法将是徒劳的。

future.example: She wants to be a doctor in the future and help many people.
future.exampleZh: 她将来想成为一名医生，帮助很多人。

gab.example: We sat on the porch and gabbed about our neighbors for an hour.
gab.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上，闲聊了一个小时的邻居。

gabble.example: The nervous boy gabbled his answer so fast that nobody understood him.
gabble.exampleZh: 那个紧张的男孩说得又快又含糊，没人听懂他的话。

gadget.example: I bought a small gadget that can open any bottle easily.
gadget.exampleZh: 我买了一个能轻松打开任何瓶子的小装置。

gaffe.example: His loud joke at the funeral was a serious gaffe.
gaffe.exampleZh: 他在葬礼上讲那个大声的笑话是一次严重的失礼。

gag.example: The new rules gag reporters and stop them from asking hard questions.
gag.exampleZh: 新规定压制记者发声，阻止他们提出尖锐的问题。

gaggle.example: A gaggle of geese walked slowly across the quiet farm road.
gaggle.exampleZh: 一群鹅慢慢地走过安静的农场小路。

gaiety.example: The music and dancing filled the room with gaiety all night.
gaiety.exampleZh: 音乐和舞蹈让整个房间整夜充满了欢乐。

gaily.example: The children walked gaily down the road, singing their favorite songs together.
gaily.exampleZh: 孩子们沿着小路欢快地走着，一起唱着他们最喜欢的歌。

gain.example: She worked hard to gain more experience in her new job.
gain.exampleZh: 她努力工作，为了在新工作中获得更多经验。

gait.example: His heavy gait showed that his old knee injury still bothered him.
gait.exampleZh: 他沉重的步态说明他的旧膝伤仍在困扰着他。

gala.example: The school will hold a big gala to celebrate its hundredth birthday.
gala.exampleZh: 学校将举办一场盛大的庆典来庆祝建校一百周年。

galaxy.example: Our galaxy has billions of stars, and scientists study it every night.
galaxy.exampleZh: 我们的星系有数十亿颗恒星，科学家们每晚都在研究它。

gale.example: The gale blew down several trees in our garden last night.
gale.exampleZh: 昨晚的狂风吹倒了我们花园里的几棵树。

gall.example: He had the gall to ask for more money after doing so little work.
gall.exampleZh: 他活儿干得那么少，居然还有脸要更多的钱。

gallant.example: The gallant young man helped the old lady carry her heavy bags home.
gallant.exampleZh: 那位殷勤的年轻人帮老太太把沉重的袋子提回了家。

gallantry.example: He was praised for his gallantry during the rescue of the two children.
gallantry.exampleZh: 他因在营救那两个孩子时表现出的勇敢而受到赞扬。

gallery.example: We spent the whole afternoon looking at old paintings in the city gallery.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们整个下午都在市立美术馆里看古老的画作。

gallon.example: I bought two gallons of milk for the family party.
gallon.exampleZh: 我为家庭聚会买了两加仑牛奶。

gallop.example: The horse began to gallop across the empty field.
gallop.exampleZh: 那匹马开始在空旷的田野上飞奔起来。

galore.example: There are cheap hotels galore near the beach in this small town.
galore.exampleZh: 这个小镇的海滩附近有许多便宜的旅馆。

galvanize.example: The coach's speech helped galvanize the team into working harder together.
galvanize.exampleZh: 教练的讲话激励全队更加齐心协力地努力。

gambit.example: His first friendly smile was a clever gambit to win our trust.
gambit.exampleZh: 他最初那个友好的微笑是赢得我们信任的巧妙策略。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on card games with his friends every weekend.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢每个周末和朋友们玩牌赌博。

game.example: The children played a fun game in the park after school.
game.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在公园里玩了一个有趣的游戏。

gamely.example: She tried gamely to finish the race despite her injured ankle.
gamely.exampleZh: 尽管脚踝受伤，她还是兴致勃勃地努力跑完了比赛。

gamut.example: Her music covers the whole gamut from soft songs to loud rock.
gamut.exampleZh: 她的音乐涵盖了从轻柔歌曲到响亮摇滚的整个范围。

gang.example: A gang of boys was playing football in the park after school.
gang.exampleZh: 放学后一帮男孩在公园里踢足球。

gangling.example: The gangling boy walked slowly across the room to get his book.
gangling.exampleZh: 那个瘦长难看的男孩慢慢地走过房间去拿他的书。

gangster.example: The police caught the gangster who robbed the small bank last night.
gangster.exampleZh: 警察抓住了昨晚抢劫那家小银行的歹徒。

gap.example: There is a big gap between the two teams.
gap.exampleZh: 这两支队伍之间存在很大的差距。

gaping.example: She stared with a gaping mouth at the huge hole in the road.
gaping.exampleZh: 她目瞪口呆地张着嘴，盯着路上那个巨大的洞。

garage.example: My father keeps his old car in the garage behind our house.
garage.exampleZh: 我父亲把他那辆旧车停在我们家后面的车库里。

garb.example: The dancers wore bright traditional garb for the festival.
garb.exampleZh: 舞者们为节日穿上了鲜艳的传统服装。

garbage.example: Please put the garbage in the bin outside the kitchen door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放到厨房门外的垃圾桶里。

garble.example: The noise garbled his voice so we could not understand him.
garble.exampleZh: 噪音使他的声音变得含混不清，我们听不懂他在说什么。

garden.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她的一个小花园里种西红柿和花。

gargle.example: The doctor told me to gargle with warm salt water twice a day.
gargle.exampleZh: 医生让我每天用温盐水漱口两次。

garland.example: The children made a garland of fresh flowers for the festival.
garland.exampleZh: 孩子们为节日用鲜花做了一个花环。

garlic.example: My mother puts garlic in almost every soup she makes at home.
garlic.exampleZh: 我妈妈在家里做的几乎每道汤里都会放大蒜。

garment.example: She washed the dirty garment by hand and hung it outside to dry.
garment.exampleZh: 她手洗了那件脏衣服，然后挂到外面晾干。

garner.example: She worked hard to garner support from her neighbors and friends.
garner.exampleZh: 她努力工作，从邻居和朋友那里获得了支持。

garnish.example: She used fresh basil to garnish the soup before serving it.
garnish.exampleZh: 她在上汤之前用新鲜罗勒叶给汤做点缀。

garrison.example: A small garrison defended the old fort during the winter.
garrison.exampleZh: 一支小规模的驻军在冬天守卫着这座古老的堡垒。

garter.example: She wore a red garter under her dress at the wedding.
garter.exampleZh: 婚礼上，她在裙子下面系了一条红色吊袜带。

gas.example: Please turn off the gas before you leave the house.
gas.exampleZh: 离开房子前请关掉煤气。

gaseous.example: The gaseous fuel moves through the pipe quickly and safely.
gaseous.exampleZh: 这种气态燃料快速而安全地流过管道。

gash.example: He fell on the broken glass and got a deep gash on his arm.
gash.exampleZh: 他摔在碎玻璃上，手臂上划出了一道深长的口子。

gasket.example: I need a new gasket for the old water pipe under the sink.
gasket.exampleZh: 水槽下面那根旧水管需要一个新垫圈。

gasp.example: She gasped for air after running up the stairs, and I heard a loud gasp.
gasp.exampleZh: 她跑上楼梯后大口喘气，我听到了一声响亮的倒吸气。

gastric.example: The doctor said the pain comes from a gastric problem after eating too fast.
gastric.exampleZh: 医生说这种疼痛来自吃得太快引起的胃部问题。

gate.example: Please wait for me at the gate in front of the school.
gate.exampleZh: 请在学校前面的大门等我。

gather.example: People gather in the park every morning to run and talk.
gather.exampleZh: 人们每天早上聚集在公园里跑步和聊天。

gauge.example: Can you gauge how much water is in the tank?
gauge.exampleZh: 你能估测一下水箱里有多少水吗？

gavel.example: The judge hit the table with his gavel to quiet the room.
gavel.exampleZh: 法官用小木槌敲了敲桌子，让房间安静下来。

gawk.example: The children gawked at the elephant in the zoo.
gawk.exampleZh: 孩子们呆呆地看着动物园里的大象。

gaze.example: She gazed at the stars for a long time last night.
gaze.exampleZh: 昨晚她长时间地凝视着星星。

gear.example: He changed gear before driving up the steep hill.
gear.exampleZh: 他在开上陡坡之前换了挡。

gel.example: She put some gel on her wet hair before the party.
gel.exampleZh: 聚会前，她在湿头发上抹了一些发胶。

gelatin.example: She made the dessert with gelatin so it would hold its shape.
gelatin.exampleZh: 她用明胶做甜点，这样甜点就能保持形状。

gem.example: She wore a red gem on her finger at the party.
gem.exampleZh: 她在派对上手指上戴着一颗红色宝石。

gender.example: She asked each student to write their name and gender on the form.
gender.exampleZh: 她让每个学生在表格上写下自己的姓名和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in our body carries information that decides how we grow.
gene.exampleZh: 我们身体里的每个基因都携带着决定我们如何生长的信息。

genealogy.example: My grandmother keeps a book about our family genealogy.
genealogy.exampleZh: 我奶奶保存着一本关于我们家族家谱的书。

general.example: The general idea of this book is easy to understand.
general.exampleZh: 这本书的总体思路很容易理解。

generate.example: Solar panels can generate clean electricity even on cloudy days.
generate.exampleZh: 即使在阴天，太阳能板也能产生清洁电力。

generation.example: Each generation learns something new from the older generation.
generation.exampleZh: 每一代人都从老一辈那里学到新东西。

generator.example: The generator in our garage makes enough power for the whole house.
generator.exampleZh: 我们车库里的发电机能为整栋房子提供足够的电力。

generic.example: This generic medicine is much cheaper than the famous brand.
generic.exampleZh: 这种非专利药比那个知名品牌便宜得多。

generous.example: My generous uncle gave me a new bike for my birthday.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的叔叔在我生日时送了我一辆新自行车。

genetic.example: Genetic tests can show whether a person carries a certain disease gene.
genetic.exampleZh: 基因检测可以显示一个人是否携带某种疾病基因。

genial.example: Our genial neighbor always smiles and says hello to everyone on the street.
genial.exampleZh: 我们和蔼的邻居总是微笑着和街上的每个人打招呼。

genie.example: The boy found an old lamp, and a genie came out of it.
genie.exampleZh: 男孩找到一盏旧灯，一个妖怪从里面出来了。

genital.example: The doctor examined the genital area to check for any signs of infection.
genital.exampleZh: 医生检查了生殖器区域，以查看是否有任何感染迹象。

genius.example: Einstein was a genius whose ideas changed the world.
genius.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦是一位天才，他的思想改变了世界。

genre.example: This genre of music is very popular with young people.
genre.exampleZh: 这种音乐流派非常受年轻人欢迎。

genteel.example: His genteel manners made everyone feel welcome at the small family dinner.
genteel.exampleZh: 他文雅的举止让每个人在小家庭晚餐上都感到自在。

gentle.example: The gentle teacher speaks to her students with a soft voice.
gentle.exampleZh: 这位温和的老师用轻柔的声音对学生说话。

gentleman.example: The old gentleman opened the door for the children.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位老绅士为孩子们开了门。

genuine.example: She gave me a genuine smile and thanked me for my help.
genuine.exampleZh: 她给了我一个真诚的微笑，并感谢我的帮助。

genus.example: Scientists put these animals in the same genus because they look alike.
genus.exampleZh: 科学家把这些动物归入同一个属，因为它们看起来很相似。

geography.example: We study geography to learn about rivers, mountains and cities.
geography.exampleZh: 我们学习地理，以了解河流、山脉和城市。

geology.example: She studies geology at university and often goes hiking to look at rocks.
geology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习地质学，经常去徒步观察岩石。

geometry.example: In geometry class today, we learned how to find the area of a triangle.
geometry.exampleZh: 今天的几何课上，我们学习了如何求三角形的面积。

geriatric.example: The hospital has a special ward for geriatric patients who need extra care.
geriatric.exampleZh: 这家医院有一个专门的病房，收治需要额外照护的老年患者。

germ.example: Wash your hands to stop germs from spreading to other people.
germ.exampleZh: 勤洗手可以阻止细菌传播给其他人。

german.example: My German friend speaks English and Chinese very well.
german.exampleZh: 我的德国朋友英语和中文都说得很好。

germane.example: Your question is not germane to the topic we are discussing today.
germane.exampleZh: 你的问题与我们今天讨论的话题无关。

germinate.example: The seeds will germinate quickly if you keep the soil warm and wet.
germinate.exampleZh: 如果你保持土壤温暖湿润，这些种子很快就会发芽。

gesture.example: She made a gesture with her hand to show me the way.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了个手势给我指路。

get.example: I hope to get a good grade on the test tomorrow.
get.exampleZh: 我希望明天的考试能取得好成绩。

geyser.example: The geyser near the hotel shoots hot water into the air every hour.
geyser.exampleZh: 旅馆附近的间歇泉每小时都会把热水喷向空中。

ghastly.example: The accident left a ghastly mark on the old road.
ghastly.exampleZh: 那场事故在这条旧路上留下了一个可怕的痕迹。

ghost.example: She says she saw a ghost in the old house last night.
ghost.exampleZh: 她说她昨晚在那栋老房子里看到了一个鬼。

giant.example: A giant tree stands in the middle of the small village.
giant.exampleZh: 一棵巨大的树矗立在这个小村庄的中央。

gift.example: My best friend gave me a beautiful gift for my birthday.
gift.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友为我的生日送了我一份漂亮的礼物。

gigantic.example: The new stadium is gigantic, and it can hold thousands of people.
gigantic.exampleZh: 这座新体育场非常巨大，可以容纳数千人。

gild.example: They gilded the old frame to make it look more valuable.
gild.exampleZh: 他们给旧画框镀了金，让它看起来更值钱。

gill.example: The fish takes in water through its mouth and pushes it out through the gills.
gill.exampleZh: 鱼从嘴里吸水，再通过鳃把水排出去。

gilt.example: The old mirror had a gilt frame that looked bright in the sun.
gilt.exampleZh: 那面旧镜子的镀金边框在阳光下看起来很亮。

ginger.example: My mother puts fresh ginger in the soup to make it taste better.
ginger.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放新鲜生姜，让它味道更好。

giraffe.example: The giraffe at the zoo has a very long neck.
giraffe.exampleZh: 动物园里的那只长颈鹿脖子很长。

girl.example: The little girl is playing with her dog in the park.
girl.exampleZh: 那个小女孩正在公园里和她的狗玩耍。

girth.example: The nurse measured the girth of his waist with a tape.
girth.exampleZh: 护士用卷尺量了他的腰围。

give.example: Can you give me a glass of water, please?

glacier.example: The glacier moves slowly down the valley and melts in summer.
glacier.exampleZh: 这条冰川沿着山谷缓慢移动，并在夏天融化。

glad.example: I am very glad to see you again today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天再次见到你，我非常高兴。

glade.example: We stopped to rest in a quiet glade near the river.
glade.exampleZh: 我们在河边一处安静的林间空地上停下来休息。

glamour.example: The old city has a special glamour that attracts many young visitors.
glamour.exampleZh: 这座老城有一种特殊的魅力，吸引着许多年轻游客。

glance.example: She gave the letter a quick glance and smiled.
glance.exampleZh: 她快速瞥了一眼那封信，然后笑了。

glare.example: The driver gave me an angry glare when I crossed the road slowly.
glare.exampleZh: 我慢慢过马路时，那位司机愤怒地瞪了我一眼。

glass.example: Please be careful with that glass because it can break easily.
glass.exampleZh: 请小心那个玻璃杯，因为它很容易碎。

glaze.example: The potter will glaze the bowl before the final baking.
glaze.exampleZh: 陶艺师会在最后烘烤前给碗上釉。

gleam.example: A gleam of light came through the small window of the old house.
gleam.exampleZh: 一道微光透过老房子的小窗户照了进来。

glean.example: We gleaned useful facts from the old letters.
glean.exampleZh: 我们从那些旧信件中慢慢收集到了有用的事实。

glen.example: We walked through a quiet glen full of tall green trees.
glen.exampleZh: 我们走过一个安静的山谷，那里长满了高大的绿树。

glide.example: The bird began to glide slowly over the quiet lake.
glide.exampleZh: 那只鸟开始在安静的湖面上缓缓滑翔。

glimmer.example: A glimmer of light appeared under the door in the dark room.
glimmer.exampleZh: 黑暗的房间里，门缝下出现了一线微光。

glimpse.example: I caught a quick glimpse of the deer before it ran away.
glimpse.exampleZh: 在鹿跑开之前，我匆匆瞥见了它一眼。

glint.example: A glint of light came from the lake as the sun went down.
glint.exampleZh: 太阳落下时，湖面上闪着一道微光。

glisten.example: Her eyes glistened in the candlelight as she read the old letter.
glisten.exampleZh: 她读那封信时，眼睛在烛光下闪闪发亮。

glitch.example: A small glitch in the system stopped the game for a few seconds.
glitch.exampleZh: 系统里的一个小故障让游戏停止了几秒钟。

glitter.example: The stars glitter in the cold night sky above the quiet town.
glitter.exampleZh: 星星在安静小镇上方寒冷的夜空中闪闪发光。

gloat.example: He gloated over his rival's mistake instead of helping him.
gloat.exampleZh: 他对对手的错误幸灾乐祸，而不是去帮他。

global.example: Global trade is growing fast and touches almost every country on the map.
global.exampleZh: 全球贸易正在快速增长，几乎涉及地图上的每一个国家。

globe.example: People from every corner of the globe came to watch the Olympic Games.
globe.exampleZh: 来自世界各地的人们前来观看奥运会。

gloom.example: A deep gloom filled the room after we heard the bad news.
gloom.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，一种深深的忧郁笼罩了整个房间。

gloomy.example: The room was dark and gloomy, so we turned on all the lights.
gloomy.exampleZh: 房间又暗又阴沉，于是我们把所有的灯都打开了。

glorify.example: Some movies glorify war and make young people want to fight.
glorify.exampleZh: 有些电影美化战争，让年轻人想要去打仗。

glory.example: The soldiers won great glory for their country in the war.
glory.exampleZh: 士兵们在战争中为他们的国家赢得了巨大的荣誉。

gloss.example: The old table still has a nice gloss after years of use.
gloss.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子用了多年之后仍然有着漂亮的光泽。

glossy.example: Her glossy hair shines brightly in the morning sun.
glossy.exampleZh: 她光泽的头发在晨光中闪闪发亮。

glove.example: I wear a warm glove on each hand when it snows.
glove.exampleZh: 下雪时我每只手上都戴一只暖和的手套。

glow.example: Her face began to glow with joy when she saw the gift.
glow.exampleZh: 她看到礼物时，脸上洋溢着喜悦的光彩。

glucose.example: Plants make glucose from sunlight, water, and air during photosynthesis.
glucose.exampleZh: 植物在光合作用中利用阳光、水和空气制造葡萄糖。

glue.example: I need some glue to fix this broken cup.
glue.exampleZh: 我需要一些胶水来修这个破杯子。

glum.example: She looked glum after hearing the bad news about her exam.
glum.exampleZh: 听到考试的不幸消息后，她显得闷闷不乐。

gnarled.example: The old tree had gnarled branches that twisted in every direction.
gnarled.exampleZh: 那棵老树的树枝粗糙多瘤，向四面八方扭曲生长。

gnaw.example: The dog likes to gnaw on a bone every afternoon.
gnaw.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢每天下午啃骨头。

gnome.example: The old story says a gnome lives under the garden and guards the flowers.
gnome.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事说，一个土地神住在花园下面，守护着花朵。

go.example: I go to school by bus every morning.
go.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公交车去学校。

goad.example: Her constant teasing goaded him into finishing the work early.
goad.exampleZh: 她不断的取笑刺激他提早完成了工作。

goal.example: My main goal this year is to learn English well.
goal.exampleZh: 我今年的主要目标是学好英语。

goat.example: The goat is eating grass on the hill near our house.
goat.exampleZh: 那只山羊正在我们家附近的山坡上吃草。

god.example: In many old stories, people pray to a god for help.
god.exampleZh: 在许多古老的故事里，人们会向神祈祷寻求帮助。

goddess.example: In the old story, the goddess helped the farmers bring water to their fields.
goddess.exampleZh: 在那个古老的故事里，女神帮助农民们把水引到田地里。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger and smiled at everyone.
gold.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚金戒指，对每个人微笑。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning at the club.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天早上都和朋友们在俱乐部打高尔夫球。

good.example: She is very good at math and always helps her friends after school.
good.exampleZh: 她数学很好，放学后总是帮助朋友们。

goose.example: The old farmer keeps a white goose and two small ducks.
goose.exampleZh: 那位老农养了一只白鹅和两只小鸭子。

gore.example: The bull's horns were covered with gore after the fight.
gore.exampleZh: 那头公牛打架后，角上沾满了血污。

gorge.example: The river runs through a deep gorge between the two mountains.
gorge.exampleZh: 这条河穿过两座山之间的一道深峡谷。

gorgeous.example: The garden looks gorgeous in the morning sun.
gorgeous.exampleZh: 花园在晨光中看起来美极了。

gory.example: The movie tells a gory story about a cruel king and his many victims.
gory.exampleZh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于残酷国王及其众多受害者的血腥故事。

gospel.example: She shared the gospel of kindness with everyone she met.
gospel.exampleZh: 她把善良这一信条分享给每一个她遇到的人。

gossip.example: She loves to gossip about her neighbors every morning at the bus stop.
gossip.exampleZh: 她每天早上在公交站都喜欢说邻居的闲话。

govern.example: The new rules will govern how students use phones in school.
govern.exampleZh: 新规定将管理学生在学校使用手机的方式。

government.example: The government plans to build a new school in our town next year.
government.exampleZh: 政府计划明年在我们镇上建一所新学校。

governor.example: The governor visited our school and spoke to the students yesterday.
governor.exampleZh: 州长昨天参观了我们学校并与学生们交谈。

gown.example: She wore a long blue gown to the wedding last night.
gown.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一件蓝色长礼服去参加婚礼。

grab.example: She grabbed her bag and ran to catch the bus.
grab.exampleZh: 她抓起包就跑，赶去搭公交车。

grace.example: She moved across the room with such grace that everyone stopped to watch.
grace.exampleZh: 她以如此优雅的姿态穿过房间，以至于所有人都停下来观看。

gracious.example: The gracious host welcomed every guest with a warm smile.
gracious.exampleZh: 这位亲切的主人用温暖的微笑迎接每一位客人。

grade.example: My sister is in grade five and she gets good grades in math.
grade.exampleZh: 我妹妹上五年级，她数学成绩很好。

gradient.example: The hill has a steep gradient, so walking up takes a lot of energy.
gradient.exampleZh: 这座山的坡度很陡，所以往上走要花很多力气。

gradual.example: The change in weather was gradual, so nobody felt cold at first.
gradual.exampleZh: 天气的变化是逐渐的，所以一开始没有人觉得冷。

graduate.example: My sister will graduate from high school next June, and she plans to study art in college.
graduate.exampleZh: 我姐姐明年六月将从高中毕业，她打算在大学学习艺术。

grain.example: This bread is made from whole grain, so it is healthy.
grain.exampleZh: 这个面包由全谷物制成，因此很健康。

gram.example: I need two hundred grams of sugar for this cake.
gram.exampleZh: 做这个蛋糕我需要两百克糖。

grammar.example: I often make small mistakes in English grammar.
grammar.exampleZh: 我经常在英语语法上犯小错误。

granary.example: The farmers stored their wheat in the old granary near the river.
granary.exampleZh: 农民们把小麦存放在河边那座旧谷仓里。

grand.example: The old hotel has a grand entrance and a large garden.
grand.exampleZh: 这家老酒店有一个宏伟的入口和一个大花园。

grant.example: The school granted her a small grant to study music in Europe.
grant.exampleZh: 学校授予她一笔小额补助金，让她去欧洲学习音乐。

grape.example: My mother buys fresh grapes from the market every Sunday morning.
grape.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天早上都从市场买新鲜葡萄。

graph.example: The graph shows how the temperature changes during the day.
graph.exampleZh: 这张图表显示了白天温度的变化。

graphic.example: The teacher gave a graphic description of the storm in class.
graphic.exampleZh: 老师在课堂上对那场暴风雨做了生动的描述。

grasp.example: She could not grasp the main idea of the lesson at first.
grasp.exampleZh: 她一开始没能理解这节课的主要意思。

grass.example: The children are playing on the grass in the park.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在公园的草地上玩耍。

grate.example: The loud noise can grate on your nerves after a while.
grate.exampleZh: 这种噪音过一会儿就会让你心烦。

grateful.example: I am very grateful for all the help you gave me last week.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感激你上周给我的所有帮助。

gratitude.example: I want to show my gratitude to you for all your help.
gratitude.exampleZh: 我想向你表达我的感激，感谢你所有的帮助。

grave.example: The doctor said his illness was grave, so we were all very serious.
grave.exampleZh: 医生说他的病情很严重，所以我们都很严肃。

gravity.example: The apple fell to the ground because of gravity.
gravity.exampleZh: 苹果因为重力而掉到了地上。

gravy.example: The roast beef was served with hot gravy and fresh bread.
gravy.exampleZh: 烤牛肉配上了热肉汁和新鲜面包。

gray.example: The sky looks gray and sad before the rain comes.
gray.exampleZh: 下雨前天空看起来灰蒙蒙的，让人感到压抑。

graze.example: The cows graze in the field near the river every morning.
graze.exampleZh: 牛每天早上在河边的田野里吃草。

grease.example: The mechanic put grease on the wheel to make it turn easily.
grease.exampleZh: 机械师在轮子上涂了润滑脂，让它转动得更顺畅。

great.example: She is a great teacher and all her students love her class.
great.exampleZh: 她是一位伟大的老师，所有学生都喜欢她的课。

greed.example: His greed for money made him lose all his friends.
greed.exampleZh: 他对金钱的贪婪让他失去了所有朋友。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cookies before dinner.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在晚饭前把所有饼干都吃了。

greek.example: My friend is Greek and she taught me a few simple words.
greek.exampleZh: 我的朋友是希腊人，她教了我几个简单的词。

green.example: The green leaves look fresh after the rain, and the children play under the tree.
green.exampleZh: 雨后绿叶看起来很清新，孩子们在树下玩耍。

greenhouse.example: The old greenhouse is full of tomatoes and small green plants.
greenhouse.exampleZh: 这个旧温室里满是西红柿和小绿植。

greet.example: She smiled and greeted each guest at the door.
greet.exampleZh: 她微笑着在门口迎接每一位客人。

grief.example: She could not hide her grief when her old dog died.
grief.exampleZh: 她的老狗去世时，她无法掩饰自己的悲伤。

grieve.example: She still grieves for her old dog after all these years.
grieve.exampleZh: 这么多年过去了，她仍然为她的老狗感到悲伤。

grill.example: We put the fish on the grill and cooked it for ten minutes.
grill.exampleZh: 我们把鱼放在烤架上烤了十分钟。

grim.example: The news about the accident was grim and made everyone very quiet.
grim.exampleZh: 关于那场事故的消息很严酷，让大家都很沉默。

grin.example: She grinned at me when she heard the good news.
grin.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她冲我咧嘴笑了笑。

grind.example: She grinds the coffee beans every morning before she goes to work.
grind.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前磨咖啡豆。

grip.example: She gripped the rope hard and pulled herself up the wall.
grip.exampleZh: 她紧紧抓住绳子，把自己拉上了墙。

groan.example: The old man gave a loud groan when he stood up.
groan.exampleZh: 老人站起来时大声呻吟了一声。

grocery.example: I stop at the grocery on my way home to buy milk and bread.
grocery.exampleZh: 我回家路上会去食品杂货店买牛奶和面包。

groom.example: The groom brushed the horse before the wedding.
groom.exampleZh: 新郎在婚礼前给马梳了毛。

groove.example: The needle sits in the groove and plays the old record.
groove.exampleZh: 唱针落在凹槽里，播放着那张旧唱片。

grope.example: She had to grope for the light switch in the dark room.
grope.exampleZh: 她不得不在黑暗的房间里摸索电灯开关。

gross.example: The gross weight of the box is ten kilos.
gross.exampleZh: 这个箱子的毛重是十公斤。

ground.example: The children are playing on the ground outside the school.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们正在学校外面的地上玩。

group.example: The teacher put the students into small groups to finish the work.
group.exampleZh: 老师把学生们分成小组来完成这项工作。

grouse.example: He often grouses about the cold weather, but he never complains about the food.
grouse.exampleZh: 他经常抱怨寒冷的天气，但从不抱怨食物。

grove.example: There is a small grove of apple trees behind our house.
grove.exampleZh: 我们家房子后面有一小片苹果树林。

grow.example: Children grow taller and stronger when they eat well and sleep enough.
grow.exampleZh: 孩子们吃得好、睡得足，就会长得更高更壮。

growl.example: The big dog began to growl when a stranger came near the gate.
growl.exampleZh: 当陌生人走近大门时，那只大狗开始低吼。

growth.example: The growth of the small company surprised everyone in the town.
growth.exampleZh: 这家小公司的增长让镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

grub.example: The birds dig in the soil to find grubs and small worms.
grub.exampleZh: 鸟儿在泥土里翻找蛆虫和小虫子。

grudge.example: She still holds a grudge against her old boss for firing her.
grudge.exampleZh: 她仍然因为被解雇而怨恨她的旧老板。

grumble.example: He likes to grumble about the weather and the traffic every morning.
grumble.exampleZh: 他每天早上都喜欢抱怨天气和交通。

grunt.example: He grunted a few words and went back to his work.
grunt.exampleZh: 他咕哝了几句，就回去继续干活了。

guarantee.example: We guarantee all our products for one year if you keep the receipt.
guarantee.exampleZh: 如果您保留收据，我们为所有产品保修一年。

guard.example: Two soldiers guard the gate at night and stay alert.
guard.exampleZh: 两名士兵在夜里守卫大门并保持警惕。

guess.example: I guess she will come to the party tonight.
guess.exampleZh: 我想她今晚会来参加聚会。

guest.example: We had a guest stay with us for two nights last week.
guest.exampleZh: 上周有一位客人在我们家住了两晚。

guidance.example: The teacher gave me useful guidance on how to write my report.
guidance.exampleZh: 老师就如何写报告给了我有用的指导。

guide.example: A local guide showed us the way to the old temple.
guide.exampleZh: 一位当地向导给我们指了去古庙的路。

guideline.example: The company issued a new guideline for using email at work.
guideline.exampleZh: 公司发布了关于工作中使用电子邮件的新准则。

guild.example: The old guild helped its members find work and learn new skills.
guild.exampleZh: 这个古老的行会帮助其成员找到工作并学习新技能。

guilt.example: He felt a deep sense of guilt after he lied to his mother.
guilt.exampleZh: 他对母亲撒谎后感到深深的内疚。

guilty.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his mother's birthday last week.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为上周忘记母亲的生日而感到内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after he finishes his homework.
guitar.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天傍晚做完作业后都会弹吉他。

gulf.example: There is a growing gulf between the rich and the poor.
gulf.exampleZh: 富人与穷人之间的鸿沟日益加深。

gull.example: A gull flew low over the quiet harbor and landed on a wooden boat.
gull.exampleZh: 一只海鸥低低地飞过安静的港口，落在了木船上。

gum.example: The dentist told me to stop chewing gum because it hurts my gums.
gum.exampleZh: 牙医让我别再嚼口香糖了，因为这让我的牙龈疼。

gun.example: The police officer put the gun back in the locked box.
gun.exampleZh: 警察把枪放回了上锁的箱子里。

gust.example: A sudden gust of wind blew her hat off.
gust.exampleZh: 一阵突如其来的强风把她的帽子吹掉了。

gut.example: She trusted her gut and said no to the risky deal.
gut.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，拒绝了那笔有风险的交易。

guy.example: That guy at the front desk was very friendly and helpful.
guy.exampleZh: 前台那个家伙非常友好，也很乐于助人。

gym.example: I go to the gym with my friends after school on Fridays.
gym.exampleZh: 我每周五放学后和朋友们去健身房。

gymnasium.example: The new gymnasium next to our school has two basketball courts.
gymnasium.exampleZh: 我们学校旁边的新体育馆有两个篮球场。

habit.example: It is a good habit to drink water every morning.
habit.exampleZh: 每天早上喝水是一个好习惯。

habitable.example: This old house is still habitable after the storm.
habitable.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨过后，这座老房子仍然可以住人。

habitat.example: The panda's natural habitat is the mountain forest.
habitat.exampleZh: 熊猫的天然栖息地是山林。

habitual.example: His habitual late arrival made the whole team wait every morning.
habitual.exampleZh: 他习惯性的迟到让整个团队每天早上都要等他。

habituate.example: Farm animals habituate quickly to the noise of the machines.
habituate.exampleZh: 农场里的动物很快就会习惯机器的噪音。

hack.example: Someone tried to hack into the company computers last night.
hack.exampleZh: 昨晚有人试图非法入侵公司的电脑。

hacker.example: A young hacker broke into the company system and stole some secret files.
hacker.exampleZh: 一名年轻黑客闯入了公司系统，窃取了一些机密文件。

haggard.example: After three sleepless nights, she looked pale and haggard in the morning light.
haggard.exampleZh: 三个不眠之夜后，她在晨光中显得苍白而憔悴。

haggle.example: She likes to haggle with the seller over the price of fresh fruit.
haggle.exampleZh: 她喜欢为新鲜水果的价格和卖家讨价还价。

hail.example: The children ran outside to hail the first snow of the year.
hail.exampleZh: 孩子们跑到外面欢呼今年的第一场雪。

hair.example: She washes her hair every morning before she goes to work.
hair.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会洗头发。

haircut.example: I need a haircut before I go to the party.
haircut.exampleZh: 去参加聚会之前我需要理个发。

hairdo.example: She got a new hairdo before the party on Saturday.
hairdo.exampleZh: 她在周六的聚会前做了个新发型。

hairy.example: My uncle has hairy arms and a very loud laugh.
hairy.exampleZh: 我叔叔手臂上毛发很多。他笑声很大。

halcyon.example: She often thinks back to the halcyon days of her childhood in the countryside.
halcyon.exampleZh: 她常常回想起童年在乡下那段平静美好的日子。

hale.example: My grandfather is still hale and active at ninety years old.
hale.exampleZh: 我爷爷九十岁了依然健壮而活跃。

half.example: I ate half of the cake and saved the other half for my sister.
half.exampleZh: 我吃了一半蛋糕，把另一半留给了我妹妹。

halfhearted.example: His halfhearted apology did not convince anyone in the room.
halfhearted.exampleZh: 他半心半意的道歉没有说服房间里的任何人。

halfway.example: We stopped halfway up the hill to rest and drink some water.
halfway.exampleZh: 我们在半山腰停下来休息并喝了些水。

hall.example: The students waited in the hall before the meeting began.
hall.exampleZh: 会议开始前，学生们在大厅里等候。

hallmark.example: A long waiting list is a hallmark of this popular restaurant.
hallmark.exampleZh: 长长的等候名单是这家热门餐厅的一个标志。

hallow.example: The old church was hallowed by centuries of prayer and song.
hallow.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂因数百年的祈祷与歌声而变得神圣。

hallucinate.example: When he was very tired, he began to hallucinate strange things in the dark.
hallucinate.exampleZh: 当他非常疲倦时，他开始在黑暗中产生幻觉，看到奇怪的东西。

hallucination.example: The medicine can cause hallucinations, so tell your doctor if you see things.
hallucination.exampleZh: 这种药可能引起幻觉，所以如果你看到不存在的东西，请告诉医生。

halt.example: The train came to a halt at the small station.

halter.example: She put a halter on the horse before the ride.
halter.exampleZh: 骑马前她给马戴上了缰绳。

halve.example: The company plans to halve its waste next year.
halve.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将废弃物减半。

ham.example: I like to eat ham and eggs for breakfast every morning.
ham.exampleZh: 我每天早上都喜欢吃火腿和鸡蛋。

hamburger.example: I ate a hamburger with my friends at lunch today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 今天午饭我和朋友们一起吃了一个汉堡包。

hamlet.example: The old man lived in a quiet hamlet near the river.
hamlet.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边一个安静的小村庄里。

hammer.example: He used a hammer to fix the broken chair in the old room.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用锤子修好了旧房间里那把坏椅子。

hamper.example: Heavy rain can hamper our plan to hike up the mountain tomorrow.
hamper.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们明天爬山的计划。

hand.example: Please hand the book to your sister; she needs it for class today.
hand.exampleZh: 请把书递给你姐姐，她今天上课要用。

handbill.example: A young man stood outside the station and gave me a colorful handbill.
handbill.exampleZh: 一个年轻人站在车站外，递给我一张彩色传单。

handbook.example: Please read the handbook before you start your first day at work.
handbook.exampleZh: 请在你第一天上班之前阅读这本手册。

handcuff.example: The police officer put a handcuff on the man's left wrist.
handcuff.exampleZh: 警察把一只手铐戴在了那个男人的左手腕上。

handful.example: Only a handful of students came to the class today.
handful.exampleZh: 今天只有少数几个学生来上课。

handicap.example: His poor eyesight is a handicap when he plays sports.
handicap.exampleZh: 视力不好是他参加体育运动时的一个障碍。

handiwork.example: Her beautiful garden is the handiwork of many years of patient care.
handiwork.exampleZh: 她那美丽的花园是多年耐心照料下的成果。

handle.example: She can handle this difficult problem without any help today.
handle.exampleZh: 她今天不需要任何帮助就能处理这个难题。

handmade.example: She gave me a handmade card for my birthday.
handmade.exampleZh: 她送给我一张手工制作的生日贺卡。

handout.example: The teacher gave each student a handout before the class began.
handout.exampleZh: 老师在开始上课前给每个学生发了一份讲义。

handshake.example: A firm handshake can show that you are friendly and sure of yourself.
handshake.exampleZh: 有力的握手可以表明你友好且自信。

handsome.example: The tall man next to me is quite handsome and very kind.
handsome.exampleZh: 我旁边那位高个子男人相当英俊，而且非常善良。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so the teacher can read it easily.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的笔迹又小又工整，老师很容易看清。

handwritten.example: She gave me a handwritten letter for my birthday.
handwritten.exampleZh: 她给了我一张手写的生日信。

handy.example: This small dictionary is handy when I read English books.
handy.exampleZh: 这本小词典在我读英文书时很方便。

hang.example: She likes to hang her coat behind the door after work.
hang.exampleZh: 她喜欢下班后把外套挂在门后。

hangar.example: The plane was parked inside the hangar for repairs.
hangar.exampleZh: 飞机停在机库内进行维修。

hanging.example: The hanging of the old flag took only a few minutes.
hanging.exampleZh: 挂起那面旧旗只花了几分钟。

hangover.example: I had a bad hangover after the party last night.
hangover.exampleZh: 昨晚聚会后我宿醉得很厉害。

hansom.example: The old hansom waited by the station, and the driver smiled at us.
hansom.exampleZh: 那辆旧双轮马车等在车站旁，车夫朝我们微笑。

happen.example: Bad things can happen when you drive too fast on wet roads.
happen.exampleZh: 在湿滑的路上开得太快时，糟糕的事可能会发生。

harangue.example: My boss gave me a long harangue about being late again.
harangue.exampleZh: 老板又因为我迟到对我长篇训斥了一通。

harass.example: The boys often harass the new student after school.
harass.exampleZh: 那些男孩放学后经常骚扰那个新来的学生。

harassment.example: She told her boss about the harassment at work last week.
harassment.exampleZh: 她上周把工作中受到的骚扰告诉了老板。

harbinger.example: Dark clouds are often a harbinger of a heavy storm.
harbinger.exampleZh: 乌云常常是暴风雨的预兆。

harbor.example: The old harbor is quiet at night, and she still harbors hope.
harbor.exampleZh: 旧港口夜晚很安静，而她仍怀有希望。

hard.example: This bread is very hard, so please cut it slowly.
hard.exampleZh: 这块面包很硬，请慢慢地切。

harden.example: The cold weather made the soft ground harden quickly last night.
harden.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气让松软的地面在昨晚很快变硬了。

hardly.example: I could hardly hear him because the room was very noisy.
hardly.exampleZh: 我几乎听不见他说话，因为房间里非常吵。

hardship.example: Many families faced great hardship during the war years.
hardship.exampleZh: 许多家庭在战争年代经历了巨大的艰难。

hardware.example: The store sells tools, nails and other hardware for building work.
hardware.exampleZh: 这家商店出售工具、钉子和其他建筑用的五金器具。

hardworking.example: She is a hardworking student who always finishes her homework on time.
hardworking.exampleZh: 她是个勤劳的学生，总是按时完成作业。

hardy.example: These hardy plants can grow well in cold and dry weather.
hardy.exampleZh: 这些耐寒的植物在寒冷干燥的天气里也能生长得很好。

hare.example: A hare ran quickly across the field and disappeared into the tall grass.
hare.exampleZh: 一只野兔飞快地跑过田野，消失在深草丛中。

harken.example: You should harken to your parents when they give you good advice.
harken.exampleZh: 当父母给你好的建议时，你应该听从他们的话。

harm.example: Too much sun can harm your skin, so use sunscreen every day.
harm.exampleZh: 过多的阳光会伤害你的皮肤，所以每天都要涂防晒霜。

harmful.example: Too much sugar is harmful to your teeth and body.
harmful.exampleZh: 吃太多糖对你的牙齿和身体都有害。

harmless.example: These small snakes look scary but they are completely harmless to people.
harmless.exampleZh: 这些蛇看起来吓人，但对人完全无害。

harmonious.example: The small village is a harmonious place where everyone helps each other.
harmonious.exampleZh: 这个小村庄是一个和谐的地方，大家互相帮助。

harmonize.example: The two teams worked hard to harmonize their plans before the meeting.
harmonize.exampleZh: 两个团队在会议前努力协调他们的计划。

harmony.example: The two brothers live in harmony even though they share a small room.
harmony.exampleZh: 尽管兄弟俩共用一个小房间，他们仍然和睦相处。

harness.example: We can harness the power of the sun to heat our homes.
harness.exampleZh: 我们可以利用太阳能来为家里供暖。

harp.example: She plays the harp and often harps on about her busy day.
harp.exampleZh: 她弹竖琴，还常常唠叨自己忙碌的一天。

harpoon.example: The sailor threw a harpoon at the large whale near the boat.
harpoon.exampleZh: 水手朝船附近的大鲸鱼投出了鱼叉。

harrow.example: The farmer used a heavy machine to harrow the field before planting.
harrow.exampleZh: 农民在播种前用一台重型机器耙地。

harsh.example: The winter here is harsh and the wind is very cold.
harsh.exampleZh: 这里的冬天很严酷，风也很冷。

harvest.example: The farmers will harvest the rice before the rain comes.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民们会在下雨前收割稻谷。

hassle.example: It is too much hassle to move all these boxes today.
hassle.exampleZh: 今天搬这些箱子太麻烦了。

haste.example: In her haste to catch the bus, she forgot her keys.
haste.exampleZh: 她匆忙赶公交车，忘了带钥匙。

hasten.example: She hastened to tell him the good news before he left.
hasten.exampleZh: 她赶在他离开前急忙把这个好消息告诉了他。

hasty.example: He made a hasty decision and later felt very sorry for it.
hasty.exampleZh: 他做了一个草率的决定，后来为此感到非常后悔。

hat.example: She wears a red hat when she goes out in winter.
hat.exampleZh: 冬天出门时，她戴一顶红色的帽子。

hatch.example: The birds hatch their eggs in spring, and the ship's hatch stays open.
hatch.exampleZh: 鸟儿在春天孵化它们的蛋，而船的舱口一直开着。

hatchet.example: He used a small hatchet to cut the dry branches into firewood.
hatchet.exampleZh: 他用一把短柄小斧把干树枝劈成柴火。

hate.example: I hate getting up early on cold winter mornings.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌在寒冷的冬天早晨早起。

hateful.example: It is hateful to treat a kind person so badly.
hateful.exampleZh: 如此恶劣地对待一个善良的人，真是令人憎恶。

haul.example: We had to haul the heavy boxes up the stairs this morning.
haul.exampleZh: 今天早上我们不得不把那些沉重的箱子拖上楼梯。

haunt.example: The old song still haunts me when I walk past that quiet house.
haunt.exampleZh: 当我走过那栋安静的房子时，那首老歌仍然萦绕在我的心头。

haven.example: The small fishing boats found a safe haven from the storm.
haven.exampleZh: 那些小渔船在风暴中找到了一个安全的避风港。

havoc.example: The storm caused great havoc in the small coastal town.
havoc.exampleZh: 暴风雨在这个沿海小镇造成了巨大的破坏。

hawk.example: A hawk flew high above the field and looked for small animals.
hawk.exampleZh: 一只鹰在田野上空高高飞翔，寻找小动物。

hawthorn.example: The old hawthorn in our garden turns red every autumn.
hawthorn.exampleZh: 我们花园里那棵老山楂树每到秋天就变红。

hay.example: The farmer put the dry hay in the barn to keep it safe.
hay.exampleZh: 农民把干草放进谷仓里，以保证它安全。

hazard.example: Driving in heavy snow is a serious hazard for young drivers.
hazard.exampleZh: 在大雪中开车对年轻司机来说是一个严重的危险。

hazardous.example: This old road is hazardous for cars at night.
hazardous.exampleZh: 这条旧路在夜间对汽车来说很危险。

haze.example: A thick haze covered the city this morning.
haze.exampleZh: 今天早上，一层厚厚的雾霾笼罩着这座城市。

hazy.example: The mountains were hazy in the early morning light.
hazy.exampleZh: 清晨的光线中，群山显得朦胧。

head.example: She turned her head and smiled at the man behind her.
head.exampleZh: 她转过头，对身后的男人笑了笑。

headache.example: I had a bad headache this morning, so I stayed in bed.
headache.exampleZh: 今天早上我头痛得厉害，所以一直躺在床上。

heading.example: The heading at the top of the page tells readers what the report is about.
heading.exampleZh: 页面顶端的标题告诉读者这份报告是关于什么的。

headline.example: The headline on the front page caught my eye this morning.
headline.exampleZh: 今天早上头版的大字标题吸引了我的注意。

headlong.example: He made a headlong decision to quit his job without another plan.
headlong.exampleZh: 他轻率地决定辞职，却没有其他计划。

headphone.example: I put on my headphone to listen to music in the quiet room.
headphone.exampleZh: 我戴上耳机，在安静的房间里听音乐。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a new city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 这家公司去年把总部搬到了一个新的城市。

headway.example: We are making good headway on the new project this week.
headway.exampleZh: 本周我们在新项目上取得了不错的进展。

headwind.example: The strong headwind made the bike ride much harder than before.
headwind.exampleZh: 强劲的逆风让这次骑行比以前困难得多。

heady.example: The heady smell of fresh flowers made everyone in the room smile.
heady.exampleZh: 鲜花那令人陶醉的香气让房间里的每个人都笑了。

heal.example: Time can heal old wounds and help people forgive each other.
heal.exampleZh: 时间能治愈旧伤，也能帮助人们彼此原谅。

healer.example: The old healer used simple herbs to help the sick children.
healer.exampleZh: 那位年老的医治者用简单的草药帮助生病的孩子们。

healing.example: Time and rest play an important part in a person's healing.
healing.exampleZh: 时间和休息在一个人的康复过程中起着重要作用。

health.example: Good health is more important than money for most people.
health.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，健康比金钱更重要。

healthy.example: Eating fresh fruit and vegetables every day helps you stay healthy.
healthy.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果和蔬菜有助于你保持健康。

heap.example: He put the dirty clothes in a heap on the floor.
heap.exampleZh: 他把脏衣服堆成一堆放在地板上。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见窗外鸟儿在唱歌。

hearing.example: His hearing has gotten worse, so he needs to see a doctor soon.
hearing.exampleZh: 他的听力变差了，因此他需要尽快去看医生。

hearsay.example: The story about the new teacher was only hearsay, so nobody believed it.
hearsay.exampleZh: 关于新老师的说法只是传闻，所以没人相信。

heart.example: My heart beats fast when I run to school in the morning.
heart.exampleZh: 早上跑步去学校时，我的心跳得很快。

heartbreak.example: The loss of her old dog brought her great heartbreak.
heartbreak.exampleZh: 失去那只老狗让她极度伤心。

hearten.example: The good news heartened everyone in the team to keep working hard.
hearten.exampleZh: 这个好消息鼓舞了团队里的每个人继续努力。

heartfelt.example: She gave me a heartfelt thank you for my help.
heartfelt.exampleZh: 她对我的帮助表示了衷心的感谢。

hearth.example: The family sat by the hearth and told stories every winter night.
hearth.exampleZh: 每个冬天的夜晚，一家人坐在壁炉边讲故事。

heartily.example: She laughed heartily at the funny story her friend told.
heartily.exampleZh: 她听到朋友讲的搞笑故事，开心地大笑起来。

hearty.example: We gave the guests a hearty welcome and a hearty meal.
hearty.exampleZh: 我们热情地欢迎了客人，并招待了一顿丰盛的饭菜。

heat.example: The heat from the sun makes the room very warm.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量让房间变得非常暖和。

heated.example: After a heated discussion, the team finally agreed on a simple plan.
heated.exampleZh: 经过一番热烈的讨论，团队最终就一个简单的方案达成了一致。

heath.example: The sheep wandered across the open heath in the cool morning air.
heath.exampleZh: 羊群在清凉的晨风中漫步于开阔的荒地上。

heating.example: The heating in our old house does not work well in winter.
heating.exampleZh: 我们老房子的供暖在冬天效果不好。

heatstroke.example: He got heatstroke after playing football in the hot sun all afternoon.
heatstroke.exampleZh: 他在烈日下踢了一下午足球后中暑了。

heave.example: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck together.
heave.exampleZh: 他们一起用力把那个重箱子抬上了卡车。

heaven.example: She believes her kind grandmother is now in heaven.
heaven.exampleZh: 她相信善良的祖母现在在天堂里。

heavenly.example: The cake she made tasted heavenly, like something from a dream.
heavenly.exampleZh: 她做的蛋糕味道妙极了，就像梦里的美味一样。

heavy.example: This box is too heavy for me to carry upstairs.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不上楼。

heavyweight.example: The new coach is a heavyweight in the world of football.
heavyweight.exampleZh: 这位新教练是足球界的重量级人物。

heckle.example: Some people in the crowd began to heckle the speaker during his speech.
heckle.exampleZh: 人群中有些人开始在演讲者讲话时当众诘问他。

hectare.example: The farm covers about fifty hectares of land near the river.
hectare.exampleZh: 这个农场在河边占地约五十公顷。

hectic.example: It was a hectic day at work, but I still ate lunch.
hectic.exampleZh: 那天工作忙乱不堪，但我还是吃了午饭。

hedge.example: The farmer planted a hedge around his field to keep animals out.
hedge.exampleZh: 农民在田边种了一圈树篱，防止动物进入。

hedgehog.example: The hedgehog rolled into a ball when it saw the dog.
hedgehog.exampleZh: 刺猬看到狗时蜷成了一个球。

hedonism.example: His hedonism made him spend all his money on parties and travel.
hedonism.exampleZh: 他的享乐主义让他把所有钱都花在了派对和旅行上。

heed.example: Please heed the teacher's advice and read the notes before the test.
heed.exampleZh: 请听取老师的建议，在考试前阅读笔记。

heedless.example: He was heedless of the warning and walked into the busy road.
heedless.exampleZh: 他不顾警告，走上了繁忙的马路。

heel.example: My new shoes hurt my heel when I walk to school.
heel.exampleZh: 我穿着新鞋走路去学校时，脚后跟会疼。

hefty.example: He carried a hefty box up the stairs to his room.
hefty.exampleZh: 他把一个很重的箱子搬上楼，送到了自己的房间。

hegemony.example: The country used its economic power to keep hegemony over smaller neighbors.
hegemony.exampleZh: 这个国家利用其经济实力来保持对较小邻国的霸权。

heifer.example: The farmer kept one young heifer to grow into a milk cow.
heifer.exampleZh: 农夫留下一头小母牛，把它养大成为奶牛。

height.example: The height of the mountain is about two thousand meters.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度约为两千米。

heighten.example: The new lights heighten the colors of the paintings in the hall.
heighten.exampleZh: 新灯光使大厅里画作的颜色更加鲜明。

heinous.example: The judge said the heinous crime shocked the whole quiet town.
heinous.exampleZh: 法官说这桩十恶不赦的罪行震惊了整个宁静的小镇。

heir.example: The old man left his house to his only heir.
heir.exampleZh: 那位老人把他的房子留给了他唯一的继承人。

heirloom.example: My grandmother gave me this old ring as a family heirloom.
heirloom.exampleZh: 我祖母把这枚旧戒指作为传家宝送给了我。

helicopter.example: The helicopter flew low over the trees and landed in a field.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机低空飞过树林，降落在田野里。

helium.example: Helium is a light gas that makes balloons float in the air.
helium.exampleZh: 氦是一种轻气体，能让气球飘在空中。

hell.example: The old story says bad people go to hell after they die.
hell.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事说，坏人死后会下地狱。

hellhole.example: The old prison was a hellhole where many people suffered every single day.
hellhole.exampleZh: 那座旧监狱是一个人间地狱，许多人每天都在那里受苦。

hellish.example: The traffic jam on that hot day was a hellish experience for everyone.
hellish.exampleZh: 那个炎热的日子里的交通堵塞对每个人来说都是一次地狱般的经历。

helm.example: She took the helm and guided the small boat safely home.
helm.exampleZh: 她接过舵，把小船安全地引回了家。

helmet.example: The workers must wear a helmet on the building site.
helmet.exampleZh: 工人在建筑工地上必须戴头盔。

helmsman.example: The old helmsman steered the ship safely through the storm last night.
helmsman.exampleZh: 老舵手昨晚安全地驾驶船只穿过风暴。

help.example: Can you help me carry these books to the classroom?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到教室吗？

helpful.example: This small dictionary is very helpful when I read English books.
helpful.exampleZh: 这本小词典在我读英文书时非常有用。

hem.example: She wore a white dress with a red hem.
hem.exampleZh: 她穿了一件带红色褶边的白色连衣裙。

hemisphere.example: The left hemisphere of the brain controls speech in most people.
hemisphere.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，大脑左半球控制语言。

hemp.example: In some countries, farmers grow hemp for its strong fibers.
hemp.exampleZh: 在一些国家，农民种植大麻以获取其坚韧的纤维。

hen.example: The hen lays a brown egg every morning on the farm.
hen.exampleZh: 这只母鸡每天早上在农场里下一个棕色的蛋。

hence.example: The road was closed, hence we had to take a longer route.
hence.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们不得不走更长的路线。

henceforth.example: Henceforth, please call me before you come to my house.
henceforth.exampleZh: 从此以后，请来我家之前先给我打个电话。

henna.example: She used henna to color her hair a bright brownish red.
henna.exampleZh: 她用海娜把头发染成明亮的棕红色。

henpecked.example: Everyone jokes that my henpecked uncle cannot make any decision without his wife.
henpecked.exampleZh: 大家都开玩笑说，我那位惧内的叔叔没有妻子点头就做不了任何决定。

herald.example: The early morning birds herald the start of a bright new day.
herald.exampleZh: 清晨的鸟儿预示着光明的 new 一天的开始。

herb.example: My mother grows a small herb garden beside the kitchen.
herb.exampleZh: 我妈妈在厨房旁边种了一小块药草园。

herbicide.example: Farmers use herbicide to keep the weeds out of their fields.
herbicide.exampleZh: 农民使用除草剂来清除田里的杂草。

herbivore.example: A cow is a large herbivore that eats grass all day.
herbivore.exampleZh: 牛是一种整天吃草的大型食草动物。

herd.example: The farmer leads his herd of cows to the field every morning.
herd.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上把牛群赶到田野里。

here.example: Please sit here and wait for your name to be called.
here.exampleZh: 请坐在这里，等着叫你的名字。

hereditary.example: This disease is hereditary, so it often passes from parent to child.
hereditary.exampleZh: 这种疾病是遗传的，因此常常从父母传给孩子。

heresy.example: In the past, people who spoke against the church were often accused of heresy.
heresy.exampleZh: 过去，那些反对教会的人常被指控为异端。

heretic.example: In the past, people with new ideas were sometimes called a heretic.
heretic.exampleZh: 在过去，有新想法的人有时会被称作异端分子。

heretical.example: The church punished him for his heretical ideas about the world.
heretical.exampleZh: 教会因他关于世界的异端思想而惩罚了他。

heritage.example: The old town is an important part of our cultural heritage.
heritage.exampleZh: 这座古城是我们文化遗产的重要部分。

hermetic.example: The food stays fresh because the jar has a hermetic seal on top.
hermetic.exampleZh: 食物能保持新鲜，因为罐子顶部有一个密封的盖子。

hermit.example: The old hermit lived alone in a small hut in the mountains.
hermit.exampleZh: 那位老隐士独自住在山里的一间小屋里。

hermitage.example: The old man lives in a quiet hermitage near the forest.
hermitage.exampleZh: 那位老人住在森林附近一处安静的隐居处。

hero.example: The young hero saved the whole village and everyone thanked him.
hero.exampleZh: 这位年轻的英雄救了整个村庄，大家都感谢他。

heroic.example: The firefighter made a heroic effort to save the family from the fire.
heroic.exampleZh: 消防员做出了英勇的努力，把一家人从火中救了出来。

heroine.example: The young heroine saved the village and became a hero to everyone.
heroine.exampleZh: 这位年轻的女英雄救了整个村庄，成了大家心目中的英雄。

heroism.example: Her heroism saved the lives of many people in the fire.
heroism.exampleZh: 她的英勇行为在火灾中拯救了许多人的生命。

herring.example: We ate fresh herring with potatoes for dinner last night.
herring.exampleZh: 昨晚晚餐我们吃了新鲜鲱鱼配土豆。

hesitant.example: She was hesitant to speak in front of the large class.
hesitant.exampleZh: 她在大班同学面前犹豫着不敢发言。

hesitate.example: Do not hesitate to ask me if you need any help.
hesitate.exampleZh: 如果你需要任何帮助，请不要犹豫来问我。

hesitation.example: After a moment of hesitation, she picked up the phone and called him.
hesitation.exampleZh: 犹豫了一会儿之后，她拿起电话打给了他。

heterodox.example: His heterodox ideas about education surprised many of the older teachers.
heterodox.exampleZh: 他关于教育的非正统想法让许多年长的教师感到惊讶。

heterogeneous.example: Our class is heterogeneous because it has students of many different ages and skills.
heterogeneous.exampleZh: 我们的班级是异质的，因为其中有年龄和能力各不相同的学生。

heuristic.example: The teacher used a heuristic method to help students find their own answers.
heuristic.exampleZh: 老师使用启发式的方法帮助学生自己找到答案。

hex.example: The old woman in the village was called a hex by the frightened children.
hex.exampleZh: 村里的孩子们害怕地称那位老妇人为巫婆。

hexagon.example: The bee builds its home in the shape of a hexagon.
hexagon.exampleZh: 蜜蜂把家筑成六边形的形状。

hexagonal.example: The honeycomb is made of many small hexagonal cells filled with honey.
hexagonal.exampleZh: 蜂巢由许多装满蜂蜜的小六边形巢室组成。

heyday.example: In its heyday, this small town had three busy factories.
heyday.exampleZh: 在全盛时期，这个小镇曾有三家繁忙的工厂。

hiatus.example: After a long hiatus, she returned to work with fresh energy.
hiatus.exampleZh: 经过长时间的中断后，她带着全新的精力回到了工作岗位。

hibernate.example: Bears sleep in caves and hibernate through the cold winter.
hibernate.exampleZh: 熊在洞穴里睡觉，整个寒冷的冬天都在冬眠。

hiccup.example: A small hiccup in the system delayed our work for an hour.
hiccup.exampleZh: 系统的一个小故障让我们的工作中断了一个小时。

hidden.example: There is a hidden door behind the old bookshelf.
hidden.exampleZh: 旧书架后面有一扇隐藏的门。

hide.example: She tried to hide the key under the old brown mat.
hide.exampleZh: 她试着把钥匙藏在那块旧的棕色垫子下面。

hideous.example: The old house looked hideous after the storm broke all its windows.
hideous.exampleZh: 暴风雨打碎了所有窗户后，那座老房子看起来丑陋极了。

hideout.example: The police found the thief's hideout in an old house.
hideout.exampleZh: 警察在一座旧房子里找到了小偷的躲藏处。

hierarchical.example: The company has a hierarchical structure with clear levels of power.
hierarchical.exampleZh: 这家公司有一个等级分明的结构，权力层级清晰。

hierarchy.example: The company has a clear hierarchy of managers and workers.
hierarchy.exampleZh: 这家公司有着明确的经理与员工等级制度。

high.example: The tall tree is higher than the small house next to it.
high.exampleZh: 那棵大树比它旁边的小房子高。

high-rise.example: They live in a new high-rise near the park in our city.
high-rise.exampleZh: 他们住在我们城市公园附近的一栋新高楼里。

highbrow.example: He thinks that reading difficult books makes him a highbrow.
highbrow.exampleZh: 他认为读难懂的书会让他显得是个高知。

highland.example: The highlands in the north are cool and green in summer.
highland.exampleZh: 北部的高地在夏天凉爽而翠绿。

highlight.example: The teacher used a red pen to highlight the most important words.
highlight.exampleZh: 老师用红笔标出了最重要的单词。

highly.example: The teacher thinks highly of her students and their hard work.
highly.exampleZh: 老师非常赞许她的学生和他们的努力。

highway.example: We drove along the highway for three hours to visit my grandparents.
highway.exampleZh: 我们沿着公路开了三个小时去探望我的祖父母。

hijack.example: Two men tried to hijack a plane and fly it to another country.
hijack.exampleZh: 两名男子试图劫持一架飞机并飞往另一个国家。

hike.example: We plan to hike in the mountains this weekend if the weather stays nice.
hike.exampleZh: 如果天气一直不错，我们打算这个周末去山里徒步。

hilarity.example: The party was full of hilarity as everyone laughed at the funny stories.
hilarity.exampleZh: 聚会上充满了欢闹，大家都被那些有趣的故事逗笑了。

hill.example: We walked up the green hill behind our house.
hill.exampleZh: 我们爬上了房子后面的绿色小山。

hillbilly.example: The old man laughed and said he was just a hillbilly from the mountains.
hillbilly.exampleZh: 老人笑着说，他不过是个从山里来的乡巴佬。

hilt.example: He held the sword by its hilt and raised it slowly.
hilt.exampleZh: 他握住剑柄，慢慢地把剑举了起来。

hind.example: The dog hurt its hind leg while jumping over the fence.
hind.exampleZh: 那只狗跳过栅栏时伤了后腿。

hinder.example: Heavy rain may hinder our work today.
hinder.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们今天的工作。

hindquarter.example: The butcher cut a large piece from the hindquarter of the cow.
hindquarter.exampleZh: 屠夫从牛的后臀切下了一大块肉。

hindrance.example: The heavy rain was a hindrance to our trip.
hindrance.exampleZh: 大雨成了我们旅行的阻碍。

hindsight.example: In hindsight, I should have studied harder for the exam.
hindsight.exampleZh: 事后想来，我当初应该更努力地准备考试。

hinge.example: The success of our plan will hinge on how well the team works together.
hinge.exampleZh: 我们计划能否成功，将取决于团队合作得有多好。

hint.example: Please give me a small hint about the answer to this question.
hint.exampleZh: 请给我一点关于这个问题的答案的提示。

hinterland.example: The small town lies in the hinterland and is far from the busy coast.
hinterland.exampleZh: 这个小镇位于内地，远离繁忙的沿海地区。

hip.example: My grandmother fell and hurt her hip, but she is fine now.
hip.exampleZh: 我奶奶摔倒伤了髋部，但她现在没事了。

hippie.example: The hippie wore long hair and colorful clothes at the music festival.
hippie.exampleZh: 那个嬉皮士在音乐节上留着长发、穿着色彩鲜艳的衣服。

hippo.example: The hippo in the river has a very big mouth.
hippo.exampleZh: 河里的那只河马有一张非常大的嘴。

hire.example: We decided to hire a car for the weekend trip.
hire.exampleZh: 我们决定为周末的旅行租一辆车。

histogram.example: The report shows the test scores in a simple histogram.
histogram.exampleZh: 这份报告用一个简单的直方图展示了考试分数。

historian.example: The historian wrote a short book about life in the old city.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于老城生活的短书。

historic.example: This is a historic day for our small town.
historic.exampleZh: 对我们这个小镇来说，这是具有历史意义的一天。

historical.example: This old building has great historical value for our city.
historical.exampleZh: 这座老建筑对我们的城市具有重大的历史价值。

history.example: She likes to read about the history of our town.
history.exampleZh: 她喜欢阅读我们小镇的历史。

histrionic.example: She gave a histrionic speech about her broken phone.
histrionic.exampleZh: 她就手机坏了这件事发表了一番戏剧化的讲话。

hit.example: The ball hit the window and everyone in the room heard it.
hit.exampleZh: 球击中了窗户，房间里的每个人都听到了。

hitch.example: He tried to hitch a ride to the next town before dark.
hitch.exampleZh: 他试图在天黑前搭便车去下一个镇。

hitchhike.example: They decided to hitchhike across the country during their summer holiday.
hitchhike.exampleZh: 他们决定在暑假期间搭便车穿越全国。

hitherto.example: Hitherto, we have only met once, but we talk every day now.
hitherto.exampleZh: 迄今为止，我们只见过一次面，但现在每天都聊天。

hive.example: The busy market was a hive of noise and color all morning.
hive.exampleZh: 这个繁忙的市场整个上午都是一个喧闹纷杂的场所。

hoard.example: Squirrels hoard nuts in trees before winter comes.
hoard.exampleZh: 松鼠在冬天来临前把坚果囤积在树上。

hoarse.example: My voice was hoarse after I shouted at the game all afternoon.
hoarse.exampleZh: 我在比赛现场喊了一下午后，嗓子都嘶哑了。

hoary.example: The hoary old man told us a story about the mountain.
hoary.exampleZh: 那位头发灰白的老人给我们讲了一个关于这座山的故事。

hobby.example: My favorite hobby is reading books after school.
hobby.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的业余爱好是放学后读书。

hock.example: The old horse has a small cut on its hock.
hock.exampleZh: 那匹老马的蹄骨上有一个小伤口。

hockey.example: My brother plays hockey with his friends every Saturday morning.
hockey.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六早上都和他的朋友们打曲棍球。

hoe.example: The farmer used a hoe to turn the hard soil in the garden.
hoe.exampleZh: 农民用锄头翻松了花园里坚硬的土壤。

hog.example: The farmer keeps a fat hog in the small pen behind his house.
hog.exampleZh: 农夫在他房子后面的小围栏里养着一头肥猪。

hoist.example: They used a hoist to lift the heavy box onto the truck.
hoist.exampleZh: 他们用起重机把那个沉重的箱子吊到卡车上。

hold.example: She will hold the small box in her hands during the trip.
hold.exampleZh: 旅行期间她会把小盒子捧在手里。

holder.example: She is the holder of the key to the small box.
holder.exampleZh: 她是这个小盒子钥匙的持有者。

hole.example: The rabbit ran into a hole under the big tree.
hole.exampleZh: 兔子跑进了大树下面的一个洞里。

holiday.example: We are going to the beach for our summer holiday next week.
holiday.exampleZh: 下周我们要去海边过暑假。

holistic.example: We need a holistic view of the problem before we make any changes.
holistic.exampleZh: 在做出任何改变之前，我们需要对这个问题有一个整体的看法。

hollow.example: The old tree has a hollow trunk where small animals live.
hollow.exampleZh: 这棵老树的树干是空心的，小动物就住在里面。

holly.example: A bright red berry grew on the holly near our front door.
holly.exampleZh: 我们家前门旁的冬青树上结了一颗鲜红的浆果。

holocaust.example: The museum teaches children about the holocaust so that history is never repeated.
holocaust.exampleZh: 博物馆向孩子们讲述那场大屠杀，让历史永不重演。

hologram.example: The museum showed a hologram of the ancient king.
hologram.exampleZh: 博物馆展示了一位古代国王的全息图。

holster.example: The police officer put his gun back in the leather holster.
holster.exampleZh: 警察把枪放回皮革手枪皮套里。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

homage.example: The young soldiers paid homage to the king.
homage.exampleZh: 年轻的士兵们向国王表示敬意。

home.example: She felt happy to be home with her family again.
home.exampleZh: 她再次和家人回到家中，感到很幸福。

homecoming.example: Our school holds a big homecoming every autumn with games and music.
homecoming.exampleZh: 我们学校每年秋天都会举办一场有比赛和音乐的盛大返校节。

homeland.example: He returned to his homeland after living abroad for ten years.
homeland.exampleZh: 在国外生活十年后，他回到了祖国。

homeless.example: The homeless man slept on a bench in the park last night.
homeless.exampleZh: 那个无家可归的人昨晚睡在公园的长椅上。

homely.example: Her homely cooking always makes me feel warm and happy.
homely.exampleZh: 她家常的饭菜总是让我感到温暖和快乐。

homesick.example: She felt homesick on her first night in the new city.
homesick.exampleZh: 她在新城市的第一个晚上就想家了。

homicide.example: The police said the man was charged with homicide after the fight.
homicide.exampleZh: 警方表示，那名男子在斗殴后因杀人罪被起诉。

homogeneous.example: The members of this club are homogeneous because they all share the same interests.
homogeneous.exampleZh: 这个俱乐部的成员是同质的，因为他们都有相同的兴趣。

homosexual.example: Many people think homosexual relationships should be treated with the same respect as any other.
homosexual.exampleZh: 许多人认为同性恋关系应当与其他任何关系得到同样的尊重。

honesty.example: Her honesty made everyone in the team trust her.
honesty.exampleZh: 她的诚实让团队里的每个人都信任她。

honor.example: It is a great honor to meet you today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天见到您是莫大的荣幸。

honorable.example: He is an honorable man who always keeps his word.
honorable.exampleZh: 他是一个总是信守承诺的可敬的人。

honorary.example: He received an honorary degree from the university for his charity work.
honorary.exampleZh: 他因慈善工作获得了这所大学的名誉学位。

hood.example: She pulled the hood over her head before going out in the rain.
hood.exampleZh: 出门前，她把兜帽拉到了头上，外面正下着雨。

hoof.example: The horse hurt its front hoof on a sharp stone near the river.
hoof.exampleZh: 那匹马在河边被一块尖石头弄伤了前蹄。

hook.example: Hang your coat on the hook behind the door.
hook.exampleZh: 把你的外套挂在门后的钩子上。

hoop.example: The children rolled the wooden hoop down the street with a stick.
hoop.exampleZh: 孩子们用一根棍子把木箍沿街滚着走。

hoot.example: We heard an owl hoot in the dark forest last night.
hoot.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在黑暗的森林里听到一只猫头鹰在叫。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party next week.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你下周能来参加我的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: She is hopeful that her brother will come home soon.
hopeful.exampleZh: 她抱有希望，觉得哥哥很快就会回家。

horizon.example: Reading books can widen your horizon and help you see the world differently.
horizon.exampleZh: 读书能开阔你的眼界，帮助你用不同的方式看待世界。

horizontal.example: The line on the page is not horizontal but slightly slanted.
horizontal.exampleZh: 页面上的这条线不是水平的，而是略微倾斜的。

hormone.example: The doctor said my hormone levels are normal and healthy.
hormone.exampleZh: 医生说我的激素水平正常且健康。

horn.example: The old car's horn was very loud and made everyone jump.
horn.exampleZh: 那辆旧汽车的喇叭很响，把大家都吓了一跳。

hornet.example: A hornet flew into the kitchen and scared my little sister.
hornet.exampleZh: 一只大黄蜂飞进厨房，把我妹妹吓坏了。

horology.example: He studied horology for years and learned how to repair old clocks.
horology.exampleZh: 他研究钟表学多年，学会了如何修理旧钟表。

horoscope.example: She reads her horoscope every morning before she goes to work.
horoscope.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会看她的星座运势。

horrible.example: The weather was horrible, so we stayed at home all day.
horrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

horrific.example: The car crash was a horrific sight that nobody wanted to see.
horrific.exampleZh: 那场车祸是一个没有人想看到的可怕景象。

horror.example: The children ran from the dark house in horror.
horror.exampleZh: 孩子们惊恐地从那所黑房子里跑出来。

horse.example: The horse runs very fast across the green field every morning.
horse.exampleZh: 这匹马每天早上都在绿色的田野上飞快地奔跑。

horsepower.example: This old car has only sixty horsepower, so it is very slow.
horsepower.exampleZh: 这辆旧车只有六十马力，所以开得很慢。

horticulture.example: My sister studies horticulture at a small college near the city.
horticulture.exampleZh: 我姐姐在城郊一所小学院学习园艺学。

hospitality.example: The people in that small village are known for their warm hospitality.
hospitality.exampleZh: 那个小村庄的人们以热情好客而闻名。

hospitalize.example: The doctor decided to hospitalize him after his condition got worse.
hospitalize.exampleZh: 他的病情恶化后，医生决定送他住院治疗。

host.example: Our host welcomed every guest at the door and showed them to their seats.
host.exampleZh: 我们的主人站在门口迎接每一位客人，并把他们领到座位上。

hostage.example: The police worked all night to free the young hostage from the small room.
hostage.exampleZh: 警察整夜工作，把那名年轻的人质从那个小房间里解救出来。

hostel.example: We stayed in a cheap hostel near the train station last summer.
hostel.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们住在火车站附近一家便宜的青年旅舍。

hostile.example: The hostile crowd shouted at the players as they left the field.
hostile.exampleZh: 当球员们离开球场时，充满敌意的人群对他们大声喊叫。

hostility.example: His hostility toward the new plan made everyone in the room uncomfortable.
hostility.exampleZh: 他对新计划的敌意让房间里的每个人都感到不自在。

hot.example: The soup is too hot to eat right now, so please wait a little.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤现在太烫了，没法吃，请稍等一会儿。

hotel.example: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach for three nights.
hotel.exampleZh: 我们在海滩附近的一家小旅馆住了三个晚上。

hound.example: The hound ran across the field after the rabbit.
hound.exampleZh: 猎犬跑过田野追赶兔子。

hour.example: It takes an hour to get to the airport by bus.
hour.exampleZh: 坐公交车去机场需要一个小时。

house.example: They plan to house the old books in a small house.
house.exampleZh: 他们打算把旧书收藏在一栋小房子里。

household.example: Every household in our village has clean water now.
household.exampleZh: 我们村里的每一户人家现在都有干净的水。

housing.example: Many families in the city need cheap housing near their work.
housing.exampleZh: 这座城市的许多家庭需要在工作地点附近有便宜的住房。

hover.example: A large bird hovers above the field, looking for something to eat.
hover.exampleZh: 一只大鸟在田野上空盘旋，寻找可以吃的东西。

hovercraft.example: The hovercraft moved quickly across the water and reached the small island.
hovercraft.exampleZh: 气垫船快速驶过水面，到达了那座小岛。

however.example: I wanted to go out, however I had too much work to do.
however.exampleZh: 我本想出去，然而我有太多工作要做。

howl.example: The dog began to howl loudly when it heard the strange noise.
howl.exampleZh: 那只狗听到奇怪的声音后开始大声嚎叫。

hub.example: The old train station is a busy hub for travelers from many small towns.
hub.exampleZh: 这座老火车站是来自许多小镇的旅客的繁忙中心。

hubbub.example: The hubbub in the crowded market made it hard to hear my friend.
hubbub.exampleZh: 拥挤市场里的喧哗声让我很难听清朋友说话。

hubris.example: His hubris made him believe that no one could ever defeat him.
hubris.exampleZh: 他的傲慢使他相信没有人能打败他。

huddle.example: The children huddled together under the blanket to keep warm.
huddle.exampleZh: 孩子们挤在毯子下面取暖。

hue.example: The sky changed its hue from blue to orange at sunset.
hue.exampleZh: 日落时，天空的颜色从蓝色变成了橙色。

huff.example: She gave a little huff and walked out of the room without a word.
huff.exampleZh: 她气呼呼地哼了一声，一言不发地走出了房间。

hug.example: She gave her mother a big hug at the airport.
hug.exampleZh: 她在机场给了妈妈一个大大的拥抱。

huge.example: The new shopping mall is huge, and it has many shops.
huge.exampleZh: 这个新购物中心非常大，里面有很多商店。

hull.example: The hull of the old boat was full of small holes.
hull.exampleZh: 这条旧船的外壳布满了小洞。

hum.example: She likes to hum a quiet song while she works in the garden.
hum.exampleZh: 她喜欢在花园里干活时轻轻哼一首歌。

human.example: Every human has the right to live a safe and happy life.
human.exampleZh: 每个人都有权过上安全快乐的生活。

humane.example: It is humane to treat animals with care and kindness.
humane.exampleZh: 以关爱和善意对待动物是人道的。

humanism.example: Humanism values people and their ability to reason and learn.
humanism.exampleZh: 人文主义重视人以及人推理和学习的能力。

humanitarian.example: The humanitarian group gave food and clean water to families after the flood.
humanitarian.exampleZh: 洪水过后，这个人道主义组织为许多家庭提供了食物和干净的水。

humanity.example: We must treat every person with humanity and respect.
humanity.exampleZh: 我们必须以人道和尊重对待每一个人。

humankind.example: Climate change is a problem for all humankind, so every country must work together.
humankind.exampleZh: 气候变化是全人类的问题，因此每个国家都必须合作。

humble.example: He is a humble man who never talks about his success.
humble.exampleZh: 他是个谦逊的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

humdrum.example: His life in the small town was humdrum and never changed.
humdrum.exampleZh: 他在小镇上的生活单调乏味，从未有过变化。

humid.example: The air in the small room was hot and humid all summer.
humid.exampleZh: 那个小房间里的空气整个夏天都又热又潮湿。

humidify.example: We use a machine to humidify the air in the room during winter.
humidify.exampleZh: 冬天我们用一台机器给房间里的空气增湿。

humidity.example: The humidity in the room is very high today.
humidity.exampleZh: 今天房间里的湿度很高。

humiliate.example: He tried to humiliate me in front of my friends.
humiliate.exampleZh: 他试图在我朋友面前羞辱我。

humility.example: True humility means listening to others and admitting when you are wrong.
humility.exampleZh: 真正的谦逊意味着倾听他人，并在自己犯错时承认错误。

humor.example: His good humor made everyone feel happy during the long meeting.
humor.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议中，他良好的幽默感让每个人都感到愉快。

humorous.example: My new teacher is very humorous and often makes the whole class laugh.
humorous.exampleZh: 我的新老师很幽默，经常让全班同学大笑。

hump.example: We rested behind the camel's hump to hide from the strong wind.
hump.exampleZh: 我们躲在骆驼的驼峰后面，以避开强风。

humus.example: The rich humus in the soil helps these small plants grow very fast.
humus.exampleZh: 土壤中丰富的腐殖质帮助这些小植物快速生长。

hunch.example: I had a hunch that she would come back today.
hunch.exampleZh: 我有一种预感，她今天会回来。

hundred.example: There are about two hundred students in our school this year.
hundred.exampleZh: 我们学校今年大约有两百名学生。

hunger.example: Millions of people around the world still face hunger and need our help.
hunger.exampleZh: 全世界仍有数百万的人面临饥饿，需要我们的帮助。

hungry.example: After the long walk, the children were very hungry and wanted some bread.
hungry.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，孩子们非常饿，想吃些面包。

hunt.example: They hunt for food in the forest near their small village.
hunt.exampleZh: 他们在小村庄附近的森林里寻找食物。

hurdle.example: She jumped over the hurdle and kept running to the finish line.
hurdle.exampleZh: 她跨过栏架，继续向终点跑去。

hurl.example: He hurled the ball across the field and then shouted at his friend.
hurl.exampleZh: 他把球猛力扔过球场，然后对着朋友大喊。

hurrah.example: Hurrah, our team won the game at last.
hurrah.exampleZh: 好哇，我们队终于赢了比赛。

hurricane.example: The hurricane broke many windows and tore the roof off our old house.
hurricane.exampleZh: 飓风打破了许多窗户，还把我们老房子的屋顶掀掉了。

hurried.example: She ate a hurried breakfast and ran out the door.
hurried.exampleZh: 她匆匆吃了早饭，就冲出了门。

hurry.example: I must hurry to catch the early bus to school.
hurry.exampleZh: 我必须赶紧去赶早班公交车上学。

hurt.example: My bad words hurt her feelings and made her cry.
hurt.exampleZh: 我不好的话伤害了她的感情，让她哭了。

husband.example: Her husband cooks dinner for the family every evening.
husband.exampleZh: 她的丈夫每天晚上都为家人做晚饭。

husbandry.example: Good husbandry of water and soil keeps the farm productive for many years.
husbandry.exampleZh: 良好的水土管理能让农场多年保持高产。

hush.example: She asked the children to hush so the baby could sleep.
hush.exampleZh: 她让孩子们安静下来，好让婴儿睡觉。

husk.example: She threw the corn husk into the bin after dinner.
husk.exampleZh: 晚饭后她把玉米外皮扔进了垃圾桶。

husky.example: His voice was husky after he sang songs for three hours.
husky.exampleZh: 他唱了三个小时的歌之后，声音变得沙哑了。

hut.example: The old man lives in a small hut near the river.
hut.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边的一间小屋里。

hybrid.example: The new car is a hybrid that uses both gas and electricity.
hybrid.exampleZh: 这款新车是一种同时使用汽油和电力的混合动力车。

hybridize.example: Farmers sometimes hybridize two kinds of rice to get a stronger plant.
hybridize.exampleZh: 农民有时将两种水稻杂交，以获得更强壮的植株。

hydrant.example: The fire truck stopped next to the hydrant on our street.
hydrant.exampleZh: 消防车停在我们街上的消防栓旁边。

hydrate.example: You should hydrate your body with water before and after exercise.
hydrate.exampleZh: 你应该在运动前后用水为身体补水。

hydraulic.example: The machine uses hydraulic power to lift heavy boxes.
hydraulic.exampleZh: 这台机器用液压动力抬起沉重的箱子。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, and it is essential for all life.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧组成，它对所有生命都至关重要。

hyena.example: The hyena laughed in the dark and ran away with the bone.
hyena.exampleZh: 鬣狗在黑暗中发出笑声，然后叼着骨头跑开了。

hygiene.example: Good hygiene helps us stay healthy and avoid getting sick.
hygiene.exampleZh: 良好的卫生习惯帮助我们保持健康、避免生病。

hygienic.example: Keeping the kitchen clean is important for hygienic food preparation.
hygienic.exampleZh: 保持厨房清洁对卫生的食物准备很重要。

hymn.example: The children sang a beautiful hymn in church on Sunday morning.
hymn.exampleZh: 孩子们星期天早上在教堂里唱了一首优美的赞美诗。

hype.example: There is a lot of hype about the new phone, but it is just a phone.
hype.exampleZh: 这款新手机被大肆宣传，但它只不过是一部手机。

hyperactive.example: The hyperactive child could not sit still during the whole class.
hyperactive.exampleZh: 那个过度活跃的孩子整节课都坐不住。

hyperbole.example: Her description of the storm was hyperbole, but it made the story fun.
hyperbole.exampleZh: 她对暴风雨的描述是夸张法，但这让故事变得有趣。

hypertension.example: My grandfather takes medicine every morning because he has hypertension.
hypertension.exampleZh: 我爷爷每天早上吃药，因为他有高血压。

hyphen.example: Please add a hyphen between these two words on the line.
hyphen.exampleZh: 请在这一行上的这两个词之间加一个连字符。

hypnosis.example: The doctor used hypnosis to help the patient relax and sleep better.
hypnosis.exampleZh: 医生用催眠帮助这位病人放松并睡得更香。

hypnotic.example: The soft music had a hypnotic effect, and I soon fell asleep.
hypnotic.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐有催眠的效果，我很快就睡着了。

hypnotize.example: The soft music and dim lights soon hypnotized the tired baby.
hypnotize.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐和昏暗的灯光很快就使疲倦的宝宝昏昏欲睡。

hypocrisy.example: His kindness was pure hypocrisy, and everyone at work knew the truth.
hypocrisy.exampleZh: 他的友善纯粹是伪善，公司里每个人都知道真相。

hypothesis.example: The scientist tested his hypothesis with a simple experiment.
hypothesis.exampleZh: 科学家用一个简单的实验检验了他的假设。

hypothetical.example: We discussed a hypothetical case in class to understand the rule.
hypothetical.exampleZh: 我们在课上讨论了一个假设的案例来理解这条规则。

hysteria.example: The strange news caused a wave of hysteria across the small town.
hysteria.exampleZh: 那条奇怪的消息在这个小镇上引发了一阵歇斯底里。

hysterical.example: She became hysterical when she saw the huge spider on her bed.
hysterical.exampleZh: 看到床上的大蜘蛛时，她变得歇斯底里。

ice.example: The children put some ice in their drinks on a hot day.
ice.exampleZh: 炎热的天气里，孩子们在饮料里放了一些冰块。

iceberg.example: The ship hit an iceberg and sank in the cold sea.
iceberg.exampleZh: 那艘船撞上了冰山，在寒冷的海水中沉没了。

icon.example: The icon on my phone opens the camera very quickly.
icon.exampleZh: 我手机上的图标可以很快打开相机。

icy.example: Her icy voice made everyone in the room feel cold and unwelcome.
icy.exampleZh: 她冷淡的声音让房间里的每个人都感到寒冷和不受欢迎。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our class trip next week.
idea.exampleZh: 对于我们下周的班级旅行，我有一个好主意。

ideal.example: This quiet place is an ideal spot for reading and studying.
ideal.exampleZh: 这个安静的地方是读书学习的理想场所。

idealism.example: Her idealism makes her believe that people are always kind.
idealism.exampleZh: 她的理想主义让她相信人们总是善良的。

idealist.example: My uncle is an idealist who believes he can change the world.
idealist.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个理想主义者，他相信自己能改变世界。

idealize.example: Some people idealize their childhood and forget the hard times.
idealize.exampleZh: 有些人把童年理想化，忘记了那些艰难的时光。

ideally.example: Ideally, we should leave home early to avoid the morning traffic.
ideally.exampleZh: 理想情况下，我们应该早点出门，以避开早高峰的交通。

identical.example: The two sisters wore identical dresses to the party last night.
identical.exampleZh: 昨晚两姐妹穿着完全相同的连衣裙去参加聚会。

identifiable.example: The police said the man was easily identifiable by his red coat.
identifiable.exampleZh: 警方说那名男子穿着红色外套，很容易辨认。

identification.example: Please bring your identification to the front desk before you enter the building.
identification.exampleZh: 进入大楼前，请把你的身份证明带到前台。

identify.example: Can you identify the man in this old photo?
identify.exampleZh: 你能认出这张旧照片里的那个男人吗？

identity.example: Her sense of identity became stronger after she moved to a new city.
identity.exampleZh: 搬到新城市后，她的身份认同感变得更强了。

ideological.example: The two parties have deep ideological differences about the role of government.
ideological.exampleZh: 这两个政党在政府角色上存在深刻的意识形态分歧。

ideology.example: The party's ideology shapes how people think about work and family.
ideology.exampleZh: 该政党的意识形态塑造了人们看待工作和家庭的方式。

idiocy.example: It was pure idiocy to leave the door unlocked all night.
idiocy.exampleZh: 整夜不锁门纯粹是愚蠢之举。

idiom.example: Learning an idiom like "break the ice" helps you sound natural in English.
idiom.exampleZh: 学习像 break the ice 这样的习语有助于你的英语听起来更自然。
