idiomatic.example: Her English sounds idiomatic because she reads many books.
idiomatic.exampleZh: 她的英语听起来很地道，因为她读了很多书。

idiosyncrasy.example: Everyone accepts his strange idiosyncrasies because he is a talented and kind man.
idiosyncrasy.exampleZh: 大家都接受他那些奇怪的小癖好，因为他是个有才华又善良的人。

idiot.example: He felt like an idiot after asking such a simple question.
idiot.exampleZh: 问了这么简单的问题后，他觉得自己像个白痴。

idiotic.example: It was an idiotic idea to go hiking without any water.
idiotic.exampleZh: 不带水就去徒步是个愚蠢的主意。

idle.example: The old machine sits idle in the corner of the factory.
idle.exampleZh: 那台旧机器闲置在工厂的角落里。

idleness.example: His idleness at work made the other team members very angry.
idleness.exampleZh: 他上班时的懒散让其他团队成员非常生气。

idol.example: Many young people treat a famous singer as their idol.
idol.exampleZh: 许多年轻人把一位著名歌手当作自己的偶像。

idolize.example: Many young fans idolize famous singers and copy their clothes.
idolize.exampleZh: 许多年轻粉丝把著名歌手当作偶像崇拜，并模仿他们的穿着。

igloo.example: The Inuit built a small igloo to stay warm in the snow.
igloo.exampleZh: 因纽特人搭建了一个小雪屋，在雪地里保持温暖。

ignite.example: A single spark can ignite a large fire in a dry forest.
ignite.exampleZh: 一个火花就能在干燥的森林里点燃一场大火。

ignition.example: He turned the key in the ignition and the car started at once.
ignition.exampleZh: 他转动了点火开关上的钥匙，汽车立刻启动了。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of the basic rules caused many problems for the team.
ignorance.exampleZh: 他对基本规则的无知给团队带来了许多问题。

ignorant.example: He was ignorant of the new rules and made a mistake.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他不了解新规则，因此犯了一个错误。

ignore.example: Do not ignore the warning signs on the road.
ignore.exampleZh: 不要忽视道路上的警告标志。

ill.example: He is ill and cannot go to work today.
ill.exampleZh: 他生病了，今天不能去上班。

illegal.example: It is illegal to park your car on this street.
illegal.exampleZh: 在这条街上停车是违法的。

illegible.example: His handwriting is so illegible that no one can read the note.
illegible.exampleZh: 他的字迹太难辨认了，没人能读懂那张便条。

illegitimacy.example: The court examined the illegitimacy of the documents before making a final decision.
illegitimacy.exampleZh: 法院在做出最终决定前审查了这些文件的非法性。

illegitimate.example: The court said the company's actions were illegitimate and against the law.
illegitimate.exampleZh: 法院表示该公司的行为是非法的，违反了法律。

illicit.example: The police found illicit drugs hidden in the back of his car.
illicit.exampleZh: 警方在他汽车后备箱里发现了藏匿的非法毒品。

illiterate.example: My grandfather was illiterate, but he could still fix almost anything.
illiterate.exampleZh: 我祖父是文盲，但他仍然几乎什么都能修好。

illness.example: His illness kept him at home for two weeks.
illness.exampleZh: 他的病使他在家待了两周。

illogical.example: It is illogical to blame the teacher for your own mistakes.
illogical.exampleZh: 把你自己的错误归咎于老师是不合逻辑的。

illuminate.example: The new lights illuminate the whole street at night.
illuminate.exampleZh: 新的路灯在夜里照亮了整条街。

illumination.example: The soft illumination of the room made everyone feel calm and relaxed.
illumination.exampleZh: 房间里柔和的照明让每个人都感到平静和放松。

illusion.example: The mirror creates an illusion that the room is much larger than it is.
illusion.exampleZh: 镜子造成一种错觉，让房间看起来比实际大得多。

illustrate.example: Let me illustrate this rule with a simple example.
illustrate.exampleZh: 让我用一个简单的例子来说明这条规则。

illustration.example: The book has a colorful illustration on every page.
illustration.exampleZh: 这本书每一页都有一幅彩色插图。

image.example: The company wants to improve its public image with young customers.
image.exampleZh: 这家公司想改善它在年轻顾客中的公众形象。

imagery.example: The poet uses vivid imagery to describe the quiet lake at night.
imagery.exampleZh: 诗人用生动的意象描绘夜晚宁静的湖面。

imaginable.example: We tried every imaginable way to fix the old computer.
imaginable.exampleZh: 我们试遍了所有能想到的办法来修那台旧电脑。

imaginary.example: The child has an imaginary friend who goes everywhere with him.
imaginary.exampleZh: 这个孩子有一个想象中的朋友，无论他去哪里都陪着他。

imagination.example: Children need imagination to turn a simple box into a spaceship.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们需要想象力才能把一个简单的盒子变成一艘宇宙飞船。

imaginative.example: The imaginative child built a small city out of old boxes.
imaginative.exampleZh: 这个富于想象力的孩子用旧纸箱搭出了一座小城市。

imitate.example: Many young children imitate their parents when they learn to speak.
imitate.exampleZh: 许多幼儿在学说话时会模仿他们的父母。

imitation.example: Children learn language by imitation of their parents and teachers.
imitation.exampleZh: 儿童通过模仿父母和老师来学习语言。

immeasurable.example: The joy of seeing her again was immeasurable.
immeasurable.exampleZh: 再次见到她时的喜悦是无法计量的。

immediate.example: Please give me an immediate answer to my question.
immediate.exampleZh: 请立即给我这个问题的答复。

immense.example: The immense mountain was covered with snow all year long.
immense.exampleZh: 这座巨大的山终年被积雪覆盖。

immensely.example: The new teacher is immensely patient with young children and always helps them.
immensely.exampleZh: 这位新老师对小孩子极其有耐心，总是帮助他们。

immerse.example: She likes to immerse herself in music after a long day at work.
immerse.exampleZh: 工作一整天后，她喜欢让自己沉浸在音乐中。

immersion.example: Full immersion in a new language helps you learn it much faster.
immersion.exampleZh: 完全沉浸在一门新语言中能帮助你更快地学会它。

immigrant.example: My grandfather was an immigrant who came to this country with nothing.
immigrant.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位来到这个国家时一无所有的移民。

immigrate.example: My grandfather decided to immigrate to Canada when he was young.
immigrate.exampleZh: 我祖父年轻时决定移居加拿大。

immigration.example: The government is discussing a new immigration law this week.
immigration.exampleZh: 政府本周正在讨论一项新的移民法。

imminent.example: Dark clouds filled the sky, so we knew a storm was imminent.
imminent.exampleZh: 乌云布满了天空，所以我们知道暴风雨即将来临。

immortal.example: The old story says that a kind immortal lives on the mountain.
immortal.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事说，山上住着一位善良的神仙。

immortality.example: Many people believe that art can give a person a kind of immortality.
immortality.exampleZh: 许多人相信艺术能赋予人一种不朽。

immune.example: People who get the vaccine are immune to this disease.
immune.exampleZh: 接种疫苗的人对这种疾病有免疫力。

immunity.example: Good sleep helps your body build immunity against common illnesses.
immunity.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠有助于身体建立对常见疾病的免疫力。

immunize.example: Doctors immunize children against serious diseases before they start school.
immunize.exampleZh: 医生在孩子上学前为他们接种疫苗以预防严重疾病。

impact.example: The new road had a big impact on traffic near our school.
impact.exampleZh: 这条新路对我们学校附近的交通造成了很大影响。

impair.example: Too much noise can impair your ability to focus on work.
impair.exampleZh: 太多的噪音会损害你专注工作的能力。

impairment.example: The loud noise caused a slight impairment of his hearing over time.
impairment.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音随着时间的推移对他的听力造成了轻微损伤。

impart.example: Teachers impart knowledge and good values to their students every day.
impart.exampleZh: 老师每天向学生传授知识和良好的价值观。

impartial.example: A good judge must stay impartial when deciding who is right.
impartial.exampleZh: 一位好法官在判断谁有理时必须保持公正。

impasse.example: The two sides reached an impasse after hours of talking.
impasse.exampleZh: 双方谈了几个小时后陷入了僵局。

impatience.example: His impatience grew as the bus was late again.
impatience.exampleZh: 公交车又晚点了，他越来越不耐烦。

impatient.example: The passengers were impatient because the train was late again.
impatient.exampleZh: 乘客们很不耐烦，因为火车又晚点了。

impeach.example: The lawmakers voted to impeach the president for his misuse of power.
impeach.exampleZh: 议员们投票弹劾总统，因为他滥用权力。

impeccable.example: Her English is impeccable, and everyone in the office admires it.
impeccable.exampleZh: 她的英语无懈可击，办公室里的每个人都很佩服。

impede.example: Heavy rain may impede traffic on the main road this morning.
impede.exampleZh: 今天早上大雨可能会妨碍主干道上的交通。

impending.example: Dark clouds filled the sky, a sign of impending rain.
impending.exampleZh: 乌云布满天空，这是即将下雨的征兆。

imperative.example: It is imperative that we leave now before the storm gets worse.
imperative.exampleZh: 我们必须在暴风雨变得更糟之前马上离开。

imperceptible.example: The change in her voice was so slight that it was almost imperceptible.
imperceptible.exampleZh: 她声音的变化非常细微，几乎觉察不到。

imperfect.example: My English is imperfect, but I keep practicing every day.
imperfect.exampleZh: 我的英语并不完美，但我每天坚持练习。

imperial.example: The imperial palace in Beijing is very large and old.
imperial.exampleZh: 北京的皇宫又大又古老。

imperialism.example: Many people in the colony fought against imperialism and foreign rule.
imperialism.exampleZh: 殖民地许多人民反抗帝国主义和外国统治。

imperil.example: Smoking can imperil your health and the health of people around you.
imperil.exampleZh: 吸烟会危及你的健康以及你身边人的健康。

impersonal.example: The office felt impersonal because nobody ever said hello to me.
impersonal.exampleZh: 这个办公室让人觉得很冷淡，因为从来没有人跟我打招呼。

impetuous.example: He made an impetuous decision to quit his job without a plan.
impetuous.exampleZh: 他冲动地决定辞职，却没有任何计划。

impetus.example: The new plan gave a strong impetus to the local economy.
impetus.exampleZh: 这项新计划给当地经济带来了强劲的推动力。

implant.example: The doctor will implant a small device in his heart tomorrow.
implant.exampleZh: 医生明天将在他心脏中植入一个小装置。

implement.example: Our team will implement the new plan next week with simple tools.
implement.exampleZh: 我们团队下周将用简单的工具实施这个新计划。

implicate.example: The new evidence may implicate several people in the crime.
implicate.exampleZh: 新证据可能会牵涉几个人到这次犯罪中。

implication.example: The implication of his words was clear to everyone in the room.
implication.exampleZh: 他话里的含义对房间里的每个人来说都很清楚。

implicit.example: His silence gave implicit approval to the plan.
implicit.exampleZh: 他的沉默是对这个计划的默许。

implicitly.example: She implicitly trusted her old friend to keep the secret.
implicitly.exampleZh: 她绝对信任她的老朋友会保守这个秘密。

imply.example: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with us.
imply.exampleZh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他并不同意我们的看法。

import.example: We import most of our coffee from Brazil and it costs less.
import.exampleZh: 我们从巴西进口大部分咖啡，而且价格更低。

importance.example: Teachers often tell students about the importance of hard work.
importance.exampleZh: 老师经常告诉学生努力的重要性。

impose.example: The government imposed new taxes on imported cars last year.
impose.exampleZh: 政府去年对进口汽车征收了新税。

imposing.example: The old church is an imposing building with tall towers.
imposing.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂是一座拥有高塔的宏伟建筑。

impostor.example: The man was an impostor who pretended to be a doctor.
impostor.exampleZh: 那个人是个冒名顶替者，假装自己是医生。

impoverish.example: Years of war had impoverished the small country and its people.
impoverish.exampleZh: 多年的战争使这个小国及其人民陷入了贫困。

impractical.example: It is impractical to carry such a heavy bag on a long walk.
impractical.exampleZh: 带着这么重的包长途步行是不切实际的。

impress.example: Her hard work and kind smile impressed everyone in the small office.
impress.exampleZh: 她的努力工作和亲切微笑给这个小办公室里的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

impression.example: My first impression of the city was very good.
impression.exampleZh: 我对这座城市的第一印象非常好。

impressionism.example: Impressionism changed how painters used light and color in their works.
impressionism.exampleZh: 印象派改变了画家们在作品中使用光线和色彩的方式。

impressive.example: Her piano playing was so impressive that everyone in the room stood up.
impressive.exampleZh: 她的钢琴演奏令人印象深刻，房间里的每个人都站了起来。

improbable.example: It is improbable that it will rain tomorrow.

improve.example: Reading every day can improve your English quickly.
improve.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以很快提高你的英语水平。

improvement.example: My English shows great improvement after months of practice with friends.
improvement.exampleZh: 和朋友练习了几个月后，我的英语有了很大进步。

improvise.example: When the lights went out, the band had to improvise a quiet song.
improvise.exampleZh: 灯熄灭时，乐队只好即兴演奏一首安静的歌曲。

impudent.example: That impudent boy talked back to his teacher in front of the whole class.
impudent.exampleZh: 那个厚颜无耻的男孩在全班面前顶撞老师。

impulse.example: She bought the expensive dress on impulse and never wore it.
impulse.exampleZh: 她一时冲动买下了那条昂贵的裙子，却从未穿过。

impulsive.example: He is too impulsive to think before he acts.
impulsive.exampleZh: 他太冲动了，行动前从不思考。

impure.example: The water in the old well was impure and unsafe to drink.
impure.exampleZh: 那口老井里的水不纯净，喝了不安全。

in.example: My keys are in my bag, and my sister is in her room.
in.exampleZh: 我的钥匙在我的包里，我妹妹在她的房间里。

inaccessible.example: The village is inaccessible by car during the winter months.
inaccessible.exampleZh: 冬季的几个月里，汽车无法到达这个村庄。

inaccuracy.example: The inaccuracy in his report caused a small problem for the team.
inaccuracy.exampleZh: 他报告中的误差给团队带来了一个小问题。

inaccurate.example: His report was inaccurate because he used old numbers.
inaccurate.exampleZh: 他的报告不准确，因为他用了旧数据。

inadequacy.example: The team failed because of the inadequacy of its training.
inadequacy.exampleZh: 这个团队失败是因为其培训不足。

inadequate.example: His training was inadequate for such a difficult and dangerous job.
inadequate.exampleZh: 对于如此困难又危险的工作，他的训练是不够的。

inadvisable.example: It is inadvisable to swim in this river after heavy rain.
inadvisable.exampleZh: 大雨过后在这条河里游泳是不可取的。

inane.example: His inane questions made the whole class laugh during the lesson.
inane.exampleZh: 他那些愚蠢的问题让全班在课堂上都笑了。

inappropriate.example: It is inappropriate to wear shorts to a formal meeting.
inappropriate.exampleZh: 穿短裤参加正式会议是不合适的。

inaugurate.example: The new president will be inaugurated in the capital next month.
inaugurate.exampleZh: 新总统将于下个月在首都举行就职典礼。

inauguration.example: Many people watched the president's inauguration on television last week.
inauguration.exampleZh: 上周许多人在电视上观看了总统的就职典礼。

inborn.example: Her inborn talent for music surprised all of her teachers.
inborn.exampleZh: 她天生的音乐天赋让她所有的老师都感到惊讶。

incandescent.example: The incandescent bulb in the old lamp still gives a warm, bright light.
incandescent.exampleZh: 旧台灯里的白炽灯泡仍然发出温暖而明亮的光。

incapable.example: He is incapable of carrying that heavy box by himself.
incapable.exampleZh: 他一个人无法搬动那个沉重的箱子。

incense.example: The sweet incense in the temple slowly filled the quiet room.
incense.exampleZh: 寺庙里甜甜的香慢慢充满了安静的房间。

incentive.example: The company offers a cash bonus as an incentive for good work.
incentive.exampleZh: 公司提供现金奖金，作为对良好工作表现的激励。

inception.example: The inception of the project was a simple idea shared by two friends.
inception.exampleZh: 这个项目的开端是两位朋友分享的一个简单想法。

incessant.example: The incessant noise from the street kept me awake all night.
incessant.exampleZh: 街上连续不断的噪音让我整夜睡不着。

incidence.example: The incidence of this disease is higher in older people.
incidence.exampleZh: 这种疾病在老年人中的发生率更高。

incident.example: The police are investigating the incident that happened near the school yesterday.
incident.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨天在学校附近发生的那起事件。

incidental.example: The extra fee was incidental and not part of the main cost.
incidental.exampleZh: 这笔额外费用是附带的，不属于主要成本。

incidentally.example: Incidentally, I saw your brother at the store yesterday afternoon.
incidentally.exampleZh: 顺便说一句，我昨天下午在商店看到了你哥哥。

incite.example: His angry words incited the crowd to fight against the new rule.
incite.exampleZh: 他愤怒的言辞煽动人群反对这项新规定。

inclination.example: She has a strong inclination to read books before going to sleep.
inclination.exampleZh: 她有一个强烈的倾向，就是在睡觉前读书。

incline.example: The path begins to incline sharply after the old bridge.
incline.exampleZh: 过了那座旧桥后，小路开始急剧向上倾斜。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free use of the hotel pool.
include.exampleZh: 价格包括早餐和免费使用酒店泳池。

inclusive.example: Our school is inclusive and welcomes students from many different countries.
inclusive.exampleZh: 我们学校具有包容性，欢迎来自许多不同国家的学生。

income.example: Her monthly income is enough to cover rent and food.
income.exampleZh: 她每月的收入足够支付房租和伙食费。

incompatible.example: His plan is incompatible with the rules of the team.
incompatible.exampleZh: 他的计划与团队的规定不相容。

incompetence.example: His incompetence at work made the whole team very angry.
incompetence.exampleZh: 他在工作中的无能让整个团队非常生气。

incompetent.example: He was fired because he was incompetent at his job.
incompetent.exampleZh: 他因为工作不称职而被解雇了。

incomplete.example: Our plan is still incomplete because we need more time and money.
incomplete.exampleZh: 我们的计划仍然不完整，因为我们需要更多的时间和金钱。

incomprehensible.example: The teacher's explanation was so fast that it sounded completely incomprehensible to me.
incomprehensible.exampleZh: 老师的讲解太快了，对我来说听起来完全无法理解。

inconceivable.example: It is inconceivable that she would forget her own birthday.
inconceivable.exampleZh: 她居然会忘记自己的生日，这真是不可思议。

incongruous.example: The modern glass building looks incongruous next to the old stone church.
incongruous.exampleZh: 那座现代玻璃建筑紧挨着古老的石教堂，看起来很不协调。

inconsistent.example: His story was inconsistent, so nobody believed what he said.
inconsistent.exampleZh: 他的说法前后矛盾，所以没人相信他的话。

inconspicuous.example: He wore plain clothes so he would stay inconspicuous in the crowd.
inconspicuous.exampleZh: 他穿着普通的衣服，以便在人群中不显眼。

inconvenience.example: I am sorry for the inconvenience this delay may cause you.
inconvenience.exampleZh: 很抱歉这次延误可能给您带来的不便。

incorporate.example: We will incorporate your ideas into the new plan.
incorporate.exampleZh: 我们会把你的想法纳入新计划。

incorporation.example: The incorporation of the two small firms created one larger company.
incorporation.exampleZh: 这两家小公司的合并造就了一家更大的公司。

increase.example: The number of students in our school will increase next year.
increase.exampleZh: 我们学校的学生人数明年将会增加。

increasingly.example: More and more people are increasingly careful about what they eat.
increasingly.exampleZh: 越来越多的人对吃的东西日益谨慎。

incredible.example: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible.
incredible.exampleZh: 山顶上的景色令人难以置信。

incredibly.example: The final test was incredibly hard, but she passed it easily.
incredibly.exampleZh: 期末考试极其难，但她轻松通过了。

incredulous.example: She gave me an incredulous look when I told her the news.
incredulous.exampleZh: 当我告诉她这个消息时，她露出怀疑的表情。

increment.example: Each year the company gives a small increment to every worker.
increment.exampleZh: 公司每年给每位员工小幅加薪。

incubate.example: The birds incubate their eggs in a warm nest for several weeks.
incubate.exampleZh: 这些鸟在温暖的巢里孵化它们的蛋长达数周。

incumbent.example: The incumbent mayor plans to run again in the next election.
incumbent.exampleZh: 现任市长计划在下次选举中再次参选。

indecent.example: It is indecent to shout rude jokes at a family dinner.
indecent.exampleZh: 在家庭聚餐上大声讲粗俗笑话是不合适的。

indecision.example: Her indecision about the job offer lasted for several weeks.
indecision.exampleZh: 她对这份工作邀请的犹豫不决持续了好几周。

independence.example: She learned to live with independence after moving to a new city.
independence.exampleZh: 搬到新城市后，她学会了独立生活。

independent.example: She is an independent girl and does most things by herself.
independent.exampleZh: 她是个独立的女孩，大部分事情都自己完成。

index.example: The book has an index at the back to help you find topics.
index.exampleZh: 这本书末尾有一个索引，帮助你查找主题。

indicate.example: The dark clouds indicate that a storm is coming soon.
indicate.exampleZh: 乌云表明暴风雨很快就要来了。

indication.example: Dark clouds are often an indication that rain is coming soon.
indication.exampleZh: 乌云常常是即将下雨的迹象。

indicative.example: The dark clouds are indicative of rain later today.
indicative.exampleZh: 乌云预示着今天晚些时候会下雨。

indifference.example: His indifference to her problems made everyone in the office upset.
indifference.exampleZh: 他对她的问题漠不关心，这让办公室里的每个人都很不安。

indifferent.example: He seems indifferent to the problems of his own team.
indifferent.exampleZh: 他似乎对自己团队的问题漠不关心。

indigenous.example: This plant is indigenous to the mountains of southern China.
indigenous.exampleZh: 这种植物原产于中国南方的山区。

indignant.example: She was indignant when the manager blamed her for the mistake.
indignant.exampleZh: 经理把错误归咎于她时，她感到非常愤慨。

indignation.example: She felt deep indignation when she saw the unfair treatment of the workers.
indignation.exampleZh: 当她看到工人们受到不公平的对待时，她感到深深的愤慨。

indignity.example: He felt a deep indignity when they laughed at his mistake.
indignity.exampleZh: 当他们嘲笑他的错误时，他感到一种深深的侮辱。

indirect.example: She gave an indirect answer to my question about the party.
indirect.exampleZh: 她对我关于聚会的问题给出了一个间接的回答。

indirectly.example: She indirectly told me the news by asking about my weekend plans.
indirectly.exampleZh: 她通过问我周末的计划，间接地告诉了我这个消息。

indispensable.example: Good sleep is indispensable for staying healthy and thinking clearly every day.
indispensable.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对于保持健康和每天思维清晰是不可或缺的。

indisputable.example: It is an indisputable fact that regular exercise is good for your health.
indisputable.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对健康有益，这是一个无可争辩的事实。

individual.example: Each individual student in our class has a different way of learning English.
individual.exampleZh: 我们班每个个别学生都有不同的英语学习方式。

individualism.example: Her strong individualism sometimes makes teamwork difficult.
individualism.exampleZh: 她强烈的个人主义有时会让团队合作变得困难。

indoctrinate.example: Some schools try to indoctrinate students with one narrow view of history.
indoctrinate.exampleZh: 有些学校试图用单一狭隘的历史观向学生灌输思想。

indoor.example: We play indoor games when it rains outside.
indoor.exampleZh: 外面下雨时我们玩室内游戏。

induce.example: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about the trip.
induce.exampleZh: 没有什么能诱使他改变关于这次旅行的想法。

indulge.example: She likes to indulge in a small piece of chocolate after dinner.
indulge.exampleZh: 她喜欢在晚饭后尽情吃一小块巧克力。

indulgent.example: Her indulgent parents bought her everything she asked for.
indulgent.exampleZh: 她溺爱孩子的父母给她买了她要的一切。

industrial.example: The city has many industrial areas near the river.
industrial.exampleZh: 这座城市在河边有许多工业区。

industrialize.example: Many countries began to industrialize quickly after the war ended.
industrialize.exampleZh: 许多国家在战争结束后开始迅速工业化。

industrious.example: She is an industrious student who always finishes her homework on time.
industrious.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

industry.example: The car industry is very important to this city's economy.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车工业对这座城市的经济非常重要。

inedible.example: The old bread in the kitchen was hard and completely inedible.
inedible.exampleZh: 厨房里的旧面包又硬又完全不能吃了。

ineffective.example: The old medicine was ineffective, so he went back to the doctor.
ineffective.exampleZh: 那种旧药没有效果，所以他又回去看医生了。

inefficiency.example: The manager found serious inefficiency in the way the team handled daily tasks.
inefficiency.exampleZh: 经理发现团队处理日常工作的方式存在严重的无效率问题。

inefficient.example: The old computer is too inefficient to finish this work quickly.
inefficient.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑效率太低，无法快速完成这项工作。

inept.example: He was too inept to fix the broken chair by himself.
inept.exampleZh: 他太笨拙了，无法独自修好那把坏掉的椅子。

inevitable.example: Change is inevitable, so we should learn to accept it.
inevitable.exampleZh: 变化是不可避免的，所以我们应该学会接受它。

inevitably.example: If you rush your work, mistakes will inevitably happen.
inevitably.exampleZh: 如果你赶工，错误就不可避免地会发生。

inexhaustible.example: The sun gives us an inexhaustible supply of clean energy.
inexhaustible.exampleZh: 太阳为我们提供了用之不尽的清洁能源。

inexpensive.example: This small restaurant serves inexpensive food that tastes very good.
inexpensive.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆供应便宜又好吃的食物。

inexperienced.example: The inexperienced driver drove slowly on the busy road.
inexperienced.exampleZh: 这位没有经验的司机在繁忙的路上开得很慢。

infallible.example: No one is infallible, so we should always check our own work.
infallible.exampleZh: 没有人是绝无错误的，所以我们应该总是检查自己的工作。

infamous.example: This infamous street is very dangerous at night.
infamous.exampleZh: 这条臭名昭著的街道在晚上非常危险。

infant.example: The infant was sleeping quietly in her mother's arms.
infant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿正在她母亲的怀里安静地睡着。

infantry.example: The infantry marched through the forest before the sun came up.
infantry.exampleZh: 步兵在太阳升起前穿过了森林。

infect.example: The flu virus can infect many people in a short time.
infect.exampleZh: 流感病毒能在短时间内感染许多人。

infection.example: Wash your hands often to stop the infection from spreading to others.
infection.exampleZh: 经常洗手可以防止感染传播给他人。

infectious.example: Her infectious laughter made everyone in the room smile.
infectious.exampleZh: 她有感染力的笑声让房间里的每个人都笑了。

infer.example: We can infer from the empty streets that it rained.
infer.exampleZh: 我们可以从空荡荡的街道推断出刚才下过雨。

inference.example: Her inference from the data turned out to be correct.
inference.exampleZh: 她从数据中得出的推断结果最终是正确的。

inferior.example: This cheaper bag is inferior to the one I bought last year.
inferior.exampleZh: 这个便宜些的包比我去年买的那个质量差。

inferiority.example: His constant comparison with his brother gave him a deep sense of inferiority.
inferiority.exampleZh: 他不断地和哥哥比较，这让他产生了深深的自卑感。

infinite.example: The night sky seems infinite when you look at it from the mountains.
infinite.exampleZh: 从山上望去，夜空似乎无边无际。

infinity.example: The night sky seems to stretch to infinity when you look up.
infinity.exampleZh: 当你抬头仰望时，夜空似乎一直延伸到无限远处。

inflate.example: The government may inflate the currency if it prints too much money.
inflate.exampleZh: 如果政府印太多钱，可能会使货币贬值（引发通胀）。

inflation.example: High inflation makes it hard for families to buy everyday food.
inflation.exampleZh: 高通货膨胀使家庭难以购买日常食物。

inflexible.example: My grandfather is inflexible about bedtime and never stays up late.
inflexible.exampleZh: 我爷爷在睡觉时间上很固执，从不熬夜。

influence.example: Parents have a strong influence on how their children think and behave.
influence.exampleZh: 父母对孩子的想法和行为有很强的影响。

influential.example: She is one of the most influential writers in modern China.
influential.exampleZh: 她是现代中国最有影响力的作家之一。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

informal.example: We had an informal talk about the new plan after lunch.
informal.exampleZh: 午饭后我们非正式地聊了聊这个新计划。

informant.example: The police found the informant who told them about the plan.
informant.exampleZh: 警方找到了那个向他们告发这个计划的线人。

information.example: She found some useful information about the job on the internet.
information.exampleZh: 她在网上找到了关于这份工作的一些有用信息。

informed.example: She is well informed about the news in our city.
informed.exampleZh: 她对这座城市的新闻消息很灵通。

infrastructure.example: The city needs new infrastructure before more people can move here.
infrastructure.exampleZh: 在这座城市能迁入更多人口之前，它需要新的基础设施。

infrequent.example: Snow is infrequent in this warm city, so children get excited.
infrequent.exampleZh: 在这座温暖的城市里很少下雪，所以孩子们很兴奋。

infringe.example: You must not infringe on the rights of other people.
infringe.exampleZh: 你不能侵犯他人的权利。

infringement.example: The company was accused of copyright infringement after using the song without permission.
infringement.exampleZh: 该公司因未经许可使用这首歌曲而被指控侵犯版权。

infuriate.example: His constant lying began to infuriate everyone in the small office.
infuriate.exampleZh: 他不断说谎，开始让这个小办公室里的每个人都很生气。

ingenuity.example: Her ingenuity made the old machine work again with very little money.
ingenuity.exampleZh: 她的机灵让那台旧机器在花费很少的情况下重新运转起来。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple bread recipe.
ingredient.exampleZh: 面粉是这个简单面包配方中的主要成分。

inhabit.example: Many kinds of birds inhabit the forest near our small town.
inhabit.exampleZh: 许多种类的鸟栖息在我们小镇附近的森林里。

inhabitant.example: The island has only a few hundred inhabitants, and most of them are fishermen.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个岛上只有几百名居民，其中大多数是渔民。

inherent.example: Risk is an inherent part of starting any new business.
inherent.exampleZh: 风险是创办任何新企业固有的一部分。

inherit.example: She inherited a small house from her grandmother last year.
inherit.exampleZh: 去年她从祖母那里继承了一栋小房子。

inheritance.example: She received a small inheritance from her grandmother last year.
inheritance.exampleZh: 她去年从祖母那里得到了一笔小额遗产。

inhibit.example: Fear of failure can inhibit students from trying new things in class.
inhibit.exampleZh: 对失败的恐惧会抑制学生在课堂上尝试新事物。

inhibition.example: Shyness can cause inhibition in social situations.
inhibition.exampleZh: 害羞会在社交场合造成压抑感。

initial.example: My initial plan was to take the early train to the city.
initial.exampleZh: 我最初的计划是乘坐早班火车去城里。

initially.example: Initially, I found the work hard, but now it is easy.
initially.exampleZh: 最初我觉得这份工作很难，但现在它很容易了。

initiate.example: They plan to initiate a new project next month.
initiate.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月发起一个新项目。

initiative.example: She took the initiative to help the new student in her class.
initiative.exampleZh: 她主动帮助班里的新同学。

inject.example: The doctor will inject the medicine into your arm tomorrow morning.
inject.exampleZh: 医生明天早上会把药注射到你的手臂里。

injection.example: The nurse gave him an injection in his arm this morning.
injection.exampleZh: 今天早上护士在他手臂上给他打了一针。

inland.example: This small inland town is far from the sea and very quiet.
inland.exampleZh: 这个内陆小镇远离大海，非常安静。

inlet.example: The small boat entered the quiet inlet between two rocky hills.
inlet.exampleZh: 小船驶入两座岩石山丘之间那个安静的小海湾。

inn.example: We stayed in a small inn near the lake for two nights.
inn.exampleZh: 我们在湖边的一家小旅馆住了两晚。

inner.example: She keeps her inner feelings hidden from most of the people around her.
inner.exampleZh: 她对周围大多数人隐藏自己内心的感受。

innocence.example: The young child looked at me with complete innocence and trust.
innocence.exampleZh: 那个小孩带着全然的天真和信任看着我。

innocent.example: The innocent child smiled at everyone in the room.
innocent.exampleZh: 那个天真的孩子对房间里的每个人微笑。

innovation.example: The new phone shows great innovation in its camera design.
innovation.exampleZh: 这款新手机在摄像头设计上展现出极大的创新。

innovative.example: She has an innovative plan to make our city cleaner and greener.
innovative.exampleZh: 她有一个创新的计划，让我们的城市更干净、更环保。

input.example: Please input your name and password before you start the program.
input.exampleZh: 请在启动程序前输入你的姓名和密码。

inquire.example: I will inquire about the train times at the front desk.
inquire.exampleZh: 我会去前台询问火车时刻。

inquiry.example: The police made an inquiry into the cause of the fire.
inquiry.exampleZh: 警方对火灾原因进行了调查。

inquisitive.example: The inquisitive child asked many questions about the stars.
inquisitive.exampleZh: 这个好奇的孩子问了很多关于星星的问题。

insane.example: The man's insane behavior scared everyone in the small village.
insane.exampleZh: 那个男人疯狂的行为吓坏了小村庄里的所有人。

inscribe.example: They will inscribe her name on the stone wall.
inscribe.exampleZh: 他们将在石墙上刻下她的名字。

inscription.example: The inscription on the old stone was hard to read after many years.
inscription.exampleZh: 多年之后，那块旧石头上的铭文已经很难辨认了。

insert.example: Please insert the key into the lock and turn it gently.
insert.exampleZh: 请把钥匙插入锁中，然后轻轻转动。

insertion.example: The insertion of the key into the lock was quick and easy.
insertion.exampleZh: 把钥匙插入锁里的动作又快又轻松。

insider.example: Only an insider could know the truth about what really happened that night.
insider.exampleZh: 只有内部人士才知道那天晚上真正发生了什么。

insight.example: Her book gives useful insight into how young children learn language.
insight.exampleZh: 她的书对幼儿如何学习语言提供了有用的见解。

insist.example: My parents insist that I should finish my homework before dinner.
insist.exampleZh: 我父母坚持要我在晚饭前完成作业。

insistence.example: Her insistence on paying made us all feel a little awkward.
insistence.exampleZh: 她坚持要付钱，让我们都感到有点尴尬。

insomnia.example: My doctor says my insomnia is getting worse because I worry too much.
insomnia.exampleZh: 医生说我的失眠越来越严重，因为我过于焦虑。

inspect.example: The teacher came to inspect our classroom before the new term began.
inspect.exampleZh: 新学期开始前，老师来检查了我们的教室。

inspection.example: The teacher made a careful inspection of our homework.
inspection.exampleZh: 老师仔细检查了我们的作业。

inspiration.example: My teacher's story gave me great inspiration for my new project.
inspiration.exampleZh: 老师的故事为我的新项目给了我很大的灵感。

inspire.example: Her teacher's kind words inspired her to try again.
inspire.exampleZh: 老师温暖的话语鼓舞了她再次尝试。

install.example: We will install the new software on all the office computers tomorrow.
install.exampleZh: 我们明天会在所有办公电脑上安装新软件。

installation.example: The installation of the new machine took two hours yesterday.
installation.exampleZh: 昨天安装这台新机器花了两个小时。

installer.example: The installer put the new software on my computer in a few minutes.
installer.exampleZh: 安装程序在几分钟内就把新软件装到了我的电脑上。

installment.example: I pay for the new phone in monthly installments.
installment.exampleZh: 我按月分期付款买这部新手机。

instance.example: This is a clear instance of how small changes can solve big problems.
instance.exampleZh: 这是一个明显的例子，说明小改动如何解决大问题。

instant.example: The instant noodles are ready to eat in just three minutes.
instant.exampleZh: 这碗速食面只需三分钟就可以吃了。

instantaneous.example: The change was instantaneous, and everyone in the room noticed it immediately.
instantaneous.exampleZh: 变化是瞬间发生的，房间里的每个人都立刻注意到了。

instantly.example: She recognized him instantly and smiled at him across the room.
instantly.exampleZh: 她立刻认出了他，隔着房间对他微笑。

instead.example: I wanted tea, but there was no milk, so I drank water instead.
instead.exampleZh: 我想喝茶，但没有牛奶，所以我改喝了水。

instill.example: Teachers instill good habits in children through daily practice and patience.
instill.exampleZh: 老师通过日常练习和耐心逐渐向孩子们灌输好习惯。

instinct.example: Her mother instinct told her the baby was hungry.
instinct.exampleZh: 她的母亲本能告诉她宝宝饿了。

instinctive.example: She has an instinctive feeling when someone is watching her.
instinctive.exampleZh: 当有人看着她时，她有一种本能的感觉。

institute.example: My father works at a small institute near our home and studies plants.
institute.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近的一家小型研究所工作，研究植物。

institution.example: The bank is a large financial institution with offices in many cities.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是一家在许多城市设有办事处的大型金融机构。

instruct.example: Our teacher will instruct us how to use the new computer today.
instruct.exampleZh: 我们的老师今天将指导我们如何使用这台新电脑。

instruction.example: The teacher gave clear instructions before the students started the test.
instruction.exampleZh: 老师在学生开始考试前给出了清晰的指示。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my eyes.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的眼睛。

instrumental.example: Music was instrumental in helping him feel calm after a long day.
instrumental.exampleZh: 音乐在他漫长一天后帮助他平静下来方面起了很大作用。

insult.example: He did not mean to insult you with that simple question.
insult.exampleZh: 他问那个简单的问题并不是有意侮辱你。

insurable.example: This old car is still insurable if you fix the brakes first.
insurable.exampleZh: 如果你先修好刹车，这辆旧车仍然可以投保。

insurance.example: We pay for car insurance every month to stay safe on the road.
insurance.exampleZh: 我们每月支付汽车保险费，以便在路上保持安全。

intact.example: The glass box was still intact after the long trip.
intact.exampleZh: 经过长途运输，这个玻璃盒依然完好无损。

integral.example: Good sleep is an integral part of staying healthy and happy.
integral.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠是保持健康和快乐不可或缺的一部分。

integrate.example: Our school helps new students integrate into class life quickly.
integrate.exampleZh: 我们学校帮助新同学很快融入班级生活。

integration.example: The integration of these two teams made the whole project much easier.
integration.exampleZh: 这两个团队的融合让整个项目变得容易多了。

integrity.example: Her honesty and integrity made everyone in the office trust her.
integrity.exampleZh: 她的诚实与正直让办公室里的每个人都信任她。

intellect.example: Her quick intellect helped her solve the difficult problem before anyone else.
intellect.exampleZh: 她敏捷的才智帮助她比其他任何人都先解决了这个难题。

intellectual.example: She enjoys intellectual talks with her friends after class.
intellectual.exampleZh: 她喜欢课后和朋友们进行智力上的交流。

intelligence.example: Artificial intelligence is changing the way people live and work.
intelligence.exampleZh: 人工智能正在改变人们生活和工作的方式。

intelligent.example: My sister is very intelligent and always gets good grades in school.
intelligent.exampleZh: 我妹妹很聪明，在学校总是取得好成绩。

intelligible.example: The teacher's explanation was clear and intelligible to all the students in class.
intelligible.exampleZh: 老师的解释清晰易懂，班上所有学生都能理解。

intend.example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算今晚晚饭前完成作业。

intended.example: The medicine had the intended effect and she felt better soon.
intended.exampleZh: 这种药产生了预期的效果，她很快就感觉好多了。

intense.example: The intense heat made everyone very tired after the long walk.
intense.exampleZh: 强烈的炎热让每个人在长途步行后都非常疲惫。

intensify.example: We must intensify our efforts to protect the environment.
intensify.exampleZh: 我们必须加强保护环境的努力。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的强度让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

intensive.example: The city offers an intensive English course for new students each summer.
intensive.exampleZh: 这座城市每年夏天为新学生提供强化的英语课程。

intent.example: Her intent was clear, and everyone in the room understood it at once.
intent.exampleZh: 她的意图很清楚，房间里的每个人都立刻明白了。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my plan.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有改变计划的意图。

interact.example: Students interact with each other in small groups during class.
interact.exampleZh: 课堂上，学生们以小组形式互相交流互动。

interaction.example: Regular interaction with classmates helps children build strong social skills.
interaction.exampleZh: 与同学经常互动有助于孩子培养良好的社交能力。

interest.example: High interest rates make it harder for young people to buy a house.
interest.exampleZh: 高利率使年轻人更难买房。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work when I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要干涉我的工作。

interference.example: The loud noise outside caused interference with my radio signal.
interference.exampleZh: 外面的喧闹声对我的收音机信号造成了干扰。

interim.example: The company hired an interim manager while the old one was away.
interim.exampleZh: 公司在原来的经理不在期间聘请了一位临时经理。

interior.example: The interior of the house is warm and bright.
interior.exampleZh: 房子的内部温暖又明亮。

intermediate.example: This class is for intermediate students who already know the basics.
intermediate.exampleZh: 这门课面向已经掌握基础知识的中级学生。

internal.example: The company keeps its internal reports private and shares them only with senior managers.
internal.exampleZh: 公司将其内部报告保密，只与高级管理人员分享。

international.example: She works for an international company and travels to many countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去许多国家出差。

interpret.example: Can you interpret what he said into English for me?
interpret.exampleZh: 你能帮我把他说的话翻译成英语吗？

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem was quite different from mine.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的理解和我的很不一样。

interpreter.example: She works as an interpreter at the United Nations.
interpreter.exampleZh: 她在联合国担任口译员。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking to the class.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我给全班讲话时，请不要打断我。

intersection.example: Turn left at the next intersection and you will see the bank.
intersection.exampleZh: 在下一个交叉路口左转，你就会看到那家银行。

interval.example: We took a short break in the interval between the two classes.
interval.exampleZh: 我们在两节课之间的间隔里短暂休息了一下。

intervene.example: The teacher had to intervene when the two students started arguing loudly.
intervene.exampleZh: 当两个学生开始大声争吵时，老师不得不介入。

intervention.example: The teacher's intervention stopped the fight before anyone got hurt.
intervention.exampleZh: 老师的介入在有人受伤之前制止了那场打斗。

intimacy.example: Trust is the key to intimacy between two people.
intimacy.exampleZh: 信任是两个人之间亲密关系的关键。

intimate.example: She shared her intimate thoughts with only a few close friends.
intimate.exampleZh: 她只和几个亲密的朋友分享了她私密的想法。

intimidate.example: The big boy tried to intimidate the younger students at school.
intimidate.exampleZh: 那个大男孩试图在学校里恐吓年幼的学生。

intimidation.example: The older boys used intimidation to make the younger students give them money.
intimidation.exampleZh: 那些大男孩用恐吓手段让低年级学生给他们钱。

into.example: She walked into the kitchen and made a cup of tea.
into.exampleZh: 她走进厨房，泡了一杯茶。

intricacy.example: The intricacy of the old clock surprised the young boy.
intricacy.exampleZh: 这座旧钟的错综复杂让小男孩感到惊讶。

intricate.example: The old clock has an intricate design with many small parts.
intricate.exampleZh: 这座旧钟的设计错综复杂，由许多小零件组成。

intrigue.example: The old map intrigued her, and she soon joined their secret plan.
intrigue.exampleZh: 那张古老的宝图激起了她的兴趣，她很快加入了他们的秘密计划。

intrinsic.example: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of how young children learn about the world.
intrinsic.exampleZh: 好奇心是幼儿认识世界的内在组成部分。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new teacher.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我的新老师。

introduction.example: The teacher gave a short introduction before the main lesson began.
introduction.exampleZh: 老师在正式课程开始前做了一个简短的介绍。

introductory.example: This introductory book helps new students learn English grammar easily.
introductory.exampleZh: 这本入门书帮助新生轻松学习英语语法。

invade.example: Every summer, large crowds of tourists invade this small quiet town by the sea.
invade.exampleZh: 每年夏天，大批游客涌入这个海边安静的小镇。

invader.example: The invaders broke down the city gate and ran into the street.
invader.exampleZh: 入侵者攻破城门，冲进了街道。

invalid.example: Your ticket is invalid because it was bought for a different date.
invalid.exampleZh: 你的票无效，因为它是为另一个日期购买的。

invaluable.example: Good advice from an old friend is invaluable when you feel lost.
invaluable.exampleZh: 当你感到迷茫时，老朋友给出的好建议是极其宝贵的。

invasion.example: The country built a strong wall to stop a sudden invasion.
invasion.exampleZh: 这个国家修建了一道坚固的墙，以阻止突然的入侵。

invent.example: Many students believe that Thomas Edison invented the light bulb in 1879.
invent.exampleZh: 许多学生认为托马斯·爱迪生在1879年发明了电灯泡。

invention.example: The invention of the telephone changed how people talk to each other.
invention.exampleZh: 电话的发明改变了人们彼此交谈的方式。

inventor.example: The inventor built a small machine that helps clean dirty water.
inventor.exampleZh: 这位发明家造了一台帮助净化脏水的小机器。

inventory.example: The store checks its inventory at the end of every month.
inventory.exampleZh: 这家店在每个月底检查它的库存。

invest.example: My father plans to invest some money in a small local business.
invest.exampleZh: 我父亲打算把一些钱投资到当地的一家小企业。

investigate.example: The police will investigate the case and find out the truth.
investigate.exampleZh: 警方将调查此案并查明真相。

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the missing money.
investigation.exampleZh: 警方开始调查失踪的钱款。

investigator.example: The investigator asked many questions about the missing money.
investigator.exampleZh: 调查员就丢失的钱问了很多问题。

investment.example: She made a small investment in the local coffee shop last year.
investment.exampleZh: 去年她对这家本地咖啡店做了一笔小额投资。

investor.example: The investor bought a small house near the river last year.
investor.exampleZh: 这位投资者去年在河边买了一栋小房子。

invitation.example: I sent her an invitation to my birthday party.
invitation.exampleZh: 我给她发了一张参加我生日聚会的请柬。

invite.example: They invite all their friends to the party every year.
invite.exampleZh: 他们每年都邀请所有朋友来参加聚会。

inviting.example: The warm bread looked very inviting on the kitchen table.
inviting.exampleZh: 那条热面包放在厨房桌上，看起来非常诱人。

involve.example: This job involves a lot of travel to other cities.
involve.exampleZh: 这份工作涉及很多去其他城市的出差。

involvement.example: His involvement in the project helped the whole team finish on time.
involvement.exampleZh: 他对这个项目的参与帮助整个团队按时完成了任务。

iron.example: The old gate is made of iron and it feels very cold.
iron.exampleZh: 这扇旧门是铁制的，摸起来非常冰凉。

ironic.example: It is ironic that the fire station burned down last night.
ironic.exampleZh: 消防站昨晚被烧毁了，这真是讽刺。

irony.example: The irony is that he forgot his own birthday.
irony.exampleZh: 讽刺的是，他忘记了自己的生日。

island.example: The small island has a beautiful beach and many tall trees.
island.exampleZh: 这个小岛有一片美丽的海滩和许多高大的树木。

isolate.example: Doctors had to isolate the sick boy from the other children.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生们不得不把这个生病的男孩和其他孩子隔离开来。

isolation.example: The sick man stayed in isolation until the doctor said he was well.
isolation.exampleZh: 那个病人一直被隔离，直到医生说他康复了。

issue.example: This is a serious issue that we must solve today.
issue.exampleZh: 这是一个我们必须今天解决的严重问题。

item.example: There is one item on the list that I still need to buy.
item.exampleZh: 清单上还有一样东西我需要买。

ivory.example: The old piano has ivory keys that feel smooth and cool.
ivory.exampleZh: 这架旧钢琴的象牙琴键摸起来光滑又清凉。

jab.example: The nurse gave me a quick jab in the arm.
jab.exampleZh: 护士在我胳膊上迅速打了一针。

jabber.example: The excited boy jabbered about his new toy to anyone who listened.
jabber.exampleZh: 那个兴奋的男孩见人就不停地急促说着他的新玩具。

jabot.example: Her white blouse had a soft jabot down the front.
jabot.exampleZh: 她的白色衬衫前面有一条柔软的荷叶边饰。

jack.example: He used a jack to lift the car and change the flat tire.
jack.exampleZh: 他用千斤顶把车抬起来，更换了漏气的轮胎。

jackal.example: The jackal hunted small animals alone in the dry grass.
jackal.exampleZh: 那只豺独自在干草中捕猎小动物。

jacket.example: He took off his jacket and put it on the chair.
jacket.exampleZh: 他脱下夹克，把它放在椅子上。

jackpot.example: She won the jackpot and bought a small house for her family.
jackpot.exampleZh: 她中了头奖，为家人买了一栋小房子。

jade.example: My grandmother gave me a small jade necklace for my birthday.
jade.exampleZh: 我奶奶在我生日时送了我一条小小的玉项链。

jaded.example: After years of doing the same job, she felt jaded and tired.
jaded.exampleZh: 做了多年同样的工作后，她感到厌倦和疲惫。

jagged.example: The old road has a jagged edge along the cliff.
jagged.exampleZh: 这条旧路沿着悬崖有一道锯齿状的边缘。

jaguar.example: The jaguar is a large cat that lives in the forests of South America.
jaguar.exampleZh: 美洲豹是一种生活在南美洲森林里的大型猫科动物。

jail.example: The thief was put in jail for two years after the trial.
jail.exampleZh: 审判后，那个小偷被关进监狱两年。

jam.example: The cars were in a traffic jam, so we got out and walked.
jam.exampleZh: 汽车堵在路上，于是我们下车步行。

janitor.example: The janitor cleans the school floors every evening after the students go home.
janitor.exampleZh: 学生们回家后，校工每天晚上打扫学校的地板。

jar.example: The loud noise jarred the sleeping baby awake.
jar.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音把熟睡的婴儿震醒了。

jargon.example: The doctor used too much medical jargon, so I did not understand him.
jargon.exampleZh: 那位医生用了太多医学术语，所以我没有听懂他。

jasmine.example: The jasmine in our garden smells sweet every summer evening.
jasmine.exampleZh: 我们花园里的茉莉花在每个夏夜都散发着芳香。

jaundice.example: The doctor noticed jaundice in the baby's eyes and ordered more tests.
jaundice.exampleZh: 医生注意到婴儿眼睛里有黄疸，于是安排了更多检查。

jaunt.example: We took a short jaunt to the beach last Sunday.
jaunt.exampleZh: 上周日我们去海边做了一次短途旅行。

jaunty.example: She wore a jaunty little hat and smiled at everyone on the street.
jaunty.exampleZh: 她戴着一顶潇洒的小帽子，对街上的每个人微笑。

jaw.example: He hurt his jaw while playing football with his friends yesterday.
jaw.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们踢足球时伤到了下巴。

jaywalk.example: You should not jaywalk when the traffic light is red.
jaywalk.exampleZh: 红灯时你不应该乱穿马路。

jazz.example: My sister loves jazz and listens to it every night after dinner.
jazz.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢爵士乐，每天晚饭后都会听。

jealous.example: She feels jealous when her best friend talks to other girls.
jealous.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友和其他女孩说话时，她会感到嫉妒。

jeans.example: I wear blue jeans and a white T-shirt on weekends.
jeans.exampleZh: 周末我穿蓝色牛仔裤和白色T恤。

jeep.example: My uncle drives an old green jeep to his farm every morning.
jeep.exampleZh: 我叔叔每天早上开一辆旧绿色吉普车去他的农场。

jeer.example: The boys jeered at him when he fell off his bike.
jeer.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来时，男孩们都嘲笑他。

jell.example: Add water and let the mixture jell in the fridge overnight.
jell.exampleZh: 加水后让混合物在冰箱里放一夜凝固。

jelly.example: The children ate red jelly with fruit for dessert after lunch.
jelly.exampleZh: 午饭后，孩子们吃了带水果的红色果冻作为甜点。

jellyfish.example: A jellyfish can hurt you if you touch it in the sea.
jellyfish.exampleZh: 如果你在海里碰到水母，它可能会伤到你。

jeopardize.example: Smoking can jeopardize your health in many serious ways.
jeopardize.exampleZh: 吸烟会在许多严重方面危及你的健康。

jeopardy.example: His careless words put the whole plan in jeopardy.
jeopardy.exampleZh: 他轻率的话让整个计划陷入了危险。

jerk.example: He gave the rope a sudden jerk and it broke.
jerk.exampleZh: 他猛拉了一下绳子，绳子就断了。

jerkwater.example: He grew up in a jerkwater town with one store and no hospital.
jerkwater.exampleZh: 他在一个只有一家商店、没有医院的偏僻小镇长大。

jersey.example: He wore a blue jersey with his team's name on it.
jersey.exampleZh: 他穿了一件印有队名的蓝色运动衫。

jest.example: He said it as a jest, but she did not laugh.
jest.exampleZh: 他是当作玩笑说的，但她没有笑。

jester.example: The jester made the king and everyone at court laugh all afternoon.
jester.exampleZh: 那个弄臣让国王和宫廷里的所有人笑了一下午。

jet.example: The jet flew high above the clouds on its way to Paris.
jet.exampleZh: 这架喷气式飞机飞得很高，越过云层，前往巴黎。

jetty.example: The small boat was tied to the jetty near the beach.
jetty.exampleZh: 小船被拴在海滩附近的码头上。

jewel.example: The queen wore a jewel on her dress at the party.
jewel.exampleZh: 女王在聚会上在裙子上戴了一颗宝石。

jewelry.example: She keeps her jewelry in a small box by the bed.
jewelry.exampleZh: 她把首饰放在床边的一个小盒子里。

jigsaw.example: The children spent the rainy afternoon putting together a large jigsaw on the floor.
jigsaw.exampleZh: 孩子们在下雨的下午坐在地板上拼一幅大拼图。

jigsaw puzzle.example: The children spent the whole afternoon putting together a large jigsaw puzzle.
jigsaw puzzle.exampleZh: 孩子们花了一整个下午拼一幅大拼图。

jingle.example: I heard the jingle of bells as the horse walked down the road.
jingle.exampleZh: 我听到马走在路上时铃铛发出的叮当声。

jinx.example: Some people think a black cat is a jinx and avoid it.
jinx.exampleZh: 有些人认为黑猫是不祥之物，会避开它。

jitter.example: She felt a jitter in her hands before the big test.
jitter.exampleZh: 大考前她感到双手一阵紧张不安的抖动。

jive.example: Don't give me that jive; I know you are not telling the truth.
jive.exampleZh: 别跟我胡说八道，我知道你没说实话。

job.example: My father found a new job in the city last month.
job.exampleZh: 我父亲上个月在城里找到了一份新工作。

jobless.example: My uncle has been jobless for six months and is looking for work.
jobless.exampleZh: 我叔叔已经失业六个月了，正在找工作。

jockey.example: The jockey rode the horse to victory in the final race.
jockey.exampleZh: 那名骑师在最后一场比赛中骑马夺冠。

jog.example: I jog in the park every morning before work.
jog.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前在公园慢跑。

join.example: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight after work?
join.exampleZh: 你今晚下班后愿意和我们一起吃饭吗？

joint.example: The two companies signed a joint agreement to build a new school.
joint.exampleZh: 两家公司签署了一项共同协议，要建一所新学校。

joke.example: He told a funny joke and everyone in the room laughed.
joke.exampleZh: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话，房间里的每个人都笑了。

jolly.example: The jolly old man laughed at every joke we told him.
jolly.exampleZh: 那位快乐的老爷爷听到我们讲的每个笑话都笑了。

jolt.example: The news gave her a jolt, but she stayed calm.
jolt.exampleZh: 这个消息让她震惊了一下，但她保持冷静。

jostle.example: People jostled each other to get on the crowded bus.
jostle.exampleZh: 人们互相推挤着上了拥挤的公交车。

jot.example: I jot down a few notes during the meeting every morning.
jot.exampleZh: 我每天早上开会时都会草草记下几条笔记。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before going to sleep.
journal.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

journalism.example: She studied journalism in college and now writes for a local newspaper.
journalism.exampleZh: 她在大学学习新闻学，现在为一家地方报纸撰稿。

journalist.example: The journalist asked the mayor several questions about the new road.
journalist.exampleZh: 这名新闻记者就新道路的事向市长提了几个问题。

journey.example: The long journey by train was tiring but very interesting.
journey.exampleZh: 那次坐火车的长途旅行虽然累，但非常有趣。

jovial.example: Our jovial neighbor always greets everyone with a warm smile and a funny story.
jovial.exampleZh: 我们那位快活的邻居总是用温暖的笑容和有趣的故事跟每个人打招呼。

joy.example: The children jumped with joy when they saw the snow.
joy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴得跳了起来。

joyful.example: The children were joyful when they saw the snow falling outside.
joyful.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面下雪时非常欢喜。

joyous.example: The whole family felt joyous at the little girl's birthday party.
joyous.exampleZh: 在小女孩的生日聚会上，全家人都感到非常喜悦。

judge.example: The judge will judge the best cake at the school fair today.
judge.exampleZh: 法官今天将在学校集市上评判最好的蛋糕。

judgment.example: Her judgment of the situation was correct from the start.
judgment.exampleZh: 她对形势的判断从一开始就是正确的。

judicial.example: The judge works in the judicial system and must be fair to everyone.
judicial.exampleZh: 这位法官在司法系统中工作，必须对每个人公正。

judicious.example: A judicious leader listens to everyone before making a final decision.
judicious.exampleZh: 明智的领导者在做最终决定前会听取每个人的意见。

jug.example: She filled the jug with cold water and put it on the table.
jug.exampleZh: 她把壶装满冷水，放在了桌子上。

juggle.example: She has to juggle work and family every day.
juggle.exampleZh: 她每天都要尽力兼顾工作和家庭。

juice.example: She drinks a glass of orange juice every morning before school.
juice.exampleZh: 她每天早晨上学前都喝一杯橙汁。

juicy.example: The juicy burger was so good that everyone wanted a second one.
juicy.exampleZh: 那个多汁的汉堡太好吃了，每个人都想再来一个。

jumble.example: Her toys were all jumbled together in one big box.
jumble.exampleZh: 她的玩具全都杂乱地堆在一个大箱子里。

jumbo.example: They bought a jumbo bag of rice for the family party.
jumbo.exampleZh: 他们为家庭聚会买了一大袋特大号的大米。

jump.example: The cat tried to jump over the tall fence but failed.
jump.exampleZh: 那只猫试图跳过那道高栅栏，但没成功。

junction.example: Turn left at the junction where the two main roads meet.
junction.exampleZh: 在两条主路交汇的交叉口向左转。

juncture.example: At this critical juncture, we must stay calm and think clearly.
juncture.exampleZh: 在这个关键时刻，我们必须保持冷静并清晰思考。

jungle.example: It is hard to walk through the jungle because the trees grow very close together.
jungle.exampleZh: 很难穿过这片丛林，因为树木长得非常密。

junior.example: My junior brother is still learning how to drive a car.

junk.example: We put all the old junk in a big box and threw it away.
junk.exampleZh: 我们把所有旧废品装进一个大箱子然后扔掉了。

junket.example: The manager called the trip a junket, but he still enjoyed the free food.
junket.exampleZh: 经理称这次出行为公费旅游，但他还是享受了免费的食物。

junta.example: The junta took control of the country after the old leader left.
junta.exampleZh: 老领导人离开后，军政府控制了该国。

jurisdiction.example: The court has no jurisdiction over crimes committed in another country.
jurisdiction.exampleZh: 该法院对在另一个国家犯下的罪行没有管辖权。

jurisprudence.example: She studied jurisprudence for three years before she became a judge.
jurisprudence.exampleZh: 她学了三年法学，之后才成为一名法官。

juror.example: Every juror must listen carefully to all the facts before making a decision.
juror.exampleZh: 每位陪审员在做出决定前都必须仔细听取所有事实。

jury.example: The jury listened carefully to all the facts before making a decision.
jury.exampleZh: 陪审团在做出决定前仔细听取了所有事实。

just.example: I just want a fair answer, so please tell me the truth.
just.exampleZh: 我只是想要一个公正的答案，所以请告诉我真相。

justice.example: The people asked for justice after the unfair trial.
justice.exampleZh: 那场不公正的审判之后，人们要求正义。

justify.example: Nothing can justify the way he treated his old friends.
justify.exampleZh: 没有任何理由能证明他那样对待老朋友是正当的。

jut.example: The rock juts out over the water and looks dangerous.
jut.exampleZh: 那块岩石突出在水面上方，看起来很危险。

juvenile.example: The juvenile was caught stealing candy from the small store.
juvenile.exampleZh: 那个青少年在小店里偷糖果时被抓住了。

juvenilia.example: Her early novels are now considered juvenilia and rarely read today.
juvenilia.exampleZh: 她早期的小说如今被视为少年时代的作品，很少有人读了。

juxtapose.example: The museum likes to juxtapose old paintings with modern ones.
juxtapose.exampleZh: 这家博物馆喜欢把古老的画作与现代作品并列展示。

kale.example: My mother cooks kale with garlic and a little salt.
kale.exampleZh: 我妈妈用大蒜和少许盐煮羽衣甘蓝。

kaleidoscope.example: The city at night is a kaleidoscope of lights and colors.
kaleidoscope.exampleZh: 夜晚的城市是一个光与色的万花筒。

kangaroo.example: The kangaroo jumped across the field very quickly with its baby.
kangaroo.exampleZh: 那只袋鼠带着它的宝宝飞快地跳过了田野。

karat.example: This ring is made of pure gold, so it is twenty-four karat.
karat.exampleZh: 这枚戒指由纯金制成，因此是二十四开金。

karate.example: My brother goes to karate class every Tuesday after school.
karate.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周二放学后都去上空手道课。

karma.example: Some people believe good karma will bring them luck in life.
karma.exampleZh: 有些人相信好的因果报应会给他们的生活带来好运。

kayak.example: We took a kayak across the lake and watched the birds.
kayak.exampleZh: 我们划着皮划艇穿过湖面，看着鸟儿。

kebab.example: We bought hot kebab and bread from a small shop near the station.
kebab.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的小店买了热腾腾的烤肉串和面包。

keel.example: The strong wind made the small boat keel over near the shore.
keel.exampleZh: 强风使小船在岸边倾覆了。

keen.example: She is keen to learn English and practises every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她热衷于学英语，每天都练习。

keep.example: Please keep this book for a week and return it to me.
keep.exampleZh: 请把这本书保留一周，然后还给我。

keeper.example: The keeper feeds the animals every morning before the park opens.
keeper.exampleZh: 饲养员每天早上在公园开门前喂动物。

keeping.example: The keeping of these old records is her main job.
keeping.exampleZh: 保管这些旧档案是她的主要工作。

keg.example: The farmer kept a small keg of apple juice in the cold room.
keg.exampleZh: 农民在冷库里放了一小桶苹果汁。

kelp.example: Kelp grows in thick forests under the cold sea near the shore.
kelp.exampleZh: 巨藻在近岸寒冷的海洋下生长成茂密的森林。

kelvin.example: The temperature of the liquid was about three hundred kelvin at room conditions.
kelvin.exampleZh: 在室温条件下，这种液体的温度约为三百开尔文。

ken.example: The answer is beyond my ken, so I cannot explain it.
ken.exampleZh: 这个答案超出了我的知识范围，所以我无法解释。

kennel.example: The little dog sleeps in a warm kennel behind the house.
kennel.exampleZh: 那只小狗睡在屋后一个温暖的狗舍里。

kerb.example: The ball rolled off the road and stopped at the kerb.
kerb.exampleZh: 球滚出了马路，停在了路缘边。

kernel.example: The kernel of his idea is simple and easy to understand.
kernel.exampleZh: 他的想法的核心很简单，容易理解。

kerosene.example: She poured some kerosene into the old lamp and lit it.
kerosene.exampleZh: 她往旧灯里倒了些煤油，然后点燃了它。

ketch.example: The old ketch sailed slowly into the harbor at sunset.
ketch.exampleZh: 那艘旧双桅小帆船在日落时缓缓驶入港口。

ketchup.example: My little brother likes to put ketchup on his eggs every morning.
ketchup.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢每天早上在鸡蛋上挤番茄酱。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove to make hot tea.
kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上烧水泡茶。

key.example: She keeps her car key in a small blue bag.
key.exampleZh: 她把车钥匙放在一个蓝色的小包里。

keyboard.example: I use my keyboard to type emails every morning at work.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班时用键盘打字写邮件。

keynote.example: Her keynote at the meeting set a positive tone for the whole team.
keynote.exampleZh: 她在会议上的主题演讲为整个团队定下了积极的基调。

keystone.example: Trust is the keystone of any strong friendship.
keystone.exampleZh: 信任是任何牢固友谊的根本基础。

kick.example: He kicked the ball hard and it flew over the wall.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢球，球飞过了墙。

kickoff.example: The kickoff of the new school year is next Monday morning.
kickoff.exampleZh: 新学年的开始是下周一早上。

kid.example: The kid next door likes to kid his sister about her new haircut.
kid.exampleZh: 隔壁的小孩喜欢拿他姐姐的新发型开玩笑。

kidnap.example: The police are looking for the two men who kidnapped the young boy.
kidnap.exampleZh: 警方正在寻找绑架那个小男孩的两名男子。

kidney.example: The doctor said my left kidney is healthy and working well.
kidney.exampleZh: 医生说我左边的肾脏很健康，功能正常。

kill.example: The cold weather can kill young plants in the garden.
kill.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会冻死花园里的幼苗。

killer.example: The police finally caught the killer after a long search.
killer.exampleZh: 警方经过长时间搜捕，终于抓住了那个杀人者。

killing.example: The long journey was killing, but the view at the top was worth it.
killing.exampleZh: 这段漫长的旅程令人精疲力尽，但山顶的景色值得一看。

kiln.example: The old kiln was still warm when we arrived.
kiln.exampleZh: 我们到达时，那座旧窑还是温的。

kilo.example: I bought two kilos of apples at the market this morning.
kilo.exampleZh: 今天早上我在市场买了两公斤苹果。

kilobyte.example: One kilobyte is equal to about one thousand bytes of data.
kilobyte.exampleZh: 一千字节大约等于一千个字节的数据。

kilogram.example: This bag of rice weighs about one kilogram.
kilogram.exampleZh: 这袋大米大约重一千克。

kilometer.example: The school is two kilometers away from my house.
kilometer.exampleZh: 学校离我家有两公里远。

kilowatt.example: This small heater uses about one kilowatt of power every hour.
kilowatt.exampleZh: 这个小加热器每小时大约使用一千瓦的功率。

kin.example: His kin came from the village to help the family.
kin.exampleZh: 他的亲属从村里赶来帮助这家人。

kind.example: She is very kind to her new classmates and often helps them.
kind.exampleZh: 她对她的新同学非常和蔼，经常帮助他们。

kindergarten.example: My little sister learns to sing and draw at kindergarten every day.
kindergarten.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天在幼儿园学唱歌和画画。

kindle.example: Her kind words helped kindle a new hope in his heart.
kindle.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语帮助在他心中重新燃起了希望。

kindness.example: Her kindness to the new students made them feel welcome at school.
kindness.exampleZh: 她对新生们的友善让他们在学校里感到受欢迎。

kindred.example: We soon found that he was a kindred spirit who loved books and music.
kindred.exampleZh: 我们很快发现他是一个热爱书籍和音乐的志趣相投的人。

kinetic.example: The kinetic energy of the moving car was very high at top speed.
kinetic.exampleZh: 汽车在最高速度时，其运动产生的能量非常高。

king.example: The king lives in a big castle with his family.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for forty years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 这位老国王统治他的王国四十年。

kingfisher.example: A kingfisher flew low over the water and caught a small fish.
kingfisher.exampleZh: 一只翠鸟贴着水面低飞，抓到了一条小鱼。

kingpin.example: The old man was the kingpin of the small town's fishing business.
kingpin.exampleZh: 这位老人是小镇渔业生意的首领。

kink.example: There is a small kink in the wire that we need to fix.
kink.exampleZh: 电线上有一个小扭结，我们需要把它修好。

kiosk.example: I bought a cold drink from a small kiosk near the station.
kiosk.exampleZh: 我在车站附近的一个小售货亭买了一杯冷饮。

kipper.example: My father likes a smoked kipper with eggs for breakfast.
kipper.exampleZh: 我父亲早餐喜欢吃烟熏鲱鱼配鸡蛋。

kiss.example: She gave her little son a gentle kiss on the head.
kiss.exampleZh: 她轻轻吻了一下小儿子的头。

kit.example: He opened the kit and took out a small hammer and some nails.
kit.exampleZh: 他打开工具箱，取出一把小锤子和一些钉子。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里做晚饭。

kite.example: The little boy flies a red kite in the park on windy days.
kite.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在刮风的日子里去公园放一只红色的风筝。

kitten.example: The little kitten is sleeping in a warm basket beside the door.
kitten.exampleZh: 那只小猫正睡在门边一个温暖的篮子里。

kitty.example: The children fed the little kitty some warm milk.
kitty.exampleZh: 孩子们给小猫喂了些温牛奶。

kleptomania.example: The doctor said his stealing was caused by kleptomania, not by real need.
kleptomania.exampleZh: 医生说他的偷窃行为是由盗窃癖引起的，而不是出于真正的需要。

knack.example: She has a knack for explaining hard ideas in simple words.
knack.exampleZh: 她有用简单的话解释难懂概念的诀窍。

knapsack.example: He put some bread and water in his knapsack before the long walk.
knapsack.exampleZh: 长途步行前，他把一些面包和水放进了背包。

knave.example: The old man called the young thief a knave and walked away.
knave.exampleZh: 老人骂那个年轻小偷是流氓，然后走开了。

knead.example: She likes to knead the dough with her hands before baking bread.
knead.exampleZh: 她喜欢在烤面包之前用手揉面团。

knee.example: He fell off his bike and hurt his left knee.
knee.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，伤到了左膝盖。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down on the floor to pick up the small toy.
kneel.exampleZh: 她不得不跪在地板上，才把那个小玩具捡起来。

knelt.example: She knelt by the bed and prayed for her sick mother.
knelt.exampleZh: 她在床边跪下，为生病的母亲祈祷。

knife.example: Please be careful with that sharp knife when you cut the bread.
knife.exampleZh: 切面包时请小心那把锋利的刀。

knight.example: The brave knight rode a white horse to the castle.
knight.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士骑着白马前往城堡。

knit.example: My grandmother likes to knit warm sweaters for us every winter.
knit.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢每年冬天为我们编织温暖的毛衣。

knob.example: He turned the small knob on the radio to make the music louder.
knob.exampleZh: 他转动收音机上的小旋钮，把音乐调大一些。

knock.example: Please knock on the door before you come in.

knoll.example: A small knoll rises behind the old farmhouse where we played as children.
knoll.exampleZh: 一座小圆丘耸立在那座老农舍后面，我们小时候常在那里玩耍。

knot.example: She tied a tight knot in the rope and pulled it hard.
knot.exampleZh: 她在绳子上打了一个紧结，然后用力拉。

know.example: I know his name but I do not know him well.
know.exampleZh: 我知道他的名字，但我不太了解他。

know-how.example: He has the know-how to fix this old car.
know-how.exampleZh: 他有修理这辆旧车的诀窍。

knowledge.example: Her knowledge of Chinese history helped her a lot in class.
knowledge.exampleZh: 她对中国历史的知识在课堂上帮了她很多。

knowledgeable.example: Our teacher is very knowledgeable about history and always answers our questions.
knowledgeable.exampleZh: 我们的老师对历史非常博学，总是回答我们的问题。

knuckle.example: He cut his knuckle while fixing the old bike in the garage.
knuckle.exampleZh: 他在车库里修那辆旧自行车时划破了指关节。

lab.example: The students did a simple test in the lab this morning.
lab.exampleZh: 学生们今天早上在实验室做了一个简单的测试。

label.example: Please read the label on the bottle before you take the medicine.
label.exampleZh: 吃药前请先看一下瓶子上的标签。

labeled.example: Each labeled box on the shelf shows the name of the food inside.
labeled.exampleZh: 架子上每个标有标签的盒子都写着里面食物的名称。

labile.example: Her mood is labile and can change quickly during the day.
labile.exampleZh: 她的情绪很不稳定，一天之内可能很快发生变化。

labor.example: She went into labor early this morning and the baby is healthy.
labor.exampleZh: 她今天清晨开始分娩，宝宝很健康。

laboratory.example: The students did a simple experiment in the science laboratory today.
laboratory.exampleZh: 学生们今天在科学实验室里做了一个简单的实验。

labored.example: His labored breathing showed how tired he was after the long race.
labored.exampleZh: 他吃力的呼吸表明，跑完这场长途比赛后他有多累。

laborer.example: The laborer worked hard all day in the hot sun.
laborer.exampleZh: 那个工人在烈日下辛苦工作了一整天。

laborious.example: The laborious work took him three long days to finish.
laborious.exampleZh: 这项费力的工作花了他整整三天才完成。

labyrinth.example: The old city is a labyrinth of narrow streets and small shops.
labyrinth.exampleZh: 这座老城是由狭窄街道和小店铺构成的迷宫。

lace.example: She tied the laces on her running shoes before the race.
lace.exampleZh: 比赛前，她系紧了跑鞋上的鞋带。

lacerate.example: The broken glass lacerated his hand badly and he needed a doctor.
lacerate.exampleZh: 碎玻璃严重划破了他的手，他需要去看医生。

lack.example: Many students lack the confidence to speak English in class.
lack.exampleZh: 许多学生缺乏在课堂上说英语的自信。

lackadaisical.example: He gave a lackadaisical answer and did not seem to care.
lackadaisical.exampleZh: 他回答得无精打采，似乎并不在意。

lackey.example: The boss's little lackey always agrees with everything he says.
lackey.exampleZh: 老板的那个小走狗总是对他说的每件事都表示赞同。

lackluster.example: The team's lackluster performance disappointed the fans last night.
lackluster.exampleZh: 球队昨晚黯淡的表现让球迷们失望了。

laconic.example: His laconic reply made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
laconic.exampleZh: 他言简意赅的回答让每个人在漫长的会议中都笑了。

lacquer.example: She put a thin coat of lacquer on the wooden box.
lacquer.exampleZh: 她在木盒上涂了一层薄薄的漆。

lactose.example: Some people cannot drink milk because the lactose in it makes them feel sick.
lactose.exampleZh: 有些人不能喝牛奶，因为里面的乳糖让他们感到不适。

lacuna.example: There is a lacuna in the report where the last page is missing.
lacuna.exampleZh: 报告的最后一页不见了，那里有一处空缺。

lad.example: The lad next door often helps his mother carry the shopping home.
lad.exampleZh: 隔壁的小伙子经常帮妈妈把买的东西提回家。

ladder.example: He climbed the ladder to fix the light on the ceiling.
ladder.exampleZh: 他爬上梯子去修天花板上的灯。

lade.example: They lade the small boat with fresh fish every morning.
lade.exampleZh: 他们每天早上把新鲜的鱼装上小船。

ladle.example: She used a large ladle to serve hot soup to the guests.
ladle.exampleZh: 她用一把大汤勺给客人们盛热汤。

lady.example: The lady in the red coat is my English teacher.
lady.exampleZh: 那位穿红外套的女士是我的英语老师。

ladybug.example: A small red ladybug landed on the green leaf in our garden.
ladybug.exampleZh: 一只小红瓢虫落在了我们花园里的绿叶上。

lag.example: Our small team tends to lag behind the bigger companies in new technology.
lag.exampleZh: 我们的小团队在新技术方面往往落后于大公司。

laggard.example: Our team was the laggard and finished the project two weeks late.
laggard.exampleZh: 我们团队是落后者，项目晚了两周才完成。

lagoon.example: The children swam in the warm, shallow lagoon near our small hotel.
lagoon.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们小旅馆附近温暖的浅水潟湖里游泳。

laity.example: The laity often find the rules of the church difficult to understand.
laity.exampleZh: 俗人往往觉得教会的规矩很难理解。

lake.example: We walked around the lake and took many photos of the quiet water.
lake.exampleZh: 我们绕着湖走了一圈，拍了许多张平静水面的照片。

lamb.example: The little lamb followed its mother across the green field.
lamb.exampleZh: 小羊跟着它的妈妈穿过绿色的田野。

lambaste.example: The coach lambasted his players for their careless mistakes in the game.
lambaste.exampleZh: 教练严厉斥责了球员们在比赛中的粗心失误。

lame.example: His excuse for being late was lame and nobody believed it.
lame.exampleZh: 他迟到的借口站不住脚，没人相信。

lament.example: Many people came to lament the loss of their old teacher.
lament.exampleZh: 许多人前来哀悼他们那位老教师的离去。

lamentable.example: It is lamentable that so many old trees were cut down.
lamentable.exampleZh: 这么多老树被砍掉，真是令人惋惜。

lamp.example: I turn on the small lamp beside my bed to read before sleeping.
lamp.exampleZh: 我睡前打开床边的小台灯看书。

lamplight.example: She read the old letter by the soft lamplight.
lamplight.exampleZh: 她在柔和的灯光下读着那封旧信。

lance.example: The knight rode into battle with a long wooden lance in his hand.
lance.exampleZh: 骑士手持一根长木矛骑马冲入战场。

land.example: The plane will land on the green field near our small town.
land.exampleZh: 飞机将降落在我们小镇附近的绿色田野上。

landfill.example: The old factory site became a landfill for the city's waste.
landfill.exampleZh: 那个旧厂址变成了这座城市的垃圾填埋场。

landing.example: The plane made a smooth landing on the runway.
landing.exampleZh: 飞机在跑道上平稳着陆。

landlady.example: The landlady collects the rent from every tenant on the first day of the month.
landlady.exampleZh: 女房东在每个月的第一天向每位房客收房租。

landlocked.example: This small landlocked country has no port and must trade with its neighbors.
landlocked.exampleZh: 这个小小的内陆国家没有港口，必须与邻国进行贸易。

landlord.example: The landlord fixed the broken window in our apartment yesterday.
landlord.exampleZh: 房东昨天修好了我们公寓里那扇破窗户。

landmark.example: The old tower is a famous landmark in our city.
landmark.exampleZh: 这座古塔是我们城市著名的地标。

landowner.example: The landowner let the young farmer grow corn on his field.
landowner.exampleZh: 这位土地所有者让那位年轻农民在他的田里种玉米。

landscape.example: The landscape outside our window is beautiful in spring.
landscape.exampleZh: 春天我们窗外的景色很美。

lane.example: The little boy rode his bike slowly down the narrow lane.
lane.exampleZh: 小男孩骑着自行车沿着狭窄的小巷慢慢前行。

language.example: English is a useful language for people who travel to many countries.
language.exampleZh: 英语对去许多国家旅行的人来说是一门有用的语言。

languid.example: The hot afternoon made everyone feel languid and slow.
languid.exampleZh: 炎热的午后让每个人都感到懒洋洋的、行动迟缓。

languish.example: The sick dog languished in the cold corner until someone finally helped it.
languish.exampleZh: 那只生病的狗在冰冷的角落里受苦，直到终于有人来帮它。

lank.example: The tall boy had lank hair and very long thin arms.
lank.exampleZh: 那个高个子男孩头发平直，手臂又长又瘦。

lanky.example: The lanky boy was too tall for his small bed.
lanky.exampleZh: 那个瘦长的男孩太高了，他那张小床装不下他。

lantern.example: We hung a red lantern outside the door during the Spring Festival.
lantern.exampleZh: 春节期间，我们在门外挂了一盏红灯笼。

lap.example: The cat sat on her lap and licked its paw.
lap.exampleZh: 猫坐在她的大腿上，舔着自己的爪子。

lapse.example: A small lapse in care can cause a serious problem.
lapse.exampleZh: 一时的小疏忽就可能造成严重的问题。

laptop.example: I take my laptop to the library and study there every afternoon.
laptop.exampleZh: 我每天下午带着笔记本电脑去图书馆学习。

large.example: The large dog ran across the park to catch the ball.
large.exampleZh: 那只大狗跑过公园去接球。

largely.example: The success of the project was largely due to hard work.
largely.exampleZh: 这个项目的成功主要归功于努力工作。

largesse.example: The rich man's largesse helped many poor families in the village.
largesse.exampleZh: 那位富人的慷慨赠予帮助了村里许多贫困家庭。

lark.example: We heard a lark singing high in the sky this morning.
lark.exampleZh: 今天早上我们听到一只云雀在高空中歌唱。

larva.example: A butterfly begins its life as a small larva on a green leaf.
larva.exampleZh: 蝴蝶的一生从绿叶上的一只小幼虫开始。

laser.example: The doctor used a laser to fix my eye.
laser.exampleZh: 医生用激光治疗了我的眼睛。

lash.example: The strong wind lashed the trees all night.
lash.exampleZh: 大风整夜猛烈地抽打着树木。

lass.example: The young lass carried a basket of fresh apples to the market.
lass.exampleZh: 那个小姑娘提着一篮新鲜苹果去市场。

last.example: The last train leaves at ten, so please do not be late.
last.exampleZh: 最后一班火车十点开，所以请不要迟到。

lasting.example: Their lasting friendship began when they were children in the same small town.
lasting.exampleZh: 他们持久的友谊始于童年时期，当时他们住在同一个小镇上。

latch.example: Please push the small latch down before you open the garden gate.
latch.exampleZh: 打开花园大门之前，请先把那个小门闩按下。

late.example: Sorry, I am late for the meeting again this morning.
late.exampleZh: 抱歉，今天早上开会我又迟到了。

lately.example: I have not seen him lately, so I do not know how he is.
lately.exampleZh: 我最近没见过他，所以不知道他怎么样了。

latent.example: She has a latent talent for music that few people notice.
latent.exampleZh: 她有一种很少有人注意到的潜在音乐天赋。

later.example: I will call you later when I get home from work.
later.exampleZh: 我下班回到家后会晚点给你打电话。

lateral.example: The lateral wall of the room has two small windows.
lateral.exampleZh: 这个房间的侧面墙上有两扇小窗户。

latest.example: I check the latest news on my phone every morning.
latest.exampleZh: 我每天早上用手机看最新消息。

latitude.example: The teacher gave us latitude to choose our own topic.
latitude.exampleZh: 老师给了我们选择自己题目的自由。

latter.example: Of the two plans, the latter one seems much easier to follow.
latter.exampleZh: 在这两个方案中，后者似乎容易遵循得多。

laud.example: The teacher always lauds students who work hard and help others.
laud.exampleZh: 老师总是称赞那些努力学习并帮助他人的学生。

laugh.example: The children laugh at the funny story every time they hear it.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们每次听到那个有趣的故事都会笑。

laughable.example: The excuse he gave for being late was laughable.
laughable.exampleZh: 他迟到给出的借口很可笑。

laughter.example: Her loud laughter made everyone in the room smile.
laughter.exampleZh: 她响亮的笑声让房间里的每个人都笑了。

launch.example: The company will launch a new phone next week.
launch.exampleZh: 这家公司将在下周推出一款新手机。

laundry.example: I need to do the laundry because my basket is very full.
laundry.exampleZh: 我需要洗衣服，因为我的洗衣篮已经很满了。

laurel.example: He won the laurel after years of hard training and never gave up.
laurel.exampleZh: 经过多年艰苦训练，他从未放弃，最终赢得了桂冠。

lava.example: The hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
lava.exampleZh: 炽热的熔岩沿着火山坡缓缓流下。

lavatory.example: Excuse me, where is the lavatory on this floor?
lavatory.exampleZh: 打扰一下，这一层的洗手间在哪里？

lavender.example: She grows lavender in her small garden and loves its sweet smell.
lavender.exampleZh: 她在自己的小花园里种薰衣草，很喜欢它甜甜的香味。

lavish.example: They held a lavish party for their daughter's birthday last week.
lavish.exampleZh: 他们上周为女儿的生日举办了一场奢华的派对。

law.example: Everyone must obey the law, even people with power and money.
law.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守法律，即使是有权有钱的人。

lawful.example: It is not lawful to park your car here at any time.
lawful.exampleZh: 任何时候在这里停车都是不合法的。

lawmaker.example: The lawmaker spoke to the crowd about the new school plan.
lawmaker.exampleZh: 这位立法者向人群讲述了新的学校计划。

lawn.example: The children are playing football on the green lawn in front of our house.
lawn.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子前面的绿色草坪上踢足球。

lawsuit.example: The workers filed a lawsuit against the company for unfair pay.
lawsuit.exampleZh: 工人们因不公平的薪酬对该公司提起了诉讼。

lawyer.example: My sister is a lawyer and she works in a big city.
lawyer.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一名律师，她在一座大城市工作。

lay.example: She will lay the baby on the bed and cover him.
lay.exampleZh: 她会把婴儿放在床上，然后给他盖上被子。

layer.example: The cake has three layers of chocolate and cream.
layer.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力和奶油。

layered.example: The cake has a layered look with cream and fruit between each part.
layered.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕每一层之间都夹着奶油和水果，看起来层次分明。

layman.example: As a layman, I found the science article hard to understand.
layman.exampleZh: 作为一个外行，我觉得那篇科学文章很难理解。

layoff.example: The company announced a layoff of fifty workers at its factory.
layoff.exampleZh: 公司宣布在其工厂裁员五十名工人。

layout.example: The layout of this small room makes it feel much bigger.
layout.exampleZh: 这个小房间的布局让它显得大得多。

lazy.example: He is too lazy to clean his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 他太懒了，周末都不打扫自己的房间。

lead.example: She will lead the team to finish the work this week.
lead.exampleZh: 她将带领团队在本周完成这项工作。

leader.example: The team leader helps everyone finish the work on time.
leader.exampleZh: 团队领导者帮助每个人按时完成工作。

leaderboard.example: She checked the leaderboard to see if her score was still the highest.
leaderboard.exampleZh: 她查看排行榜，看自己的分数是否仍是最高的。

leadership.example: Good leadership helps a team work together and reach its goals.
leadership.exampleZh: 良好的领导力能帮助团队齐心协力并实现目标。

leading.example: She is a leading doctor in this small city.
leading.exampleZh: 她是这座小城里一位最重要的医生。

leaf.example: A red leaf fell from the tree and landed on my book.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片红叶从树上落下，掉在了我的书上。

leaflet.example: She gave me a leaflet about the new library opening hours.
leaflet.exampleZh: 她给了我一张关于图书馆新开放时间的传单。

leafy.example: We walked through a leafy park on our way home.
leafy.exampleZh: 我们在回家的路上穿过了一个绿树成荫的公园。

league.example: Our school joined a new sports league last year.
league.exampleZh: 我们学校去年加入了一个新的体育联赛。

leak.example: The old pipe began to leak water all over the kitchen floor.
leak.exampleZh: 那根旧管子开始漏水，水流得厨房地板到处都是。

leakage.example: The plumber found a small leakage under the kitchen sink last night.
leakage.exampleZh: 水管工昨晚在厨房水槽下面发现了一处小的渗漏。

lean.example: The old tree leans to one side after the strong wind.
lean.exampleZh: 强风过后，那棵老树向一侧倾斜。

leap.example: The cat leaped over the small fence and ran into the garden.
leap.exampleZh: 那只猫跳过小栅栏，跑进了花园里。

learn.example: We learn new words and useful skills at school every day.
learn.exampleZh: 我们每天在学校学习新单词和实用的技能。

learned.example: The learned professor explained the old book to his students in simple words.
learned.exampleZh: 这位博学的教授用简单的话向学生们讲解了这本古书。

learning.example: Learning is easier when you practice a little every day.
learning.exampleZh: 每天练习一点，学习就会更容易。

lease.example: We signed a two-year lease for the small apartment near the park.
lease.exampleZh: 我们为公园附近的那套小公寓签了一份两年的租约。

least.example: She likes this book least of all the books on the shelf.
least.exampleZh: 书架上所有的书里，她最喜欢这本。

leather.example: My father bought a brown leather jacket for the winter.
leather.exampleZh: 我父亲买了一件棕色皮夹克过冬。

leave.example: He took a week of leave to visit his family.
leave.exampleZh: 他请了一周假去探望家人。

leaven.example: A little kindness can leaven a hard day and make it brighter.
leaven.exampleZh: 一点善意能影响艰难的一天，让它变得更明亮。

lectern.example: The speaker placed her notes on the lectern before starting the talk.
lectern.exampleZh: 演讲者在开始讲话前把笔记放在讲台上。

lecture.example: I went to a lecture on modern art at the university yesterday.
lecture.exampleZh: 我昨天在大学里听了一场关于现代艺术的讲座。

lecturer.example: The lecturer explained the difficult topic in a very clear way.
lecturer.exampleZh: 这位讲师用非常清晰的方式讲解了这个难懂的话题。

ledge.example: She put the small plant on the narrow ledge near the window.
ledge.exampleZh: 她把那盆小植物放在窗边狭窄的壁架上。

leech.example: That man is a leech who never pays for his own meals.
leech.exampleZh: 那个男人是个吸血鬼，从来不为自己付饭钱。

leek.example: My mother added some chopped leek to the soup for extra flavor.
leek.exampleZh: 我妈妈往汤里加了一些切碎的韭葱来增添风味。

leer.example: The old man gave her a leer from across the room.
leer.exampleZh: 那个老人在房间对面色迷迷地看了她一眼。

leeway.example: The manager gave us some leeway to choose our own working hours.
leeway.exampleZh: 经理给了我们一些余地，让我们自己选择工作时间。

left.example: There is only a little food left in the fridge.
left.exampleZh: 冰箱里只剩下一点食物了。

left-handed.example: My brother is left-handed, so he writes with his left hand.
left-handed.exampleZh: 我弟弟是左撇子，所以他用左手写字。

leftover.example: I ate the leftover rice from last night for lunch today.
leftover.exampleZh: 我今天午饭吃了昨晚剩下的米饭。

leg.example: My left leg hurts after the long run yesterday.
leg.exampleZh: 昨天长时间跑步后，我的左腿疼。

legacy.example: This old library is an important legacy for the whole town.
legacy.exampleZh: 这座旧图书馆是留给整个小镇的重要遗产。

legal.example: It is not legal to drive a car without a license.
legal.exampleZh: 没有驾照开车是不合法的。

legend.example: The old man told a legend about a hero who saved the village.
legend.exampleZh: 那位老人讲了一个关于拯救村庄的英雄的传说。

legendary.example: The legendary hero could lift a huge rock with one hand.
legendary.exampleZh: 这位传奇英雄能用一只手举起一块巨石。

legible.example: Please write clearly so that your handwriting is legible to everyone.
legible.exampleZh: 请写清楚一些，让每个人都能看清你的字。

legislate.example: The government decided to legislate against the use of plastic bags.
legislate.exampleZh: 政府决定立法禁止使用塑料袋。

legislation.example: The new legislation will protect young workers in small companies.
legislation.exampleZh: 这项新法规将保护小公司的年轻工人。

legislative.example: The legislative group met to discuss the new school rules.
legislative.exampleZh: 立法小组开会讨论新的学校规定。

legislature.example: The state legislature passed a new law about school funding last week.
legislature.exampleZh: 州立法机关上周通过了一项关于学校拨款的新法律。

legitimate.example: She has a legitimate reason for asking for more time to finish the work.
legitimate.exampleZh: 她要求更多时间完成这项工作有正当的理由。

legitimize.example: The new law may legitimize the work of these small groups.
legitimize.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能会使这些小团体的工作合法化。

leisure.example: In my leisure time, I like to read books and take long walks.
leisure.exampleZh: 在闲暇时间，我喜欢读书和长时间散步。
