leisurely.example: We had a leisurely lunch and talked for two hours.
leisurely.exampleZh: 我们吃了一顿悠闲的午餐，聊了两个小时。

lemma.example: The math teacher proved a short lemma before starting the main problem.
lemma.exampleZh: 数学老师在开始讲主要问题之前先证明了一个简短的引理。

lemon.example: She put a slice of lemon in her tea.
lemon.exampleZh: 她在茶里放了一片柠檬。

lend.example: Could you lend me your book for a few days?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把你的书借给我几天吗？

lender.example: The lender asked us to pay back the money by June.
lender.exampleZh: 贷方要求我们在六月前还清这笔钱。

length.example: The length of the table is two meters.
length.exampleZh: 这张桌子的长度是两米。

lengthy.example: The lengthy meeting made everyone tired and hungry.
lengthy.exampleZh: 漫长的会议让每个人都又累又饿。

lenient.example: The judge was lenient with the young man because he had no criminal record.
lenient.exampleZh: 法官对这个年轻人很宽容，因为他没有犯罪记录。

lens.example: The camera lens was dirty, so all the photos looked a little blurry.
lens.exampleZh: 相机镜头脏了，所以所有照片看起来都有一点模糊。

leopard.example: A leopard can run very fast and often rests in tall trees.
leopard.exampleZh: 豹子能跑得很快，还常常在高大的树上休息。

leper.example: People treated him like a leper after the scandal.
leper.exampleZh: 丑闻过后，人们把他当作被排斥的人看待。

lesion.example: The doctor found a small lesion on his skin after the checkup.
lesion.exampleZh: 检查后，医生在他的皮肤上发现了一个小损伤。

less.example: I have less time today, so we should start now.
less.exampleZh: 我今天时间较少，所以我们现在就该开始。

lesson.example: We learned a useful lesson from that mistake.
lesson.exampleZh: 我们从那个错误中学到了有用的一课。

let.example: My parents let me go out and play after I finish my homework.
let.exampleZh: 我父母让我做完作业后出去玩。

lethal.example: The snake's bite can be lethal to small children.
lethal.exampleZh: 这种蛇的咬伤对幼儿可能是致命的。

lethargic.example: After a big lunch, he felt lethargic and could not finish his work.
lethargic.exampleZh: 午饭吃得太饱后，他感到昏昏欲睡，无法完成工作。

lethargy.example: After a long night without sleep, he felt deep lethargy and could barely move.
lethargy.exampleZh: 一夜没睡之后，他感到深深的昏睡乏力，几乎动弹不得。

letter.example: I wrote a short letter to my old friend last week.
letter.exampleZh: 上周我给老朋友写了一封短信。

level.example: Her English level is much higher than mine.
level.exampleZh: 她的英语水平比我高得多。

lever.example: He used a long stick as a lever to lift the heavy box.
lever.exampleZh: 他用一根长棍作为杠杆来抬起那个沉重的箱子。

leverage.example: The company used its strong brand as leverage in the deal.
leverage.exampleZh: 公司在交易中把强大的品牌作为筹码。

levitate.example: The magician made the table levitate above the stage for a few seconds.
levitate.exampleZh: 魔术师让桌子在舞台上悬浮了几秒钟。

levy.example: The city will levy a new tax on large cars next year.
levy.exampleZh: 该市明年将对大型汽车征收一项新税。

lexical.example: The lexical meaning of this word is easy to find in a dictionary.
lexical.exampleZh: 这个词的词汇意义在词典里很容易查到。

liability.example: The driver accepted liability for the accident and paid for the damage.
liability.exampleZh: 司机承认对事故负有责任，并赔偿了损失。

liable.example: Drivers are liable for any damage they cause in an accident.
liable.exampleZh: 司机对事故中造成的任何损失负有法律责任。

liaison.example: She acts as a liaison between the school and the parents.
liaison.exampleZh: 她担任学校和家长之间的联络人。

liberal.example: My parents are quite liberal and let me make my own choices.
liberal.exampleZh: 我的父母相当开明，让我自己做选择。

liberalize.example: The government plans to liberalize trade rules to help small businesses grow.
liberalize.exampleZh: 政府计划放宽贸易规则，以帮助小企业发展。

liberate.example: The soldiers came to liberate the small town from enemy control.
liberate.exampleZh: 士兵们前来解放这个小镇，使其脱离敌人的控制。

liberation.example: The people celebrated their liberation with songs and dancing in the streets.
liberation.exampleZh: 人们在街头用歌声和舞蹈庆祝他们的解放。

liberty.example: People in that country fought hard for their liberty and their rights.
liberty.exampleZh: 那个国家的人民为他们的自由和权利奋力抗争。

librarian.example: The librarian helped me find a good book about animals.
librarian.exampleZh: 图书管理员帮我找到了一本关于动物的好书。

library.example: I go to the library after school to borrow some new books.
library.exampleZh: 放学后我去图书馆借几本新书。

license.example: You must have a valid license to drive a car in this country.
license.exampleZh: 在这个国家开车必须持有有效的驾照。

lichen.example: The old stone wall is covered with green lichen.
lichen.exampleZh: 那堵古老的石墙上覆盖着绿色的地衣。

lick.example: The dog began to lick the boy's hand after dinner.
lick.exampleZh: 晚饭后，那只狗开始舔男孩的手。

lid.example: She lifted the lid of the pot to see the soup.

lie.example: The old dog likes to lie in the sun all afternoon.
lie.exampleZh: 那只老狗喜欢整个下午躺在阳光下。

lieutenant.example: The young lieutenant led his soldiers across the river at night.
lieutenant.exampleZh: 那位年轻的中尉夜里带领士兵们渡过了河。

life.example: Music is a big part of my life.
life.exampleZh: 音乐是我生活中很重要的一部分。

lifeboat.example: The crew lowered the lifeboat into the water to rescue the passengers.
lifeboat.exampleZh: 船员们把救生艇放下水去营救乘客。

lifeguard.example: The lifeguard watched the children swim in the pool all morning.
lifeguard.exampleZh: 救生员整个上午都看着孩子们在游泳池里游泳。

lifestyle.example: A healthy lifestyle helps you feel better and have more energy every day.
lifestyle.exampleZh: 健康的生活方式能让你感觉更好，每天精力更充沛。

lifetime.example: He spent his lifetime working as a teacher in a small town.
lifetime.exampleZh: 他一生都在一个小镇当老师。

lift.example: Can you help me lift this heavy box onto the table?
lift.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这个沉箱子抬到桌子上吗？

ligament.example: The doctor said I hurt a ligament in my knee during the game.
ligament.exampleZh: 医生说我比赛中伤到了膝盖的一条韧带。

light.example: This bag is light, so I can carry it easily.
light.exampleZh: 这个包很轻，所以我可以轻松地拿着它。

lighten.example: The morning sun will lighten the whole room and make everyone feel happy.
lighten.exampleZh: 早晨的阳光会照亮整个房间，让每个人都感到开心。

lighter.example: He took a lighter from his pocket and lit the candle.
lighter.exampleZh: 他从口袋里拿出一个打火机，点燃了蜡烛。

lightning.example: The lightning was very bright and we heard loud thunder right after it.
lightning.exampleZh: 那道闪电非常亮，紧接着我们就听到了响亮的雷声。

lightweight.example: This lightweight laptop is easy to carry to school every day.
lightweight.exampleZh: 这台轻便的笔记本电脑每天带去学校都很方便。

like.example: She sings like a bird every morning in the garden.
like.exampleZh: 她每天早上在花园里像小鸟一样唱歌。

likeable.example: She is a likeable girl, and everyone in our class likes her.
likeable.exampleZh: 她是个讨人喜欢的女孩，我们班上每个人都喜欢她。

likelihood.example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow afternoon.
likelihood.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很大。

likely.example: It will likely rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
likely.exampleZh: 明天很可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

liken.example: People often liken his voice to the sound of a gentle river.
liken.exampleZh: 人们常把他的嗓音比作一条轻柔河流的声音。

likewise.example: He works hard, and his brother does likewise.
likewise.exampleZh: 他工作努力，他的弟弟也一样。

lilac.example: She planted a lilac near the gate so it would smell sweet in spring.
lilac.exampleZh: 她在门旁种了一株丁香，这样春天时就会散发甜香。

limb.example: He hurt his left limb while climbing the tall tree.
limb.exampleZh: 他在爬那棵高树时伤了左肢。

limber.example: Runners should limber up before they start the race.
limber.exampleZh: 跑步者在开始比赛前应该活动开身体。

lime.example: They put lime on the soil to help the plants grow.
lime.exampleZh: 他们往土壤里撒石灰来帮助植物生长。

limelight.example: She loves being in the limelight at every party.
limelight.exampleZh: 她喜欢在每次聚会上成为众人瞩目的焦点。

limestone.example: The walls of the old house were built with limestone from the nearby hills.
limestone.exampleZh: 这座老房子的墙是用附近山丘上的石灰岩砌成的。

limit.example: The speed limit on this road is fifty kilometres per hour.
limit.exampleZh: 这条路的速度限制是每小时五十公里。

limitation.example: One limitation of this plan is that it costs too much money.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个局限是它花费太多钱。

limited.example: Our school has limited space, so only twenty students can join the club.
limited.exampleZh: 我们学校的空间有限，所以只有二十名学生能加入这个社团。

limp.example: After the long run, he walked with a limp and felt very tired.
limp.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他走起路来一瘸一拐，感到非常疲惫。

limpet.example: The limpet clung tightly to the rock as the waves crashed over it.
limpet.exampleZh: 海浪拍打过来时，那只帽贝紧紧吸附在岩石上。

line.example: Please draw a straight line on the paper with your ruler.
line.exampleZh: 请用你的尺子在纸上画一条直线。

lineage.example: She can trace her lineage back to a small farming village.
lineage.exampleZh: 她的血统可以追溯到一个小小的农耕村落。

linear.example: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
linear.exampleZh: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。

linen.example: She washed the linen and hung it in the sun to dry.
linen.exampleZh: 她洗了亚麻布，然后挂在太阳下晾干。

linger.example: The linger stayed near the old gate for a long time.
linger.exampleZh: 那个逗留者在旧大门附近待了很久。

linguistic.example: She has a strong interest in linguistic studies at her university.
linguistic.exampleZh: 她对大学的语言学研习有浓厚的兴趣。

linguistics.example: She studies linguistics at a small university near her home.
linguistics.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小型大学学习语言学。

lining.example: The coat has a warm lining inside it for cold winter days.
lining.exampleZh: 这件外套里面有保暖的衬里，适合寒冷的冬日。

link.example: Please link your phone to the computer with this cable.
link.exampleZh: 请用这根线把手机连接到电脑上。

linkage.example: There is a clear linkage between exercise and good health.
linkage.exampleZh: 运动与健康之间存在明显的联系。

linoleum.example: The kitchen floor is covered with old linoleum.
linoleum.exampleZh: 厨房地板上铺着旧油地毡。

lint.example: The doctor cleaned the small cut and covered it with clean lint.
lint.exampleZh: 医生清理了那个小伤口，并用干净的纱布把它盖住。

lion.example: The lion sleeps under a tree in the hot afternoon sun.
lion.exampleZh: 炎热的午后，狮子在树下睡觉。

lip.example: She bit her lower lip while she was thinking about the question.
lip.exampleZh: 她思考那个问题时咬着下嘴唇。

lipstick.example: She put on some red lipstick before going to the party.
lipstick.exampleZh: 她去参加聚会前涂了一些红色口红。

liquid.example: Water is a liquid, but ice is solid and hard.
liquid.exampleZh: 水是液体，但冰是固体，很硬。

liquidate.example: The company had to liquidate its assets to pay off all its debts.
liquidate.exampleZh: 公司不得不变卖资产来清偿全部债务。

liquor.example: He does not drink liquor because his doctor told him to stop.
liquor.exampleZh: 他不喝烈性酒，因为医生让他戒酒。

list.example: Please list all the books you want to buy this week.
list.exampleZh: 请列出你这周想买的全部书籍。

listen.example: You should listen carefully to your teacher in class every day.
listen.exampleZh: 你每天在课堂上应该认真听老师讲课。

liter.example: I bought two liters of milk at the store yesterday.
liter.exampleZh: 我昨天在商店买了两升牛奶。

literacy.example: Basic literacy is important for every child in school.
literacy.exampleZh: 基本的读写能力对每个在校孩子都很重要。

literal.example: He gave a literal translation of the sentence, so it sounded strange.
literal.exampleZh: 他给出了这句话的字面翻译，所以听起来很奇怪。

literally.example: I literally read the whole letter word by word.
literally.exampleZh: 我确实是逐字读完了整封信。

literary.example: She writes literary essays for a small magazine in her city.
literary.exampleZh: 她为她所在城市的一家小杂志撰写文学随笔。

literate.example: Most people in this city are literate and can read the daily news.
literate.exampleZh: 这座城市里大多数人都识字，能读日报上的新闻。

literature.example: I like to read English literature in my free time.
literature.exampleZh: 我喜欢在空闲时间读英国文学。

litigation.example: The company faces costly litigation over the broken contract.
litigation.exampleZh: 该公司因合同违约而面临代价高昂的诉讼。

litre.example: I bought two litres of milk at the shop this morning.
litre.exampleZh: 我今天早上在商店买了两升牛奶。

litter.example: Please do not litter in the park.
litter.exampleZh: 请不要在公园里乱扔垃圾。

little.example: There is little water left in the bottle, so please drink slowly.
little.exampleZh: 瓶子里剩下的水不多了，所以请慢慢喝。

live.example: The live fish in the small pond are still moving today.
live.exampleZh: 小池塘里的活鱼今天还在动。

lively.example: The children are lively and full of fun at the party.
lively.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上很活泼，充满乐趣。

liver.example: The doctor said too much sugar is bad for your liver.
liver.exampleZh: 医生说糖分过多对你的肝脏有害。

livestock.example: The farmer keeps livestock such as cows and sheep on his small farm.
livestock.exampleZh: 这位农民在他的小农场里饲养牛和羊等家畜。

living.example: The cost of living is high in this city.
living.exampleZh: 这座城市的生活成本很高。

llama.example: The llama walked slowly across the mountain path in the warm sun.
llama.exampleZh: 那只美洲驼在温暖的阳光下沿着山路慢慢走着。

load.example: The heavy load on the small truck made the drive very slow.
load.exampleZh: 小卡车上的沉重负荷让行驶变得非常缓慢。

loaf.example: She bought a loaf of bread and some milk for breakfast.
loaf.exampleZh: 她买了一条面包和一些牛奶当早餐。

loan.example: The bank gave him a loan to buy his first house.
loan.exampleZh: 银行给他一笔贷款，让他买了第一套房子。

loathing.example: She felt deep loathing for the man who had lied to her.
loathing.exampleZh: 她对那个对她撒谎的男人感到深深的憎恶。

lobby.example: Many people went to the city to lobby for better laws.
lobby.exampleZh: 许多人前往该市游说，争取更好的法律。

lobster.example: We ate fresh lobster at a small restaurant near the sea.
lobster.exampleZh: 我们在海边的一家小餐馆吃了新鲜的龙虾。

local.example: The local market sells fresh fruit every morning.
local.exampleZh: 当地的市场每天早上都卖新鲜水果。

locality.example: The doctor asked about the locality of the pain in my back.
locality.exampleZh: 医生询问了我背部疼痛的位置。

locate.example: The hotel is located near the train station and the city park.
locate.exampleZh: 这家酒店位于火车站和城市公园附近。

location.example: The hotel is in a quiet location near the river.
location.exampleZh: 这家酒店位于河边一个安静的位置。

lock.example: Please lock the door before you leave the house.
lock.exampleZh: 离开房子前请把门锁上。

locker.example: I put my bag in a locker near the swimming pool.
locker.exampleZh: 我把包放在游泳池附近的一个储物柜里。

locomotion.example: The robot's smooth locomotion helps it walk over small rocks.
locomotion.exampleZh: 这个机器人平稳的运动能力帮助它走过小石块。

locomotive.example: The old locomotive pulled six heavy cars up the long hill.
locomotive.exampleZh: 那台旧机车拉着六节沉重的车厢爬上了长长的山坡。

locust.example: A big group of locusts flew over the field and ate all the crops.
locust.exampleZh: 一大群蝗虫飞过田野，吃光了所有的庄稼。

lodge.example: We will lodge in a small hotel near the train station tonight.
lodge.exampleZh: 今晚我们将暂住在火车站附近的一家小旅馆里。

lodging.example: I need cheap lodging near the station for two nights.
lodging.exampleZh: 我需要在车站附近找个便宜的住所住两晚。

loft.example: They keep old books and boxes in the loft above the garage.
loft.exampleZh: 他们把旧书和箱子放在车库上方的阁楼里。

lofty.example: The lofty mountain looked very beautiful in the morning light.
lofty.exampleZh: 那座高耸的山在晨光中看起来非常美。

log.example: Please log in with your new password before you check the report.
log.exampleZh: 请先用你的新密码登录，然后再查看报告。

logic.example: There is no logic in his plan, so I cannot support it.
logic.exampleZh: 他的计划毫无逻辑，所以我无法支持它。

logical.example: Her logical answer showed that the plan would save both time and money.
logical.exampleZh: 她合乎逻辑的回答表明，这个计划既省时又省钱。

logo.example: The company put its new logo on every box.
logo.exampleZh: 公司把新标识印在了每个盒子上。

loin.example: The butcher cut a piece of meat from the loin.
loin.exampleZh: 屠夫从腰部切下一块肉。

loiter.example: Two boys loiter near the shop every afternoon after school.
loiter.exampleZh: 两个男孩每天下午放学后都在商店附近闲逛。

loneliness.example: Her loneliness grew after she moved to a new city alone.
loneliness.exampleZh: 她独自搬到一座新城市后，孤独感越来越强。

lonely.example: The old man felt lonely after his children moved to another city.
lonely.exampleZh: 孩子们搬到另一个城市后，老人感到很孤独。

long.example: I long to see my family again after this long trip.
long.exampleZh: 这次漫长的旅行之后，我渴望再次见到我的家人。

longevity.example: Healthy food and regular exercise may help people enjoy greater longevity.
longevity.exampleZh: 健康的饮食和规律的锻炼可能帮助人们更长寿。

longing.example: She felt a deep longing for her home in the mountains.
longing.exampleZh: 她对山里的家感到深深的渴望。

longitude.example: The ship's longitude showed that it was far from land.
longitude.exampleZh: 这艘船的经度显示它离陆地很远。

look.example: She gave me a strange look when I told her the news.
look.exampleZh: 当我告诉她这个消息时，她用奇怪的神情看了我一眼。

lookout.example: The sailors stood on the lookout and watched the sea all night.
lookout.exampleZh: 水手们站在瞭望台上，整夜注视着海面。

loony.example: My friend went a little loony after staying awake for two days.
loony.exampleZh: 我朋友熬了两天夜之后有点发疯了。

loop.example: The program uses a loop to repeat the same steps.
loop.exampleZh: 这个程序用一个循环来重复相同的步骤。

loophole.example: The new tax law has a loophole that lets rich people pay less.
loophole.exampleZh: 新税法有一个漏洞，让富人能少缴税。

loose.example: My old jeans are too loose, so I need a smaller size.
loose.exampleZh: 我的旧牛仔裤太松了，所以我需要小一号的。

loot.example: The soldiers looted the empty shops after the battle.
loot.exampleZh: 战斗结束后，士兵们洗劫了空无一人的商店。

lord.example: The old lord lived in a large castle with his family.
lord.exampleZh: 那位年老的领主和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

lordship.example: The old lordship ruled the village and its land for many years.
lordship.exampleZh: 这位老勋爵统治这个村庄及其土地多年。

lore.example: The old man shared his lore about the forest with us.
lore.exampleZh: 老人和我们分享了关于这片森林的传说。

lorry.example: The lorry is carrying boxes of apples to the market.
lorry.exampleZh: 那辆卡车正把一箱箱苹果运往市场。

lose.example: Be careful with your bag, or you will lose it again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心你的包，否则你又会把它弄丢的。

loser.example: He felt like a loser after failing the exam twice.
loser.exampleZh: 两次考试不及格后，他觉得自己是个失败者。

loss.example: The company reported a big loss last year.
loss.exampleZh: 公司去年报告了巨额亏损。

lost.example: The lost child was crying near the busy street.
lost.exampleZh: 那个迷路的孩子在繁忙的街道旁哭泣。

lot.example: There are a lot of people in the park today.

lotion.example: She puts lotion on her hands after washing them.
lotion.exampleZh: 她洗完手后会在手上涂护肤液。

lottery.example: My mother buys a lottery ticket every week but has never won.
lottery.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周都买一张彩票，但从未中过奖。

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太响了，请把它调小一点。

loudspeaker.example: The teacher spoke into the loudspeaker so everyone in the hall could hear.
loudspeaker.exampleZh: 老师对着扩音器讲话，好让大厅里的每个人都能听见。

lounge.example: We waited in the hotel lounge until our room was ready.
lounge.exampleZh: 我们在酒店休息室等到房间准备好。

louse.example: The teacher warned the children that a louse can hide in long hair.
louse.exampleZh: 老师提醒孩子们，虱子可能藏在长发里。

lousy.example: The food at that restaurant was lousy and we will not go back.
lousy.exampleZh: 那家餐厅的食物很糟糕，我们不会再去了。

lout.example: The lout at the party spilled his drink on everyone and laughed.
lout.exampleZh: 聚会上的那个粗人把饮料洒在每个人身上，还大笑起来。

lovable.example: The little dog is very lovable and everyone in our family likes him.
lovable.exampleZh: 这只小狗非常可爱，我们家里每个人都喜欢它。

love.example: My love for music started when I was very young.
love.exampleZh: 我对音乐的热爱始于我很小的时候。

lovelorn.example: The lovelorn boy wrote a sad song about his old girlfriend.
lovelorn.exampleZh: 那个失恋的男孩写了一首关于前女友的悲伤歌曲。

lovely.example: She has a lovely little garden behind her house.
lovely.exampleZh: 她的房子后面有一个可爱的小花园。

lover.example: My brother is a great lover of old music and books.
lover.exampleZh: 我哥哥是个热爱老音乐和书籍的人。

low.example: My desk is very low, so I can reach it easily.
low.exampleZh: 我的书桌很低，所以我很容易够到它。

lowbrow.example: Some people think that lowbrow movies are just silly fun for a rainy night.
lowbrow.exampleZh: 有些人认为低级趣味的电影不过是雨夜里消遣的傻乐。

lower.example: Please lower your voice so the baby can sleep.
lower.exampleZh: 请把声音放低，这样宝宝才能睡觉。

lowland.example: Many farmers grow rice in the lowlands near the river.
lowland.exampleZh: 许多农民在河附近的低地上种植水稻。

lowly.example: He was born in a lowly family but worked very hard.
lowly.exampleZh: 他出生在一个卑微的家庭，但他非常努力。

loyal.example: A loyal friend always stands by you when times are hard.
loyal.exampleZh: 忠诚的朋友在你艰难时总会站在你身边。

loyalist.example: He was a loyalist who stayed with the king until the very end.
loyalist.exampleZh: 他是一个效忠者，直到最后都跟随国王。

loyalty.example: Her loyalty to her friends never changed, even when life became difficult.
loyalty.exampleZh: 她对朋友的忠诚从未改变，即使生活变得艰难。

lubricant.example: You should add some lubricant to the machine before you start it.
lubricant.exampleZh: 启动机器前你应该给它加一些润滑油。

lubricate.example: Please lubricate the wheels of your bike before the long ride.
lubricate.exampleZh: 长途骑行前，请给你的自行车轮子加润滑油。

luck.example: I think luck is important, but hard work matters more.
luck.exampleZh: 我认为运气很重要，但努力工作更重要。

lucky.example: I feel lucky to have such good friends.
lucky.exampleZh: 有这么好的朋友，我觉得很幸运。

lucrative.example: Selling handmade bags online has become a lucrative business for her family.
lucrative.exampleZh: 在网上卖手工包已成为她家一项有利可图的生意。

lug.example: He had to lug the heavy box up the stairs alone.
lug.exampleZh: 他不得不独自把那个沉重的箱子费力搬上楼。

luggage.example: Please keep your luggage with you at all times in the station.
luggage.exampleZh: 在车站里请随时把行李带在身边。

lukewarm.example: The coffee was lukewarm, so I did not drink it.
lukewarm.exampleZh: 咖啡是微温的，所以我没喝。

lull.example: The soft music helped lull the baby to sleep.
lull.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐帮助哄婴儿入睡。

lullaby.example: My mother sang a soft lullaby to help me fall asleep.
lullaby.exampleZh: 妈妈唱了一首轻柔的摇篮曲，帮我入睡。

lumber.example: The old house was built with lumber from the nearby forest.
lumber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用附近森林里的木材建造的。

lumen.example: This lamp gives about eight hundred lumens of light on its brightest setting.
lumen.exampleZh: 这盏灯在最亮档位下发出大约八百流明的光。

luminous.example: The luminous moon made the small garden bright last night.
luminous.exampleZh: 昨晚明亮的月亮把小花園照得很亮。

lump.example: The doctor felt a small lump on my neck this morning.
lump.exampleZh: 今天早上医生在我脖子上摸到了一个小肿块。

lunacy.example: It is lunacy to drive so fast on a rainy night.
lunacy.exampleZh: 在雨夜开这么快车是愚蠢的行为。

lunar.example: The lunar calendar is important for many traditional festivals in Asia.
lunar.exampleZh: 阴历对亚洲的许多传统节日很重要。

lunch.example: I eat lunch with my friends at school every day.
lunch.exampleZh: 我每天在学校和朋友们一起吃午饭。

luncheon.example: The club holds a formal luncheon for its members every spring.
luncheon.exampleZh: 这个俱乐部每年春天为会员举办一次正式的午餐会。

lung.example: Smoking is very bad for your lungs and can make you sick.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的肺非常有害，会让你生病。

lunge.example: He made a sudden lunge for the ball but missed it.
lunge.exampleZh: 他突然向球猛扑过去，但没有碰到。

lurch.example: The bus gave a sudden lurch and we all grabbed the handrails.
lurch.exampleZh: 公交车突然一歪，我们都抓住了扶手。

lure.example: The smell of fresh bread lured many people into the small shop.
lure.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味吸引了许多人走进这家小店。

lurid.example: The newspaper printed lurid details about the crime, shocking all its readers.
lurid.exampleZh: 报纸刊登了关于这起犯罪的骇人听闻的细节，令所有读者震惊。

lurk.example: The cat likes to lurk behind the door and surprise us.
lurk.exampleZh: 那只猫喜欢潜伏在门后，然后吓我们一跳。

luscious.example: The cake was luscious and sweet, and everyone wanted a second piece.
luscious.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕美味香甜，每个人都想再来一块。

lush.example: The garden looks lush after weeks of warm spring rain.
lush.exampleZh: 经过几周温暖的春雨，花园看起来郁郁葱葱。

lust.example: His lust for money made him forget his old friends.
lust.exampleZh: 他对金钱的贪欲让他忘记了老朋友。

luxuriant.example: The garden has luxuriant green grass and many tall trees.
luxuriant.exampleZh: 这个花园有繁茂的青草和许多高大的树木。

luxurious.example: They stayed in a luxurious hotel with a big pool and a great view.
luxurious.exampleZh: 他们住在一家豪华酒店，那里有一个大泳池和很棒的景色。

luxury.example: She enjoys the luxury of a long bath after a busy day.
luxury.exampleZh: 忙碌一天后，她享受着长时间泡澡的奢侈。

lying.example: The old dog is lying on the warm floor near the window.
lying.exampleZh: 那只老狗正躺在窗边温暖的地板上。

lymph.example: The doctor said the clear fluid in her leg was lymph.
lymph.exampleZh: 医生说，她腿里的清澈液体是淋巴液。

lymphatic.example: The lymphatic system helps the body fight infection and remove waste.
lymphatic.exampleZh: 淋巴系统帮助身体抵抗感染并清除废物。

lyric.example: She wrote the lyrics for our school song last year.
lyric.exampleZh: 她去年为我们学校的校歌写了歌词。

lyrical.example: Her lyrical voice made the simple song feel warm and beautiful.
lyrical.exampleZh: 她如歌般的嗓音让这首简单的歌听起来温暖而优美。

macabre.example: The old house had a macabre feeling that frightened the children.
macabre.exampleZh: 那栋老房子有一种令人毛骨悚然的感觉，让孩子们感到害怕。

machine.example: This machine can wash a lot of clothes in one hour.
machine.exampleZh: 这台机器能在一小时内洗很多衣服。

machinery.example: The new machinery in the factory helps workers finish their jobs faster.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂里的新机器帮助工人们更快完成工作。

macroeconomics.example: Macroeconomics helps us understand why prices rise and jobs disappear.
macroeconomics.exampleZh: 宏观经济学帮助我们理解物价上涨和就业岗位消失的原因。

macroscopic.example: At the macroscopic level, the whole city looks like a single living thing.
macroscopic.exampleZh: 在宏观层面上，整座城市看起来就像一个活着的整体。

madam.example: Excuse me, madam, may I help you with your bags?
madam.exampleZh: 女士，打扰一下，我帮您拿包好吗？

madrigal.example: The choir sang a lovely madrigal about spring at the school concert.
madrigal.exampleZh: 合唱团在学校的音乐会上唱了一首关于春天的优美牧歌。

magazine.example: She reads a fashion magazine every month to learn about new styles.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每个月都读一本时尚杂志，了解新的款式。

magic.example: The children believe this old box has magic inside it.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信这个旧盒子里有魔法。

magistrate.example: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
magistrate.exampleZh: 地方法官在做出裁决前仔细听取了双方的陈述。

magma.example: The hot magma flows slowly down the side of the volcano.
magma.exampleZh: 炽热的岩浆沿着火山坡缓缓流下。

magnanimous.example: The magnanimous winner praised the other team for playing so well.
magnanimous.exampleZh: 这位宽宏大量的赢家称赞对方队伍打得非常出色。

magnet.example: The boy used a magnet to pick up the small metal pins.
magnet.exampleZh: 男孩用磁铁把那些小金属针吸了起来。

magnetic.example: The magnetic toy sticks to the fridge door very easily.
magnetic.exampleZh: 这个磁性玩具很容易吸在冰箱门上。

magnetism.example: The magnetism of the old town attracts many visitors every year.
magnetism.exampleZh: 这座老城的魅力每年吸引许多游客。

magnificent.example: The castle on the hill is a magnificent building with tall towers.
magnificent.exampleZh: 山上的城堡是一座带有高塔的宏伟建筑。

magnify.example: You can magnify the small text with this app.
magnify.exampleZh: 你可以用这个应用把小字放大。

magnitude.example: The magnitude of the earthquake was small, so no buildings were damaged.
magnitude.exampleZh: 这次地震的震级很小，所以没有建筑物受损。

mahogany.example: The old table is made of mahogany and looks very beautiful.
mahogany.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子是用桃花心木做的，看起来非常漂亮。

maid.example: The maid cleans the rooms every morning before the guests wake up.
maid.exampleZh: 女仆每天早上在客人醒来之前打扫房间。

maiden.example: The young maiden sang a soft song by the river.
maiden.exampleZh: 那位年轻的少女在河边唱着一首轻柔的歌。

mail.example: I will mail the letter to my friend this afternoon.
mail.exampleZh: 我今天下午会把信寄给我的朋友。

mailbox.example: I put the letter in your mailbox this morning.
mailbox.exampleZh: 今天早上我把信放进了你的邮箱。

maim.example: The bomb maimed two soldiers and left them unable to walk.
maim.exampleZh: 炸弹炸残了两名士兵，使他们无法行走。

main.example: The main road to the airport is closed for repairs today.
main.exampleZh: 通往机场的主干道今天因维修而封闭。

mainland.example: Many people take a train from the mainland to visit the island.
mainland.exampleZh: 许多人从大陆坐火车去参观这座岛。

mainstream.example: This idea is now part of the mainstream in many countries.
mainstream.exampleZh: 这个想法现在在许多国家已成为主流的一部分。

maintain.example: We must maintain the machines every month to keep them working well.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须每月保养这些机器，让它们保持良好运转。

maintenance.example: The maintenance of this old building costs a lot of money.
maintenance.exampleZh: 这栋老建筑的维护要花很多钱。

majestic.example: The old king lived in a majestic castle on the hill.
majestic.exampleZh: 那位年迈的国王住在山上的一座雄伟城堡里。

major.example: She chose history as her major because she loves reading about the past.
major.exampleZh: 她选择历史作为主修专业，因为她喜欢阅读关于过去的书。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class like playing basketball after school.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后打篮球。

makeup.example: She wears very little makeup on school days.

malady.example: The doctor said this malady is easy to treat with rest.
malady.exampleZh: 医生说这种病只要休息就容易治好。

malaria.example: Malaria is a serious disease spread by mosquito bites in hot countries.
malaria.exampleZh: 疟疾是一种由蚊虫叮咬在炎热国家传播的严重疾病。

malfunction.example: A small malfunction in the engine stopped the whole machine.
malfunction.exampleZh: 发动机的一个小故障使整台机器停止了运转。

malice.example: He spoke without malice, but his words still hurt her feelings.
malice.exampleZh: 他说话并无恶意，但他的话仍然伤害了她的感情。

malignant.example: The doctor said the tumor was malignant and needed to be removed quickly.
malignant.exampleZh: 医生说这个肿瘤是恶性的，需要尽快切除。

mall.example: We will meet our friends at the mall this afternoon.
mall.exampleZh: 我们今天下午将在购物中心见我们的朋友。

malnutrition.example: Many children in poor areas suffer from malnutrition because they do not get enough food.
malnutrition.exampleZh: 贫困地区的许多儿童因为得不到足够的食物而营养不良。

malware.example: The virus on his computer was a kind of malware that steals passwords.
malware.exampleZh: 他电脑上的病毒是一种会窃取密码的恶意软件。

mammal.example: The whale is a mammal that lives in the ocean, not a fish.
mammal.exampleZh: 鲸鱼是生活在海洋里的哺乳动物，不是鱼。

mammalian.example: The whale is a mammalian animal that lives in the ocean.
mammalian.exampleZh: 鲸鱼是一种生活在海洋中的哺乳动物。

mammoth.example: The new museum is a mammoth building with over fifty rooms.
mammoth.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆是一座拥有五十多个房间的巨大建筑。

manage.example: She manages a small shop and still finds time to study.
manage.exampleZh: 她经营一家小店，还抽得出时间学习。

manageable.example: The work is hard, but it is still manageable for our small team.
manageable.exampleZh: 这项工作量很大，但对我们的小团队来说仍然是可以处理的。

management.example: Good management helps a small team finish its work on time.
management.exampleZh: 良好的管理能帮助小团队按时完成工作。

manager.example: The new manager will meet our team tomorrow morning.
manager.exampleZh: 新经理明天上午会来见我们团队。

mandate.example: The new government has a clear mandate to improve public health care.
mandate.exampleZh: 新政府拥有明确的授权来改善公共医疗。

mandatory.example: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory for all drivers in this country.
mandatory.exampleZh: 在这个国家，所有司机都必须系安全带。

maneuver.example: The army practiced a simple maneuver before the big training exercise.
maneuver.exampleZh: 军队在大型训练演习前练习了一个简单的调动。

manifest.example: The symptoms of the illness began to manifest themselves after a few days.
manifest.exampleZh: 这种疾病的症状几天后开始显现出来。

manifesto.example: The group published a manifesto to explain its goals to the public.
manifesto.exampleZh: 该团体发表了一份宣言，向公众说明其目标。

manipulate.example: Some people try to manipulate the news to change what we think.
manipulate.exampleZh: 有些人试图操纵新闻来改变我们的想法。

mankind.example: This new medicine may bring hope to all mankind.
mankind.exampleZh: 这种新药可能为全人类带来希望。

manly.example: His deep voice and strong hands made him seem very manly.
manly.exampleZh: 他低沉的嗓音和有力的双手让他显得很有男子气概。

manned.example: The manned spacecraft carried three astronauts to the space station.
manned.exampleZh: 这艘载人飞船将三名宇航员送上了空间站。

manner.example: Her friendly manner makes everyone feel welcome at work.
manner.exampleZh: 她和善的态度让每个人在工作中都感到受欢迎。

manor.example: The old family lived in a large manor near the river.
manor.exampleZh: 那个古老的家族住在河边一座大庄园里。

mansion.example: They live in a large old mansion near the river.
mansion.exampleZh: 他们住在河边一座古老的大宅邸里。

mantle.example: The old king wore a heavy mantle over his shoulders.
mantle.exampleZh: 老国王肩上披着一件厚重的斗篷。

manual.example: Please read the manual before you use the new washing machine.
manual.exampleZh: 使用新洗衣机之前，请先阅读说明书。

manufacture.example: This factory manufactures small parts for cars and bikes.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这家工厂为汽车和自行车制造小零件。

manuscript.example: She sent the manuscript to a publisher last week.
manuscript.exampleZh: 她上周把手稿寄给了出版商。

many.example: Many people like to walk in the park after dinner.
many.exampleZh: 许多人喜欢晚饭后去公园散步。

map.example: Can you show me the map of this small town?
map.exampleZh: 你能给我看看这个小镇的地图吗？

maple.example: The big maple in our yard turns bright red every fall.
maple.exampleZh: 我们院子里的那棵大枫树每到秋天就会变成鲜红色。

mar.example: A single careless joke can mar an otherwise perfect evening.
mar.exampleZh: 一个不小心的玩笑就可能毁掉原本完美的夜晚。

marathon.example: My father ran his first marathon last year and felt very proud.
marathon.exampleZh: 我父亲去年跑了他人生中的第一次马拉松，感到非常自豪。

marble.example: The floor of the old hall was made of smooth white marble.
marble.exampleZh: 那座老大厅的地板是用光滑的白色大理石铺成的。

margin.example: The teacher wrote a short note in the margin of my book.
margin.exampleZh: 老师在我书的页边空白处写了一条简短的批注。

marginal.example: The change in price was so marginal that most customers did not notice it.
marginal.exampleZh: 价格的变化非常微小，大多数顾客都没有注意到。

marginally.example: This new phone is only marginally better than the old one.
marginally.exampleZh: 这款新手机只比旧的好一点点。

marine.example: The marine animals live in the deep sea near the island.
marine.exampleZh: 这些海洋动物生活在岛屿附近的深海里。

marital.example: Her marital status is not important to my work.
marital.exampleZh: 她的婚姻状况对我的工作并不重要。

maritime.example: Maritime trade brought many goods and new ideas to the coastal towns.
maritime.exampleZh: 海上贸易为沿海城镇带来了许多货物和新思想。

mark.example: The teacher will mark our test papers before Friday afternoon.
mark.exampleZh: 老师会在周五下午之前给我们的试卷打分。

markedly.example: Her English improved markedly after she started reading simple books every day.
markedly.exampleZh: 她开始每天读简单的书之后，英语明显进步了。

market.example: She goes to the market every Saturday to buy fresh fruit and vegetables.
market.exampleZh: 她每个星期六都去市场买新鲜水果和蔬菜。

maroon.example: The storm left the sailors marooned on a small island.
maroon.exampleZh: 暴风雨让船员们被困在一座小岛上。

marriage.example: Their happy marriage began with a small wedding in the countryside.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们幸福的婚姻始于乡下一场小型婚礼。

marry.example: My sister will marry her boyfriend next spring in a small village.
marry.exampleZh: 我姐姐明年春天将在一个小村庄里和她的男朋友结婚。

marsh.example: The old boat was stuck in the marsh near our village.
marsh.exampleZh: 那条旧船卡在我们村子附近的沼泽里。

martial.example: He has practiced martial arts since he was a young boy.

martyr.example: The old church was built in memory of a martyr who died for his faith.
martyr.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂是为了纪念一位为信仰而死的殉道者而建的。

marvel.example: It is a marvel that such a small bird can fly so far.
marvel.exampleZh: 这么小的鸟能飞这么远，真是个奇迹。

marvelous.example: The view from the top of the hill was marvelous.
marvelous.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色真是美极了。

mascot.example: The team's mascot is a big friendly bear that children love.
mascot.exampleZh: 这支队伍的吉祥物是一只孩子们喜欢的大而友好的熊。

masculine.example: His deep voice and short hair give him a very masculine look.
masculine.exampleZh: 他低沉的嗓音和短发让他看起来很有男子气概。

mask.example: She wore a mask on the bus because she had a bad cold.
mask.exampleZh: 她因为得了重感冒，在公交车上戴了口罩。

mass.example: A large mass of dark clouds gathered above the small town before the storm.
mass.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，一大团乌云聚集在小镇上空。

massacre.example: The soldiers were tried for the massacre of innocent people in the village.
massacre.exampleZh: 那些士兵因在村庄里屠杀无辜百姓而受审。

massive.example: The company spent a massive amount of money on the new building.
massive.exampleZh: 公司在这座新楼上花费了大量资金。

master.example: She worked hard to master English and became a master of it.
master.exampleZh: 她努力学习掌握英语，并成为了这方面的大师。

masterpiece.example: Many people think this old book is a masterpiece of modern writing.
masterpiece.exampleZh: 许多人认为这本旧书是现代写作的一部杰作。

match.example: This old match is no match for my little brother at chess.
match.exampleZh: 这场旧比赛和我弟弟下棋时，我根本不是他的对手。

matching.example: She wore a matching hat and gloves to the party.
matching.exampleZh: 她戴了一顶相配的帽子和手套去参加聚会。

material.example: This material is soft and easy to cut with simple tools.
material.exampleZh: 这种材料很柔软，用简单的工具就很容易切开。

materialism.example: His materialism makes him care more about money than about people.
materialism.exampleZh: 他的物质主义让他更在乎钱，而不是在乎人。

materialistic.example: Some people think that materialistic values make us less happy.
materialistic.exampleZh: 有些人认为物质主义的价值观让我们变得不那么快乐。

maternal.example: Her maternal love gave the child a warm and safe home.
maternal.exampleZh: 她的母爱给了孩子一个温暖而安全的家。

math.example: Math is my favorite subject because I like working with numbers.
math.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的科目，因为我喜欢和数字打交道。

mathematical.example: She solved the mathematical problem quickly and correctly.
mathematical.exampleZh: 她迅速且正确地解出了那道数学题。

mathematics.example: I like mathematics because it helps me solve everyday problems.
mathematics.exampleZh: 我喜欢数学，因为它能帮我解决日常问题。

matrix.example: The teacher drew a simple matrix on the board to show the numbers.
matrix.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一个简单的矩阵来展示这些数字。

matter.example: This is a small matter, so do not worry about it.
matter.exampleZh: 这是一件小事，所以不要担心。

mature.example: She is very mature for her age and handles problems calmly.
mature.exampleZh: 就她的年龄而言，她非常成熟，处理问题很冷静。

maturity.example: Her maturity shows in how calmly she handles difficult problems at work.
maturity.exampleZh: 她的成熟体现在工作时处理难题的冷静态度上。

maximize.example: Good managers know how to maximize the time they spend with their team.
maximize.exampleZh: 优秀的管理者懂得如何充分利用与团队相处的时间。

maximum.example: The maximum speed of this car is very high.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆车的最高速度非常高。

may.example: May I ask you a simple question about this book?
may.exampleZh: 我可以问你一个关于这本书的简单问题吗？

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain later, so take an umbrella with you.
maybe.exampleZh: 也许稍后会下雨，所以你带把伞吧。

mayor.example: The mayor opened the new library in front of many people.
mayor.exampleZh: 市长在许多人面前为新图书馆揭幕。

maze.example: The children got lost in the maze and could not find the way out.
maze.exampleZh: 孩子们在迷宫里迷了路，找不到出去的路。

meadow.example: The cows walked slowly across the green meadow behind the farm.
meadow.exampleZh: 奶牛慢慢地走过农场后面的绿色草地。

meager.example: The family lived on a meager income and could barely buy enough food.
meager.exampleZh: 这家人靠微薄的收入生活，几乎买不起足够的食物。

meal.example: We usually eat three meals a day at home.
meal.exampleZh: 我们通常一天在家吃三顿饭。

mean.example: What does this word mean? The average is five.
mean.exampleZh: 这个词是什么意思？平均数是五。

meaning.example: I do not understand the meaning of this word.
meaning.exampleZh: 我不明白这个词的意思。

meaningful.example: This small gift is very meaningful to my family.
meaningful.exampleZh: 这份小礼物对我的家人来说非常有意义。

means.example: He has the means to buy a new car this year.
means.exampleZh: 他有能力在今年买一辆新车。

measurable.example: The new plan brought a measurable improvement in our daily work.
measurable.exampleZh: 新计划给我们的日常工作带来了明显的改善。

measure.example: We need to measure the table before we buy a new cloth for it.
measure.exampleZh: 在买新桌布之前，我们需要量一下这张桌子。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 那位机械工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

mechanical.example: His mechanical way of answering questions made him seem cold and unfriendly.
mechanical.exampleZh: 他机械式的回答方式让他显得冷漠而不友好。

mechanically.example: He nodded mechanically and did not really hear what I said.
mechanically.exampleZh: 他机械地点了点头，其实并没听见我说的话。

mechanism.example: The clock has a small mechanism that keeps it running all day.
mechanism.exampleZh: 这个钟有一个小机械装置，使它整天运转。

medal.example: She won a gold medal in the running race at school last year.
medal.exampleZh: 她在去年的学校跑步比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

meddle.example: Please do not meddle in my personal affairs again.
meddle.exampleZh: 请不要再干涉我的私事。

media.example: The media often plays an important role in shaping public opinion.
media.exampleZh: 媒体在塑造公众舆论方面经常发挥重要作用。

medical.example: She wants to study medical science at a good university next year.
medical.exampleZh: 她想明年在一所好大学学习医学。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me some medicine for my cough and told me to rest.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我一些治咳嗽的药，并让我休息。

medieval.example: This old town still has many medieval walls and narrow streets.
medieval.exampleZh: 这座古镇仍有许多中世纪的城墙和狭窄街道。

mediocre.example: The food at that restaurant was mediocre, so we will not go back.
mediocre.exampleZh: 那家餐厅的食物很普通，所以我们不会再去了。

meditate.example: Every morning she sits quietly by the window and meditates for twenty minutes.
meditate.exampleZh: 每天早上她都安静地坐在窗边冥想二十分钟。

meditation.example: She does meditation for twenty minutes every morning before she goes to work.
meditation.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前会冥想二十分钟。

medium.example: She buys medium coffee and drinks it slowly every morning.
medium.exampleZh: 她买中杯咖啡，每天早上慢慢喝。

meet.example: We will meet at the train station at nine tomorrow morning.
meet.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点在火车站会面。

melancholy.example: A deep melancholy filled the empty house after she left.
melancholy.exampleZh: 她离开后，一种深深的忧郁充满了这座空房子。

melody.example: The melody of this old song makes me think of my childhood.
melody.exampleZh: 这首老歌的旋律让我想起了童年。

melt.example: The snow will melt quickly when the warm spring sun comes out.
melt.exampleZh: 温暖的春日阳光一出来，雪就会很快融化。

member.example: She is a new member of our school music club.
member.exampleZh: 她是我们学校音乐社团的新成员。

membership.example: I renewed my gym membership last week so I can keep exercising.
membership.exampleZh: 我上周续了健身房会员资格，这样我就能继续锻炼了。

memo.example: I wrote a short memo to remind the team about tomorrow's meeting.
memo.exampleZh: 我写了一份简短的备忘录，提醒团队明天的会议。

memorial.example: The city built a memorial for the soldiers who died in the war.
memorial.exampleZh: 这座城市为在战争中阵亡的士兵建了一座纪念碑。

memorize.example: Students often memorize new words by reading them aloud many times.
memorize.exampleZh: 学生们常常通过大声朗读多次来记住新单词。

memory.example: Music helps me keep the memory of my childhood alive.
memory.exampleZh: 音乐帮助我留住童年的记忆。

menace.example: The dark clouds were a menace to the small boat.
menace.exampleZh: 乌云对小船构成了威胁。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your physical and mental health.
mental.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对身体和心理健康都有好处。

mention.example: She did not mention the meeting in her email yesterday.
mention.exampleZh: 她昨天的邮件里没有提到那次会议。

mentor.example: My mentor helped me learn the job in my first month.
mentor.exampleZh: 我的导师在我第一个月里帮我学会了这份工作。

menu.example: The waiter gave us a menu with many local dishes.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员给了我们一份有许多当地菜的菜单。

merchandise.example: The store sells all kinds of merchandise, from small toys to winter clothes.
merchandise.exampleZh: 这家店出售各种商品，从小玩具到冬季衣物都有。

merchant.example: The merchant sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the market every morning.
merchant.exampleZh: 这个商人每天早上在市场卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

mercury.example: The mercury in the thermometer rose quickly when the sun came out.
mercury.exampleZh: 太阳出来后，温度计里的水银迅速上升。

mercy.example: The judge showed mercy and gave the young man a second chance.
mercy.exampleZh: 法官心生怜悯，给了这个年轻人第二次机会。

mere.example: It was a mere mistake, so please do not worry about it.
mere.exampleZh: 那只不过是个错误，所以请不要为此担心。

merge.example: The two small companies will merge into one big team next year.
merge.exampleZh: 这两家小公司明年将合并成一个大团队。

merit.example: Her hard work and honesty have great merit in the eyes of the teacher.
merit.exampleZh: 她的勤奋和诚实，在老师眼里很有价值。

merry.example: The children were merry as they sang songs around the fire.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们围着火唱歌，十分欢乐。

mess.example: His room is always in a mess, and he never cleans it.
mess.exampleZh: 他的房间总是乱糟糟的，他从不打扫。

message.example: I got a message from my sister this morning before I left home.
message.exampleZh: 今天早上我出门前收到了姐姐发来的一条信息。

metabolic.example: Regular exercise can improve your metabolic rate and help you stay healthy.
metabolic.exampleZh: 规律运动能提高你的新陈代谢率，帮助你保持健康。

metal.example: Iron and copper are common metals used to make tools and machines.
metal.exampleZh: 铁和铜是常见的金属，用来制造工具和机器。

metaphor.example: The poet uses a metaphor to compare the city to a sleeping giant.
metaphor.exampleZh: 诗人用隐喻把这座城市比作一个沉睡的巨人。

meteorite.example: The meteorite fell into a field near our small village last night.
meteorite.exampleZh: 昨晚那颗陨石落到了我们小村庄附近的田野里。

method.example: She has a simple method for keeping her desk tidy.
method.exampleZh: 她有一个保持书桌整洁的简单方法。

methodology.example: The teacher explained her methodology for helping students learn new words.
methodology.exampleZh: 老师解释了她帮助学生记忆新单词的教学方法。

metropolitan.example: Life in a metropolitan city is fast and exciting for young people.
metropolitan.exampleZh: 在大都市生活对年轻人来说节奏快又令人兴奋。

microbe.example: Washing your hands helps stop harmful microbes from spreading to other people.
microbe.exampleZh: 洗手有助于阻止有害微生物传播给其他人。

microorganism.example: This microorganism lives in the water and can make people sick.
microorganism.exampleZh: 这种微生物生活在水里，会让人生病。

microscope.example: We used a microscope to look at the tiny cells in the water.
microscope.exampleZh: 我们用显微镜观察水中的微小细胞。

microsope.example: The student looked through the microscope and saw small cells for the first time.
microsope.exampleZh: 这名学生透过显微镜第一次看到了小细胞。

microwave.example: She put the cold soup in the microwave for two minutes.
microwave.exampleZh: 她把冷汤放进微波炉里热了两分钟。

middle.example: Put the small table in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 把小桌子放在房间的中间。

might.example: She might come to the party later if she finishes her work early.
might.exampleZh: 如果她早点完成工作，她可能会晚点来参加聚会。

migrant.example: Every autumn, these migrants fly south to find warmer weather.
migrant.exampleZh: 每年秋天，这些候鸟都会飞往南方寻找更温暖的天气。

migrate.example: Many birds migrate south every winter to find warmer weather.
migrate.exampleZh: 许多鸟类每年冬天南迁，寻找更温暖的天气。

migratory.example: Some birds are migratory and fly south every winter.
migratory.exampleZh: 有些鸟是迁徙的，每年冬天都飞往南方。

mild.example: The weather is mild today, so we can walk outside.
mild.exampleZh: 今天天气温和，我们可以到外面走走。

militant.example: The militant group refused to talk with the government.
militant.exampleZh: 那个激进组织拒绝与政府对话。

military.example: The country spends a lot of money on military training every year.
military.exampleZh: 这个国家每年在军事训练上花很多钱。

milk.example: I drink a glass of milk every morning before I go to school.
milk.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前喝一杯牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river grinds wheat into flour every morning.
mill.exampleZh: 河边的老磨坊每天早上把小麦磨成面粉。

millennium.example: This city has changed a lot in the past millennium.
millennium.exampleZh: 这座城市在过去一千年里发生了很大变化。

millimeter.example: The box is only ten millimeters wide, so it fits in my hand.
millimeter.exampleZh: 这个盒子只有十毫米宽，所以能放在我手里。

million.example: Millions of people around the world speak English as a second language.
million.exampleZh: 全世界有数百万人把英语作为第二语言。

mind.example: Please keep an open mind when you listen to other people's ideas.
mind.exampleZh: 听别人讲想法时，请保持开放的心态。

mineral.example: This rock is rich in a mineral called iron.
mineral.exampleZh: 这块岩石富含一种叫做铁的矿物。

mingle.example: At the party, the guests began to mingle and talk with each other.
mingle.exampleZh: 在聚会上，客人们开始互相交往交谈。

minimal.example: The damage to the car was minimal after the small accident.
minimal.exampleZh: 那次小事故后，汽车的损伤是最小的。

minimize.example: We should minimize noise at night to help our neighbors sleep.
minimize.exampleZh: 我们应该在夜间尽量减少噪音，以帮助邻居入睡。

minimum.example: The minimum age to drive a car in this country is eighteen.
minimum.exampleZh: 在这个国家，开车的最低年龄是十八岁。

minister.example: The minister will visit our school next Monday morning.
minister.exampleZh: 部长将于下周一上午来我校参观。

minor.example: This is a minor problem, so we can fix it later.
minor.exampleZh: 这是一个较小的问题，我们可以稍后再解决。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students wanted to change the school rules.
minority.exampleZh: 只有少部分学生想改变校规。

mint.example: The old mint on the corner makes coins for the whole country.
mint.exampleZh: 街角那座古老的铸币厂为全国制造硬币。

minus.example: Ten minus four is six, and minus five means five below zero.
minus.exampleZh: 十减四等于六，而负五表示零下五度。

minute.example: Please wait a minute while I find the right file.
minute.exampleZh: 请等一分钟，我去找一下正确的文件。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the crash.
miracle.exampleZh: 那次撞车没有人受伤，真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: The calm lake was a mirror of the blue sky above.
mirror.exampleZh: 平静的湖面是上方蓝天的写照。

misconception.example: It is a common misconception that people only use ten percent of their brains.
misconception.exampleZh: 一个常见的误解是，人们只使用大脑的百分之十。

miserable.example: I felt miserable after walking home in the cold rain without an umbrella.
miserable.exampleZh: 在冷雨中没带伞走回家后，我感到很痛苦。

misery.example: Losing his job brought him great misery for many months.
misery.exampleZh: 失业给他带来了好几个月的极大痛苦。

misfortune.example: She lost her job last month, but that misfortune made her stronger.
misfortune.exampleZh: 她上个月失业了，但那次不幸让她变得更坚强。

mishap.example: Our trip was fun, but we had a small mishap with the car.
mishap.exampleZh: 我们的旅行很有趣，不过车子出了点小事故。

mislead.example: The ad may mislead people who know nothing about the product.
mislead.exampleZh: 这则广告可能会误导那些对该产品一无所知的人。

miss.example: I miss my old friends, and I never miss a chance to call them.
miss.exampleZh: 我想念我的老朋友，而且我从不放过给他们打电话的机会。

missile.example: The missile hit the empty building, but luckily no one was hurt.
missile.exampleZh: 导弹击中了那栋空楼，但幸运的是没有人受伤。

mission.example: Our mission is to help every child learn to read well.
mission.exampleZh: 我们的使命是帮助每个孩子学会好好阅读。

missionary.example: The missionary traveled to a small village and taught children there.
missionary.exampleZh: 这位传教士前往一个小村庄，在那里教孩子们。

mist.example: The mountains were hidden in a soft mist this morning.
mist.exampleZh: 今天早上群山隐没在轻柔的薄雾中。

mistake.example: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so please don't be too hard on yourself.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以请不要对自己太苛刻。

mistress.example: The mistress of the house welcomed every guest with a warm smile.
mistress.exampleZh: 这家的女主人用温暖的笑容迎接每一位客人。

mix.example: Mix the eggs and the milk in a large bowl.
mix.exampleZh: 把鸡蛋和牛奶放在一个大碗里搅拌。

mixture.example: The cake batter is a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk.
mixture.exampleZh: 蛋糕面糊是面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶的混合物。

moan.example: She began to moan softly when the nurse touched her arm.
moan.exampleZh: 护士碰到她的手臂时，她开始轻声呻吟。

mobile.example: My mobile phone is always in my bag when I go out.
mobile.exampleZh: 我出门时手机总是放在包里。

mode.example: This mode of teaching is simple and fun for young students.
mode.exampleZh: 这种教学方式对年轻学生来说既简单又有趣。

model.example: She is a famous model and often appears in magazines.
model.exampleZh: 她是一位著名模特，经常出现在杂志上。

moderate.example: We do moderate exercise every morning to stay healthy and happy.
moderate.exampleZh: 我们每天早上做适度运动，以保持健康和快乐。

modern.example: Modern phones can do many things that old computers could not do.
modern.exampleZh: 现代手机能做许多旧电脑做不到的事情。

modest.example: He is a modest man who never talks about his success.
modest.exampleZh: 他是个谦虚的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before the meeting tomorrow.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天开会前修改这个计划。

moist.example: The air was moist and cool after the heavy rain.
moist.exampleZh: 大雨过后，空气潮湿而凉爽。

moisture.example: The air in the old house is full of moisture.
moisture.exampleZh: 老房子里的空气充满了湿气。

mold.example: There is mold on the old bread, so we must throw it away.
mold.exampleZh: 旧面包上长了霉，所以我们必须把它扔掉。

molecule.example: Each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.exampleZh: 每个水分子有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find the right file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我来找一下正确的文件。

momentum.example: The team kept its momentum and won the next three games easily.
momentum.exampleZh: 球队保持了势头，轻松赢下了接下来的三场比赛。

monarchy.example: In a monarchy, one king or queen rules the whole country.
monarchy.exampleZh: 在君主制下，由一位国王或女王统治整个国家。

monetary.example: The bank controls monetary policy and tries to keep prices stable.
monetary.exampleZh: 银行控制货币政策，并努力保持物价稳定。

monitor.example: The teacher uses a monitor to check the students' progress every week.
monitor.exampleZh: 老师每周用显示器来查看学生们的学习进度。

monitoring.example: The doctor is monitoring his heart rate every hour today.
monitoring.exampleZh: 医生今天每小时监测一次他的心率。

monkey.example: The little monkey climbed high into the tree and ate a banana.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只小猴子爬到高高的树上，吃了一根香蕉。

monopoly.example: The large company has a monopoly on selling clean water in this city.
monopoly.exampleZh: 这家大公司垄断了这座城市的净水销售。

monotonous.example: The long drive through the desert was monotonous and made everyone sleepy.
monotonous.exampleZh: 穿过沙漠的漫长车程单调乏味，让每个人都昏昏欲睡。

monster.example: The little boy thinks a monster lives under his bed at night.
monster.exampleZh: 这个小男孩认为晚上有只怪物住在他的床底下。

montage.example: The film opens with a quick montage of city streets at night.
montage.exampleZh: 影片以一组快速剪辑的城市夜景街道开场。

month.example: We will visit our grandparents next month and stay for a few days.
month.exampleZh: 我们下个月会去看望祖父母，并住上几天。

monument.example: The old monument in the park honors the soldiers who died for freedom.
monument.exampleZh: 公园里的那座古老纪念碑纪念着为自由而牺牲的士兵们。

monumental.example: Building the bridge was a monumental task for the small town.
monumental.exampleZh: 建造这座桥对这个小镇来说是一项巨大的工程。

mood.example: The good news put everyone in a happy mood all day.
mood.exampleZh: 这个好消息让大家一整天都心情愉快。

moon.example: The moon looks very bright and round in the sky tonight.
moon.exampleZh: 今晚月亮在天空中又亮又圆。

mop.example: She used a wet mop to clean the kitchen floor after dinner.
mop.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用湿拖把擦洗厨房地板。

moral.example: The story has a clear moral about honesty and hard work.
moral.exampleZh: 这个故事有一个关于诚实和努力的明确寓意。

morale.example: The team's morale was low after they lost three games.
morale.exampleZh: 连输三场后，球队的士气很低。

morality.example: Honesty and kindness are important parts of morality in every culture.
morality.exampleZh: 诚实和善良是每种文化中道德的重要组成部分。

moreover.example: The room is clean and cheap; moreover, it is very close to the station.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间干净又便宜，而且离车站很近。

morning.example: The sun comes up early in the morning and the birds start singing.
morning.exampleZh: 早晨太阳升起得很早，鸟儿开始歌唱。

morsel.example: She gave the hungry cat a small morsel of fish.
morsel.exampleZh: 她给那只饥饿的猫一小口鱼肉。

mortal.example: All mortal creatures must die, but their love can live on.
mortal.exampleZh: 所有终有一死的生灵都会死去，但他们的爱可以延续下去。

mortality.example: The mortality rate for young children has fallen in many countries.
mortality.exampleZh: 许多国家的幼儿死亡率已经下降。

mortar.example: The soldiers fired a mortar at the enemy position on the hill.
mortar.exampleZh: 士兵们向山上的敌军阵地发射了一枚迫击炮。

mortgage.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first house last year.
mortgage.exampleZh: 他们去年办了一笔抵押贷款，买了他们的第一套房子。

mosquito.example: A mosquito bit my arm while I was sleeping last night.
mosquito.exampleZh: 昨晚我睡觉时，一只蚊子咬了我的胳膊。

mostly.example: The class is mostly girls, and they usually study together after school.
mostly.exampleZh: 这个班大部分是女生，她们通常放学后一起学习。

moth.example: A moth flew into the room and stayed near the lamp all night.
moth.exampleZh: 一只飞蛾飞进房间，整晚都停在灯旁。

motion.example: The motion of the train made me feel a little sleepy.
motion.exampleZh: 火车的运动让我有点困了。

motivate.example: Teachers should motivate students to read more books at home.
motivate.exampleZh: 老师应该激励学生在家多读书。

motivation.example: Her motivation to learn English grew after she made her first foreign friend.
motivation.exampleZh: 在结交第一个外国朋友后，她学习英语的动力增强了。

motive.example: His motive for helping us was to gain more power.
motive.exampleZh: 他帮助我们的动机是为了获得更多权力。

motor.example: The motor in this old car still runs very well.
motor.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的发动机仍然运转得很好。

motorcycle.example: My father rides his motorcycle to work every day when the weather is good.
motorcycle.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我父亲每天骑摩托车上班。

mound.example: A small mound of earth rose above the grass near the old tree.
mound.exampleZh: 一棵老树旁的草地上鼓起了一个小土丘。

mount.example: She will mount the stairs to reach the top of the tower.
mount.exampleZh: 她将登上楼梯到达塔顶。

mountain.example: We climbed the mountain in the early morning and watched the sunrise.
mountain.exampleZh: 我们清晨爬上这座山，观看了日出。

mourn.example: Many people mourn their lost family members and friends every year.
mourn.exampleZh: 每年都有很多人哀悼他们失去的家人和朋友。

mouse.example: The mouse ran under the table when it heard a loud noise.
mouse.exampleZh: 老鼠听到一声巨响就跑到桌子底下去了。

mouth.example: He opened his mouth to take a bite of the apple.
mouth.exampleZh: 他张开嘴咬了一口苹果。

move.example: We plan to move to a new apartment near the park next month.
move.exampleZh: 我们打算下个月搬到公园附近的一套新公寓。

movement.example: The slow movement of the crowd made everyone wait a long time.
movement.exampleZh: 人群缓慢的移动让大家等了很久。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在家看了一部有趣的电影。

mower.example: My father uses the mower every Saturday morning to cut the grass.
mower.exampleZh: 我父亲每周六早上都用割草机割草。

much.example: She does not have much time to cook dinner tonight.
much.exampleZh: 她今晚没有很多时间做晚饭。

mud.example: The children came home with mud all over their shoes.
mud.exampleZh: 孩子们回家时鞋子上全是泥。

multiple.example: This job has multiple tasks, and each one needs your full attention.
multiple.exampleZh: 这份工作有多项任务，每一项都需要你全神贯注。

multiply.example: Bacteria multiply quickly in warm and wet places.
multiply.exampleZh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的地方繁殖得很快。

multitude.example: A multitude of people gathered in the square to watch the show.
multitude.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看演出。

mumble.example: He always mumbles when he is nervous in front of other people.
mumble.exampleZh: 他在别人面前紧张时总是含糊地咕哝。

mundane.example: He wanted to escape his mundane life and travel the world.
mundane.exampleZh: 他想逃离自己平凡的生活，去环游世界。

municipal.example: The municipal government plans to build a new library near my home.
municipal.exampleZh: 市政府计划在我家附近建一座新图书馆。

mural.example: The artist painted a bright mural on the wall of our school.
mural.exampleZh: 这位艺术家在我们学校的墙上画了一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画。

murder.example: The police said it was murder, not an accident.
murder.exampleZh: 警方说这是一起谋杀，而不是意外。

murky.example: The water in the old pond was murky and hard to see through.
murky.exampleZh: 旧池塘里的水很浑浊，很难看透。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房锻炼，以练出强壮的肌肉。

muscular.example: The muscular man lifted the heavy box with one hand.
muscular.exampleZh: 那个肌肉发达的男人用一只手举起了这个沉重的箱子。

muse.example: She likes to muse quietly by the lake on warm summer evenings.
muse.exampleZh: 在温暖的夏日傍晚，她喜欢在湖边静静地沉思。

museum.example: We visited a famous museum in the city last Sunday with our friends.
museum.exampleZh: 上周日我们和朋友们参观了城里一座著名的博物馆。

mushroom.example: The little mushroom grew quickly after the warm rain, and the company's sales mushroomed too.
mushroom.exampleZh: 暖雨过后，那朵小蘑菇长得很快，公司的销售额也迅速增长了。

music.example: She listens to music every morning while she makes breakfast and checks her email.
music.exampleZh: 她每天早上做早饭和查邮件时都会听音乐。

musical.example: She has a musical voice and loves to sing songs every morning.
musical.exampleZh: 她有一副悦耳的嗓音，每天早上都喜欢唱歌。

musician.example: My brother is a talented musician who plays the piano very well.
musician.exampleZh: 我哥哥是一位有才华的音乐家，钢琴弹得很好。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you can watch TV.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业才能看电视。

mute.example: He stayed mute during the meeting and never said a word.
mute.exampleZh: 他在会上保持沉默，一句话也没说。

mutter.example: He muttered something under his breath and walked away.
mutter.exampleZh: 他低声嘟囔了几句，然后走开了。

mutual.example: Good friendship needs mutual trust and respect between two people.
mutual.exampleZh: 良好的友谊需要两个人之间有相互的信任和尊重。

mysterious.example: There is a mysterious light in the old house at night.
mysterious.exampleZh: 夜里那座老房子里有一道神秘的光。

mystery.example: The old house is still a mystery to everyone in our small town.
mystery.exampleZh: 那座老房子对我们小镇上的每个人来说仍然是个谜。

myth.example: It is a myth that you can learn a language in one week.
myth.exampleZh: 认为一周就能学会一门语言是一种荒诞说法。

mythology.example: She loves reading Greek mythology before bed each night.
mythology.exampleZh: 她喜欢每晚睡前读希腊神话。

nail.example: He used a hammer to nail the picture to the wall.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把画钉在墙上。

naive.example: The naive boy believed every story his friends told him.
naive.exampleZh: 那个天真的男孩相信朋友们讲的每一个故事。

naked.example: The little boy ran across the beach naked and laughing at the waves.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着身子跑过海滩，对着海浪大笑。

name.example: Please write your name at the top of the paper.
name.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在纸的顶端。

namely.example: Only one person can lead the team, namely Sarah.
namely.exampleZh: 只有一个人能带领这个团队，也就是萨拉。

narrate.example: The old man likes to narrate stories about his childhood to the children.
narrate.exampleZh: 这位老人喜欢给孩子们讲述他童年的故事。

narrative.example: The film tells a powerful narrative about a family's long journey home.
narrative.exampleZh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于一家人漫长回家之路的有力叙事。

narrow.example: This street is too narrow for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条街太窄了，两辆车过不去。

nasty.example: The weather was nasty, so we stayed inside all day.
nasty.exampleZh: 天气很恶劣，所以我们一整天都待在屋里。

nation.example: The whole nation was happy when the team won the game.
nation.exampleZh: 球队赢得比赛时，举国上下都很高兴。

national.example: The national team played very well and made the whole country proud.
national.exampleZh: 国家队打得非常好，让全国人民都感到骄傲。

nationwide.example: People across the country watched the nationwide speech on TV last night.
nationwide.exampleZh: 昨晚全国各地的人们都通过电视观看了这场全国性的演讲。

native.example: She is a native speaker of English and teaches at our school.
native.exampleZh: 她的母语是英语，并在我们学校教书。

natural.example: It is natural for children to ask questions about the world.
natural.exampleZh: 孩子对世界提出问题是很自然的。

naturalist.example: The naturalist spent many years studying birds and plants in the forest.
naturalist.exampleZh: 这位博物学家花了多年时间在森林里研究鸟类和植物。

naturally.example: She naturally speaks English well because she grew up in Canada.
naturally.exampleZh: 她天生英语说得好，因为她是在加拿大长大的。

nature.example: It is in her nature to help people who need it.

naval.example: My uncle works at a naval base near the sea.
naval.exampleZh: 我叔叔在海边的一个海军基地工作。

navigate.example: Sailors use the stars to navigate across the open sea at night.
navigate.exampleZh: 水手们在夜里利用星星在广阔的海面上航行。

navigation.example: The ship's navigation system helps sailors find the right way at sea.
navigation.exampleZh: 这艘船的导航系统帮助水手在海上找到正确的方向。

near.example: My new house is near a small park and a busy market.
near.exampleZh: 我的新房子在一个小公园和一个热闹的市场附近。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby, so we often walk there.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有个小公园，所以我们经常去那里散步。

nearly.example: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
nearly.exampleZh: 今天早上我差点错过公交车。

neat.example: Her neat desk and tidy notes made a good impression on the teacher.
neat.exampleZh: 她整洁的书桌和整齐的笔记给老师留下了好印象。

neatly.example: She neatly put all the books back on the shelf.
neatly.exampleZh: 她把所有的书整齐地放回书架上。

necessary.example: A good breakfast is necessary for children before they go to school.
necessary.exampleZh: 孩子上学前吃一顿好早餐是必要的。

necessity.example: A good breakfast is a necessity for students who study all morning.
necessity.exampleZh: 对一整个上午都在学习的学生来说，一顿丰盛的早餐是必需品。

neck.example: She wore a warm scarf around her neck on the cold winter morning.
neck.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬日早晨，她脖子上围着一条温暖的围巾。

necklace.example: She wore a silver necklace to the party last night.
necklace.exampleZh: 她昨晚戴着一条银项链去参加聚会。

need.example: We need more time to finish this work today.
need.exampleZh: 我们今天需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give him the medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给他注射药物。

needless.example: There is no needless waste of time when we plan our work well.
needless.exampleZh: 当我们把工作规划好时，就不会有不必要的时间浪费。

negative.example: His negative answer made everyone leave the room quickly.
negative.exampleZh: 他否定的回答让大家都迅速离开了房间。

neglect.example: Do not neglect your health when you are busy with work.
neglect.exampleZh: 工作忙的时候不要忽视你的健康。

negligence.example: The accident was caused by the driver's negligence.
negligence.exampleZh: 这起事故是由司机的疏忽造成的。

negligent.example: The negligent driver forgot to check his mirrors before changing lanes.
negligent.exampleZh: 那位粗心的司机在变道前忘了检查后视镜。

negligible.example: The difference between the two prices is negligible, so I bought the cheaper one.
negligible.exampleZh: 这两个价格之间的差别微不足道，所以我买了较便宜的那个。

negotiable.example: The price is negotiable if you are willing to buy two items.
negotiable.exampleZh: 如果你愿意买两件商品，价格是可以协商的。

negotiate.example: The two sides will negotiate a new deal next week.
negotiate.exampleZh: 双方将在下周谈判达成一项新协议。

negotiation.example: The two companies had a long negotiation about the price of the new machines.
negotiation.exampleZh: 两家公司就新机器的价格进行了长时间的谈判。

neighbor.example: Our neighbor helped us carry the heavy boxes into the house.
neighbor.exampleZh: 我们的邻居帮我们把沉重的箱子搬进了屋里。

neighborhood.example: There is a small park in my neighborhood where children often play.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我家附近有个小公园，孩子们常在那里玩。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee, and neither do I.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟都不喜欢咖啡，我也不喜欢。

neon.example: The bright neon sign outside the shop lights up the whole street.
neon.exampleZh: 商店外面明亮的霓虹灯招牌照亮了整条街道。

nephew.example: My nephew is only five, and he loves playing football with me.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子只有五岁，他喜欢和我一起踢足球。

nerve.example: He did not have the nerve to tell her the truth.
nerve.exampleZh: 他没有勇气告诉她真相。

nervous.example: I always feel nervous before I speak in front of many people.
nervous.exampleZh: 在很多人面前讲话之前，我总是感到紧张。

nest.example: The bird built a warm nest in the tall tree near our house.
nest.exampleZh: 那只鸟在我们家附近的一棵大树上筑了一个温暖的巢。

net.example: He caught a big fish in the old net near the river.
net.exampleZh: 他在河边的旧网里捕到了一条大鱼。

network.example: She joined a network of friends who help each other find jobs.
network.exampleZh: 她加入了一个互相帮助找工作的朋友关系网。

neutral.example: Switzerland stayed neutral during the war and did not join either side.
neutral.exampleZh: 瑞士在战争期间保持中立，没有加入任何一方。

neutron.example: A neutron is a very small particle found inside the nucleus of an atom.
neutron.exampleZh: 中子是原子核内部一种非常小的粒子。

nevertheless.example: The test was hard; nevertheless, she finished it on time.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 考试很难，然而她还是按时完成了。

new.example: She bought a new phone and a fresh bag for school.
new.exampleZh: 她买了一部新手机和一个上学用的新书包。

newly.example: The newly built school opened its doors to students last week.
newly.exampleZh: 这所新建的学校上周向学生们开放了。

news.example: I watch the news every night to learn about the world.
news.exampleZh: 我每天晚上看新闻来了解世界。

newspaper.example: My father reads a newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会看一份报纸。

next.example: I will see you next Monday at the school gate.
next.exampleZh: 我下周一在学校门口见你。

nibble.example: The rabbit likes to nibble on fresh carrots in the garden.
nibble.exampleZh: 兔子喜欢在花园里啃新鲜胡萝卜。

nice.example: She is very nice to the old man next door.
nice.exampleZh: 她对隔壁的老人非常友好。

nickel.example: The old coin in my hand is made of nickel.
nickel.exampleZh: 我手里的这枚旧硬币是用镍制成的。

niece.example: My niece is coming to visit us this weekend.
niece.exampleZh: 我的侄女这个周末要来看我们。

night.example: The stars look bright in the night sky.
night.exampleZh: 夜晚的天空中星星看起来很明亮。

nightmare.example: I had a terrible nightmare last night and could not sleep again.
nightmare.exampleZh: 昨晚我做了一个可怕的噩梦，之后就再也睡不着了。

nimble.example: Her nimble fingers quickly tied the small rope into a knot.
nimble.exampleZh: 她灵巧的手指很快把细绳打成了一个结。

nine.example: My little sister is nine years old and she loves to read.
nine.exampleZh: 我妹妹九岁了，她很喜欢读书。

nitrogen.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow strong and green.
nitrogen.exampleZh: 植物需要从土壤中获取氮才能长得健壮翠绿。

noble.example: He is a noble man who always helps people in need.
noble.exampleZh: 他是一个高尚的人，总是帮助有需要的人。

nobody.example: Nobody in my class knew the answer to that easy question.
nobody.exampleZh: 我们班上没有人知道那个简单问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a small nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她轻轻点头，对我笑了笑。

noise.example: The noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上的噪音让我整夜都没睡着。

nomad.example: The nomad travels with his family and animals across the wide desert.
nomad.exampleZh: 这位游牧民带着家人和牲畜穿越辽阔的沙漠。

nomadic.example: Their family lived a nomadic life, moving from place to place with their animals.
nomadic.exampleZh: 他们一家人过着游牧生活，带着牲畜四处迁徙。

nominal.example: He is the nominal head of the company, but she makes all the real decisions.
nominal.exampleZh: 他是公司名义上的负责人，但所有真正的决定都由她来做。

nominate.example: The team will nominate her for the award at the meeting tomorrow.
nominate.exampleZh: 团队将在明天的会议上提名她参评该奖项。

nominee.example: She is the nominee for the best new artist award this year.
nominee.exampleZh: 她是今年最佳新人奖的被提名者。

none.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个也没来参加聚会。

nonsense.example: Don't talk nonsense; we all know the truth about what happened.
nonsense.exampleZh: 别胡说，我们都知道发生了什么。

noodle.example: My mother makes a big bowl of noodle soup for us.
noodle.exampleZh: 妈妈给我们做了一大碗面条汤。

noon.example: We usually eat lunch at noon and then take a short rest.
noon.exampleZh: 我们通常中午吃午饭，然后短暂休息一下。

nor.example: She did not call me, nor did she send any message.
nor.exampleZh: 她没有给我打电话，也没有发任何消息。

norm.example: It is the norm for students to arrive on time.

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day at work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作一整天后感到疲惫是正常的。

north.example: The cold wind comes from the north in winter.
north.exampleZh: 冬天，刺骨的寒风从北方吹来。

northern.example: Many birds fly to the northern part of the country in spring.
northern.exampleZh: 许多鸟在春天飞到该国的北部地区。

northward.example: The birds fly northward every spring to find cooler places.
northward.exampleZh: 每年春天，鸟儿向北飞，寻找更凉爽的地方。

nose.example: My dog has a wet nose and a very good sense of smell.
nose.exampleZh: 我的狗鼻子湿湿的，嗅觉非常好。

nostalgia.example: She felt a deep nostalgia for the small town where she grew up.
nostalgia.exampleZh: 她对从小长大的那个小镇怀有深深的怀念。

not.example: She is not ready to go home yet.

notable.example: She is a notable writer, and many people read her books.
notable.exampleZh: 她是一位著名的作家，很多人读她的书。

notary.example: The notary signed the papers and stamped them in front of us.
notary.exampleZh: 公证人在我们面前签署了文件并盖了章。

note.example: Please note down the main points and keep your notes in a safe place.
note.exampleZh: 请记下要点，并把你的笔记放在安全的地方。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the fridge, so we should go shopping today.
nothing.exampleZh: 冰箱里什么都没有，所以我们今天应该去买东西。

notice.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的小标牌。

noticeable.example: There was a noticeable change in his voice after the long trip.
noticeable.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，他的嗓音有了明显的变化。

notify.example: Please notify the teacher if you cannot come to class today.
notify.exampleZh: 如果你今天不能来上课，请通知老师。

notion.example: She has a strange notion that cats can understand everything we say.
notion.exampleZh: 她有一个奇怪的观念，认为猫能听懂我们说的每一句话。

notorious.example: This street is notorious for its heavy traffic and loud noise.
notorious.exampleZh: 这条街因交通拥堵和噪音大而声名狼藉。

notwithstanding.example: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the children still played outside all afternoon.
notwithstanding.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，孩子们还是在外面玩了一下午。

noun.example: In English, a noun can name a person, a place, or a thing.
noun.exampleZh: 在英语中，名词可以表示人、地点或事物。

novel.example: She wrote a novel about life in a small old town.
novel.exampleZh: 她写了一部关于小镇生活的小说。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new toy wore off after a few days.
novelty.exampleZh: 新玩具的新鲜感几天后就消失了。

now.example: I am busy now, so please call me later today.
now.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，所以请今天晚些时候再打给我。

nowadays.example: Nowadays, most people use phones to read the news.
nowadays.exampleZh: 如今，大多数人用手机看新闻。

nowhere.example: The cat was nowhere in the house, so we looked outside.
nowhere.exampleZh: 猫在房子里哪儿都找不到，于是我们到外面去找。

nuclear.example: The country uses nuclear power to make electricity for its cities.
nuclear.exampleZh: 这个国家利用核能为其城市发电。

nucleus.example: The nucleus is the central part of an atom.
nucleus.exampleZh: 原子核是原子的中心部分。

nude.example: The artist painted a nude woman sitting by the window.
nude.exampleZh: 画家画了一位坐在窗边的裸体女子。

nuisance.example: The noise from the street is a real nuisance at night.
nuisance.exampleZh: 街上的噪音在晚上真是件麻烦事。

numb.example: My fingers were numb with cold after walking in the snow.
numb.exampleZh: 在雪地里走了一段路后，我的手指冻得麻木了。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of this page.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这一页的顶部。

numerical.example: The report gives numerical data about the city's population and its growth.
numerical.exampleZh: 这份报告提供了关于该城市人口及其增长的数值数据。

numerous.example: There are numerous books about cooking in our small school library.
numerous.exampleZh: 我们学校的小图书馆里有许多关于烹饪的书。

nun.example: The nun reads her Bible every morning before breakfast.
nun.exampleZh: 那位修女每天早晨在早餐前读圣经。

nurse.example: The nurse is very kind to the children in the hospital.
nurse.exampleZh: 这位护士对医院里的孩子们非常和善。

nursery.example: The children spend their days at the nursery while their parents work.
nursery.exampleZh: 父母上班时，孩子们在托儿所度过白天。

nutrient.example: Plants get nutrients from the soil and need water to grow well.
nutrient.exampleZh: 植物从土壤中获取养分，并且需要水才能长得好。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养帮助孩子强壮成长并保持健康。

nutritious.example: Fresh vegetables and fruit are nutritious foods for growing children.
nutritious.exampleZh: 新鲜蔬菜和水果是供成长中孩子食用的有营养的食物。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at six o'clock on school days.
o'clock.exampleZh: 上学的日子我通常六点钟起床。

oak.example: The big oak in our garden is over a hundred years old.
oak.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵大橡树已有一百多年了。

oar.example: He put the oar into the water and rowed the boat slowly.
oar.exampleZh: 他把桨放进水里，慢慢地划着船。

oasis.example: This small café is an oasis of calm in the busy city.
oasis.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆是繁忙城市中的一片宁静绿洲。

oath.example: He made an oath to tell the truth in court.
oath.exampleZh: 他发誓在法庭上说实话。

obedience.example: The dog learned obedience through simple training and daily practice.
obedience.exampleZh: 这只狗通过简单的训练和日常练习学会了服从。

obedient.example: The obedient dog sat down and waited quietly for its owner.
obedient.exampleZh: 那只听话的狗坐下来，安静地等着它的主人。

obese.example: The doctor said the obese cat must eat less food and exercise more.
obese.exampleZh: 医生说这只肥胖的猫必须少吃食物并多运动。

obey.example: We must obey the rules at school and listen to our teachers.
obey.exampleZh: 我们在学校必须遵守规则，听老师的话。

object.example: She put the heavy object on the table and then objected to my plan.
object.exampleZh: 她把那个重物放在桌上，然后反对我的计划。

objection.example: She raised a strong objection to the new plan at the meeting.
objection.exampleZh: 她在会上对这项新计划提出了强烈的反对。

objective.example: Our main objective is to finish the project before Friday.
objective.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在周五之前完成这个项目。

obligation.example: Parents have an obligation to take care of their children.
obligation.exampleZh: 父母有照顾孩子的义务。

obligatory.example: Wearing a helmet is obligatory for all workers on this site.
obligatory.exampleZh: 在这个工地上，所有工人都必须戴安全帽。

oblige.example: The rain obliged us to stay indoors all afternoon.
oblige.exampleZh: 这场雨迫使我们整个下午都待在室内。

obscene.example: The police removed the obscene pictures from the wall of the old building.
obscene.exampleZh: 警察从旧楼墙上取下了那些淫秽的图片。

obscure.example: The old map was obscure, so we could not find the lake.
obscure.exampleZh: 那张旧地图很模糊，所以我们找不到那个湖。

observation.example: Her careful observation of the birds helped the class learn a lot.
observation.exampleZh: 她对鸟类的仔细观察帮助全班学到了很多东西。

observatory.example: We visited the old observatory on the hill to look at the stars.
observatory.exampleZh: 我们参观了山上的旧天文台，观看星星。

observe.example: We observe that the stars move slowly across the night sky.
observe.exampleZh: 我们观察到星星在夜空中缓慢移动。

obsess.example: She is obsessed with clean air and refuses to open the window.
obsess.exampleZh: 她执着于干净的空气，拒绝打开窗户。

obsolescence.example: The rapid obsolescence of old phones makes people buy new ones often.
obsolescence.exampleZh: 旧手机的迅速过时让人们经常购买新手机。

obsolete.example: This old computer is obsolete and we cannot use it anymore.
obsolete.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑已经过时了，我们不能再使用它了。

obstacle.example: The biggest obstacle to my plan is the lack of money.
obstacle.exampleZh: 我计划的最大障碍是缺钱。

obstruct.example: The fallen tree obstructed the road, so we had to walk home.
obstruct.exampleZh: 倒下的树堵塞了道路，所以我们不得不走回家。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在前台免费获得一张地图。

obtrusive.example: His obtrusive questions made everyone at the meeting feel uncomfortable.
obtrusive.exampleZh: 他那些冒失的问题让会上每个人都感到不自在。

obvious.example: It is obvious that the baby is very tired now.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显，这个婴儿现在很累了。

occasion.example: A wedding is a happy occasion for the whole family.
occasion.exampleZh: 婚礼是全家人欢聚的幸福场合。

occasional.example: We get an occasional visit from our old neighbors.
occasional.exampleZh: 我们的老邻居偶尔会来拜访我们。

occupation.example: Her occupation is teaching, but she also enjoys painting in her free time.
occupation.exampleZh: 她的职业是教书，但她闲暇时也喜欢画画。

occupy.example: The children occupy themselves with games while their parents cook dinner.
occupy.exampleZh: 父母做晚饭时，孩子们玩着游戏打发时间。

occur.example: Accidents often occur when drivers are tired and not paying attention.
occur.exampleZh: 当司机疲劳且注意力不集中时，事故常常发生。

occurrence.example: The police are investigating the strange occurrence at the old house last night.
occurrence.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚那栋老房子里发生的奇怪事件。

ocean.example: Many fish and whales live in the deep ocean.
ocean.exampleZh: 许多鱼类和鲸生活在深海里。

october.example: My birthday is in October and we always have a big family dinner.
october.exampleZh: 我的生日在十月，我们总会吃一顿丰盛的家庭晚餐。

octopus.example: The octopus hid behind a rock and changed color to escape danger.
octopus.exampleZh: 章鱼躲在岩石后面并改变颜色以逃避危险。

odd.example: It is odd that he never answers his phone in the evening.
odd.exampleZh: 他晚上从来不接电话，这很奇怪。

odds.example: The odds of winning the game are very small.
odds.exampleZh: 赢得这场比赛的可能性非常小。

odor.example: A strange odor came from the old box in the corner.
odor.exampleZh: 角落里那个旧箱子里传出一股奇怪的气味。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my honest words.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用我诚实的话冒犯你。

offense.example: Stealing is a serious offense and can lead to time in prison.
offense.exampleZh: 偷窃是严重的违法行为，可能导致入狱。

offensive.example: His offensive words made everyone in the room feel very uncomfortable.
offensive.exampleZh: 他那些冒犯性的话让房间里的每个人都感到很不舒服。

offer.example: She offered me a cup of tea and a chair.
offer.exampleZh: 她给我端来一杯茶，还给了我一把椅子。

offering.example: The church received a small offering from each family in the village.
offering.exampleZh: 教堂收到了村里每户人家的一份小额捐献。

office.example: She left her office early today to meet a friend.
office.exampleZh: 她今天提早离开办公室去见一个朋友。

officer.example: The officer asked us to show our papers at the gate.
officer.exampleZh: 那名官员在门口要求我们出示证件。

official.example: The official report gives simple facts about the new school.
official.exampleZh: 这份官方报告提供了关于新学校的简单事实。

offspring.example: The farmer kept the strongest offspring to start next year's herd.
offspring.exampleZh: 农场主留下了最强壮的后代来繁衍明年的畜群。

often.example: I often walk to school with my friends in the morning.
often.exampleZh: 我早上经常和朋友一起走路去学校。

oil.example: The car needs oil before we drive to the city.
oil.exampleZh: 我们开车去城里之前，这辆车需要加油。

ointment.example: The doctor told me to put this ointment on the cut twice a day.
ointment.exampleZh: 医生让我每天在伤口上涂两次这种药膏。

old.example: My old bike is still fast, but my grandfather is even older.
old.exampleZh: 我的旧自行车还很快，但我祖父更年长。

olive.example: She put a green olive on top of the salad.
olive.exampleZh: 她在沙拉上面放了一颗绿色的橄榄。

omega.example: Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet, so it often means the end.
omega.exampleZh: 欧米伽是希腊字母表的最后一个字母，因此它常被用来表示结局。

omen.example: The dark clouds were seen as a bad omen by the sailors.
omen.exampleZh: 水手们把乌云看作一个不祥的预兆。

ominous.example: The dark clouds over the sea looked ominous to the fishermen.
ominous.exampleZh: 海面上空的乌云在渔民看来是不祥的。

omission.example: The omission of his name from the list was a careless mistake.
omission.exampleZh: 名单上遗漏了他的名字，这是个粗心的错误。

omit.example: Please do not omit any important details from your report.
omit.exampleZh: 请不要在你的报告中遗漏任何重要细节。

once.example: Once you start reading this book, you will not want to stop.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始读这本书，你就会不想停下来。

one.example: One of my best friends lives in a small town near the sea.
one.exampleZh: 我最好的一个朋友住在海边的一个小镇上。

onion.example: My mother puts an onion in the soup every time.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈每次做汤都会放一个洋葱。

online.example: You can buy tickets online or at the box office.
online.exampleZh: 你可以在网上购票，也可以在售票处购票。

only.example: This is the only key that opens the old door.
only.exampleZh: 这是唯一能打开那扇旧门的钥匙。

onset.example: The onset of winter brought cold winds and heavy snow.
onset.exampleZh: 冬天的来临带来了寒风和大雪。

open.example: The shop is open from nine in the morning until six in the evening.
open.exampleZh: 这家商店从早上九点营业到晚上六点。
