opening.example: The opening of the new library will be next Monday morning.
opening.exampleZh: 新图书馆的开幕仪式将在下周一的上午举行。

opera.example: My parents took me to the opera for the first time last night.
opera.exampleZh: 昨晚我父母第一次带我去看歌剧。

operate.example: He knows how to operate this old machine safely.
operate.exampleZh: 他知道如何安全地操作这台旧机器。

operation.example: The doctor said the operation went well and she can go home soon.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说手术很顺利，她很快就可以回家了。

operator.example: The operator answered my call and helped me find the right number.
operator.exampleZh: 接线员接了我的电话，并帮我找到了正确的号码。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is worth reading twice.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书值得读两遍。

opponent.example: My opponent in the final match was very strong and fast.
opponent.exampleZh: 我在决赛中的对手非常强壮而且速度很快。

opportunity.example: This job is a good opportunity for you to learn new skills.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这份工作是你学习新技能的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people in the town oppose the plan to build a new factory.
oppose.exampleZh: 镇上的许多人反对建造新工厂的计划。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from the school.
opposite.exampleZh: 银行在街道对面，与学校相对。

opposition.example: The plan met strong opposition from local workers and their families.
opposition.exampleZh: 该计划遭到了当地工人及其家人的强烈反对。

opt.example: You can opt for the cheaper plan if you want.
opt.exampleZh: 如果你愿意，你可以选择更便宜的那个方案。

optical.example: The new optical lens helps him see small words much more clearly.
optical.exampleZh: 新的光学镜片帮助他更清楚地看到小字。

optimism.example: Her optimism helps the whole team stay calm during hard times.
optimism.exampleZh: 她的乐观帮助整个团队在困难时期保持冷静。

optimistic.example: She is optimistic about the future and always smiles at everyone.
optimistic.exampleZh: 她对未来很乐观，总是对每个人微笑。

optimum.example: This room temperature is the optimum level for the plants to grow well.
optimum.exampleZh: 这个室温是植物良好生长的最适宜水平。

option.example: You have two options: take the bus or walk to school.
option.exampleZh: 你有两个选择：坐公交车或者步行去学校。

optional.example: Wearing a tie to the meeting is optional for everyone.
optional.exampleZh: 会议上打领带对每个人来说都是可选择的。

oral.example: She has an oral English test tomorrow morning, so she is practicing with her friend.
oral.exampleZh: 她明天上午有一场英语口试，所以她正在和朋友练习。

orbit.example: The moon moves in a fixed orbit around the earth.
orbit.exampleZh: 月球在固定的轨道上绕地球运行。

orchard.example: My grandfather grows apples and pears in the orchard behind his house.
orchard.exampleZh: 我祖父在他房子后面的果园里种苹果和梨。

orchestra.example: The orchestra played a beautiful song at the concert last night.
orchestra.exampleZh: 昨晚音乐会上，管弦乐队演奏了一首优美的歌曲。

order.example: He gave the waiter a simple order at the small coffee shop.
order.exampleZh: 他在那家小咖啡店向服务员下了一个简单的订单。

orderly.example: The nurse kept the small room clean and orderly every morning.
orderly.exampleZh: 护士每天早上都把那个小房间收拾得干净整洁。

ordinary.example: She is an ordinary girl, but her story is very special.
ordinary.exampleZh: 她是个普通的女孩，但她的故事非常特别。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是人体中一个重要的器官。

organic.example: She grows organic vegetables in her small garden every summer.
organic.exampleZh: 她每年夏天都在自己的小花园里种有机蔬菜。

organism.example: Every living organism needs water and food to grow and stay healthy.
organism.exampleZh: 每一个生物体都需要水和食物才能生长并保持健康。

organization.example: She works for a large organization that helps poor children in many countries.
organization.exampleZh: 她在一个帮助许多国家贫困儿童的大型组织工作。

organize.example: She helped organize the school trip for all the students.
organize.exampleZh: 她帮助为所有学生组织这次学校旅行。

orientation.example: The new students had an orientation to learn about the school.
orientation.exampleZh: 新生参加了迎新介绍，以了解学校的情况。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍然是个谜。

original.example: The original plan was too hard, so we made a new one.
original.exampleZh: 最初的计划太难了，所以我们制定了一个新的。

originate.example: Many popular foods originate from small villages in the countryside.
originate.exampleZh: 许多受欢迎的食物源自乡村的小村庄。

ornament.example: She put a small ornament on the tree before the party started.
ornament.exampleZh: 聚会开始前，她在树上放了一个小装饰品。

ornamental.example: She grows ornamental plants in her small garden.
ornamental.exampleZh: 她在她的小花园里种观赏植物。

orphan.example: The little orphan lives with a kind family in the village.
orphan.exampleZh: 那个小孤儿和村里一户善良的人家一起生活。

orthodox.example: His family still follows the orthodox rules of the old religion.
orthodox.exampleZh: 他的家庭仍然遵循古老宗教的正统规则。

ostrich.example: The ostrich buried its head in the sand when danger came near.
ostrich.exampleZh: 危险靠近时，那只鸵鸟把头埋进了沙子里。

other.example: Some people like tea, but other people like coffee better.
other.exampleZh: 有些人喜欢茶，但另一些人更喜欢咖啡。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the last bus home.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们会错过回家的末班车。

otter.example: The otter swam quickly through the cold river and caught a fish.
otter.exampleZh: 水獭在冰冷的河里快速游动，抓到了一条鱼。

ought.example: You ought to tell your parents the truth about this matter.
ought.exampleZh: 你应该把这件事的真相告诉你的父母。

ounce.example: He drank an ounce of water and then went back to work.
ounce.exampleZh: 他喝了一盎司水，然后又回去工作了。

outbreak.example: There was a sudden outbreak of flu in the small town last winter.
outbreak.exampleZh: 去年冬天，这个小镇突然爆发了流感。

outcome.example: The outcome of the game was a big surprise to everyone.
outcome.exampleZh: 比赛的结果让所有人都大吃一惊。

outdoor.example: The children like to play outdoor games in the park after school.
outdoor.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后喜欢在公园里玩户外游戏。

outer.example: The outer layer of the cake is hard and sweet.

outfit.example: She bought a new outfit for the party on Friday night.
outfit.exampleZh: 她为周五晚上的聚会买了一套新衣服。

outing.example: Our class went on an outing to the lake last Saturday.
outing.exampleZh: 上周六我们班去湖边郊游了。

outline.example: Before writing the essay, she made a short outline of her main ideas.
outline.exampleZh: 写文章之前，她先为要点列了一份简短的提纲。

outlook.example: His outlook on life changed after he traveled to new countries.
outlook.exampleZh: 他去过新的国家之后，对生活的看法改变了。

output.example: The factory doubled its output of cars last year.
output.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的汽车产量翻了一番。

outrage.example: The whole town felt outrage at the cruel attack on the old man.
outrage.exampleZh: 整个小镇对那位老人遭受的残忍袭击感到愤慨。

outright.example: She rejected the offer outright because the pay was too low.
outright.exampleZh: 她立即拒绝了这个提议，因为报酬太低。

outset.example: We knew from the outset that the plan might be hard to finish.
outset.exampleZh: 我们从一开始就知道这个计划可能很难完成。

outside.example: The children are playing outside the house in the warm sun.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们正在温暖的阳光下于房子外面玩耍。

outskirts.example: They live on the outskirts of the city, near a small lake.
outskirts.exampleZh: 他们住在城市郊外，靠近一个小湖。

outstanding.example: Her outstanding work at the office earned her a big promotion.
outstanding.exampleZh: 她在办公室的杰出工作为她赢得了很大的晋升。

outward.example: From the outside, her outward calm hid a great deal of worry.
outward.exampleZh: 从外表看，她外表的平静掩盖了许多担忧。

oval.example: The egg has an oval shape, and the table in the kitchen is oval too.
oval.exampleZh: 这个鸡蛋是椭圆形的，厨房里的桌子也是椭圆形的。

oven.example: She put the cake into the hot oven and waited for twenty minutes.
oven.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕放进热烤箱里，等了二十分钟。

over.example: The plane flew over the city and then landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞越这座城市，然后安全降落了。

overall.example: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
overall.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总体费用比我们预期的要低。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己在公众场合讲话的恐惧。

overhead.example: The overhead lights in the room are too bright for me.
overhead.exampleZh: 房间里头顶上的灯对我来说太亮了。

overhear.example: I overheard them talking about the party in the hallway.
overhear.exampleZh: 我无意中听到他们在走廊里谈论那个聚会。

overlap.example: The two meetings overlap, so I can only attend one of them.
overlap.exampleZh: 两个会议时间重叠，所以我只能参加其中一个。

overlook.example: We should not overlook the small mistakes in our daily work.
overlook.exampleZh: 我们不应忽视日常工作中的小错误。

overnight.example: The weather changed overnight, so we stayed home the next day.
overnight.exampleZh: 天气一夜之间变了，所以第二天我们待在家里。

overseas.example: My brother works overseas and comes home only once a year.
overseas.exampleZh: 我哥哥在国外工作，一年只回家一次。

oversee.example: Her job is to oversee the work of five new employees.
oversee.exampleZh: 她的工作是监督五名新员工的工作。

overt.example: His overt anger made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable.
overt.exampleZh: 他公然的愤怒让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服。

overtake.example: We can overtake the slow truck on the next straight road.
overtake.exampleZh: 我们可以在下一个直道上超过那辆慢卡车。

overthrow.example: The people wanted to overthrow the old government and build a better country.
overthrow.exampleZh: 人民想要推翻旧政府，建设一个更好的国家。

overtime.example: She works overtime every Friday to finish the weekly report.
overtime.exampleZh: 她每周五都加班完成周报。

overturn.example: The court decided to overturn the old rule last week.
overturn.exampleZh: 法院上周决定推翻这条旧规定。

overwhelm.example: The small team was overwhelmed by the huge amount of work.
overwhelm.exampleZh: 这个小团队被大量工作压得喘不过气来。

owe.example: I still owe him twenty dollars from last week.
owe.exampleZh: 我上周还欠他二十美元。

owl.example: The owl sat in the tall tree and looked down at us.
owl.exampleZh: 那只猫头鹰坐在高高的树上，朝下看着我们。

own.example: I want to own my own small shop near the station.
own.exampleZh: 我想在车站附近拥有一家自己的小店。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop knows every customer by name.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主认识每一位顾客的名字。

ownership.example: The ownership of the house was transferred to her last year.
ownership.exampleZh: 这栋房子的所有权去年转让给了她。

ox.example: The old ox pulled the heavy cart slowly down the road.
ox.exampleZh: 那头老牛拉着沉重的车，沿路慢慢走着。

oxide.example: Rust is a common oxide that forms on iron in wet air.
oxide.exampleZh: 铁锈是铁在潮湿空气中形成的一种常见氧化物。

oxygen.example: Plants and animals need oxygen to live and grow well.
oxygen.exampleZh: 植物和动物需要氧气才能生存和良好生长。

oyster.example: He ate a fresh oyster with lemon at the beach.
oyster.exampleZh: 他在海滩上吃了一只配柠檬的新鲜牡蛎。

ozone.example: The ozone layer high above Earth protects us from harmful sun rays.
ozone.exampleZh: 地球上方高处的臭氧层保护我们免受有害太阳光线的伤害。

pabulum.example: Good books give us pabulum for the mind, not just for the body.
pabulum.exampleZh: 好书为我们提供精神食粮，而不仅仅是身体的食物。

pace.example: Pace our teacher, I still think this answer is not right.
pace.exampleZh: 恕我直言，老师，我仍然认为这个答案不对。

pachyderm.example: An elephant is a pachyderm with thick skin and a long trunk.
pachyderm.exampleZh: 大象是一种皮很厚、长着长鼻子的厚皮动物。

pacifist.example: My grandfather was a pacifist who refused to fight in any war.
pacifist.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位和平主义者，他拒绝参加任何战争。

pacify.example: The mother sang softly to pacify her crying baby.
pacify.exampleZh: 母亲轻声唱歌来安抚哭闹的婴儿。

pack.example: She will pack her clothes into a small bag and leave tonight.
pack.exampleZh: 她今晚会把衣服装进一个小背包里然后离开。

pact.example: The two countries signed a pact to keep the river clean.
pact.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项协定，以保持河流清洁。

pad.example: She wrote her phone number on a small pad of paper.
pad.exampleZh: 她把电话号码写在一小本便签纸上。

paddle.example: We used a paddle to move the small boat across the calm lake.
paddle.exampleZh: 我们用桨把这条小船划过平静的湖面。

padre.example: The old padre in our village helps everyone and is very kind.
padre.exampleZh: 我们村里的老神父帮助每个人，非常和善。

paean.example: The whole crowd sang a paean to the victorious team.
paean.exampleZh: 全场观众为获胜的队伍唱起了赞歌。

pagan.example: The old pagan festival is still celebrated in some villages today.
pagan.exampleZh: 这个古老的异教节日至今仍在一些村庄里庆祝。

pageant.example: The town holds a colorful pageant every summer with music and dancing.
pageant.exampleZh: 这个镇每年夏天都会举办一场有音乐和舞蹈的多彩盛会。

painstaking.example: Her painstaking work on the report made every detail clear.
painstaking.exampleZh: 她对这份报告做了细致的处理，让每个细节都清晰明了。

palatable.example: The soup was hot, simple, and very palatable to everyone at the table.
palatable.exampleZh: 这汤热气腾腾、做法简单，桌上每个人都觉得很好喝。

palatial.example: They live in a palatial house with a huge garden and a pool.
palatial.exampleZh: 他们住在一栋带大花园和游泳池的宫殿般的房子里。

paleontology.example: She studies paleontology at the university and often travels to find old fossils.
paleontology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习古生物学，并且经常外出寻找古老的化石。

palette.example: The artist mixed blue and green paint on her wooden palette.
palette.exampleZh: 这位艺术家在她的木制调色板上混合了蓝色和绿色颜料。

pall.example: The long meeting began to pall after the first hour.
pall.exampleZh: 会议开了一个小时后就开始变得乏味了。

palliate.example: The doctor gave him medicine to palliate the pain.
palliate.exampleZh: 医生给他药来减轻疼痛。

palm.example: She held the small bird gently in her open palm.
palm.exampleZh: 她把那只小鸟轻轻地捧在摊开的手掌里。

palpable.example: The tension in the room was palpable before the game began.
palpable.exampleZh: 比赛开始前，房间里紧张的气氛明显可感。

palpitate.example: My heart began to palpitate when I had to speak in front of the whole class.
palpitate.exampleZh: 当我不得不在全班同学面前发言时，我的心开始怦怦直跳。

pamper.example: Her parents pamper her with gifts and never say no.
pamper.exampleZh: 她的父母用礼物娇惯她，从不说“不”。

panacea.example: Technology is not a panacea for every problem in education.
panacea.exampleZh: 技术并不是解决教育中所有问题的万灵药。

pandemic.example: The pandemic changed how people work, travel, and meet each other.
pandemic.exampleZh: 这场大流行病改变了人们工作、旅行和相互见面的方式。

pander.example: Some newspapers pander to the public's taste for shocking stories.
pander.exampleZh: 有些报纸迎合公众对耸人听闻故事的口味。

panorama.example: From the hill you can see a full panorama of the city and the river.
panorama.exampleZh: 从山上你可以看到城市和河流的完整全景。

pant.example: After the long race, he began to pant and asked for water.
pant.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他开始喘气，并要水喝。

pantomime.example: The children performed a pantomime about a lost cat at school.
pantomime.exampleZh: 孩子们在学校表演了一出关于一只走失的猫的哑剧。

paper.example: I need some paper to write down the phone number.
paper.exampleZh: 我需要一些纸来写下这个电话号码。

par.example: Her work is on par with the best in the class.
par.exampleZh: 她的作品和班上最好的作品不相上下。

parable.example: The teacher told a short parable to help us understand the value of kindness.
parable.exampleZh: 老师讲了一个简短的寓言，帮助我们理解善良的价值。

paradigm.example: This small school became a paradigm of good teaching for the whole city.
paradigm.exampleZh: 这所小学校成了全市良好教学的典范。

paradox.example: It is a paradox that the richest country has so many poor people.
paradox.exampleZh: 最富有的国家却有这么多穷人，这是一个悖论。

paragon.example: Her honest work made her a paragon for the whole team.
paragon.exampleZh: 她诚实的工作使她成为整个团队的典范。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph of this book before class.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请在上课前读一下这本书的第一段。

paralysis.example: The accident left him with paralysis in both legs for many years.
paralysis.exampleZh: 那场事故使他双腿瘫痪多年。

parameter.example: We need to change one parameter before we run the test.
parameter.exampleZh: 在运行测试之前，我们需要更改一个参数。

paramount.example: Keeping the children safe is of paramount importance to every parent.
paramount.exampleZh: 保护孩子的安全对每位父母来说都至关重要。

paranoia.example: His paranoia made him think everyone was watching him.
paranoia.exampleZh: 他的多疑让他觉得每个人都在盯着他。

paraphrase.example: Can you paraphrase this sentence in simpler words for new readers?
paraphrase.exampleZh: 你能用更简单的词为新的读者释义这句话吗？

parasite.example: The doctor said the parasite can live inside a person for years.
parasite.exampleZh: 医生说这种寄生虫能在人体内生存多年。

parch.example: The hot sun will parch the grass if it does not rain soon.
parch.exampleZh: 如果不下雨，烈日会把草烤干。

parent.example: My parents taught me to be kind to other people.
parent.exampleZh: 我的父母教导我要善待他人。

parenthetical.example: Her parenthetical comment about the weather made the long meeting feel shorter.
parenthetical.exampleZh: 她关于天气的附带评论让漫长的会议显得短了一些。

parity.example: The two teams finally reached parity in salary and working hours.
parity.exampleZh: 这两支队伍最终在薪资和工作时间上达到了对等。

park.example: We can park the car near the park and walk inside.
park.exampleZh: 我们可以把车停在公园附近，然后走进去。

parlance.example: In medical parlance, this condition is simply called high blood pressure.
parlance.exampleZh: 在医学用语中，这种情况就被称作高血压。

parley.example: The two sides agreed to a parley to end the long fight.
parley.exampleZh: 双方同意举行和谈，以结束这场持久的争斗。

parliament.example: The new law was passed by parliament after a long debate.
parliament.exampleZh: 经过长时间辩论，议会通过了这项新法律。

parlor.example: The old parlor was warm and quiet on that cold winter night.
parlor.exampleZh: 那个寒冷的冬夜，这间老客厅里温暖而安静。

parochial.example: His parochial view made it hard for him to understand other cultures.
parochial.exampleZh: 他狭隘的观点使他很难理解其他文化。

parody.example: The movie is a funny parody of famous superhero films.
parody.exampleZh: 这部电影是对著名超级英雄电影的有趣戏仿。

paroxysm.example: A paroxysm of coughing woke him up in the middle of the night.
paroxysm.exampleZh: 一阵剧烈的咳嗽让他在半夜醒了过来。

parquet.example: The old hall has a beautiful parquet floor that shines under the lights.
parquet.exampleZh: 这个古老的大厅有一片漂亮的拼花地板，在灯光下闪闪发亮。

parry.example: He tried to parry the question with a joke, but nobody laughed.
parry.exampleZh: 他试图用一句玩笑回避这个问题，但没有人笑。

parsimonious.example: My parsimonious uncle never buys new clothes for himself.
parsimonious.exampleZh: 我吝啬的叔叔从不给自己买新衣服。

parsley.example: Add some chopped parsley on top of the soup before you serve it.
parsley.exampleZh: 上汤之前，在汤上面撒一些切碎的欧芹。

parson.example: The old parson visits every family in the village each week.
parson.exampleZh: 那位年老的教区牧师每周都去拜访村里的每一户人家。

partake.example: All the students were happy to partake in the school sports day.
partake.exampleZh: 所有学生都很高兴参加学校的运动会。

partial.example: The teacher was partial to the students who always did their homework.
partial.exampleZh: 老师偏袒那些总是完成作业的学生。

participate.example: Many students participate in sports games after school.
participate.exampleZh: 许多学生放学后参加体育比赛。

particle.example: Tiny particles of dust floated in the sunlight near the window.
particle.exampleZh: 细小的灰尘颗粒在窗边的阳光中飘浮。

particular.example: She has a particular way of making tea in the morning.
particular.exampleZh: 她早上泡茶有一种特别的方式。

partisan.example: He is a strong partisan of the new plan, but his friends disagree.
partisan.exampleZh: 他是这项新计划的铁杆支持者，但他的朋友们并不赞同。

partition.example: A glass partition divides the office into two small rooms.
partition.exampleZh: 一道玻璃隔墙把办公室分成了两个小房间。

partner.example: My business partner and I opened a small coffee shop last year.
partner.exampleZh: 我和我的生意伙伴去年开了一家小咖啡店。

partridge.example: We saw a partridge walking slowly across the quiet country road.
partridge.exampleZh: 我们看到一只鹧鸪慢慢地走过那条安静的乡间小路。

pass.example: Please pass this note to the teacher after class.
pass.exampleZh: 请在课后把这张便条传给老师。

passable.example: The road is passable now, but the food here is only passable.
passable.exampleZh: 这条路现在可以通行了，但这里的饭菜只是勉强过得去。

passage.example: The narrow passage leads to a small garden behind the old house.
passage.exampleZh: 这条狭窄的通道通向老房子后面的一个小花园。

passion.example: Her passion for music began when she was a young girl.
passion.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情始于年幼时。

passive.example: He is too passive in class and rarely asks any questions.
passive.exampleZh: 他在课堂上太被动了，很少提问。

paste.example: She used paste to stick the paper onto the wall, then pasted the photo in her book.
paste.exampleZh: 她用浆糊把纸粘到墙上，然后把照片粘在书中。

pastel.example: She painted her bedroom walls in soft pastel colors last summer.
pastel.exampleZh: 去年夏天，她把卧室的墙壁刷成了柔和的淡色。

pasteurize.example: We pasteurize the milk before selling it to the shops.
pasteurize.exampleZh: 我们在把牛奶卖给商店之前先对它进行巴氏消毒。

pastime.example: Reading is my favorite pastime on quiet weekend mornings.
pastime.exampleZh: 在安静的周末早晨，阅读是我最喜欢的消遣。

pastor.example: The pastor spoke kindly to the family after the Sunday service.
pastor.exampleZh: 周日礼拜结束后，牧师温和地对这家人说话。

pasture.example: The cows walk slowly across the green pasture every morning.
pasture.exampleZh: 奶牛每天早上慢慢走过绿色的牧场。

pat.example: She gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.

patch.example: The farmer grows beans on a small patch of land behind his house.
patch.exampleZh: 农民在他家后面的一小块土地上种豆子。

patent.example: The small company applied for a patent on its new design.
patent.exampleZh: 这家小公司为其新设计申请了一项专利。

paternal.example: His paternal grandfather taught him how to fish in that small river.
paternal.exampleZh: 他的祖父教他如何在那条小河里钓鱼。

path.example: We walked along a narrow path through the tall green trees.
path.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条穿过高大绿树的小路行走。

pathetic.example: It is pathetic that he still blames others for his own mistakes.
pathetic.exampleZh: 他还把自己犯的错怪到别人头上，真是可悲。

pathology.example: She studies pathology to learn how diseases change the human body.
pathology.exampleZh: 她学习病理学，以了解疾病如何改变人体。

pathos.example: The old singer's voice was full of pathos and moved everyone in the room.
pathos.exampleZh: 那位老歌手的嗓音充满哀婉的感染力，打动了房间里的每一个人。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes time and patience, so do not give up too quickly.
patience.exampleZh: 学一门新语言需要时间和耐心，所以不要轻易放弃。

patriot.example: The old soldier was a true patriot who loved his country all his life.
patriot.exampleZh: 这位老兵是一位真正的爱国者，他一生都热爱自己的国家。

patrol.example: The guards patrol the building every night to keep it safe.
patrol.exampleZh: 保安每晚在大楼里巡逻，以保证它的安全。

patron.example: The old patron often helped young artists with money and advice.
patron.exampleZh: 这位老主顾常常用钱和建议帮助年轻艺术家。

patronize.example: We often patronize the small coffee shop near our office.
patronize.exampleZh: 我们经常光顾办公室附近的那家小咖啡店。

pattern.example: The teacher noticed a clear pattern in the students' answers.
pattern.exampleZh: 老师注意到学生们的答案中有明显的规律。

paucity.example: There is a paucity of fresh water in this dry region.
paucity.exampleZh: 这个干旱地区缺乏淡水。

paunch.example: The old man had a large paunch and walked slowly down the street.
paunch.exampleZh: 那位老人有个大肚子，沿着街道慢慢地走着。

pauper.example: The pauper had no money to buy food for his children.
pauper.exampleZh: 这个穷人没有钱给他的孩子们买食物。

pause.example: Please pause the game for a moment and listen to me.
pause.exampleZh: 请把游戏暂停一下，听我说。

pave.example: The workers will pave the road in front of our school next week.
pave.exampleZh: 工人们下周会铺设我们学校前面的那条路。

paw.example: The little cat hurt its front paw and could not walk well.
paw.exampleZh: 那只小猫伤了前爪，走起路来不太方便。

pay.example: I will pay for the tickets with my phone today.
pay.exampleZh: 我今天会用手机支付这些票的费用。

peace.example: After the war ended, the whole country finally enjoyed peace and quiet.
peace.exampleZh: 战争结束后，整个国家终于享受到了和平与安宁。

peach.example: The peach is sweet and juicy, and my sister eats one every morning.
peach.exampleZh: 桃子又甜又多汁，我妹妹每天早上都吃一个。

peak.example: We reached the peak of the mountain after six hours of walking.
peak.exampleZh: 我们走了六个小时后到达了山顶。

peal.example: The church bells began to peal across the quiet village at noon.
peal.exampleZh: 中午时分，教堂的钟声开始在宁静的村庄上空鸣响。

peanut.example: I like to eat a few peanuts with my tea.
peanut.exampleZh: 我喜欢喝茶时吃几颗花生。

pearl.example: She wore a simple white dress with a single pearl around her neck.
pearl.exampleZh: 她穿着一条简洁的白裙子，脖子上戴着一颗珍珠。

peasant.example: The poor peasant works hard in the field every day.
peasant.exampleZh: 那个贫穷的农民每天在田里辛勤劳作。

pebble.example: The little boy picked up a smooth pebble from the beach.
pebble.exampleZh: 小男孩从海滩上捡起一块光滑的鹅卵石。

peck.example: The little bird began to peck at the bread on the ground.
peck.exampleZh: 小鸟开始啄地上的面包。

peculiar.example: There was a peculiar smell in the old house.
peculiar.exampleZh: 那座老房子里有一股奇怪的味道。

pedagogy.example: Her pedagogy focuses on helping students learn through real projects.
pedagogy.exampleZh: 她的教学法侧重于通过真实项目帮助学生学习。

pedal.example: She put her foot on the pedal and the bike began to move.
pedal.exampleZh: 她把脚放在踏板上，自行车开始移动。

peddle.example: He was arrested for trying to peddle fake watches on the street.
peddle.exampleZh: 他因试图在街上兜售假表而被逮捕。

pedestrian.example: The pedestrian waited for the green light before crossing the busy street.
pedestrian.exampleZh: 那个行人在绿灯亮后才穿过繁忙的街道。

pedigree.example: His pedigree shows that his family has lived here for many years.
pedigree.exampleZh: 他的家谱显示他的家族在这里生活了很多年。

peek.example: She opened the box to peek at the gift inside.
peek.exampleZh: 她打开盒子偷看了一眼里面的礼物。

peel.example: She likes to peel an apple and eat it with her friends.
peel.exampleZh: 她喜欢削个苹果，和朋友们一起吃。

peer.example: As a peer, she often helps me with my math homework after school.
peer.exampleZh: 作为同龄人，她放学后经常帮我做数学作业。

peeve.example: Loud music late at night really peeves my neighbors.
peeve.exampleZh: 深夜的大声音乐确实惹恼了我的邻居们。

peg.example: He used a wooden peg to keep the tent rope tight.
peg.exampleZh: 他用一根木桩把帐篷绳绷紧。

pelican.example: We saw a large pelican standing quietly beside the small lake this morning.
pelican.exampleZh: 今天早上我们看到一只大鹈鹕静静地站在小湖边。

pell-mell.example: The children ran pell-mell down the stairs when the bell rang.
pell-mell.exampleZh: 铃响时，孩子们乱哄哄地冲下楼梯。

pellet.example: The boy shot a small pellet from his toy gun.
pellet.exampleZh: 男孩用玩具枪射出了一颗小弹丸。

pelt.example: The children laughed as heavy rain began to pelt against the window.
pelt.exampleZh: 大雨开始猛烈敲打窗户时，孩子们笑了起来。

pen.example: Please use this pen to write your name on the paper.
pen.exampleZh: 请用这支钢笔在纸上写下你的名字。

penal.example: The judge explained the penal rules to the young man.
penal.exampleZh: 法官向那个年轻人解释了刑罚规则。

penalty.example: He had to pay a penalty for breaking the rules.
penalty.exampleZh: 他因为违反规则而不得不交罚款。

penchant.example: She has a penchant for sweet coffee and long morning walks.
penchant.exampleZh: 她嗜好甜咖啡，也喜欢清晨长时间散步。

pending.example: The final decision is still pending until the manager returns next Monday.
pending.exampleZh: 最终决定仍未确定，要等到经理下周一回来。

pendulum.example: The pendulum of the old clock swings slowly back and forth.
pendulum.exampleZh: 那座旧钟的钟摆缓慢地来回摆动。

penetrate.example: Sunlight can penetrate the thick clouds and reach the ground below.
penetrate.exampleZh: 阳光能穿透厚厚的云层，照到下面的地面。

penicillin.example: The doctor gave him penicillin to treat the infection in his lungs.
penicillin.exampleZh: 医生给他用了青霉素来治疗他肺部的感染。

peninsula.example: Italy is a long peninsula that goes into the sea.
peninsula.exampleZh: 意大利是一个伸入海中的狭长半岛。

penitent.example: The penitent boy said he was sorry for taking the money.
penitent.exampleZh: 那个后悔的男孩说他对拿了钱感到抱歉。

pension.example: My grandfather gets a small pension from the factory every month.
pension.exampleZh: 我爷爷每个月从工厂领到一笔不多的养老金。

pensive.example: She sat by the window with a pensive look on her face.
pensive.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，脸上带着沉思的神情。

penury.example: Years of penury made the old man very careful with every coin.
penury.exampleZh: 多年的赤贫让这位老人对每一枚硬币都十分节省。

pepper.example: Please add some pepper to the soup to make it taste better.
pepper.exampleZh: 请往汤里加一些胡椒，让它味道更好。

perceive.example: Many people perceive him as a kind and honest man.
perceive.exampleZh: 许多人认为他是一个善良诚实的人。

percentage.example: Only a small percentage of students passed the difficult math test.
percentage.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生通过了这次难度较大的数学考试。

perceptible.example: There was a perceptible change in his voice when he spoke about her.
perceptible.exampleZh: 当他谈到她时，他的声音有了可察觉的变化。

perception.example: My perception of the problem changed after I heard her story.
perception.exampleZh: 听了她的故事后，我对这个问题的看法改变了。

perch.example: A small bird perched on the wooden fence and sang a sweet song.
perch.exampleZh: 一只小鸟栖息在木栅栏上，唱着甜美的歌。

peremptory.example: His peremptory tone made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable and a little afraid.
peremptory.exampleZh: 他专横的语气让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服，还有点害怕。

perennial.example: The garden is famous for its perennial flowers that bloom every spring.
perennial.exampleZh: 这个花园以每年春天开花的多年生花卉而闻名。

perfect.example: Nobody is perfect, so we keep trying to improve ourselves.
perfect.exampleZh: 没有人是完美的，所以我们不断努力完善自己。

perfectionist.example: She is a perfectionist who checks her work many times before sending it.
perfectionist.exampleZh: 她是个完美主义者，发送之前会反复检查自己的工作。

perfidious.example: The perfidious man broke his promise and left his friends.
perfidious.exampleZh: 那个背信弃义的人违背了诺言，抛弃了他的朋友。

perfume.example: The room smelled of fresh flowers and a light perfume.
perfume.exampleZh: 房间里弥漫着鲜花和淡淡香水的味道。

perfunctory.example: His perfunctory answer showed that he did not really care about our question.
perfunctory.exampleZh: 他敷衍的回答表明他并不真正在意我们的问题。

perhaps.example: Perhaps she will come to the party with her friends tonight.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许她今晚会和朋友们一起来参加聚会。

peril.example: The climbers knew the mountain was full of peril.
peril.exampleZh: 登山者们知道这座山充满了危险。

period.example: This period of history is very important for our country.
period.exampleZh: 这段历史时期对我们的国家非常重要。

periodic.example: The doctor recommends periodic checkups to keep your health in good condition.
periodic.exampleZh: 医生建议定期体检，以保持良好的健康状况。

periodical.example: She reads a science periodical at the library every week.
periodical.exampleZh: 她每周都在图书馆读一本科学期刊。

peripheral.example: This is a peripheral problem, so we will deal with it later.
peripheral.exampleZh: 这是一个次要问题，我们稍后再处理。

perish.example: Many plants perish in the cold winter without enough sunlight.
perish.exampleZh: 许多植物在缺乏足够阳光的寒冷冬天里会枯死。

perjury.example: The witness was charged with perjury after he lied in court.
perjury.exampleZh: 那名证人在法庭上撒谎后，被控伪证罪。

perk.example: The new job comes with a free gym membership as a perk.
perk.exampleZh: 这份新工作附带一个福利，就是免费的健身房会员。

permanence.example: The permanence of the old stone bridge surprised everyone who visited the small town.
permanence.exampleZh: 这座古老石桥的持久性让每个到访小镇的人都感到惊讶。

permeable.example: This paper is permeable, so water can pass through it easily.
permeable.exampleZh: 这种纸是可渗透的，所以水很容易穿过它。

permeate.example: The smell of fresh coffee permeated the whole house this morning.
permeate.exampleZh: 今天早上，新鲜咖啡的香味弥漫了整栋房子。

permissible.example: It is not permissible to park your car in front of the school gate.
permissible.exampleZh: 在学校门口停车是不允许的。

permit.example: My father gave me permission to drive after I got my permit.
permit.exampleZh: 我拿到执照后，父亲允许我开车。

pernicious.example: Smoking has a pernicious effect on your health and your family.
pernicious.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康和家人都有恶劣的影响。

perpendicular.example: The wall is perpendicular to the floor, so it stands straight up.
perpendicular.exampleZh: 这面墙与地板垂直，所以它笔直地立着。

perpetrate.example: The police caught the man who perpetrated the crime last night.
perpetrate.exampleZh: 警方抓住了昨晚犯下这起罪行的男子。

perpetual.example: Her perpetual questions made the long meeting feel even longer than usual.
perpetual.exampleZh: 她不断的提问让这场漫长的会议显得比平时更久。

perpetuate.example: If we keep telling the same old story, we perpetuate the problem.
perpetuate.exampleZh: 如果我们继续讲同样的老故事，就是在使这个问题持续下去。

perplex.example: His strange question perplexed the whole class for a while.
perplex.exampleZh: 他那个奇怪的问题让全班同学困惑了一阵。

perquisite.example: Free parking is one of the perquisites of this job.
perquisite.exampleZh: 免费停车是这份工作的额外福利之一。

persecute.example: The government persecuted people who spoke against it.
persecute.exampleZh: 政府迫害那些公开反对它的人。

persevere.example: She decided to persevere with her studies even when the work became difficult.
persevere.exampleZh: 即使学业变得艰难，她也决定坚持不懈地学下去。

persist.example: If you persist in practicing every day, your English will improve.
persist.exampleZh: 如果你坚持每天练习，你的英语就会进步。

persona.example: He wears a friendly persona at work but is quiet at home.
persona.exampleZh: 他在工作中戴着一副友善的人格面具，但在家里却很安静。

personable.example: The new teacher is personable and always makes students feel welcome.
personable.exampleZh: 这位新老师风度翩翩，总是让学生感到受欢迎。

personality.example: Her friendly personality makes her popular with everyone at school.
personality.exampleZh: 她友善的个性使她在学校里很受大家欢迎。

personify.example: In many old stories, people personify the sun and the moon as gods.
personify.exampleZh: 在许多古老的故事中，人们把太阳和月亮拟人化为神灵。

personnel.example: The company hired more personnel to handle the busy season.
personnel.exampleZh: 公司招聘了更多人员来应对旺季。

perspective.example: From where I stand, this problem looks quite different in perspective.
perspective.exampleZh: 从我的角度看，这个问题在视角上看起来很不一样。

perspicacious.example: Her perspicacious remarks helped us see the real problem at once.
perspicacious.exampleZh: 她敏锐的评论让我们立刻看清了真正的问题。

perspire.example: After running for an hour, he began to perspire heavily.
perspire.exampleZh: 跑了一个小时后，他开始大量出汗。

persuade.example: My friends tried to persuade me to join the school basketball team.
persuade.exampleZh: 我的朋友们试图说服我加入校篮球队。

pertain.example: These rules pertain to all new students in our school.
pertain.exampleZh: 这些规定适用于我们学校的全体新生。

pertinent.example: Her question is very pertinent to our discussion today.
pertinent.exampleZh: 她的问题与我们今天的讨论非常相关。

perturb.example: The strange noise outside began to perturb the sleeping baby.
perturb.exampleZh: 外面奇怪的声音开始让睡着的宝宝不安。

peruse.example: She likes to peruse the newspaper every morning before work.
peruse.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天上班前仔细读报纸。

pervade.example: A warm smell of fresh bread pervades the whole house every morning.
pervade.exampleZh: 每天早晨，新鲜面包的温暖香气弥漫整间屋子。

perverse.example: It seems perverse to refuse help when you need it most.
perverse.exampleZh: 在你最需要帮助的时候拒绝帮助，这似乎很不合情理。

pervert.example: He tried to pervert the truth, but everyone saw what really happened.
pervert.exampleZh: 他试图歪曲事实，但每个人都看清了真正发生了什么。

pessimism.example: His constant pessimism about the future makes the whole team feel tired.
pessimism.exampleZh: 他对未来不断的悲观态度让整个团队都感到疲惫。

pest.example: This small pest eats the leaves of my tomato plants every summer.
pest.exampleZh: 这种小害虫每年夏天都吃我番茄植株的叶子。

pester.example: The little boy kept pestering his mother for candy at the store.
pester.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在商店里一直缠着妈妈要糖果。

pesticide.example: Farmers use pesticide on crops to keep insects away.
pesticide.exampleZh: 农民在农作物上使用杀虫剂来驱赶昆虫。

pestilence.example: The village lost many people when pestilence spread through the town that winter.
pestilence.exampleZh: 那个冬天瘟疫在镇上蔓延时，村里失去许多人。

pet.example: My pet dog likes to sleep on my bed every night.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物狗喜欢每天晚上睡在我的床上。

petal.example: A single pink petal fell from the flower and landed on the table.
petal.exampleZh: 一片粉色的花瓣从花上落下，掉在了桌子上。

petite.example: The petite girl easily found a small seat in the front row.
petite.exampleZh: 这个娇小的女孩很容易就在前排找到了一个小座位。

petition.example: Many people signed the petition to save the old library.
petition.exampleZh: 许多人签署了请愿书以拯救这座老图书馆。

petrify.example: The terrible news petrified her, and she could not say a word.
petrify.exampleZh: 那个可怕的消息把她吓呆了，她一句话也说不出来。

petroglyph.example: The old petroglyph on the rock shows a deer and a hunter.
petroglyph.exampleZh: 岩石上的古老岩画描绘了一只鹿和一个猎人。

petrol.example: The car stopped because it had no petrol left on the road.
petrol.exampleZh: 汽车停了下来，因为它在路上没有汽油了。

petroleum.example: Many countries buy petroleum from other nations to make fuel for cars.
petroleum.exampleZh: 许多国家从其他国家购买石油来制造汽车燃料。

petty.example: She got upset over a petty problem at work today.
petty.exampleZh: 她今天因为工作上一个小问题而心烦。

petulant.example: The petulant child refused to eat his dinner and threw his spoon on the floor.
petulant.exampleZh: 那个耍性子的孩子不肯吃晚饭，还把勺子扔到了地上。

phase.example: The project has three phases, and we will finish the first one soon.
phase.exampleZh: 这个项目分为三个阶段，我们很快就会完成第一阶段。

phenomenal.example: The young singer has phenomenal talent and will be famous soon.
phenomenal.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手有非凡的天赋，很快就会出名。

phenomenon.example: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon that children love to see.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 彩虹是孩子们喜欢看的自然现象。

philanthropy.example: Her family is known for its philanthropy and gives money to many local schools.
philanthropy.exampleZh: 她的家族以慈善事业闻名，为许多当地学校捐款。

philharmonic.example: The philharmonic orchestra played a wonderful concert in the city park last night.
philharmonic.exampleZh: 昨晚，交响乐团在城市公园里举办了一场精彩的音乐会。

philological.example: The professor used philological methods to study the ancient text.
philological.exampleZh: 教授用文献学的方法研究这部古代文本。

philosophy.example: Her philosophy is to stay calm and work hard every day.
philosophy.exampleZh: 她的人生理念是保持冷静，并且每天努力工作。

phobia.example: She has a phobia of flying and always travels by train.
phobia.exampleZh: 她有飞行恐惧症，总是坐火车出行。

phoenix.example: The old city rose like a phoenix after the war and became strong again.
phoenix.exampleZh: 这座古城在战后像凤凰一样重生，再次变得强大。

phone.example: I use my phone to call my mother every evening.
phone.exampleZh: 我每天晚上用手机给妈妈打电话。

phonetic.example: Students learn phonetic symbols to improve their English pronunciation.
phonetic.exampleZh: 学生学习音标来提高英语发音。

phosphorus.example: White phosphorus burns easily when it is left in the air.
phosphorus.exampleZh: 白磷暴露在空气中时很容易燃烧。

photoelectric.example: This photoelectric device turns light into electricity for the small lamp.
photoelectric.exampleZh: 这个光电装置把光转化为电能，为小灯供电。

photograph.example: She took a photograph of the old bridge near her house.
photograph.exampleZh: 她拍了一张她家附近那座旧桥的照片。

photosynthesis.example: Plants use photosynthesis to make food from sunlight, water and air.
photosynthesis.exampleZh: 植物利用光合作用从阳光、水和空气中制造养分。

photovoltaic.example: This photovoltaic panel turns sunlight into electricity for our small house.
photovoltaic.exampleZh: 这块光伏板把阳光转化为我们家那栋小房子的电力。

phrase.example: He used a short phrase to explain the idea to the class.
phrase.exampleZh: 他用一个简短的短语向全班解释了这个想法。

physical.example: Regular physical activity is good for both your body and your mind.
physical.exampleZh: 有规律的体育锻炼对身心都有好处。

physician.example: My physician told me to drink more water and get more sleep.
physician.exampleZh: 我的医生让我多喝水、多睡觉。

physicist.example: The famous physicist explained how light travels through space to the students.
physicist.exampleZh: 这位著名的物理学家向学生们解释了光如何在太空中传播。

physiology.example: Students learn how the heart and lungs work in physiology class.
physiology.exampleZh: 学生们在生理学课上学习心脏和肺如何运作。

physiotherapy.example: After the accident, she goes to physiotherapy twice a week to help her walk again.
physiotherapy.exampleZh: 事故之后，她每周去做两次理疗，以帮助自己重新走路。

pianist.example: My sister wants to be a famous pianist one day.
pianist.exampleZh: 我妹妹希望有一天能成为一名著名的钢琴家。

piazza.example: Every evening, many people walk slowly around the old piazza in the city center.
piazza.exampleZh: 每天傍晚，许多人沿着市中心那座古老的广场慢慢散步。

pick.example: Please pick a book from the shelf and read it here.
pick.exampleZh: 请从书架上挑一本书，在这里读。

pickle.example: My grandmother keeps a big jar of pickle in the kitchen.
pickle.exampleZh: 我奶奶在厨房里放着一大罐腌菜。

picnic.example: We had a picnic in the park with our friends on Sunday.
picnic.exampleZh: 星期天我们和朋友们在公园里野餐。

pictorial.example: This pictorial book helps young children learn new words through bright pictures.
pictorial.exampleZh: 这本图画书通过鲜艳的图片帮助幼儿学习新单词。

picture.example: I can picture the beautiful lake and the tall trees in my mind.
picture.exampleZh: 我能在脑海中想象出那个美丽的湖和高大的树木。

picturesque.example: The small village is picturesque, with old stone houses and a quiet river.
picturesque.exampleZh: 这个小村庄风景如画，有古老的石头房子和一条安静的河。

pidgin.example: Traders on the old coast used a simple pidgin to talk with foreign sailors.
pidgin.exampleZh: 旧时海岸上的商人用一种简单的洋泾浜语与外国水手交谈。

pie.example: My mother made a warm apple pie for us this afternoon.
pie.exampleZh: 今天下午我妈妈给我们做了一个热乎乎的苹果派。

piece.example: She cut the cake into pieces and gave one to each child.
piece.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成小块，给每个孩子分了一块。

pier.example: The small boat is tied to the pier near our hotel.
pier.exampleZh: 那条小船拴在我们酒店附近的码头上。

pierce.example: Her sharp eyes seemed to pierce through every lie he told.
pierce.exampleZh: 她锐利的目光似乎能看穿他说的每一个谎言。

piety.example: Her piety was clear in the way she prayed every morning.
piety.exampleZh: 她每天早晨祈祷的方式清楚地体现了她的虔诚。

pig.example: The farmer keeps a fat pig and some chickens on his small farm.
pig.exampleZh: 这个农民在他的小农场上养了一头肥猪和几只鸡。

pigeon.example: A gray pigeon sat on the roof and watched us eat lunch.
pigeon.exampleZh: 一只灰色的鸽子停在屋顶上，看着我们吃午饭。

pigment.example: The artist mixed red pigment with oil to paint the wall.
pigment.exampleZh: 画家把红色颜料和油混合起来刷墙。

pile.example: There is a pile of books on the desk.

pilgrim.example: The pilgrim walked a long way to visit the old church on the hill.
pilgrim.exampleZh: 这位朝圣者走了很远的路，去拜访山上的那座古老教堂。

pill.example: The doctor gave me a small pill to take after dinner.
pill.exampleZh: 医生给了我一片小药丸，让我晚饭后服用。

pillage.example: The soldiers began to pillage the small village after the long battle.
pillage.exampleZh: 漫长战斗之后，士兵们开始掠夺这个小村庄。

pillar.example: She is a pillar of the community and helps many people.
pillar.exampleZh: 她是社区的栋梁，帮助了许多人。

pillory.example: The old town pillory still stands in the square.
pillory.exampleZh: 那座古老的颈手枷仍然立在广场上。

pillow.example: I put my head on the pillow and fell asleep quickly.
pillow.exampleZh: 我把头枕在枕头上，很快就睡着了。

pilot.example: The pilot will pilot the new plane on its first test flight.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员将驾驶这架新飞机进行首次试飞。

pin.example: She used a pin to fix the note to the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚别针把便条固定在了板上。

pinch.example: She gave his arm a gentle pinch and told him to stay quiet.
pinch.exampleZh: 她轻轻捏了一下他的胳膊，叫他保持安静。

pine.example: She likes to walk in the pine forest behind her house.
pine.exampleZh: 她喜欢在屋后的松树林里散步。

pineapple.example: My sister likes to eat sweet pineapple with breakfast every morning.
pineapple.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢每天早上吃甜菠萝配早餐。

pink.example: She wore a pink dress to the party last night.
pink.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

pinnacle.example: The singer's new album marks the pinnacle of her long career.
pinnacle.exampleZh: 这位歌手的新专辑标志着她漫长职业生涯的巅峰。

pinpoint.example: Doctors can pinpoint the exact cause of the pain with this test.
pinpoint.exampleZh: 医生用这项检查能准确找出疼痛的确切原因。

pint.example: He drank a pint of cold beer after work.
pint.exampleZh: 下班后他喝了一品脱冰啤酒。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in computer science and helped many young women.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学领域的先驱，帮助了许多年轻女性。

pious.example: The pious old man prays every morning before he eats breakfast.
pious.exampleZh: 那位虔诚的老人每天早晨吃饭前都会祈祷。

pipe.example: The water flows through a long pipe under the street.
pipe.exampleZh: 水从街道下面的一根长管道中流过。

piracy.example: The police worked hard to stop piracy near the small island.
piracy.exampleZh: 警方努力制止那座小岛附近的海盗行为。

pirate.example: The pirate sailed across the sea to look for gold.
pirate.exampleZh: 海盗横渡大海去寻找黄金。

pistol.example: The police officer carried a pistol and asked us to stay calm.
pistol.exampleZh: 警察带着一把手枪，让我们保持冷静。

piston.example: The mechanic replaced the broken piston inside the old car engine.
piston.exampleZh: 机械师更换了旧汽车发动机里损坏的活塞。

pit.example: The old coal pit near the village is deep and dangerous.
pit.exampleZh: 村子附近那个旧煤矿坑又深又危险。

pitch.example: The children helped their father pitch the tent near the lake.
pitch.exampleZh: 孩子们帮爸爸在湖边搭帐篷。

pitcher.example: She filled the pitcher with cold water for the players.
pitcher.exampleZh: 她为大伙儿把大水罐装满了凉水。

pitfall.example: The biggest pitfall in learning English is to give up too early.
pitfall.exampleZh: 学习英语最大的隐患就是过早就放弃。

pitiable.example: The pitiable dog sat alone in the cold rain and waited for someone kind.
pitiable.exampleZh: 那只可怜的狗独自坐在冷雨中，等着有善良的人来。

pitiful.example: It was pitiful to see the little dog waiting in the rain.
pitiful.exampleZh: 看到那只小狗在雨里等待，真是令人怜悯。

pity.example: It is a pity that she cannot come to the party tonight.
pity.exampleZh: 很遗憾她今晚不能来参加聚会。

pivot.example: The company will pivot to online sales next year.
pivot.exampleZh: 公司明年将转向线上销售。

pizza.example: We ordered a large pizza with cheese and mushrooms for dinner.
pizza.exampleZh: 我们晚餐点了一个加奶酪和蘑菇的大比萨饼。

placebo.example: The doctor gave him a placebo, but he still felt much better.
placebo.exampleZh: 医生给了他一片安慰剂，但他仍然感觉好多了。

placid.example: The lake was placid and calm in the early morning light.
placid.exampleZh: 清晨的光线下，湖面平静而安宁。

plagiarize.example: He was caught trying to plagiarize another student's essay for his final paper.
plagiarize.exampleZh: 他因试图为期末论文剽窃另一名学生的文章而被发现。

plague.example: The plague killed many people, and fear plagued the small town for years.
plague.exampleZh: 瘟疫夺去了许多人的生命，恐惧多年来一直困扰着这个小镇。

plain.example: It is plain that he told us the plain truth about the wide plain.
plain.exampleZh: 很明显，他向我们讲述了那片辽阔平原上的朴素事实。

plaintiff.example: The plaintiff said the man broke her window last night.
plaintiff.exampleZh: 原告说那个男人昨晚打破了她的窗户。

plaintive.example: The dog gave a plaintive cry when its owner left the house.
plaintive.exampleZh: 主人离开家时，那只狗发出了哀伤的叫声。

plan.example: We need a clear plan before we start the new project.
plan.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个清晰的计划。

plane.example: The plane lands at the small airport every morning.
plane.exampleZh: 这架飞机每天早上在那个小机场降落。

planet.example: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun in our solar system.
planet.exampleZh: 火星是太阳系中距太阳第四近的行星。

plank.example: The workers laid a long wooden plank across the muddy ditch.
plank.exampleZh: 工人们在泥泞的沟渠上铺了一块长木板。

plant.example: My mother likes to plant flowers in the garden behind our old factory.
plant.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在我们旧工厂后面的花园里种花。

plantation.example: The old plantation grows sugar cane and employs many local workers.
plantation.exampleZh: 这座古老的种植园种植甘蔗，并雇用了许多当地工人。

plaque.example: The dentist said a small plaque was forming on my teeth.
plaque.exampleZh: 牙医说我牙齿上正在形成一小块牙菌斑。

plasma.example: The doctor gave him plasma after the accident to help him recover.
plasma.exampleZh: 事故后医生给他输血浆，帮助他恢复。

plate.example: Please put the clean plates on the table before dinner.
plate.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前把干净的盘子放到桌子上。

plateau.example: After years of rapid growth, sales have reached a plateau this year.
plateau.exampleZh: 经过多年的快速增长，今年销售额已达到一个稳定水平。

platform.example: The train arrived at the platform and we got on.
platform.exampleZh: 火车到站台后，我们上了车。

platinum.example: She wears a simple ring made of platinum on her right hand.
platinum.exampleZh: 她右手上戴着一枚铂金做的简单戒指。

platitude.example: His speech was full of platitudes that everyone had heard many times before.
platitude.exampleZh: 他的演讲满是陈词滥调，每个人都早已听过很多遍。

platoon.example: The soldiers in the first platoon stood in a straight line.
platoon.exampleZh: 第一排的士兵站成了一条直线。

platter.example: She put the fruit on a large platter for the guests.
platter.exampleZh: 她把水果放在一个大浅盘上给客人们吃。

plausible.example: His story sounds plausible, but I still need more proof.
plausible.exampleZh: 他的说法听起来貌似合理，但我仍然需要更多证据。

playwright.example: The playwright wrote a funny story about a small town family.
playwright.exampleZh: 这位剧作家写了一个关于小镇家庭的有趣故事。

plea.example: His plea for help was heard by the whole village.
plea.exampleZh: 他求助的恳求被整个村子听到了。

plead.example: She pleaded with the doctor to save her little son.
plead.exampleZh: 她恳求医生救救她的小儿子。

pleasant.example: The weather was pleasant, so we walked in the park after lunch.
pleasant.exampleZh: 天气很宜人，所以午饭后我们在公园里散步。

please.example: The kind words please her very much.
please.exampleZh: 这些亲切的话语让她非常高兴。

plebiscite.example: The country held a plebiscite to decide whether to change its constitution.
plebiscite.exampleZh: 该国举行全民公决，以决定是否修改宪法。

pledge.example: She made a pledge to help her friend every day.
pledge.exampleZh: 她发誓每天都要帮助她的朋友。

plentiful.example: Fresh water is plentiful in this area during the rainy season.
plentiful.exampleZh: 雨季时这个地区淡水很充足。

plenty.example: There is plenty of food and water for everyone here.
plenty.exampleZh: 这里有充足的食物和水供每个人使用。

plethora.example: There is a plethora of cheap clothes in that store.
plethora.exampleZh: 那家商店里有过多廉价的衣服。

pliable.example: This soft leather is pliable enough to wrap around the small box.
pliable.exampleZh: 这种柔软的皮革柔韧性很好，足以包裹住这个小盒子。

plight.example: The old man told us about the plight of families who lost their homes.
plight.exampleZh: 那位老人向我们讲述了失去家园的家庭所面临的困境。

plot.example: The police say the two men plotted to steal money from the small bank.
plot.exampleZh: 警方说这两名男子密谋从这家小银行偷钱。

plow.example: The old farmer used a plow to turn the soil before planting.
plow.exampleZh: 那位老农民在播种前用犁翻地。

ploy.example: The salesman used a clever ploy to make us buy more things.
ploy.exampleZh: 那个推销员用了一个聪明的花招让我们买更多东西。

pluck.example: She plucked a few apples from the tree and put them in her basket.
pluck.exampleZh: 她从树上摘了几个苹果，放进篮子里。

plug.example: He put the plug into the wall socket and turned on the machine.
plug.exampleZh: 他把插头插进墙上的插座，然后打开了机器。

plum.example: She put a ripe plum in her bag and went to school.
plum.exampleZh: 她把一个熟李子放进包里，然后去上学了。

plumb.example: The ship's crew plumbed the depth of the harbor before they sailed.
plumb.exampleZh: 船员们在出海前探测了港口的深度。

plumber.example: The plumber fixed the leak under the kitchen sink this morning.
plumber.exampleZh: 水管工今天早上修好了厨房水槽下面的漏水。

plume.example: A plume of smoke rose slowly from the old chimney this morning.
plume.exampleZh: 今天早上，一缕烟从旧烟囱里缓缓升起。

plummet.example: The temperature will plummet tonight, so remember to wear a warm coat.
plummet.exampleZh: 今晚气温会骤降，所以记得穿上一件暖和的外套。

plump.example: The plump little baby smiled at everyone in the room.
plump.exampleZh: 那个胖乎乎的小宝宝对着房间里的每个人微笑。

plunder.example: The soldiers began to plunder the small village after the long battle.
plunder.exampleZh: 长时间的战斗之后，士兵们开始掠夺这个小村庄。

plunge.example: The car plunged into the icy river after the bridge collapsed.
plunge.exampleZh: 桥塌后，汽车坠入了冰冷的河水。

plural.example: In English we add an s to make the plural form of most nouns.
plural.exampleZh: 在英语中，我们给大多数名词加 s 来构成复数形式。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and the extra shirt is a plus item.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，那件额外的衬衫是一件附加物品。

plywood.example: The table is made of plywood, so it is light and cheap.
plywood.exampleZh: 这张桌子是用胶合板做的，所以又轻又便宜。

pneumonia.example: My grandfather stayed in the hospital for a week because of pneumonia.
pneumonia.exampleZh: 我爷爷因为肺炎在医院住了一个星期。

poach.example: Some hunters poach rare animals in the forest for money.
poach.exampleZh: 一些猎人为了钱在森林里偷猎稀有动物。

pocket.example: He put the key in his coat pocket and left the house.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把钥匙放进口袋里，然后离开了家。

pod.example: The astronauts climbed into the small pod and began their long trip.
pod.exampleZh: 宇航员爬进那个小吊舱，开始了他们漫长的旅程。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为她的班级写了一首关于大海的短诗。

poet.example: The young poet wrote a short poem about the quiet river near his home.
poet.exampleZh: 这位年轻诗人写了一首关于他家附近宁静河流的短诗。

poetry.example: She writes poetry about the sea and the quiet life of her small town.
poetry.exampleZh: 她写诗歌，内容关于大海和她小镇上宁静的生活。

poignant.example: The old photograph was a poignant reminder of her childhood.
poignant.exampleZh: 那张老照片令人心酸地勾起了她对童年的回忆。

point.example: The main point of his talk is clear to everyone here.
point.exampleZh: 他讲话的要点对这里的每个人来说都很清楚。

poison.example: Someone put poison in the dog's food last night.
poison.exampleZh: 昨晚有人把毒药放进了狗的食物里。

poke.example: She used a stick to poke the fire and make it burn.
poke.exampleZh: 她用一根棍子戳火，让它烧得更旺。

polar.example: The polar ice is melting fast because the earth is getting warmer.
polar.exampleZh: 由于地球变暖，极地冰川正在快速融化。

polarize.example: The new policy could polarize the small town into two angry groups.
polarize.exampleZh: 这项新政策可能会使这个小镇分裂成两个对立的愤怒群体。

pole.example: The flag hangs from a tall pole outside the school gate.
pole.exampleZh: 旗子挂在校门外一根高高的杆子上。

police.example: The police helped the lost child find his parents.
police.exampleZh: 警察帮助走失的孩子找到了他的父母。

policy.example: The company has a new policy about working from home.
policy.exampleZh: 公司有一项关于居家办公的新政策。

polio.example: Children in many countries now receive a vaccine that prevents polio.
polio.exampleZh: 许多国家的儿童现在都会接种预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗。

polish.example: She used a soft cloth to polish her old shoes before the party.
polish.exampleZh: 晚会前，她用一块软布把旧鞋子擦亮了。

polite.example: He is always polite to his teachers and classmates at school.
polite.exampleZh: 他在学校对老师和同学总是很有礼貌。

political.example: She often talks about political issues with her friends at lunch.
political.exampleZh: 她常在午餐时和朋友们谈论政治问题。

politician.example: The politician gave a short speech to the people in the town square.
politician.exampleZh: 那位政治家在城镇广场上向人们发表了简短的讲话。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at university because he wants to help his city.
politics.exampleZh: 我弟弟在大学学政治学，因为他想帮助他所在的城市。

poll.example: The newspaper ran a poll to see who people would vote for.
poll.exampleZh: 报纸做了一项民意测验，看看人们会投票给谁。

pollinate.example: Bees pollinate many flowers as they move from plant to plant.
pollinate.exampleZh: 蜜蜂在植物之间飞来飞去时给许多花授粉。

pollute.example: The factory pours dirty water into the river and pollutes it.
pollute.exampleZh: 那家工厂把脏水倒进河里，污染了河水。

polygon.example: A triangle is a polygon with three sides and three angles.
polygon.exampleZh: 三角形是一个有三条边和三个角的多边形。

polymer.example: This plastic bottle is made from a strong polymer.
polymer.exampleZh: 这个塑料瓶由一种坚固的聚合物制成。

pompeii.example: The ancient city of Pompeii was buried by a volcano long ago.
pompeii.exampleZh: 庞贝古城很久以前被一座火山掩埋了。

pond.example: There are many small fish in the pond behind our house.
pond.exampleZh: 我们家后面的池塘里有很多小鱼。

ponder.example: She sat by the window and pondered the question for a long time.
ponder.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，把这个问题沉思了很久。

ponderous.example: The old wooden desk was ponderous and hard to move.
ponderous.exampleZh: 那张旧木桌很笨重，很难搬动。

pontiff.example: The pontiff spoke to a large crowd in the square.
pontiff.exampleZh: 教皇在广场上对一大群人讲话。

pool.example: The children swim in the pool, and we pool our money for snacks.
pool.exampleZh: 孩子们在游泳池里游泳，我们凑钱买零食。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边的一间小房子里。

pop.example: Her new song became a pop hit and everyone sang it.
pop.exampleZh: 她的新歌成了一首流行金曲，大家都在唱。

pope.example: The new pope spoke to the crowd from the balcony of the church.
pope.exampleZh: 新教皇在教堂阳台上向人群讲话。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people all over the world.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在世界各地的年轻人中非常受欢迎。

populate.example: Many people populate this small town near the sea.
populate.exampleZh: 许多人居住在这座海边的小镇上。

population.example: The population of this small town grows every year.
population.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人口每年都在增长。

porch.example: We sat on the porch and watched the children play in the yard.
porch.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上，看孩子们在院子里玩耍。

porcupine.example: A porcupine has sharp quills on its back to keep enemies away.
porcupine.exampleZh: 豪猪背上有尖锐的刺，用来把敌人赶走。

pore.example: She likes to pore over old photos on quiet Sunday afternoons.
pore.exampleZh: 她喜欢在安静的周日下午仔细翻看旧照片。

pork.example: My mother cooks pork with potatoes and carrots for dinner.
pork.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚餐用猪肉和土豆、胡萝卜一起做菜。

pornography.example: The website was closed because it showed illegal pornography to young users.
pornography.exampleZh: 该网站因向年轻用户展示非法色情内容而被关闭。

port.example: The ship arrived at the port early this morning and unloaded its cargo.
port.exampleZh: 这艘船今天清晨抵达港口并卸下了货物。

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry on trips.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小巧的便携式收音机在旅行时很容易携带。

portal.example: The new portal on our city website makes it easy to find local services.
portal.exampleZh: 我们城市网站上的新门户让查找本地服务变得很方便。

portend.example: Dark clouds portend a heavy storm this afternoon.
portend.exampleZh: 乌云预示着今天下午会有一场大暴风雨。

portent.example: The dark clouds were a portent of the storm that came.
portent.exampleZh: 乌云是那场暴风雨来临的预兆。

porter.example: The porter helped us carry our heavy bags to the room.
porter.exampleZh: 搬运工帮我们把沉重的行李搬到了房间。

portfolio.example: She put her laptop and papers into her new portfolio before the meeting.
portfolio.exampleZh: 开会前，她把笔记本电脑和文件放进了她的新公文包里。

portion.example: She ate only a small portion of the cake and saved the rest.
portion.exampleZh: 她只吃了一小部分蛋糕，把剩下的留了下来。

portrait.example: This old portrait shows a young woman with a gentle smile.
portrait.exampleZh: 这幅旧画像上画着一位面带温柔微笑的年轻女子。

portray.example: The book tries to portray the young teacher as a hero.
portray.exampleZh: 这本书试图把那位年轻教师描绘成英雄。

pose.example: The new rules pose a serious problem for small shops.
pose.exampleZh: 新规定给小店铺带来了严重的问题。

position.example: I am not sure about my position on this question.
position.exampleZh: 我对这个问题的立场还不太确定。

positive.example: She always has a positive attitude toward her work and her friends.
positive.exampleZh: 她对工作和朋友总是抱有积极的态度。

possess.example: She possesses great talent and a strong will to succeed.
possess.exampleZh: 她拥有非凡的天赋和强烈的成功意愿。

possession.example: The old man lost all his possessions in the fire last night.
possession.exampleZh: 那位老人在昨晚的火灾中失去了他所有的财产。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
possibility.exampleZh: 明天 real 有可能下雨。

possible.example: It is possible that we will finish the work today.
possible.exampleZh: 我们今天有可能完成这项工作。

post.example: She will post the letter at the post office today.
post.exampleZh: 她今天要去邮局寄这封信。

postage.example: The postage for this letter is two dollars.
postage.exampleZh: 这封信的邮费是两美元。

poster.example: The poster on the wall shows a beautiful beach.
poster.exampleZh: 墙上的海报展示着一片美丽的海滩。

posterior.example: The posterior part of the brain controls balance and some simple movements.
posterior.exampleZh: 大脑的后部控制平衡和一些简单的运动。

posterity.example: Our grandparents saved money so that posterity could live a better life.
posterity.exampleZh: 我们的祖辈攒钱，是为了让后代能过上更好的生活。

posthumous.example: The writer became famous only after his posthumous novel was published.
posthumous.exampleZh: 这位作家仅在他的遗作小说出版后才出名。

postnatal.example: Postnatal care is very important for both the mother and the baby.
postnatal.exampleZh: 产后护理对母亲和婴儿都非常重要。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting because the manager was ill.
postpone.exampleZh: 因为经理生病了，我们不得不推迟会议。

postulate.example: Scientists postulate that the missing rock was carried away by water.
postulate.exampleZh: 科学家们假定那块缺失的岩石是被水冲走的。

pot.example: She put the hot pot on the table carefully.
pot.exampleZh: 她小心地把热锅放在桌上。

potent.example: This medicine is very potent, so you must take only a small dose.
potent.exampleZh: 这种药药效很强，所以你只能服用很小的剂量。

potential.example: She has great potential as a singer, but she needs more practice.
potential.exampleZh: 她作为歌手很有潜力，但需要更多练习。

potter.example: The potter made a large bowl from wet clay.
potter.exampleZh: 陶工用湿黏土做了一个大碗。

pottery.example: She makes beautiful pottery in a small studio near her house.
pottery.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一个小工作室里制作漂亮的陶器。

pouch.example: The mother kangaroo carries her baby in a warm pouch on her belly.
pouch.exampleZh: 袋鼠妈妈把幼崽放在肚子上温暖的育儿袋里。

poultry.example: We keep poultry on our small farm and sell the eggs.
poultry.exampleZh: 我们在小农场里养家禽，并出售鸡蛋。

pound.example: He put ten pounds of rice in the bag and pounded the door hard.
pound.exampleZh: 他把十磅大米放进袋子里，然后用力猛敲门。

pour.example: She poured the hot soup into four bowls for the children.
pour.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进四个碗里给孩子们。

poverty.example: Many families in this small village still live in poverty.
poverty.exampleZh: 这个小村庄里的许多家庭仍然生活在贫困之中。

powder.example: She mixed the white powder with water to make a thin paste.
powder.exampleZh: 她把这种白色粉末和水混合，调成稀糊状。

power.example: She used the power of words to change many people's minds.
power.exampleZh: 她用语言的力量改变了许多人的想法。

practical.example: This small bag is very practical for daily use.
practical.exampleZh: 这个小包在日常使用中非常实用。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English skills.
practice.exampleZh: 每日练习是提高英语能力的最佳方式。

practitioner.example: The young practitioner works in a small clinic near the river.
practitioner.exampleZh: 这位年轻的从业者在河边的一家小诊所工作。

prairie.example: Wild horses ran across the wide prairie under a clear blue sky.
prairie.exampleZh: 野马在晴朗湛蓝的天空下奔过辽阔的大草原。

praise.example: Her teacher gave her great praise for her hard work this term.
praise.exampleZh: 老师因她这学期的努力而给予了她极大的赞扬。

pray.example: Every night she prays for her family and friends.
pray.exampleZh: 每天晚上她都为家人和朋友祈祷。

preach.example: The old man likes to preach in the small church every Sunday morning.
preach.exampleZh: 这位老人喜欢每周日早上在小教堂里布道。

preamble.example: The preamble of the book explains why the author wrote it.
preamble.exampleZh: 这本书的前言解释了作者写它的原因。

precarious.example: The old bridge is precarious, so we never walk across it.
precarious.exampleZh: 那座旧桥很不稳固，所以我们从不从上面走过。

precaution.example: Take the right precautions before you travel to a new country.
precaution.exampleZh: 去一个新国家旅行之前，要采取适当的预防措施。

precede.example: Dark clouds usually precede a heavy storm in summer.
precede.exampleZh: 夏天，乌云通常出现在大暴雨之前。

precedent.example: The judge's decision set a precedent for future cases in this town.
precedent.exampleZh: 法官的判决为这个镇未来的案件树立了先例。

precept.example: My grandmother lived by the simple precept that kindness costs nothing.
precept.exampleZh: 我的祖母恪守这样一条简单的准则：善良不费分文。

precinct.example: The police station is in the old precinct near the river.
precinct.exampleZh: 警察局位于河边那个旧城区里。

precious.example: Time with family is precious, so I never waste it.
precious.exampleZh: 与家人共度的时光是宝贵的，所以我从不浪费它。

precipice.example: We stood at the edge of the precipice and looked down.
precipice.exampleZh: 我们站在悬崖边上向下看。

precipitate.example: His precipitate decision caused serious problems for the whole team.
precipitate.exampleZh: 他仓促的决定给整个团队带来了严重的问题。

precipitation.example: Heavy precipitation fell all night and flooded the roads near our house.
precipitation.exampleZh: 整夜的大量降水淹没了我们家附近的路。

precise.example: Her instructions were precise, so we finished the task quickly.
precise.exampleZh: 她的指示很精确，所以我们很快完成了任务。

preclude.example: Bad weather may preclude us from going on the trip today.
preclude.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气可能会妨碍我们今天去旅行。

precocious.example: The precocious child could read simple books before he started school.
precocious.exampleZh: 这个早熟的孩子在入学前就能读简单的书了。

preconception.example: His preconception about the new job made him nervous on the first day.
preconception.exampleZh: 他对新工作的先入之见让他在第一天很紧张。

precursor.example: This small invention was the precursor of the modern computer.
precursor.exampleZh: 这项小发明是现代计算机的前身。

predator.example: The lion is a strong predator that hunts other animals for food.
predator.exampleZh: 狮子是强壮的捕食者，捕猎其他动物为食。

predecessor.example: My predecessor left the job last month, so I am still learning it.
predecessor.exampleZh: 我的前任上个月离职了，所以我还在学习这份工作。

predict.example: Scientists can predict the weather a few days before it happens.
predict.exampleZh: 科学家能在天气发生前几天做出预测。

predominant.example: Blue is the predominant color in this small seaside town.
predominant.exampleZh: 蓝色是这个海滨小镇的主导颜色。

preeminent.example: She is the preeminent scientist in our country.
preeminent.exampleZh: 她是我国最杰出的科学家。

preempt.example: She decided to preempt the problem by calling him first.
preempt.exampleZh: 她决定先给他打电话，以抢先解决问题。

preen.example: The bird preened its bright feathers in the morning sun.
preen.exampleZh: 那只鸟在晨光中整理它鲜艳的羽毛。

prefab.example: They bought a prefab house and moved in last week.
prefab.exampleZh: 他们买了一套预制房屋，上周搬了进去。

prefer.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
prefer.exampleZh: 早上我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

prefix.example: In English, a prefix comes before the main part of a word.
prefix.exampleZh: 在英语中，前缀出现在单词主要部分的前面。

pregnant.example: She is pregnant and very happy with her family.
pregnant.exampleZh: 她怀孕了，和家人在一起非常开心。

prehistoric.example: Scientists found prehistoric tools in the cave near the river.
prehistoric.exampleZh: 科学家在河边的洞穴里发现了史前工具。

prejudice.example: We should judge people by their actions, not by prejudice.
prejudice.exampleZh: 我们应该根据一个人的行为来判断他，而不是凭偏见。

preliminary.example: The preliminary results look good, so we will continue the test next week.
preliminary.exampleZh: 初步结果看起来不错，所以我们下周将继续进行测试。

prelude.example: The small fight was a prelude to a much bigger war.
prelude.exampleZh: 那场小小的冲突是一场更大战争的前奏。

premature.example: It is premature to make a decision before we see all the facts.
premature.exampleZh: 在看到所有事实之前就做决定是过早的。

premier.example: The premier will meet other leaders at the meeting tomorrow.
premier.exampleZh: 总理明天将在会议上与其他领导人会面。

premiere.example: The film's premiere will be held in London next week.
premiere.exampleZh: 这部电影的首映将于下周在伦敦举行。

premise.example: The whole plan rests on the premise that prices will stay low.
premise.exampleZh: 整个计划都建立在价格会保持低位这一前提之上。

premium.example: The insurance company raised my premium after the car accident last year.
premium.exampleZh: 去年发生车祸后，保险公司提高了我的保险费。

premonition.example: She had a premonition that something bad would happen that night.
premonition.exampleZh: 她有一种预感，那天晚上会发生不好的事。

preoccupation.example: His main preoccupation right now is passing the final exam.
preoccupation.exampleZh: 他目前最关心的事是通过期末考试。

preponderance.example: The preponderance of evidence supports his story about the missing money.
preponderance.exampleZh: 大多数证据支持他关于这笔丢失的钱的说法。

prerequisite.example: Basic math is a prerequisite for this science course.
prerequisite.exampleZh: 基础数学是这门科学课程的先决条件。

prerogative.example: Only the manager has the prerogative to change the schedule.
prerogative.exampleZh: 只有经理有更改日程的特权。

prescribe.example: The doctor will prescribe some medicine to help you sleep better.
prescribe.exampleZh: 医生会开一些药来帮助你睡得更好。

prescription.example: The doctor wrote a prescription for my cough and told me to rest.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张治咳嗽的处方，并让我休息。

presence.example: Your presence at the meeting made everyone feel calm and happy.
presence.exampleZh: 你出席会议让每个人都感到平静和愉快。

present.example: The teacher was present when we gave her a small present to say thank you.
present.exampleZh: 当我们送给老师一份小礼物表示感谢时，她也在场。

preservation.example: The preservation of old books is important for the next generation.
preservation.exampleZh: 古籍的保护对下一代很重要。

preserve.example: We must preserve the old trees in our city for future generations.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护好城市里的老树。

preside.example: The mayor will preside over the meeting in the town hall tonight.
preside.exampleZh: 市长今晚将在市政厅主持这场会议。

president.example: The president of the company gave a short speech to all the workers.
president.exampleZh: 公司总裁向所有员工做了简短的讲话。

press.example: She pressed the button twice, but the elevator still did not move.
press.exampleZh: 她按了两次按钮，但电梯仍然没有动。

pressure.example: She feels a lot of pressure at work every day.
pressure.exampleZh: 她每天在工作中感到很大的压力。

prestige.example: The old school has great prestige in our city.
prestige.exampleZh: 这所老学校在我们城市很有声望。

prestigious.example: She works at a prestigious university in the north of the country.
prestigious.exampleZh: 她在该国北部一所很有声望的大学工作。

presumably.example: He is not here, so he is presumably still at work.
presumably.exampleZh: 他不在这里，所以大概还在上班。

presume.example: I presume you have already read the report before the meeting.
presume.exampleZh: 我假设你在会前已经读过那份报告了。

pretend.example: He likes to pretend that he is a superhero.
pretend.exampleZh: 他喜欢假装自己是个超级英雄。

pretext.example: He used the rain as a pretext to stay home from school.
pretext.exampleZh: 他以下雨为借口，没去上学。

pretty.example: The weather is pretty nice today, so we can walk to the park.
pretty.exampleZh: 今天天气相当不错，所以我们可以走到公园。

prevail.example: In the end, common sense will prevail over fear and confusion.
prevail.exampleZh: 最终，常识将战胜恐惧与混乱。

prevalent.example: This idea is prevalent among young people today.
prevalent.exampleZh: 这种想法在当今年轻人中很普遍。

prevent.example: Washing your hands often can prevent many common illnesses.
prevent.exampleZh: 经常洗手可以预防许多常见疾病。

preview.example: You can preview the lesson before class and watch a short preview of the film.
preview.exampleZh: 你可以在课前预习这节课，并观看这部电影的简短预告。

previous.example: She had no previous experience, but she learned the new job quickly.
previous.exampleZh: 她先前没有经验，但她很快就学会了这份新工作。

prey.example: Lions hunt their prey at night, and small animals prey on insects.
prey.exampleZh: 狮子在夜间捕猎猎物，而小动物则捕食昆虫。

price.example: The price of this coat is too high for me.
price.exampleZh: 这件外套的价格对我来说太高了。

pride.example: She felt great pride when her students passed the exam.
pride.exampleZh: 她的学生们通过考试时，她感到非常自豪。

priest.example: The young priest spoke kindly to everyone after the morning service.
priest.exampleZh: 那位年轻的神父在早晨的礼拜后和蔼地与每个人交谈。

primarily.example: This book is primarily for students who want to learn English fast.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要面向想要快速学会英语的学生。

primary.example: Her primary goal this year is to pass the final exam.
primary.exampleZh: 她今年的首要目标是通过期末考试。

prime.example: Safety is our prime concern when we build new roads.
prime.exampleZh: 修建新道路时，安全是我们的首要考虑。

primer.example: This primer explains basic grammar in a clear and simple way.
primer.exampleZh: 这本入门书用清晰简单的方式讲解基础语法。

primeval.example: These primeval forests have stood here for thousands of years.
primeval.exampleZh: 这些原始森林已经在这里矗立了数千年。

primitive.example: Their tools were primitive and made of stone and wood.
primitive.exampleZh: 他们的工具很简陋，是用石头和木头做的。

primordial.example: The forest still holds some primordial plants and animals.
primordial.exampleZh: 这片森林里仍有一些原始植物和动物。

prince.example: The young prince lived in a big castle with his family.
prince.exampleZh: 这位年轻的王子与家人住在一座大城堡里。

principal.example: The principal reason we moved here was the good school near our new house.
principal.exampleZh: 我们搬到这里的主要原因是新家附近有一所好学校。

principle.example: She always follows her own principles when making difficult decisions at work.
principle.exampleZh: 她在工作中做艰难决定时，总是遵循自己的原则。

print.example: The school will print new books for all the students next week.
print.exampleZh: 学校下周将为所有学生印刷新书。

prior.example: She had a prior meeting, so we moved our talk to Friday.
prior.exampleZh: 她之前有个会议，所以我们把谈话改到了周五。

priority.example: Safety is always our top priority at work and at home.
priority.exampleZh: 无论是在工作中还是在家里，安全始终是我们最重要的事项。

prism.example: A prism splits white light into a rainbow of colors.
prism.exampleZh: 棱镜把白光分解成彩虹般的多种颜色。

prison.example: He was sent to prison for two years after the robbery.
prison.exampleZh: 那次抢劫之后，他被送进监狱服刑两年。

pristine.example: The lake water was so pristine that we could see the fish below.
pristine.exampleZh: 湖水如此清澈干净，我们能看到下面的鱼。

privacy.example: She closed the door because she wanted some privacy in her room.
privacy.exampleZh: 她关上门，因为她想在自己的房间里有独处的空间。

private.example: He keeps his private life away from his busy office work.
private.exampleZh: 他把自己的私人生活与繁忙的办公室工作分开。

privilege.example: It is a privilege to work with such a kind team.
privilege.exampleZh: 能和这么友善的团队一起工作是一种荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school singing contest last year.
prize.exampleZh: 她去年在学校歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

probability.example: The probability of rain is high this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
probability.exampleZh: 今天下午下雨的可能性很大，所以带把伞吧。

probable.example: It is probable that the train will arrive late today.
probable.exampleZh: 今天的火车很可能会晚点。

probe.example: The doctors used a small probe to find the cause of the pain.
probe.exampleZh: 医生用一根小探针来查找疼痛的原因。

problem.example: We must find a way to solve this problem today.
problem.exampleZh: 我们必须今天找到解决这个问题的办法。

procedure.example: Please follow the safety procedure before you start the new machine.
procedure.exampleZh: 在启动这台新机器之前，请遵守安全程序。

proceed.example: We will proceed with the meeting after lunch.
proceed.exampleZh: 午饭后我们将继续进行会议。

proceeds.example: All proceeds from the concert will go to the local children's hospital.
proceeds.exampleZh: 音乐会的全部收益将捐给当地儿童医院。

process.example: Learning a new language is a slow process, but it is worth it.
process.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是一个缓慢的过程，但它值得。

proclaim.example: The government proclaimed a new holiday for all workers last week.
proclaim.exampleZh: 政府上周宣布为所有劳动者设立一个新的节日。

procrastinate.example: I always procrastinate when I have to study for difficult exams.
procrastinate.exampleZh: 每当要为难的考试复习时，我总是拖延。

produce.example: This factory produces many simple toys for children every year.
produce.exampleZh: 这家工厂每年为孩子们生产许多简单的玩具。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品很受年轻人欢迎。

productive.example: A short morning walk makes me more productive at work.
productive.exampleZh: 早上短暂散步能让我工作时更富有成效。

productivity.example: Good sleep can help you improve your productivity at work.
productivity.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠能帮助你在工作中提高工作效率。

profess.example: He professes to know the answer, but nobody believes his words.
profess.exampleZh: 他声称知道答案，但没人相信他的话。

profession.example: She chose teaching as her profession and has worked in it for many years.
profession.exampleZh: 她选择教书作为自己的职业，并在这个行业工作了很多年。

professional.example: She is a professional nurse who cares for many patients every day.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一名专业护士，每天照顾许多病人。

professor.example: My professor helped me understand the difficult math problem after class today.
professor.exampleZh: 今天下课后，我的教授帮我弄懂了那道数学难题。

proffer.example: She proffered a simple plan to improve the team's daily work.
proffer.exampleZh: 她提出了一个简单的方案来改善团队的日常工作。

proficiency.example: Her proficiency in English helped her get a good job in the city.
proficiency.exampleZh: 她熟练的英语能力帮助她在城里找到了一份好工作。

profile.example: This profile gives a short introduction to the writer's life.
profile.exampleZh: 这份简介简要介绍了这位作家的生平。

profit.example: The small shop makes a good profit every month.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店每个月都获得不错的利润。

profitable.example: The small shop became profitable after it started selling coffee.
profitable.exampleZh: 这家小店开始卖咖啡后就变得有利可图了。

profound.example: The old teacher had a profound effect on my life.
profound.exampleZh: 这位老教师对我的一生有着深远的影响。

profuse.example: She gave profuse thanks to everyone who helped her move.
profuse.exampleZh: 她对每个帮她搬家的人都表示了万分感谢。

progeny.example: The old farmer hoped his progeny would keep the family land.
progeny.exampleZh: 这位老农夫希望他的后代能保住家族的土地。

program.example: She wrote a small program to sort the names.
program.exampleZh: 她写了一个小程序来给名字排序。

progress.example: She has made great progress in her English this year.
progress.exampleZh: 她今年在英语上取得了很大进步。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our team will start a new project next week after the meeting.
project.exampleZh: 会议结束后，我们团队下周将开始一个新项目。

proletariat.example: The proletariat worked long hours in the factories for very low pay.
proletariat.exampleZh: 工人阶级在工厂里长时间工作，工资却很低。

proliferate.example: Fake news continues to proliferate quickly on social media.
proliferate.exampleZh: 虚假新闻在社交媒体上继续迅速扩散。

prolific.example: She is a prolific writer who has published over thirty books.
prolific.exampleZh: 她是一位多产的作家，已出版了三十多本书。

prologue.example: The prologue of the book explains how the story began.
prologue.exampleZh: 这本书的序言解释了故事的起源。

prolong.example: The cold weather may prolong the time we need to finish the work.
prolong.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气可能会延长我们完成这项工作所需的时间。

prominent.example: She is a prominent doctor in our city and helps many people.
prominent.exampleZh: 她是我们城市一位杰出的医生，帮助过很多人。

promiscuous.example: His promiscuous lifestyle worried his family and his old friends.
promiscuous.exampleZh: 他滥交的生活方式让家人和老朋友都很担心。

promise.example: She made a promise to call her mother every day.
promise.exampleZh: 她承诺每天给母亲打电话。

promising.example: The young singer is very promising and already has many fans.
promising.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手很有前途，已经有了很多粉丝。

promote.example: The new manager wants to promote healthy habits among the team.
promote.exampleZh: 新经理希望在团队中推广健康的习惯。

prompt.example: The loud noise was a prompt for everyone to leave the building quickly.
prompt.exampleZh: 那声巨响促使所有人迅速离开大楼。

prone.example: He is prone to make careless mistakes when he is tired.
prone.exampleZh: 他累的时候容易犯粗心的错误。

pronoun.example: In this sentence, the pronoun refers to the person who is speaking.
pronoun.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，这个代词指的是正在说话的人。

pronounce.example: The teacher asked me to pronounce each word slowly and clearly.
pronounce.exampleZh: 老师让我把每个单词慢慢地、清楚地读出来。

proof.example: The police need proof that he was at home last night.
proof.exampleZh: 警方需要证据证明他昨晚在家。

propaganda.example: The government used posters and radio for propaganda during the war.
propaganda.exampleZh: 战争期间，政府利用海报和广播进行宣传。

propagate.example: Rabbits propagate quickly, and their news can propagate just as fast.
propagate.exampleZh: 兔子繁殖得很快，而它们的消息也能同样迅速地传播开。

propel.example: Strong winds can propel the small boat across the lake very quickly.
propel.exampleZh: 强风能推动小船很快地穿过湖面。

propensity.example: He has a propensity to talk too much when he is nervous.
propensity.exampleZh: 他紧张时有一种说话太多的倾向。

proper.example: Please use the proper tools when you fix the old chair.
proper.exampleZh: 修理这把旧椅子时，请使用合适的工具。

property.example: The fire destroyed all his property, including his house and car.
property.exampleZh: 这场火灾毁掉了他所有的财产，包括他的房子和汽车。

prophecy.example: The old woman's prophecy about the flood came true many years later.
prophecy.exampleZh: 那位老妇人关于洪水的预言在许多年后应验了。

prophet.example: The old prophet told the people that a great change was coming soon.
prophet.exampleZh: 那位年老的先知告诉人们，一场巨大的变化即将到来。

propitiate.example: She brought flowers to propitiate her angry neighbor after the long argument.
propitiate.exampleZh: 长时间争吵之后，她带上鲜花去抚慰愤怒的邻居。

propitious.example: The sunny morning was a propitious time to start our long journey.
propitious.exampleZh: 阳光明媚的早晨是开始我们长途旅行的合适时机。

proponent.example: She is a strong proponent of clean energy for small towns.
proponent.exampleZh: 她是小城镇清洁能源的有力倡导者。

proportion.example: A large proportion of the students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: She made a good proposal at the meeting yesterday.
proposal.exampleZh: 她在昨天的会议上提出了一个好建议。

propose.example: I propose that we meet at the library tomorrow afternoon.
propose.exampleZh: 我提议我们明天下午在图书馆见面。

proposition.example: Her main proposition is simple and easy for everyone to understand.
proposition.exampleZh: 她的主要观点很简单，每个人都很容易理解。

proprietary.example: The company keeps its software proprietary and does not share the code with anyone.
proprietary.exampleZh: 这家公司将其软件作为专有产品，不向任何人共享代码。

proprietor.example: The proprietor of the small shop knows all his customers by name.
proprietor.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主认识所有顾客的名字。

propriety.example: He always behaves with propriety when guests visit our home.
propriety.exampleZh: 有客人来我们家时，他总是举止得体。

propulsion.example: The new engine provides enough propulsion to move the small boat quickly.
propulsion.exampleZh: 新发动机提供了足够的推进力，使小船快速移动。

prose.example: She writes simple prose about her daily life in the countryside.
prose.exampleZh: 她用朴素的散文描写自己在乡下的日常生活。

prosecute.example: The police decided to prosecute him for stealing money from the shop.
prosecute.exampleZh: 警方决定因他从商店偷钱而起诉他。

prospect.example: The prospect of a better job makes him study harder every day.
prospect.exampleZh: 找到更好工作的前景让他每天都更努力地学习。

prospective.example: She has a meeting with a prospective client tomorrow morning.
prospective.exampleZh: 她明天上午要和一位潜在客户会面。

prosper.example: Small shops can prosper when the town attracts many visitors each year.
prosper.exampleZh: 当小镇每年吸引许多游客时，小商店就能兴旺起来。

prosperity.example: The small town found peace and prosperity after the new road was built.
prosperity.exampleZh: 新路修好后，这个小镇迎来了安宁与繁荣。

prosperous.example: The small town became prosperous after the new factory opened.
prosperous.exampleZh: 新工厂开张后，这个小镇变得繁荣起来。

protect.example: We must protect the small animals in the forest.
protect.exampleZh: 我们必须保护森林里的小动物。

protein.example: You need to eat more protein to build strong muscles.
protein.exampleZh: 你需要摄入更多蛋白质来长肌肉。

protest.example: Many people protested against the new law outside the city hall.
protest.exampleZh: 许多人在市政厅外抗议这项新法律。

protocol.example: The two countries signed a protocol to protect the river and share clean water.
protocol.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项协议，以保护这条河流并共享清洁水源。

prototype.example: The team built a prototype of the new car last year.
prototype.exampleZh: 团队去年造了一辆新车的原型。

protract.example: The bad weather may protract the building work by several weeks.
protract.exampleZh: 恶劣天气可能会使这项建筑工程延长几周。

protrude.example: The sharp rock protrudes from the shallow water near the shore.
protrude.exampleZh: 那块尖锐的岩石从岸边的浅水中凸出。

proud.example: My parents are very proud of me because I work hard at school.
proud.exampleZh: 我父母为我感到非常自豪，因为我在学校很努力。

prove.example: The new test results prove that the medicine works.
prove.exampleZh: 新的测试结果证明这种药有效。

proverb.example: My grandmother often used a proverb to teach me about life.
proverb.exampleZh: 我奶奶常用一句谚语来教我人生的道理。

provide.example: The school will provide free books and lunch for every student this year.
provide.exampleZh: 学校今年将为每个学生提供免费的书和午餐。

province.example: This province is famous for its mountains and old towns.
