province.exampleZh: 这个省以它的山脉和古镇而闻名。

provision.example: The camp made provision for enough food and water for everyone.
provision.exampleZh: 营地做好了准备，为每个人提供足够的食物和水。

provisional.example: We made a provisional plan for the trip and will change it later.
provisional.exampleZh: 我们为这次旅行制定了一个临时的计划，之后会再修改。

provocative.example: His provocative question made everyone in the room stop and think.
provocative.exampleZh: 他那挑衅性的问题让房间里的每个人都停下来思考。

provoke.example: His rude words provoked a big argument in the meeting.
provoke.exampleZh: 他无礼的话在会议上激起了一场大争论。

prowess.example: Her athletic prowess helped the team win the game easily.
prowess.exampleZh: 她高超的运动能力帮助球队轻松赢得了比赛。

proximity.example: The hotel's proximity to the beach makes it a popular choice for families.
proximity.exampleZh: 这家酒店离海滩很近，因此深受家庭游客的欢迎。

proxy.example: She acted as a proxy for her boss at the meeting.
proxy.exampleZh: 她在会议上作为老板的代理人出席。

prude.example: My friends call me a prude because I never tell rude jokes.
prude.exampleZh: 朋友们说我是个假正经的人，因为我从不讲粗俗的笑话。

prudent.example: It is prudent to save some money for a rainy day.
prudent.exampleZh: 存一些钱以备不时之需是明智的。

prune.example: Farmers prune the old branches every winter so the trees grow better.
prune.exampleZh: 农民每年冬天都会修剪老枝，让树木长得更好。

pry.example: She tried to pry into her neighbor's private life.
pry.exampleZh: 她试图窥探邻居的私生活。

pseudonym.example: The famous writer used a pseudonym so no one knew his real name.
pseudonym.exampleZh: 这位著名作家用了一个笔名，所以没人知道他的真名。

psychiatry.example: She decided to study psychiatry because she wants to help people with mental illness.
psychiatry.exampleZh: 她决定学习精神病学，因为她想帮助患有精神疾病的人。

psychic.example: She believes she has psychic powers that let her see the future.
psychic.exampleZh: 她相信自己有通灵能力，能看到未来。

psychology.example: She studies psychology at university and wants to help people understand their feelings.
psychology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习心理学，想帮助人们理解自己的情绪。

psychotherapy.example: She started psychotherapy last year to help with her anxiety and stress.
psychotherapy.exampleZh: 她去年开始接受心理治疗，以帮助缓解焦虑和压力。

pub.example: We met some old friends at a small pub near the river.
pub.exampleZh: 我们在河边一家小酒吧遇到了几位老朋友。

public.example: The new library is open to the public every day.
public.exampleZh: 新图书馆每天都向公众开放。

publication.example: This magazine is a monthly publication for young readers.
publication.exampleZh: 这本杂志是面向年轻读者的月刊。

publicity.example: The new film received a lot of publicity before it came out.
publicity.exampleZh: 这部新电影在上映前得到了大量宣传。

publish.example: The company will publish her new book next month.
publish.exampleZh: 公司将在下个月出版她的新书。

pudding.example: My mother made a chocolate pudding for dessert last night.
pudding.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨晚做了一个巧克力布丁当甜点。

puddle.example: After the rain, the children jumped in every puddle on the way to school.
puddle.exampleZh: 雨后，孩子们在上学路上踩遍了每一个水坑。

puff.example: After running fast, he was puffing and had to stop.
puff.exampleZh: 快跑之后，他气喘吁吁，不得不停下来。

pull.example: He pulled the heavy box across the floor to the door.
pull.exampleZh: 他把那个沉重的箱子从地板上拖到了门口。

pulp.example: She cut the fruit in half and scooped out the sweet pulp with a spoon.
pulp.exampleZh: 她把水果切成两半，用勺子把甜甜的果肉挖了出来。

pulse.example: The nurse checked his pulse after he ran around the track.
pulse.exampleZh: 他绕着跑道跑完后，护士检查了他的脉搏。

pump.example: The farmer used a pump to bring water from the well.

pumpkin.example: My mother made a sweet pie with a big orange pumpkin from the garden.
pumpkin.exampleZh: 我妈妈用菜园里一个大大的橙色南瓜做了一个甜派。

punch.example: He gave the wall a hard punch with his right fist.
punch.exampleZh: 他用右拳重重地打了墙一下。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for class and never arrives late.
punctual.exampleZh: 她上课总是很准时，从不迟到。

punctuate.example: Small shops punctuate the long street and often break my walk.
punctuate.exampleZh: 小店点缀着这条长街，常常打断我的散步。

puncture.example: A sharp nail made a small puncture in my front tire.
puncture.exampleZh: 一颗尖钉子在我的前轮胎上扎出了一个小孔。

pungent.example: The pungent smell of garlic filled the small kitchen.
pungent.exampleZh: 大蒜的刺鼻气味充满了小厨房。

punish.example: The teacher will punish anyone who cheats in the exam.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚任何在考试中作弊的人。

punitive.example: The school took punitive steps against students who broke the rules.
punitive.exampleZh: 学校对违反规定的学生采取了惩罚性措施。

pupil.example: The pupil could not answer the teacher's question about the new lesson.
pupil.exampleZh: 这个学生回答不出老师关于新课的问题。

puppet.example: The little boy moved the puppet with strings and made the crowd laugh.
puppet.exampleZh: 小男孩用线操控木偶，逗得人群大笑。

puppy.example: The little puppy followed me home and slept by my bed.
puppy.exampleZh: 那只小狗跟着我回家，睡在我的床边。

purchase.example: I want to purchase a new laptop for my online classes.
purchase.exampleZh: 我想为我的网课购买一台新笔记本电脑。

pure.example: The water in this mountain lake is pure and clean.
pure.exampleZh: 这个山间湖泊里的水纯净清澈。

purge.example: The new leader decided to purge the company of dishonest workers.
purge.exampleZh: 新领导决定清洗公司里不诚实的员工。

purify.example: We need clean water, so we must purify it before drinking.
purify.exampleZh: 我们需要干净的水，所以饮用前必须把它净化。

puritan.example: The puritan refused to dance or sing on Sunday.
puritan.exampleZh: 那个清教徒拒绝在星期天跳舞或唱歌。

purpose.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan our next project.
purpose.exampleZh: 这次会议的目的是规划我们的下一个项目。

purr.example: The cat likes to purr softly when I hold it in my arms.
purr.exampleZh: 当我把它抱在怀里时，这只猫喜欢轻轻地发出呼噜声。

purse.example: She opened her purse and found only a few coins inside.
purse.exampleZh: 她打开钱包，发现里面只有几枚硬币。

pursue.example: She wants to pursue a career in music after college.
pursue.exampleZh: 她大学毕业后想从事音乐方面的职业。

pursuit.example: Her lifelong pursuit of knowledge made her a respected scientist.
pursuit.exampleZh: 她对知识的终身追求使她成为一位受人尊敬的科学家。

push.example: She pushed the heavy door open and walked into the room.
push.exampleZh: 她推开那扇沉重的门，走进了房间。

put.example: Please put the books on the desk before you leave.
put.exampleZh: 请在离开前把书放在桌子上。

putrid.example: The putrid smell from the old fridge made everyone leave the kitchen.
putrid.exampleZh: 旧冰箱里腐烂的气味让所有人都离开了厨房。

puzzle.example: The question puzzled me, so I asked my teacher for help.
puzzle.exampleZh: 这个问题让我困惑，所以我向老师求助。

pygmy.example: The tall explorer looked like a giant next to the pygmy.
pygmy.exampleZh: 那位高大的探险家站在这个矮人旁边，看起来像个巨人。

pyramid.example: The children built a small pyramid with their blocks.
pyramid.exampleZh: 孩子们用积木搭了一个小金字塔。

pyre.example: They built a pyre of dry wood beside the river.
pyre.exampleZh: 他们在河边用干木头搭起了一个火葬堆。

pyrite.example: The shiny yellow stone looks like gold, but it is only pyrite.
pyrite.exampleZh: 这块闪亮的黄色石头看起来像黄金，但它只是黄铁矿。

pyroclastic.example: The volcano threw hot pyroclastic rocks into the air.
pyroclastic.exampleZh: 火山把炽热的火山碎屑岩石抛向空中。

python.example: The python slowly wrapped itself around a thick branch in the tree.
python.exampleZh: 那条蟒蛇慢慢地把自己缠绕在树上的一根粗树枝上。

quack.example: The old man turned out to be a quack who sold useless medicine.
quack.exampleZh: 那位老人原来是个卖无用药的江湖医生。

quadruple.example: The company plans to quadruple its sales over the next five years.
quadruple.exampleZh: 公司计划在未来五年内将销售额增加到四倍。

quaff.example: The old man quaffed a glass of cold water after his long walk.
quaff.exampleZh: 老人走了很长的路后，痛饮了一杯凉水。

quagmire.example: The truck got stuck in a quagmire after the heavy rain.
quagmire.exampleZh: 大雨过后，那辆卡车陷进了泥潭里。

quail.example: The little quail hid in the tall grass when it saw the dog.
quail.exampleZh: 那只小鹌鹑看到狗时躲进了高高的草丛里。

quaint.example: We stayed in a quaint little village with old stone houses.
quaint.exampleZh: 我们住在一个古朴的小村庄里，那里有古老的石头房子。

quake.example: The ground began to quake, so everyone ran out of the building quickly.
quake.exampleZh: 地面开始震动，所以大家都迅速跑出了大楼。

qualification.example: She has the right qualifications for this job.
qualification.exampleZh: 她具备这份工作所需的资格条件。

qualify.example: His hard work helped him qualify for the final exam.
qualify.exampleZh: 他的努力帮助他获得了期末考试资格。

qualitative.example: The study gives a qualitative picture of how students learn at home.
qualitative.exampleZh: 这项研究定性地描述了学生在家学习的情况。

quality.example: The quality of this small hotel is much better than I expected.
quality.exampleZh: 这家小旅馆的质量比我预期的要好得多。

qualms.example: She had no qualms about leaving her old job for a better one.
qualms.exampleZh: 她对离开旧工作去追求更好的工作毫无疑虑。

quandary.example: She was in a quandary about which job offer to accept.
quandary.exampleZh: 她对接受哪份工作邀请感到进退两难。

quantify.example: It is hard to quantify the value of extra practice.
quantify.exampleZh: 很难量化额外练习的价值。

quantitative.example: The study uses quantitative methods to measure student progress.
quantitative.exampleZh: 这项研究使用定量的方法来衡量学生的进步。

quantity.example: We need a large quantity of water for the whole team.
quantity.exampleZh: 我们需要大量的水供整个团队使用。

quarantine.example: The sick travelers must stay in quarantine for two weeks before they go home.
quarantine.exampleZh: 生病的旅客必须在隔离区待两周才能回家。

quarrel.example: The two brothers had a quarrel about the TV remote last night.
quarrel.exampleZh: 两兄弟昨晚为电视遥控器吵了一架。

quart.example: I bought a quart of milk at the store this morning.
quart.exampleZh: 我今天早上在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。

quarter.example: I will visit my parents in the next quarter of the year.
quarter.exampleZh: 我将在今年的下一个季度去看望我的父母。

quarterly.example: The company sends a quarterly report to all of its employees.
quarterly.exampleZh: 公司向所有员工发送一份季度报告。

quartz.example: The old watch has a small piece of quartz inside it.
quartz.exampleZh: 这块旧手表里面有一小块石英。

quash.example: The judge decided to quash the earlier ruling after new evidence appeared.
quash.exampleZh: 新证据出现后，法官决定撤销先前的裁决。

quasi.example: This quasi scientific report looks like real research but lacks solid proof.
quasi.exampleZh: 这份半科学的报告看起来像真正的研究，但缺乏确凿证据。

queen.example: The queen lives in a big palace with her family and many servants.
queen.exampleZh: 女王和她的家人以及许多仆人住在一座大宫殿里。

queer.example: There is a queer smell in this old room.
queer.exampleZh: 这个旧房间里有一股奇怪的味道。

quench.example: A cold glass of water can quench your thirst on a hot day.
quench.exampleZh: 在炎热的天气里，一杯冷水能解渴。

query.example: I have a query about the new schedule and want to ask you.
query.exampleZh: 我对新日程有个疑问，想问问你。

question.example: May I ask you a question about the homework?
question.exampleZh: 我可以问你一个关于作业的问题吗？

queue.example: We had to queue for an hour to buy the tickets.
queue.exampleZh: 我们不得不排队一个小时才买到票。

quibble.example: He likes to quibble about small details instead of finishing the work.
quibble.exampleZh: 他喜欢在小细节上吹毛求疵，而不是把工作完成。

quick.example: She is very quick at learning new words in English class.
quick.exampleZh: 她在英语课上记新单词很快。

quiescent.example: The volcano has been quiescent for many years, so nearby farmers feel safe.
quiescent.exampleZh: 这座火山已经休眠多年，所以附近的农民感到很安全。

quiet.example: The library was very quiet, so we spoke in low voices.
quiet.exampleZh: 图书馆很安静，所以我们低声说话。

quill.example: The old writer dipped his quill in ink and began to write.
quill.exampleZh: 这位老作家把羽毛笔蘸上墨水，开始写作。

quilt.example: My grandmother made a warm quilt for me last winter.
quilt.exampleZh: 去年冬天，我奶奶给我做了一床暖和的被子。

quinary.example: The quinary group sat at the fifth table near the window.
quinary.exampleZh: 第五组坐在靠窗的第五张桌子旁。

quintessence.example: This small garden is the quintessence of peace and simple beauty.
quintessence.exampleZh: 这个小花园是宁静与朴素之美的典范。

quintessential.example: This small café is the quintessential place to relax on a Sunday morning.
quintessential.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆是周日早晨放松的典型去处。

quip.example: He made a clever quip about the weather and everyone laughed.
quip.exampleZh: 他说了一句关于天气的俏皮话，大家都笑了。

quirk.example: Everyone laughs at his little quirk of talking to his plants every morning.
quirk.exampleZh: 大家都笑他每天早上跟植物说话这个小怪癖。

quit.example: She decided to quit her job and move to another city.
quit.exampleZh: 她决定辞掉工作，搬到另一座城市去。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, so everyone finished it in twenty minutes.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当容易，所以每个人都在二十分钟内做完了。

quiver.example: Her voice began to quiver when she spoke about her old dog.
quiver.exampleZh: 当她谈到她的老狗时，她的声音开始颤抖。

quiz.example: Our teacher gives a short quiz every Friday, and she often quizzes us on new words.
quiz.exampleZh: 我们老师每周五都会进行一次小测验，她经常就新单词向我们提问。

quorum.example: We need a quorum of ten members before we can vote.
quorum.exampleZh: 我们需要十名成员达到法定人数才能投票。

quote.example: She likes to quote her teacher when she writes a report.
quote.exampleZh: 她写报告时喜欢引用她老师的话。

quotidian.example: His quotidian routine of coffee and emails rarely changes.
quotidian.exampleZh: 他每日喝咖啡、看邮件的日常几乎从不改变。

qur'an.example: Many Muslims read the Qur'an every day to learn about their faith.
qur'an.exampleZh: 许多穆斯林每天阅读《古兰经》，以了解自己的信仰。

rabbi.example: The rabbi read from the old book and answered the children's questions.
rabbi.exampleZh: 拉比诵读那本古老的书，并回答了孩子们的问题。

rabbit.example: The white rabbit is eating a carrot in the garden.
rabbit.exampleZh: 那只白兔正在花园里吃胡萝卜。

rabid.example: His rabid fans cheered loudly when the team won the game.
rabid.exampleZh: 球队赢得比赛时，他那些狂热的粉丝大声欢呼。

rabies.example: Rabies is a dangerous disease that people can get from animal bites.
rabies.exampleZh: 狂犬病是一种危险的疾病，人们可能因动物咬伤而感染。

raccoon.example: We saw a raccoon near the river last night.
raccoon.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在河边看到一只浣熊。

race.example: She won the race and ran fast to the finish line.
race.exampleZh: 她赢得了比赛，并快速跑向终点线。

racial.example: Many people still face unfair treatment because of racial differences.
racial.exampleZh: 许多人仍然因为种族差异而遭受不公平的对待。

racism.example: Racism hurts people and makes our society less fair for everyone.
racism.exampleZh: 种族主义伤害人们，也让我们的社会对每个人都不那么公平。

racist.example: He was called a racist after making rude comments about people from other countries.
racist.exampleZh: 他因为对其他國家的人发表粗鲁言论而被称为种族主义者。

rack.example: He put his heavy bag on the rack above the seat.
rack.exampleZh: 他把沉重的包放在座位上方的行李架上。

racket.example: He bought a new tennis racket before his first match on Saturday.
racket.exampleZh: 他在周六第一场比赛前买了一把新网球拍。

racketeer.example: The police finally caught the racketeer who had cheated many small shop owners.
racketeer.exampleZh: 警方终于抓住了那个欺骗了许多小店主敲诈勒索者。

racquet.example: She put her new racquet in the bag before the tennis game.
racquet.exampleZh: 她在网球比赛前把新球拍放进了包里。

racquetball.example: My friends and I play racquetball at the gym every Saturday morning.
racquetball.exampleZh: 我和朋友们每周六早上在健身房打短柄墙球。

radar.example: The ship uses radar to find its way safely through the fog.
radar.exampleZh: 这艘船用雷达在浓雾中安全航行。

radial.example: The wheel has radial spokes that go from the center to the edge.
radial.exampleZh: 这个轮子有从中心延伸到边缘的放射状辐条。

radiance.example: The bride's face glowed with radiance as she walked into the room.
radiance.exampleZh: 新娘走进房间时，脸上洋溢着光彩。

radiant.example: She looked radiant in her new dress at the party last night.
radiant.exampleZh: 昨晚聚会上她穿着新裙子，显得容光焕发。

radiate.example: The old stove radiates warm heat across the whole room.
radiate.exampleZh: 那个旧炉子向整个房间散发着温暖的热气。

radiation.example: The doctor warned us that too much radiation is bad for the body.
radiation.exampleZh: 医生警告我们说，过多的辐射对身体有害。

radiator.example: The radiator in my bedroom keeps the room warm all winter.
radiator.exampleZh: 我卧室里的暖气片整个冬天都让房间保持温暖。

radical.example: The new plan is too radical for most of the older workers.
radical.exampleZh: 这个新方案对大多数年长员工来说太激进了。

radicalism.example: The teacher said that radicalism can bring fast changes but often causes trouble.
radicalism.exampleZh: 老师说激进主义能带来快速的变化，但常常惹出麻烦。

radio.example: We listen to the radio every morning while we eat breakfast.
radio.exampleZh: 我们每天早上吃早饭时听收音机。

radioactive.example: The old factory left radioactive waste in the ground for many years.
radioactive.exampleZh: 那座旧工厂在地下留下了放射性废物，持续了很多年。

radioactivity.example: Scientists found high levels of radioactivity in the soil near the old factory.
radioactivity.exampleZh: 科学家在旧工厂附近的土壤中发现了高水平的放射性。

radish.example: She put a red radish in the salad and mixed it well.
radish.exampleZh: 她在沙拉里放了一个红萝卜，并把它拌匀了。

radium.example: Radium is a radioactive element that was discovered by Marie Curie.
radium.exampleZh: 镭是一种放射性元素，由居里夫人发现。

radius.example: The park is within a radius of two miles from our house.
radius.exampleZh: 公园在我们家两英里的半径范围之内。

radon.example: Radon is a harmful gas that can build up inside old houses.
radon.exampleZh: 氡是一种有害气体，可能会在旧房子里积聚。

raffle.example: They won a new bike in the school raffle last week.
raffle.exampleZh: 他们上周在学校抽奖活动中赢得了一辆新自行车。

raft.example: They built a small raft to cross the river.
raft.exampleZh: 他们造了一个小木筏来过河。

rag.example: She cleaned the dirty window with an old rag.
rag.exampleZh: 她用一块旧破布擦干净了那扇脏窗户。

rage.example: He shook with rage when he heard the unfair news.
rage.exampleZh: 他听到那个不公平的消息时气得浑身发抖。

ragged.example: The ragged old man sat quietly on the corner and asked for some food.
ragged.exampleZh: 那位衣衫褴褛的老人安静地坐在街角，讨要一些食物。

raid.example: The police made a raid on the old building last night.
raid.exampleZh: 警方昨晚突袭了那栋旧楼。

rail.example: Hold the rail while you walk down the stairs.

railroad.example: The railroad runs along the river and connects the two small towns.
railroad.exampleZh: 这条铁路沿着河延伸，连接着两个小镇。

railway.example: My grandfather worked on the railway for over thirty years.
railway.exampleZh: 我的祖父在铁路上工作了三十多年。

rainbow.example: After the rain, a bright rainbow appeared in the sky above our house.
rainbow.exampleZh: 雨后，一道明亮的彩虹出现在我们家上方的天空中。

raise.example: They raised money to help the poor children in the village.
raise.exampleZh: 他们筹集资金帮助村里的贫困儿童。

rake.example: The gardener used a rake to gather the dry leaves.
rake.exampleZh: 园丁用耙子把干枯的叶子耙拢起来。

rally.example: The team rallied together after the storm and rebuilt the school.
rally.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，队伍重新集合起来，重建了学校。

ram.example: The angry ram rammed the fence and broke two wooden boards.
ram.exampleZh: 那只愤怒的公羊猛撞栅栏，撞断了两块木板。

ramble.example: We ramble through the old town and talk about everything.
ramble.exampleZh: 我们在老城区漫步，什么都聊。

ramp.example: The workers pushed the heavy boxes up the ramp to the truck.
ramp.exampleZh: 工人们把沉重的箱子沿着坡道推上卡车。

ranch.example: My uncle lives on a big ranch with many cows and horses.
ranch.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在一个养着许多牛和马的大牧场上。

rancher.example: The rancher gets up early every day to feed his cattle.
rancher.exampleZh: 这位牧场主每天早起喂牛。

rancor.example: He still felt deep rancor toward the man who had taken his job.
rancor.exampleZh: 他对那个抢走他工作的人仍然怀有深深的积怨。

random.example: I picked a random number between one and ten.
random.exampleZh: 我在一到十之间随便挑了一个数字。

range.example: This shop sells a wide range of cheap clothes for young people.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种适合年轻人的便宜衣服。

rank.example: He holds a high rank in the army and ranks first among his peers.
rank.exampleZh: 他在军队中拥有很高的军衔，在同伴中排名第一。

ransom.example: The thieves asked for a large ransom before they would let the boy go.
ransom.exampleZh: 窃贼索要一大笔赎金才肯放走那个男孩。

rap.example: Someone rapped on the door and I opened it.
rap.exampleZh: 有人敲了敲门，我就把门打开了。

rapacious.example: The rapacious company took more and more land from the poor farmers.
rapacious.exampleZh: 这家贪婪的公司从贫穷的农民手中夺走了越来越多的土地。

rape.example: The court found him guilty of rape and sent him to prison.
rape.exampleZh: 法庭判定他犯有强奸罪，将他送进了监狱。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city surprised all of us.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展让我们所有人都感到惊讶。

rapt.example: The children sat rapt as the old man told his story.
rapt.exampleZh: 老人讲故事时，孩子们全神贯注地坐着。

rapture.example: Her face showed pure rapture when she heard the good news.
rapture.exampleZh: 她听到好消息时，脸上露出纯粹的狂喜。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm city.
rare.exampleZh: 在这个温暖的城市里看到雪是很罕见的。

rascal.example: The little rascal hid my shoes under the bed again.
rascal.exampleZh: 那个小捣蛋鬼又把我的鞋子藏到床底下了。

rash.example: It is rash to spend all your money on a new phone.
rash.exampleZh: 把所有钱花在一部新手机上是轻率的。

rat.example: The rat ran under the old wooden bridge near my house.
rat.exampleZh: 那只老鼠跑到了我家附近那座旧木桥下面。

rate.example: The hotel charges a low rate in winter, and guests often rate it highly.
rate.exampleZh: 这家酒店冬季收费较低，客人们常常给它很高的评价。

rather.example: I would rather stay home today because the weather is rather cold.
rather.exampleZh: 我今天宁愿待在家里，因为天气相当冷。

ratify.example: The government will ratify the new trade agreement next month.
ratify.exampleZh: 政府将于下个月批准这项新的贸易协定。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is two to one.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生与女生的比例是二比一。

ration.example: During the war, each family received a small ration of bread and sugar.
ration.exampleZh: 战争期间，每个家庭都分到一小份面包和糖的配给量。

rational.example: It is rational to save some money for a rainy day.
rational.exampleZh: 存点钱以备不时之需是理性的。

rattle.example: The strong wind made the old window rattle all night long.
rattle.exampleZh: 大风让那扇旧窗户整夜咔嗒作响。

ravage.example: The storm ravaged the small village and left many families without homes.
ravage.exampleZh: 暴风雨摧毁了这个小村庄，使许多家庭无家可归。

rave.example: The young fans rave about the singer's new song.
rave.exampleZh: 年轻粉丝们对这位歌手的新歌狂热赞扬。

raven.example: A big black raven sat on the old tree and looked at us.
raven.exampleZh: 一只黑色的大渡鸦停在老树上，看着我们。

ravenous.example: After the long hike, the hungry boys were ravenous and ate everything on the table.
ravenous.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，那些饥饿的男孩饿极了，把桌上的东西全都吃光了。

ravish.example: The beautiful music ravished her heart and she forgot everything around her.
ravish.exampleZh: 美妙的音乐令她心醉，她忘记了周围的一切。

raw.example: The raw meat must be cooked well before you eat it.
raw.exampleZh: 生肉必须彻底煮熟后才能吃。

rawhide.example: The cowboy used rawhide to make a strong rope for his horse.
rawhide.exampleZh: 牛仔用生皮为他的马做了一根结实的绳子。

ray.example: A ray of sunlight came through the window and lit the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一束阳光透过窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

razor.example: My father shaves his face with a sharp razor every morning.
razor.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上都用一把锋利的剃刀刮脸。

reach.example: We reached the top of the hill before the sun went down.
reach.exampleZh: 我们在太阳落山前到达了山顶。

react.example: When she heard the good news, she did not react at all.
react.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她一点反应也没有。

reaction.example: Her reaction to the news was very calm and quiet.
reaction.exampleZh: 她对这个消息的反应非常平静。

read.example: I read a good book about animals every night before bed.
read.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读一本关于动物的好书。

reader.example: This book is easy to read, so every reader will enjoy it.
reader.exampleZh: 这本书很容易读，所以每个读者都会喜欢它。

readily.example: She readily agreed to help us with the difficult task.
readily.exampleZh: 她乐意地答应帮我们完成这项困难的任务。

reading.example: My reading improves when I spend twenty minutes with a good book each night.
reading.exampleZh: 每天晚上花二十分钟读一本好书，我的阅读能力就会提高。

ready.example: Dinner is ready, so please come to the table and sit down.
ready.exampleZh: 晚饭准备好了，请到餐桌旁坐下。

real.example: The story is about a real boy who lives in a small town.
real.exampleZh: 这个故事讲的是一个住在小镇上的真实男孩。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan that we can actually finish this year.
realistic.exampleZh: 我们需要一个切实可行的计划，能在今年真正完成。

reality.example: The reality of the job is harder than he expected.
reality.exampleZh: 这份工作的实际情况比他预想的更难。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until I saw the clock.
realize.exampleZh: 直到看到时钟，我才意识到已经这么晚了。

realm.example: Science fiction often explores the realm of new technology and space travel.
realm.exampleZh: 科幻小说常常探索新技术和太空旅行这一领域。

reap.example: Farmers reap the rice in autumn and sell it at the market.
reap.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割稻谷，然后拿到市场上卖。

rear.example: She sat in the rear seat of the car with her little son.
rear.exampleZh: 她和年幼的儿子坐在汽车的后排座位上。

reason.example: She gave a good reason for being late to class today.
reason.exampleZh: 她为今天上课迟到给出了一个充分的理由。

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for more time to finish the work.
reasonable.exampleZh: 要求更多时间来完成这项工作是合理的。

rebel.example: The young rebel refused to follow the old rules.
rebel.exampleZh: 那个年轻的反叛者拒绝遵守旧规则。

rebellion.example: The king sent soldiers to stop the rebellion in the north.
rebellion.exampleZh: 国王派兵去镇压北方的叛乱。

rebound.example: After the long fall, the ball will rebound and prices may rebound too.
rebound.exampleZh: 经过长时间下跌后，球会反弹，价格也可能回升。

recall.example: I cannot recall where I put my keys this morning.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起来今天早上把钥匙放在哪里了。

recede.example: The flood water began to recede after the heavy rain stopped.
recede.exampleZh: 暴雨停止后，洪水开始退去。

receipt.example: Please keep the receipt in case you want to return the shoes.
receipt.exampleZh: 请保留收据，以便你想退鞋时使用。

receive.example: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
receive.exampleZh: 我每周都会收到朋友的一封信。

recent.example: In recent years, many people have started to work from home.
recent.exampleZh: 近年来，许多人开始在家工作。

reception.example: The new hotel has a large reception area for guests.
reception.exampleZh: 这家新酒店有一个很大的客人接待区。

receptor.example: The doctor said these cells have a receptor that feels heat.
receptor.exampleZh: 医生说这些细胞有一种能感知热量的受体。

recession.example: The country lost many jobs during the recession last year.
recession.exampleZh: 去年经济衰退期间，这个国家失去了许多工作岗位。

recipe.example: My mother gave me her secret recipe for making apple cake.
recipe.exampleZh: 我妈妈把她做苹果蛋糕的秘方给了我。

recipient.example: The recipient of the letter was very happy to read it.
recipient.exampleZh: 这封信的收件人读到它时非常高兴。

reciprocal.example: The two countries signed a reciprocal agreement to share weather data.
reciprocal.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项共享气象数据的互惠协议。

recite.example: Every morning the students recite a short poem in front of the class.
recite.exampleZh: 每天早上学生们都在全班面前背诵一首短诗。

reckless.example: His reckless driving put everyone on the road in danger.
reckless.exampleZh: 他鲁莽的驾驶让路上的每个人都身处危险。

reckon.example: I reckon we will finish the work before six today.
reckon.exampleZh: 我估计我们今天六点前能完成这项工作。

reclaim.example: The city hopes to reclaim the old factory site and turn it into a park.
reclaim.exampleZh: 市政府希望回收利用这块旧厂址，把它改建成一座公园。

recognize.example: I did not recognize him at first because he looked very different.
recognize.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出他，因为他看起来大不一样了。

recoil.example: She felt the gun recoil against her shoulder and took a step back.
recoil.exampleZh: 她感到枪在肩上产生后坐力，于是后退了一步。

recollect.example: I cannot recollect where I put my keys last night.
recollect.exampleZh: 我想不起来昨晚把钥匙放在哪里了。

recommend.example: I recommend this book to anyone who wants to learn English.
recommend.exampleZh: 我把这本书推荐给任何想学英语的人。

reconcile.example: They met again to reconcile their differences after the long argument.
reconcile.exampleZh: 经过长时间的争论，他们再次见面以调和彼此的分歧。

reconsider.example: We should reconsider our plan before we start the new project.
reconsider.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们应该重新考虑一下我们的计划。

record.example: She keeps a record of all her daily expenses in this small notebook.
record.exampleZh: 她在这个小本子里记录每天的所有开销。

recover.example: It took him three weeks to recover from the flu.
recover.exampleZh: 他花了三周时间才从流感中康复。

recovery.example: Her recovery after the long illness was slow but steady.
recovery.exampleZh: 她在久病之后的恢复虽然缓慢，但很稳定。

recreate.example: The children recreate in the park after school every day.
recreate.exampleZh: 孩子们每天放学后在公园里消遣娱乐。

recruit.example: The company plans to recruit more young people this year.
recruit.exampleZh: 公司计划今年招募更多年轻人。

rectangle.example: The teacher drew a long rectangle on the board for the math lesson.
rectangle.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一个长方形，用来上数学课。

rectify.example: The manager promised to rectify the mistakes in the report before Friday.
rectify.exampleZh: 经理承诺在周五之前纠正报告中的错误。

recur.example: The same problem may recur if we do not fix the system.
recur.exampleZh: 如果我们不修复这个系统，同样的问题可能会再次发生。

recurrence.example: The doctor said the cancer has a low chance of recurrence after treatment.
recurrence.exampleZh: 医生说治疗后癌症复发的可能性很低。

recycle.example: We recycle old paper and plastic bottles at school every week.
recycle.exampleZh: 我们每周在学校回收旧纸张和塑料瓶。

red.example: She has a red bag and wears red shoes to school every day.
red.exampleZh: 她有一个红色的包，每天穿红色的鞋去学校。

reddent.example: The reddent sky above the hills warned us that evening was near.
reddent.exampleZh: 山丘上方泛红的天空提醒我们傍晚将至。

redeem.example: He worked hard to redeem his mistake and win back our trust.
redeem.exampleZh: 他努力工作来弥补自己的错误，并重新赢得我们的信任。

reduce.example: We must reduce the amount of waste we produce every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们必须减少每天产生的垃圾量。

redundant.example: This extra step is redundant and makes the whole process slower.
redundant.exampleZh: 这个多余的步骤让整个过程变得更慢。

refer.example: You can refer to the dictionary when you do not know a word.
refer.exampleZh: 当你不认识某个单词时，可以查阅词典。

referee.example: The referee stopped the game when a player fell down.
referee.exampleZh: 一名球员摔倒时，裁判中止了比赛。

refine.example: The team will refine the plan before the meeting next week.
refine.exampleZh: 团队会在下周会议前完善这个计划。

reflect.example: The calm lake can reflect the trees and the sky clearly.
reflect.exampleZh: 平静的湖面能清晰地映出树木和天空。

reflection.example: The reflection of the mountains in the lake was very beautiful.
reflection.exampleZh: 群山在湖中的倒影非常美丽。

reform.example: The new leader promised to reform the old education system soon.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺很快改革旧的教育制度。

refrain.example: Please refrain from smoking in the small room where the children sleep.
refrain.exampleZh: 请不要在孩子们睡觉的那个小房间里吸烟。

refresh.example: A short break and a cup of tea will refresh you.
refresh.exampleZh: 短暂休息并喝杯茶会让你恢复精力。

refuge.example: The old church became a refuge for the whole family during the storm.
refuge.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间，那座古老的教堂成了全家的避难所。

refugee.example: The refugee family arrived at the camp with very little food or clothing.
refugee.exampleZh: 这户难民家庭到达营地时几乎没带食物和衣物。

refund.example: I asked the store to refund my money for the broken toy.
refund.exampleZh: 我要求商店退还我买这个坏玩具的钱。

refuse.example: He refused the extra money because he wanted to finish the work himself.
refuse.exampleZh: 他拒绝了额外的钱，因为他想自己完成这项工作。

refute.example: She used clear facts to refute his argument in the meeting.
refute.exampleZh: 她在会议上用清楚的事实反驳了他的观点。

regard.example: Many people regard him as a kind and honest friend.
regard.exampleZh: 很多人把他视为一位善良且诚实的朋友。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding your plan for next week.
regarding.exampleZh: 关于你下周的计划，我有个问题。

regime.example: The new regime promised to improve the lives of ordinary people.
regime.exampleZh: 新政权承诺改善普通人的生活。

region.example: This region is famous for its tea and beautiful mountains.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以茶叶和美丽的山峦而闻名。

register.example: You must register at the front desk before you can enter the building.
register.exampleZh: 你必须先在前台登记，然后才能进入大楼。

regress.example: Without practice, his English skills began to regress.
regress.exampleZh: 由于缺乏练习，他的英语能力开始倒退。

regret.example: I regret not studying harder when I was in school.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔上学时没有更努力学习。

regular.example: We have a regular meeting every Monday morning at nine.
regular.exampleZh: 我们每周一早上九点开例行会议。

regulate.example: Teachers regulate the use of phones in the classroom during tests.
regulate.exampleZh: 老师会在考试期间管控教室里手机的使用。

regulation.example: The new regulation requires all drivers to wear seat belts.
regulation.exampleZh: 新规定要求所有司机系安全带。

rehearsal.example: The band has one more rehearsal before the big show on Friday.
rehearsal.exampleZh: 乐队在周五的大型演出前还有一次排练。

rehearse.example: The students will rehearse the play in the school hall this afternoon.
rehearse.exampleZh: 学生们今天下午将在学校礼堂排练这部戏剧。

reign.example: The queen's reign lasted for forty years and brought peace to the land.
reign.exampleZh: 这位女王的统治持续了四十年，为这片土地带来了和平。

reinforce.example: Good friends can reinforce your confidence when you feel unsure.
reinforce.exampleZh: 好朋友能在你不自信时增强你的信心。

reject.example: The manager will reject the plan because it costs too much money.
reject.exampleZh: 经理会拒绝这个计划，因为它花费太多钱。

rejoice.example: We all rejoice when the old friends come home for the holiday.
rejoice.exampleZh: 当老朋友回家过节时，我们都很高兴。

relate.example: I can relate to his story because I had a similar experience last year.
relate.exampleZh: 我能认同他的故事，因为我去年也有过类似的经历。

relation.example: The relation between the two countries is now much better.
relation.exampleZh: 这两个国家之间的关系现在好多了。

relationship.example: She has a good relationship with her parents and her teachers.
relationship.exampleZh: 她和父母以及老师的关系都很好。

relative.example: My relatives often visit us on weekends and we eat together.
relative.exampleZh: 我的亲戚们常在周末来看我们，我们一起吃饭。

relax.example: You should relax and take a short break after work.
relax.exampleZh: 下班后你应该放松一下，休息一会儿。

release.example: The band will release their new album next Friday.
release.exampleZh: 乐队将于下周五发行他们的新专辑。

relevant.example: Please give me only the relevant facts about this problem.
relevant.exampleZh: 请只给我关于这个问题的相关事实。

reliance.example: Our daily life shows a growing reliance on smartphones and the internet.
reliance.exampleZh: 我们的日常生活显示出对智能手机和互联网日益增长的依赖。

relic.example: This old temple is a relic of a time long gone.
relic.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙是早已逝去的时代的遗物。

relief.example: The medicine gave her some relief from the pain.
relief.exampleZh: 这种药使她的疼痛有所缓解。

relieve.example: These simple pills can relieve your headache quickly and safely.
relieve.exampleZh: 这些简单的药片能快速安全地缓解你的头痛。

religion.example: My grandmother follows a religion that teaches her to be kind to everyone.
religion.exampleZh: 我的祖母信奉一种教导她对每个人都要友善的宗教。

religious.example: My grandmother is a very religious person and goes to church every Sunday.
religious.exampleZh: 我的祖母是一个非常虔诚的人，每个星期天都去教堂。

rely.example: You can rely on her to finish the work on time.
rely.exampleZh: 你可以依靠她按时完成这项工作。

remain.example: Only a few old friends remain in the small village today.
remain.exampleZh: 如今，这个小村庄里只剩下几个老朋友了。

remainder.example: The remainder of the cake was kept in the fridge.
remainder.exampleZh: 剩下的蛋糕被放进了冰箱里。

remains.example: The remains of an old stone wall are still visible near the river.
remains.exampleZh: 河边仍能看到一堵古老石墙的遗迹。

remark.example: He made a rude remark about my new haircut.
remark.exampleZh: 他对我的新发型说了一句粗鲁的评论。

remarkable.example: She has a remarkable ability to remember names and faces.
remarkable.exampleZh: 她有着记住名字和面孔的非凡能力。

remedy.example: There is no easy remedy for this problem, so we must work together.
remedy.exampleZh: 这个问题没有简单的补救办法，所以我们必须共同努力。

remember.example: I always remember my mother's birthday and call her every year.
remember.exampleZh: 我总是记得妈妈的生日，每年都给她打电话。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tonight.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我今晚给妈妈打电话。

reminiscent.example: The old song is reminiscent of my happy school days.
reminiscent.exampleZh: 这首歌让我想起快乐的校园时光。

remit.example: Please remit the money to my bank account before Friday.
remit.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把钱汇到我的银行账户。

remote.example: He works in a remote village far from any big city.
remote.exampleZh: 他在一个远离任何大城市的偏僻村庄工作。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter the room.

render.example: The judge will render a decision after hearing both sides of the case.
render.exampleZh: 法官在听取双方陈述后会作出裁决。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before Friday.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在星期五之前续借我的图书馆书籍。

renounce.example: She decided to renounce her old job and start a new life.
renounce.exampleZh: 她决定放弃旧工作，开始新的生活。

renovate.example: They plan to renovate the old school building next spring.
renovate.exampleZh: 他们计划明年春天翻新那栋旧校舍。

renown.example: The old doctor won great renown for his skill and kindness.
renown.exampleZh: 这位老医生因其医术和善良赢得了很大的名望。

rent.example: We pay rent every month for our small apartment.
rent.exampleZh: 我们每个月为我们的小公寓付租金。

repair.example: My father can repair the old bike in just one hour.
repair.exampleZh: 我父亲能在一小时内修好这辆旧自行车。

repay.example: I will repay the money to my friend next month.
repay.exampleZh: 我下个月会把钱还给我的朋友。

repeal.example: The new government plans to repeal the old tax law next year.
repeal.exampleZh: 新政府计划明年废除这项旧税法。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so everyone can hear it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复这个问题，让大家都能听到。

repel.example: The strong smell of the old fish can repel most hungry animals.
repel.exampleZh: 那条旧鱼的强烈气味能击退大多数饥饿的动物。

repetition.example: Practice and repetition help you learn new words faster.
repetition.exampleZh: 练习和重复能帮助你更快地学会新单词。

replace.example: Please replace the old battery with a new one.

reply.example: She did not reply to my email, so I called her later.
reply.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我后来给她打了电话。

report.example: She will report the good news to her parents after school.
report.exampleZh: 她放学后会把好消息报告给她的父母。

represent.example: These three colors represent the main ideas of our school project.
represent.exampleZh: 这三种颜色代表我们学校项目的主要理念。

representative.example: Our class representative will speak to the teacher about the new rules.
representative.exampleZh: 我们班的代表将就新规定和老师谈一谈。

repress.example: She tried hard to repress her anger during the meeting.
repress.exampleZh: 她在会议上努力压抑自己的怒火。

reproduce.example: Many birds reproduce in spring when the weather becomes warm and food is easy to find.
reproduce.exampleZh: 许多鸟类在春天繁殖，那时天气变暖，食物也容易找到。

reptile.example: A snake is a reptile that moves along the ground without legs.
reptile.exampleZh: 蛇是一种没有腿、沿地面爬行的爬行动物。

republic.example: The country became a republic after the war and elected its first president.
republic.exampleZh: 这个国家在战后成为共和国，并选举了第一任总统。

reputation.example: His good reputation helped him get the job at the new company.
reputation.exampleZh: 他良好的名声帮助他在新公司得到了这份工作。

request.example: She made a polite request for more time to finish the work.
request.exampleZh: 她礼貌地请求多给一些时间来完成这项工作。

require.example: Good jobs require hard work and a little patience.
require.exampleZh: 好工作需要努力工作和一点耐心。

rescue.example: Firefighters rescued two children from the burning house last night.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员昨晚从着火的房子里救出了两个孩子。

research.example: She did a lot of research before she bought her first car.
research.exampleZh: 在买第一辆车之前，她做了大量研究。

resemble.example: These two brothers resemble each other in both looks and voice.
resemble.exampleZh: 这两兄弟在外貌和声音上都很相似。

resent.example: She still resents him for leaving without saying goodbye that night.
resent.exampleZh: 她仍然怨恨他那晚不告而别。

reservation.example: I have a reservation for two at the restaurant tonight.
reservation.exampleZh: 我今晚在那家餐厅预订了两个座位。

reserve.example: I would like to reserve a table for two people tonight.
reserve.exampleZh: 我想预订今晚一张两人桌。

reservoir.example: The city gets most of its drinking water from a large reservoir.
reservoir.exampleZh: 这座城市的饮用水大部分来自一座大型水库。

reside.example: They reside in a small house near the river.
reside.exampleZh: 他们居住在河边的一所小房子里。

residence.example: Their new residence is a small house near the river.
residence.exampleZh: 他们的新住宅是河边的一栋小房子。

resident.example: She is a resident of this small town and works at the local hospital.
resident.exampleZh: 她是这个小镇的居民，在当地医院工作。

resign.example: He decided to resign from his job because the pay was too low.
resign.exampleZh: 因为工资太低，他决定辞去这份工作。

resist.example: I cannot resist the sweet smell of fresh bread in the morning.
resist.exampleZh: 我无法抗拒早晨新鲜面包的甜香。

resolve.example: She resolved the problem quickly and promised to work harder.
resolve.exampleZh: 她迅速解决了这个问题，并承诺会更加努力。

resort.example: When the problem got worse, they had to resort to asking a lawyer for help.
resort.exampleZh: 问题变得更严重时，他们不得不求助律师。

resource.example: We must use our time and money as limited resources.
resource.exampleZh: 我们必须把时间和金钱当作有限的资源来使用。

respect.example: We should respect our teachers and listen to their advice.
respect.exampleZh: 我们应该尊敬老师，听取他们的建议。

respective.example: The two students went back to their respective homes after school.
respective.exampleZh: 放学后，这两名学生各自回了家。

respond.example: She did not respond to my email for three days.
respond.exampleZh: 她三天没有回复我的邮件。

response.example: Her quick response to my question surprised everyone in the room.
response.exampleZh: 她对我问题的迅速回答让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

responsibility.example: My father taught me that taking responsibility for my own mistakes is important.
responsibility.exampleZh: 我父亲教导我，为自己的错误承担责任很重要。

responsible.example: She is responsible for the new project at our office.
responsible.exampleZh: 她负责我们办公室的新项目。

rest.example: After a long walk, we sat down to rest under a big tree.
rest.exampleZh: 走了很长一段路后，我们坐下来在一棵大树下休息。

restless.example: The children grew restless after waiting an hour for the bus.
restless.exampleZh: 孩子们等了一个小时公交车后变得焦躁不安。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old church next year.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们明年将修复这座古老的教堂。

restrain.example: She tried hard to restrain her anger during the meeting.
restrain.exampleZh: 她努力在会议期间克制自己的怒火。

restrict.example: The school restricts phone use during class to help students focus.
restrict.exampleZh: 学校限制课堂上使用手机，以帮助学生集中注意力。

result.example: The result of the test made everyone very happy.
result.exampleZh: 这次测试的结果让每个人都很高兴。

resume.example: She will resume her studies next week and look for a new job.
resume.exampleZh: 她下周将继续学业，并寻找一份新工作。

retain.example: The old box can retain heat and keep the food warm.
retain.exampleZh: 这个旧箱子能保温，让食物保持温热。

retaliate.example: If he hits you, do not retaliate and tell the teacher instead.
retaliate.exampleZh: 如果他打你，不要报复，而是去告诉老师。

retard.example: Heavy rain may retard the growth of young plants.
retard.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍幼苗的生长。

retell.example: Please retell the story to your classmates in your own words.
retell.exampleZh: 请用你自己的话把这个故事复述给同学们听。

retention.example: The retention of water in the soil helps plants grow in dry weather.
retention.exampleZh: 土壤中水分的保持有助于植物在干燥天气中生长。

retire.example: My father will retire from his job next year after forty years.
retire.exampleZh: 我父亲在工作四十年后将于明年退休。

retort.example: She retorted that the plan would cost far too much money.
retort.exampleZh: 她反驳说这个计划要花太多钱。

retreat.example: The soldiers had to retreat quickly when the enemy attacked from the north.
retreat.exampleZh: 敌人从北方进攻时，士兵们不得不迅速撤退。

retrieve.example: I went back to the classroom to retrieve my lost notebook.
retrieve.exampleZh: 我回到教室去取回我丢失的笔记本。

return.example: She will return the book to the library tomorrow morning.
return.exampleZh: 她明天早上会把书还给图书馆。

reunite.example: The family will reunite at the airport after many years apart.
reunite.exampleZh: 分开多年后，这家人将在机场重聚。

reveal.example: The new study may reveal the truth about this old story.
reveal.exampleZh: 这项新研究可能揭示这个古老故事背后的真相。

revel.example: The children reveled in the first snow of the winter.
revel.exampleZh: 孩子们陶醉在冬天的第一场雪中。

revenge.example: He wanted revenge after his brother was hurt in the fight.
revenge.exampleZh: 他哥哥在打斗中受伤后，他想要报复。

revenue.example: The company's revenue grew quickly last year after it launched two new products.
revenue.exampleZh: 公司去年推出两款新产品后，收入增长很快。

reverberate.example: The sound of the bell reverberated through the empty hall for a long time.
reverberate.exampleZh: 钟声在空荡的大厅里回荡了很长时间。

reverse.example: The new rule had the reverse effect and made things worse.
reverse.exampleZh: 这条新规定产生了相反的效果，使情况变得更糟。

review.example: I will review my notes before the English test tomorrow morning.
review.exampleZh: 明天早上英语考试前，我会复习我的笔记。

revise.example: I need to revise my report before the meeting tomorrow.
revise.exampleZh: 我需要在明天开会前修改我的报告。

revive.example: The old town hopes to revive its markets and attract more young visitors.
revive.exampleZh: 这座老城希望复兴它的集市，吸引更多年轻游客。

revoke.example: The school decided to revoke his library card after he lost three books.
revoke.exampleZh: 在他丢失三本书后，学校决定注销他的借书卡。

revolt.example: The poor farmers decided to revolt against the cruel king.
revolt.exampleZh: 贫穷的农民们决定反抗残暴的国王。

revolution.example: The invention of the internet caused a big revolution in how people live.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网的发明在人们的生活方式上引发了一场巨大的变革。

revolve.example: The earth revolves around the sun once every year.
revolve.exampleZh: 地球每年绕太阳公转一周。

reward.example: My parents gave me a reward for passing the exam.
reward.exampleZh: 我父母因为我通过了考试而给了我一份奖励。

rhetoric.example: His speech was full of rhetoric but offered no real solutions.
rhetoric.exampleZh: 他的演讲充满华丽辞藻，却没有提出真正的解决办法。

rhyme.example: This short poem has a clear rhyme at the end of each line.
rhyme.exampleZh: 这首短诗在每行末尾都有一个清晰的韵。

rhythm.example: I love the rhythm of this song because it makes me want to dance.
rhythm.exampleZh: 我喜欢这首歌的节奏，因为它让我想跳舞。

rib.example: The doctor said I broke a rib when I fell off my bike.
rib.exampleZh: 医生说我从自行车上摔下来时摔断了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon in her hair before the party.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她在聚会前把一条红丝带系在头发上。

rice.example: We eat rice with vegetables and fish every day.
rice.exampleZh: 我们每天都吃米饭配蔬菜和鱼。

rich.example: The rich soil in this valley helps farmers grow many healthy vegetables.
rich.exampleZh: 这个山谷里富饶的土壤帮助农民种出许多健康的蔬菜。

rid.example: We must find a way to rid the house of mice.
rid.exampleZh: 我们必须想办法把房子里的老鼠清除掉。

riddle.example: The old man asked us a riddle that no one could answer.
riddle.exampleZh: 老人给我们出了一个没人能答上来的谜语。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day with my sister.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天和妹妹一起骑自行车去学校。

ridge.example: We walked along the narrow ridge and saw the whole valley below.
ridge.exampleZh: 我们沿着狭窄的山脊行走，看到了下方的整个山谷。

ridicule.example: The other kids ridiculed him for wearing that old hat to school.
ridicule.exampleZh: 其他孩子因为他戴着那顶旧帽子去学校而嘲笑他。

ridiculous.example: It is ridiculous to blame the weather for your own bad plan.
ridiculous.exampleZh: 把你自己糟糕的计划归咎于天气，这是很荒谬的。

rifle.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle carefully before the long march.
rifle.exampleZh: 长途行军前，士兵仔细地擦拭了他的步枪。

right.example: You are right, and everyone has the right to choose their own path.
right.exampleZh: 你是对的，每个人都有权利选择自己的道路。

rigid.example: His rigid rules make the small team feel tired and unhappy.
rigid.exampleZh: 他死板的规矩让这个小团队感到疲惫和不快。

rigorous.example: The teacher is rigorous about homework and checks every answer carefully.
rigorous.exampleZh: 这位老师对作业要求很严格，会仔细检查每一个答案。

rim.example: She put her cup on the rim of the sink.
rim.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在水槽的边缘上。

ring.example: She wears a gold ring and often calls her mother every day.
ring.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚金戒指，并且每天经常给母亲打电话。

riot.example: The city was quiet again after the riot ended last night.
riot.exampleZh: 昨晚的骚乱结束后，城市又恢复了平静。

rip.example: The strong wind will rip the old flag into small pieces.
rip.exampleZh: 强风会把那面旧旗撕成小碎片。

ripe.example: The apples on the tree are ripe and ready to eat.
ripe.exampleZh: 树上的苹果已经成熟，可以吃了。

ripple.example: A small stone fell into the lake and made a ripple spread across the water.
ripple.exampleZh: 一块小石头落进湖里，激起一圈涟漪在水面上扩散开来。

rise.example: The sun rises early in summer, and prices rise with it.
rise.exampleZh: 夏天太阳升得早，物价也随之上涨。

risk.example: Driving too fast in the rain is a big risk to everyone.
risk.exampleZh: 在雨中开得太快对每个人来说都是很大的风险。

ritual.example: Morning coffee is a small ritual I never skip.
ritual.exampleZh: 早晨喝咖啡是我从不省略的小仪式。

rival.example: She is my biggest rival at work, but we still respect each other.
rival.exampleZh: 她是我工作上最大的竞争对手，但我们仍然互相尊重。

river.example: The river runs through our town and many children swim in it in summer.
river.exampleZh: 这条河穿过我们的小镇，夏天许多孩子在里面游泳。

road.example: The road to the village is narrow and very quiet at night.
road.exampleZh: 通往村庄的路很窄，夜里非常安静。

roam.example: We like to roam around the old town on quiet Sunday mornings.
roam.exampleZh: 安静的周日早晨，我们喜欢在古镇里四处闲逛。

roar.example: The lion began to roar loudly when the crowd came near its cage.
roar.exampleZh: 当人群靠近笼子时，狮子开始大声吼叫。

roast.example: My mother will roast a chicken for dinner and then roast vegetables too.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈会为晚餐烤一只鸡，然后再烤些蔬菜。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank near my house.
rob.exampleZh: 两个男人试图抢劫我家附近的那家小银行。

robe.example: The king wore a long red robe during the ceremony.
robe.exampleZh: 仪式上，国王穿着一件长长的红色长袍。

robot.example: The factory uses a robot to do simple and repeated jobs.
robot.exampleZh: 这家工厂用机器人来做简单而重复的工作。

robust.example: The old bridge is still robust enough to carry heavy trucks.
robust.exampleZh: 这座老桥依然足够结实，能够承载重型卡车。

rock.example: She likes to rock the baby gently while singing soft rock songs.
rock.exampleZh: 她喜欢一边轻轻摇着宝宝，一边唱柔和的摇滚歌曲。

rocket.example: Prices rocket when demand is high and supplies are low.
rocket.exampleZh: 需求高而供应少时，价格会猛涨。

rod.example: He used a long wooden rod to reach the ball.
rod.exampleZh: 他用一根长木杆够到了那个球。

role.example: Teachers play an important role in helping students learn and grow.
role.exampleZh: 老师在帮助学生学习与成长方面发挥着重要作用。

roll.example: The ball rolled down the hill and stopped near the big tree.
roll.exampleZh: 球滚下山坡，停在那棵大树附近。

romance.example: Their romance began in a small coffee shop near the university.
romance.exampleZh: 他们的爱情故事始于大学附近的一家小咖啡店。

romantic.example: She loves romantic movies with happy endings and beautiful music.
romantic.exampleZh: 她喜欢有幸福结局和美妙音乐的浪漫电影。

roof.example: The cat sat on the roof and looked at the birds.
roof.exampleZh: 猫坐在屋顶上看着鸟儿。

room.example: There is not enough room in this small car for five people.
room.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车里没有足够的空间坐五个人。

root.example: The tree has deep roots, and its roots hold the soil well.
root.exampleZh: 这棵树有很深的根，它的根能很好地固定土壤。

rope.example: He used a long rope to pull the small boat to the shore.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根长绳把小船拉到岸边。

rose.example: She gave me a red rose on my birthday.
rose.exampleZh: 她在我生日那天送了我一朵红玫瑰。

roster.example: The teacher checked the roster to see who was absent today.
roster.exampleZh: 老师查看了花名册，看今天谁缺席。

rotate.example: Farmers rotate their crops each year to keep the soil healthy.
rotate.exampleZh: 农民每年轮作作物，以保持土壤健康。

rough.example: The rough road made the old car shake a lot.
rough.exampleZh: 这条粗糙的路让那辆旧车颠得很厉害。

round.example: The children sat in a round circle and sang songs together.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

rouse.example: The loud noise outside finally roused him from a deep sleep.
rouse.exampleZh: 外面的巨响终于把他从沉睡中唤醒。

route.example: We took a new route to school this morning.
route.exampleZh: 我们今天早上走了一条新路线去学校。

routine.example: Getting up early is part of my daily routine.
routine.exampleZh: 早起是我日常常规的一部分。

row.example: We sat in the front row and watched the boats row slowly across the lake.
row.exampleZh: 我们坐在前排，看着船只缓缓划过湖面。

royal.example: The royal family lives in that big old palace near the river.
royal.exampleZh: 王室一家住在河附近那座又大又旧的宫殿里。

rub.example: Please rub the cream on your hands before you go to bed.
rub.exampleZh: 睡前请把药膏揉抹在手上。

rubble.example: After the earthquake, workers searched the rubble for survivors.
rubble.exampleZh: 地震后，救援人员在瓦砾中寻找幸存者。

ruby.example: She wore a ring with a small red ruby in the center.
ruby.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚中间镶着一颗小红宝石的戒指。

rudimentary.example: He has only a rudimentary knowledge of French, but he keeps practicing every day.
rudimentary.exampleZh: 他只有一些基础的法语知识，但他每天坚持练习。

rug.example: My grandmother put a small rug beside the bed.
rug.exampleZh: 我奶奶在床边放了一块小地毯。

rugged.example: The rugged road was hard to walk on but we kept going.
rugged.exampleZh: 那条崎岖的路很难走，但我们继续前进。

ruin.example: The heavy rain ruined our picnic and forced everyone to go home early.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨破坏了我们的野餐，迫使大家提早回家。

rule.example: The teacher explained the new rule to the class in simple words.
rule.exampleZh: 老师用简单的话向全班解释了新规则。

ruler.example: The ruler of this small country lives in a very old castle.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国的统治者住在一座非常古老的城堡里。

rumor.example: A rumor about the new teacher spread quickly through the whole school.
rumor.exampleZh: 关于新老师的谣言迅速传遍了整个学校。

run.example: She runs a small coffee shop near the station every morning.
run.exampleZh: 她每天早上在车站附近经营一家小咖啡店。

runway.example: The plane slowed down as soon as the wheels touched the runway.
runway.exampleZh: 轮子一接触跑道，飞机就减速了。

rural.example: My grandparents live in a quiet rural area with many farms.
rural.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在一个有许多农场的安静乡村地区。

rush.example: Every morning people rush to catch the train during the busy rush hour.
rush.exampleZh: 每天早上，人们在繁忙的高峰时段匆忙赶火车。

rust.example: The old bicycle was covered in rust after many years in the rain.
rust.exampleZh: 那辆旧自行车在雨中放了多年，上面布满了锈。

rustle.example: Leaves rustle softly in the wind, and the children listen.
rustle.exampleZh: 树叶在风中轻轻沙沙作响，孩子们侧耳倾听。

ruthless.example: The ruthless king gave no food to the poor farmers.
ruthless.exampleZh: 那个无情的国王不给穷苦农民任何食物。

sabotage.example: The workers were blamed for the sabotage at the factory last night.
sabotage.exampleZh: 工人们被指责是昨晚工厂蓄意破坏事件的肇事者。

sabre.example: The soldier cleaned his sabre carefully after the long ride.
sabre.exampleZh: 长途骑行之后，士兵仔细地擦干净了他的马刀。

sack.example: The farmer put the potatoes into a large sack.
sack.exampleZh: 农民把土豆装进一个大麻袋里。

sacred.example: In many cultures, this old temple is a sacred place.
sacred.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，这座古老的寺庙是一个神圣的地方。

sacrifice.example: Parents often sacrifice their own time to give their children a better life.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 父母常常牺牲自己的时间来给孩子更好的生活。

sacrilege.example: Burning the old church was seen as a sacrilege by the whole town.
sacrilege.exampleZh: 烧毁那座古老的教堂被全镇人视为一种亵渎行为。

sacrosanct.example: In this small town, Sunday lunch with family is sacrosanct.
sacrosanct.exampleZh: 在这个小镇上，与家人共进周日午餐是神圣不可侵犯的。

sad.example: She felt sad when her best friend moved to another city.
sad.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友搬到另一个城市时，她感到很难过。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and rode away.
saddle.exampleZh: 他把马鞍放在马背上，然后骑马离开了。

safe.example: Keep your passport in a safe place when you travel.
safe.exampleZh: 旅行时请把护照放在安全的地方。

safety.example: Please follow the safety rules when you use the machines.
safety.exampleZh: 使用这些机器时，请遵守安全规则。

sag.example: The old rope began to sag under the heavy weight of the box.
sag.exampleZh: 旧绳子在箱子的重压下开始下沉。

saga.example: The old man told a long saga about his family's travels.
saga.exampleZh: 老人讲了一个关于他家族迁徙的长篇故事。

sagacious.example: The sagacious old farmer knew the storm would come early.
sagacious.exampleZh: 那位睿智的老农知道暴风雨会提前到来。

sagacity.example: Her sagacity helped the team avoid a costly mistake.
sagacity.exampleZh: 她的睿智帮助团队避免了一个代价高昂的错误。

sage.example: The sage old man shared his wisdom with the young villagers every morning.
sage.exampleZh: 那位睿智的老人每天早上都与年轻的村民们分享他的智慧。

sail.example: The small boat sailed across the blue lake with its white sail open.
sail.exampleZh: 小船张开白帆，驶过蓝色的湖面。

sailboat.example: The little sailboat moved slowly across the calm blue lake.
sailboat.exampleZh: 那只小帆船在平静的蓝色湖面上缓缓移动。

sailor.example: The old sailor told us a story about the sea.
sailor.exampleZh: 那位老水手给我们讲了一个关于大海的故事。

saint.example: My grandmother was a true saint who always helped the poor.
saint.exampleZh: 我的祖母是一位真正的圣人，她总是帮助穷人。

saintly.example: Her saintly patience with the noisy children amazed everyone in the room.
saintly.exampleZh: 她对吵闹的孩子们圣徒般的耐心让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

sake.example: For the sake of your health, you should stop smoking now.
sake.exampleZh: 为了你的健康，你现在应该戒烟。

salad.example: I make a fresh salad with tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber for lunch.
salad.exampleZh: 我午餐做了一份有西红柿、生菜和黄瓜的新鲜色拉。

salary.example: She spends part of her salary on books every month.
salary.exampleZh: 她每个月都花一部分薪水买书。

sale.example: The store has a big sale on shoes this weekend.
sale.exampleZh: 这家店这个周末鞋子大特价。

salient.example: The most salient feature of her plan is its low cost.
salient.exampleZh: 她的方案最显著的特点是成本低。

saline.example: Doctors gave him saline water to drink after he lost too much blood.
saline.exampleZh: 医生在他失血过多后给他喝盐水。

saliva.example: The dog left saliva on my hand after it licked me.
saliva.exampleZh: 那只狗舔了我之后，在我手上留下了唾液。

salmon.example: We ate fresh salmon with rice and vegetables for dinner last night.
salmon.exampleZh: 昨晚我们晚餐吃了新鲜三文鱼配米饭和蔬菜。

salon.example: She goes to the salon every month to get her hair cut.
salon.exampleZh: 她每个月都去美发厅剪头发。

salsa.example: We danced salsa at the party and ate chips with fresh salsa.
salsa.exampleZh: 我们在派对上跳萨尔萨舞，还吃了配新鲜萨尔萨辣酱的薯片。

salt.example: Please add some salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加一些盐。

salty.example: This soup is too salty for me, but my brother likes it.
salty.exampleZh: 这汤对我来说太咸了，但我弟弟喜欢。

salute.example: We salute the brave soldiers who protect our country every day.
salute.exampleZh: 我们向每天保卫我们国家的勇敢士兵致敬。

salvage.example: Divers tried to salvage the valuable cargo from the sunken ship.
salvage.exampleZh: 潜水员试图从沉船中打捞贵重的货物。

salvation.example: For the tired workers, a hot meal was a kind of salvation.
salvation.exampleZh: 对那些疲惫的工人来说，一顿热饭是一种拯救。

same.example: We go to the same school and we are in the same class.
same.exampleZh: 我们去同一所学校，而且在同一个班。

sample.example: The lab tested a small sample of water from the river.
sample.exampleZh: 实验室检测了从河里取的一小份水样。

sanction.example: The government decided to sanction the new plan after a long and careful debate.
sanction.exampleZh: 经过长时间而仔细的辩论后，政府决定批准这项新计划。

sanctuary.example: The old church became a sanctuary for people during the war.
sanctuary.exampleZh: 战争期间，那座古老的教堂成了人们的避难所。

sand.example: The children played in the warm sand for hours.
sand.exampleZh: 孩子们在温暖的沙子里玩了好几个小时。

sandal.example: She wears a pair of brown sandals when she walks on the beach.
sandal.exampleZh: 她在海滩上散步时穿着一双棕色的凉鞋。

sandwich.example: I made a ham sandwich and put it in my bag.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我做了一个火腿三明治，把它放进了包里。

sane.example: It is hard to stay sane when everything around you keeps changing.
sane.exampleZh: 当周围的一切不断变化时，人很难保持理智。

sanguine.example: She is sanguine about her chances of passing the exam next week.
sanguine.exampleZh: 她对下周通过考试的可能性很乐观。

sanitary.example: The kitchen looks clean and sanitary after we washed every table.
sanitary.exampleZh: 我们擦洗了每张桌子后，厨房看起来干净又卫生。

sanitation.example: Clean water and good sanitation help keep children healthy.
sanitation.exampleZh: 清洁的水和良好的卫生设施有助于孩子保持健康。

sap.example: The cold weather can sap your energy and make you feel tired.
sap.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会逐渐消耗你的精力，让你感到疲惫。

sarcasm.example: Her voice was full of sarcasm, but nobody in the room laughed.
sarcasm.exampleZh: 她的话里满是讽刺，但房间里没人笑。

sarcastic.example: She gave a sarcastic answer, and everyone in the room laughed.
sarcastic.exampleZh: 她给了一个讽刺的回答，屋里的每个人都笑了。

sardonic.example: She gave a sardonic smile and said nothing about my plan.
sardonic.exampleZh: 她讥讽地笑了笑，对我的计划什么也没说。

satellite.example: The satellite moves around the Earth and sends pictures back to us.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星围绕地球运行，并把图片传回给我们。

satire.example: His new book is a sharp satire about modern politics.
satire.exampleZh: 他的新书是一部关于现代政治的尖锐讽刺作品。

satisfaction.example: She smiled with great satisfaction after finishing all her work on time.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 她按时完成了所有工作，满意地笑了。

satisfactory.example: The test results were satisfactory, so the teacher let us move on.
satisfactory.exampleZh: 考试结果令人满意，所以老师让我们继续往下学。

satisfy.example: Does this answer satisfy your teacher's requirements for the project?
satisfy.exampleZh: 这个答案能满足老师对这项课题的要求吗？

saturate.example: Heavy rain will saturate the soil and fill the small holes with water.
saturate.exampleZh: 大雨会使土壤饱和，并让那些小洞里积满水。

sauce.example: She put a little sauce on the chicken and ate it.
sauce.exampleZh: 她在鸡肉上放了一点酱汁，然后吃了起来。

saucy.example: That saucy little boy smiled at me and ran away.
saucy.exampleZh: 那个调皮的小男孩冲我笑了笑就跑开了。

sausage.example: My mother cooks sausage with eggs for breakfast every Sunday morning.
sausage.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天早上都用香肠炒鸡蛋做早餐。

savage.example: The savage dog barked at everyone who came near the gate.
savage.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对每个靠近大门的人狂吠。

savanna.example: Many wild animals live on the savanna during the dry season.
savanna.exampleZh: 许多野生动物在旱季生活在热带草原上。

save.example: He works hard to save money and also save his family from worry.
save.exampleZh: 他努力工作存钱，也让家人免于担忧。

savings.example: She used her savings to buy a small car.
savings.exampleZh: 她用自己的存款买了一辆小汽车。

savior.example: The doctor was a savior to the small village during the flood.
savior.exampleZh: 洪水期间，那位医生成了这个小村庄的救星。

savor.example: She took a moment to savor the sweet taste of fresh bread.
savor.exampleZh: 她停下来细细品味新鲜面包的香甜滋味。

savvy.example: She is a savvy businesswoman who knows how to deal with difficult customers.
savvy.exampleZh: 她是一位精明的女商人，懂得如何应对难缠的顾客。

saw.example: I saw my father use a saw to cut the wood.
saw.exampleZh: 我看见我父亲用锯子锯木头。

say.example: People say this small town is very quiet at night.
say.exampleZh: 人们说这个小镇晚上很安静。

saying.example: My grandmother often uses an old saying to teach us about life.
saying.exampleZh: 我奶奶经常用一句古老的谚语教我们做人的道理。

scaffold.example: Workers put up a scaffold around the old building.
scaffold.exampleZh: 工人们在老楼周围搭起了脚手架。

scale.example: The scale of the problem surprised everyone at the meeting.
scale.exampleZh: 问题的规模让会上每个人都感到惊讶。

scan.example: She used her phone to scan the code before opening the door.
scan.exampleZh: 她开门前用手机扫描了二维码。

scandal.example: The scandal shocked the whole town and made him lose his job.
scandal.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻震惊了整个小镇，并使他失去了工作。

scant.example: We had scant time to finish the work before the store closed.
scant.exampleZh: 在商店关门前，我们几乎没有多少时间完成这项工作。

scar.example: The old scar on his arm still reminds him of that accident.
scar.exampleZh: 他手臂上的旧伤疤仍然让他想起那次事故。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in some parts of the world.
scarce.exampleZh: 在世界的一些地方，干净的水很稀缺。

scarcely.example: I could scarcely hear him over the noise of the traffic.
scarcely.exampleZh: 在车流的噪音中我几乎听不见他说话。

scarcity.example: The scarcity of clean water is a serious problem in this village.
scarcity.exampleZh: 清洁水的短缺是这个村庄的一个严重问题。

scare.example: The loud noise scared the little dog and it ran away.
scare.exampleZh: 巨大的响声吓到了那只小狗，它跑开了。

scarf.example: She wore a red scarf around her neck on the cold morning.
scarf.exampleZh: 寒冷的早晨，她脖子上围着一条红色的围巾。

scatter.example: The children scatter the seeds across the field before it rains.
scatter.exampleZh: 孩子们在下雨前把种子撒播到田地里。

scenario.example: We need to plan for the worst scenario before the project starts.
scenario.exampleZh: 我们需要在项目开始前为最坏的情景做好规划。

scene.example: The police closed the scene of the accident for two hours.
scene.exampleZh: 警察把事故现场封锁了两个小时。

scenery.example: The scenery along the river is very beautiful in autumn.
scenery.exampleZh: 秋天时沿河的风景非常美。

scent.example: The scent of fresh bread filled the small kitchen.
scent.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在小厨房里。

schedule.example: I will check my schedule and call you after lunch today.
schedule.exampleZh: 我会查看一下我的日程表，今天午饭后再给你打电话。

scheme.example: The police say the two men had a secret scheme to steal money.
scheme.exampleZh: 警方称这两名男子有一个偷钱的秘密阴谋。

scholar.example: He is a famous scholar who studies ancient Chinese history.
scholar.exampleZh: 他是一位研究中国古代史的著名学者。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study abroad next year.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她获得了明年出国留学的奖学金。

school.example: My little sister walks to school with her friends every morning.
school.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上和朋友们一起步行去学校。

science.example: She studies science at school and wants to become a teacher.
science.exampleZh: 她在学校学习理科，想成为一名教师。

scientific.example: We need a scientific way to solve this problem.
scientific.exampleZh: 我们需要用科学的方法来解决这个问题。

scientist.example: The scientist studies plants and animals in the forest near her home.
scientist.exampleZh: 这位科学家在她家附近的森林里研究植物和动物。

scissors.example: Please pass me the scissors on the table so I can cut this paper.
scissors.exampleZh: 请把桌上的剪刀递给我，我要剪这张纸。

scold.example: My mother scolded me for coming home late last night.
scold.exampleZh: 我妈妈因为我昨晚回家晚了而骂了我。

scoop.example: The young reporter got a big scoop about the new factory.
scoop.exampleZh: 那位年轻记者得到了关于新工厂的一条重大独家新闻。

scope.example: The new job gives me plenty of scope to learn new skills.
scope.exampleZh: 这份新工作给了我充足的空间去学习新技能。

score.example: He got a high score on the math test and played the score on the piano.
score.exampleZh: 他在数学考试中得了高分，还在钢琴上弹奏了这首乐谱。

scorn.example: She looked at his cheap gift with scorn and walked away.
scorn.exampleZh: 她轻蔑地看了一眼他廉价的礼物，然后走开了。

scour.example: She had to scour the dirty pot before she could cook dinner.
scour.exampleZh: 她得先把脏锅擦洗干净，然后才能做晚饭。

scout.example: The scout walked ahead of the group to find a safe path.
scout.exampleZh: 侦察员走在队伍前面，寻找一条安全的道路。

scowl.example: The old man scowled at the noisy children and shut the door.
scowl.exampleZh: 那位老人怒视着吵闹的孩子们，然后关上了门。

scramble.example: The children scramble up the small hill to watch the sunset.
scramble.exampleZh: 孩子们爬上山坡去看日落。

scrap.example: He kept every scrap of paper because he thought it might be useful someday.
scrap.exampleZh: 他把每一片废纸都留着，因为他觉得有一天它们可能派得上用场。

scrape.example: He had to scrape the old paint off the door before painting it again.
scrape.exampleZh: 他得先刮掉门上的旧漆，然后才能重新刷漆。

scratch.example: The cat likes to scratch the old chair with its sharp claws.
scratch.exampleZh: 那只猫喜欢用锋利的爪子抓那把旧椅子。

scream.example: She began to scream when she saw the snake in the grass.
scream.exampleZh: 她看到草地里的蛇时开始尖叫起来。

screen.example: The teacher used a screen to show the video to the class.
screen.exampleZh: 老师用屏幕给全班播放视频。

screw.example: Please screw the lid on the jar tightly before you put it away.
screw.exampleZh: 请在你把它收起来之前把罐子的盖子拧紧。

script.example: The actor read the script carefully before the first rehearsal.
script.exampleZh: 演员在第一次排练前仔细阅读了剧本。

scrub.example: I need to scrub the dirty floor before the guests arrive.
scrub.exampleZh: 在客人到来之前，我需要擦洗脏地板。

scrutiny.example: The plan is under close scrutiny by the city council.
scrutiny.exampleZh: 该计划正受到市议会的仔细审查。

sculpture.example: The museum has a beautiful sculpture of a horse in the garden.
sculpture.exampleZh: 博物馆的花园里有一座漂亮的马雕塑。

sea.example: The sea is very deep and blue, and many fish live in it.
sea.exampleZh: 大海又深又蓝，许多鱼生活在里面。

seal.example: The seal on the letter was already broken before I opened it.
seal.exampleZh: 我打开信之前，信上的封条就已经破损了。

seam.example: The water came through a small seam in the roof.
seam.exampleZh: 水从屋顶的一条小接缝处渗了进来。

search.example: The police searched the whole house for the missing money.
search.exampleZh: 警察搜查了整栋房子以寻找丢失的钱。

season.example: Summer is my favorite season, and I season the soup with salt.
season.exampleZh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节，我用盐给汤调味。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the movie starts.

second.example: Wait a second, I will second your idea at the second meeting.
second.exampleZh: 等一下，我会在第二次会议上支持你的想法。

secondary.example: In our school, history is a secondary subject for younger students.
secondary.exampleZh: 在我们学校，历史对低年级学生来说是一门次要科目。

secret.example: She kept her plan a secret from everyone until the very end.
secret.exampleZh: 她一直把自己的计划对所有人保密，直到最后一刻。

secretary.example: The secretary will answer the phone and take a message for you.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书会接电话并为你留言。

section.example: This section of the book explains how plants grow.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的这个部分讲解了植物如何生长。

sector.example: The service sector provides many jobs in our city.
sector.exampleZh: 服务部门在我们城市提供了许多就业岗位。

secure.example: Keep your password secure and do not share it with anyone.
secure.exampleZh: 请妥善保管你的密码，不要与任何人分享。

security.example: The bank keeps your money safe and gives you good security.
security.exampleZh: 银行妥善保管你的钱，并为你提供良好的安全保障。

sedate.example: The old library was a sedate place where people read quietly.
sedate.exampleZh: 那座古老的图书馆是个安静庄重的地方，人们都在那里静静地读书。

sedentary.example: A sedentary lifestyle is not good for your health.
sedentary.exampleZh: 久坐不动的生活方式对你的健康不利。

sediment.example: The river carries sediment downstream and leaves it on the riverbed.
sediment.exampleZh: 河流把沉积物带往下游，并将其留在河床上。

seduce.example: She tried to seduce him with sweet words and gifts.
seduce.exampleZh: 她试图用甜言蜜语和礼物来引诱他。

see.example: I can see the mountains clearly from my window every morning.
see.exampleZh: 每天早上我从窗户就能清楚地看见那些山。

seed.example: The farmer planted a small seed in the garden and waited for it to grow.
seed.exampleZh: 农民在花园里种下一颗小种子，等待它生长。

seedling.example: The farmer planted each seedling carefully in the wet soil.
seedling.exampleZh: 农民把每一株幼苗小心地种在湿润的土壤里。

seek.example: She went to the office to seek help from her new manager.
seek.exampleZh: 她去办公室向她的新经理寻求帮助。

seem.example: You seem very tired today after the long trip.
seem.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，你今天看起来很累。

segment.example: This segment of the road is closed while the workers repair it.
segment.exampleZh: 这段路正在封闭，工人们正在维修。

segregate.example: The old school used to segregate students by race many years ago.
segregate.exampleZh: 这所老学校多年前曾按种族隔离学生。

segregation.example: The old law required segregation of schools by race.
segregation.exampleZh: 旧法律要求学校按种族隔离。

seize.example: The police seized the drugs and arrested two men at the airport.
seize.exampleZh: 警察在机场没收了毒品，并逮捕了两名男子。

seizure.example: The police made a large seizure of illegal goods at the port yesterday.
seizure.exampleZh: 警方昨天在港口查获了大批非法货物。

seldom.example: I seldom drink coffee after dinner because it keeps me awake.
seldom.exampleZh: 我晚饭后很少喝咖啡，因为它让我睡不着。

select.example: Please select one book from this shelf for your class.
select.exampleZh: 请从书架上挑选一本书用于你的课程。

selection.example: The store offers a wide selection of fresh fruit at low prices.
selection.exampleZh: 这家店以低廉的价格提供多种新鲜水果供挑选。

self.example: She is slowly learning to trust her own self again.
self.exampleZh: 她正在慢慢学会再次相信自身。

self-conscious.example: She felt self-conscious when she had to speak in front of the whole class.
self-conscious.exampleZh: 当她不得不在全班同学面前发言时，她感到很忸怩。

self-evident.example: It is self-evident that clean water is important for good health.
self-evident.exampleZh: 干净的水对健康很重要，这是不言而喻的。

self-reliant.example: She is a self-reliant young woman who earns her own money.
self-reliant.exampleZh: 她是一个自立的年轻女性，自己挣钱养活自己。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不肯把玩具分给其他孩子。

sell.example: He wants to sell his old car before he moves to another city.
sell.exampleZh: 他想在搬到另一个城市之前卖掉他的旧车。

semester.example: I will study French this semester and take many classes.
semester.exampleZh: 这个学期我将学习法语并上很多课。

semiconductor.example: This small semiconductor helps the computer run faster and use less power.
semiconductor.exampleZh: 这个小半导体元件帮助电脑运行得更快，并减少电力消耗。

seminar.example: I went to a seminar on climate change last week.
seminar.exampleZh: 上周我参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。

senate.example: The senate voted on the new law today.
senate.exampleZh: 参议院今天对这项新法律进行了投票。

senator.example: The senator spoke to the people about the new law.
senator.exampleZh: 这位参议员向民众讲述了这项新法律。

send.example: I will send you the photos by email tonight.
send.exampleZh: 我今晚会把照片通过电子邮件发给你。

senior.example: My senior brother is a senior manager at a big company.
senior.exampleZh: 我的师兄是一家大公司的高级经理。

sensation.example: The new movie caused a great sensation all over the world.
sensation.exampleZh: 这部新电影在全世界引起了巨大的轰动。

sensational.example: The newspaper story about the actor was sensational and everyone talked about it.
sensational.exampleZh: 那篇关于这位演员的报纸报道耸人听闻，人人都在谈论它。

sense.example: She has a good sense of humor and loves making people laugh.
sense.exampleZh: 她有很好的幽默感，喜欢逗人笑。

sensible.example: It is sensible to save some money for a rainy day.
sensible.exampleZh: 存些钱以备不时之需是明智的。

sensitive.example: My skin is very sensitive to this new soap.
sensitive.exampleZh: 我的皮肤对这种新肥皂非常敏感。

sensitivity.example: Her sensitivity to other people's feelings makes her a good friend.
sensitivity.exampleZh: 她对他人感受的敏感体贴使她成为一个好朋友。

sensor.example: The sensor in my phone turns off the screen when I hold it to my ear.
sensor.exampleZh: 我手机里的传感器会在我把手机贴到耳边时关闭屏幕。

sensory.example: Young children learn about the world through sensory play and touch.
sensory.exampleZh: 幼儿通过感官游戏和触摸来认识世界。

sensual.example: The warm music and soft lights made the whole room feel calm and sensual.
sensual.exampleZh: 温暖的音乐和柔和的灯光让整个房间显得宁静而富有感官享受。

sentence.example: The judge will sentence the man tomorrow morning in court.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将在法庭上对那名男子宣判。

sentient.example: Scientists believe that whales are highly sentient animals with complex social lives.
sentient.exampleZh: 科学家认为鲸鱼是高度有知觉的动物，有着复杂的社交生活。

sentiment.example: Her sentiment about the old house was warm and full of memories.
sentiment.exampleZh: 她对那座老房子的感情温暖而充满回忆。

sentimental.example: She felt sentimental when she looked at old photos of her family.
sentimental.exampleZh: 当她看着家人的旧照片时，她感到伤感。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing them.
separate.exampleZh: 洗衣服之前，请把白色衣服和彩色衣服分开。

separation.example: The separation of the two teams made the work much harder.
separation.exampleZh: 两个团队的分开让这项工作变得困难得多。

sequence.example: Please put these numbers in the correct sequence from small to large.
sequence.exampleZh: 请把这些数字按从小到大的正确顺序排列。

serene.example: The lake was serene in the early morning light.
serene.exampleZh: 清晨的光线中，湖面一片宁静。

serenity.example: The quiet lake at dawn gave her a deep sense of serenity.
serenity.exampleZh: 黎明时分宁静的湖水给了她一种深深的安详感。

sergeant.example: The sergeant told his soldiers to stand in a straight line.
sergeant.exampleZh: 中士让他的士兵们站成一条直线。

serial.example: I watch a new serial every Friday night with my family.
serial.exampleZh: 我每周五晚上和家人一起看一部新的连续剧。

series.example: This book is the first in a new series about space travel.
series.exampleZh: 这本书是关于太空旅行的新系列中的第一本。

serious.example: This is a serious problem, so we must talk about it today.
serious.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的问题，所以我们必须今天就讨论它。

sermon.example: The old priest gave a long sermon about kindness and forgiveness.
sermon.exampleZh: 那位年老的牧师做了一场关于善良与宽恕的冗长布道。

servant.example: The old servant has worked in this house for thirty years.
servant.exampleZh: 这位老仆人在这个家里已经工作了三十年。

serve.example: Good restaurants serve hot food and treat every guest with care.
serve.exampleZh: 好的餐厅供应热菜，并用心接待每一位客人。

service.example: The hotel offers good service, and they service the rooms every day.
service.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供优质服务，他们每天都会打扫房间。

session.example: The training session starts at nine and lasts for two hours.
session.exampleZh: 培训课程九点开始，持续两个小时。

set.example: She set the cup on the table and watched the sun set.
set.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在桌上，看着太阳落山。

setback.example: The team faced a serious setback but did not give up.
setback.exampleZh: 团队遇到了严重的挫折，但没有放弃。

settee.example: We sat on the old settee and talked for a long time.
settee.exampleZh: 我们坐在那张旧长沙发上聊了很久。

setting.example: The story takes place in a quiet country setting.
setting.exampleZh: 故事发生在一个安静的乡村环境中。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the sea.
settle.exampleZh: 他们决定在靠近海边的小镇定居。

settlement.example: The two sides finally reached a peaceful settlement after a long talk.
settlement.exampleZh: 双方经过长时间商谈，最终达成了和平的解决办法。

seven.example: My little sister is seven years old and she starts school this year.
seven.exampleZh: 我妹妹七岁了，她今年开始上学。

several.example: Several students in my class like to play football after school.
several.exampleZh: 我们班有几个学生喜欢放学后踢足球。

severe.example: The storm was severe, so the school closed for the day.
severe.exampleZh: 暴风雨很严重，所以学校停课一天。

sew.example: My mother taught me how to sew a button onto my shirt.
sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈教我怎么把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

sex.example: Please write your name, age, and sex on this form.
sex.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

sexual.example: The school teaches students about sexual health and safe relationships.
sexual.exampleZh: 学校教导学生关于性健康和安全关系的知识。

shabby.example: He wore a shabby old coat and looked very poor.
shabby.exampleZh: 他穿着一件破旧的旧外套，看起来非常穷。

shack.example: The old man lives in a small wooden shack near the river.
shack.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边一间小小的木棚屋里。

shade.example: We sat in the shade of a big tree and drank cold water.
shade.exampleZh: 我们坐在大树的树荫下喝冷水。

shadow.example: The tall tree cast a long shadow on the grass in the afternoon.
shadow.exampleZh: 下午，那棵高树在草地上投下了一道长长的影子。

shake.example: She gave the bottle a good shake before opening it.
shake.exampleZh: 她打开瓶子前把它好好摇了一下。

shall.example: You shall not enter this room without permission.
shall.exampleZh: 未经允许，你不得进入这个房间。

shallow.example: The water in the pool is shallow enough for small children to stand in.
shallow.exampleZh: 泳池里的水很浅，小孩子都能站在里面。

shame.example: It is a shame that you cannot come to the party tonight.
shame.exampleZh: 你今晚不能来参加聚会，真是遗憾。

shape.example: The shape of this table is round and easy to move.
shape.exampleZh: 这张桌子的形状是圆的，很容易搬动。

share.example: She likes to share her lunch with friends at school every day.
share.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天在学校和朋友们分享她的午餐。

sharp.example: Be careful with that sharp knife before you cut the bread.
sharp.exampleZh: 切面包之前要小心那把锋利的刀。

shatter.example: The loud noise shattered the quiet morning and woke everyone up.
shatter.exampleZh: 巨大的响声打破了宁静的早晨，把每个人都吵醒了。

shawl.example: She put a warm shawl around her shoulders before going out.
shawl.exampleZh: 她出门前把一条温暖的披肩围在肩上。

shear.example: The farmer will shear the sheep before the hot summer comes.
shear.exampleZh: 农民会在炎热的夏天到来前剪羊毛。

sheath.example: The knife comes with a soft leather sheath to keep it safe.
sheath.exampleZh: 这把刀配有一个柔软的皮革护套，以保证安全。

shed.example: The old wooden shed in our garden keeps our bikes dry.
shed.exampleZh: 我们花园里那个旧木棚让我们的自行车保持干燥。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on the hill behind his house.
sheep.exampleZh: 农夫在房子后面的山坡上养了许多羊。

sheer.example: It was sheer luck that we found the small house.
sheer.exampleZh: 我们找到那所小房子纯粹是运气。

sheet.example: She put a clean sheet on the bed before the guests arrived.
sheet.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，她在床上铺了一条干净床单。

shelf.example: She put the old books on the top shelf above her desk.
shelf.exampleZh: 她把旧书放在书桌上方的最高一层架子上。

shell.example: She found a small shell on the beach and put it in her pocket.
shell.exampleZh: 她在海滩上发现了一个小贝壳，把它放进了口袋里。

shelter.example: The old church became a shelter for families after the storm destroyed their homes.
shelter.exampleZh: 暴风雨摧毁了他们的家园后，这座古老的教堂成了这些家庭的避难所。

shield.example: He held the shield up to protect his face from the wind.
shield.exampleZh: 他举起盾牌挡住脸前的风。

shift.example: She had to shift her plans because the meeting time changed again.
shift.exampleZh: 因为会议时间又变了，她不得不调整计划。

shimmer.example: The lake began to shimmer as the sun set behind the hills.
shimmer.exampleZh: 太阳落到山后时，湖面开始微微发亮。

shine.example: The morning sun began to shine through the small kitchen window.
shine.exampleZh: 早晨的太阳开始透过厨房的小窗户照耀进来。

ship.example: They will ship the boxes to our store by ship next week.
ship.exampleZh: 他们下周会通过船把箱子运到我们的商店。

shipment.example: The first shipment of goods will arrive at the store on Monday.
shipment.exampleZh: 第一批货物将于周一到店。

shirt.example: He wears a white shirt and black pants to work every day.
shirt.exampleZh: 他每天穿白衬衫和黑裤子去上班。

shiver.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind.

shock.example: The news of the accident gave everyone a great shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的消息让每个人都大为震惊。

shoe.example: I put on my shoes and go out to work.
shoe.exampleZh: 我穿上鞋子，出门去上班。

shoot.example: He likes to shoot photos of the new green shoots in spring.
shoot.exampleZh: 他喜欢在春天拍摄新长出的绿色嫩芽。

shop.example: I usually shop for fresh food at the small shop near my home.
shop.exampleZh: 我通常在家附近的小店购买新鲜食物。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and looked for small stones.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，寻找小石子。

short.example: The meeting was short, so we went home early.
short.exampleZh: 会议很短，所以我们早早回家了。

shortage.example: The city has a serious shortage of clean water this summer.
shortage.exampleZh: 今年夏天这座城市严重缺乏干净的饮用水。

shorthand.example: In the meeting, she used shorthand to write down everything the manager said quickly.
shorthand.exampleZh: 会议上，她用速记快速记下了经理说的每一句话。

should.example: You should drink more water when the weather is hot.
should.exampleZh: 天气热的时候你应该多喝水。

shoulder.example: She carried the heavy bag on her left shoulder all the way home.
shoulder.exampleZh: 她一路把沉重的袋子扛在左肩上回家。

shout.example: He had to shout loudly because the music was very loud.
shout.exampleZh: 音乐太吵了，他不得不大声喊叫。

shove.example: Don't shove your clothes into the small bag like that.
shove.exampleZh: 别那样把你的衣服乱塞进这个小包里。

show.example: The teacher will show us how to use the new machine.
show.exampleZh: 老师会向我们展示如何使用这台新机器。

shower.example: I take a quick shower every morning before going to work.
shower.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会快速洗个淋浴。

shrewd.example: She is a shrewd businesswoman who always knows how to make a good deal.
shrewd.exampleZh: 她是一位精明的女商人，总是知道如何做成一笔好买卖。

shrink.example: The old sweater will shrink if you wash it in hot water.
shrink.exampleZh: 如果你用热水洗这件旧毛衣，它会缩水。

shrub.example: There is a small green shrub in front of our house.
shrub.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵绿色的小灌木。
