shrug.example: He just shrugged and said he did not know the answer.
shrug.exampleZh: 他只是耸了耸肩，说不知道答案。

shudder.example: She felt a cold shudder run through her body when the door opened.
shudder.exampleZh: 门打开时，她感到一阵寒栗传遍全身。

shun.example: She shunned her old friends after she became famous.
shun.exampleZh: 她出名后就避开了她的老朋友。

shut.example: Please shut the door quietly when you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 离开房间时请轻轻把门关上。

shutter.example: She closed the shutters before the strong afternoon sun could heat the room.
shutter.exampleZh: 她在午后强烈的阳光把房间晒热之前关上了百叶窗。

shuttle.example: A free shuttle takes visitors from the hotel to the airport every hour.
shuttle.exampleZh: 每小时有一趟免费班车把游客从酒店送到机场。

sick.example: I felt sick after eating too much cake at the party.
sick.exampleZh: 在聚会上吃了太多蛋糕后，我感到恶心。

side.example: The two sides finally agreed to talk and find a simple answer.
side.exampleZh: 双方最终同意坐下来商谈，寻找一个简单的解决办法。

siege.example: The city was under siege for six months before it finally fell.
siege.exampleZh: 这座城市被围困了六个月，最终陷落了。

sieve.example: Use a sieve to wash the rice under cold water.
sieve.exampleZh: 用筛子或滤网在冷水下冲洗大米。

sigh.example: She looked at the old photo and gave a long sigh.
sigh.exampleZh: 她看着那张旧照片，长长地叹了一口气。

sight.example: The old man lost his sight, but he still enjoys the beautiful sights of the city.
sight.exampleZh: 那位老人失去了视力，但他仍然喜欢欣赏这座城市的美景。

sighting.example: Several people reported a sighting of the rare bird near the lake yesterday.
sighting.exampleZh: 昨天有几个人报告在湖边看见了那种稀有鸟类。

sign.example: Please sign your name at the bottom of this page.
sign.exampleZh: 请在这页的底部签上你的名字。

signal.example: The red light is a signal that we must stop the car.
signal.exampleZh: 红灯是我们必须停车的信号。

signature.example: The teacher asked every student to write their signature at the bottom of the page.
signature.exampleZh: 老师让每个学生在页面底部写下自己的签名。

significance.example: The teacher explained the significance of the new rule to the class.
significance.exampleZh: 老师向全班解释了这条新规定的重要性。

significant.example: This is a significant change for our small town.
significant.exampleZh: 这对我们的小镇来说是一个重大的变化。

signify.example: Dark clouds in the sky often signify rain coming soon.
signify.exampleZh: 天空中的乌云常常预示很快就要下雨。

silence.example: The teacher asked for silence so everyone could hear the small bird.
silence.exampleZh: 老师要求大家安静，好让每个人都能听到那只小鸟的叫声。

silent.example: The room was silent as we waited for the teacher to speak.
silent.exampleZh: 我们等着老师说话时，房间里一片寂静。

silicon.example: The computer chip is made of silicon and other materials.
silicon.exampleZh: 这块电脑芯片由硅和其他材料制成。

silk.example: She wore a soft dress made of silk for the party.
silk.exampleZh: 她为参加聚会穿了一条柔软的丝绸连衣裙。

silly.example: It is silly to go out in the rain without an umbrella.
silly.exampleZh: 下雨天不带伞就出门是很傻的。

silt.example: The river was full of silt after the heavy rain.
silt.exampleZh: 大雨过后，河里满是淤泥。

silver.example: She wore a silver ring on her finger and a silver chain around her neck.
silver.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚银戒指，脖子上戴着一条银链子。

similar.example: These two pictures look very similar, but they are not the same.
similar.exampleZh: 这两张图片看起来非常相似，但它们并不相同。

simmer.example: The soup needs to simmer for twenty minutes before we eat.
simmer.exampleZh: 汤需要炖二十分钟，然后我们再吃。

simple.example: The rules of this game are simple and easy to remember.
simple.exampleZh: 这个游戏的规则很简单，容易记住。

simplicity.example: The simplicity of her design makes the room feel calm and bright.
simplicity.exampleZh: 她设计的简洁让这个房间显得宁静而明亮。

simulate.example: We can use a computer to simulate the weather in the future.
simulate.exampleZh: 我们可以用电脑来模拟未来的天气。

simultaneous.example: The two teams made simultaneous changes to the plan last night.
simultaneous.exampleZh: 昨晚两个团队同时对该计划做出了修改。

simultaneously.example: The two students answered the question simultaneously and gave the same answer.
simultaneously.exampleZh: 两个学生同时回答了这个问题，给出了相同的答案。

sin.example: In many religions, people believe that telling a lie is a sin.
sin.exampleZh: 在许多宗教中，人们认为撒谎是一种罪。

since.example: I have not seen him since he moved to another city last year.
since.exampleZh: 自从他去年搬到另一个城市后，我就没见过他。

sincere.example: She gave me a sincere apology for being late to the meeting.
sincere.exampleZh: 她为开会迟到向我真诚地道了歉。

sing.example: She likes to sing English songs with her friends after school.
sing.exampleZh: 她喜欢放学后和朋友们一起唱英文歌。

singer.example: The singer sang a beautiful song for us at the concert.
singer.exampleZh: 歌手在音乐会上为我们唱了一首优美的歌。

single.example: I booked a single ticket for the early train to Beijing.
single.exampleZh: 我订了一张去北京的早班火车单程票。

singular.example: This word has a singular form but no plural form.
singular.exampleZh: 这个单词有单数形式，但没有复数形式。

sink.example: The old boat began to sink slowly into the cold water.
sink.exampleZh: 那条旧船开始慢慢沉入冰冷的水中。

sit.example: Please sit down and wait for your name to be called.
sit.exampleZh: 请坐下，等待叫到你的名字。

site.example: The old church is a famous site in our small town.
site.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂是我们小镇上一个著名的遗址。

situation.example: The situation in the city is getting better every day.
situation.exampleZh: 城市的形势每天都在变好。

six.example: My little sister is six years old and she starts school this year.
six.exampleZh: 我妹妹六岁了，她今年开始上学。

size.example: What size shoes do you wear?

skate.example: My sister likes to skate on the ice in winter.
skate.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢在冬天滑冰。

sketch.example: She drew a quick sketch of the tree and colored it later.
sketch.exampleZh: 她快速画了一棵树的草图，之后又给它上了色。

ski.example: We ski on the snowy hills every winter with our friends.
ski.exampleZh: 我们每年冬天都和朋友们在雪山上滑雪。

skill.example: She has a special skill for making hard jobs look easy.
skill.exampleZh: 她有一种特殊的本领，能让难做的工作看起来很容易。

skilled.example: She is a skilled worker and can fix many machines quickly.
skilled.exampleZh: 她是一名熟练的工人，能很快修好许多机器。

skillful.example: She is a skillful cook and makes delicious food for her family.
skillful.exampleZh: 她是个技术娴熟的厨师，为家人做出美味的饭菜。

skim.example: I only had time to skim the report before the meeting started.
skim.exampleZh: 会议开始前我只来得及略读一下那份报告。

skin.example: The baby has soft skin on her small hands and face.
skin.exampleZh: 这个婴儿的小手和脸上有着柔软的皮肤。

skip.example: We can skip the last question if we are short of time.
skip.exampleZh: 如果我们时间不够，可以跳过最后一道题。

skirt.example: She wore a long blue skirt to the party last night.
skirt.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条蓝色的长裙去参加聚会。

skull.example: The skull protects the brain and gives shape to the whole face.
skull.exampleZh: 颅骨保护大脑，并赋予整张脸以形状。

sky.example: The sky is clear and blue today, so we can see many stars tonight.
sky.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗湛蓝，所以今晚我们可以看到很多星星。

slack.example: Business is slack in winter, so many shops close early.
slack.exampleZh: 冬天生意萧条，所以许多商店早早关门。

slam.example: She slammed the door and walked away without saying a word.
slam.exampleZh: 她砰地关上门，一言不发地走了。

slash.example: The company plans to slash its budget and use a slash between the two dates.
slash.exampleZh: 公司计划大幅削减预算，并在两个日期之间使用一条斜线。

slave.example: The farmer forced the slave to work all day in the fields.
slave.exampleZh: 农场主强迫那个奴隶整天在田里干活。

slavery.example: Many people fought to end slavery in the United States.
slavery.exampleZh: 许多人曾为终结美国的奴隶制而斗争。

sleep.example: I try to sleep for eight hours every night.
sleep.exampleZh: 我尽量每晚睡八个小时。

sleeve.example: He rolled up his sleeves and washed the dirty dishes.
sleeve.exampleZh: 他卷起袖子，洗了那些脏盘子。

slender.example: The tall girl has a slender figure and long dark hair.
slender.exampleZh: 那个高个子女孩身材苗条，留着长长的黑发。

slice.example: She ate a slice of bread with butter and jam.
slice.exampleZh: 她吃了一片涂了黄油和果酱的面包。

slide.example: The children like to slide down the big slide in the park.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢从公园里的大滑梯上滑下来。

slight.example: There is a slight difference between the two colors.
slight.exampleZh: 这两种颜色之间有轻微的差别。

slim.example: She eats less sugar and walks daily to stay slim.
slim.exampleZh: 她少吃糖、每天走路，以保持苗条。

slip.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the door.
slip.exampleZh: 小心别在门附近的湿地上滑倒。

slogan.example: The company put a short slogan on every poster to attract young buyers.
slogan.exampleZh: 公司在每张海报上放了一句简短的广告语，以吸引年轻买家。

slope.example: The children ran down the steep slope behind the house.
slope.exampleZh: 孩子们从屋后陡峭的斜坡上跑了下来。

slot.example: Please put the coin into the slot and wait for your turn.
slot.exampleZh: 请把硬币投入投币口，然后等待轮到你。

slow.example: The old bus is very slow on the way to school.
slow.exampleZh: 那辆旧公交车在去学校的路上开得很慢。

slum.example: Many families in the slum still lack clean water and electricity.
slum.exampleZh: 贫民窟里的许多家庭仍然缺乏干净的水和电。

slump.example: Sales slumped badly last year, and the whole industry fell into a deep slump.
slump.exampleZh: 去年销量大幅暴跌，整个行业陷入了深度萧条。

small.example: This small room has one window and a wooden desk.
small.exampleZh: 这个小房间有一扇窗户和一张木桌。

smart.example: She is smart and always finds quick answers to hard problems.
smart.exampleZh: 她很聪明，总能很快找到难题的答案。

smash.example: The ball hit the window and smashed it into small pieces.
smash.exampleZh: 球击中窗户，把它砸成了碎片。

smell.example: I can smell the fresh bread in the kitchen.
smell.exampleZh: 我能闻到厨房里新鲜面包的香味。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and said hello.
smile.exampleZh: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑并说了声你好。

smog.example: The smog over the city is thick and makes it hard to see.
smog.exampleZh: 城市上空的雾霾很浓，让人很难看清。

smoke.example: The smoke from the fire made everyone cough and leave the room quickly.
smoke.exampleZh: 火产生的烟让每个人都咳嗽，并很快离开了房间。

smooth.example: The table has a smooth surface, and the train ride was very smooth.
smooth.exampleZh: 这张桌子表面很光滑，火车旅程也非常平稳。

smuggle.example: He tried to smuggle the gold across the border late at night.
smuggle.exampleZh: 他试图在深夜把黄金走私过边境。

snack.example: I often eat a healthy snack like fruit between lunch and dinner.
snack.exampleZh: 我经常在午餐和晚餐之间吃水果这样的健康点心。

snake.example: The snake moved quietly through the tall grass behind our house.
snake.exampleZh: 那条蛇悄悄地穿过我们房子后面的高草。

snap.example: He tried to snap the dry branch in half with his hands.
snap.exampleZh: 他试着用双手把干树枝折断成两半。

snatch.example: The thief tried to snatch her bag and run away.
snatch.exampleZh: 小偷试图抢走她的包然后跑掉。

sneak.example: He tried to sneak into the kitchen to grab a cookie.
sneak.exampleZh: 他试图偷偷溜进厨房拿一块饼干。

sniff.example: The dog sniffed the ground and then ran after the ball.
sniff.exampleZh: 狗闻了闻地面，然后追着球跑了。

snow.example: The children played in the snow all afternoon and made a big snowman.
snow.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在雪地里玩，还堆了一个大雪人。

so.example: The soup is so hot that I cannot drink it now.
so.exampleZh: 汤太烫了，我现在喝不了。

soak.example: Let the beans soak in water for a few hours.
soak.exampleZh: 让豆子在水里浸泡几个小时。

soap.example: I wash my hands with soap before I eat lunch.
soap.exampleZh: 我吃午饭前用肥皂洗手。

soar.example: The bird soared high above the trees and then flew away.
soar.exampleZh: 那只鸟高飞在树林上方，然后飞走了。

sober.example: He stayed sober all night so he could drive his friends home.
sober.exampleZh: 他整晚保持清醒，以便能开车送朋友们回家。

social.example: Making friends is an important social skill for children.
social.exampleZh: 交朋友是孩子们一项重要的社交技能。

society.example: Every member of society should help keep our city clean and safe.
society.exampleZh: 社会中的每个成员都应帮助保持我们城市的整洁与安全。

sociology.example: She studies sociology at the university because she wants to understand how people live together.
sociology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习社会学，因为她想了解人们如何共同生活。

sock.example: I can't find my other blue sock anywhere in the bedroom.
sock.exampleZh: 我在卧室里到处都找不到另一只蓝色的袜子。

soda.example: I would like a cold glass of soda with my lunch today.
soda.exampleZh: 我今天午餐时想喝一杯冰镇汽水。

sofa.example: The cat is sleeping on the sofa in the living room.
sofa.exampleZh: 那只猫正在客厅的沙发上睡觉。

soft.example: Her soft voice made the baby fall asleep quickly.
soft.exampleZh: 她柔和的声音让宝宝很快睡着了。

software.example: The new software helps students learn English faster and more easily.
software.exampleZh: 这款新软件帮助学生更快、更容易地学习英语。

soil.example: The soil in our garden is dark and good for growing vegetables.
soil.exampleZh: 我们花园里的土壤颜色深，很适合种蔬菜。

solar.example: Solar energy can help us save money and protect the environment.
solar.exampleZh: 太阳能可以帮助我们省钱并保护环境。

soldier.example: The soldier carried his bag and walked slowly toward the small village.
soldier.exampleZh: 那名士兵背着他的包，慢慢朝那个小村庄走去。

sole.example: The sole of my old shoe is broken.

solemn.example: The whole school stood in solemn silence during the ceremony.
solemn.exampleZh: 整个学校在仪式中庄严地静立默哀。

solid.example: This old table is very solid and strong.
solid.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子非常坚固结实。

solidarity.example: The workers showed strong solidarity during the long strike.
solidarity.exampleZh: 工人们在漫长的罢工期间表现出了坚强的团结。

solitary.example: The old man lives a solitary life in the small house by the sea.
solitary.exampleZh: 那位老人在这座海边的小屋里过着独居的生活。

solution.example: We need a simple solution to this problem.
solution.exampleZh: 我们需要一个简单的办法来解决这个问题。

solve.example: We must work together to solve this problem before Friday.
solve.exampleZh: 我们必须在周五之前齐心协力解决这个问题。

some.example: I need to buy some bread and milk for breakfast this morning.
some.exampleZh: 今天早上我需要买一些面包和牛奶当早餐。

somebody.example: Somebody left a small bag on the chair this morning.
somebody.exampleZh: 今天早上有人把一个小包落在了椅子上。

somehow.example: Somehow she found my lost keys in the garden.
somehow.exampleZh: 不知怎么地，她在花园里找到了我丢失的钥匙。

something.example: There is something strange about the way he talks.
something.exampleZh: 他说话的方式有点奇怪。

sometime.example: Please come to see me sometime next week if you are free.
sometime.exampleZh: 如果你有空，请下周找个时间来见我。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to school with my little sister when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时会和我妹妹一起步行去学校。

somewhat.example: The test was somewhat harder than the homework we did last night.
somewhat.exampleZh: 这次考试比我们昨晚做的作业稍微难一点。

somewhere.example: I think I left my keys somewhere in the living room.
somewhere.exampleZh: 我想我把钥匙落在客厅的某个地方了。

son.example: My son is ten years old and he loves playing football with his friends.
son.exampleZh: 我儿子十岁了，他喜欢和朋友们一起踢足球。

song.example: The little girl sang a happy song for her mother.
song.exampleZh: 小女孩为她的妈妈唱了一首欢快的歌。

soon.example: I hope to see you again soon after the holiday.
soon.exampleZh: 我希望假期过后不久能再见到你。

sophisticated.example: This is a very sophisticated computer program that helps doctors find illnesses early.
sophisticated.exampleZh: 这是一个非常精密的电脑程序，能帮助医生及早发现疾病。

sophistication.example: The sophistication of her design surprised everyone at the small office.
sophistication.exampleZh: 她设计的精致程度让这个小办公室里的每个人都很惊讶。

sore.example: My throat is sore, so I will drink warm water today.
sore.exampleZh: 我的喉咙很痛，所以今天我会喝温水。

sorrow.example: She felt deep sorrow after her old dog died last winter.
sorrow.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗去世后，她感到深深的悲伤。

sort.example: She likes this sort of music, and she sorts her CDs every weekend.
sort.exampleZh: 她喜欢这类音乐，而且每个周末都会整理她的CD。

soul.example: Music can touch your soul in a way that words cannot.
soul.exampleZh: 音乐能以语言无法做到的方式触动你的灵魂。

sound.example: The sound of her voice sounds reasonable, so we agreed with her plan.
sound.exampleZh: 她的声音听起来很合理，所以我们同意了她的计划。

soup.example: My mother makes hot chicken soup for us on cold days.
soup.exampleZh: 天冷的时候，妈妈会给我们做热鸡汤。

sour.example: The milk went sour because we left it out of the fridge.
sour.exampleZh: 牛奶变酸了，因为我们把它放在了冰箱外面。

source.example: The reporter refused to name the source of her information.
source.exampleZh: 记者拒绝说出她的信息来源。

south.example: My grandparents live in a small town in the south of China.
south.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在中国南方的一个小镇上。

sovereign.example: The sovereign ruled the small island nation for over forty years.
sovereign.exampleZh: 这位君主统治这个小岛国四十多年。

sovereignty.example: The island nation fought hard to protect its sovereignty and its people.
sovereignty.exampleZh: 这个岛国为保护其主权和人民而奋力抗争。

sow.example: Farmers sow seeds in the field every spring.
sow.exampleZh: 农民每年春天在田里播种。

space.example: There is not enough space in this room for a big table.
space.exampleZh: 这个房间里没有足够的空间放一张大桌子。

spacecraft.example: The spacecraft flew past the moon and sent pictures back to Earth.
spacecraft.exampleZh: 这艘航天器飞过月球，并把照片传回了地球。

span.example: The bridge has a wide span and crosses the river here.
span.exampleZh: 这座桥跨度很大，从这里横跨河流。

spare.example: Can you spare a few minutes to help me with this box?
spare.exampleZh: 你能抽出几分钟帮我搬这个箱子吗？

spark.example: A single spark from the fire started the big fire in the forest.
spark.exampleZh: 火中的一颗火星引发了森林里的大火。

spatial.example: Children learn spatial skills by playing with blocks and simple puzzles.
spatial.exampleZh: 孩子们通过玩积木和简单的拼图来学习空间技能。

speak.example: She can speak three languages well, so she talks with many people.
speak.exampleZh: 她能流利地说三种语言，因此她和许多人交谈。

speaker.example: The speaker stood at the front and talked to the whole class.
speaker.exampleZh: 演讲者站在前面，对着全班讲话。

special.example: She has a special gift for making people feel welcome.
special.exampleZh: 她有一种让人感到宾至如归的特殊天赋。

specialist.example: My doctor sent me to see a heart specialist last week.
specialist.exampleZh: 上周我的医生让我去看一位心脏专科医生。

species.example: This species of bird lives only on small islands.
species.exampleZh: 这种鸟只生活在小岛上。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand your idea.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我才能理解你的想法。

specifically.example: This book is written specifically for students who want to improve their English.
specifically.exampleZh: 这本书是专门为想要提高英语的学生写的。

specimen.example: The scientist put a small plant specimen under the microscope.
specimen.exampleZh: 科学家把一小份植物标本放到显微镜下。

spectacle.example: The fireworks over the lake were a wonderful spectacle for the whole town.
spectacle.exampleZh: 湖面上的烟花对全镇人来说是一场美妙的景象。

spectator.example: The spectator cheered loudly when the runner crossed the finish line.
spectator.exampleZh: 当跑者冲过终点线时，那位观众大声欢呼。

spectrum.example: The teacher showed us the full spectrum of colors in the light.
spectrum.exampleZh: 老师向我们展示了光中完整的色彩光谱。

speculate.example: I can only speculate about what she meant by that.
speculate.exampleZh: 我只能猜测她那句话是什么意思。

speech.example: Her speech at the meeting was short but very clear.
speech.exampleZh: 她在会上的演讲很短，但非常清楚。

speed.example: The car was going at high speed on the highway.
speed.exampleZh: 那辆车在高速公路上以很快的速度行驶。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me on this form?
spell.exampleZh: 你能在这张表格上为我拼写一下你的姓吗？

spelling.example: My teacher says my spelling is getting better every week.
spelling.exampleZh: 老师说我的拼写每周都在进步。

spend.example: I spend about an hour reading English books every evening.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚上花大约一个小时读英语书。

sphere.example: She is well known in the sphere of modern art.
sphere.exampleZh: 她在现代艺术领域很有名。

spice.example: A little spice makes this soup taste much better.
spice.exampleZh: 加一点香料能让这碗汤的味道好很多。

spider.example: A spider is making a small web in the corner of the room.
spider.exampleZh: 一只蜘蛛正在房间角落里结一张小网。

spill.example: Be careful not to spill the hot soup on the table.
spill.exampleZh: 小心别把热汤洒在桌子上。

spin.example: The wheels began to spin faster and faster on the wet road.
spin.exampleZh: 车轮在湿滑的路上开始越转越快。

spine.example: He hurt his spine when he fell from the tall tree.
spine.exampleZh: 他从高高的树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。

spiral.example: The airplane went into a steep spiral before the pilot gained control again.
spiral.exampleZh: 飞机陷入了急剧的螺旋式下降，随后飞行员重新控制住了飞机。

spirit.example: She has a strong spirit and never gives up when life gets hard.
spirit.exampleZh: 她有坚强的精神，生活艰难时从不放弃。

spite.example: She said those mean words out of spite, not because they were true.
spite.exampleZh: 她说那些刻薄话是出于怨恨，而不是因为它们是真的。

splash.example: The children splash water on each other in the pool.
splash.exampleZh: 孩子们在泳池里互相泼水。

splendid.example: The palace looked splendid in the warm light of the setting sun.
splendid.exampleZh: 在夕阳的暖光中，这座宫殿显得壮丽辉煌。

split.example: They decided to split the bill after a long and happy dinner.
split.exampleZh: 在一顿漫长而愉快的晚餐后，他们决定平摊账单。

spoil.example: Too much praise may spoil a young child.
spoil.exampleZh: 过多的赞美可能会宠坏一个年幼的孩子。

sponge.example: Use a wet sponge to clean the dirty kitchen table.
sponge.exampleZh: 用一块湿海绵来擦干净的厨房桌子。

sponsor.example: The company agreed to sponsor the local football team for the new season.
sponsor.exampleZh: 公司同意在新赛季赞助当地足球队。

spontaneous.example: She gave a spontaneous hug when she heard the good news.
spontaneous.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她不由自主地拥抱了一下。

spoon.example: Please give me a clean spoon for my hot soup.
spoon.exampleZh: 请给我一把干净的勺子喝热汤。

sport.example: My favorite sport is basketball, and I play it with friends every weekend.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球，我每个周末都和朋友一起打。

spot.example: I found a quiet spot in the park to read my book.
spot.exampleZh: 我在公园里找到一个安静的地方读书。

spray.example: The gardener sprayed water on the small plants every morning before the sun rose.
spray.exampleZh: 园丁每天早上在太阳升起前给这些小植物喷水。

spread.example: The news spread quickly through the small town last night.
spread.exampleZh: 昨晚这个消息在小镇里迅速传播开来。

spring.example: In spring the warm sun makes the little river flow again.
spring.exampleZh: 春天，温暖的阳光让小河重新流淌。

sprinkle.example: Please sprinkle some salt on the eggs before you eat them.
sprinkle.exampleZh: 吃鸡蛋前请在上面撒一些盐。

spur.example: Her kind words were a spur to me and made me try again.
spur.exampleZh: 她善意的话语对我是一种激励，让我重新振作再试一次。

spy.example: She saw a spy near the old hotel last night.
spy.exampleZh: 她昨晚在旧旅馆附近看到一个间谍。

squad.example: A small squad of police officers arrived at the scene quickly.
squad.exampleZh: 一小队警察迅速赶到了现场。

squander.example: He squandered all his money on useless things.
squander.exampleZh: 他把所有的钱都浪费在了没用的东西上。

square.example: The old square in our town is always full of people on sunny days.
square.exampleZh: 我们镇上那座古老的广场在晴天总是挤满了人。

squash.example: He accidentally squashed the tomatoes in his bag on the way home.
squash.exampleZh: 他在回家的路上不小心把包里的西红柿压碎了。

squat.example: He squats down to tie his shoes before the race starts.
squat.exampleZh: 比赛开始前，他蹲下来系鞋带。

squeak.example: The little mouse began to squeak when it saw the cat.
squeak.exampleZh: 那只小老鼠看到猫时开始吱吱叫。

squeeze.example: She had to squeeze the lemon hard to get enough juice for the tea.
squeeze.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲挤压柠檬，才能为茶取得足够的汁。

squirrel.example: A little squirrel ran up the tree and hid a nut.
squirrel.exampleZh: 一只小松鼠跑上树，把一颗坚果藏了起来。

stab.example: He stabbed the meat with a fork to see if it was cooked.
stab.exampleZh: 他用叉子戳了一下肉，看看熟了没有。

stability.example: The new job gave her more financial stability and peace of mind.
stability.exampleZh: 这份新工作让她有了更多的经济稳定和内心的安宁。

stabilize.example: The doctor gave him some medicine to stabilize his blood pressure.
stabilize.exampleZh: 医生给他一些药来稳定他的血压。

stable.example: The old wooden stable is not very stable in strong winds.
stable.exampleZh: 那座旧木马厩在强风中不太稳固。

stack.example: Please stack the chairs in the corner and keep the room tidy.
stack.exampleZh: 请把椅子堆放在角落里，并保持房间整洁。

staff.example: The staff at our school works hard every day.
staff.exampleZh: 我们学校的全体职员每天都努力工作。

stage.example: The band will go on stage after the lights go down.
stage.exampleZh: 灯光暗下来后，乐队将登台演出。

stagger.example: The tired old man staggered slowly down the narrow street after work.
stagger.exampleZh: 那位疲惫的老人下班后沿着狭窄的街道缓慢蹒跚而行。

stagnant.example: The water in the old pond is stagnant and dirty.
stagnant.exampleZh: 那个旧池塘里的水停滞不动，而且很脏。

stain.example: The red wine left a dark stain on the white tablecloth.
stain.exampleZh: 红酒在白色桌布上留下了一块深色的污渍。

stair.example: She walked up the stairs to her room on the second floor.
stair.exampleZh: 她走上楼梯，到了二楼自己的房间。

stake.example: Each partner owns a small stake in the new company.
stake.exampleZh: 每位合伙人在新公司中拥有少量股份。

stale.example: The bread on the table is stale and no one wants to eat it.
stale.exampleZh: 桌上的面包不新鲜了，没人想吃。

stall.example: The old car may stall if you drive too slowly up the hill.
stall.exampleZh: 如果你开车上坡太慢，那辆旧车可能会熄火。

stamina.example: Running every morning helps me build the stamina I need for long races.
stamina.exampleZh: 每天早上跑步帮助我培养长跑所需的耐力。

stamp.example: She put a stamp on the letter and mailed it yesterday.
stamp.exampleZh: 她在信上贴了邮票，昨天把它寄了出去。

stand.example: I can't stand the noise from the street, so I stand by the window.
stand.exampleZh: 我无法忍受街上的噪音，所以我站在窗边。

standard.example: All students must meet the school standard before they can graduate.
standard.exampleZh: 所有学生都必须达到学校标准才能毕业。

staple.example: Rice is a staple food for many people in Asia.
staple.exampleZh: 米饭是许多亚洲人的主食。

star.example: Many people go outside at night to look at the stars in the sky.
star.exampleZh: 许多人晚上到外面去看天上的星星。

stare.example: She stared at the painting for a long time without saying a word.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着那幅画看了很久，一句话也没说。

start.example: We will start the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
start.exampleZh: 我们明天上午九点开始会议。

startle.example: The loud noise outside the window startled the sleeping baby.
startle.exampleZh: 窗外的巨响把熟睡的婴儿吓了一跳。

starve.example: Many children in poor countries still starve because they have no food.
starve.exampleZh: 许多贫困国家的孩子仍然因为没有食物而挨饿。

state.example: The teacher asked him to state his opinion about the new school rules.
state.exampleZh: 老师让他陈述自己对新校规的看法。

statement.example: The company sent me a monthly statement for my bank account.
statement.exampleZh: 公司给我寄了一份银行账户的月度结算单。

static.example: Static made my hair stand up after I took off my hat.
static.exampleZh: 我摘下帽子后，静电让我的头发竖了起来。

statistic.example: This statistic shows that most students walk to school every day.
statistic.exampleZh: 这项统计数据表明，大多数学生每天步行上学。

statue.example: There is a large stone statue in the middle of the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园中央有一座大石雕像。

status.example: Her status in the company has grown quickly this year.
status.exampleZh: 她在公司的地位今年提升得很快。

statute.example: The new statute says every driver must wear a seat belt.
statute.exampleZh: 这项新法规规定每位司机都必须系安全带。

stay.example: We plan to stay at a small hotel near the beach for three nights.
stay.exampleZh: 我们打算在海滩附近的一家小旅馆住三个晚上。

steady.example: He kept the ladder steady while I painted the wall.
steady.exampleZh: 我刷墙时，他把梯子扶得稳稳的。

steak.example: My father likes to eat steak with potatoes and a green salad.
steak.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢吃牛排配土豆和一份蔬菜沙拉。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bike outside the shop yesterday.
steal.exampleZh: 昨天有人试图在商店外面偷走我的自行车。

steam.example: Hot steam from the boiling soup rose up and covered the kitchen window.
steam.exampleZh: 沸腾的汤里冒出的热蒸汽升起来，遮住了厨房的窗户。

steel.example: The bridge is made of steel and is very strong.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥是用钢制成的，非常坚固。

steep.example: The hill is too steep for young children to climb safely.
steep.exampleZh: 这座山太陡，年幼的孩子无法安全攀爬。

steer.example: My father steered the small boat slowly toward the quiet shore.
steer.exampleZh: 我父亲把小船慢慢驶向安静的岸边。

stem.example: The stem of this plant is green and it grows very fast.
stem.exampleZh: 这株植物的茎是绿色的，而且它长得很快。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后停下。

stereo.example: He turned on the stereo and played some quiet music.
stereo.exampleZh: 他打开音响，放了一些安静的音乐。

stereotype.example: People should not judge other people based on a stereotype.
stereotype.exampleZh: 人们不应该根据刻板印象来评判他人。

stern.example: The old captain gave us a stern look and told us to work harder.
stern.exampleZh: 老船长严厉地看了我们一眼，叫我们更努力工作。

stew.example: My mother makes a warm beef stew every cold winter evening.
stew.exampleZh: 每个寒冷的冬夜，妈妈都会做一锅热腾腾的炖牛肉。

steward.example: The steward helped us find our seats on the train.
steward.exampleZh: 乘务员帮我们在火车上找到了座位。

stick.example: He used a stick to help him walk, and he stuck the map on the wall.
stick.exampleZh: 他用一根手杖帮助自己走路，还把地图粘贴在了墙上。

sticky.example: The sticky candy stuck to my fingers and was hard to clean.
sticky.exampleZh: 那块黏黏的糖果粘在了我的手指上，很难清洗。

stiff.example: After sitting all day, my neck felt stiff and painful.
stiff.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，我的脖子感到僵硬又疼痛。

still.example: The lake is still and quiet in the early morning.
still.exampleZh: 清晨的湖面静止而寂静。

stimulate.example: Good teachers stimulate students to ask questions and think for themselves.
stimulate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生提出问题并独立思考。

sting.example: A bee stung my hand, and the sting hurt for hours.
sting.exampleZh: 一只蜜蜂叮了我的手，那种刺痛持续了好几个小时。

stingy.example: My stingy neighbor never gives candy to the children.
stingy.exampleZh: 我那个小气的邻居从不给孩子们糖果。

stir.example: She used a spoon to stir the hot soup slowly.
stir.exampleZh: 她用勺子慢慢地搅拌热汤。

stirrup.example: The rider put his foot in the stirrup and climbed onto the horse.
stirrup.exampleZh: 骑手把脚放进马镫，然后爬上了马。

stock.example: The store keeps a large stock of winter coats for the cold season.
stock.exampleZh: 这家商店为寒冷季节储备了大量冬季外套。

stocking.example: She wore a pair of warm wool stockings under her long skirt.
stocking.exampleZh: 她在长裙下穿了一双暖和的羊毛长袜。

stomach.example: My stomach feels full because I ate too much rice for lunch.
stomach.exampleZh: 我的胃感觉很饱，因为午饭我吃了太多米饭。

stone.example: The boy picked up a small stone and threw it into the river.
stone.exampleZh: 男孩捡起一块小石头，把它扔进了河里。

stoop.example: He had to stoop to pick up the pen from the floor.
stoop.exampleZh: 他不得不弯腰从地板上捡起那支笔。

stop.example: The bus will stop here, so please wait by the station.
stop.exampleZh: 公交车会在这里停，所以请在车站旁等候。

storage.example: We keep our old winter clothes in storage under the bed.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把旧的冬装存放在床下的储物处。

store.example: We store extra rice and water in the small room behind the store.
store.exampleZh: 我们把多余的大米和水储存在商店后面的小房间里。

storm.example: The storm broke the windows and flooded the whole street last night.
storm.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨打碎了窗户，淹没了整条街。

story.example: She told the children a funny story before they went to bed.
story.exampleZh: 她在孩子们上床睡觉前给他们讲了一个有趣的故事。

stove.example: She put the hot pot on the stove and waited for the water to boil.
stove.exampleZh: 她把热锅放在炉子上，等着水烧开。

straight.example: The road is straight and goes directly to the small train station.
straight.exampleZh: 这条路是直的，直接通往那个小火车站。

straightforward.example: Her answer was straightforward, so everyone understood the plan right away.
straightforward.exampleZh: 她的回答直截了当，所以大家马上就明白了这个计划。

strain.example: The heavy box may strain your back if you lift it alone.
strain.exampleZh: 如果你一个人搬这个重箱子，可能会拉伤你的背。

strand.example: The small boat was stranded on the beach after the storm.
strand.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，小船搁浅在海滩上。

strange.example: It is strange that nobody answered the phone all morning.
strange.exampleZh: 整个上午没人接电话，这很奇怪。

stranger.example: My mother always tells me not to open the door to a stranger.
stranger.exampleZh: 我妈妈总是告诉我不要给陌生人开门。

strap.example: He pulled the strap tight to keep his heavy bag on his shoulder.
strap.exampleZh: 他把带子拉紧，让沉重的包留在肩上。

strategic.example: The company made a strategic plan to enter the new market.
strategic.exampleZh: 公司制定了进入新市场的战略计划。

strategy.example: Our team needs a clear strategy to win the game.
strategy.exampleZh: 我们队需要一个清晰的战略来赢得比赛。

stray.example: Be careful, or you may stray far from the right path.
stray.exampleZh: 小心点，否则你可能会偏离正确的道路很远。

streak.example: There was a long streak of paint on the old wooden floor.
streak.exampleZh: 旧木地板上有一道长长的油漆条纹。

stream.example: A small stream flows through the green hills behind our village.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪流过我们村庄后面的青山。

streamline.example: We streamlined the approval process to save time and reduce errors.
streamline.exampleZh: 我们精简了审批流程以节省时间并减少错误。

street.example: There are many small shops on both sides of our street.
street.exampleZh: 我们街道两旁有很多小商店。

strength.example: Her greatest strength is the ability to stay calm under pressure.
strength.exampleZh: 她最大的优势是能在压力下保持冷静。

strengthen.example: Daily exercise can strengthen your body and help you feel much better.
strengthen.exampleZh: 每天锻炼可以增强你的体质，让你感觉好很多。

stress.example: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep well at night.
stress.exampleZh: 压力太大会让人晚上难以睡好。

stretch.example: She likes to stretch her arms before she goes for a run.
stretch.exampleZh: 她喜欢在跑步前伸展一下手臂。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about homework and always checks it carefully.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对作业要求很严格，总是仔细检查。

stride.example: She walked with long strides across the field to reach the gate.
stride.exampleZh: 她大步穿过田野，走向大门。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer working conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定罢工，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

striking.example: There is a striking difference between the two brothers.
striking.exampleZh: 这两兄弟之间有显著的区别。

string.example: She tied the box with a strong piece of string.
string.exampleZh: 她用一根结实的绳子把盒子捆了起来。

strip.example: He had to strip the old paint off the door before painting it again.
strip.exampleZh: 他得先把门上的旧漆剥掉，然后才能重新刷漆。

stripe.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
stripe.exampleZh: 斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

strive.example: We must strive to do better every day.
strive.exampleZh: 我们必须努力每天做得更好。

stroke.example: My grandfather had a stroke last year but he is much better now.
stroke.exampleZh: 我爷爷去年中风了，但他现在好多了。

stroll.example: We often stroll along the river after dinner and talk about our day.
stroll.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们常沿着河边散步，聊聊一天的事。

structure.example: The teacher explained the structure of the sentence before we wrote the story.
structure.exampleZh: 老师在我们写故事之前讲解了句子的结构。

struggle.example: She had to struggle hard to finish the work on time.
struggle.exampleZh: 她不得不努力奋斗才能按时完成工作。

student.example: Every student in my class works hard and asks good questions.
student.exampleZh: 我班上的每个学生都很努力，也会提出好问题。

studio.example: She works in a small studio near her home.
studio.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一间小工作室里工作。

study.example: I study English in my quiet study every evening.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上在我安静的书房里学习英语。

stuff.example: Please put your stuff in the box before we leave.
stuff.exampleZh: 在我们离开之前，请把你的东西放进箱子里。

stumble.example: I stumbled on the stairs but did not fall down.
stumble.exampleZh: 我在楼梯上绊了一下，但没有摔倒。

stun.example: The sudden loud news stunned everyone in the small room.
stun.exampleZh: 这个突然传来的惊人消息让小屋里的每个人都震惊了。

stupid.example: It was stupid of me to forget my keys again.
stupid.exampleZh: 我又忘了带钥匙，真是太愚蠢了。

sturdy.example: This old wooden table is very sturdy and can hold many heavy books.
sturdy.exampleZh: 这张旧木桌非常结实，能放很多很重的书。

style.example: Her writing style is simple and clear, so everyone enjoys reading her stories.
style.exampleZh: 她的写作风格简洁明了，所以大家都喜欢读她的故事。

subdue.example: The police used little force to subdue the angry crowd.
subdue.exampleZh: 警方用了很小的武力就制服了愤怒的人群。

subject.example: Math is my favorite subject, but these students are subject to strict rules.
subject.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的科目，但这些学生受严格规定的约束。

subjective.example: This is a subjective opinion, not a fact.
subjective.exampleZh: 这是主观的看法，不是事实。

submerge.example: The heavy rain submerged the small road under water.
submerge.exampleZh: 大雨把那条小路淹没了。

submit.example: You must submit your form before Friday.
submit.exampleZh: 你必须在周五之前提交你的表格。

subordinate.example: He is friendly to his subordinates and never acts like a boss.
subordinate.exampleZh: 他对下属很友好，从不摆老板的架子。

subscribe.example: I subscribe to two magazines and read them every weekend.
subscribe.exampleZh: 我订阅了两本杂志，每个周末都会读。

subsequent.example: The first meeting was short, and the subsequent talks went well.
subsequent.exampleZh: 第一次会议很短，随后的会谈进行得很顺利。

substance.example: Water is the most important substance for all life on Earth.
substance.exampleZh: 水是地球上所有生命最重要的物质。

substantial.example: The company made a substantial profit last year.
substantial.exampleZh: 这家公司去年获得了大量利润。

substitute.example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this cake.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个蛋糕里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subterranean.example: The workers found a subterranean river beneath the old factory.
subterranean.exampleZh: 工人们在旧工厂下面发现了一条地下河。

subtle.example: There is a subtle difference between these two words.
subtle.exampleZh: 这两个词之间有一个微妙的差别。

subtract.example: Please subtract five from ten to get the right answer.
subtract.exampleZh: 请从十中减去五，得出正确答案。

suburb.example: They moved to a quiet suburb after their first child was born.
suburb.exampleZh: 他们的第一个孩子出生后，他们搬到了安静的郊区。

subway.example: I take the subway to work every morning at eight.
subway.exampleZh: 我每天早上八点乘地铁去上班。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，你最终会成功。

success.example: Her hard work finally brought her great success in the new job.
success.exampleZh: 她的努力终于让她在新工作中取得了巨大成功。

successive.example: The team won three successive games last week without any trouble.
successive.exampleZh: 这支队伍上周连续赢了三场比赛，毫无困难。

successor.example: The young man will be the successor to his father's company.
successor.exampleZh: 这个年轻人将成为他父亲公司的继任者。

succinct.example: Her answer was succinct and easy for everyone to understand.
succinct.exampleZh: 她的回答简明扼要，每个人都容易理解。

succumb.example: I hope she will not succumb to the pressure from her boss.
succumb.exampleZh: 我希望她不会屈服于老板的压力。

such.example: I never saw such a big dog before.
such.exampleZh: 我以前从没见过这么大的狗。

suck.example: Babies suck milk from a bottle, but this old vacuum really sucks at cleaning.
suck.exampleZh: 婴儿从奶瓶里吸奶，但这台旧吸尘器吸尘效果真的很差。

sudden.example: There was a sudden change in the weather this afternoon.
sudden.exampleZh: 今天下午天气突然发生了变化。

sue.example: The company decided to sue the driver for the damage to its truck.
sue.exampleZh: 公司决定起诉那名司机，要求赔偿卡车的损失。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from headaches when they work too long.
suffer.exampleZh: 许多人工作时间过长时会头痛。

sufficient.example: We had sufficient food and water for the whole trip.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供整个旅程使用。

suffix.example: In the word happiness, ness is a common suffix.
suffix.exampleZh: 在 happiness 这个词中，ness 是一个常见的后缀。

suffocate.example: The smoke filled the small room and made it hard to breathe, and we felt we might suffocate.
suffocate.exampleZh: 烟雾充满了小房间，让我们呼吸困难，我们觉得自己可能会窒息。

suffrage.example: Women fought for many years to win the right of suffrage.
suffrage.exampleZh: 妇女们为争取选举权奋斗了许多年。

sugar.example: She puts two spoons of sugar in her tea every morning.
sugar.exampleZh: 她每天早上在茶里放两勺糖。

suggest.example: The doctor suggested that I get more sleep and drink more water.
suggest.exampleZh: 医生建议我多睡觉、多喝水。

suit.example: This dark suit fits him well for the meeting.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色西装很适合他在会议上穿。

suitable.example: This movie is not suitable for young children.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合小孩子看。

suite.example: They stayed in a large suite on the top floor of the hotel.
suite.exampleZh: 他们住在酒店顶层的一间大套房里。

sulfur.example: The yellow powder on the rock is sulfur from the nearby volcano.
sulfur.exampleZh: 岩石上的黄色粉末是附近火山留下的硫磺。

sullen.example: He stayed sullen all afternoon and would not talk to anyone.
sullen.exampleZh: 他整个下午都闷闷不乐，不愿和任何人说话。

summary.example: The teacher asked us to write a short summary of the story.
summary.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一篇这个故事的简短摘要。

summer.example: We often go swimming in the river during the hot summer.
summer.exampleZh: 炎热的夏天，我们经常去河里游泳。

summit.example: They finally reached the summit of the mountain after a long climb.
summit.exampleZh: 经过漫长的攀登，他们终于到达了山顶。

summon.example: The judge will summon three witnesses to the court tomorrow morning.
summon.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将传唤三名证人到法庭。

sun.example: The sun is very bright today, so we should wear hats.
sun.exampleZh: 今天太阳很亮，所以我们应该戴帽子。

superb.example: The food at that small restaurant was superb, and the service was friendly.
superb.exampleZh: 那家小餐馆的食物极好，服务也很友好。

superficial.example: His knowledge of the subject is superficial and not deep.
superficial.exampleZh: 他对这门学科的了解很肤浅，并不深入。

superfluous.example: The extra chair was superfluous, so we moved it to another room.
superfluous.exampleZh: 那把多出来的椅子是多余的，所以我们把它搬到了另一个房间。

superintendent.example: The superintendent of the building keeps everything clean and safe.
superintendent.exampleZh: 大楼的主管保持一切干净又安全。

superior.example: The new manager is superior to the old one in many ways.
superior.exampleZh: 新经理在很多方面都比旧经理更优秀。

supervise.example: My teacher supervises the students when they work in the computer room.
supervise.exampleZh: 学生们在机房学习时，我的老师会监督他们。

supervisor.example: My supervisor checked my report and gave me some useful advice.
supervisor.exampleZh: 我的主管检查了我的报告，并给了我一些有用的建议。

supplement.example: I take a vitamin supplement every morning with my breakfast.
supplement.exampleZh: 我每天早晨吃早餐时服用一种维生素补充剂。

supply.example: The company supplies fresh water to thousands of homes every day.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司每天向数千个家庭供应淡水。

support.example: My family always supports me when I try something new.
support.exampleZh: 当我尝试新事物时，我的家人总是支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose you are right about the meeting time tomorrow.
suppose.exampleZh: 我想你关于明天会议时间的看法是对的。

suppress.example: The government tried to suppress the news, but people still learned the truth.
suppress.exampleZh: 政府试图压制这条消息，但人们还是知道了真相。

supreme.example: The king had supreme power over all the land and its people.
supreme.exampleZh: 国王对这片土地及其人民拥有至高无上的权力。

sure.example: I am sure that she will come to our party tonight.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信她今晚会来参加我们的聚会。

surface.example: The fish swam up to the surface of the clear lake.
surface.exampleZh: 鱼游到了清澈湖水的表面。

surge.example: The surge in online shopping changed how small shops do business.
surge.exampleZh: 网上购物的激增改变了小商店做生意的方式。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before he began the long operation.
surgeon.exampleZh: 外科医生在开始长时间的手术之前仔细地洗了手。

surgery.example: She had surgery on her knee and stayed in the hospital for three days.
surgery.exampleZh: 她做了膝盖手术，在医院住了三天。

surplus.example: The factory had a surplus of goods and sold them at a low price.
surplus.exampleZh: 工厂有大量剩余货物，于是以低价出售。

surprise.example: The surprise party for my mother made her cry with joy.
surprise.exampleZh: 为我妈妈举办的惊喜派对让她高兴得哭了。

surrender.example: The soldiers had to surrender when they ran out of food and water.
surrender.exampleZh: 士兵们在食物和水耗尽后不得不投降。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small lake near our village.
surround.exampleZh: 高大的树木环绕着我们村庄附近的小湖。

surveillance.example: The police kept the suspect under surveillance for several days.
surveillance.exampleZh: 警方对嫌疑人进行了几天的监视。

survey.example: The company did a survey to learn what its customers really want.
survey.exampleZh: 公司做了一项调查，以了解顾客真正想要什么。

survival.example: The survival of the small animals depends on clean water and safe homes.
survival.exampleZh: 这些小动物的存活取决于干净的水源和安全的栖息地。

survive.example: Only a few people survived the terrible earthquake in that small mountain village.
survive.exampleZh: 那个小山村发生的可怕地震中只有几个人幸存下来。

survivor.example: The only survivor of the crash was a young boy.
survivor.exampleZh: 这次坠机事故的唯一幸存者是一个小男孩。

susceptible.example: Young children are more susceptible to colds in winter.
susceptible.exampleZh: 幼儿在冬天更容易感冒。

suspect.example: The police suspect that the quiet man next door stole the money.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑隔壁那个沉默的男人偷了钱。

suspend.example: The school will suspend classes for two days because of the storm.
suspend.exampleZh: 因为暴风雨，学校将停课两天。

suspense.example: The movie kept us in suspense until the very last minute.
suspense.exampleZh: 这部电影让我们一直悬着心，直到最后一分钟。

suspension.example: The school announced a short suspension of classes after the heavy snow.
suspension.exampleZh: 大雪之后，学校宣布短暂停课。

suspicion.example: Her strange behavior raised a suspicion in my mind.
suspicion.exampleZh: 她奇怪的行为在我心中引起了怀疑。

suspicious.example: The police found a suspicious bag near the busy train station this morning.
suspicious.exampleZh: 今天早上警方在繁忙的火车站附近发现了一个可疑的包。

sustain.example: She works hard to sustain her family and keep them happy.
sustain.exampleZh: 她努力工作来维持家庭并让他们快乐。

sustainable.example: We need a sustainable plan to protect the forest and its animals.
sustainable.exampleZh: 我们需要一个可持续的计划来保护森林和其中的动物。

swallow.example: The bird is a swallow, and it can swallow small insects quickly.
swallow.exampleZh: 这只鸟是燕子，它能很快地吞下小昆虫。

swamp.example: The heavy rain began to swamp the small garden behind our house.
swamp.exampleZh: 大雨开始淹没我们房子后面的小花园。

swap.example: Let us swap seats so we can sit together.
swap.exampleZh: 我们交换一下座位吧，这样就能坐在一起了。

swarm.example: A swarm of bees flew into the garden and settled on a tree.
swarm.exampleZh: 一群蜜蜂飞进花园，落在了一棵树上。

sway.example: The tall trees sway gently in the wind on a quiet afternoon.
sway.exampleZh: 在一个安静的下午，高高的树在风中轻轻摇摆。

swear.example: I swear I will never tell anyone your secret.
swear.exampleZh: 我发誓我永远不会把你的秘密告诉任何人。

sweat.example: After the long run, his shirt was wet with sweat.
sweat.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他的衬衫被汗水浸湿了。

sweep.example: Please sweep the dirty floor before your friends come home tonight.
sweep.exampleZh: 今晚你朋友回家前，请把脏地板扫一扫。

sweet.example: This cake is very sweet, and the children love it.
sweet.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕很甜，孩子们很喜欢。

swell.example: My ankle began to swell after I fell off my bike yesterday.
swell.exampleZh: 昨天我从自行车上摔下来后，脚踝开始肿了起来。

swerve.example: The driver had to swerve quickly to avoid hitting the dog.
swerve.exampleZh: 司机不得不迅速转向，以免撞到那只狗。

swift.example: The swift runner reached the finish line before everyone else.
swift.exampleZh: 那个敏捷的跑步者比其他人先到达终点线。

swing.example: The children like to swing high on the new swing in the park.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里的新秋千上荡得很高。

switch.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the room.

sword.example: The brave knight carried a sharp sword into the dark forest.
sword.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士带着一把锋利的剑走进了黑暗的森林。

symbol.example: The red heart is a symbol of love for many people.
symbol.exampleZh: 红心对许多人来说是爱的象征。

symbolic.example: The white dove is a symbolic image of peace in many cultures.
symbolic.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，白鸽是和平的象征性形象。

symmetry.example: The butterfly's wings have perfect symmetry, so both sides look exactly the same.
symmetry.exampleZh: 这只蝴蝶的翅膀有着完美的对称性，因此两边看起来完全一样。

sympathetic.example: She gave me a sympathetic smile when I told her about my bad day.
sympathetic.exampleZh: 当我告诉她我糟糕的一天时，她给了我一个同情的微笑。

sympathy.example: She felt deep sympathy for the old man and helped him cross the street.
sympathy.exampleZh: 她对那位老人深感同情，并帮他过了马路。

symphony.example: The new symphony sounded beautiful and brought the whole city together.
symphony.exampleZh: 这部新交响曲听起来很美，把整座城市凝聚在一起。

symposium.example: She gave a short talk at the symposium on climate change last week.
symposium.exampleZh: 上周她在气候变化专题讨论会上做了一个简短的报告。

symptom.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this illness.
symptom.exampleZh: 高烧是这种疾病的常见症状。

syndrome.example: This syndrome often makes children feel very tired and weak.
syndrome.exampleZh: 这种综合征常使儿童感到非常疲倦和虚弱。

synthesis.example: This report is a synthesis of many small studies.
synthesis.exampleZh: 这份报告是对许多小型研究的综合。

synthetic.example: This jacket is made of synthetic material that feels soft and light.
synthetic.exampleZh: 这件夹克由合成材料制成，摸起来柔软轻便。

system.example: The school has a new computer system for all its students.
system.exampleZh: 学校为所有学生配备了一套新的计算机系统。

systematic.example: She takes a systematic approach to solving problems at work.
systematic.exampleZh: 她在工作中采用系统的方法来解决问题。

table.example: Please put the books on the table before we start the meeting.
table.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前把书放在桌子上。

tablet.example: The doctor gave me a small white tablet to take with water.
tablet.exampleZh: 医生给了我一小片白色的药片，用水送服。

taboo.example: In some cultures, it is a taboo to talk about money at dinner.
taboo.exampleZh: 在某些文化中，晚餐时谈论金钱是一种禁忌。

tabulate.example: Please tabulate all the answers so we can see the results clearly.
tabulate.exampleZh: 请把所有答案制成表格，这样我们就能清楚地看到结果。

tacit.example: There was a tacit agreement between them that nobody would mention the money.
tacit.exampleZh: 他们之间有一种心照不宣的默契，谁都不会提起那笔钱。

taciturn.example: My taciturn uncle rarely speaks at family dinners.
taciturn.exampleZh: 我沉默寡言的叔叔在家庭聚餐时很少说话。

tack.example: The carpenter drove a tack into the wood with a small hammer.
tack.exampleZh: 木匠用小锤子把一枚平头钉钉进木头里。

tackle.example: The team must tackle this problem before it gets worse.
tackle.exampleZh: 团队必须在这个问题变得更糟之前处理它。

tact.example: Her tact made the difficult conversation easy for everyone in the room.
tact.exampleZh: 她的圆滑得体让这场艰难的谈话对在场的每个人都轻松了许多。

tactful.example: She was tactful when she told him about the mistake.
tactful.exampleZh: 她告诉他这个错误时很得体。

tactic.example: He tried a new tactic to solve the problem at work.
tactic.exampleZh: 他尝试了一种新策略来解决工作中的问题。

tactical.example: The team made a tactical change after the first half.
tactical.exampleZh: 球队在上半场后做出了战术调整。

tactile.example: The soft blanket is very tactile and feels nice on my skin.
tactile.exampleZh: 这条柔软的毯子触感很好，贴在我皮肤上很舒服。

tadpole.example: The little tadpole swims in the pond with its long tail.
tadpole.exampleZh: 小蝌蚪拖着长长的尾巴在池塘里游来游去。

tag.example: Please put a name tag on your bag before the trip.
tag.exampleZh: 旅行前请在你的包上放一个姓名标签。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail when it saw me come home.
tail.exampleZh: 狗看到我回家时摇着尾巴。

tailor.example: The tailor can adjust my suit to fit me better.
tailor.exampleZh: 裁缝可以把我的西装调整得更合身。

take.example: Please take this bag to your teacher before the class starts.
take.exampleZh: 请在上课前把这个包带给你的老师。

takeover.example: The big company announced a takeover of its smaller rival last week.
takeover.exampleZh: 这家大公司上周宣布收购其规模较小的竞争对手。

tale.example: My grandmother told me an old tale about a brave king.
tale.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于勇敢国王的古老故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for music and loves to sing every day.
talent.exampleZh: 她在音乐方面很有天赋，每天都喜欢唱歌。

talk.example: I need to talk with my teacher about the homework.
talk.exampleZh: 我需要和老师谈谈作业的事。

tally.example: The teacher will tally the votes and then write the score on the board.
tally.exampleZh: 老师会计算票数，然后把分数写在黑板上。

tame.example: The horse is very tame and lets the children feed it.
tame.exampleZh: 这匹马很温顺，让孩子们给它喂食。

tamper.example: Someone tampered with the lock on the back door last night.
tamper.exampleZh: 昨晚有人动了后门的锁。

tangent.example: The line touches the circle at one point, so it is a tangent.
tangent.exampleZh: 这条线在一点处与圆相接，所以它是一条切线。

tangible.example: The company needs tangible results, not just promises, before the end of this year.
tangible.exampleZh: 公司需要在今年年底前看到切实的成果，而不只是口头承诺。

tangle.example: The wires behind the desk tangle together and are hard to separate.
tangle.exampleZh: 桌子后面的电线缠在一起，很难分开。

tank.example: He keeps two goldfish in a small glass tank on the desk.
tank.exampleZh: 他在桌上的一个小玻璃缸里养了两条金鱼。

tap.example: He turned on the tap and washed his hands quickly.
tap.exampleZh: 他打开水龙头，很快洗了手。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the box before I moved it.
tape.exampleZh: 我搬家前用胶带把箱子粘好了。

target.example: Our team's main target is to finish the project before Friday.
target.exampleZh: 我们团队的主要目标是赶在周五前完成这个项目。

tariff.example: The new tariff on imported cars made them more expensive for many families.
tariff.exampleZh: 新的进口汽车关税使它们对许多家庭来说变得更贵了。

tarry.example: We tarried at the station until the last train left.
tarry.exampleZh: 我们在车站逗留到最后一班火车开走。

task.example: My first task today is to clean the kitchen.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是打扫厨房。

taste.example: This soup has a strange taste, but I like it.
taste.exampleZh: 这汤味道有点怪，但我喜欢。

tatter.example: The old coat was torn to tatters after the long walk through the forest.
tatter.exampleZh: 那件旧外套在长途穿过森林后变成了碎布条。

tattoo.example: He has a small tattoo of a dragon on his left arm.
tattoo.exampleZh: 他左臂上有一个小的龙纹身。

taunt.example: The boys liked to taunt him about his old shoes.
taunt.exampleZh: 男孩们喜欢拿他穿旧鞋子来奚落他。

taut.example: The rope was pulled taut before we tied the knot.
taut.exampleZh: 我们把绳子拉紧，然后才打上结。

tavern.example: After work, he stopped at a small tavern for a drink.
tavern.exampleZh: 下班后，他顺路去了一家小酒馆喝了一杯。

tax.example: The government plans to tax the rich to help poor families.
tax.exampleZh: 政府计划向富人征税以帮助贫困家庭。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of hot tea every morning before work.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: She will teach us English every Monday and Friday morning.
teach.exampleZh: 她每周一和周五早上教我们英语。

team.example: Our team works hard every day to finish the project on time.
team.exampleZh: 我们团队每天努力工作，以按时完成这个项目。

tear.example: The little boy began to tear when he lost his favorite toy.
tear.exampleZh: 那个小男孩丢了最喜欢的玩具后开始流泪。

tease.example: The boys often tease their little sister about her funny glasses.
tease.exampleZh: 男孩们经常取笑他们的小妹妹戴的那副滑稽眼镜。

technical.example: He has strong technical skills and can fix many machines.
technical.exampleZh: 他有很强的技术能力，能修理很多机器。

technician.example: The technician fixed our computer in less than an hour.
technician.exampleZh: 技术员不到一小时就修好了我们的电脑。

technique.example: This simple technique helps students learn new words faster.
technique.exampleZh: 这个简单的方法能帮助学生更快地记住新单词。

technology.example: Modern technology helps students learn faster and easier.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术帮助学生们学得更快更容易。

tedious.example: The long meeting was tedious, so I almost fell asleep.
tedious.exampleZh: 那场漫长的会议冗长乏味，我差点睡着了。

teem.example: The river teems with fish in early summer.
teem.exampleZh: 初夏时节，这条河里鱼很多。

teenager.example: As a teenager, she often stayed up late reading novels.
teenager.exampleZh: 作为一个青少年，她经常熬夜读小说。

telecom.example: The telecom in our city is growing fast and offers many new jobs.
telecom.exampleZh: 我们城市的电信业发展迅速，提供了许多新工作。

telegram.example: She sent him a telegram to say the train was late.
telegram.exampleZh: 她给他发了电报，说火车晚点了。

telegraph.example: He sent a telegraph to his family to tell them the good news.
telegraph.exampleZh: 他给家人发了一封电报，告诉他们这个好消息。

telephone.example: I called my mother on the telephone to tell her the good news.
telephone.exampleZh: 我用电话打给妈妈，告诉她这个好消息。

telescope.example: We used a small telescope to look at the moon last night.
telescope.exampleZh: 昨晚我们用一架小望远镜看月亮。

television.example: My family watches television together in the living room every evening.
television.exampleZh: 我的家人每天晚上在客厅一起看电视。

tell.example: Please tell me the way to the train station.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我去火车站的路。

temper.example: He lost his temper and shouted at the children, but later he calmed down.
temper.exampleZh: 他发了脾气，对孩子们大喊，但后来他冷静了下来。

temperament.example: Her calm temperament makes her a good teacher for young children.
temperament.exampleZh: 她性情温和，因此很适合教小孩子。

temperate.example: This temperate city has mild weather all year round.
temperate.exampleZh: 这座温带城市全年气候温和。

temperature.example: The temperature outside is very low today, so wear a warm coat.
temperature.exampleZh: 今天外面的气温很低，所以穿一件暖和的外套。

tempest.example: The small boat was lost in the tempest last night.
tempest.exampleZh: 昨晚那艘小船在暴风雨中失踪了。

template.example: Use this template to write your report quickly and neatly.
template.exampleZh: 用这个模板来快速整洁地写你的报告。

temple.example: The old temple on the hill is very quiet in the morning.
temple.exampleZh: 山上的那座古庙在早晨非常安静。

tempo.example: The tempo of the music was slow and easy to follow.
tempo.exampleZh: 这首音乐的节奏很慢，很容易跟上。

temporal.example: The study looks at the temporal pattern of sleep in young children.
temporal.exampleZh: 这项研究考察幼儿睡眠的时间模式。

temporary.example: My job here is only temporary, so I will look for something new soon.
temporary.exampleZh: 我这里的这份工作只是暂时的，所以我很快会找新工作。

tempt.example: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to stop at the bakery.
tempt.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味诱使我在面包店前停下。

tenable.example: Her argument is not tenable because the facts do not support it.
tenable.exampleZh: 她的论点站不住脚，因为事实并不支持它。

tenacious.example: She is tenacious and never gives up when the work gets hard.
tenacious.exampleZh: 她很顽强，工作变得艰难时从不放弃。

tenant.example: The tenant pays the rent on the first day of each month.
tenant.exampleZh: 房客在每个月的第一天交房租。

tend.example: Parents tend to worry about their children when they are sick.
tend.exampleZh: 孩子生病时，父母往往会担心。

tendency.example: He has a tendency to talk too fast when he gets nervous.
tendency.exampleZh: 他一紧张就倾向于说得太快。

tender.example: She gave the little boy a tender smile and held his hand.
tender.exampleZh: 她给了小男孩一个温柔的微笑，并握住了他的手。

tendon.example: The doctor said I hurt a tendon in my leg while running.
tendon.exampleZh: 医生说我跑步时伤到了腿上的一根肌腱。

tenet.example: One main tenet of our club is to help others every day.
tenet.exampleZh: 我们俱乐部的一条主要信条是每天帮助他人。

tennis.example: My brother and I play tennis in the park every Saturday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我和哥哥每周六早上都在公园打网球。

tension.example: You could feel the tension in the room before the exam began.
tension.exampleZh: 考试开始前，你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

tent.example: We put up a tent by the lake and slept there last night.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在湖边搭了一个帐篷，昨晚就睡在那里。

tentative.example: We made a tentative plan to meet again next week.

tenure.example: She received tenure after six years of teaching at the university.
tenure.exampleZh: 她在大学任教六年后获得了终身教职。

tepid.example: The water in the bottle was tepid, so nobody wanted to drink it.
tepid.exampleZh: 瓶子里的水是微温的，所以没人想喝。

term.example: We learned some new terms in class this term and used them in our reports.
term.exampleZh: 这学期我们在课上学了一些新术语，并把它们用在了报告中。

terminal.example: The bus stopped at the terminal near the airport before noon.
terminal.exampleZh: 公共汽车在中午前停在了机场附近的终点站。

terminate.example: The company may terminate the contract if you miss two payments.
terminate.exampleZh: 如果你两次未付款，公司可能会终止合同。

terminology.example: The doctor used medical terminology that was hard for me to understand.
terminology.exampleZh: 医生使用了让我难以理解的医学术语。

terrace.example: From the terrace we could see green rice terraces below the hill.
terrace.exampleZh: 从露台上我们可以看到山下绿色的稻田梯田。

terrain.example: The mountain terrain is steep and difficult to walk on.
terrain.exampleZh: 这片山地的地形很陡峭，走起来很困难。

terrestrial.example: Many terrestrial animals live in forests and find food on the ground.
terrestrial.exampleZh: 许多陆生动物生活在森林里，在地面上寻找食物。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

terrific.example: The new restaurant in our town serves terrific food at a low price.
terrific.exampleZh: 我们镇上那家新餐厅以低价提供极好的食物。

terrify.example: The loud thunder terrified the little dog and it hid under the bed.
terrify.exampleZh: 巨大的雷声吓坏了那只小狗，它躲到了床底下。

territory.example: The small bird protects its territory from other birds.
territory.exampleZh: 这只小鸟保护自己的领地，不让其他鸟进入。

terror.example: The loud scream filled her with terror in the dark night.
terror.exampleZh: 那声尖叫在黑夜中让她充满了恐惧。

test.example: Our teacher will give us a short test on Friday morning.
test.exampleZh: 我们老师星期五上午会给我们做一个小测验。

testify.example: Two workers will testify about the accident in court tomorrow.
testify.exampleZh: 两名工人明天将在法庭上就这起事故作证。

testimony.example: Her testimony in court helped the police find the truth.
testimony.exampleZh: 她在法庭上的证词帮助警方找到了真相。

testing.example: The new software needs a lot of testing before we use it.
testing.exampleZh: 这款新软件在我们使用之前需要进行大量测试。

testosterone.example: The doctor said his testosterone level was normal for his age.
testosterone.exampleZh: 医生说他的睾酮水平在他这个年龄段是正常的。

testy.example: He gets testy when he is tired and hungry.
testy.exampleZh: 他又累又饿的时候就会变得暴躁。

tether.example: The farmer tethered the goat to a tree and went home.
tether.exampleZh: 农夫把山羊拴在树上，然后回家去了。

texture.example: This cloth has a soft texture and feels nice on my skin.
texture.exampleZh: 这块布料质地柔软，摸起来对皮肤很舒服。

thanks.example: She said thanks to everyone who helped her with the project.
thanks.exampleZh: 她向所有帮助过她完成这个项目的人表示感谢。

thatch.example: The old house in the village had a roof made of thatch.
thatch.exampleZh: 村里那栋老房子的屋顶是用茅草做的。

thaw.example: The ice will thaw quickly in the warm spring sun.
thaw.exampleZh: 冰在温暖的春日阳光下会很快融化。

theater.example: We went to the new theater last night to see a famous play.
theater.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去那家新剧院看了一场著名的戏。

theft.example: The police arrested the man for the theft of a bike.
theft.exampleZh: 警方因一起自行车失窃案逮捕了那名男子。

theme.example: The main theme of the story is love and family.
theme.exampleZh: 这个故事的主题是爱与家庭。

theology.example: She studies theology at a small university in the north.
theology.exampleZh: 她在北方一所小型大学学习神学。

theorem.example: Our teacher explained the theorem with a simple drawing on the board.
theorem.exampleZh: 老师用黑板上的一幅简图解释了这个定理。

theoretical.example: This idea is only theoretical and needs more tests.
theoretical.exampleZh: 这个想法只是理论上的，还需要更多测试。

theory.example: In theory, the plan sounds good, but nobody has tested it yet.
theory.exampleZh: 理论上这个计划听起来不错，但还没有人测试过。

therapy.example: She is in therapy to help with her anxiety and stress.
therapy.exampleZh: 她正在接受心理治疗，以缓解焦虑和压力。

thereafter.example: He left the company in May and thereafter worked from home.
thereafter.exampleZh: 他五月离开了公司，此后便在家工作。

thereby.example: He finished his work early, thereby leaving time for a short walk.
thereby.exampleZh: 他提前完成了工作，因此有时间短暂散步。

therefore.example: It was raining hard, and therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们一整天都待在家里。

thermal.example: This thermal coat keeps me warm on cold winter days.
thermal.exampleZh: 这件保暖外套让我在寒冷的冬日里保持温暖。

thermometer.example: The doctor put a thermometer in my mouth to check my temperature.
thermometer.exampleZh: 医生把体温计放进我嘴里量体温。

thermos.example: She put hot tea in a thermos before the long trip.
thermos.exampleZh: 长途旅行前，她把热茶装进了一个保温瓶。

thesis.example: She spent two years writing her thesis on modern Chinese literature.
thesis.exampleZh: 她花了两年时间写关于中国现代文学的毕业论文。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick, so we can walk on it.
thick.exampleZh: 湖面上的冰很厚，所以我们可以在上面走。

thief.example: The police caught the thief who stole my bike last night.
thief.exampleZh: 警察抓住了昨晚偷我自行车的小偷。

thigh.example: He hurt his thigh while playing football with his friends yesterday.
thigh.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们踢足球时伤到了大腿。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on, so we stayed near the shore.
thin.exampleZh: 湖上的冰太薄了，不能在上面走，所以我们留在岸边。

thing.example: I have many things to do at home today.
thing.exampleZh: 我今天在家有很多事情要做。

think.example: I think we should go home now because it is late.
think.exampleZh: 我想我们现在应该回家，因为已经很晚了。

thinker.example: The old thinker had many new ideas about human life.
thinker.exampleZh: 这位年长的思想家对人生有许多新见解。

third.example: She lives on the third floor of that old building.
third.exampleZh: 她住在那栋旧楼的三楼。

thirst.example: After the long run, I felt a strong thirst for cold water.
thirst.exampleZh: 长跑之后，我非常渴望喝到凉水。

thorn.example: Be careful of the sharp thorns on that rose bush.
thorn.exampleZh: 小心那株玫瑰丛上的尖刺。

thorough.example: The doctor gave him a thorough check before the long trip.
thorough.exampleZh: 医生在长途旅行前给他做了一次彻底的检查。

thought.example: My thoughts are often clearer in the morning.
thought.exampleZh: 我的想法在早晨通常更清晰。

thoughtful.example: She is a thoughtful friend who always remembers my birthday.
thoughtful.exampleZh: 她是个体贴的朋友，总是记得我的生日。

thrash.example: Their team thrashed ours in the final game last night.
thrash.exampleZh: 昨晚的决赛中，他们队彻底击败了我们队。

thread.example: She lost the thread of the story and could not follow it.
thread.exampleZh: 她跟不上故事的思路，无法继续听下去。

threat.example: The rising sea is a serious threat to small towns along the coast.
threat.exampleZh: 不断上升的海平面是对沿海小镇的严重威胁。

threshold.example: The noise rose above the threshold, so we closed the window.
threshold.exampleZh: 噪音超过了阈値，所以我们关上了窗户。

thrift.example: Good thrift helps a family save money for hard times.
thrift.exampleZh: 良好的节俭习惯能帮家庭在困难时期存下钱。

thrill.example: The children felt a great thrill when the roller coaster began to move.
thrill.exampleZh: 过山车开始移动时，孩子们感到非常激动。

thrive.example: Small businesses often thrive when the local economy is strong and stable.
thrive.exampleZh: 当地方经济强劲稳定时，小企业往往能蓬勃发展。

throat.example: The cold air made my throat feel dry and sore.
throat.exampleZh: 冷空气让我的喉咙感到又干又痛。

throne.example: The young king sat on the throne after the long ceremony.
throne.exampleZh: 漫长的仪式结束后，年轻的国王坐上了王座。

throng.example: A throng of fans crowded the streets to see the famous singer.
throng.exampleZh: 一大群粉丝挤满街道，只为一睹那位著名歌手的风采。

throttle.example: He tried to throttle the engine to save fuel on the long drive.
throttle.exampleZh: 在长途驾驶中，他试图通过节流来节省燃油。

throughout.example: The small cafe is famous for its fresh bread throughout the town.
throughout.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆因新鲜面包而闻名全镇。

throw.example: Please throw the ball to me and I will throw it back.
throw.exampleZh: 请把球扔给我，我再把它扔回去。

thrust.example: He thrust the key into the lock and opened the door quickly.
thrust.exampleZh: 他把钥匙插进锁里，迅速打开了门。

thud.example: I heard a loud thud when the heavy box fell off the table.
thud.exampleZh: 沉重的箱子从桌上掉下来时，我听到砰的一声巨响。

thug.example: The police caught the thug who robbed the old woman last night.
thug.exampleZh: 警察抓住了昨晚抢劫那位老太太的暴徒。

thumb.example: He hurt his thumb while opening the heavy wooden door.
thumb.exampleZh: 他在打开那扇沉重的木门时伤到了拇指。

thump.example: My heart began to thump loudly when I heard that sudden noise.
thump.exampleZh: 听到那突如其来的响声时，我的心开始砰砰直跳。

thus.example: The road was closed, and thus we had to take a longer route.
thus.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们不得不走一条更长的路线。

thwart.example: Bad weather thwarted our plan to go hiking on Saturday.
thwart.exampleZh: 恶劣天气阻挠了我们周六去徒步的计划。

tick.example: The clock will tick softly while we wait for the bus.
tick.exampleZh: 我们等公交车的时候，钟会轻轻地发出滴答声。

ticket.example: I bought a ticket for the train to Beijing this morning.
ticket.exampleZh: 我今天早上买了一张去北京的火车票。

tickle.example: My little sister laughs when I tickle her feet.
tickle.exampleZh: 我挠我妹妹的脚时，她会笑。

tidal.example: The tidal waves are very strong near the beach at night.
tidal.exampleZh: 夜晚海滩附近的潮汐浪非常大。

tide.example: The tide comes in twice a day on this beach.
tide.exampleZh: 这片海滩每天涨潮两次。

tidy.example: Please tidy your room and keep your desk tidy every day.
tidy.exampleZh: 请整理你的房间，并且每天保持书桌整洁。

tie.example: His old school tie is still a strong bond between the two friends.
tie.exampleZh: 他的旧校服领带仍是这两位朋友之间牢固的纽带。

tier.example: The seats in the top tier cost more than those below.
tier.exampleZh: 最高层看台的座位比下面几层的座位贵。

tiger.example: The tiger sleeps in the shade of a big tree.
tiger.exampleZh: 那只老虎在一棵大树的树荫下睡觉。

tight.example: The lid is too tight, so I cannot open the jar.
tight.exampleZh: 盖子太紧了，所以我打不开这个罐子。

tile.example: The kitchen floor is covered with white tiles.
tile.exampleZh: 厨房的地面上铺着白色的瓷砖。

till.example: Please wait here till I come back with the money.
till.exampleZh: 请在这里等到我带着钱回来。

tilt.example: The old table began to tilt when we put the heavy box on it.
tilt.exampleZh: 当我们把沉重的箱子放上去时，旧桌子开始倾斜。

timber.example: The old house was built with strong timber from the local forest.
timber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用当地森林里结实的木材建造的。

time.example: I do not have enough time to finish my work today.
time.exampleZh: 我今天没有足够的时间完成工作。

timely.example: Thank you for your timely help with my homework last night.
timely.exampleZh: 谢谢你昨晚及时帮我做作业。

timid.example: The timid boy stood at the door and did not say a word.
timid.exampleZh: 那个胆小的男孩站在门口，一句话也没说。

tinge.example: A slight tinge of pink appeared in the sky at sunrise.
tinge.exampleZh: 日出时天空中出现了一抹淡淡的粉红色。

tingle.example: Her cheeks began to tingle when she spoke in front of the class.
tingle.exampleZh: 她在全班面前发言时，脸颊开始发烫。

tinker.example: He likes to tinker with old radios in his free time.
tinker.exampleZh: 他空闲时喜欢摆弄旧收音机。

tinkle.example: The small bells on the door tinkle softly whenever someone comes in.
tinkle.exampleZh: 每当有人进来时，门上的小铃铛就会轻轻叮当作响。

tint.example: The morning sky had a soft pink tint.
tint.exampleZh: 清晨的天空带着柔和的粉色调。

tip.example: He left a tip on the table and thanked the waiter.
tip.exampleZh: 他在桌上留了小费，并感谢了服务员。

tiptoe.example: She had to tiptoe past the baby's room after midnight.
tiptoe.exampleZh: 午夜过后，她不得不踮着脚尖走过婴儿房。

tirade.example: His angry tirade about the broken machine lasted almost ten minutes.
tirade.exampleZh: 他因这台坏掉的机器而大发雷霆，长篇训斥了将近十分钟。

tire.example: I tire easily when I work late, so I go to bed early.
tire.exampleZh: 我工作到很晚时容易疲劳，所以我早早就睡了。

tissue.example: The doctor said the tissue in my knee was damaged.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生说我的膝盖组织受损了。

title.example: The title of his new book is very easy to remember.
title.exampleZh: 他那本新书的书名很容易记住。

toad.example: The toad sat quietly under the wet leaves in our garden.
toad.exampleZh: 那只蟾蜍静静地蹲在我们花园里潮湿的叶子下面。

toast.example: I like to eat toast with butter and jam for breakfast every morning.
toast.exampleZh: 我每天早上喜欢吃抹了黄油和果酱的烤面包。

token.example: She gave me a small gift token to show her thanks.
token.exampleZh: 她给了我一张小礼券以表示感谢。

tolerance.example: Learning tolerance helps people live together in a peaceful and friendly way.
tolerance.exampleZh: 学会宽容有助于人们和平友好地相处。

tolerant.example: My teacher is very tolerant of our mistakes in class.
tolerant.exampleZh: 我的老师对我们在课堂上的错误非常宽容。

tolerate.example: I cannot tolerate loud music late at night.
tolerate.exampleZh: 我无法忍受深夜大声播放音乐。

toll.example: The war took a heavy toll on the small town and its people.
toll.exampleZh: 这场战争给这个小镇和它的人民造成了沉重的代价。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了一个红色的番茄。

tomb.example: The old tomb stands quietly at the edge of the village.
tomb.exampleZh: 那座古老的坟墓静静地矗立在村庄边缘。

ton.example: I bought a ton of apples for the party last weekend.
ton.exampleZh: 上周末我为聚会买了大量的苹果。

tone.example: Her tone was calm and gentle as she spoke to the child.
tone.exampleZh: 她用平静而温和的语气对孩子说话。

tongue.example: The doctor asked me to open my mouth and show him my tongue.
tongue.exampleZh: 医生让我张开嘴，把我的舌头给他看。

tonic.example: The doctor said this tonic would help me feel stronger soon.
tonic.exampleZh: 医生说这种补药能帮我很快感觉更强壮。

tonight.example: I will finish my homework tonight so we can watch a movie.
tonight.exampleZh: 我今晚会完成作业，这样我们就能看场电影了。

tonsil.example: The doctor looked at my throat and said my left tonsil was swollen.
tonsil.exampleZh: 医生检查了我的喉咙，说我左边的扁桃体肿了。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for building things at home.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是家里做东西时有用的工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said I have a small hole in one tooth.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我有一颗牙齿上有个小洞。

top.example: The book is on the top shelf and you cannot reach it.
top.exampleZh: 这本书在最顶层的书架上，你够不到它。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is how to keep a healthy diet.
topic.exampleZh: 今天这节课的话题是如何保持健康的饮食。

topple.example: The strong wind toppled the old tree in the park last night.
topple.exampleZh: 昨晚大风把公园里的老树吹倒了。

torch.example: She used a torch to find her keys under the bed.
torch.exampleZh: 她用手电筒在床底下找钥匙。

torment.example: The memory of that day was a torment he could not forget.
torment.exampleZh: 那天的记忆是他无法忘记的一种折磨。

torrent.example: The heavy rain turned the small river into a rushing torrent.
torrent.exampleZh: 大雨把小河变成了湍急的激流。

torso.example: The statue is missing its head and arms, but the torso remains beautiful.
torso.exampleZh: 这座雕像缺失了头和手臂，但躯干部分依然很美。

tortoise.example: The tortoise moves very slowly across the grass in the garden.
tortoise.exampleZh: 那只陆龟在花园的草地上慢慢地爬行。

tortuous.example: The tortuous mountain road made our drive slow and difficult.
tortuous.exampleZh: 那条蜿蜒的山路让我们的车程又慢又艰难。

torture.example: The prisoners suffered terrible torture, and the pain still haunts them today.
torture.exampleZh: 囚犯们遭受了可怕的酷刑，那种痛苦至今仍萦绕在他们心头。

toss.example: She tossed the ball to her little brother and he caught it.
toss.exampleZh: 她把球扔给弟弟，他接住了。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要高。

totem.example: The eagle is a sacred totem for many Native American tribes.
totem.exampleZh: 鹰对许多美洲原住民部落来说是神圣的图腾。

touch.example: Please do not touch the paintings, and keep your voice down in the hall.
touch.exampleZh: 请不要触摸这些画，在展厅里请保持低声。

tough.example: This old pair of shoes is tough and will last for many years.
tough.exampleZh: 这双旧鞋很结实，能穿很多年。

tour.example: We took a tour of the old city and visited many famous places.
tour.exampleZh: 我们游览了老城，参观了许多著名的地方。

tournament.example: Our school team won three games in the basketball tournament last week.
tournament.exampleZh: 我们校队在 last week 的篮球锦标赛中赢了三场比赛。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the door.

toward(s).example: She walked slowly toward the open door and smiled at her old friend.
toward(s).exampleZh: 她慢慢地走向那扇敞开的门，对老朋友笑了笑。

towel.example: Please give me a clean towel to dry my hands and face.
towel.exampleZh: 请给我一条干净的毛巾来擦干我的手和脸。

tower.example: The old tower stands at the top of the hill.
tower.exampleZh: 那座古老的塔矗立在山顶上。

town.example: My grandmother lives in a small town near the river.
town.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在河边的一个小镇上。

toxic.example: The factory poured toxic waste into the river near our town.
toxic.exampleZh: 那家工厂把有毒废物排入了我们镇附近的河里。

toxin.example: This toxin can make people very sick if they eat the fish.
toxin.exampleZh: 如果人们吃了这种鱼，这种毒素会让人病得很重。

toy.example: The little boy got a new toy car for his fifth birthday.
toy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩在五岁生日时得到了一辆新的玩具车。

trace.example: The police traced the missing car to a small village.
trace.exampleZh: 警方追踪那辆失踪的汽车，一路查到了一个小村庄。

track.example: The police used the dog to track the missing child through the forest.
track.exampleZh: 警察用狗穿过森林追踪那个失踪的孩子。

tract.example: A long tract of forest covers the hills behind our small town.
tract.exampleZh: 我们小镇后面的山丘上覆盖着一大片森林。

tractor.example: The farmer uses a tractor to pull a heavy plow in his field.
tractor.exampleZh: 农民用拖拉机在田里拉重犁。

trade.example: My father works in the trade of fresh fruit and vegetables.
trade.exampleZh: 我父亲从事新鲜水果和蔬菜的贸易。

trademark.example: The company put its trademark on every product it sells.
trademark.exampleZh: 公司在它销售的每件产品上都印上了自己的商标。

tradition.example: In my family, it is a tradition to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
tradition.exampleZh: 在我家，除夕一起吃饺子是一个传统。

traditional.example: My grandmother still cooks traditional food for the family every Sunday.
traditional.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天仍然为家人做传统食物。

traffic.example: The heavy traffic in the city makes my morning drive very slow.
traffic.exampleZh: 城市里拥挤的交通让我早上开车很慢。

tragedy.example: The fire was a great tragedy for the small town.
tragedy.exampleZh: 这场火灾对这个小城镇来说是一场巨大的灾难。

trail.example: The dog followed the trail of the rabbit through the snow.
trail.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着兔子在雪地里的踪迹一路追踪。

train.example: She takes the train to work and trains new staff every morning.
train.exampleZh: 她每天坐火车上班，每天早上还培训新员工。

trait.example: Honesty is a good trait that people value in a friend.
trait.exampleZh: 诚实是人们在一个朋友身上所看重的良好特质。

traitor.example: Everyone called him a traitor after he sold the secret plans to the enemy.
traitor.exampleZh: 他把秘密计划卖给敌人后，大家都称他为叛徒。

trajectory.example: The rocket's trajectory took it far above the clouds.
trajectory.exampleZh: 火箭的弹道使它远远飞到了云层之上。

tram.example: We took a tram to the old part of the city.
tram.exampleZh: 我们乘有轨电车去了老城区。

tramp.example: The old man tramped through the deep snow to reach his small house.
tramp.exampleZh: 老人踩着厚厚的雪跋涉回到他的小房子。

trample.example: Please do not trample the flowers when you walk through the garden.
trample.exampleZh: 走过花园时请不要踩踏花朵。

trance.example: She sat by the window in a trance, watching the rain fall.
trance.exampleZh: 她恍惚地坐在窗边，看着雨落下。

tranquil.example: The lake was very tranquil in the early morning before the birds began to sing.
tranquil.exampleZh: 清晨鸟儿开始歌唱之前，湖面非常宁静。

transaction.example: The bank records every transaction in a secure computer system.
transaction.exampleZh: 银行把每一笔交易都记录在一个安全的计算机系统里。

transcend.example: Great music can transcend language and reach people from every country.
transcend.exampleZh: 伟大的音乐能超越语言，打动来自每个国家的人。

transcribe.example: The teacher asked us to transcribe the whole passage into our notebooks.
transcribe.exampleZh: 老师让我们把整段文章抄写到笔记本里。

transcript.example: The school sent my transcript to the university last week.
transcript.exampleZh: 学校上周把我的成绩单寄给了那所大学。

transfer.example: He will transfer to a new school next month.
transfer.exampleZh: 他下个月将转学到一所新学校。

transform.example: The internet has transformed the way people learn and share ideas.
transform.exampleZh: 互联网改变了人们学习和分享想法的方式。

transformer.example: The transformer near our house makes a low sound at night.
transformer.exampleZh: 我们家附近的变压器在夜里发出低沉的声音。

transfusion.example: The doctor gave him a blood transfusion after the accident.
transfusion.exampleZh: 事故后医生给他输了血。

transient.example: The pain was transient and went away after a short rest.
transient.exampleZh: 这种疼痛是短暂的，休息一会儿就消失了。

transistor.example: This small transistor helps the radio work without using much power.
transistor.exampleZh: 这个小晶体管帮助收音机工作，而且耗电不多。

transit.example: The city's light rail transit makes it easy to travel without a car.
transit.exampleZh: 这座城市的轻轨交通让人们无需开车也能方便出行。

transition.example: The transition from school to work can be hard for young people.
transition.exampleZh: 从学校到工作的过渡对年轻人来说可能很艰难。

translate.example: Can you translate this short letter into English for me?
translate.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这封短信翻译成英语吗？

transmission.example: The transmission of this disease is often caused by dirty water.
transmission.exampleZh: 这种疾病的传播常常是由脏水引起的。

transmit.example: Mosquitoes can transmit this disease to people through their bites.
transmit.exampleZh: 蚊子可以通过叮咬把这种疾病传播给人们。

transparent.example: The glass bottle is transparent, so you can see the water inside.
transparent.exampleZh: 这个玻璃瓶是透明的，所以你能看到里面的水。

transplant.example: The doctor will transplant the healthy kidney into the sick patient tomorrow.
transplant.exampleZh: 医生明天将把健康的肾脏移植到这位病人体内。

transport.example: The city needs a better transport system for people who work downtown.
transport.exampleZh: 这座城市需要一套更好的交通系统，供在市中心工作的人使用。

trap.example: The hunters set a trap to catch the fox.
trap.exampleZh: 猎人们设了一个陷阱来抓那只狐狸。

trash.example: Please put the empty bottles and other trash in the bin outside.
trash.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子和其他垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶里。

travel.example: My parents travel to many countries for work every year.
travel.exampleZh: 我父母每年因工作去许多国家旅行。

traverse.example: We had to traverse the wide desert before reaching the small town.
traverse.exampleZh: 我们不得不穿越广阔的沙漠才能到达那个小镇。

tray.example: She put the cups on a tray and carried them to the table.
tray.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌子旁。

treacherous.example: The treacherous road was dangerous after the heavy rain.
treacherous.exampleZh: 大雨过后，那条路危险又变幻莫测。

tread.example: Please don't tread on the flowers when you walk through the garden.
tread.exampleZh: 你穿过花园时请不要踩到花。

treason.example: He was found guilty of treason after he sold secret plans to another country.
treason.exampleZh: 他把秘密计划卖给另一个国家后，被判犯有叛国罪。

treasure.example: She keeps her old letters as a treasure and reads them every year.
treasure.exampleZh: 她把旧信件当作珍宝珍藏，每年都会读一读。

treat.example: The kind doctor will treat my little brother with care today.
treat.exampleZh: 这位善良的医生今天会细心治疗我的弟弟。

treatise.example: He wrote a long treatise on the history of Chinese tea.
treatise.exampleZh: 他写了一篇关于中国茶历史的长篇论文。

treatment.example: The doctor said my treatment would take about two weeks.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生说我的治疗大约需要两周。

treaty.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after many years of war.
treaty.exampleZh: 两国在多年战争后签署了一项和平条约。

tree.example: There is a big tree in front of our house.
tree.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵大树。

trek.example: They trekked through the mountains for two days to reach the small village.
trek.exampleZh: 他们徒步穿越群山两天，才到达那个小村庄。

tremble.example: Her hands tremble with cold as she waits for the bus.
tremble.exampleZh: 她在等公交车时，双手冷得发抖。

tremendous.example: The storm caused tremendous damage to the small village last night.
tremendous.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨给这个小村庄造成了巨大的损失。

trench.example: The workers dug a deep trench along the side of the road.
trench.exampleZh: 工人们在路边挖了一条很深的沟。

trend.example: There is a growing trend of people working from home.
trend.exampleZh: 在家工作的人越来越多，这已成为一种趋势。

trial.example: The new drug is still under trial and doctors are watching the results.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药仍在试验中，医生们正在观察结果。

triangle.example: The children drew a big triangle on the paper with their colored pencils.
triangle.exampleZh: 孩子们用彩色铅笔在纸上画了一个大三角形。

tribal.example: The old man still follows the tribal rules of his small village.
tribal.exampleZh: 那位老人仍然遵守他小村庄的部落规矩。

tribe.example: The small tribe lived near the river and shared their food every day.
tribe.exampleZh: 这个小部落住在河边，每天分享食物。

tributary.example: The small river is a tributary of the large river nearby.
tributary.exampleZh: 这条小河是附近那条大河的支流。

tribute.example: This song is a tribute to all the teachers who helped us.
tribute.exampleZh: 这首歌是对所有帮助过我们的老师的致敬。

trick.example: He used a clever trick to open the old box.
trick.exampleZh: 他用了一个巧妙的窍门打开了那个旧箱子。
