trickle.example: Water began to trickle from the old pipe onto the floor.
trickle.exampleZh: 水开始从旧管子里滴到地板上。

tricky.example: This tricky question is harder than it looks at first.
tricky.exampleZh: 这个棘手的问题比乍看之下要难。

trifle.example: Don't waste time arguing about such a trifle as who sits where.
trifle.exampleZh: 别为谁坐哪儿这种小事浪费时间争吵。

trigger.example: The alarm can trigger a loud noise and wake everyone up.
trigger.exampleZh: 这个警报器会触发巨大的声响，把所有人都吵醒。

trill.example: The little bird sang a sweet trill in the garden this morning.
trill.exampleZh: 今天早晨，那只小鸟在花园里唱出甜美的颤音。

trilobite.example: The trilobite lived in the sea long before the age of dinosaurs.
trilobite.exampleZh: 三叶虫在恐龙时代之前的很久以前就生活在海洋里。

trilogy.example: The director's new trilogy tells one long story across three separate films.
trilogy.exampleZh: 这位导演的新三部曲用三部独立的电影讲述了一个漫长的故事。

trim.example: She trim the bushes in the garden every Sunday morning.
trim.exampleZh: 她每周日早上修剪花园里的灌木。

trinity.example: The three friends formed a trinity of trust, laughter and shared dreams.
trinity.exampleZh: 这三个朋友组成了信任、欢笑与共同梦想的三位一体。

trip.example: Our trip to the beach was fun, but I tripped on a rock.
trip.exampleZh: 我们的海滩之行很有趣，但我在石头上绊了一下。

triple.example: The company's profits tripled in just three years after the new manager arrived.
triple.exampleZh: 新经理到来后，公司的利润在短短三年内增至三倍。

trite.example: His speech was full of trite ideas that everyone had heard before.
trite.exampleZh: 他的演讲充满了人人都听过的老一套观点。

triumph.example: Her hard work and patience finally brought triumph after many long years.
triumph.exampleZh: 她的努力和耐心在多年之后终于带来了胜利。

triumphant.example: The triumphant team ran off the field with happy smiles.
triumphant.exampleZh: 得胜的队伍带着开心的笑容跑下了球场。

trivial.example: Do not waste time on trivial problems like this one.
trivial.exampleZh: 不要在这种微不足道的问题上浪费时间。

trolley.example: She put the heavy bags in a trolley and pushed it to the car.
trolley.exampleZh: 她把沉重的袋子放进手推车里，然后把它推到车旁。

troop.example: A large troop of soldiers marched slowly through the small town this morning.
troop.exampleZh: 一大队士兵今天早上缓慢地穿过这座小镇。

trophic.example: Scientists study trophic levels to understand how energy moves through the food chain.
trophic.exampleZh: 科学家研究营养级，以了解能量如何在食物链中传递。

trophy.example: She won a big trophy at the school sports event last week.
trophy.exampleZh: 她上周在学校运动会上赢得了一个大奖杯。

tropical.example: Tropical weather is hot and wet all year round.
tropical.exampleZh: 热带天气一年到头又热又潮湿。

trot.example: The horse began to trot slowly along the quiet country road.
trot.exampleZh: 那匹马开始沿着安静的乡间小路慢慢小跑。

trouble.example: I had some trouble finding your house, but I got here at last.
trouble.exampleZh: 我找你家费了点劲，但最后还是到了。

trough.example: The water in the trough was too low for the horses to drink.
trough.exampleZh: 槽里的水太浅了，马喝不到。

troupe.example: The dance troupe will perform in our city next week.
troupe.exampleZh: 这个舞蹈团下周将在我们城市演出。

trousers.example: He put on his new trousers and went to work.
trousers.exampleZh: 他穿上新裤子去上班了。

trout.example: We caught a big trout in the cold river last summer.
trout.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在冰冷的河里抓到了一条大鳟鱼。

truce.example: The two sides agreed to a truce so they could talk about peace.
truce.exampleZh: 双方同意休战，以便讨论和平问题。

truck.example: The truck is carrying a lot of boxes to the city.
truck.exampleZh: 这辆卡车正载着许多箱子前往城里。

trudge.example: We had to trudge through the deep snow to reach the old house.
trudge.exampleZh: 我们不得不艰难地穿过深雪，才能到达那栋老房子。

true.example: It is true that she works hard every day after school.
true.exampleZh: 她每天放学后都努力学习，这是真的。

truly.example: She is truly happy to see her old friends again.
truly.exampleZh: 再次见到老朋友，她真的非常开心。

trumpet.example: The boy played a loud trumpet in the school band.
trumpet.exampleZh: 那个男孩在学校乐队里吹响了响亮的喇叭。

trunk.example: He put his heavy bag in the trunk of the car.
trunk.exampleZh: 他把沉重的包放进了汽车的后备箱。

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he never lies to me.
trust.exampleZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为他从不对我说谎。

trustee.example: The trustee manages the money for the children until they grow up.
trustee.exampleZh: 受托人管理这笔钱，直到孩子们长大。

truth.example: She finally told me the truth about what happened last night.
truth.exampleZh: 她终于告诉了我昨晚发生的事的真相。

try.example: I will try to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
try.exampleZh: 我会努力在今晚晚饭前完成作业。

tub.example: She filled the tub with warm water and washed her hair.
tub.exampleZh: 她往浴缸里放满温水，然后洗了头发。

tube.example: She put the small tube of cream into her bag.
tube.exampleZh: 她把那管小支的乳霜放进了包里。

tuck.example: She tucked the map into her bag and ran for the bus.
tuck.exampleZh: 她把地图塞进包里，然后跑去赶公交车。

tuft.example: A small tuft of gray hair stuck out from under his hat.
tuft.exampleZh: 一小簇灰白的头发从他的帽子下面翘了出来。

tug.example: The children tug the rope hard during the tug-of-war game.
tug.exampleZh: 拔河比赛中，孩子们用力拉着绳子。

tuition.example: My parents pay my tuition, so I must study hard this year.
tuition.exampleZh: 我父母为我付学费，所以今年我必须努力学习。

tulip.example: Every spring, the red tulips in our garden open wide and bright.
tulip.exampleZh: 每年春天，我们花园里的红色郁金香都会盛开，鲜艳夺目。

tumble.example: The little boy tumbled down the stairs but was not hurt.
tumble.exampleZh: 小男孩从楼梯上摔了下来，但没有受伤。

tumor.example: The doctor found a small tumor in his left lung last week.
tumor.exampleZh: 上周医生在他的左肺发现了一个小肿瘤。

tundra.example: Few trees can grow on the cold tundra near the top of the world.
tundra.exampleZh: 在世界顶端附近的寒冷苔原上，几乎没有树木能够生长。

tune.example: She hummed a soft tune while washing the dishes.
tune.exampleZh: 她一边洗碗一边轻轻哼着曲子。

tunnel.example: The train goes through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过山下一段长长的隧道。

turbine.example: The turbine spins fast when the hot wind blows through it.
turbine.exampleZh: 当热风穿过涡轮机时，它转得很快。

turbulence.example: The flight was rough because of strong turbulence over the mountains.
turbulence.exampleZh: 由于山地上空的强烈湍流，飞行十分颠簸。

turbulent.example: The river is turbulent after the heavy rain.

turmoil.example: The country was in turmoil after the sudden change of government.
turmoil.exampleZh: 政府突然更迭后，这个国家陷入了动荡。

turn.example: Please turn left at the next corner and you will see the bank.
turn.exampleZh: 请在下一个路口左转，你就会看到那家银行。

turnover.example: The company reported a higher turnover this year and hired fewer new staff.
turnover.exampleZh: 公司今年报告了更高的营业额，并且招聘的新员工更少。

turret.example: The old castle has a tall turret on its highest wall.
turret.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡最高的墙上有一座高高的塔楼。

turtle.example: A turtle slowly walked across the warm sand toward the sea.
turtle.exampleZh: 一只海龟慢慢地穿过温暖的沙滩，朝大海爬去。

tusk.example: The elephant has a long white tusk on each side of its mouth.
tusk.exampleZh: 这头大象嘴的两侧各有一根长长的白色象牙。

tutor.example: My tutor helps me with math after school every Wednesday.
tutor.exampleZh: 我的家教每周三放学后帮我辅导数学。

twelve.example: My little sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
twelve.exampleZh: 我的小妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

twenty.example: My sister is twenty years old and studies at a big school.
twenty.exampleZh: 我姐姐二十岁，在一所大学校读书。

twice.example: I read this book twice last year.
twice.exampleZh: 我去年把这本小说读了两遍。

twig.example: She broke a small twig off the tree and held it in her hand.
twig.exampleZh: 她从树上折下一根小细枝，握在手里。

twilight.example: The sky turned soft and pink in the twilight.
twilight.exampleZh: 暮色中，天空变得柔和而粉红。

twin.example: My twin brother and I look the same but act very differently.
twin.exampleZh: 我的双胞胎哥哥和我长得一样，但性格却很不相同。

twist.example: She had to twist the lid hard to open the jar.
twist.exampleZh: 她得用力扭开瓶盖才能打开这个罐子。

twitch.example: The muscle in his leg began to twitch after the long run.
twitch.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他腿上的肌肉开始抽搐。

two.example: I have two small cats and one big dog at home.
two.exampleZh: 我家里有两只小猫和一只大狗。

type.example: What type of music do you like to listen to?
type.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

typewriter.example: My grandfather wrote all his letters on an old typewriter.
typewriter.exampleZh: 我祖父所有的信都是用一台旧打字机写的。

typhoon.example: The typhoon hit the small island and destroyed many houses near the coast.
typhoon.exampleZh: 台风袭击了这座小岛，摧毁了海岸附近的许多房屋。

typical.example: This is a typical day in the life of a busy student.
typical.exampleZh: 这是一个忙碌学生生活中典型的一天。

typist.example: The typist typed all the letters quickly before the meeting began.
typist.exampleZh: 打字员在会议开始前快速打完了所有信件。

tyranny.example: The people fought together to end the tyranny of the cruel king.
tyranny.exampleZh: 人民团结起来，终结了那位残暴国王的暴政。

tyrant.example: The old king was a cruel tyrant, so the people feared him.
tyrant.exampleZh: 老国王是个残暴的暴君，所以人民都害怕他。

ubiquitous.example: Smartphones are now ubiquitous in our daily life, even in small towns.
ubiquitous.exampleZh: 如今智能手机在我们的日常生活中无处不在，即使在小城镇也是如此。

ulcer.example: The doctor said the ulcer in his stomach would heal with rest.
ulcer.exampleZh: 医生说，他胃里的溃疡通过休息会愈合。

ultimate.example: Winning that game was the team's ultimate goal last season.
ultimate.exampleZh: 赢下那场比赛是球队上赛季的最终目标。

ultra.example: He has ultra strict rules about using phones at the dinner table.
ultra.exampleZh: 他对在餐桌上使用手机有极其严格的规定。

ultrasonic.example: The doctor used an ultrasonic machine to look at the baby.
ultrasonic.exampleZh: 医生用超声波仪器查看胎儿。

umbrella.example: I always take an umbrella with me when the sky looks dark.
umbrella.exampleZh: 天空看起来阴沉时，我总是随身带把雨伞。

unable.example: I am unable to answer your question right now.
unable.exampleZh: 我现在无法回答你的问题。

unanimous.example: The class was unanimous in choosing the museum for the trip.
unanimous.exampleZh: 全班一致同意选择博物馆作为出行地点。

unavailable.example: The book is unavailable because someone borrowed it from the library.
unavailable.exampleZh: 这本书无法借到，因为有人已经从图书馆把它借走了。

unavoidable.example: Some mistakes are unavoidable when you learn a new language.
unavoidable.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言时，有些错误是不可避免的。

unaware.example: I was unaware of the meeting until my friend told me.
unaware.exampleZh: 直到朋友告诉我，我才知道有那个会议。

unbearable.example: The heat in the small room was unbearable, so we opened all the windows.
unbearable.exampleZh: 小房间里的热气让人难以忍受，于是我们把所有窗户都打开了。

unbelievable.example: It is unbelievable that he finished the whole race in one hour.
unbelievable.exampleZh: 他一小时内跑完了整场比赛，真是难以置信。

unbiased.example: A good judge must always stay unbiased when listening to both sides.
unbiased.exampleZh: 一个好的法官在听取双方意见时必须始终保持公正。

uncanny.example: It is uncanny how much he looks like his father.
uncanny.exampleZh: 他长得像他父亲的程度真是太不可思议了。

uncertain.example: I am uncertain about the answer to this question.
uncertain.exampleZh: 我对这个问题的答案不确定。

uncertainty.example: There is some uncertainty about the date of the meeting.
uncertainty.exampleZh: 会议日期还有些不确定。

uncle.example: My uncle lives in a small town near the sea.
uncle.exampleZh: 我的叔叔住在海边的一个小镇上。

uncomfortable.example: I feel uncomfortable when I sit in this hard chair all day.
uncomfortable.exampleZh: 整天坐在这把硬椅子上，我感到很不舒服。

uncommon.example: It is uncommon to see snow in this warm city.
uncommon.exampleZh: 在这座温暖的城市里看到雪是不寻常的。

unconscious.example: He was unconscious after the accident and did not wake up until the next morning.
unconscious.exampleZh: 事故后他失去了知觉，直到第二天早上才醒来。

uncover.example: The police worked hard to uncover the truth behind the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方努力揭露那笔失踪钱款背后的真相。

undergo.example: She will undergo surgery next week at a hospital in the city.
undergo.exampleZh: 她下周将在城里的一家医院接受手术。

undergraduate.example: My sister is an undergraduate at a small university near our home.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 我姐姐是我们家附近一所小型大学里的本科生。

underground.example: The underground room stays cool in summer and warm in winter.
underground.exampleZh: 这个地下房间夏天凉爽，冬天温暖。

underlie.example: Many small choices underlie the success of a big project.
underlie.exampleZh: 许多小的选择构成了一个大项目成功的基础。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this sentence before you read it again.
underline.exampleZh: 请在你再次阅读之前，给这个句子中的重要单词划下划线。

underlying.example: The underlying problem is that we do not have enough money.
underlying.exampleZh: 根本问题是我们没有足够的钱。

undermine.example: His friends' constant criticism slowly undermined his confidence and made him doubt himself.
undermine.exampleZh: 朋友们不断的批评逐渐削弱了他的自信，使他开始怀疑自己。

underneath.example: The cat is sleeping underneath the old wooden table.
underneath.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在旧木桌下面。

underpin.example: Strong data underpins the report and makes its conclusions easier to trust.
underpin.exampleZh: 可靠的数据支撑着这份报告，使其结论更容易让人信服。

underscore.example: The teacher underscored the need for daily practice in her short speech.
underscore.exampleZh: 老师在简短的讲话中强调了每天练习的必要性。

underside.example: The underside of the old boat was covered with green sea plants.
underside.exampleZh: 这条旧船的下侧长满了绿色的海草。

understand.example: I do not understand this question, so please explain it again.
understand.exampleZh: 我不明白这个问题，请再解释一遍。

understanding.example: Her understanding of the problem helped the whole team find a simple solution.
understanding.exampleZh: 她对问题的理解帮助整个团队找到了一个简单的解决方案。

understate.example: He tends to understate the problem, so we should check the facts ourselves.
understate.exampleZh: 他往往会把问题说得轻一些，所以我们应该自己去核实事实。

undertake.example: The team will undertake a new project next month.
undertake.exampleZh: 团队下个月将着手一个新项目。

undertaking.example: Starting a small business is a difficult undertaking for young people.
undertaking.exampleZh: 对年轻人来说，创办一家小企业是一项艰难的事业。

underworld.example: The police are trying to stop the underworld from selling drugs.
underworld.exampleZh: 警方正试图阻止黑社会贩卖毒品。

undesirable.example: Loud music late at night is undesirable for most neighbors.
undesirable.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐对大多数邻居来说是不受欢迎的。

undo.example: You can undo the last change with one click.
undo.exampleZh: 你可以一键撤销上一次的更改。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best singer in our small school band.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是我们这个小小校园乐队里最好的歌手。

undress.example: The little boy began to undress before his bath.
undress.exampleZh: 小男孩在洗澡前开始脱衣服。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy when the stranger walked into the quiet room.
uneasy.exampleZh: 当陌生人走进安静的房间时，她感到不安。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate in our city has gone up this year.
unemployment.exampleZh: 我们城市的失业率今年上升了。

uneven.example: The table is uneven, so the cups keep sliding to one side.
uneven.exampleZh: 这张桌子不平，所以杯子总是往一边滑。

unexpected.example: Her unexpected visit made everyone in the office very happy.
unexpected.exampleZh: 她意外的来访让办公室里的每个人都很高兴。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame him for the mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪他是不公平的。

unfamiliar.example: This street is unfamiliar to me, so please walk with me.
unfamiliar.exampleZh: 这条街对我来说很陌生，请和我一起走。

unfit.example: He is unfit for this heavy job because of his poor health.
unfit.exampleZh: 由于身体不好，他不适合这份繁重的工作。

unfold.example: As the story begins to unfold, we learn more about the family.
unfold.exampleZh: 随着故事逐渐展开，我们对这个家庭有了更多了解。

unfolding.example: The unfolding of the story kept the children quiet all afternoon.
unfolding.exampleZh: 故事的逐渐展开让孩子们整个下午都安静地听着。

unfortunate.example: It was unfortunate that we missed the last train home.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 很遗憾我们错过了回家的最后一班火车。

unfounded.example: His fear about the new job was completely unfounded, and everyone welcomed him warmly.
unfounded.exampleZh: 他对新工作的担心完全没有根据，每个人都热情地欢迎他。

unidentified.example: The police found an unidentified man near the old train station last night.
unidentified.exampleZh: 警方昨晚在旧火车站附近发现了一名身份不明的男子。

uniform.example: All the students in my class wear the same blue school uniform.
uniform.exampleZh: 我们班所有学生都穿一样的蓝色校服。

unify.example: The new leader wants to unify the team before the big project starts.
unify.exampleZh: 新领导希望在大项目开始前让团队团结一致。

unilateral.example: The company made a unilateral decision to close the factory without asking the workers.
unilateral.exampleZh: 公司单方面决定关闭工厂，没有征求工人们的意见。

uninitiated.example: To the uninitiated, the rules of this game seem very strange.
uninitiated.exampleZh: 对入门者来说，这个游戏的规则显得很奇怪。

union.example: The workers formed a union to ask for better pay.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了一个工会，要求更好的薪酬。

unique.example: Each person's fingerprint is unique, so the police can use it to find people.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的，因此警方可以用它来找到人。

unit.example: The first unit of this book is easy for most students.
unit.exampleZh: 这本书的第一单元对大多数学生来说很容易。

unite.example: The two small teams will unite to finish the project on time.
unite.exampleZh: 这两个小团队将联合起来，按时完成这个项目。

unity.example: The team showed great unity during the difficult project and finished it on time.
unity.exampleZh: 团队在艰难的项目中表现出极大的团结，并按时完成了任务。

universal.example: Music is a universal language that people all over the world can enjoy.
universal.exampleZh: 音乐是一种普遍的语言，全世界的人都能欣赏。

universe.example: Scientists believe our universe is still expanding and holds many unknown things.
universe.exampleZh: 科学家认为我们的宇宙仍在膨胀，其中包含许多未知的事物。

university.example: My sister studies English at a big university in Beijing.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在北京的一所大型综合性大学学习英语。

unjust.example: It is unjust to punish him for a mistake he did not make.
unjust.exampleZh: 因为一个他没犯的错误而惩罚他是不公正的。

unkind.example: It is unkind to laugh at someone when they make a mistake.
unkind.exampleZh: 当别人犯错时嘲笑他们是不仁慈的。

unknown.example: The cause of the fire is still unknown to the police.
unknown.exampleZh: 火灾的原因对警方来说仍然未知。

unlawful.example: It is unlawful to park your car on this street.
unlawful.exampleZh: 在这条街上停车是违法的。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则不能出去。

unlike.example: Unlike his brother, Tom likes to read books at home.
unlike.exampleZh: 与他哥哥不同，汤姆喜欢在家读书。

unlikely.example: It is unlikely that he will come to school today.
unlikely.exampleZh: 他今天不太可能来学校。

unlimited.example: The internet gives students unlimited access to information and learning tools.
unlimited.exampleZh: 互联网为学生提供了无限获取信息和学习工具的机会。

unload.example: The workers will unload the boxes from the truck this morning.
unload.exampleZh: 工人们今天上午会从卡车上卸下这些箱子。

unlock.example: She used the old key to unlock the front door and went inside.
unlock.exampleZh: 她用那把旧钥匙打开了前门，然后走了进去。

unmatched.example: Her skill at the piano is unmatched by anyone in our small town.
unmatched.exampleZh: 她弹钢琴的技艺在我们这个小镇上无人能比。

unnatural.example: It feels unnatural to wear a heavy coat in hot summer weather.
unnatural.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏天穿厚外套让人感觉很不自然。

unnecessary.example: Buying a second car is unnecessary for our small family.
unnecessary.exampleZh: 对我们这个小家庭来说，再买一辆车是不必要的。

unofficial.example: This is an unofficial website, so please do not trust all the information.
unofficial.exampleZh: 这是一个非官方网站，所以请不要完全相信上面的所有信息。

unpack.example: Let's unpack the box and see what is inside.
unpack.exampleZh: 我们打开箱子看看里面有什么吧。

unpleasant.example: The weather was unpleasant, so we stayed inside all day.
unpleasant.exampleZh: 天气令人不快，所以我们整天都待在屋里。

unprecedented.example: The city saw unprecedented growth in its population last year.
unprecedented.exampleZh: 这座城市去年的人口出现了前所未有的增长。

unpredictable.example: The weather here is unpredictable, so always bring an umbrella with you.
unpredictable.exampleZh: 这里的天气捉摸不定，所以总要随身带把伞。

unqualified.example: He is unqualified for this job because he has no experience.
unqualified.exampleZh: 他没有经验，所以不能胜任这份工作。

unravel.example: The detective worked hard to unravel the mystery before the trial.
unravel.exampleZh: 侦探在审判前努力解开这个谜团。

unrealistic.example: It is unrealistic to think you can learn a language in one week.
unrealistic.exampleZh: 认为一周就能学会一门语言是不切实际的。

unreasonable.example: It is unreasonable to blame him for the mistake.
unreasonable.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪他是不合理的。

unreasonably.example: She was unreasonably angry with me for such a small mistake.
unreasonably.exampleZh: 因为这么小的一个错误，她对我发了一通不合理的脾气。

unreliable.example: This old car is unreliable, so I take the bus to work.
unreliable.exampleZh: 这辆旧车不可靠，所以我坐公交车上班。

unrest.example: There was growing unrest in the city after the sudden price rise.
unrest.exampleZh: 物价突然上涨后，这座城市的动荡不断加剧。

unsettle.example: The sudden news began to unsettle the children.
unsettle.exampleZh: 这个突如其来的消息开始让孩子们感到不安。

unsightly.example: The old factory is unsightly, so the town plans to paint it green.
unsightly.exampleZh: 那座旧工厂很难看，所以镇上打算把它刷成绿色。

unsophisticated.example: She is unsophisticated about city life but very kind.
unsophisticated.exampleZh: 她对城市生活不太懂世故，但非常善良。

unstable.example: The old bridge is unstable and too dangerous for people to cross.
unstable.exampleZh: 这座旧桥不稳定，人们过桥太危险了。

unsteady.example: The old wooden table is unsteady, so please do not put the hot soup on it.
unsteady.exampleZh: 那张旧木桌摇摇晃晃的，所以请不要把热汤放在上面。

unsuitable.example: This movie is unsuitable for young children.
unsuitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合幼童观看。

untie.example: She bent down to untie her shoes before going into the house.
untie.exampleZh: 她弯下腰解开鞋带，然后才走进屋里。

until.example: We waited at the station until the last train arrived.
until.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到达。

unusual.example: It is unusual to see snow in this warm city.
unusual.exampleZh: 在这座温暖的城市里看到雪是不寻常的。

unveil.example: The company will unveil its new phone at the event tomorrow.
unveil.exampleZh: 公司将在明天的活动上首次展示它的新手机。

unwilling.example: She was unwilling to answer the question in front of everyone.
unwilling.exampleZh: 她不愿意在大家面前回答这个问题。

unwind.example: After a long week at work, I like to unwind with a warm bath.
unwind.exampleZh: 工作了一整周后，我喜欢用热水澡来放松一下。

up-to-date.example: Her phone is always up-to-date with the newest apps and games.
up-to-date.exampleZh: 她的手机总是装着最新的应用和游戏。

upbringing.example: Her good upbringing taught her to be kind to others.
upbringing.exampleZh: 她良好的教养教会她要善待他人。

upcoming.example: We are excited about the upcoming school trip next week.
upcoming.exampleZh: 我们对下周即将到来的学校旅行感到兴奋。

update.example: Please update your password and check the latest update on the website.
update.exampleZh: 请更新你的密码，并查看网站上的最新更新。

upgrade.example: We plan to upgrade our old computers next month to make work faster.
upgrade.exampleZh: 我们计划下个月升级旧电脑，让工作更快。

upheaval.example: The war caused great upheaval in the small country and changed many lives.
upheaval.exampleZh: 战争给这个小国带来了巨大的动乱，改变了许多人的生活。

uphold.example: The court decided to uphold the original ruling after a long review.
uphold.exampleZh: 经过长时间审查后，法院决定维持原判。

upkeep.example: The upkeep of this old house costs a lot of money.
upkeep.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的维修需要花很多钱。

upon.example: Upon arriving home, she put the keys on the table.
upon.exampleZh: 一到家，她就把钥匙放在了桌子上。

upper.example: The books are on the upper shelf near the window.
upper.exampleZh: 那些书在窗户附近的上层书架上。

upright.example: The tall tree stood upright after the strong wind.
upright.exampleZh: 那棵高树在强风过后依然直立着。

uprising.example: The people's uprising was quickly stopped by the king's soldiers.
uprising.exampleZh: 人民的起义很快被国王的士兵镇压了。

uproar.example: The whole room was in an uproar after the teacher announced the surprise test.
uproar.exampleZh: 老师宣布突击考试后，整个教室一片骚动。

uproot.example: The storm uprooted several large trees on our quiet street last night.
uproot.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨把我们安静街道上的几棵大树连根拔起了。

upset.example: The bad news upset her, and she could not sleep that night.
upset.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她很难过，她那天晚上睡不着。

upshot.example: The upshot of our long talk was that we agreed to try again.
upshot.exampleZh: 我们长谈的结果是，我们同意再试一次。

upside.example: There is an upside to working from home every day.
upside.exampleZh: 每天在家工作也有它的好处。

upstairs.example: She ran upstairs to get her phone and then came back down.
upstairs.exampleZh: 她跑上楼去拿手机，然后又下来了。

upstanding.example: He is an upstanding man who always tells the truth to everyone.
upstanding.exampleZh: 他是一个诚实正直的人，总是对每个人说真话。

upstart.example: The young upstart bought a big house but still had no manners.
upstart.exampleZh: 那个年轻的暴发户买了大房子，却依然没有礼貌。

upsurge.example: There has been a sudden upsurge in demand for electric cars.
upsurge.exampleZh: 电动汽车的需求突然激增。

uptight.example: My father gets uptight when guests arrive late for dinner.
uptight.exampleZh: 客人晚饭迟到时，我父亲就会变得紧张。

upward.example: The company reported upward growth in sales this year.
upward.exampleZh: 公司今年报告了销售额的上升增长。

uranium.example: The country uses uranium to make power for many homes.
uranium.exampleZh: 这个国家用铀为许多家庭发电。

urban.example: The urban area has many shops, parks and busy streets.
urban.exampleZh: 城区有许多商店、公园和繁忙的街道。

urge.example: My teacher urged me to read more books before the exam.
urge.exampleZh: 老师敦促我在考试前多读些书。

urgent.example: She sent an urgent message to the doctor about her sick child.
urgent.exampleZh: 她给医生发了一条紧急消息，说的是她生病的孩子。

usable.example: This old phone is still usable even after five years.
usable.exampleZh: 这部旧手机用了五年之后仍然可以使用。

usage.example: The teacher explained the correct usage of this word to us.
usage.exampleZh: 老师向我们讲解了这个词的正确用法。

use.example: Please use the stairs instead of the lift when you go up.
use.exampleZh: 上楼时请走楼梯，不要坐电梯。

useful.example: This small book is very useful for learning English words.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小书对学习英语单词非常有用。

useless.example: This old phone is useless because it cannot connect to the internet.
useless.exampleZh: 这部旧手机毫无用处，因为它无法连接互联网。

usual.example: I got up earlier than usual to catch the first bus.
usual.exampleZh: 我比平常起得早，为了赶上第一班公交车。

utensil.example: Please wash the dirty kitchen utensils before you start cooking dinner.
utensil.exampleZh: 请在开始做晚饭前把这些脏的厨房用具洗干净。

utility.example: The utility of this simple tool is clear to everyone.
utility.exampleZh: 这个简单工具的实用性对每个人来说都很明显。

utilize.example: We can utilize the free time after class to practice English.
utilize.exampleZh: 我们可以利用课后的空闲时间练习英语。

utmost.example: She listened to the doctor's advice with the utmost care and attention.
utmost.exampleZh: 她极其认真地听取了医生的建议。

utopia.example: Many people dream of a utopia where everyone is happy and no one is poor.
utopia.exampleZh: 许多人梦想有一个乌托邦，在那里人人都幸福，没有人贫穷。

utter.example: She did not utter a word during the whole meeting, and her face stayed completely calm.
utter.exampleZh: 整个会议期间她一句话也没说，脸上始终十分平静。

vacant.example: The seat next to me was vacant, so I sat down there.
vacant.exampleZh: 我旁边的座位是空的，所以我就坐在了那里。

vacate.example: We must vacate the office before the new company moves in.
vacate.exampleZh: 我们必须在新的公司搬进来之前空出这间办公室。

vacation.example: We are planning a long vacation to the beach next summer.
vacation.exampleZh: 我们打算明年夏天去海边度一个长假。

vaccine.example: The doctor gave the child a vaccine to keep her healthy.
vaccine.exampleZh: 医生给孩子打了疫苗，让她保持健康。

vacuum.example: The scientist used a pump to remove all the air and create a vacuum.
vacuum.exampleZh: 科学家用泵抽走所有空气，制造出一个真空。

vague.example: His answer was vague, so nobody knew what he really meant.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很模糊，所以没人知道他真正想表达什么。

vain.example: It was vain to try to change his mind about the plan.
vain.exampleZh: 试图改变他对这个计划的想法是徒劳的。

valid.example: Your ticket is valid for three months from the date of purchase.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票自购买之日起三个月内有效。

validate.example: We need to validate the results before we share them.
validate.exampleZh: 在分享这些结果之前，我们需要先验证它们。

valley.example: The river flows through the green valley and past the small village.
valley.exampleZh: 这条河流经绿色的山谷，流过那个小村庄。

value.example: Parents should teach their children the value of hard work and honesty.
value.exampleZh: 父母应该教孩子努力工作和诚实的重要性。

valve.example: The doctor said the valve in his heart was not working well.
valve.exampleZh: 医生说他的心脏瓣膜工作不正常。

van.example: The driver parked the van in front of our house.
van.exampleZh: 司机把厢式货车停在了我们家门口。

vanish.example: The cat ran into the garden and vanished behind the tall green trees.
vanish.exampleZh: 那只猫跑进花园，消失在高大的绿树后面。

vanity.example: Her vanity made her check the mirror every five minutes.
vanity.exampleZh: 她的虚荣心让她每五分钟就照一次镜子。

vapor.example: The hot water in the pot turned into vapor and rose into the air.
vapor.exampleZh: 锅里的热水变成了蒸汽，升到了空中。

variable.example: The results are variable, so we must check the data again.
variable.exampleZh: 结果是可变的，所以我们必须再检查一次数据。

variant.example: This variant of the virus spreads faster than the original one.
variant.exampleZh: 这种病毒的变体比原始毒株传播得更快。

variation.example: There is a small variation in price between the two shops.
variation.exampleZh: 这两家店的价格有一点小差异。

variety.example: This shop sells a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables.
variety.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

various.example: The store sells various kinds of fruit at low prices.
various.exampleZh: 这家商店以低价出售各种各样的水果。

vary.example: The weather can vary a lot from morning to night.
vary.exampleZh: 天气从早到晚可能会有很大变化。

vast.example: The vast desert stretches for miles beyond the small village.
vast.exampleZh: 广阔的沙漠从小村庄向外延伸数英里。

vault.example: The old bank keeps its gold in a heavy vault under the building.
vault.exampleZh: 那家老银行把黄金存放在大楼下方一个沉重的金库里。

vector.example: A vector has both size and direction, so it helps us describe movement.
vector.exampleZh: 向量既有大小又有方向，因此它帮助我们描述运动。

veer.example: The car veered to the left to avoid a dog on the road.
veer.exampleZh: 汽车向左转向，以避开路上的一条狗。

veil.example: The bride wore a white veil and smiled at everyone.
veil.exampleZh: 新娘戴着白色面纱，对每个人微笑。

vein.example: The doctor found a small vein in his arm and gave him medicine.
vein.exampleZh: 医生在他手臂上找到一根小静脉，并给他用了药。

velocity.example: The velocity of the car increased quickly as it went down the hill.
velocity.exampleZh: 汽车下山时速度很快增加了。

velvet.example: She wore a long dress made of soft red velvet.
velvet.exampleZh: 她穿了一条柔软红色天鹅绒长裙。

vendor.example: The vendor sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the street market every morning.
vendor.exampleZh: 那个小贩每天早上在街市上卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

vengeance.example: He finally got his vengeance on the man who stole his money.
vengeance.exampleZh: 他终于向那个偷走他钱的人报了仇。

venom.example: The snake's venom is dangerous, so stay away from it.
venom.exampleZh: 这条蛇的毒液很危险，所以要离它远一点。

vent.example: The small vent in the wall lets hot air out of the kitchen.
vent.exampleZh: 墙上那个小小的通风口让厨房里的热气排出去。

ventilate.example: We open the windows every morning to ventilate the small kitchen.
ventilate.exampleZh: 我们每天早上打开窗户，让这个小厨房通风。

venture.example: They started a small business venture and soon dared to enter a new market.
venture.exampleZh: 他们创办了一家小型企业，并很快敢于进入一个新市场。

verbal.example: Her verbal agreement was not enough, so we signed a contract.
verbal.exampleZh: 她的口头同意还不够，所以我们签了一份合同。

verdict.example: The jury reached a verdict after two hours of careful discussion.
verdict.exampleZh: 陪审团经过两小时的仔细讨论后作出了裁决。

verge.example: The old house stands on the verge of the forest.
verge.exampleZh: 那座老房子坐落在森林的边缘。

verify.example: Please verify the address before you send the package.
verify.exampleZh: 寄包裹之前请核实一下地址。

versatile.example: She is a versatile cook who can make many different dishes.
versatile.exampleZh: 她是一位多才多艺的厨师，能做许多不同的菜。

verse.example: She wrote a short verse about the sea for her class.
verse.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一首关于大海的短诗。

version.example: This new version of the app is faster and easier to use.
version.exampleZh: 这个新版本的应用程序更快，也更容易使用。

versus.example: Tonight's match is the champions versus the young challengers.
versus.exampleZh: 今晚的比赛是冠军队对阵年轻的挑战者。

vertical.example: Draw a vertical line down the middle of the page.
vertical.exampleZh: 在页面中间画一条垂直线。

vessel.example: The small vessel carried fresh water across the wide river.
vessel.exampleZh: 这只小船载着淡水穿过宽阔的河流。

veteran.example: The veteran shared his stories with the young soldiers.
veteran.exampleZh: 这位老兵和年轻的士兵们分享了他的故事。

veto.example: The president used his veto to block the new law.
veto.exampleZh: 总统使用了否决权来阻止这项新法律。

via.example: We flew to Paris via London and arrived late at night.
via.exampleZh: 我们经由伦敦飞往巴黎，深夜才到达。

viable.example: This plan is viable because it is cheap and easy to start.
viable.exampleZh: 这个方案可行，因为它成本低而且容易启动。

vibrant.example: The vibrant colors of the flowers make the small garden look beautiful.
vibrant.exampleZh: 花朵鲜艳的色彩让这个小花园看起来很漂亮。

vibrate.example: The phone began to vibrate on the table next to my bed.
vibrate.exampleZh: 手机开始在我床边的桌子上振动起来。

vice.example: His only vice is eating too much sweet food late at night.
vice.exampleZh: 他唯一的恶习是深夜吃太多甜食。

vicinity.example: There are several small shops in the vicinity of our school.
vicinity.exampleZh: 我们学校附近有几家小商店。

vicious.example: That vicious dog bit a small boy on the leg yesterday.
vicious.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗昨天咬了一个小男孩的腿。

victim.example: The victim of the car accident was taken to the hospital quickly.
victim.exampleZh: 车祸的受害者被迅速送往医院。

victory.example: The whole team ran onto the field to celebrate their great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 全队跑上场地庆祝他们的伟大胜利。

video.example: I watched a short video about animals on my phone last night.
video.exampleZh: 昨晚我在手机上看了一个关于动物的短视频。

view.example: The view from the top of the hill is beautiful.
view.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色很美。

vigilant.example: The guard stayed vigilant all night and watched the gate carefully.
vigilant.exampleZh: 警卫整夜保持警惕，仔细看守着大门。

vigor.example: She worked with great vigor all morning and never seemed tired.
vigor.exampleZh: 她整个上午都干劲十足，似乎从不觉得累。

vigorous.example: He is a vigorous old man who walks five miles every morning.
vigorous.exampleZh: 他是一位精力充沛的老人，每天早上走五英里。

vigorously.example: She shook the bottle vigorously before opening it.
vigorously.exampleZh: 她在打开瓶子前用力摇了摇。

village.example: The small village is quiet in the morning and busy in the evening.
village.exampleZh: 这个小村庄早上很安静，晚上很忙碌。

vinegar.example: Add a little vinegar to the sauce to make it taste better.
vinegar.exampleZh: 在酱汁里加一点醋，让它味道更好。

violate.example: You must not violate the rules of the game.

violence.example: The school teaches children to solve problems without violence.
violence.exampleZh: 学校教导孩子们不用暴力解决问题。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many windows in our old school building last night.
violent.exampleZh: 昨晚那场猛烈的暴风雨打破了我们那栋老旧教学楼的许多窗户。

violet.example: She wore a violet dress and picked a small violet in the garden.
violet.exampleZh: 她穿着一条紫色的连衣裙，还在花园里摘了一朵小紫罗兰。

violin.example: My sister plays the violin in the school music group every Friday.
violin.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周五在学校音乐团里拉小提琴。

virtual.example: This online school gives students a virtual classroom and real teachers.
virtual.exampleZh: 这所网络学校为学生提供虚拟教室和真实的老师。

virtually.example: The two plans are virtually the same, so you can choose either one.
virtually.exampleZh: 这两个计划几乎完全相同，所以你可以任选一个。

virtue.example: Patience is a virtue that helps us in many hard situations.
virtue.exampleZh: 耐心是一种美德，能在许多艰难处境中帮助我们。

virus.example: The virus made my little brother stay in bed for three days.
virus.exampleZh: 这种病毒让我弟弟在床上躺了三天。

visible.example: The stars are clearly visible in the sky tonight.
visible.exampleZh: 今晚天空中的星星清晰可见。

vision.example: Good vision helps you see things clearly in the dark.
vision.exampleZh: 良好的视力能帮助你在黑暗中看清东西。

visit.example: I visit my grandparents every Sunday morning.
visit.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上都去看望我的祖父母。

visual.example: The movie has beautiful visual effects that make the story feel real.
visual.exampleZh: 这部电影有漂亮的视觉效果，让故事感觉很真实。

vital.example: Good sleep is vital for children and for older people too.
vital.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对儿童和老年人来说都至关重要。

vivid.example: She gave a vivid description of her trip to the small mountain village.
vivid.exampleZh: 她生动地描述了那次去小山村旅行的经历。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day is a good way to build your vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读是积累词汇量的好方法。

vocal.example: She became very vocal about the problem at work last week.
vocal.exampleZh: 上周她对工作中的那个问题变得非常直言不讳。

vocation.example: She felt that teaching was her true vocation in life.
vocation.exampleZh: 她觉得教书是她一生真正的天职。

voice.example: She spoke in a soft voice so the baby would not wake up.
voice.exampleZh: 她用轻柔的嗓音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。

void.example: The empty room felt like a void after they moved out.
void.exampleZh: 他们搬走后，那个空房间让人感到一片空虚。

volcano.example: The volcano near our town has not erupted for many years.
volcano.exampleZh: 我们镇附近的火山已经很多年没有喷发了。

voluble.example: My voluble neighbor talked about her garden for an hour.
voluble.exampleZh: 我那位健谈的邻居聊她的花园聊了一个小时。

volume.example: The volume of the music was too loud for the small room.
volume.exampleZh: 音乐的音量对这个小房间来说太大了。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the local animal shelter every Saturday.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每周六在当地动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: She works as a volunteer at the local hospital every weekend.
volunteer.exampleZh: 她每个周末在当地医院做志愿者。

vomit.example: He felt sick on the bus and had to vomit twice.
vomit.exampleZh: 他在公交车上感到恶心，不得不吐了两次。

vote.example: Every citizen should vote in the election to choose a better leader.
vote.exampleZh: 每个公民都应该在选举中投票，选出更好的领导人。

voucher.example: Please keep this voucher because you will need it at the front desk.
voucher.exampleZh: 请保管好这张凭证，因为你在前台会需要它。

voyage.example: The voyage across the ocean took three long weeks.
voyage.exampleZh: 横渡大洋的航行花了三个漫长的星期。

vulgar.example: His vulgar jokes made everyone at the dinner table uncomfortable.
vulgar.exampleZh: 他粗俗的笑话让餐桌上的每个人都感到不舒服。

vulnerable.example: Young children are vulnerable when they walk alone on busy streets.
vulnerable.exampleZh: 小孩子独自走在繁忙的街道上时很容易受到伤害。

waddle.example: The little duck waddled across the road to reach the pond.
waddle.exampleZh: 小鸭子摇摇摆摆地穿过马路，走向池塘。

wade.example: We had to wade through the cold river to reach the other side.
wade.exampleZh: 我们不得不涉过冰冷的河水到达对岸。

wafer.example: The wafer is thin and crisp, and it tastes very sweet.
wafer.exampleZh: 这块薄脆饼又薄又脆，味道很甜。

waffle.example: Stop waffling and tell me what you really want to do.
waffle.exampleZh: 别再含糊其辞了，告诉我你到底想做什么。

wag.example: The happy dog likes to wag its tail when I come home.
wag.exampleZh: 我回家时，那只开心的狗喜欢摇尾巴。

wage.example: The workers asked for a higher wage and better working conditions.
wage.exampleZh: 工人们要求更高的工资和更好的工作条件。

wager.example: He made a small wager with his friend on the game.
wager.exampleZh: 他和朋友就这场比赛打了一个小赌。

waggle.example: The happy dog likes to waggle its tail when I come home.
waggle.exampleZh: 我回家时，那只快乐的狗喜欢摇尾巴。

waggon.example: The farmer loaded the hay onto the waggon before the long journey.
waggon.exampleZh: 农夫把干草装上货运马车，然后开始了漫长的旅程。

wail.example: The baby began to wail when her mother left the room.
wail.exampleZh: 妈妈离开房间时，婴儿开始恸哭起来。

waist.example: She tied a red belt around her waist before going out.
waist.exampleZh: 她出门前在腰间系了一条红腰带。

wait.example: Please wait for me here while I buy the tickets.
wait.exampleZh: 我去买票的时候，请在这里等我。

waiter.example: The waiter brought us two cups of hot tea.
waiter.exampleZh: 服务员给我们端来了两杯热茶。

waive.example: The school will waive the fee for students from poor families.
waive.exampleZh: 学校将为贫困家庭的学生免除这项费用。

wake.example: I wake at six every morning and drink a cup of tea.
wake.exampleZh: 我每天早上六点醒来，喝一杯茶。

wakeful.example: She was wakeful all night and could not fall asleep.

walk.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
walk.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起步行去学校。

walkout.example: The workers staged a walkout to protest against the low pay.
walkout.exampleZh: 工人们举行罢工，抗议低工资。

wall.example: There is a tall stone wall around the old garden.
wall.exampleZh: 旧花园周围有一堵高高的石墙。

wallet.example: I lost my wallet on the bus yesterday and had to walk home.
wallet.exampleZh: 我昨天在公交车上把钱包丢了，只好走回家。

wallop.example: The big wave walloped the small boat and almost turned it over.
wallop.exampleZh: 巨浪猛击小船，差点把它掀翻。

walnut.example: The table is made of dark walnut and looks very nice in our room.
walnut.exampleZh: 这张桌子是用深色胡桃木做的，放在我们房间里很好看。

walrus.example: A walrus has two long tusks and lives in cold seas.
walrus.exampleZh: 海象有两根长牙，生活在寒冷的海域。

wand.example: The old wizard pointed his wand at the door and it opened.
wand.exampleZh: 老巫师用魔杖指向门，门就开了。

wander.example: I like to wander around the old town on quiet Sunday mornings.
wander.exampleZh: 我喜欢在安静的周日早晨在老城区漫步。

wanderlust.example: Her wanderlust took her to many small towns across Asia last year.
wanderlust.exampleZh: 去年，她的漫游癖让她去了亚洲的许多小镇。

wane.example: The moon begins to wane after it is full at night.
wane.exampleZh: 月亮在夜里变圆之后就开始亏缺。

wanting.example: His skills are wanting, so he needs more training.
wanting.exampleZh: 他的技能还不够，所以需要更多训练。

war.example: The country suffered greatly during the long war.
war.exampleZh: 这个国家在漫长的战争中遭受了巨大苦难。

warble.example: A small bird began to warble softly in the tree outside my window.
warble.exampleZh: 一只小鸟开始在我窗外的树上轻柔地鸣唱。

ward.example: The nurse walked into the ward to check on the patients.
ward.exampleZh: 护士走进病房查看病人的情况。

warden.example: The warden keeps the prison safe and checks every cell each night.
warden.exampleZh: 监狱长维护监狱的安全，每晚巡查每间牢房。

ware.example: The shop sells kitchen ware made of glass and steel.
ware.exampleZh: 这家商店出售玻璃和钢制成的厨房器皿。

warehouse.example: The workers moved the boxes into the warehouse before noon.
warehouse.exampleZh: 工人们在中午前把箱子搬进了仓库。

warfare.example: Modern warfare often uses computers and drones instead of soldiers.
warfare.exampleZh: 现代战争往往使用计算机和无人机，而不是士兵。

warily.example: She walked warily into the dark room and looked around.
warily.exampleZh: 她谨慎地走进那间黑屋子，环顾四周。

warm.example: Her warm smile made everyone feel welcome at the party.
warm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑让每个人在聚会上都感到受欢迎。

warmth.example: The warmth of the fire made us feel safe and happy.
warmth.exampleZh: 火的温暖让我们感到安全和快乐。

warn.example: The teacher warned us to be quiet in the library.
warn.exampleZh: 老师告诫我们在图书馆里要保持安静。

warp.example: The hot sun can warp old wooden doors and window frames.
warp.exampleZh: 烈日会使旧木门和窗框变形。

warrant.example: The police had a warrant to search the old house.
warrant.exampleZh: 警方持有搜查那栋老房子的授权令。

warranty.example: The shop gave me a one-year warranty for the new laptop.
warranty.exampleZh: 商店为这台新笔记本电脑提供了一年的保修。

warrior.example: The brave warrior fought hard to protect his village from danger.
warrior.exampleZh: 这位勇敢的战士奋力作战，保护他的村庄免受危险。

wary.example: Be wary of strangers who offer you money on the street.
wary.exampleZh: 要警惕那些在街上主动给你钱的陌生人。

wash.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner.

washout.example: The heavy rain caused a washout on the road near our school.
washout.exampleZh: 大雨在我们学校附近的路面上造成了冲刷。

wasp.example: A wasp flew into the kitchen and scared my little sister.
wasp.exampleZh: 一只黄蜂飞进厨房，把我妹妹吓坏了。

waste.example: Don't waste your time on small problems; save your energy for the big ones.
waste.exampleZh: 不要在小问题上浪费时间，把精力留给大问题。

wasteful.example: It is wasteful to buy new clothes when you already have many.
wasteful.exampleZh: 你已经有很多衣服了，再买新衣服是浪费的。

watch.example: We watch the birds in the park and my father wears a watch.
watch.exampleZh: 我们在公园里观看鸟儿，我父亲戴着一块手表。

watchdog.example: The watchdog guards the house and barks at every stranger.
watchdog.exampleZh: 看门狗守着房子，对每个陌生人都叫。

water.example: Please give me a glass of water, and I will water the plants later.
water.exampleZh: 请给我一杯水，我稍后会给植物浇水。

waterfall.example: We walked for two hours and finally saw the waterfall in the forest.
waterfall.exampleZh: 我们走了两个小时，终于在森林里看到了瀑布。

waterproof.example: I wear a waterproof coat when it rains because my old one gets wet.
waterproof.exampleZh: 下雨时我穿一件防水外套，因为我的旧外套会湿。

watershed.example: That election became a watershed in the history of our country.
watershed.exampleZh: 那场选举成为我们国家历史上的一个转折点。

watertight.example: The box is watertight, so rain cannot get inside.
watertight.exampleZh: 这个箱子是防水的，所以雨水进不去。

watt.example: This small lamp uses only five watts of power each hour.
watt.exampleZh: 这盏小灯每小时只使用五瓦的电力。

wave.example: The children wave at the train as it goes past.
wave.exampleZh: 火车经过时，孩子们向火车挥手。

waveform.example: The scientist used a computer to show the waveform of the sound on the screen.
waveform.exampleZh: 科学家用电脑在屏幕上显示声音的波形。

wavelength.example: The red light has a longer wavelength than the blue light.
wavelength.exampleZh: 红光的波长比蓝光的波长更长。

waver.example: He did not waver for a moment before he said yes.
waver.exampleZh: 他在说“是”之前一刻也没有犹豫。

wax.example: The moon will wax until it is full next week.
wax.exampleZh: 月亮会逐渐变圆，直到下周满月。

way.example: This is the best way to learn English quickly.
way.exampleZh: 这是快速学英语的最好方法。

waylay.example: Three men tried to waylay him on his way home last night.
waylay.exampleZh: 昨晚有三个人想在他回家的路上拦截他。

weak.example: He felt weak after the long walk and sat down to rest.
weak.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，他感到很虚弱，便坐下来休息。

weakness.example: His greatest weakness is that he cannot say no to sweet food.
weakness.exampleZh: 他最大的弱点就是无法对甜食说不。

wealth.example: His wealth grew slowly through years of hard work and careful saving.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的财富通过多年的辛勤工作和谨慎储蓄慢慢增长。

wean.example: It takes time to wean a baby from milk to solid food.
wean.exampleZh: 让婴儿从吃奶断奶到吃固体食物需要时间。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon in the man's car.
weapon.exampleZh: 警察在那个男人的车里发现了一件武器。

wear.example: She likes to wear a blue coat in winter.
wear.exampleZh: 她冬天喜欢穿一件蓝色外套。

weary.example: After the long trip, the weary children fell asleep at once.
weary.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，疲倦的孩子们立刻就睡着了。

weather.example: The weather is very cold today, so please wear a warm coat.
weather.exampleZh: 今天天气很冷，请穿一件暖和的外套。

weave.example: The old woman can weave a beautiful basket from dry grass.
weave.exampleZh: 那位老妇人能用干草编织出漂亮的篮子。

web.example: The spider made a small web between two green leaves.
web.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在两片绿叶之间结了一张小网。

wed.example: They plan to wed next spring in a small church near their home.
wed.exampleZh: 他们打算明年春天在他们家附近的一座小教堂里结婚。

wedding.example: My sister's wedding will be in a small garden next Saturday.
wedding.exampleZh: 我姐姐的婚礼将于下周六在一个小花园里举行。

wedge.example: He used a wooden wedge to keep the door open.
wedge.exampleZh: 他用一个木楔子把门撑开。

weed.example: We need to weed the garden before the flowers stop growing.
weed.exampleZh: 我们需要在花停止生长之前给花园除草。

week.example: I have three English classes this week.

weep.example: The little girl began to weep when her toy fell into the river.
weep.exampleZh: 小女孩的玩具掉进河里时，她开始哭了起来。

weigh.example: She will weigh the box before she sends it to her friend.
weigh.exampleZh: 她会在把盒子寄给朋友之前先称一下它的重量。

weight.example: The weight of my old bike makes it hard to carry upstairs.
weight.exampleZh: 我旧自行车的重量让它很难搬上楼。

weird.example: It is weird that my cat sleeps in the sink every night.
weird.exampleZh: 很奇怪，我的猫每天晚上都睡在水槽里。

welcome.example: We welcome all new students to our school every September.
welcome.exampleZh: 每年九月我们都欢迎所有新同学来到我们学校。

weld.example: He learned to weld metal in the factory last year.
weld.exampleZh: 他去年在工厂里学会了焊接金属。

welfare.example: The government should take care of the welfare of old people.
welfare.exampleZh: 政府应当关心老年人的福利。

well.example: She speaks English well and helps her friends at school.
well.exampleZh: 她英语说得很好，还在学校帮助朋友们。

well-being.example: Daily exercise and enough sleep are important for your well-being.
well-being.exampleZh: 每天锻炼和充足睡眠对你的健康很重要。

west.example: The sun sets in the west every evening.
west.exampleZh: 太阳每天傍晚在西方落下。

westward.example: The birds flew westward across the lake before the sun went down.
westward.exampleZh: 太阳落山前，鸟群向西飞过湖面。

wet.example: Her coat was wet after the long walk in the rain.
wet.exampleZh: 在雨中走了很久之后，她的外套湿了。

wetland.example: Many birds live in the wetland near our town.
wetland.exampleZh: 许多鸟类生活在我们镇附近的湿地。

whack.example: The ball hit the fence with a loud whack, and we all laughed.
whack.exampleZh: 球重重地撞在栅栏上，发出一声响，我们都笑了。

whale.example: We saw a huge whale swim near our small fishing boat.
whale.exampleZh: 我们看到一头巨大的鲸在我们的小渔船附近游动。

wharf.example: The small boat waited at the old wharf for its passengers.
wharf.exampleZh: 小船在旧码头等候乘客。

whatsoever.example: He had no money whatsoever, so he could not buy the ticket.
whatsoever.exampleZh: 他一点钱都没有，所以买不了票。

wheat.example: My grandmother makes bread from wheat that she grows on her farm.
wheat.exampleZh: 我奶奶用她农场里种的小麦做面包。

wheedle.example: She tried to wheedle her father into buying her a new phone.
wheedle.exampleZh: 她试着哄她爸爸给她买一部新手机。

wheel.example: He turned the wheel to the left and drove slowly down the hill.
wheel.exampleZh: 他把方向盘向左转，慢慢开下山坡。

whelm.example: The sudden flood whelmed the small village in deep water.
whelm.exampleZh: 突如其来的洪水淹没了这个小村庄。

when.example: I was reading a book when the phone rang loudly.
when.exampleZh: 电话响得很响的时候，我正在看书。

which.example: Which of these two books do you want to read first?
which.exampleZh: 这两本书中，你想先读哪一本？

while.example: Please wait here for a while while I find the doctor.
while.exampleZh: 请在这里等一会儿，我去找医生。

whim.example: She bought the hat on a whim and never wore it.
whim.exampleZh: 她一时兴起买了那顶帽子，却从未戴过。

whimsical.example: Her whimsical drawings of flying cats make everyone in class smile.
whimsical.exampleZh: 她那些异想天开的飞猫画作让班上每个人都笑了。

whip.example: The driver used a long whip to make the horses run faster.
whip.exampleZh: 赶车人用一条长鞭子让马跑得更快。

whirl.example: The dancers began to whirl around the room in a happy circle.
whirl.exampleZh: 舞者们开始快乐地围成一圈在房间里旋转。

whisk.example: She used a whisk to mix the eggs in a small bowl.
whisk.exampleZh: 她用搅拌器在一个小碗里搅拌鸡蛋。

whisper.example: She leaned over to whisper a secret in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她俯身在我耳边低声说了一个秘密。

whistle.example: The referee blew his whistle and the players stopped running.
whistle.exampleZh: 裁判吹响了哨子，球员们停了下来。

white.example: The white cat is sleeping on the warm sofa.
white.exampleZh: 那只白色的猫正在温暖的沙发上睡觉。

who.example: Who is the man standing next to your sister at the door?
who.exampleZh: 站在门口你妹妹旁边的那个男人是谁？

wholesale.example: They buy fruit at wholesale prices and sell it in small shops.
wholesale.exampleZh: 他们以批发价买水果，然后在小商店里出售。

wholesome.example: Eating fresh vegetables and fruit every day is a wholesome habit.
wholesome.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜蔬菜和水果是一个有益健康的习惯。

wholly.example: I wholly agree with your plan for the new school library.
wholly.exampleZh: 我完全同意你关于新学校图书馆的计划。

whopping.example: The company spent a whopping two million dollars on the new ad.
whopping.exampleZh: 公司在这则新广告上花了高达两百万美元的天大数目。

why.example: Why do you want to learn English with me?
why.exampleZh: 你为什么想和我一起学英语？

wick.example: The candle burned brightly after she trimmed the wick with scissors.
wick.exampleZh: 她用剪刀修剪烛芯后，蜡烛烧得很亮。

wide.example: The river is very wide, so we cannot swim across it.
wide.exampleZh: 这条河非常宽，所以我们无法游过去。

widespread.example: The use of smartphones is now widespread among people of all ages.
widespread.exampleZh: 如今，智能手机的使用在各年龄段的人群中都很普遍。

widow.example: The widow lives alone with her two young children in a small house.
widow.exampleZh: 这位寡妇带着两个年幼的孩子住在一间小房子里。

width.example: The width of the table is one meter.
width.exampleZh: 这张桌子的宽度是一米。

wield.example: The manager can wield great power in this company.
wield.exampleZh: 经理在这家公司里能行使很大的权力。

wife.example: My wife cooks dinner for our family every evening after work.
wife.exampleZh: 我妻子每天下班后都为家人做晚饭。

wiggle.example: The little dog wiggled its tail when I came home.
wiggle.exampleZh: 我回家时，小狗扭动着尾巴。

wild.example: Many wild animals live in the forest near our small town.
wild.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在我们小镇附近的森林里。

wilderness.example: Many animals live in the wilderness far from any town.
wilderness.exampleZh: 许多动物生活在远离任何城镇的荒野中。

will.example: She has a strong will and never gives up her dream.
will.exampleZh: 她有坚强的意志，从不放弃自己的梦想。

willful.example: Her willful refusal to listen caused a lot of trouble for everyone.
willful.exampleZh: 她任性地拒绝听取意见，给大家带来了很多麻烦。

willow.example: The old willow by the river has long green branches.
willow.exampleZh: 河边那棵老柳树有着长长的绿色枝条。

wilt.example: Without water, the flowers in the garden will wilt quickly.
wilt.exampleZh: 没有水，花园里的花很快就会枯萎。

win.example: Our team played well and we hope to win the final game.
win.exampleZh: 我们队打得很好，我们希望赢得最后一场比赛。

wind.example: The cold wind blew through the trees all night.

winding.example: The winding road goes up the hill to our small village.
winding.exampleZh: 那条蜿蜒的路顺着山坡向上，通向我们的村子。

windmill.example: The old windmill on the hill turns slowly when the wind blows.
windmill.exampleZh: 山上的那座老风车在风吹起时慢慢转动。

window.example: She opened the window to let some fresh air into the room.
window.exampleZh: 她打开窗户，让新鲜空气进入房间。

windshield.example: The rain hit the windshield hard as we drove home last night.
windshield.exampleZh: 昨晚我们开车回家时，雨点重重地打在挡风玻璃上。

wine.example: My father likes to drink a glass of red wine with dinner.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢晚饭时喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt one wing and could not fly for a few days.
wing.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了一只翅膀，好几天不能飞。

wink.example: She gave me a quick wink and then smiled at the funny joke.
wink.exampleZh: 她迅速向我使了个眼色，然后对那个有趣的笑话笑了笑。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and held up his gold medal.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着举起了他的金牌。

winter.example: We like to make snowmen in the winter.
winter.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在冬天堆雪人。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table with a clean cloth after dinner.
wipe.exampleZh: 晚饭后请用干净的布擦一下桌子。

wire.example: The worker used a thin wire to hang the picture on the wall.
wire.exampleZh: 工人用一根细金属丝把画挂在墙上。

wisdom.example: My grandmother shared her wisdom with us at dinner every Sunday.
wisdom.exampleZh: 每个星期天吃晚饭时，奶奶都会和我们分享她的智慧。

wise.example: It is wise to ask for help when you are not sure.
wise.exampleZh: 当你不确定时，寻求帮助是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck in your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在新工作中好运。

wisp.example: A thin wisp of smoke rose quietly from the old chimney.
wisp.exampleZh: 一缕细细的烟从旧烟囱里静静地升起。

wistful.example: She gave a wistful smile when she looked at her old school photos.
wistful.exampleZh: 她看着旧时的学校照片，露出留恋的微笑。

wit.example: Her quick wit made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
wit.exampleZh: 她机智风趣，让每个人在漫长的会议中都笑了。

witch.example: The old witch lives in a small house near the dark forest.
witch.exampleZh: 那个老巫婆住在黑暗森林附近的一所小房子里。

with.example: She went to the park with her two best friends after school.
with.exampleZh: 放学后她和两个最好的朋友一起去了公园。

withdraw.example: He decided to withdraw some money from the bank this morning.
withdraw.exampleZh: 他决定今天上午从银行取一些钱。

wither.example: Without water, the flowers in the garden will wither and die.
wither.exampleZh: 没有水，花园里的花将会枯萎死去。

withhold.example: The company may withhold your pay if you do not finish the work.
withhold.exampleZh: 如果你不完成这项工作，公司可能会扣留你的工资。

within.example: Please finish the report within two days.
within.exampleZh: 请在两天内完成这份报告。

without.example: I cannot drink coffee without milk in the morning.
without.exampleZh: 我早上喝咖啡不能不加牛奶。

withstand.example: These old buildings can withstand strong winds and heavy rain.
withstand.exampleZh: 这些老建筑能经受住强风和暴雨。

witness.example: She was a witness to the accident and told the police everything.
witness.exampleZh: 她是那起事故的目击者，把一切都告诉了警察。

witty.example: She is a witty writer who makes simple stories very funny.
witty.exampleZh: 她是一位机智幽默的作家，能把简单的故事写得非常有趣。

wizard.example: The old wizard can make a rabbit disappear with a wave of his hand.
wizard.exampleZh: 那位老男巫一挥手就能让兔子消失。

wobble.example: The old table began to wobble when he put the heavy box on it.
wobble.exampleZh: 当他把那个沉重的箱子放在上面时，旧桌子开始晃动。

woe.example: She told me all her woes after losing her job.
woe.exampleZh: 她失业后向我诉说了她所有的烦恼。

wolf.example: The wolf walked slowly through the snow looking for food.
wolf.exampleZh: 那只狼在雪地里慢慢走着寻找食物。

woman.example: The woman next to me on the bus was reading an old book.
woman.exampleZh: 公交车上坐在我旁边的那位女士正在读一本旧书。

womanize.example: He lost his job because he liked to womanize instead of working.
womanize.exampleZh: 他因为喜欢玩弄女性而不专心工作，结果丢了工作。

wonder.example: I wonder how this small town became such a famous wonder.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道这个小镇是如何成为如此著名的奇迹的。

woo.example: The young man tried to woo her with flowers and songs.
woo.exampleZh: 那个年轻人用鲜花和歌声来向她求爱。

wood.example: The table is made of wood and it looks very strong.
wood.exampleZh: 这张桌子是木头做的，看起来很结实。

woodcut.example: This old woodcut shows a farmer working in the field.
woodcut.exampleZh: 这幅古老的木版画描绘了一位在田里劳作的农夫。

woodland.example: We walked through the quiet woodland and saw many birds.
woodland.exampleZh: 我们穿过安静的林地，看到了许多鸟。

woodpecker.example: A woodpecker is making a hole in the tree behind our house.
woodpecker.exampleZh: 一只啄木鸟正在我们房子后面的树上凿洞。

wool.example: My grandmother made a warm sweater from soft wool.
wool.exampleZh: 我奶奶用柔软的羊毛织了一件暖和的毛衣。

word.example: I do not know the meaning of this word.
word.exampleZh: 我不知道这个词的意思。

wording.example: The wording of your email is clear and easy to understand.
wording.exampleZh: 你邮件的措辞清晰易懂。

work.example: She likes her work because it helps many people.
work.exampleZh: 她喜欢自己的工作，因为它能帮助很多人。

workforce.example: The company needs a larger workforce to finish this big project on time.
workforce.exampleZh: 这家公司需要更多的劳动力才能按时完成这个大型项目。

workload.example: The new system greatly reduced my daily workload.
workload.exampleZh: 新系统大大减轻了我每天的工作量。

workshop.example: She learned to use the new machine in the workshop last week.
workshop.exampleZh: 她上周在车间学会了使用这台新机器。

world.example: The internet lets people from around the world share ideas easily.
world.exampleZh: 互联网让世界各地的人们轻松分享想法。

worldwide.example: The company has offices worldwide and sells its products in many countries.
worldwide.exampleZh: 这家公司在世界各地设有办事处，并在许多国家销售产品。

worm.example: The bird found a small worm in the wet grass.
worm.exampleZh: 那只鸟在湿润的草丛里发现了一条小虫子。

worry.example: My mother always worries about me when I travel far from home.
worry.exampleZh: 每次我出远门，妈妈总是为我担心。

worse.example: The weather is worse today, so we should stay at home.
worse.exampleZh: 今天天气更糟了，所以我们应该待在家里。

worship.example: Many people go to the church on Sunday to worship together.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人星期天去教堂一起礼拜。

worst.example: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
worst.exampleZh: 这是我看过的最糟糕的电影。

worth.example: This old book is worth more than the money I paid for it.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书的价值超过我为它付的钱。

worthless.example: This old phone is worthless because the screen is broken.
worthless.exampleZh: 这部旧手机因为没有价值，因为屏幕坏了。

worthwhile.example: It is worthwhile to spend time with your family every day.
worthwhile.exampleZh: 每天花时间陪伴家人是值得的。

worthy.example: She is a worthy teacher who always helps her students with patience.
worthy.exampleZh: 她是一位值得尊敬的好老师，总是耐心地帮助学生。

would.example: I would like a cup of tea, please.

wound.example: The nurse cleaned the wound on his leg and put a bandage on it.
wound.exampleZh: 护士清洗了他腿上的伤口，并给它缠上了绷带。

wrangle.example: The two brothers wrangle over money every time they meet.
wrangle.exampleZh: 两兄弟每次见面都会为钱争吵。

wrap.example: She wrapped the gift in bright paper before giving it to him.
wrap.exampleZh: 她把礼物用亮色的纸包好，然后才送给他。

wrap-up.example: The teacher gave a short wrap-up at the end of the class.
wrap-up.exampleZh: 老师在课程结束时做了一个简短的总结。

wrath.example: His face turned red with wrath when he saw the broken window.
wrath.exampleZh: 当他看到破碎的窗户时，他气得脸都红了。

wreath.example: She laid a wreath of white flowers on the old stone grave.
wreath.exampleZh: 她在古老的石墓上放了一个白花花圈。

wreck.example: The storm wrecked the small boat near the rocks, but all the sailors were safe.
wreck.exampleZh: 风暴在岩石附近毁坏了那艘小船，但所有水手都安然无恙。

wrench.example: He used a wrench to turn the rusty bolt, then wrenched his back.
wrench.exampleZh: 他用扳手转动生锈的螺栓，然后扭伤了背。

wrest.example: The police had to wrest the knife from his hand.
wrest.exampleZh: 警察不得不从他手中夺下那把刀。

wrestle.example: The two boys began to wrestle on the grass after school.
wrestle.exampleZh: 放学后，两个男孩开始在草地上摔跤。

wrestling.example: My brother likes wrestling and watches it on TV every weekend.
wrestling.exampleZh: 我哥哥喜欢摔跤，每个周末都在电视上看。

wretch.example: The poor wretch had no home and slept in the cold street.
wretch.exampleZh: 那个可怜的人没有家，睡在寒冷的街上。

wretched.example: The poor family lived in a wretched little house without clean water.
wretched.exampleZh: 这户穷苦人家住在一间没有干净水的破旧小屋里。

wriggle.example: The little fish wriggled in my hands and then fell back into the water.
wriggle.exampleZh: 那条小鱼在我手里扭动着，随后又掉回了水里。

wring.example: She had to wring the wet towel before hanging it up.
wring.exampleZh: 她得先把湿毛巾拧干，然后再挂起来。

wrinkle.example: There is a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
wrinkle.exampleZh: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。

wrist.example: She hurt her wrist when she fell off her bike yesterday.
wrist.exampleZh: 她昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤到了手腕。

write.example: I write a short letter to my mother every week.
write.exampleZh: 我每周给妈妈写一封短信。

write-up.example: She wrote a short write-up about the school concert for the local newspaper.
write-up.exampleZh: 她为当地报纸写了一篇关于学校音乐会的简短报道。

writing.example: Her writing is clear and easy to read.

wrong.example: It is wrong to take things that are not yours.
wrong.exampleZh: 拿走不属于自己的东西是不道德的。

wrongdoing.example: The company denied any wrongdoing and said it would fight the case in court.
wrongdoing.exampleZh: 公司否认有任何不道德行为，并表示将在法庭上抗辩此案。

wrought.example: The wrought iron gate looked old but very strong.
wrought.exampleZh: 那扇锻铁大门看起来很旧，但非常坚固。

x-axis.example: On the graph, time is shown on the x-axis from left to right.
x-axis.exampleZh: 在图表上，时间从左到右显示在X轴上。

x-ray.example: The doctor took an x-ray of my arm to see the broken bone.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生给我的手臂拍了一张X光片，看看骨折的情况。

xenon.example: The bright blue light in the sign comes from xenon gas.
xenon.exampleZh: 招牌里明亮的蓝光来自氙气。

xenophobia.example: Xenophobia can make people treat newcomers unfairly.
xenophobia.exampleZh: 排外心理会让人们不公平地对待新来的人。

xerographic.example: The office bought a new xerographic machine to copy documents quickly.
xerographic.exampleZh: 办公室买了一台新的静电复印机，用来快速复印文件。

xerophyte.example: A cactus is a xerophyte that stores water in its thick stem.
xerophyte.exampleZh: 仙人掌是一种旱生植物，把水储存在粗厚的茎里。

xylem.example: Water moves up through the xylem of the plant stem.
xylem.exampleZh: 水分通过植物茎的木质部向上运输。

xylophone.example: My little sister can play a short song on the wooden xylophone.
xylophone.exampleZh: 我妹妹能用木琴演奏一首短曲。

yacht.example: They rented a small yacht and sailed along the coast for a week.
yacht.exampleZh: 他们租了一艘小游艇，沿着海岸航行了一个星期。

yam.example: My mother cooked yam soup with some pork for dinner.
yam.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚饭做了山药排骨汤。

yank.example: He yanked the door open and ran out into the street.
yank.exampleZh: 他猛地把门拉开，跑到了街上。

yard.example: Our dog likes to run around the yard after dinner.
yard.exampleZh: 我们的狗喜欢在晚饭后在院子里跑来跑去。

yardstick.example: The test score is a useful yardstick for measuring student progress.
yardstick.exampleZh: 考试分数是衡量学生进步的有用标准。

yarn.example: Grandma told us a funny yarn about her old village school.
yarn.exampleZh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于她村里旧学校的有趣故事。

yarrow.example: The old woman picked some yarrow in the field to make tea.
yarrow.exampleZh: 那位老妇人在田野里采了一些蓍草用来泡茶。

year.example: My sister will start college next year in a new city.
year.exampleZh: 我妹妹明年将在一座新城市开始上大学。

yearling.example: The farmer kept the yearling in a small field near the barn.
yearling.exampleZh: 农夫把那只一岁幼兽养在谷仓附近的一小块地里。

yearn.example: I yearn to see my old friends again after so many years.
yearn.exampleZh: 这么多年过去了，我渴望再次见到我的老朋友们。

yearning.example: She felt a deep yearning for her home in the mountains.
yearning.exampleZh: 她对山里的家乡有着深深的向往。

yeast.example: Yeast makes the bread rise and become soft.
yeast.exampleZh: 酵母使面包发酵膨胀并变得松软。

yell.example: The coach began to yell at the players when they missed the ball.
yell.exampleZh: 当球员们没接到球时，教练开始对他们大喊大叫。

yellow.example: She is wearing a bright yellow dress to the party today.
yellow.exampleZh: 她今天穿着一件鲜黄色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

yelp.example: The dog yelped when I stepped on its tail by accident.
yelp.exampleZh: 我不小心踩到它的尾巴时，那只狗尖叫了一声。

yes.example: Yes, I want to go with you to the park today.
yes.exampleZh: 是的，我今天想和你一起去公园。

yesterday.example: I saw my old friend at the park yesterday.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园里见到了我的老朋友。

yesteryear.example: In the quiet village, people still sing the songs of yesteryear.
yesteryear.exampleZh: 在这个安静的村庄里，人们仍然唱着往昔的歌曲。

yet.example: The bus has not arrived yet, so we must wait here.
yet.exampleZh: 公交车还没有到，所以我们必须在这里等。

yew.example: The old yew in our garden is tall and very green.
yew.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老紫杉又高又非常绿。

yield.example: The farm yields enough corn to feed all the animals.
yield.exampleZh: 这个农场出产的玉米足够喂养所有动物。

yoke.example: The ox wears a heavy wooden yoke around its neck.
yoke.exampleZh: 那头牛的脖子上套着一副沉重的木轭。

yolk.example: The yolk of a boiled egg is bright yellow and tastes very good.
yolk.exampleZh: 水煮蛋的蛋黄是亮黄色的，味道非常好。

yonder.example: The old house yonder looks quiet in the evening light.
yonder.exampleZh: 远处的那座老房子在暮色中显得很安静。

you.example: Can you help me carry these books to the classroom?
you.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到教室吗？

young.example: My young sister likes to play in the park after school.
young.exampleZh: 我年幼的妹妹喜欢放学后去公园玩。

youngster.example: The youngster across the street plays basketball with his friends every Saturday morning.
youngster.exampleZh: 街对面的那个少年每周六早上都和朋友们一起打篮球。

your.example: Please put your books on the desk before the class starts.
your.exampleZh: 上课前请把你的书放在桌子上。

youth.example: My grandfather often talks about the happy days of his youth.
youth.exampleZh: 我祖父经常谈起他青年时期的快乐时光。

yummy.example: The cake you made is really yummy and everyone wants more.
yummy.exampleZh: 你做的蛋糕真好吃，大家都想再来一些。

zany.example: His zany jokes made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
zany.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议中，他那些滑稽的笑话让每个人都笑了。

zeal.example: Her zeal for teaching made every class lively and full of joy.
zeal.exampleZh: 她对教学的热情让每堂课都生动而充满乐趣。

zealot.example: The zealot talked about his idea all day and never listened to others.
zealot.exampleZh: 那个狂热者整天谈论他的想法，从不听别人的话。

zealous.example: He is a zealous worker who always helps his friends.
zealous.exampleZh: 他是一个总是帮助朋友的热心工作者。

zebra.example: We saw a zebra with black and white stripes at the zoo.
zebra.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到了一只黑白条纹的斑马。

zenith.example: The sun was directly overhead at the zenith of the sky.
zenith.exampleZh: 太阳正好位于天空的天顶处。

zero.example: The temperature dropped to zero last night and the lake froze.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到零度，湖面结冰了。

zest.example: She added lemon zest to the cake and ate it with great zest.
zest.exampleZh: 她往蛋糕里加了柠檬皮屑，然后兴致勃勃地吃了它。

zigzag.example: The narrow road zigzags up the mountain behind our small village.
zigzag.exampleZh: 那条狭窄的小路在我们小村庄后面的山上蜿蜒而上。

zinc.example: This old gate is made of zinc so it will not rust.
zinc.exampleZh: 这扇旧门是用锌做的，所以不会生锈。

zip.example: He zipped up his jacket and ran to catch the bus.
zip.exampleZh: 他拉上夹克拉链，跑去赶公交车。

zone.example: This area is a quiet zone where cars are not allowed.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域是一个安静的禁行区，汽车不允许进入。

zoo.example: My little brother loves to see the pandas at the zoo.
zoo.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢去动物园看熊猫。

zoom.example: Prices zoomed up fast after the good news.
zoom.exampleZh: 好消息传来后，价格迅速飙升。
